text.body: <2.1> śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || vajra uvāca || ādau bhagavatā prokto vijayo bharatasya me || yacchrutvā vedmi cātmānaṃ brahmanvigatakalmaṣam ||1 || sukhaśrāvyaśca hṛdyaśca kathāsārastu bhārgava || kathāśca vividhāḥ proktāstatprasaṅgāttvayānagha || 2 || rasavatyaśca dharmajña sarvapāpakṣayaṅkarāḥ || yāstā brahmanprasaṅgena mayāpahṛtacetasā || 3 || prastutāstāḥ kathāstyaktāstā eva kathasva me || bhagavansarvadharmajña pratyakṣāmaladarthana || kathānāṃ tu prasaṅgena prastutā yāḥ kathāḥ purā ||4|| sudūramantarībhūtvā rāmasya viditātmanaḥ || tā eva śrotumicchāmi tvatto bhṛgukulodvaha ||5|| lokaṃ vāruṇamāsādya rāmo bhṛgukulodvahaḥ || śrutavāndevadeveśānkinnu bhūyaḥ pracetasaḥ ||6|| etanme sarvamācakṣva tatra me saṃśayo mahān || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || kālasya saṃkhyāṃ tāṃ śrutvā rāmaproktāṃ pracetasā || 7 || papraccha varuṇaṃ devaṃ rājadharmānataḥ param || pṛṣṭastu jāmadagnyena rāmaṃ prāha jaleśvaraḥ||8|| rājadharmāñchṛṇuṣvārya puṣkarāttanayānmama || rājadharmāḥ śrutāstena devāddaśaśatekṣaṇān || 9 || sa yathāvadvijānāti rājadharmāndvijottama || evamuktvā tadā rāmamānāyya ca tathā sutam || 10 || uvāca bhārgavasyāsya dharmānkathaya putraka || yatrayatrāsya sandeho bhaviṣyati mahātmanaḥ || 11 || tadupānuda bhadrante mama vākyena putraka || evamuktastathetyuktvā gṛhānninye bhṛgūttamam || tatrāsya kathayāmāsa rājadharmānmahodayān || 12 || rāmeṇa pṛṣṭo varuṇasya putro jagāda dharmānnṛpasattamānām || dravyānmahārthānbhuvi pālanāya lokasya sarvasya narendracandra || 13 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde rāmasya puṣkaragṛhagamanaṃ nāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ || 1 || <2.2> mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || sukhāsīno naraśreṣṭhaḥ puṣkarasya niveśane || papraccha puṣkaraṃ rāmo dharmanityo jitendriyaḥ || 1 || rāma uvāca || rāṣṭrasya kiṃ kṛtyatamaṃ tanmācakṣva pṛcchataḥ || ādāveva mahābhāga yādogaṇanṛpātmaja || 2 || puṣkara uvāca || rāṣṭrasya kṛtyaṃ dharmajña rājña evābhiṣecanam || anindramabalaṃ rāṣṭraṃ dasyavo'bhibhavantyuta || 3 || arājakeṣu rāṣṭreṣu dharmāvasthā na vidyate || varṇānāmāśramāṇāṃ ca vyavasthānaṃ ca bhārgava || 4 | arājakeṣu rāṣṭreṣu naiva kanyā pradīyate || vidyate mama tā naiva tathā vitteṣu kasyacit || 5 || svātmyo nyāyaḥ pravarteta viśvalopastathaiva ca || loke na kaścidvidyeta gurorvacanakārakaḥ || 6 ||| nādhīyīram̐strayīṃ vidyāṃ trayo varṇā dvijātayaḥ || devānāṃ yajanaṃ na syādanāvṛṣṭistato bhavet || 7 || nṛlokasuralokau ca syātāṃ saṃśayitāvubhau ||| janamārī bhavedghorā yadi rājā na pālayet ||8|| prajānāṃ rakṣaṇārthāya viṣṇutejopabṛṃhitaḥ || mānuṣye jāyate rājā devasattvavapurdharaḥ || 9 || yasminprasanne devasya prasādastūpajāyate || yasminkruddhe janasyāsya krodhaḥ samupajāyate || 10 || mahadbhiḥ puṇyasambhāraiḥ pārthivo rāma jāyate || yasyaikasya jagatsarvaṃ vacane rāma tiṣṭhati || 11 || cāturvarṇyaṃ svadharmasthaṃ teṣu deśeṣu jāyate || yeṣu deśeṣu rājendra rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ || 12 || mārakaṃ na ca durbhikṣaṃ nāgnicaurabhayaṃ tathā || na ca vyālabhayaṃ teṣāṃ yeṣāṃ dharmaparo nṛpaḥ || 13 || ādau vindeta nṛpatiṃ tato bhāryāṃ tato dhanam || kurājani janasyāsya kuto bhāryā kuto dhanam || 14 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena rāṣṭramukhye nareśvaraḥ || parīkṣya pūrvaiḥ kartavyo dhārmikaḥ satya saṅgaraḥ || 15 || yeṣāṃ hi rājā bhuvi dharmanityasteṣāṃ na loke bhayamasti kiñcit || tasmātprayatnena narendra kāryo rāṣṭrapradhānairnṛpatirvinītaḥ ||16|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde rāmaṃ prati puṣkaravākye rājapraśaṃsā nāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 2 || <2.3> puṣkara uvāca || sarvalakṣaṇalakṣaṇyo vinītaḥ priyadarśanaḥ || adīrghasūtrī dharmātmā jitakrodho jitendriyaḥ || 1 || sthūlalakṣo mahotsāhaḥ smitapūrvābhibhāṣakaḥ || surūpaḥ kulasaṃpannaḥ kṣiprakārī mahābalaḥ || 2 || brahmaṇyaścāvisaṃvādī dṛḍhabhaktiḥ priyaṃvadaḥ || alolupassaṃyatavāggaṃbhīraḥ priyadarśanaḥ || || 3 || nātidaṇḍo na nirdaṇḍaḥ cāracakṣurajihmagaḥ || vyavahāre samaḥ prāpte putrasya ripuṇā saha || 4 || rathe gaje'śve dhanuṣi vyāyāme ca kṛtaśramaḥ || upavāsatapaḥśīlo yajñayājī gurupriyaḥ || 5 || mantrisāṃvatsarādhīnaḥ samareṣvanivartakaḥ || kālajñaśca kṛtajñaśca nṛviśeṣajña eva ca || 6 || pūjyaṃ pūjayitā nityaṃ daṇḍyaṃ daṇḍayitā tathā || ṣāḍguṇyasya prayoktā ca śaktyupetastathaiva ca || || 7 || uktairanuktaistu guṇairanekairalaṅkṛto bhūmipatiśca kāryaḥ || sambhūya rāṣṭrapravarairyathāvadrāṣṭrasya rakṣārthamadīnasattvaḥ || 8 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde rāmaṃ prati puṣkaravākye rājalakṣaṇaṃ nāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 3 || <2.4> || puṣkara uvāca || evaṃ guṇagaṇākīrṇaṃ varayeyurnarādhipam || sambhūya rāṣṭrapravarāḥ kṣatriyaṃ tu kulodgatam || 1 || vṛtaśca tairvrataṃ rājā gṛhṇīyādvijitendriyaḥ || pālayiṣyāmi vaḥ sarvāndharmasthānnātra saṃśayaḥ || 2 || vrataṃ gṛhītvā rājyārthī vṛṇuyādbrāhmaṇottamam || sāṃvatsaraṃ sukhāyāsya sarvasya jagato nṛpaḥ || 3 || sarvalakṣaṇalakṣaṇyaṃ vinītaṃ priyadarśanam || surūpaṃ veśasaṃpannaṃ nityamūrjitadarśanama || 4 || adīnavādinaṃ dhīraṃ dharmanityaṃ jitendriyam || avyaṅgaṃ nādhikāṅgaṃ ca vedavedāṅgapāragam || 5 || catuḥṣaṣṭyaṅgatattvajñamūhāpohaviśāradam || bhūtabhavyabhaviṣyajñaṃ gaṇitajñaṃ viśeṣataḥ || 6 || vicandrā śarvarī yadvanmukuṭaṃ ca cyutopalam || gaṇitena tathā hīnaṃ jyotiṣaṃ nṛpasattama || 7 || āstikaṃ śraddadhānaṃ ca anukūlaṃ mahīpateḥ || sāṃvatsaraṃ nṛpo gatvā varayetprayataḥ śuciḥ || 8 || yenābhiṣikto nṛpatirvinaṣṭastu narādhipa || sāṃvatsaraṃ na taṃ vidvānvarayennṛpasattama|| 9 || na hīnāṅgaṃ na vācālaṃ na ca niṣpratibhaṃ nṛpaḥ || kuveśamalinaṃ muṇḍaṃ nāstikaṃ pāpaniścayam || 10 || bhinnavṛttiṃ ca varayedvarayetsadguṇaṃ sadā || varayitvā tu vaktavyāḥ svayameva mahībhujā || 11 || yathaivāgnimukhā devāstathā rājamukhāḥ prajāḥ || yathaivāgnimukhā mantrā rājñāṃ sāṃvatsarāstathā || 12 || tvaṃ me mātā pitā caiva deśikaśca gurustathā || daivaṃ puruṣakāraśca jñātavyau satataṃ tvayā || 13 || samadharmajña bhadraṃ te rājyaṃ sādhāraṇaṃ hi nau || samāneyaḥ śubho devastvayaiva mama sattama || 14 || pauruṣeṇa padaṃ kāryaṃ samaraṃ ca tathā mayā || sa cettadabhimanyeta pārthivasya mahāguṇam || 15 || athavā guṇadoṣeṇa prajñayā cāśu yo nṛṇām || daivopaghātasamare vijñānaṃ pauruṣasya ca || 16 || vāḍavaṃ na ca prājñastu tasyaivānumate tadā || tenoddiṣṭau tu varayedrājā mantripurohitau || 17 || tenoddiṣṭāṃ ca varayenmahiṣīṃ nṛpasattamaḥ || tato'bhiṣekasambhārām̐stasya kuryātsa daivavit || 18 || kuñjaraṃ turagaṃ kuryāttasya rājñaḥ parīkṣitau || bhadrāsanaṃ ca cchatraṃ ca vālavyajanameva ca || 19 || khaḍgaratnaṃ tathā cāpaṃ ratnāni vividhāni ca || rājño mṛtasya ye tvāsansarvāṇi tu narādhipa || 20 || te na kāryā narendrasya tena daivavidā tathā || kāmaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ kāryā alābhe'nyasya bhūbhujā || 21 || guṇādhikasya no kāryā ye'nyatrābhihitā mayā ||22|| na tatra nāgāḥ subhṛtā na yodhā rājño na mātā na pitā na bandhuḥ || yatrāsya sādhyaṃ bhavatīha vidvānsāṃvatsaro dharmavidaḥ pramattaḥ || 23 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde rāmaṃ prati puṣkarakathāsu sāṃvatsarika lakṣaṇaṃ nāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ ||4|| <2.5> rāma uvāca || rājñā purohitaḥ kāryastathā mantrī ca kīdṛśaḥ || mahiṣī ca tathā jyeṣṭhā tanmamācakṣva pṛcchataḥ || || 1 || puṣkara uvāca || avyaṅgaṃ lakṣaṇopetamanukūlaṃ priyaṃvadam || atharvavedavidvāṃsaṃ yajurvedaviśāradam || 2 || dvivedaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ rājā purohitamatharvaṇam || pañcakalpavidhānajñaṃ varayeta sudarśanam ||3|| nakṣatrakalpo vaitānastṛtīyaḥ saṃhitāvidhiḥ || caturthoṅgirasāṃ kalpaḥ śāntikalpastu pañcamaḥ ||4|| pañcakalpavidhānajñamācāryaṃ prāpya bhūpatiḥ || sarvotpātapraśāntātmā bhunakti vasudhāṃ ciram ||5|| sa ca rājñastathā kuryānnityaṃ karma sadaiva tu || naimittikaṃ tathā kāmyaṃ daivajñavacane rataḥ ||6|| na tyājyastu bhavedrājā daivajñena purodhasā || patitastu bhavettyājyo nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||7|| tathaiva patitau rāma na tyājyau tau mahībhujā || tayostyāgena rājendra rājyabhraṃśo vinirdiśeta || 8 || durgatiḥ paraloke ca bahukālamasaṃśayam || sāṃvatsaraviruddhastu tyājyo rājñā purohitaḥ || purohito'nyathā rājño yathā mātā yathā pitā || aniṣṭamasya vyasanaṃ hanyāddaivopaghātajam || 10 || brāhmaṇo niṣkṛtistasya kutra śakyā mahībhujā || yāvanna rājñā vidvāṃsau sāṃvatsarapurohitau || 11 || vṛtticchede tayo rājñaḥ kulaṃ tripuruṣaṃ vrajet || narakaṃ varjayettasmādvṛtacchedaṃ tayoḥ sadā || 12 || sthāvareṇa vibhāgaśca tayoḥ kāryo viśeṣataḥ || anurūpeṇa dharmajña sāṃvatsarapurohitau || 13 || bhāvyaṃ sadā bhārgavavaṃśacandra purohitasyātmasamasya rājñā || rājño yathāpi svajanena bhāvyo vidvānprabhuḥ syānnṛpateḥ purodhāḥ || 14 || || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde purohitalakṣaṇaṃ nāma pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ || 5 || <2.6> || puṣkara uvāca || || sarvalakṣaṇalakṣaṇyo mantrī rājñastathaiva ca || brāhmaṇo vedatattvajño vinītaḥ priyadarśanaḥ || 1 || sthūlalakṣo mahotsāhaḥ svāmibhaktaḥ priyaṃvadaḥ || bṛhaspatyuśanaḥ proktāṃ nītiṃ jānāti sarvataḥ || 2 || rāgadveṣeṇa yatkāryaṃ na vadanti mahīkṣitaḥ || lokāpavādādrājārthe bhayaṃ yasya na jāyate || 3 || kleśakṣamastathā yaśca vijitātmā jitendriyaḥ || gūḍhamantraśca dakṣaśca prājño bhaktajanapriyaḥ || 4 || iṅgitākāratattvajña ūhāpohaviśāradaḥ || śūraśca kṛtavidyaśca na ca mānī vimatsaraḥ || 5 || cārapracārakuśalaḥ praṇidhipraṇayātmavān || ṣāḍguṇyavidhitattvajña upāyakuśalastathā || 6 || vaktā vidhātā kāryāṇāṃ naiva kāryātipātitā || samaśca rājabhṛtyānāṃ tathaiva ca guṇapriyaḥ || 7 || kālajñaḥ samayajñaśca kṛtajñaśca janapriyaḥ || kṛtānāmakṛtānāñca karmaṇāṃ cānvavekṣitā|| 8 || yathānurūpamarhāṇāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ niyojitā || rājñaḥ parokṣe kāryāṇi samparāye bhṛgūttama || 9 || kṛtvā niveditā rājankarmaṇāṃ gurulāghavam || śatrumitravibhāgajño vigrahāspadatattvavit || 10 || sa rājñaḥ sarvakāryāṇi kuryādbhṛgukulodvaha || viditāni yathā kuryānnājñātāni mahīkṣitā || 11 || ajñātāni narendrasya kṛtvā kāryāṇi bhārgava || acireṇāpi vidveṣaṃ sa mantrī tvadhigacchati ||12|| karoti yastu kāryāṇi vividhāni mahīpate || bhedo no tasya bhavati kadācidapi bhūbhujā || 13 || evaṃguṇo yasya bhavecca mantrī vākye ca tasyābhiratasya rājñaḥ || rājyaṃ sthiraṃ syādvipulā ca lakṣmīrvaṃśaśca dīpto bhuvanatraye'pi || 14 || || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde matrilakṣaṇaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ || 6 || <2.7> || puṣkara uvāca || || rājñāgryamahiṣī kāryā sarvalakṣaṇapūjitā || vinītā gurubhaktā ca īrṣākrodhavivarjitā || 1 || rājñaḥ priyahitāsaktā cāruveśā priyaṃvadā || bhṛtābhṛtajanajñā ca bhṛtānāmanuvekṣiṇī || 2 || abhṛtānāṃ janānāṃ ca bhṛtikarmapravartinī || rāgadveṣaviyuktā ca sapatnīnāṃ sadaiva yā || 3 || bhojanāsanapānena sarveṣāmanuvekṣiṇī || sapatniputreṣvapi yā putravatparivartate || 4 || mantrisaṃvatsarāmātyānyā ca pūjayate sadā || brahmaṇyā ca dayāyuktā sarvabhūtānukampinī || 5 || kṛtākṛtajñā rājñaśca viditā maṇḍaleṣvapi || pararājakalatraṣu prīyamāṇā mudā yutā ||6|| dūtādipreṣaṇakarī rājadvāreṣu sarvadā || taddvāreṇa naredrāṇāṃ kāryajñā ca viśeṣataḥ || 7 || evaṃguṇagaṇopetā narendreṇa sahānaghā || abhiṣecyā bhavedrājye rājyasthena nṛpeṇa vā || 8 || evaṃ yadā yasya bhavecca patnī narendracandrasya mahānubhāvā || vṛddhiṃ vrajettasya nṛpasya rāṣṭraṃ sacārakaṃ nātra vicāraṇāsti||9|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde agryamahiṣīlakṣaṇaṃ nāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ || 7 || || <2.8> rāma uvāca || puruṣāṇāṃ tathā strīṇāṃ gajānāṃ turagaissaha || vālavyajanacchatrāṇāṃ tathā bhadrāsanasya ca || 1 || ratnānāṃ dhanuṣāṃ caiva khaḍgasya ca surātmaja || lakṣaṇaṃ śrotumicchāmi tanmamācakṣva pṛcchataḥ || 2 || puṣkara uvāca || ādāveva pravakṣyāmi puruṣāṇāṃ tu lakṣaṇam || nibodha tanme gadato bhṛguvaṃśāvivardhana || 3 || ekādhiko dviśuklaśca tribhirvyāpnoti yastathā || trivalīvām̐strivinataḥ trikālajñaśca bhārgava || 4 || puruṣaḥ syātsulakṣaṇyo vipulaśca tathā triṣu || caturlekhastathā yaśca tathaiva ca catuḥsamaḥ || 5 || catuṣkiṣkuścaturdaṃṣṭraścatuṣkṛṣṇastathaiva ca || caturgaṃdhaścaturhrasvaḥ pañcasūkṣmastathaiva ca || 6 || pañcadīrgho bhṛguśreṣṭha tathaiva ca ṣaḍunnataḥ || saptasneho'ṣṭavaṃśaśca nava sthānāmalastathā || 7 || daśapadmo daśabṛhannyagrodhaparimaṇḍalaḥ || caturdaśasamadvandvaḥ ṣoḍaśākhyaśca śasyate || 8 || rāma uvāca || ekādhikādyā ye proktāḥ puruṣasya tvayā guṇāḥ || tānahaṃ śrotumicchāmi yathāvadvaruṇatmaja || 9 || puṣkara uvāca || dharme cārthe ca kāme ca janaḥ sarvo'bhiṣajyate || ekādhikastu vijñeyo yastu dharme viśeṣataḥ || 1 0|| tārakābhyāṃ vinā netre śuklāśca daśanāstathā || dvātriṃśadrāma yasya syurdviśuklaḥ sa tu kīrtitaḥ || ||11|| uro nābhistathā sakthirgaṃbhīrā yasya dehinaḥ || procyate sa tu dharmajña trigambhīro narottamaḥ || anasūyā dayā kṣāntistrikamekaṃ prakīrtitam || ||12|| maṅgalācārasaṃsparśaḥ śaucaṃ cetyaparaṃ trayam || anāyāsamakārpaṇyamaiśvaryaṃ ca trayastrikāḥ|| tripralambo bhujābhyāṃ tu vṛṣaṇena ca kīrtyate || digdeśajātisargaiśca tejasā yaśasā śriyā || 14 || vyāpnoti yo bhṛguśreṣṭha tribhirvyāpnotyasau smṛtaḥ || udare valayastisro gambhīrā yasya dehinaḥ || 15 || sa ucyate bhṛguśreṣṭha trivalīvānnarottamaḥ || devatānāṃ dvijānāṃ ca gurūṇāṃ ca tathā nataḥ || 16 || puruṣo bhārgavaśreṣṭha proktastrivinataḥ sadā || dharmasyārthasya kāmasya saṃpatkālavibhāgavit || 17 || sevate yaśca dharmajñaḥ procyate sa trikālavit || urau lalāṭaṃ vaktraṃ ca vistīrṇaṃ yasya dehinaḥ || 18 || kathitaḥ sa bhṛguśreṣṭha vipulastriṣu mānavaḥ || dvau pāṇī dvau tathā pādau dhvajacchatrādibhiryutau || 19 || lekhābhiryasya nirdiṣṭaścaturlekhaḥ sa mānavaḥ || aṅgulyo hṛdayaṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ kaṭiryasya tathā samāḥ ||20 || puruṣaḥ sa bhṛguśreṣṭha catussama udāhṛtaḥ || ṣaṣṇavatyaṅgulotsedhaścatuṣkiṣkuḥ pramāṇataḥ || 21 || pramāṇayogāddharmajña catukiṣkuḥ sa kīrtitaḥ || daṃṣṭrāścatasraścandrābhā daśanebhyaḥ samunnatāḥ || 22 || kiñcidyasya sa dharmajña caturdaṃṣṭraḥ prakīrtitaḥ || netratāre bhruvau śmaśruḥ kṛṣṇāḥ keśāstathaiva ca || 23 || yasyeha sa catuṣkṛṣṇaḥ procyate manujottamaḥ || nāsāyāṃ vadane svede kakṣyāsu ca narottama || 24 || gandhastu surabhiryasya caturgandhaḥ sa kīrtitaḥ || bāhū jānūrugaṇḍaśca catvāryasya samāni tu || || 289 || puruṣasya bhṛguśreṣṭha catussama udāhṛtaḥ || āsyāsṛṅmadhyapadmānāṃ tulyo gandhastu yasya vai || 26 || kathitaḥ sa bhṛguśreṣṭha caturgandha iti dvijaiḥ || hrasvaṃ liṅgaṃ tathā grīvā jaṃghe hrasve tu dehinaḥ || 27 || yasya bhārgavaśārdūla caturhrasvaḥ sa kīrtitaḥ || aṅgulīnāṃ tu parvāṇi nakhakeśadvijatvacam || sūkṣmaṇi yasya taṃ rāma pañca sūkṣmaṃ pracakṣate || 28 || hanū netre lalāṭaṃ ca nāsā caiva stanāntaram || dīrghāṇi yasya taṃ rāma pañcadīrghaṃ vidurbudhāḥ || 29 || vakṣaḥ kakṣau nakhā nāsā mukhaṃ caiva kṛkāṭikā || ṣaḍunnatāni yasyeha taṃ vadaṃti ṣaḍunnatama || 30 || tvakkeśalomadaṃtāśca dṛṣṭirvāṇī nakhāstathā || snigdhā yasyeha taṃ prāhuḥ sapta snigdhaṃ bahuśrutāḥ || 31 || jānuvaṃśāvubhau rāma bhujavaṃśau tathāpyubhau || ūruvaṃśadvayaṃ caiva pṛṣṭhavaṃśaṃ ca bhārgava || 32 || nāsāvaṃśaḥ samo yasya so'ṣṭavaṃśaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || netre nāsāpuṭau karṇau meḍhrapāyū mukhaṃ tathā || 33 || chidrā navaite vimalā yasya taṃ tu navāmalam || jihvoṣṭhatālu netrāntarhastapādanakhāḥ stanau || 34 || śiśnāgravakṣo yasyaite padmābhā daśa dehinām || pāṇī pādau mukhaṃ grīvā śravaṇe hṛdayaṃ śiraḥ || 35 || lalāṭamudaraṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ bṛhantaḥ pūjitā daśa || prasāritabhujasyeha madhyamāgratvayāṃtarāt || 36 || ucchrāyeṇa samo yaḥ sa nyagrodhaparimaṇḍalaḥ || kathitaḥ sa nṛpaśreṣṭhaḥ sarvalakṣaṇapūjitaḥ || 37 || pādau gulphau sphicau pārśvau vṛṣaṇāvakṣiṇau hanū || karṇoṣṭhasakthinī jaṃghe hastau bāhū tathā bhruvau || 38 || dvandvānyetāni yasya syuḥ samāni tu caturdaśa || caturdaśasamadvandvaḥ kathitaḥ sa nṛpottamaḥ || 39 || vidyāsthānāni yānīha kathitāni caturdaśa || prapaśyati ca yo rāma netrābhyāṃ ca narottamaḥ || 40 || samyaksa kathito loke ṣoḍaśākṣo bhṛgūttama || rūkṣaṃ śirātataṃ gātraṃ tathā māṃsavivarjitama || durgandhi cāśubhaṃ sarvaṃ viparītaṃ ca śasyate || 41 || dṛṣṭiḥ prasannā madhurā ca vāṇī mattebhatulyā ca gatiḥ praśastā || ekaikakūpaprabhavāśca romā sattvaṃ plutaṃ hāsamanulbaṇaṃ ca || 42 || śrāntasya yānamaśanaṃ ca bubhukṣitasya pānaṃ tṛṣā parigatasya pareṣu rakṣā || etāni yasya puruṣasya bhavaṃti kāle taṃ dhanyamāhuradhibhūmi naraṃ dvijendrāḥ || 43 || || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde puruṣalakṣaṇaṃ nāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ ||8|| <2.9> puṣkara uvāca || śastā strī cārusarvāṅgī mattamātaṅgagāminī || gurūrujaghanā yā ca mattapārāvatekṣaṇā ||1 || sunīlakeśī tanvaṅgī parapuṣṭaninādinī || tanumadhyā vilomāṅgī snigdhavarṇā manoharā ||2|| samagrabhūspṛśau yasyāścaraṇau kamalopamau || nābhiḥ pradakṣiṇāvartā saṃhatau ca tathā stanau||3|| vibhaktamadharoṣṭhaṃ ca darśanaṃ madhuraṃ tathā || guhyaṃ pradakṣiṇāvartamaśvatthadalasannibham||4|| gulphau nigūḍhau gūḍhe ca tathā yasyāḥ kakundare|| madhyanābheśca yasyāḥ syāddhastāṃguṣṭhapramāṇataḥ || 5|| piṇḍike ca na sannaddhe na lambā ca tathā kaṭiḥ || jaṭharaṃ ca pralaṃbaṃ ca nayane ca na kekare ||6|| kacāśca kapiśā keśāḥ keśā rūkṣāstathaiva ca || na ca vṛkṣanadīnāmnī na devagirināmikā || 7 || na caivoragagandharvabhūtapretasanāmikā || na vācālā na lubdhā ca na śaṭhā kalahapriyā ||8|| na lolupā na durbhāvā na vā kuṇṭhakapālikā || devadvijātisiddhānāṃ sādhūnāṃ pūjane ratā || 9 ||| śīlopetā guṇopetā na śirālā na lomaśā || 10 || gaṇḍairmadhūkapuṣpābhaiḥ snigdhaiśca daśanacchadaiḥ || na saṃhatabhrūḥ saṃśliṣṭacaraṇāṃgulikuḍmalā ||| || 11 || patipriyā patiprāṇā yā nārī patidevatā || alakṣaṇāpi saṃjñeyā sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutā || 12 || bhruvaṃ kanīnikā yasyā na spṛśeta kathaṃcana || na tāṃ kurvīta bhāryārthaṃ mṛtyuḥ sā kathitā budhaiḥ ||13|| saromamuttaroṣṭhaṃ ca gaṇḍau yasyāḥ sakūpakau|| atidīrghā kaṣāyā ca calanmāṃsacayā tathā || 14 || sā vivarjyā viśeṣeṇa nareṇa hitamicchatā || 15 || saṃkṣepataste kathitaṃ mayaitatsyāllakṣaṇaṃ cāru nitambinīnām || rahasyametatkathitaṃ tu tatra yatrākṛtistatra guṇā vasanti || 16 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde strīlakṣaṇaṃ nāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ || 9 || <2.10> puṣkara uvāca || nāgāḥ praśastā dharmajña pramāṇenādhikāstu ye || dīrghahastā mahocchvāsā svāsanāśca viśeṣataḥ || 1 || nigūḍhavaṃśā madhvākṣā mūḍhā mūḍhoṣṭhamastakāḥ || viṃśatyaṣṭādhikanakhāḥ śītakālamadāśca ye||2|| yeṣāṃ caiva karāḥ pādā dīrghā lāṅgūlameva ca|| dakṣiṇaṃ connataṃ dīptaṃ bṛṃhitaṃ jaladopamam || 3 || atyarthavedanā ye ca śūrāḥ śabdasahiṣṇavaḥ || karṇau ca vipulau yeṣāṃ sūkṣmabinduyutatvacaḥ| 4|| te praśastā mahābhāga ye tathā saptasusthitāḥ || dantacchadeṣu dṛśyante yeṣāṃ svastikalakṣaṇāḥ ||5|| śṛṅgāravālavyajanaṃ varddhamānāṅkuśāstathā || te dhāryā na tathā dhāryā vāmanā matkuṇādayaḥ || 6 || hastinyo yāśca garbhiṇyo ye ca mūḍhā mataṅgajāḥ || apākalāśca kubjāśca saddantā ye ca bhārgava || 7 || kudantāśca tathā varjyā vāmakūṭāśca yatnataḥ || asruspṛśaśca kūṭāśca śaṭhāśca vikaṭāśca ya || 8 || rāma uvāca || vāmanādyaśca ye nāgāḥ proktā ninditalakṣaṇāḥ || teṣāṃ tu śrotumicchāmi lakṣaṇaṃ varuṇātmaja || 9 || || puṣkara uvāca || āyāmena na saṃpūrṇo yotihrasvo bhavedgajaḥ || vāmanastu samākhyāto matkuṇo dantavarjitaḥ || 10 || daśāṃ caturthīṃ saṃprāpya vardhate yasya na dvijau || sthūlāvanāyatau syātāṃ sa mūḍhākhyo gajādhamaḥ || 11 || apākalo viśālena dantenaikena vāraṇaḥ || saṃkṣiptavakṣojaghanaḥ pṛṣṭhamadhyasamunnataḥ || 12 || pramāṇahīnatannābhiḥ sa kubjo vāraṇādhamaḥ || atyunnatāṃsaḥ saddantaḥ kudantaḥ syānnato bahiḥ || 13 || vāmadantonnato nāgo vāmakūṭaśca kathyate || dantau vaktraspṛśau yasya so'sruspṛkkathito gajaḥ || 14 || ekadantastathā nāgaḥ kūṭa ityabhidhīyate || pādayoḥ sannikarṣaḥ syādyasya nāgasya gacchataḥ || 15 || sa śaṭhodhvani yuddhe ca lakṣaṇajñairnna pūjitaḥ || aratnyabhyadhikaṃ yasya vistareṇa stanāntaram || 16 || vikaṭaḥ sa vinirdiṣṭo durgatirnindito gajaḥ || rāma uvāca || śrotumicchāmi dharmajña kuñjaraṃ saptasusthitam || 17 || yaṃ prāpya kila rājāno jayanti vasudhāṃ nṛpāḥ || || puṣkara uvāca || varṇaṃ sattvaṃ balaṃ rūpaṃ kāntissaṃhananaṃ javam || saptaitāni sadā yasya sa gajaḥ saptasusthitaḥ || 18 || yeṣāṃ bhaveddakṣiṇapārśvabhāge romṇāṃ ca puṃjaḥ piṭako'thavāpi || te nāgamukhyā vijayāya yuddhe bhavanti rājñāṃ na hi saṃśayo'tra || 59 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeya vajrasaṃvāde hastilakṣaṇaṃ nāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ || 10 || <2.11> || puṣkara uvāca || aśvānāmṛṣibhiḥ proktā mahādoṣā bhṛgūttama || yairanvitā parityājyāstanme nigadataḥ śṛṇu || 1 || hīnadanto dvidantaśca karālī kṛṣṇatālukaḥ || kṛṣṇajihvaśca yamajo jātamuṣkaśca yastathā || 2|| dviśaphaśca tathā śṛṅgī nṛvarṇo vyāghravarṇakaḥ || kharavarṇo bhasmavarṇo jātavarṇaśca kākudī || 3 || śvitrī ca kākasādī ca kharaśārastathaiva ca || vānarākhyaḥ kṛṣṇasaṭaḥ kṛṣṇamuṣkastathaiva ca || 4 || kṛṣṇaprothaśca mūkaśca yaśca tittirasannibhaḥ || viṣamaśvetapādaśca dhruvāvartavivarjitaḥ || 5 || aśubhāvartasaṃyukto varjanīyasturaṅgamaḥ || || rāma uvāca || vājinaḥ ke dhruvāvartāḥ keṣu sthāneṣu śobhanāḥ || vājinaḥ ke tadā śastāstanmamācakṣva pṛcchataḥ || 6 || puṣkara uvāca || randhroparandhrayordvaudvau dvaudvau mastakavakṣasoḥ || pramāṇe ca lalāṭe ca dhruvāvartā daśa smṛtaḥ || 7 || ekopi na bhavedyasya dhuvāvartastu vājinaḥ || na taṃ śaṃsanti dharmajña tasmāttaṃ parivarjayeta ||8|| uttaroṣṭhe bhṛguśreṣṭha pramāṇasya tathopari || nāsāpuṭe tathā prothe gaṇḍaprothākṣimadhyagaḥ ||9 || kathayoraśrupātena bhruvoḥ kaṇṭhāgrayostathā || nābhyāṃ hanubalā kakṣāskandhopaskandhasandhiṣu || 10 || vido bāhupradeśe ca galamadhye tathaiva ca || āsane kakude prothe jānujaṃghāsu bhārgava || 11 || kuṣṭikānābhikakṣāsu muṣkayormūtradeśajaḥ || trike ca mūlapucche ca upari sthūṇayostathā || 12 || piṇḍayorjaṭhare caiva sīvanīyopakukṣiṣu || āvarttairvarjanīyāḥ syuḥ prayatnena turaṅgamāḥ || 13 || kakude karṇayoścaiva yasyāvartaḥ kuvājinaḥ || atyantamapraśastaṃ taṃ rājā rāṣṭrādvivāsayet || 14 || hastidevamaṇiḥ sarvaṃ pūrvakāyeṣu lakṣaṇaḥ || suvyakto rocamāno vā na tu kākudinaṃ kvacita||15|| mekhalā vāpyadhaḥkāyāddhanyādāvartasambhavam || doṣānsarvāṃsturaṅgasya na hanyātkākasādinam || 16 || ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi śubhamāvartalakṣaṇam || sṛkkiṇyośca lalāṭe ca tathā śravaṇamūlayoḥ || 17 || nigāle ca tathā kaṇṭhe stutakeśāntayostathā || bāhumūle tathā śastā romajātāsturaṅgamāḥ || 18 || āvartastu nigālastho jñeyo devamaṇiḥ śubhaḥ || kaṇṭhajo rocamānaśca sarvāvartto janādhipaḥ || 19 || arkendragopacandrābhā ye ca vāyasa sannibhāḥ || suvarṇavarṇāḥ snigdhāśca praśasyante sadaiva te || 20 || dīrghagrīvākṣakūṭāśca hrasvavarṇāśca ye tathā || hrasvaprothāśca śasyante meghaughasadṛśa svanāḥ || pṛthūrupādajavanā mukhapuṇḍrāśca vai hayāḥ ||21 || candrāṃśuśuklāsturagāḥ praśastāḥ karṇāntakeśairgavalālivarṇaiḥ || ye raktavarṇāśca samagrapādaiḥ śuklāśca varṇaiśca mahānubhāvāḥ || 22 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde aśvalakṣaṇaṃ nāmekādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 11 || <2.12> puṣkara uvāca || camarībālasambhūtāḥ śaśāṅkāṃśusamaprabhāḥ || saṃhatāḥ snigdhadīrghāśca tathā sthālinibandhanāḥ || 1 || daṇḍaśca cāmare kāryo rukmarūpyamayastathā || pravālavaiḍūryamayastathaiva kanakānvitaḥ ||2|| kṣīravṛkṣasya vā kāryo rukmarūpyanibandhanaḥ || ratnaiḥ praśastaiścitro vā kāñcanasya praśasyate || 3 || candanasyātha dantasya śārṅgaḥ kāryo yathā bhaveta || ardhahastānna cāpyūno madhyardhānna tathādhikaḥ || 4 || kartavyaṃ cāmaraṃ rājñā na ca bhārgava rañjitama ||5|| āpītavarṇaṃ tu bhavetpraśastaṃ sāṃvatsarāmātyapurohitānām || narendrapatnīyuvarājasainyasyālasya śeṣasya janasya kṛṣṇaḥ || 6|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde cāmaralakṣaṇaṃ nāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||12 || <2.13> puṣkara uvāca || haṃsapakṣairviracitaṃ mayūrasya śukasya ca || pakṣairatha balacchāyā cchatraṃ rājñaḥ praśasyate || 1 || mitrapakṣaṃ na kartavyaṃ hīnaṃ parimitaṃ tathā || caturasraṃ tu kartavyaṃ brāhmaṇasya bhṛgūttama|| 2 || vṛttaṃ rājñāṃ praśastaṃ syācchuklavastravibhūṣitam || sitaṃ dūkūlasaṃchannaṃ patākābhirvibhūṣitam || 3 || etasmindigvibhāge tu kāryāścandrāṃśunirmalāḥ || catasrastasya dharmajña patākā rukmabhūṣitāḥ ||4|| daṇḍaṃ cāmaravatkāryaṃ vaiṇavaṃ ca praśasyate|| tricatuḥpañcaṣaḍsaptacāṣṭaparvaḥ praśasyate || 5 || daśadvādaśabhirvāpi śeṣaistu parivarjayet || chatraṃ daṇḍograparvāṇaṃ daṇḍaḥ sarvatra śasyate || 6 || dhārayanti ca daṇḍaṃ vai vaiṇavaṃ gṛhamedhinaḥ || rājñāṃ praśastaṃ ṣaḍḍhastaṃ chatradaṇḍaṃ bhṛgūttama || 7|| atha pañconahastaṃ tu mahiṣīyuvarājayoḥ || senāpatisurādhyakṣasāṃvatsarapurohitaiḥ ||8|| pañcahastastu kartavyaśchatradaṇḍo bhṛgūttama || caturhastastu kartavyo mayā ye'tra na kīrtitāḥ || 9 || vyāso daṇḍārdhamānena sadā chatrasya śasyate || chatraṃ vibhūṣayedrājñāṃ tvardhacandradivākaraiḥ ||10|| vajrendranīlaiḥ sphaṭikaiśca rāma vaidūryamuktāphalasatpravālaiḥ || vibhūṣitaṃ raśmiyutaṃ praśastaṃ sadātapatraṃ tu mahīpatīnām || 11 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde chatralakṣaṇaṃ nāma trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 13 || <2.14> puṣkara uvāca || bhadrāsanaṃ narendrasya kṣīravṛkṣeṇa kārayet || ucchrāyaśca tathā tasya adhyardhaṃ tu samaṃ bhavet || 1 || hastatrayaṃ tathā viṣṭaṃ vistareṇa tu kārayet || āyāmaścāsya kartavyo vistareṇārdhasammitaḥ || 2 || caturasraṃ tu kartavyaṃ rājño bhadrāsanaṃ śubham|| nāṣṭāsraṃ na tathā vṛttaṃ na ca dīrghaṃ bhṛgūttama ||3|| suvarṇarūpyatāmraiśca citraṃ kāryaṃ viśeṣataḥ || ratnaiḥ praśastairna tathā na ratnapratirūpakaiḥ || 4 || catvāraḥ puruṣāstatra vinyastā bhṛgunandana || dviguṇāśca tathā siṃhāstebhyastu dviguṇāstathā || 5 || bhadrāsanaṃ tatra bhavennṛpasya talena pūrṇaṃ sasukhaṃ parārdhyam || vaiyāghracarmāstaraṇaṃ sukhārthaṃ varāsanaṃ tasya samāmananti || 6 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde bhadrāsanalakṣaṇaṃ nāma caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 14 || <2.15> puṣkara uvāca || vajraṃ marakataṃ caiva padmarāgaṃ ca mauktikam || indranīlaṃ mahānīlaṃ vaiḍūryamatha sasyakam || 1 || indrakāntaṃ sūryakāntaṃ sphaṭikaṃ pulakaṃ tathā || karketanaṃ puṣparāgaṃ tathā jyotīrasaṃ dvija|| 2 || sphaṭikaṃ rājavartaṃ ca tathā rājamayaṃ śubham || saugaṃdhikaṃ tathā sakhyaṃ śaṅkhabrahmamayaṃ tathā || 3 || gomedhaṃ rudhirākṣaṃ ca tathā ballātakaṃ dvija || dhūlīmarakataṃ caiva tuttūkaṃ śeṣameva ca || 4 || paluṃ pravālakaṃ caiva girivajraṃ ca bhārgava || bhujageśamaṇiṃ caiva tathā vajramaṇiṃ śubham || 5 || ṭīṭibhaṃ ca tu tāpicchaṃ bhrāmaraṃ ca tathotpalam || ratnānyetāni dhāryāṇi sarvāṇyeva mahīkṣitā || 6 || suvarṇa pratibaddhāni jayārogyasamṛddhaye || teṣāṃ gurutvaṃ rāgaśca svacchatvaṃ raśmimālitā || 7 || sujātatā masṛṇatā susaṃsthānatvameva ca || guṇavanto vinirdiṣṭā dhāryāste guṇasaṃyutāḥ || 8 || khaṃḍāssaśarkarā ye ca niṣprabhā malināstathā || na te dhāryā narendrāṇāṃ jayaśrījīvitaiṣiṇām || 9 || samastaratnavarge'pi vajradhāraṇamiṣyate || ambhastarati yadvajramabhedyaṃ vimalaṃ ca yat || 10 || tathā ca śuddhaṃ ṣaṭkoṇaṃ laghu bhārgavanandana || prabhā ca śakravāpābhā yasyārkābhimukhī bhavet || 11 || taṃ vajraṃ dhārayanrājā sarvāñjayati śātravān || śuklapakṣanibhaḥ snigdhaḥ kāntimānvimalastathā || 12 || suvarṇacūrṇasaṃkāśaiḥ sūkṣmairbindubhiranvitaḥ || śasto marakato rāma gambhīraśconnatastathā || 13 || dhāryaśca pṛthivīśānāṃ sarvopadravanāśanaḥ || kuruvindādbhavejjanma tathā saugandhikāddvija ||14|| sphaṭikātpadmarāgāṇāṃ śreṣṭhāste hyuttarottaram || jaharaṅgā bhavantīha kuruvindabhavāśca ye ||15|| kaṣāyaraṅgā nirdiṣṭā ye ca saugandhikodbhavāḥ || svacchāśca rāgavantaśca vijñeyāḥ sphaṭikodbhavāḥ || 16 || muktāphalāḥ śuktibhava bahavo matsyajāstathā || utkṛṣṭā na tathā tebhyo ye tu śaṅkhodbhavā dvija ||17|| tebhyaḥ praśastā vijñeyā nāgakumbhasamudbhavāḥ || niṣprabhāste samuddiṣṭāḥ śreṣṭhāḥ kroḍibhavā dvija ||18|| tebhyo veṇudalāḥ śreṣṭhāstebhyo bhujaṅgasambhavāḥ || tebhyo'pi bhuviduṣprāpyaṃ mauktikaṃ meghasambhavam || 19 || dhāraṇāttasya nṛpateḥ sarvasiddhiḥ prakīrtitā || mauktikānāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ vṛttatvaṃ guṇa ucyate || 20 || suṣṭhutā ca suśuklatvaṃ mahattvaṃ ca bhṛgūttama || indranīlastu yaḥ kṣīraṃ rājate bhājane sthitam|| 21 || rañjayetsvaprabhāvena tamamūlyaṃ vinirdiśet || nīlaraktaṃ tu vaiḍūryaṃ sarvataḥ śreṣṭhamucyate || 22 || sarveṣāmeva ratnānāṃ dhāryaṃ karketanaṃ smṛtam || puṣparāgāstathā rāma ye cānye kīrtitā mayā || 23 || praśastaratnairbhūpānāṃ mukuṭānyaṅgadāni ca || hārāṇi rāma kāryāṇi keyūrābharaṇāni ca || 24 || apraśastāni ratnāni varjanīyāni dūrataḥ || sarvaratnottamaṃ rājā vivarṇaṃ malinaṃ tathā || 25 || na dhārayeta dharmajñaḥ suśuddhaṃ dhārayetsadā || dhṛtiḥ praśastā bhṛguvaṃśacandra ratnottamānāṃ satataṃ nṛpāṇām || ratnāṃśudagdhaṃ tu narasya dehādanarthamāśu praśamaṃ prayāti || 26 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde ratnalakṣaṇaṃ nāma pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 15 || <2.16> || puṣkara uvāca || || dhanurdravyatrayaṃ lohaṃ śṛṅgaṃ cāru ca bhārgava || jyādravyatritayaṃ carma vaṃśabhaṃgaṃ tvacastathā || 1 || vaṃśatvagvaṃśacāpaṃ tu kartavyaṃ bhṛgunandana || anyeṣu rāma cāpeṣu śeṣadravyamidaṃ bhaveta || 2 || pramāṇaṃ nātra nirdiṣṭaṃ cāpayoḥ śārṅgalohayoḥ || dārucāpapramāṇaṃ tu śreṣṭhaṃ hastacatuṣṭayam || 3 || tadardhasamahīne tu prokte madhyakanīyasī || muṣṭigrāhyāṇi vṛttāni madhye sarvāṇi kārayet || 4 || svalpā koṭistu vārkṣāṇāṃ śārṅgalauhamayī dvija || kāminībhrūlatākārā koṭiḥ kāryā susaṃskṛtā ||5|| pṛthagvā dārumiśro vā lohaśārṅge tu kārayet || śārṅgaṃ snāyucitaṃ kāryaṃ rukmabinduvibhūṣitam || 6 || kuṭilasphuṭitaṃ cāpaṃ sacchidraṃ ca na śasyate || hastibhagnā drumā ye ca vidyuddagdhāstathā ca ye || 7 || ārāmadevatāveśmatāpasāśramasaṃbhavāḥ || śmaśānasaṃbhavā ye ca na te kāryāḥ kathaṃcana || 8 || prāṇināṃ yaḥ sajātyena śṛṅgī yudhi nipātitaḥ || tacchṛṅgaṃ varjayeccāpaṃ nityaṃ śārṅge vicakṣaṇaḥ || 9 || lohāni rāma catvāri śasyante cāpakarmaṇi || suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ tāmraṃ tathā kṛṣṇāyasaṃ dvija || 10 || kāñcanaṃ cāparatnaṃ tu saratnamapi kārayet || māhiṣaṃ śārabhaṃ śārṅgaṃ rauhījaṃ cāpi kārayet || 11 || vārkṣaṃ candanajaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ vaitasaṃ dhānvataṃ tathā || sālaśālmalikāśānāṃ kakubhasyāñjanasya ca || 12 || vaṃśasya ca mahābhāga sarvaśreṣṭhatamaṃ viduḥ || śaradgṛhītaiḥ kāṣṭhaistu cāpaṃ kāryaṃ prayatnataḥ || 13 || vaṃśānāmapi tacchreṣṭhaṃ yatra gaṅgā mahānadī || sālānāmapi tacchreṣṭhaṃ gomatī yatra bhārgava || 14 || vitastākūlajaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ vetasīnāṃ tathaiva va || evaṃ dravyamayaṃ kāryaṃ cāpaṃ lakṣaṇasaṃyutam ||15|| grahaṇa lakṣaṇaṃ cāsya bhaviṣyati ca khaḍgavat || sukhagrāhaṃ dṛṣṭikāntaṃ śaramokṣamukhaṃ tathā || 16 || ślakṣṇaṃ śliṣṭaṃ susaṃsthānaṃ sāravantaṃ susaṃhatam || avanāmasukhaṃ nityaṃ puṃnāmanavalotkaṭam ||17|| etadīdṛśakaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ cāparatnaṃ vidurbudhāḥ || rājñā cāpasya kartavyā pūjā bāṇavarasya ca || 18 || nityaṃ devakule rāma khaḍgasya ca viśeṣataḥ || ayasaścātha vaṃśasya śarasyātha śaro bhavet || 19 || śaravaṃśau grahītavyau śaratkāle bhṛgūttama || śarāḥ kirātajāḥ śreṣṭhāḥ kāñcīpurasamīpataḥ || 20 || tebhyo'pi te śreṣṭhatamāḥ skandajanmamahībhavāḥ || snigdhā nimagnaparvāṇaḥ sāravantaḥ samāhitāḥ || 21 || ṛjavo madhuvarṇābhāḥ sujātāḥ śāradā dṛḍhāḥ || snāyuśliṣṭāḥ sunetrāśca supuṅkhāḥ kalavāsasaḥ || 22 || tailadhautāśca kartavyā rukmapuṅkhavibhūṣaṇāḥ || tathā viṣamaparvāṇaḥ phalaiśca vraṇavarjitaiḥ || 23 || eka tripuṅkhaṃ kartavyaṃ rājahaṃsacchadottaram || rukmapuṅkhasuvarṇāgramayaḥphalamanuttamam ||24|| snāyubaddhaṃ balaṃ tasya rukmabandhaṃ tu kārayet || vajraiśca lakṣaṇopetaiścitritaṃ taṃ tu kārayet||25|| grahaṇaṃ tasya kartavyaṃ sāṃvatsarakarānnṛpaiḥ || tasya pūjā sadā kāryā sābhiṣekasamā bhavet || 26 || yātrāyāmabhiṣeke ca maṅgaleṣu ca karmasu || sapatāke tu taṃ cāpaṃ sapatākaṃ tu kārayet || maṅgalyaṃ tannarendrāṇāṃ kathitaṃ bhṛgunandana || 27 || ye cāparatnaṃ vinataṃ tu bhūpāḥ suvarṇaratnopacitaṃ sadaiva || bāṇena sākaṃ paripūjayanti bhavanti te rāma vipannaduḥkhāḥ || 28 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde cāpaśaralakṣaṇaṃ nāma ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 16 || <2.17> || puṣkara uvāca || purā sumeruśikhare kāñcane ratnaparvate || svargaṅgāyāstaṭe brahmā yajñaṃ yajati bhārgava || 1 || tasminyajñe sa dadṛśe vighnaṃ khe lohadānavam || vighnasya śamanaṃ tasya cintayāmāsa tattvavit || 2 || tadā cintayatastasya puruṣaḥ pāvakādbabhau || nīlotpaladalaśyāmaḥ svarucā vañcitekṣaṇaḥ || 3|| prāṃśuḥ suvadanaḥ śrīmānbalenāpratimo bhuvi || sa vavande tadā gatvā devaṃ kamalasambhavam || 4 || abhyanandanta jātena tena devāssavāsavāḥ || tasmātsa nandako nāma khaṅgaratnamabhūttadā || 5 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā bhagavānbrahmā keśavaṃ vākyamabravīt || khaḍgaṃ gṛhṇīṣva goptāraṃ dharmasya jagatāṃ pate || 6 || yajñavighnakaraṃ hatvā khaḍgenānena keśava || nipātaya mahābāho balinaṃ lohadānavam || 7 || ityevamukto jagrāha grīvayā taṃ janārdanaḥ || gṛhītamātre devena vikośaḥ samapadyata || 8 || khaḍgaḥ kamalapatrākṣo nīlotpalasamadyutiḥ || ratnamuṣṭirmahānrāma nirmalākāśasannibhaḥ || 9 || etasminnantare tatra vyadṛśyata tadā mahān || karālaḥ kṛṣṇavadanaḥ śatabāhurmahodaraḥ|| 10|| prāṃśuḥ suvṛttadaṃṣṭrāgro balavām̐llauhadānavaḥ || yajñavighnārthinaṃ prāptaṃ sa dṛṣṭvā lohadānavam || 11 || khaḍgamādāya vegena yayau taṃ prati keśavaḥ || sa keśavamanādṛtya devāñchakrapurogamān || 12 || vidrāvayāmāsa tadā gadayā bhīmavegayā || tadā bhagneṣu deveṣu yuddhaṃ kṛtvā hariściram || 13 || khaḍgena tasya gātrāṇi ciccheda madhuhā raṇe || khaḍgacchinnāni gātrāṇi nānādeśeṣu bhūtale || 14 || nipetustasya dharmajña śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ || nandakasya tu saṃsparśāttāni gātrāṇi bhārgava || 15 || lohībhūtāni sarvāṇi prasādātkeśavasya tu || hatāyāsmai varaṃ prādādbhagavānmadhusūdanaḥ || 16 || tvadaṅgāni pavitrāṇi bhaviṣyanti mahītale || āyudhāni ca tairloke kariṣyantīha mānavāḥ||17|| evamuktvā harirdevo brāhmaṇaṃ vākyamabravīt || vinā vighnaṃ makhamidaṃ kuru śīghraṃ jagadguro||18|| evamuktastadā brahmā yajñena madhusūdanam || ātmanā pūjayāmāsa susamiddhamanorathaḥ||19|| utpattiruktā khaḍgasya lohasya ca mayā tava || ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi khaḍgalakṣaṇamuttamam || 20 || pradhānadehasaṃbhūtairdaityāsthibhirarindama || lohaṃ pradhānaṃ khaḍgārthe praśastaṃ tadviśeṣataḥ || 21 || kaṭīkadūraṛṣikaṃ vaṅge śūrpākareṣu ca || videheṣu tathāṅgeṣu madhyamaṃ grāmacediṣu || 22 || sahagrāmeṣu nīpeṣu tathā kālañjarepi ca || lauhaṃ pradhānaṃ tajjānāṃ khaḍgānāṃ śṛṇu lakṣaṇam ||23|| kaṭīkadūrajātā ye darśanīyāstu te smṛtāḥ || kāyacchinnāstu ṛṣikā marmaghnā guravastathā ||24|| tīkṣṇāśchedasahā vāṅgā dṛḍhā śūrpārikodbhavāḥ || suhastāścaiva vijñeyā prabhāvanto videhajāḥ ||25 || aṃgadeśodbhavāstīkṣṇāścedi deśasamudbhavāḥ || kāliñjarā bhārasahāstathā vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇam || 26 || supramāṇāṃgulāste tu śreṣṭhā khaḍgāḥ pramāṇataḥ || pramāṇaṃ tatra vijñāya tato hīnaṃ na dhārayet || 27 || pramāṇābhyadhikaṃ caiva cchinnavaṃśaṃ tathaiva ca || śīghraḥ sumadhuraḥ śabdo yasya khaḍgasya bhārgava || 28 || kiṅkiṇī sadṛśastasya dhāraṇaṃ śreṣṭhamucyate || khaḍgaḥ padmapalāśāgro maṇḍalāgraśca śasyate ||29|| karavīrapalāśāgrasadṛśasya viśeṣataḥ || mahīghṛtasugandhaśca padmotpalasugandhikaḥ || 30 || varṇataścotpalākāraḥ savarṇo ṇaganasya ca || samāṅgulasthāḥ śasyante vraṇāḥ khaḍgeṣu bhārgava || 31 || śrīvṛkṣaparvatā kāravaṃśapadmanibhāśca ye || maṅgalyānāṃ tathānyeṣāṃ sadṛśā ye ca bhārgava || 32 || kākolūkakabandhābhā viṣamāṅgulasaṃsthitāḥ || vaṃśānugāḥ prabhūtāśca na śastāste kadācana || 33 || na khaḍge vadanaṃ paśyedvṛthā vivṛṇuyānna ca | ucchiṣṭo na spṛśetkhaḍgaṃ niśi kuryācca śīrṣake || divā ca pūjayedenaṃ gandhamālyānusaṃpadā ||34|| khaḍgaṃ praśastaṃ maṇihemacitraṃ kośe sadā candanacūrṇayukte || saṃsthāpayedbhūmipatiḥ prayatnādrakṣettathainaṃ svaśarīravacca || 35 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde khaḍgalakṣaṇaṃ nāma saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 17 || <2.18> puṣkara uvāca || iti sambhṛtasambhāro rājñassāṃvatsarastathā || kāle'bhiṣecanaṃ kuryāttaṃ kālaṃ kathayāmi te || 1 || mṛte rājñi na kālasya niyamo'tra vidhīyate || tatrāsya snapanaṃ kāryaṃ vidhivattilasarṣapaiḥ || 2 || ghoṣayitvā jayaṃ cāsya sāṃvatsarapurohitau || anyāsanopaviṣṭasya darśayetāṃ janaṃ śanaiḥ || 3 || sa sāntvayitvā svajanaṃ bhuktvā bandhanagāṃstathā || abhayaṃ ghoṣayitvā ca kālākāṃkṣī tathā bhavet || 4 || nābhiṣecyo nṛpaścaitre nādhimāse ca bhārgava || na prasupte tathā viṣṇau viśeṣātprāvṛṣi dvija || 5 || na ca bhaumadine rāma caturthyāṃ na tathaiva ca || navamyāṃ nābhiṣektavyaḥ caturdaśyāṃ ca bhārgava || 6 || dhruvāṇi vaiṣṇavaṃ śākraṃ hastapuṣye tathaiva ca || nakṣatrāṇi praśasyante bhūmipālābhiṣecane || 7 || nāgaścatuṣpadaṃ viṣṭiḥ kiṃstughnaḥ śakunistathā || karaṇāni na śasyante vyatīpātadinaṃ tadhā || 8 || nakṣatramulkābhihatamutpātābhihataṃ tathā || saurasūryakujākrāntaṃ pariviṣṭiñca bhārgava || 9 || muhūrtāścoktanakṣatrāḥ satāṃ mānahitapradāḥ || kujahorā tathā neṣṭā sarvatra kulikastathā || 10 || vṛṣo'tha kīṭasiṃhau ca kumbho lagne ca śasyate || eteṣāṃ janmalagnābhyāṃ yaḥ syādupacayasthitaḥ || 11 || tārā dvitīyā ṣaṣṭhī ca caturthī cāṣṭamī ca yā || navamī ca tathā śastā anukūlaśca candramāḥ || 12 || saumyāḥ kendragatā lagnā śubhāścaiva trikoṇayoḥ || pāpāścopacaya sthāne śasto lagne divākaraḥ || 13 || lagne navāṃśaḥ kṣitijasya varjyo vargastathā tasya mahānubhāva || sūryasya vargaḥ sakalaḥ praśasto rājño'bhiṣeke sagraho nṛpāṇām || 14 || || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde'abhiṣekakālanirṇayaṃ nāmāṣṭādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ || 18 || <2.19> puṣkara uvāca || kāryā paurandarī śāṃtiḥ prāgevāsya purodhasā || prāptebhiṣekadivase sopavāsaḥ purohitaḥ || 1 || soṣṇīṣaḥ śvetavasanaḥ sitacandanabhūṣitaḥ || sitamālyopavītaśca sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ ||2|| vedimullikhya yatnena kṛtvā ca vidhivattataḥ || juhuyādvaiṣṇavānmantrāṃstathā śākrānvicakṣaṇaḥ || 3 || sāvitrānvaiśvadevāṃśca saumyāṃ ca vidhivattataḥ || śarmavarmagaṇaṃ caiva tathā svastyayanaṃ gaṇam || 4 || āyuṣyamabhayaṃ caiva tathā caivāparājitam || sapātavantaṃ kalaśaṃ tathā kuryācca kāñcanam || 5 || vahnerdakṣiṇapārśvasthaḥ śvetacandanabhūṣitaḥ || śvetānulepanaḥ sragvī sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ || 6 || āsanasthamukhaṃ paśyennimittāni hutāśane || 7 || paśyeyuranye ca tathā nṛsiṃha daivajñavākyānnipuṇaṃ svarūpam || sāṃvatsarasyātha sadasyamukhyāḥ sadasyamukhyāśca purohitasya || 8 || || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde puraṃdaraśāṃtirnāmaikonaviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||19|| <2.20> puṣkara uvāca || pradakṣiṇāvartaśikhastaptajāmbūnadaprabhaḥ || rathaughamevanirghoṣo vidhūmaśca hutāśanaḥ ||1 || anulomasugandhaśca svastikākārasannibhaḥ || vardhamānākṛtiścaiva nandyāvartanibhastathā || 2 || prasannārcirmahājvālaḥ sphuliṅgarahito hitaḥ || svāhāvamāne jvalanaḥ svayaṃ devamukhaṃ haviḥ || 3 || yadā bhuṅkte mahābhāga tadā rājño hitaṃ bhavet || haviṣastu yadā vahnernasyātsimisimāyitam || 4 || na varjeyuśca madhyena mārjāramṛgapakṣiṇaḥ || pipīlakāśca dharmajña tadā bhūyājjayī nṛpaḥ || 5 || muktāhāramṛṇālābhe vahnau rājñāṃ jayo bhavet || tathaiva ca jayaṃ brūyātprastarasya pradāyini || 6 || saṃkṣepataste'bhihitaṃ mayādya yallakṣaṇaṃ cāru hutāśanasya || sarvāgnikarmasvatha tena vidvānbhūyāttriloke tu jayī dvijendra || 7 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde vahnilakṣaṇaṃ nāma viṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 20 || <2.21> || puṣkara uvāca || || snānaṃ samācaredrājño homakāle purohitaḥ || ādau tu svecchayā snātaḥ punarmṛdbhiḥ samācaret || 1 || parvatāgramṛdā tāvanmūrdhānaṃ śodhayennṛpaḥ || valmīkāgramṛdā karṇau candanaiḥ keśabālakān || 2 || candrālayamṛdā grīvāṃ hṛdayaṃ tu nṛpājirāt || karidantoddhṛtamṛdā dakṣiṇaṃ tu tathā bhujam || 3 || vṛṣaśṛṅgoddhṛtamṛdā vāmaṃ caiva tadā bhujam || 4 || saromṛdā tathā pṛṣṭhaṃ codaraṃ sāṅgame mṛdā || nadīkūladvayamṛdā pārśve saṃśodhayettathā || 5 || aśvasthānāttathā jaṃghe rājā saṃśodhayedbudhaḥ || rathacakroddhṛtamṛdā tathaiva ca karadvayam || 6 || mṛtsnātaḥ snapanīyaḥ syātpañcagavyajalena tu || tato bhadrāsanagataṃ mukhyāmātyacatuṣṭayam || 7 || varṇapradhānaṃ bhūpālamabhiṣiñcedyathāvidhi || pūrvato hebhakumbhena ghṛtapūrṇena brāhmaṇaḥ || 8 || rūpyakumbhena yāmyena kṣīrapūrṇena kṣatriyaḥ || dadhnā ca tāmrakumbhena vaiśyaḥ paścimato dvija || 9 || māheyena jaleno dakśūdrāmātyo'bhiṣecayet || tato'bhiṣekaṃ nṛpaterbahvṛcapravaro dvijaḥ || 10 || kurvīta madhunā rāma cchandogaśca kuśodakaiḥ || sampātavantaṃ kalaśaṃ tathā nutvā purohitaḥ || 11 || vidhāya vahnirakṣāṃ tu sadasyeṣu yathāvidhi || rājasūyābhiṣeke tu ye mantrāḥ parikīrtitāḥ || 12 || taistu dadyānmahābhāga brāhmaṇānāṃ svanena tu || tataḥ purohito gacchedvedimūlaṃ tadaiva tu || 13 || vibhūṣitaṃ tu rājānaṃ sarvatobhadra āsane || śatacchidreṇa pātreṇa sauvarṇena yathāvidhi ||14|| abhiṣiñcati dharmajña yajurvedaviśāradaḥ || yā oṣadhīrauṣadhībhiḥ sarvābhiḥ susamāhitaḥ ||15|| rathe akṣeti gandhaiśca ābrahmanbrahmaṇeti ca || bījaiḥ puṣpaistathā cainaṃ rāma puṣpavatīti ca ||16|| tenaiva cābhimantreṇa phalaistamabhiṣecayet || āśuḥ śiśāna ityeva sarvaratnaiśca bhārgava ||17|| ye devāḥ purassadeti kuśābhiḥ parimārjayet || ṛgvedakratuto rājñe rocanāyā yathāvidhi || 18 || mūrdhānaṃ ca tathā kaṇṭhe gandhadvāreti saṃspṛśet || tato brāhmaṇamukhyāśca kṣattriyāśca viśastathā || 19 || śūdrāśca vāramukhyāśca nānātīrthasamudbhavaiḥ || nādeyaiḥ sārasaiḥ kaupairnānākalaśasaṃsthitaiḥ || 20 || catussāgarajairlābhādalābhāddvijakalpitaiḥ || gaṅgāyamunayoścaiva nirjharaiśca tathodbhijaiḥ ||21 || chatrapāṇirbhavetkaścitkeciścāmarapāṇayaḥ || amātyamukhyāstaṃ kālaṃ kecidvetrakarāstathā || 22|| śaṃkhabherīninādena bandīnāṃ nisvanena ca || gītavāditraghoṣeṇa dvijakolāhalena ca || || 23 || rājānamabhiṣiñceyussametya sahitā janāḥ || sarvaiḥ stuto'bhiṣiktaśca saṃmiśrajalamiśritam || 24 || sarvauṣadhiyutaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvagandhayutaṃ tathā || ratnabījasamāyuktaṃ phalabījayutaṃ tathā || 25 || ūrjitaṃ sitasūtreṇa veṣṭitagrīvameva ca || śvetavastrāmrapatraiśca saṃvītaṃ suvibhūṣitam || || 26 || kṣīravṛkṣalatāchatraṃ sudṛḍhaṃ kāṃcanaṃ navam || ādāya kalaśaṃ rājñā svayaṃ sāṃvatsarastathā || 27 || mantrāvasāne kalaśaṃ dadyādbhṛgukulodvaha || tataḥ paśyenmukhaṃ rājā darpaṇe cātha sarpiṣi || 28 || soṣṇīṣaḥ sitavastraśca maṅgalālambhanaṃ tataḥ || kṛtvā sampūjayedviṣṇuṃ brahmāṇaṃ śaṅkaraṃ tathā || 29 || lokapālāngrahāṃścaiva nakṣatrāṇi ca bhārgava || tataḥ svapūjāṃ kurvīta śayanīyaṃ tato vrajet || || 30 || vyāghracarmottaraṃ ramyaṃ sitavastrottaracchadam || purodhā madhuparkeṇa tatrasthaṃ taṃ samarcayet || 31 || rājā caivārcayettatra sāṃvatsarapurohitau || madhuparkeṇa dharmajñastatastasya sadaiva hi || 32 || paṭṭabandhaṃ prakurvīta mukuṭasya ca bandhanam || tataḥ sa baddhamukuṭaḥ kāle pūrvaṃ mayeritam || 33 || parārdhyāstaraṇopete pañcacarmottaracchade || dhruvā dyau iti mantreṇa sopaveśya purodhasā || 34 || vṛkasya vṛṣadaṃśasya dvīpinaśca bhṛgūttama || teṣāmupari siṃhasya vyāghrasya ca tataḥ param || 35 || tatropaviṣṭasya tataḥ pratīhāraḥ pradarśayet || amātyāṃśca tathā paurānnaigamāṃśca vaṇigvarān || 36 || tataḥ prakṛtayaścānyā yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ || tato grahāvarāstrebhaturaṅgakanakottamaiḥ || 37 || gojāvigrahadānaiśca sāṃvatsarapurohitau || pūjayitvā tataḥ paścātpūjayedbrāhmaṇatrayam || 38 || anenaiva vidhānena yena rājābhiṣecitaḥ || tatastvamātyānsaṃpūjya sāṃvatsarapurodhasaḥ || 39 || tato brāhmaṇamukhyānāṃ pūjanaṃ tu samācaret || govastratilarūpyānnaphalakāñcanagorasaiḥ || || 40 || modakākṣatapuṣpaiśca mahīdānaiśca pārthivaḥ || maṅgalālambhanaṃ kṛtvā gṛhītvā saśaraṃ dhanuḥ || 41 || vahniṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya praṇipatya tathā gurum || pṛṣṭhato vṛṣamālabhya gāṃ savatsāṃ ca pārthiva || 42 || pūjayitvā ca turagaṃ mantritaṃ cābhiṣecitam || mantritaṃ dakṣiṇe karṇe svayaṃ vedavidā tataḥ || 43 || āruhya rājamārgeṇa svapuraṃ tu paribhramet || mukhyāmātyaiśca sāmantaiḥ sāṃvatsarapurohitaiḥ || 44 || sahitaḥ kuñjarārūḍhairabhigacchecca devatāḥ || tāsāṃ saṃpūjanaṃ kṛtvā nagare yā niveśitāḥ || 45 || praviśeta gṛhaṃ rājā prahṛṣṭanaravāhanaḥ || dānamānāni satkārairgṛhṇīyātprakṛtīstataḥ || 46 || saṃpūjitāstāstu visarjayitvā gṛhe svake syānmudito mahātmā || vidhānametatsamavāpya rājā kṛtsnāṃ sa pṛthvīṃ vaśagāṃ hi kuryāt||47|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde rājyābhiṣekavidhirnāmaikaviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 21|| <2.22> rāma uvāca || maṃtreṇa yena dharmajña kuryādrājño'bhiṣecanam || tamahaṃ śrotumicchāmi tvatto varuṇanandana || 1 || || puṣkara uvāca || śṛṇuṣvāva hito mantraṃ rāma kalmaṣanāśanam || yenābhiṣikto nṛpatiściraṃ yaśasi tiṣṭhati || 2 || rājño'bhiṣekaśabdānte daivavitkuśavāriṇā || kumbhādabhyukṣaṇaṃ kuryānmantrānte sakalaṃ nyaset || 3 || surāstvāmabhiṣiñcantu brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ || vāsudevo jagannāthastathā saṅkarṣaṇo vibhuḥ || 4 || pradyumnaścāniruddhastu bhavantu vijayāya te || ākhaṇḍalognirbhagavānyamo vai nairṛtistathā || 5 || varuṇaḥ pavanaścaiva dhanādhyakṣastathā śivaḥ || brahmaṇā sahitaḥ śeṣo dikpālāḥ pāntu te sadā || 6 || bhadro dharmo manurdakṣo ruciḥ śraddhā ca pārthiva || bhṛguratrirvasiṣṭhaśca sanakaśca sanandanaḥ || 7 || sanatkumāraśca tathā bhagavānapi cāṅgirā || pulahaśca pulastyaśca marīciḥ kaśyapaḥ prabhuḥ || 8 || ete tvāmabhiṣiñcantu prajādhyakṣāḥ samāgatāḥ || prabhāsurā barhiṣado hyagniṣvāttāstathaiva ca || 9 || kravyādāścopahūtāśca ājyapāśca sukālinaḥ || ete tvāmabhiṣiñcantu pitaraścāgnibhiḥ saha || 10 || lakṣmīrdevī satī khyātiranasūyā tathā smṛtiḥ || saṃbhūtissannatiścaiva kṣamā prītistathaiva ca || 11 || svāhā svadhā ca tvā rājannabhiṣiñcantu mātaraḥ || kīrtilakṣmīrdhṛtirmedhā puṣṭiḥ śraddhā kriyā tathā || 12 || buddhirlajjā vapuḥ śāntistuṣṭiḥ siddhiśca pārthiva || etāstvāmabhiṣiñcantu dharmapatnyaḥ samāgatāḥ || 13 || arundhatī vasurjāmī lambā bhānurmarutvatī || saṃkalpā ca muhūrtā ca sādhyā viśvāstathaiva ca || 14 || dharmapatnyastathānyāstvāmabhiṣiñcantu pārthiva || aditiśca ditistāmrā hyariṣṭā surasā muniḥ || || 15 || kadrūḥ krodhavaśā prādhā vinatā surabhistribhiḥ || etāstvāmabhiṣiñcantu kaśyapasya priyāḥ striyaḥ || 16 || patnī te bahuputrasya suprabhā yā ca bhāminī || samāyātvabhiṣekāya vijayāya ca pārthiva || 17 || kṛśāśvapatnī ca tathā suprabhā ca jayā tathā || astragrāmastayoḥ putro vijayaṃ vidadhātu te || 18 || manoramā bhānumatī viśālā yā ca bāhudā || ariṣṭanemī patnyastvāmabhiṣiñcantu pārthiva || 19 || kṛttikā rohiṇī daivī ilvalā bāhureva ca || punarvasuśca tiṣyaśca tathāśleṣā ca pārthiva || 20 || maghā ca phālgunī pūrvā tathaivottaraphālgunī || hastaścitrā tathā svātirviśākhā ca narādhipa || 21 || anurādhā tathā jyeṣṭhā mūlaṃ ca vasudhādhipa || āṣāḍhā ca tathā pūrvā tathaiva nṛpa cottarā || 22 || abhijicca tathāśvattho dhaniṣṭhā ca narādhipa || tathā śatabhiṣakcaiva pūrvābhādrapadā ca yā || 23 || uttarā revatī rājannaśvinī bharaṇī tathā || etāstvāmabhiṣiñcantu somapatnyaḥ samāgatāḥ || 24 || mṛgī ca mṛgamandā ca śvetā bhadrāsanā hariḥ || bhūtā ca kapiśā daṃṣṭrī surasā saramā tathā || 25 || etāḥ pulahapatnyastvāmabhiṣiñcantu pārthiva || śyenī bhāsī tathā krauñcī dhṛtarāṣṭrī śukī tathā || 26 || patnyastvāmabhiṣiñcantu aruṇasyārkasāratheḥ || āyatirniyatiścaiva rātrirnidrā tathaiva ca || 27 || etāstvāmabhiṣiñcantu lokasaṃsthānahetavaḥ || umā menā śacī caiva ghrūmrorṇā nivṛtistathā || 28 || gaurī śivā ca siddhiśca velā caivātha naḍvalā || asiknī ca tathā jyotsnā yā ca devī vanaspateḥ||29|| etāstvāmabhiṣiñcantu devapatnyaḥ samāgatāḥ || mahākalpaśca kalpaśca manvantarayugāni ca ||30|| saṃvatsarāṇi sarvāṇi tathā caivāyanadvayam || ṛtavaśca tathā māsāḥ pakṣau rātryahanī tathā||31|| saṃdhyāśca tithayaścaiva muhūrtāḥ karaṇāni ca || ete tvāmabhiṣiñcantu kālasyāvayavāḥ śubhāḥ || 32 || ādityaścandramā bhaumo budho jīvaḥ sitārkajau || grahāstvāmabhiṣiñcantu rāhuketū ca pārthiva || 33 || svāyambhuvo manuḥ pūrvamanuḥ svārociṣastathā || auttamastāmasaścaiva raivataścākṣuṣastathā || 34 || vaivasvato yathākarṇo dakṣo brahmasutāvubhau || dharmaputro rudraputro rocyo bhautyaśca yo manuḥ || 35 || ete tvāmabhiṣiñcantu manavaśca caturdaśa || viśvabhukca vipaścicca suśāntiśca śikhī vibhuḥ || 36 || manojavastathojasvī bahiradbhutaśāntikau || vṛṣaśca ṛtadhāmā ca divaspācchucireva ca||37|| ete tvāmabhiṣiñcantu devanāthāścaturdaśa || raivataśca kumāraśca tathā varcāvināyakaḥ || || 38 || vīrabhadraśca nandī ca viśvakarmā manojavaḥ || ete tvāmabhiṣiñcantu suramukhyāḥ samāgatāḥ ||39|| ātmā cāyurmanodakṣo hyāpaḥ prāṇastathaiva ca|| haviṣmāṃśca gaviṣṭhaśca ṛtaḥ satyaśca pārthiva||40|| abhiṣiñcantu rājaṃstvāṃ devā hyāṅgirasā daśa || kraturdakṣo vasussatyaḥ kālaḥ kāmo munistathā|| ||41|| kuravonmanujaścaiva rocamānastathaiva ca || ete tvāmabhiṣiñcantu viśvedevāstathā daśa||42|| aṅgārakastathā sarpo nirṛtiśca tathā ghasaḥ || ajaikapādahirbudhnyo dhūmaketustathā dvijaḥ ||43|| bharataśca tathā mṛtyuḥ kāpāliratha kiṅkiṇiḥ || ekādaśaite rudrāstvāmabhiṣiñcantu pārthiva ||44|| bhuvano bhāvanaścaiva sujanyaḥ sujanastathā || kratuḥ sarvaśca mūrdhā ca tyājyaścaiva stutastathā || 45 || prasavaścāvyayaścaiva dakṣaśca manujādhipa || ete tvāmabhiṣiñcantu bhṛgavo nāma devatāḥ || 46 || mano mantā ca prāṇaśca naro'pānaśca vīryavān || vinirbhayo nayaścaiva haṃso nārāyaṇastathā || 47 || vibhuścāpi prabhuścāpi devaśreṣṭhā jagaddhitāḥ || ete tvāmabhiṣiñcantu sādhyā dvādaśa pārthiva || 48 || dhātā mitro'ryamā pūṣā śakreśau varuṇo bhagaḥ || tvaṣṭā vivasvānsavitā viṣṇurdvādaśamastathā || 49 || ete tvāmabhiṣiñcantu kaśyapāditisambhavāḥ || ekajyotiśca dvijyotistricaturjyotireva ca|| || 50 || ekaśakro dviśakraśca triśakraśca mahābalaḥ || indrāśca gatyā dṛśyante tataḥ pratisakṛttayā || 51 || mitaśca sammitaścaiva amitaśca mahābalaḥ || ṛtajitsatyajiccaiva suṣeṇaḥ satyajittathā || 52 || atimitro namitraśca purumitraḥ purānitaḥ || ṛtaśca ṛtadhātā ca vidhātā dhāraṇo dhruvaḥ || 53 || vidhāraṇo mahātejā vāsavasya paraḥ sakhā || īdṛkṣaścāpyadṛkṣaśca etādṛgamitāśanaḥ || 54 || krītinaḥ prasadṛkṣaśca sarabhaśca mahā yaśāḥ || dhāturugrodhvanirbhīmo hyatiyuktaḥ kṣipaḥ sahaḥ || 55 || dyutirvapuranādhṛṣyo vāsaḥ kāmo jayo virāṭ || ete tvāmabhiṣiñcantu marutaste samā gatāḥ || 56 || devā ekonapañcāśanmahābalaparākramāḥ || citrāṅgadaścitrarathaścitrasenaśca vīryavān || 57 || ūrṇāyuranaghaścaiva ugrasenaśca vīryavān || dhṛtarāṣṭraśca gopaśca sūryāvartastathaiva ca || 58 || yugapastraṇayaḥ kārṣṇirnaṃdaścitrastathaiva ca || kaliḥ śāliḥ śirā rājanparjanyo nāradastathā || 59 || vṛṣaparvā ca haṃsaśca tathā caiva hahā hūhūḥ || viśvāvasustumburuśca tathā ca suruciśca yaḥ || 60 || ete tvāmabhiṣiñcantu gandharvāḥ pṛthivīpate || āhutyastā bhavatyaśca vargavatyastathaiva ca || 61 || āyurvatyastathorjāśca tathā vai kuravāḥ stavāḥ || bahvāyuścāmṛtāyuśca bhuvaścaiva rucastathā || 62 || bhīravaḥ śobhayaṃtyaśca divyā yāścāpsarogaṇāḥ || ete tvāmabhiṣiñcantu samāgatya mahīpate || 63 || anavadyā satyakāmā cānūnā varuṇā priyā || anūpā subhagā caiva sukeśā ca manovatī || 64 || menakā sahajanyā ca parṇāśā puñjikasthalā || kṛtasthalā ghṛtācī ca viśvācī pūrvacityapi || 65 || pramlocā cāpyanumlocā raṃbhā caivorvaśī tathā || pañcacūḍā sānumatī citralekhā ca pārthiva || 66 || miśrakeśī marīciśca vidyutparṇā tilottamā || adrikā lakṣmaṇā kṣepā asitā rucikā tathā ||67|| suhemā cātha hemā ca śāḍvalī ca vapustathā || suvratā ca subāhuśca sugandhā suvapustathā||68|| puṇḍarīkā sudānā cāsudānā surasā tathā || hemā śāradvatī caiva sūnṛtā kamalālayā||69|| sumukhī haṃsapādī ca vāruṇī ratilālasā || etāstvāmabhiṣiñcantu rājannapsarasaḥ śubhāḥ || 70|| prahlādaśca mahātejāstathā rājanvirocanaḥ || balirbāṇastathānye ca ditiputrāḥ samāgatāḥ||||| abhiṣiñcantu daityāstvāṃ divyenāpyambhasā svayam || vipracittimukhāḥ sarve dānavāstvāṃ samāgatāḥ || 72 || abhiṣiñcantu rājendra rājarājyena satvarāḥ || hetiścaiva prahetiśca mālī śaṅkustathaiva ca || 73 || sukeśī pauruṣeyaśca yajñahā puruṣādhamaḥ || vidyutsphūrjastathā vyāghro vadhaśca rasanastathā || 74 || ete tvāmabhiṣiñcantu samāgamyādya rākṣasāḥ || siddhārtho maṇibhadraśca sumano nandanastathā || 75|| kāṇḍabhiḥ pañcamaścaiva maṇimānuyamām̐stathā || sarvānubhūtaḥ śaṃkhaśca piṅgākṣaścastarastathā || 76 || yaśo mandaraśobhī ca padmacandraprabhaṅkarāḥ || meghavarṇaḥ subhadraśca pradyotaśca mahāghasaḥ ||77|| dyutimānketumāṃścaiva maulimāṃśca sudarśanaḥ || śvetaśca vipulaścaiva puṣpadanto jayāvahaḥ || 78 || padmavarṇo balākaśca kumudaśca balāhakaḥ || padmanābhaḥ sugandhaśca pravīro vijayaḥ kṛtiḥ || 79 || pūrṇamāso hiraṇyākṣaḥ śatajihvaśca vīryavān || ete tvāmabhiṣiñcantu rājanyakṣendra sattamāḥ || 80 || śaṃkhapadmastu rājendra makaraḥ kacchapastathā || ete tvāmabhiṣiñcantu nidhayastu samāgatāḥ || 81 || palagāścaiva vakrāśca ye ca sūcīmukhā nṛpa || duḥpūraṇā viṣādāśca jvalanāṅgārakāstathā || 82 || kumbhapātāḥ pratuṇḍāśca tapavīrā ulūkhalāḥ || akarṇāśca kuṣaṇḍāśca tathā ye pātra pāṇayaḥ || 83 || pāṃsavaśca vituṇḍāśca nipuṇāḥ skandanāstathā || ete tvāmabhiṣiñcantu piśācānāñca jātayaḥ || 84 || brahmacarye sthitā dāntāḥ sarvajñāḥ sarvadarśinaḥ || nānāprakāravadanā nānābāhuśirodharāḥ ||85|| catuṣpathapurāṭṭālaśūnyālayaniketanāḥ || madhuratve bhavedevaṃ ye gatā manujeśvarāḥ || 86|| te tvāmadyābhiṣiñcantu bhūtā bhūtapateḥ svayam || mahākālaṃ puraskṛtya narasiṃhaṃ ca mātaraḥ || 87 || sarvāstvāmabhiṣiñcantu rājarājye narādhipa || guhaḥ skando viśākhaśca naigameyastathaiva ca || 88 || abhiṣiñcantu rājam̐stvāṃ sarve skandagrahāḥ śubhāḥ || ḍākinyo yāśca yoginyaḥ khecarībhūcarīśca yāḥ || 89 || sarvāstvāmabhiṣiñcantu sametya manujeśvara || garuḍaścāruṇaścaiva āruṇiśca mahākhagaḥ || 90 || saṃpātī vinataścaiva viṣṇugandhaḥ kumārakaḥ || ete tvāmabhiṣiñcantu suparṇāḥ pṛthivīpate || 91 || anantaśca mahānāgaḥ śeṣo vāsukitakṣakau || saparṇīraśca kumbhaśca vāmanaścāñjanastathā || 92 || airāvato mahānāgaḥ kambalāśvatarāvubhau || ailamantraśca śaṃkhaśca karkoṭakadhanañjayau || 93 || mahākarṇamahānīlau dhṛtarāṣṭrabalāhakau || kumāraḥ puṣpadantaśca sumukho durmukhastathā || 94 || sūcīmukho dadhimukhaḥ kāliyaḥ śālipiṇḍakaḥ || bilvapādaḥ pāṇḍurako nāgaścāpūraṇastathā || 95|| kapilaścāmbarīṣaśca kumāraścātha kaśyapaḥ || prahrādaḥ puṣpadantaśca gandharvaśca manasvikaḥ|| 96 || nahuṣaḥ khararomā ca śaṃkhapālastathaiva ca || padmaśca kulikaścaiva pāṇirityevamādayaḥ || 97 || nāgāstvāmabhiṣiñcantu rājarājyena pārthiva || kumudairāvaṇau padmaḥ puṣpa danto'tha vāmanaḥ || 98 || supratīkoñjano nīlaḥ pāntu tvāṃ sarvataḥ sadā || cakraṃ triśūlaṃ vajraśca nandakostrāṇi cāpyatha || 99 || paitāmahāstathā haṃsā vṛṣabhaḥ śaṅkarasya ca || durgāsiṃhaśca pāntu tvāṃ yamasya mahiṣastathā ||100|| uccaiḥśravāścāśvapatistathā dhanvantarirnṛpa || kaustubhaḥ śaṃkharājaśca pāntu tvāṃ sarvataḥ sadā ||101|| sarve'bhiṣekaṃ dattvā te diśantu vijayaṃ dhuvam || dharmaśca vyavasāyaśca satyo dānaṃ tapastathā || 102 || yamo yajñastathā vāyurbrahmacarya damaḥ śamaḥ || ete tvāmabhiṣiñcantu citraguptaśca pārthiva || 103 || daṇḍaśca piṅgalaścaiva mṛtyukālāvubhau tathā || vālakhilyāstathā sarve bhavantu vijayāya te ||104|| digdhenavaścatasrastvāṃ surābhiśca tathā nṛpa || abhiṣiñcantu sarvābhirgobhiḥ sārdhaṃ nareśvara ||105 || vedavyāsaśca vālmīkiḥ kamaṭho'tha parāśaraḥ || devalaḥ parvataścaiva durvāsāśca tathā muniḥ || 106 || yājñavalkyaśca jābāliḥ jamadagniḥ śuciśravāḥ || viśvāmitraḥ sthūlaśirāścyavano'trirvidūrathaḥ || 107 || ekataśca dvitaścaiva trito gautamagālavau || śāṇḍilyaśca bharadvājo maudgalyo vedavāhanaḥ || 108|| bṛhadaśvaḥ kuṭiśaṭho jaṭājānurghaṭodaraḥ || yavakrīto'rtharaityaśca ātmavānatha jaiminiḥ ||109|| ṛṣiḥ śārṅgaravaścaiva tathāgastyo mahātapāḥ || unmuvurmumuvuścaiva idhmabāhurmahodayaḥ || 110 || kātyāyanaśca kaṇvaśca valvakāmborunandanaḥ || ete tvāmabhiṣiñcantu ṛṣayaḥ pārthivottama || 111 || pṛthurdilīpo bharato duṣyantaḥ śatrujidbalī || manuḥ kakutsthaścānenā yuvanāśvo jayadrathaḥ || 112 || māndhātā mucukundaśca tathā rājā purūravāḥ || āyuśca nahuṣaścaiva yayātiraparājitaḥ || 113 || ikṣvākuśca yaduścaiva punarbhūriśravāstathā || ambarīṣaśca nābhāgo bṛhadaśvo mahāhanuḥ || 114 || pradyumnaścātha sudyumno bhūridyumnaśca sṛñjayaḥ || ete cānye ca rājānastava rājandivaṅgatāḥ ||115 || samāyāntvabhiṣekāya vijayāya tathā śriye || parjanyādyāstathā sarve vāstudevāssamāsataḥ || 116 || drumāścauṣadhayo ratnabījāni vividhāni ca || sarve tvāmabhiṣiñcantu rājanrājyena satvarāḥ || 117 || puruṣaścāprameyātmā mahābhūtāni yāni ca || pṛthivīvāyurākāśamāpo jyotistathaiva ca || 118 || manobuddhistathaivātmā avyaktaśca mahīpate || ete tvāmabhiṣiñcantu sametā vasudhādhipa || 119 || rukmabhaumaḥ śilābhaumaḥ pātālo nīlamṛttikaḥ || pīto raktakṣitiścaiva śvetabhaumastathaiva ca || 120 || ete tvāmabhiṣiñcantu vijayāya mahīpate || bhūloko'tha bhuvarlokaḥ svarloko'tha mahajjanaḥ || 121 || tapaḥ satyaśca rājendra vijayāya bhavantu te || jambūśākakuśakrauñcāḥ śālmalidvīpa eva ca || 122 || gomedhaḥ puṣkaraścaiva svasāmyaṃ pradiśantu te || uttarāḥ kuravaḥ puṇyā ramyā hairaṇvatastathā || 123 || bhadrāśvaḥ ketumālaśca varṣaścaiva ilāvṛtaḥ || harivarṣaḥ kiṃpuruṣo varṣo bhāratasaṃjñikaḥ || 124|| ete tvāmabhiṣiñcantu sametya vasudhādhipa || indradvīpaḥ kaśeruśca tāmravarṇo gabhastimān || 125 || nāgadvīpastathā saumyo gāndharvo vāruṇastathā || ayaṃ caruvasasteṣāṃ svasāmyaṃ pradiśantu te || 126 || himavānhemakūṭaśca niṣadho nīlaparvataḥ || śvetaśca śṛṅgavānmerurmālyavāngandhamādanaḥ ||127 || mahendro malayaḥ sahyaḥ śuktimānṛkṣavāṃstathā || vindhyaśca pāriyātraśca sarva eva mahīdharāḥ || 128 || samāgamyābhiṣiñcantu tvāmadya vasudhādhipa || ṛgvedo'tha yajurvedaḥ sāmavedastathaiva ca || 129 || atharvavedo vedāstvāmabhiṣiñcantu pārthiva || itihāso dhanurvedo gandharvaścāyussaṃjñitaḥ || 130 || vedopavedāśca tathā vijayāya bhavantu te || śikṣā kalpo vyākaraṇaṃ niruktaṃ jyotiṣāṅgatiḥ || 131 || chandovicitiṣaṣṭhāni vijayaṃ pradiśantu te || aṅgāni vedāścatvāro mīmāṃsā nyāyavistaraḥ || 132 || dharmaśāstraṃ purāṇañca vidyā etāścaturdaśa || sāṃkhyayogaḥ pañcarātraṃ vedāḥ pāśupataṃ tathā || 133 || kṛtānnapañcakaṃ hyetacchāstrāṇi vividhāni ca || gāyatrī pāpaśamanī durgā devī mahāśivā || 134 || gandhārī ca tathā vidyā vijayaṃ pradiśantu te || devadānavagandharvayakṣarākṣasapannagāḥ || 135 || ṛṣayo manavo gāvo devamātara eva ca || devapatnyo drumā nāgāḥ daityāścāpsarasāṅgaṇāḥ || 136 || śastrāṇi sarvaśāstrāṇi rājāno vāhanāni ca || auṣadhāni ca ratnāni kālasyāvayavāstathā ||137|| sthānāni ca samastāni puṇyānyāyatanāni ca || jīmūtāni ca sarvāṇi tadvikārāśca ye tathā || 138 || uktāni cāpya'nuktāni vijayāya bhavantu te || lavaṇaḥ kṣāratoyaśca ghṛtamaṇḍodakastathā || 139 || dadhimaṇḍodakaścaiva surodaśca narādhipa || tathaivekṣurasodaśca tathā svādūdakaśca yaḥ || 140 || garbhodaśca svatoyaistvāmabhiṣiñcantu pārthiva || catvārassāgarāścaiva svena toyena pārthiva || 141 || samāgamyābhiṣiñcantu vijayaṃ pradiśantu te || puṣkaraśca prayāgaśca prabhāso naimiṣastathā || 142 || tathā brahmasaraḥ puṇyaṃ gayāśīrṣaṃ ca pārthiva || kālodako nandikuṇḍaḥ tathaivottaramānasaḥ || 143 || svargamārgapradaścaiva tathā pañcanadaśca yaḥ || bhṛgutīrthaṃ caujasaśca tathaivāmarakaṇṭakaḥ||144|| āśramaḥ kālikāyāśca tṛṇabindostathāśramaḥ|| gopatīrthaṃ cāpatīrthaṃ vimalaḥ svarga eva ca||145|| jambūmārgaśca rājendra puṇyastaṇḍulikāśramaḥ || kapilasya tathā tīrthaṃ tīrthe vāṭikaṣaṇḍike || 146 || mahāsarastathāgastyaḥ kumārī tīrtha eva ca || gaṅgātīraḥ kuśāvarto bilvako nīlaparvataḥ || 147 || varāhaparvataścaiva tīrthaḥ kanakhalastathā || svargandhā vaśakumbhā ca tathā śākambharī ca yā || 148 || bhṛgutuṅgaḥ sakubjāmraḥ kapilasya tathāśramam || 149 || camasodbhedanaḥ puṇyastathā vinaśanaḥ śubhaḥ || ajatuṅgaśca somaśca ajogandhaśca pārthiva || kāliñjaraśca kedāro rudrakoṭistathaiva ca || 150 || mahālagnaśca rājendra vadanāśrama eva ca || nandā ca sūryatīrthaṃ ca somatīrthaṃ śatakratoḥ || 151 || aśvinorvaruṇasyāpi vāyovairśravaṇasya ca || brahmaṇaścaiva śarvasya yamasya cyavanasya ca ||152 || virūpākṣasya dharmasya tathā cāpsarasāṃ nṛpa || ṛṣīṇāṃ ca vasūnāṃ ca sādhyānāṃ marutāṃ tathā || 153 || ādityānāṃ ca rudrāṇāṃ tathā cāṅgirasāṃ nṛpa || viśvedevabhṛgūṇāṃ ca gandharvāṇāṃ ca mānada || 154 || plakṣaprasravaṇaścaiva suṣeṇaśca narādhipa || śāligrāmasaraścaiva vārāho vāmanastathā || 155 || kāmaśramastrikūṭaśca citrakūṭastathaiva ca || saptarcaḥ kratusāraśca tathā viṣṇupadaṃ saraḥ || 156 || kapilasya tathā tīrthaṃ vāsukestīrthameva ca || sindhūttamaṃ tapo dānaṃ tathā śūrpākaraḥ śubhaḥ || 157 || pauṇḍīrakaśca rājendra gaṅgāsāgarasaṅgamaḥ || sindhusāgarayoścaiva saṅgamaḥ sumanoharaḥ || 158 || tathā kundāvasundhaśca mānasaṃ ca mahatsaraḥ || tathā bindusaraḥ puṇyaṃ saraścācchodakaṃ tathā || 159 || dharmāraṇyaṃ phalgutīrthaṃ savimuktaṃ tathaiva ca || lauhityaśca tathā puṇyo badarīpāvanaḥ śivaḥ || 160 || tīrthaṃ saptaṛṣīṇāṃ ca vahnitīrthaṃ ca pārthiva || vastrāpathastato meṣaśchāgaleśaśca pārthiva || ||161|| puṣpanyāsassakāmeśastīrtho haṃsapadastathā || aśvaśīrṣaḥ sa kṛṣṇākhyo maṇibhadrastathaiva ca || 162 || devikā sindhumārgaśca svarṇabindustathaiva ca || āhalyakastathā tīrthastīrthaścairāvatastathā||163|| airāvatisamudbhede tīrthaṃ bhogayaśastathā || karavīrāśramaścaiva nāgamodānikastathā||164|| pāpamocanikaścaiva ṛṇamocanikastathā || udvejanastathā puṇyaḥ puṇyaśca hariśeśvaraḥ || 165 || devabrahmasaraḥ puṇyaṃ sarpirdarvī ca pārthiva || ete cānye ca bahavaḥ puṇyasaṅkīrtanāḥ śubhāḥ || 166 || toyaistvāmabhiṣiñcantu sarvapātakanāśanaiḥ || gaṅgā mahānadī puṇyā hrādinī hlādinī tathā || || 167 || pāvanī ca tathā sītā cakṣuḥ sindhuśca narmadā || suprabhā kātarākṣī ca śithilā mānasī hradā || 168 || sarasvatyoghanādā ca suveṇurvimalodakā || siprā śoṇaḥ śatadruśca sarayūrgaṇḍakī tathā || 169 || acchodā ca vipāśā ca candrabhāgā irāvatī || vitastā devikā rambhā pītā devahradā śivā || 170 || tathaivekṣumatī puṇyā kauśikī yamunā tathā || gomatī dhūtapāpā ca bāhudā ca dṛṣadvatī || 171 || niḥśīrā ca tṛtīyā ca lauhityaśca mahānadaḥ || vedasmṛtirvedasinī vetraghnī varadā tathā || 172 || varṇā mā candanā caiva bahunīrā kumudvatī || pārā carmaṇvatī rūpā vidiśā veṇuvatyapi || 173 || avantī ca tathā kuntī surasā ca palāśinī || mandākinī daśārṇā ca citrakūṭā dṛṣadvatī || || 174 || tamasā pippalā senī karamodā piśācikā || citropalā cittravarṇā maṃjulā vālukāvatī || 175 || śuktīmatī silī randhrā saṅkuṇātyayakāptataḥ || tāpī payoṣṇī nirvindhyā sitā ca niṣadhāvatī || 176 || veṇā vaitaraṇī bhīmā carmā rāmā tathā kuhuḥ || toyā caiva mahāgaurī durgā matuśilā tathā || 177 || godāvarī bhīmarathī kṛṣṇā veṇā ca vaṃjulā || tuṅgabhadrā suprakārā bāhyā kāverireva ca || 178 || kṛtamālā tāmraparṇī puṣpajā hyutpalāvatī || trisamā ṛṣikulyā ca pṛthukā tridivālayā || 179 || lāṅgūlinī vaṃśadharā sukumārā kulāvatī || ṛṣikā karivegā ca mandagā mandavāhinī || 180 || kṛpī darvī dayā vyomā paroṣṇī kolavāhinī || kampanā ca viśalyā ca karatoyāṃśuvāhinī || 181 || tāmrāruṇā vetravatī gomatī cātha nadyapi || adriṇī trikasā caiva suprakārā hiraṇvatī || 182 || āpagā cālakā bhāsī sandhyā ca maḍavā nadī || nandā cālakanandā ca śuddhā ca vasuvāhinī || 183 || etāścānyāśca rājendra nadyastvāṃ vimalodakāḥ || sarvapāpapraśamanāssarvalokasya mātaraḥ || svatoyapūrṇaiḥ kalaśairabhiṣiñcantu pārthiva || 184 || etairyathoktairnṛpa rājarājye dattābhiṣekaḥ pṛthivīṃ samagrām || sasāgarāṃ bhuṃkṣva ciraṃ ca jīva dharme ca te buddhiratīva cāstu||185|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0 saṃ0 bhārgavarāmaṃ prati puṣkaravyākhyāne'bhiṣekamantro nāma dvāviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ||22|| <2.23> puṣkara uvāca || mantrā ye kīrtitā rāma mayāsmiṃstava bhārgava || teṣāṃ saṃkīrtanaṃ dhanyaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam ||1|| aiteṣāṃ kalyamutthāya yaḥ kuryātkīrtanaṃ naraḥ || sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ svargalokamavāpnuyāt||2|| tiryagyoniṃ na gacchettu narakaṃ saṃkarāṇi ca || na ca duḥkhaṃ na ca bhayaṃ maraṇaṃ na sa ca muhyati || 3 || eteṣāṃ ca namaskāraṃ yaḥ kuryātprayato naraḥ ||| na tasya tiṣṭhate pāpamabbinduriva puṣkare || 4 || eteṣāṃ tarpaṇaṃ kṛtvā snātaḥ prayatamānasaḥ || mahāpātakayukto'pi tvacevāhirvimucyate || 5 || eteṣāṃ puṣpadānena mahatīṃ śriyamaśnute || eteṣāṃ cārghyadānena pūjyo bhavati mānavaḥ || 6 || eteṣāṃ dīpadānena bhrājante candravaddivi || eteṣāmāhutiṃ dattvā kāmānāpnoti puṣkalān || 7 || naivedyaṃ ca baliṃ dattvā bhogānprāpnotyanuttamāna || etānuddiśya vipreṣu dattvā bhārgava bhojanam || 8 || saṃtarpya dakṣiṇābhiśca tridivaṃ prāpnuyācciram || abhiṣekadine rājñāṃ puṣpasnāne tathaiva ca || 9 || tathā saṃvatsaragranthau sarve pūjyā hitaiṣiṇā || yāni tīrthāni coktāni saritaśca samāsataḥ || 10 || teṣāṃ gamena pūjyante ye'pi pātakino janāḥ || snānaṃ mahāphalaṃ teṣāṃ tapaḥ śrāddha kriyāstathā || 11 || dānaṃ bahuphalaṃ proktaṃ darśanaṃ pāpanāśanam || kīrtanaṃ bhārgavaśreṣṭha na me cāsti vicāraṇā || 12 || tīrtheṣvathaiteṣu bhṛgupradhāna snātā narā yānti narendra sadyaḥ|| tīrthāni gamyāni tataḥ prayatnātpuṇyāśca sarvāssaritaśca rāma|| 13 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde tīrthaphalavarṇano nāma trayoviṃśatitamodhyāyaḥ || 23 || <2.24> || rāma uvāca || || rājño'bhiṣiktamātrasya kinnu kṛtyatamaṃ bhavet || etanme sarvamācakṣva sarvaṃ vetti yato bhavān || 1 || || puṣkara uvāca || abhiṣekārdraśirasā rājñā rājīvalocana || sahāyavaraṇaṃ kāryaṃ tatra rājyaṃ pratiṣṭhitam || 2 || yadapyalpataraṃ karma tadathaikena duṣkaram || puruṣeṇāsahāyena kinnu rājyaṃ mahatpadam || 3|| tasmātsahāyānvarayetkulīnānnṛpatiḥ svayam || śūrānuttamajātīyānbalayuktāñchrutānvitān || 4 || rūpasatvaguṇaudāryasaṃyuktānkṣamayā yutān|| kleśakṣamānmahotsāhāndharmajñāṃśca priyaṃvadān || 5 || hitopadeśikānprājñānsvāmibhaktānyaśorthinaḥ || evaṃ vidhānsahāyāṃstu śubha karmaṇi yojayet || 6 || guṇahīnānapi tathā vijñāya nṛpatiḥ svayam || karmasveva niyuñjīta yathāyogyeṣu bhārgava || 7 || kulīnāḥ śīlasaṃpannā dhanurvedaviśāradāḥ || hastiśikṣāśvaśikṣāsu kuśalāśślakṣṇabhāṣitaiḥ || 8 || nimitte śakunajñāne vittavaidyacikitsake || puruṣāntaravijñāne ṣāḍguṇyena viniścitāḥ || 9 || kṛtajñāḥ karmaṇāṃ śūrāstathā kleśasahā ṛjuḥ || vyūhatattvavidhānajñaḥ phalgusāraviśeṣavit || 10 || rājñāṃ senāpatiḥ kāryo brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo'thavā || prāṃśuḥ surūpo dakṣaśca priyavādī na coddhataḥ || 11 || cittagrāhaśca sarveṣāṃ pratīhāro vidhīyate || yathoktavādī dhūrttaḥ syāddeśabhāṣāviśāradaḥ || 12 || śābdaḥ kleśasaho vāgmī deśakālavibhāṣitā || vijñāya deśaṃ kālaṃ vā hitaṃ yatsyānmahīkṣitaḥ || 13 || vaktāpi tasyaḥ yaḥ kāle sa dūto nṛpatirbhavet || prāṃśavo vyāyatāḥ śūrā dṛḍhabhaktā nirākulāḥ || 14 || rājñā tu rakṣiṇaḥ kāryāstadā kleśasahā hitāḥ || ahāryāścānṛśaṃsāśca dṛḍhabhaktāśca pārthive || 15 || tāmbūladhārī bhavati nārī cāpyatha tadguṇā || ṣāḍguṇyavidhi tattvajño deśabhāṣāviśāradaḥ || 16 || sandhivigrahakaḥ kāryo rājñā nayaviśāradaḥ || āyavyayajño lokajño deśotpattiviśāradaḥ || 17 || kṛtākṛtajño bhṛtyānāṃ jñeyaḥ syāddakṣarakṣitā || surūpastaruṇaḥ śūro dṛḍhabhaktaḥ kulocitaḥ || 18 || śūraḥ kleśasahaścaiva khaḍgadhārī prakīrtitaḥ || śūraśca bahuyuktaśca gajāśvarathakovidaḥ || 19 || kośadhārī bhavedrājñaḥ sadā kleśasahaśca yaḥ || nimittaśakunajñānahayaśikṣāviśāradaḥ ||20 || hayāyurvedatattvajño bhūmibhāgaviśeṣavit || balābalajño rathināṃ sthiradṛṣṭirviśāradaḥ || 23 || śūraśca kṛtavidyaśca sārathiḥ parikīrtitaḥ || anāhāryaḥ śucirdakṣaḥ cikitsakavacorataḥ || 22 || sūdaśāstravidhānājñaḥ sūdādhyakṣaḥ praśasyate || sūdaśāstravidhānajñāḥ parābhedyāḥ kulodgatāḥ || 23 || sarve mahānase kāryā nīcakeśanakhā janāḥ || samaḥ śatrau ca mitre ca dharmaśāstraviśāradaḥ || 24 || vipramukhyaḥ kulīnaśca dharmādhikaraṇo bhavet || kāryāstathāvidhāstatra dvijamukhyāḥ sabhāsadaḥ||25|| sarvadeśākṣarābhijñāḥ sarvaśāstraviśāradāḥ || lekhakāḥ kathitā rāma sarvādhikaraṇeṣu vai||26|| śīrṣopetānsusaṃpūrṇānsamadroṇīgatānsamān || akṣarānvilikhedyastu lekhakaḥ sa varaḥ smṛtaḥ || 27 || upāyavākyakuśalaḥ sarvaśāstraviśāradaḥ || bahvarthavaktā cālpena lekhakaḥ syādbhṛgūttama || 28 || puruṣāntaratattvajñāḥ prāṃśavaścāpyalolupāḥ || dharmādhikaraṇe kāryā janāhvānakarā narāḥ || 29|| evaṃvidhāstathā kāryā rājño dauvārikā janāḥ || lohavastrādidhātūnāṃ ratnānāṃ ca vibhāgavit ||30|| vijñātā phalgusārāṇāṃ tvanāhāryaḥ śucissadā || nipuṇaścāpramattaśca dhanādhyakṣaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 31 || āyadvāreṣu sarveṣu dhanādhyakṣasamā narāḥ || vyayadvāreṣu sarveṣu kartavyāḥ pṛthivīkṣitā || 32 || paraṃ pāraṃ gato yaḥ syādaṣṭāṅgeṣu cikitsite || anāhāryassa vaidyaḥ syāddharmātmā ca kulodgataḥ || 33 || prāṇācāryassa vijñeyo vacanaṃ tasya bhūbhujā || rāma snehātsadā kāryaṃ yathā kāryaṃ pṛthagjanaiḥ || 34 || hastiśikṣāvidhānajño vanajātiviśāradaḥ || kleśakṣamastathā rājño gajādhyakṣaḥ praśasyate || 35 || etaireva guṇairyukto svādhīnaśca viśeṣataḥ || gajāroho narendrasya sarvakarmasu śasyate || 36 || hayaśikṣāvidhānajña staccikitsitapāragaḥ || aśvādhyakṣo mahībharttuḥ svāsanaśca praśasyate || 37 || anāhāryaśca śūraśca tathā prājñaḥ kulodgataḥ || durgādhyakṣaḥ smṛto rāma udyuktaḥ sarvakarmasu || 38 || vāstuvidyāvidhānajño lagnahasto jitaśramaḥ || dīrghadarśī ca śūraśca sthapatiḥ parikīrtitaḥ || 39 || yantramukte pāṇimukte amukte muktadhārite || astrācāryo niyuddhe ca kuśalaśca tatheṣyate || 40 || pañcāśadadhikā nāryaḥ puruṣāḥ saptatistathā || antaḥpuracarāḥ kāryā rājñā sarveṣu karmasu || 41 || sthavirā jātitattvajñāḥ satataṃ pratijāgrataḥ || rājñaḥ syādāyudhāgāre dakṣaḥ karmasu codyataḥ || 42 || karmāṇyaparimeyāni rājñāṃ bhṛgukulodvaha || uttamādhamamadhyāni buddhvā karmāṇi pārthiva || 43 || uttamādhamamadhyām̐stu puruṣānviniyojayeta || na karmaṇi viparyāsādrājā nāśamavāpnuyāt || 44 || niyuktapuruṣe bhaktiṃ śrutaṃ śauryaṃ balaṃ kulam || jñātvā vṛttirvidhātavyā puruṣāṇāṃ mahīkṣitā || 45 || puruṣāntaravijñāne tattvamātranibandhanāḥ || narendralakṣyā dharmajñāstatrāyatto bhavennṛpaḥ ||46|| svabhṛtyāśca tathā puṣṭāssatataṃ pratimānitāḥ || rājñā sahāyāḥ kartavyāḥ pṛthivīṃ jetumicchatā ||47|| yathārhaṃ cātha subhṛtānrājā karmasu yojayeta || dharmiṣṭhāndharmakāryeṣu śūrānsaṃgrāmakarmaṇi || 48 || nipuṇānarthakṛtyeṣu sarvatra ca tathā śucīn || strīṣu ṣaṇḍhānniyuñjīta tīkṣṇāndāruṇakarmasu ||49|| dharme cārthe ca kāme ca bhaye ca bhṛgunandana || rājā yathārhaṃ kuryāttānhyupadhābhiḥ parīkṣitān || 50 || samatīto yathārhāyāṃ kuryāddhastivane carān || utpādānveṣaṇaṃ yattānadhyakṣām̐statra kārayet || 51 || evamādīni karmāṇi yatnaiḥ kāryāṇi bhārgava || sarvathā neṣyate rājñastīkṣṇopakaraṇakṣayaḥ || 52 || pāpasādhyāni karmāṇi yāni rājñāṃ bhṛgūttama || santastāni na kurvanti tasmāttānbibhṛyānnṛpaḥ || 53 || neṣyate pṛthivīśānāṃ tīkṣṇopakaraṇakṣayaḥ || yasminkarmaṇi yasya syādviśeṣeṇa ca kauśalam || 54 || tasminkarmaṇi taṃ rājā parīkṣya viniyojayet || pitṛpaitāmahānbhṛtyānsarvakarmasu yojayet || 55 || vinā dāyādakṛtyeṣu tatra te hi samāsataḥ || rājā dāyādakṛtyeṣu parīkṣya svakṛtānnarān || 56 || niyuñjīta mahābhāgaḥ tasya te hitakāriṇaḥ || pararājagṛhānprāptāñjanasaṃgrahakāmyayā || 57 || uṣṭānvāpyatha vā duṣṭānsaṃśrayeta prayatnataḥ || duṣṭaṃ vijñāya viśvāsaṃ na kuryāttatra bhūmipaḥ || 68 || vṛttiṃ tasyāpi vartteta janasaṃgrahakāmyayā || rājā deśāntaraprāptaṃ puruṣaṃ pūjayedbhṛśam || 59 || sahāyaṃ deśasaṃprāptaṃ bahumānena cintayeta || kāmaṃ bhṛtyārjanaṃ rājā naiva kuryādbhṛgūttama || 60 || na vai vāsaṃ vibhaktaṃ tu bhṛtyaṃ kuryātkathañcana || śastramagniṃ viṣaṃ sarpānnistriṃśamapi caikataḥ || 61 || bhṛtyā manujaśārdūla kubhṛtyāśca tathaikataḥ || teṣāṃ cāreṇa vijñānaṃ rājñā vijñāya nityaśaḥ || 62 || guṇināṃ pūjanaṃ kuryānnirguṇānāṃ ca śāsanam || kathitāḥ satataṃ rāma rājānaścāracakṣuṣaḥ || || 63 || svadeśe paradeśe ca jātiśīlānvicakṣaṇān || anāhāryānkleśasahānniyuñjīta sadā carān || 64 || janasyāvitatānsaumyāṃstathā jñātānparasparam || vaṇijo mantrakuśalānsāṃvatsaracikitsitān || 65 || tathā pravrajitākārānrājā cārānniyojayeta || naikasya rājā śraddadhyāccārasyāpi ca bhāṣitam || 66 || dvayossaṃvādamājñāya sandadhyānnṛpatistataḥ || parasparasyāviditau yadi syātāṃ na tāvubhau || 67 || tasmādrājā prayatnena gūḍhāṃścārānprayojayeta || rājyasya mūlametāvadyadrājñaścāradṛṣṭitā || 68 || cārāṇāmapi yatnena rājñā kāryaṃ parīkṣaṇam || rāgāparāgau bhṛtyānāṃ janasya ca guṇāguṇān || 69 || śubhānāmaśubhānāṃ ca vijñānaṃ rāma karmaṇām || sarvaṃ rājñāṃ carāyattaṃ teṣvāyattassadā bhavet || 70 || karmaṇā kena me loke janassarvo'nurajyate || virajyate tathā kena vijñeyaṃ tanmahīkṣitā || virāgajananaṃ sarvaṃ varjanīyaṃ prayatnataḥ || 71 || janānurāgaprabhavo hi lakṣyo rājñāṃ yato bhārgavavaṃśacandra || tasmātprayatnena narendramukhyaiḥ kāryo'nurāgo bhuvi mānaveṣu || 72 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde sahāyasampattirnāma caturviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 24 || <2.25> || puṣkara uvāca|| yathānuvartitavyaṃ syādrāma rājopajīvibhiḥ || tathā te kathayiṣyāmi nibodha gadato mama || 1 || ājñā sarvātmanā kāryā svaśaktyā bhṛgunandana || ākṣipya vacanaṃ tasya na vaktavyaṃ tathā vacaḥ || 2 || anukūlaṃ priyaṃ tasya vaktavyaṃ janasannidhau || rahogatasya vaktavyamapriyaṃ yaddhitaṃ bhavet || 3 || parārthamatha vaktavyaṃ svasthe cetasi bhārgava || svāsthyaṃ suhṛdbhirvaktavyaṃ na svayaṃ tu kathaṃcana || 4 || kāryātipātakaṃ kāryai rakṣitavyaṃ prayatnataḥ || na ca hiṃsyadhanaṃ kiñcinniyuktena ca karmaṇi || 5 || nopekṣyaṃ tasya mānaṃ ca tathā rājñā priyo bhavet || rājñaśca na tathā kāryaṃ veśabhāṣitaceṣṭitam ||6|| rājalīlā na kartavyā taddiṣṭaṃ ca vivarjayet || rājñassamādhikau veśau na tu kāryau vijānatā || 7 || dyūtādiṣu tathaivāsya kauśalaṃ tu pradarśayet || pradarśya kauśalaṃ cāsya rājānaṃ na viśeṣayet || 8 || antaḥpuradhanādhyakṣairvairidūtairnirākṛtaiḥ || saṃsargaṃ na vrajedrāma vinā pārthivaśāsanam || 9 || nimnehatāṃ cāvamānaṃ tatprayuktaṃ ca gopayet || yacca guhyaṃ bhavedrājñastanna loke prakāśayet || 10 || nṛpeṇa śrāvitaṃ yatsyādguhyādguhyaṃ bhṛgūttama || na tatsaṃśrāvayelloke tathā rājñaḥ priyo bhavet || 11 || ājñapyamāne cānyasminsamutthāya tvarānvitaḥ || ahaṃ kiṅkaravāṇīti vācyo rājā vijānatā || 12 || kāryāvasthāṃ ca vijñāya kāryametattathā bhavet || satataṃ kriyamāṇesmim̐llāghavaṃ tu vrajedbudhaḥ || 13 || rājñaḥ priyāṇi vākyāni na cātyarthaṃ punaḥpunaḥ || na hāsyaśīlaśca bhavenna cāpi bhṛkuṭīmukhaḥ|| || 14 || nātivaktā na nirvaktā na ca mātsarikastathā || ātmasambhāvitaścaiva na bhavettu kathañcana || 15 || duṣkṛtāni narendrasya na ca saṃkīrtayetkvacit || vastraṃ patramalaṅkāraṃ rājñā dattaṃ tu dhārayet || 16 || audāryeṇa na taddeyamanyasminbhūtimicchatā || na caivādhyaśanaṃ rājñaḥ svapanaṃ cāpi kārayet || 17 || nānirdiṣṭe tathā dvāre praviśeta kathañcana || na ca paśyeta rājānamayogyāsu ca bhūmiṣu || 18 || rājñastu dakṣiṇe pārśve vāme copaviśettadā || purastāttu yathā paścādāsanaṃ tu vigarhitam||19|| jṛmbhā niṣṭhīvanaṃ kāmaṃ kopaṃ paryaṃkikāśrayam|| mukuṭaṃ vātamudgāraṃ tatsamīpe vivarjayet|| svayaṃ tathā na kurvīta svaguṇākhyāpanaṃ budhaḥ|| svaguṇākhyāpane kuryātparāneva prayojakān||21|| hṛdayaṃ nirmalaṃ kṛtvā paraṃ bhaktimupāśritaiḥ || anujīvigaṇairbhāvyaṃ nityaṃ rājñāmatandritaiḥ || 22 || śāṭhyaṃ laulyamapaiśunyaṃ nāstikyaṃ kṣudratāṃ tathā || cāpalyaṃ ca parityājyaṃ nityaṃ rājānujīvinā || 23 || śrutena vidyāśilpaiśca saṃyojyātmānamātmanā || rājasevāṃ tataḥ kuryādbhūtaye bhītivardhanaḥ || 24 || namaskāryāssadā cāsya putravallabhamantriṇaḥ || sacivaiścāsya viśvāsaṃ na tu kāryaṃ kathañcana || 25 || apṛṣṭaścāsya na brūyātkāmaṃ brūyāttathāpadi || hitaṃ pathyaṃ ca vacanaṃ hitaissaha suniścitam || 26 || cittaṃ caivāsya vijñeyaṃ nityamevānujīvinā || bharturārādhanaṃ kuryāccittajño mānavaḥ sukham || 27 || | rāgāparāgau caivāsya vijñeyau bhūtimicchatā || tyajedviraktaṃ nṛpatiṃ raktādvṛttiṃ tu kāmayet || 28 || karmopakārayornāśaṃ vipakṣābhyudayaṃ tathā || āśāsaṃvardhanaṃ kṛtvā phalanāśaṃ karoti ca || 29 || akopopi prakopābhaḥ prasannopi ca niṣphalaḥ || vākyaṃ samandaṃ vadati vṛtticchedaṃ karoti ca || | || 30 || praveśavākyānuditau na saṃbhāvayatītyatha || ārādhanāsu sarvāsu suptavacca viceṣṭate || 31 || kathāsu doṣaiḥ kṣipati vākyacchedaṃ karoti ca || lakṣyate vimukhaścaiva guṇasaṅkīrtane kṛte || 052 || dṛṣṭiṃ kṣipatyathānyatra kriyamāṇe ca karmaṇi || viraktalakṣaṇaṃ śrutvā śṛṇu raktasya lakṣaṇam || 33 || dṛṣṭvā prasanno bhavati vākyaṃ gṛhṇāti cādarāt || kuśalādiparipraśne saṃprayacchati cāsanam || 34 || viviktadarśane cāsya rahasye na ca śaṅkate || jāyate hṛṣṭavadanaḥ śrutvā tasya tu saṅkathām || 35 || apriyāṇyapi vākyāni taduktānyabhinandati || upāyanaṃ ca gṛhṇāti stokamapyādarāttathā || 36 || kathāntareṣu sarati prahaṣṭavadanastathā || iti raktasya kartavyā sevā bhṛgukulodvaha || āpatsu na tyajetpūrvaṃ viraktamapi sevitam||37|| mitraṃ na cāpatsu tathā na bhṛtyaṃ vrajanti ye nirguṇamaprameyam || prabhuṃ viśeṣeṇa ca te vrajanti surendradhāmāsuravṛnda juṣṭam || 38 || || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde anujīvivṛttaṃ nāma pañcaviṃśodhyāyaḥ || 25 || <2.26> || puṣkara uvāca || || rājā sahāyasaṃyuktaḥ prabhūtayavasendhanam || ramyamānatasāmantaḥ paśavyaṃ deśamāvaset || 1 || vaiśyaśūdrajanaprāyamanāhāryaṃ tathā paraiḥ || kiñcidbrāhmaṇasaṃyuktaṃ bahukarmakaraṃ tathā || 2 || adevamātṛkaṃ karmasvanuraktajanācitam || karairapīḍitaṃ cāpi bahupuṣpaṃ phalaṃ tathā || 3 || agamyaṃ paracakrāṇāṃ tadvādasahamāpadi || samaduḥkhasukhaṃ rājñaḥ satataṃ ca priye sthitam || 4 || sarīsṛpavihīnaṃ ca vyādhitaskaravarjitam || evaṃvidhaṃ yathālābhaṃ rājā viṣayamāvaseta || 5 || tatra durgaṃ nṛpaḥ kuryātṣaṇṇāmekatamaṃ budhaḥ || dhanvadurgaṃ mahīdurgaṃ naradurgaṃ tathaiva ca || 6 || vārkṣaṃ cevāṃbudurgaṃ ca giridurgaṃ ca bhārgava || sarveṣāmeva durgāṇāṃ giridurgaṃ praśasyate || 7 || durgaṃ ca parikhopetaṃ nṛpāṭṭālakasaṃyutam || śataghnīyantramukhyaiśca śataśaśca tathā yutam || 8 || gopuraṃ saṅkapāṭaṃ ca tatra syātsumanoharam || sapatākagajārūḍho yena rājā viśetpuram || 9 || catasraśca tathā tatra kāryāścāpaṇavīthayaḥ || ekasmim̐statra vīthyagre devaveśma bhaveddṛḍham || 10 || vīthyagre ca dvitīye vai rājaveśmābhidhīyate || dharmādhikaraṇaṃ kāryaṃ vīthyagre ca tṛtīyake || 11 || caturthe caiva vīthyagre gopuraṃ ca vidhīyate || āyataṃ caturasraṃ vā vṛttaṃ cākārayetpuram || 12 || muktihīnaṃ trikoṇaṃ ca yavamadhyaṃ tathaiva ca || ardhacandraprakāraṃ ca vajrākāraṃ ca varjayet || 13 || ardhacandraṃ praśaṃsanti nadītīraṃ tu tadvaśāt || anyatra tanna kartavyaṃ prayatnena vijānatā || 14 || rājñaḥ kośagṛhaṃ kāryaṃ dakṣiṇe rājaveśmanaḥ || tasyāpi dakṣiṇe bhāge gajasthānaṃ vidhīyate||15|| gajānāṃ prāṅmukhī śālā kartavyā cāpyudaṅmukhī || āgneye ca tathā bhāge āyudhāgāra iṣyate || 16|| mahānasaṃ ca dharmajñaḥ karmaśālāstathāparāḥ || gṛhaṃ purodhasaḥ kāryaṃ vāmato rājaveśmanaḥ || 17 || mantridaivavidāṃ caiva cikitsākartureva ca || tatraiva ca tathā bhāge koṣṭhāgāraṃ vidhīyate || 18 || gavāṃ sthānaṃ tu karttavyaṃ turagāṇāṃ tathaiva ca || uttarābhimukhī śreṇī turagāṇāṃ vidhīyate || 19 || prāṅmukhī cāpi dharmajña pariśeṣā vigarhitā || turagāśca tathā dhāryā praśastaiḥ sārvarātrikaiḥ || || 20 || kukkuṭānvānarāṃścaiva markaṭāṃśca narādhipa || dhārayedatha śālāsu savatsāṃ dhenumeva ca || 21 || ajāśca dhāryā yatnena turagāṇāṃ hitaiṣiṇā || gogajāśvaviśālāsu tatpurīṣasya niṣkramam || 22 || astaṅgate na kartavyaṃ devadeve divākare || tatastatra yathānyāyaṃ rājā vijñāya sāravit || 23 || dadyādāvasathasthānaṃ sarveṣāmanupūrvaśaḥ || yodhānāṃ śilpināṃ caiva sarveṣāmaviśeṣataḥ || 24 || dadyādāvasathāndurge mantrakālavidāṃ satāma || govaidyānaśvavaidyāṃśca gajavaidyāṃstathaiva ca || 25 || āhareta bhṛśaṃ rājā durge parabalārujaḥ || kuśīlavānāṃ viprāṇāṃ durge sthānaṃ vidhīyate || || 205 || na bahūnāṃ na tairdurgaṃ vinā kāryaṃ tathā bhavet || durge ca yantrāḥ kartavyā nānāpraharaṇānvitāḥ || 27 || sahasraghātino rāma taistu rakṣā vidhīyate || durge dvārāṇi guptāni kāryāṇyapi ca bhūbhujā || 28 || sañcayaścātra sarveṣāṃ cāyudhānāṃ praśasyate || dhanuṣāṃ kṣepaṇīyānāṃ tomarāṇāṃ ca bhārgava || 29 || śarāṇāmatha khaḍgānāṃ khanakānāṃ tathaiva ca || laguḍānāṃ guḍānāṃ ca huḍānāṃ parighaiḥ saha || 30 || aśmanāṃ ca prabhūtānāṃ mudgarāṇāṃ tathaiva ca || kaṇiyānāṃ triśūlānāṃ paṭṭiśānāṃ ca bhārgava || 31 || prāsānāṃ ca tsarūṇāṃ ca śaktīnāṃ ca narottama || paraśvadhānāṃ cakrāṇāṃ carmaṇāṃ carmabhiḥ saha || 32 || kuddālarajjuvetrāṇāṃ piṭikānāṃ tathaiva ca || hrasvakānāṃ ca pātrāṇāmagarasya ca saṃśrayama || 33 || sarveṣāṃ citrabhāṇḍānāṃ sañcayaścātra iṣyate || vāditrāṇāṃ ca sarveṣāmauṣadhānāṃ tathaiva ca || 384 || yavasānāṃ prabhūtānāṃ cendhanasya ca sañcayam || guḍasya sarvaśailānāṃ gorasānāṃ tathaiva ca || 39 || carmaṇāṃ ca sasajjānāṃ snāyūnāmasthibhiḥ saha || gorasasya paṭānāṃ ca dhānyānāṃ sarvatastathā || 36 || tathaiva prapaṭānāṃ ca yavagodhūmayorapi || ratnānāṃ sarvavastrāṇāṃ lohānāṃ cāpyaśeṣataḥ ||37 || kalāyamudgamāṣāṇāṃ caṇakānāṃ tilaiḥ saha || tathā ca sarvasasyānāṃ pāṃśugomayayorapi ||388||| saṇasarjarasaṃ bhūrjajatulākṣākaṭaṃkaṭām || rājā sañcinuyāddurge yaccānyadapi kiñcana || 39 || kumbhāḥ sāṣīviṣā dhāryā vyāghrasiṃhādayastathā || mṛgāśca pakṣiṇaścaiva paśavaśca pṛthagvidhāḥ ||4 0 || sañceyāni viruddhānāṃ suguptāni pṛthakpṛthaka || kartavyāni mahābhāga yatnena pṛthivīkṣitā || 41 || uktāni cāpyanuktāni rājadravyāṇyaśeṣataḥ || suguptāni pure kuryājjanānāṃ hita kāmyayā || 42 || jīvakarṣabhakākolīrāmalakyaḥ parūṣakam || śāliparṇī pṛśniparṇī mudgaparṇī tathaiva ca || 43 || māṣaparṇī tathā caiva sārive dve balābhayama || vīrāśvagandhā vṛthvīkā bṛhatī kaṇṭakārikā ||44|| śṛṅgāṭikā rodragodhī varṣābhūdarbhagundrakā || madhuparṇīvidāryau dve mahādurgā mahā tathā || 45 || dhanvanā mahaṛgvyāhyā trikoṭī raṇḍakaṃ viṣam || parṇāsanāhvī mṛdvīkā phalguḥ kharjūrayaṣṭikā || 46 || śukrātiśukrakāśmaryaśchatrāticchatravīraṇā || ikṣurikṣuvikāraśca phāṇitādyāśca bhārgava || 47 || sahāśca sahadevāśca viśvedevāḍharūpakam || madhūkapuṣpaṃ haṃsākhyā śatapuṣpamadhūlikā || 48 || śatāvarī madhūkaṃ ca priyālaṃ tālameva ca || ātmaguptā kaṭphalākhyā daradā rājaserukā ||49|| rājarṣabhakadhānakyā ṛṣyaproktā tathotkaṭā || kaṭaṃkaṭā padmabījaṃ govallī madhuvallikā ||50 || śītapākī kuliṅgākṣī kākajihvorupatrikā || ervārumrapasau cobhau muñjātakapunarnavā ||51 || kāśerukā tugākṣīrā bilveśālūkakesaram || śūkadhānyāni sarvāṇi śambīdhānyāni yāni ca || 52 || kṣīraṃ kṣaudraṃ tathā śuklaṃ majjā tailaṃ vasā ghṛtama || nikocābhiṣukākṣoṭaṃ vātāpaṃ sorukhāṇakam || 53 || evamādīni cānyāni vijñeyo madhuro gaṇaḥ
