|| rājā sañcinuyātsarvaṃ pure niravaśeṣataḥ || 54 || dāḍimāṃmrātakāṃ līnaṃ titantiḍīkāmlavetasam || bhavyakaḥ kaṇḍalīkaśca makarandakarūpakam ||55|| bījapūrakakāṇḍīramālatī rājadhanvanā || kolakadvayaparṇāni dvayorallīkayorapi||56|| pālevataṃ bhāgarikaṃ prācīnārūkameva ca || kapitthāmalakaṃ cukraṃ kalindaṃ ca śaṭhasya ca||57|| jāmbavaṃ navanītaṃ ca sauvīrakatupocake || surāsavaṃ ca madyāni maṇḍaṃ takradadhīni ca || 58 || śuklāni caiva sarvāṇi jñeyānyamlagaṇāni vai || saindhavodbhedanādeyapākyasāmudrarocasam || kūpyasauvarcalaviḍaṃ vālakailopabāhukam || 59 || ūṣakṣāraṃ kālabhasma vijñeyau lāvaṇo gaṇaḥ || evamādīni cānyāni rājā sañcinuyātpure || 60 || pippalī pippalīmūlaṃ cavyacitrakanāgaram || kuṭherakaṃ samaricaṃ śigruṃ bhallāta durgaṃ suguptaṃ nṛpatissadaiva||88|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0saṃ0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkarākhyāne durgasampattirnāma ṣaḍviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ||26|| <2.27> rāma uvāca || rakṣoghnāni viṣaghnāni yāni kāryāṇi bhūbhujā || agadāni samācakṣva tāni dharmabhṛtāṃ vara || 1 || puṣkara uvāca || bilvāḍhakī yavakṣārapāṭalībāhlikoṣaṇāḥ || śrīparṇī sallakīyuktā niṣkvāthaḥ prokṣaṇaṃ param || 2 || saviṣaṃ prokṣitaṃ tena sadyo bhavati nirviṣaḥ || yavasaindhavapānīyavasuśayyāsanaudanam || 3 || kavacābharaṇacchatrabālavyajanameva ca || śailūpāṭalyativiṣāśigrugopīpunarnavāḥ || 4 || sasaṅgāvṛkṣamūlatvakkapitthaṃ vṛkṣaśoṇitam || sahadantaśaṭhaṃ tadvatprokṣiṇaṃ viṣanāśanam || 5 || lākṣā priyaṅumañjiṣṭhāsamaṅgā sahareṇukā || sayaṣṭyāhvamadhūpetā babhrupittena kalkitāḥ || 6 || nikhanedgoviṣāṇasthā saptarātraṃ mahītale || tataḥ kṛtvā maṇiṃ hemnā baddhaṃ hastena dhārayet || || 7 || saṃspṛṣṭassaviṣastena sadyo bhavati nirviṣaḥ || manohvālaśamīpuṣpatvaṅniśāśvetasarṣapāḥ || 8 || kapitthakuṣṭhamañjiṣṭhāḥ pittena ślakṣṇakalkitāḥ || dhanogavaḥ kapillāyāḥ saumyākhyo'yaṃ puro gadaḥ || 9 || viṣajitparamaḥ prokto maṇiratra ca pūrvavat || mūṣakājirakā cāpi haste baddhvā viṣāpahā || 10 || hareṇumāsī maṃjiṣṭhā rajanīmadhukaṃ madhu || akṣatvaksurasaṃ.... ..śvapittaṃ pūrvavarmaṇi || 11 || vāditrāṇi patākāśca viṣṭairetaiḥ pralepitā || śrutvā dṛṣṭvā samādhāya sadyo bhavati nirviṣaḥ || 12 || tatpūṣaṇaṃ pañcalavaṇaṃ mañjiṣṭhārajanīdvayam || sūkṣmailā trivṛtāpatraṃ viruṅgānīṃdravāruṇī || 13 || madhukaṃ ceti sakṣaudraṃ goviṣāṇairnidhāpayet || tasmāduṣṇāmbunā mātrāṃ prāguktāṃ yojayettathā || ||14|| viṣaṃ bhuktaṃ jarāṃ yāti nirviṣopi na doṣakṛt || saṃtusarjarasośīrasarṣapāpatravālukaiḥ ||15|| savellāruṣkarapuraiḥ kusumairarjunasya ca|| dhūpovāso gṛhe hanti viṣaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamam || 16 || na tatra kīṭā na viṣā dardurā na sarīsṛpāḥ || na kṛtyāḥ karma nā'nyacca dhūpoyaṃ yatra dahyate || 17 || kalkitaiścandanakṣīrapalāśadrumavalkalaiḥ || pūrvailavālusurasānākulītaṇḍulīyakaiḥ || 18 || kvāthaḥ sarvodakāryeṣu kākamācījalairvṛtaḥ || rocanāpatra naipālīkuṃkumaistilakaṃ vahan || 19 || viṣaṃ na bādhate syācca naranārīnṛpapriyaḥ || cūrṇairharidrāmaṃjiṣṭhākiṇihīkaṇanimbakaiḥ || 20 || jighraṃ nnirviṣatāmeti gātraṃ sarvaviṣārditam || śirīṣasya phalaṃ patraṃ puṣpaṃ tvaṅmalameva ca || 21 || gomūtrapiṣṭo hyagadaḥ sarvakarmakaraḥ smṛtaḥ || etā vīramahauṣadhyaḥ śṛṇu cātaḥ paraṃ dvija || 22 || vandhyā karkoṭakī rāma viṣṇukrāntā tathotkaṭā || śatamūlā śatānandā balāsphoṭā paṭolikā || 23 || somā piṇḍā niśā caiva tathā dagdharuhā jayā || sthale kamalinī yā ca piṃgalī śṛṅgamūlikā || 24 || caṇḍālī hasticaṇḍālī gocaṇḍālī kavandhikā || raktā caiva mahāraktā tathā barhiśikhā ca yā || 25 || kośātakī nakramālaṃ piyālaṃ ca svalakṣaṇā || cāraṇā ca sugandhā ca tathā vai gandhanākulī || 26 || īśvarī ca saliṅgī ca somalī vaṃśanālikā || jatukārī tathā śvetā śvetā ca madhuyaṣṭikā || 27 || vajjaṭaḥ pāribhadraśca tathā vai sindhuvārikā || jīvānandī vasumatī na taṃ nāgakaṭaṃ kaṭam || 28 || tālanā jālapātālaṃ tathā ca vaṭapatrikā ||| karakṣīrā mahānīlī kahlāraṃ haṃsapādikā || 29|| maṇḍūkaparṇī vārāhī dve tathā taṇḍulīyake || sarpākṣī lavaṇā brāhmī viśvarūpā sukhaṃkarī || 30 || rujāpahā śuddhikarī tathā śalyāpahā ca yā || patrikā rohiṇī caiva raktalā ca mahauṣadhī || 31 || tathāmalakavandāru yāvacitrā paṭolikā || kākolī kṣīrakākolī pīluparṇī manovatī || 32 || keśanī vṛścikā kālī mahānāgā śatāvarī || tathā garuḍavegā ca sthalekumudinī ca yā || 33 || sthale cotpalinī yā ca mahābhūmilatā ca yā || unmādinī somarājī sarvaratnāni bhārgava || 34 || viśoṣāmarakataṃ tatra kīṭapakṣaṃ viśeṣataḥ || jīvajātāśca maṇayassarve dhāryā viśeṣataḥ || 35 || rakṣoghnāśca yaśasyāśca kṛtyā vetālanāśinaḥ || viśeṣāntaranāgāśca gokharoṣṭrasamudbhavāḥ || 36 || sarpatittiragomāyubabhrumaṇḍūkajāśca ye || siṃhavyāghrarkṣamārjāradvīpavānarasambhavāḥ || 37 || kapiñjalājagodhāvimahiṣaiṇabhavāśca ye || 38 || ityevametaissakalairupetaṃ dravyaiḥ puraṃ rakṣitasañcayaṃ ca || rājā vasettatra gṛhaṃ ca śubhraṃ guṇānvitaṃ lakṣaṇasaṃprayuktam || 39 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare mā0saṃ0 dvitīyakhaṇḍe agadaṅkarādhyāyo nāma saptaviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 27 || <2.28> || rāma uvāca || rājarakṣārahasyāni yāni durge nidhāpayet || kārayedvā mahībhartā kathayasvāśu tāni me || 1 || puṣkara uvāca || śirīṣodumbaraśamībījapūraṃ ghṛtaplutam || kṣudyogaḥ kathito rāma māsārdhasya purātanaiḥ || 2 || kaṣerūtpalamūlāni ikṣumūlaṃ tathā vimam || dūrvākṣīraghṛtairmaṇḍaḥ siddho'yaṃ māsikaḥ param || 3 || śūlaprotaṃ naraṃ prāpya tasyāsthnāmaraṇī bhavet || kalmāṣavīṇunā tatra janayettu vibhāvasum || 4 || gṛhe trirapasavyaṃ tatkriyate yatra bhārgava || nānyognirjvalate tatra nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 5 || karpāsāsthi bhujaṅgasya tathā nirmocanaṃ param || sarpanirvāsane dhūpaḥ praśastaḥ satataṃ gṛhe || 6 || sāndrasattvā ca vayasā vidyuddagdhā ca mṛttikā || tayānuliptaṃ yadveśma nāgninā dahyate dvija || 7 || divā ca durge rakṣo'gnirvāti vāte viśeṣataḥ || viṣācca rakṣyo nṛpatistatra yuktiṃ nibodha me || 8 || krīḍānimittaṃ nṛpaterdhāryāḥ syurmṛgapakṣiṇaḥ || annaṃ ca prākprarīkṣeta vahnāvatha nareṣu ca || 9 || vastraṃ patramalaṅkāraṃ bhojanācchādane tathā || nāparīkṣitapūrvaṃ tu spṛśedapi mahīpatiḥ || 10 || śyāvāsyavaktraḥ santaptaḥ sodvegaṃ ca parīkṣate || viṣadena viṣaṃ dattaṃ yatra tatra nirīkṣate || 11 || srastottarīyo vimanāḥ stambhakuṇḍyādibhistathā || pracchādayati cātmānaṃ khidyate lajjate tathā || 12 || bhuvaṃ vilikhate grīvāṃ tathā cālayate dvija || kaṇḍūyati ca mūrdhānaṃ parileḍhyadharaṃ tathā || 13 || kriyāsu tvarate rāma viparītāsvapi dhruvam || evamādīni cihnāni viṣadasya parīkṣayet || 14 || tato vicāyedagnau tadannaṃ tvarayānvitaḥ || indrāyudhasavarṇastu vṛkṣasphoṭasamanvitaḥ || 15 || ekāvarto'tha durgandhī bhṛśaṃ caṭacaṭāyate || taddhūmasevanājjantoḥ śirorogaśca jāyate || 16 || saviṣe'nne nilīyante na ca bhārgava makṣikāḥ || nilīnāśca vipadyante dṛṣṭe ca saviṣe tathā || 17 || virajyati cakorasya dṛṣṭirbhārgavasattama || vikṛtiṃ ca svaro yāti kokilasya tathā dvija || 18 || gatiḥ skhalati haṃsasya bhṛṅgarājaśca kūjati || krauṃco madamathābhyeti kṛkavākurvirauti ca || 19 || vikrośati cakoraśca śārikā vāśate tathā || cāmīkaro'nyato yāti mṛtyuṃ kāraṇḍavastathā || 20 || mehate vānaro rāma glāyate jīvajīvakaḥ || hṛṣṭaromā bhavedbabhruḥ pṛṣataścaiva roditi || 21 || harṣamāyāti ca śikhī saviṣe darśane dvija || annaṃ ca saviṣaṃ rāma cireṇa ca vipacyate || 22 || tathā bhavatyatisrāvaṃ pakvaṃ paryuṣitopamam || vyāpannarasagandhaṃ ca candrikābhistathā yutam || 23 || vyañjanānāṃ ca śuṣkatvaṃ dravāṇāṃ budbudodbhavaḥ || sasaindhavānāṃ dravyāṇāṃ jāyate phenamālikā || 24 || rasasya rājī nīlā syāttāmrā ca payasastathā || kokilābhā ca sadhyasya toyasya ca bhṛgūttama || 25 || dhānyāmlasya tathā kṛṣṇā kapilā kodravasya ca || madhuśyāvā ca takrasya nīlā pītā tathaiva ca || 26 || ghṛtasyodakasaṃkāśā kapotābhā ca mastunaḥ || haritā sākṣikasyāpi tailasya ca tathāruṇā || 27 || phalānāmapyapakvānāṃ pākaḥ kṣipraṃ prajāyate || prakopaścaiva pakvānāṃ mālyānāṃ mlānatā tathā ||28|| mṛdutā kaṭhinānāṃ syānmṛdūnāṃ ca viparyayaḥ || sūkṣmatantūpasadanaṃ tathā caivātiromatā ||29|| śyāmamaṇḍalatā caiva vastrāṇāmaviśeṣataḥ || lohānāṃ ca maṇīnāṃ ca malapaṅkopadigdhatā || 30 || anulepanagandhānāṃ snānānāṃ ca bhṛgūttama || vigandhatā ca vijñeyā parṇānāṃ mlānatā tathā || 31 || pītā nīlā sitā jñeyā tathā rāmāñjanasya ca || dantakāṣṭhatvacaḥ śāntāstantusattvaṃ tathaiva ca || 32 || evamādīni cihnāni vijñeyāni bhṛgūttama || tasmādrājā sadā tiṣṭhenmaṇimantrauṣadhīgaṇaiḥ || 33 || āptaiḥ saṃrakṣito rāma pramāda parivarjakaiḥ || 34 || prajātarormūlamihāvanīśastadrakṣaṇādvṛttimupaiti rāṣṭram || tasmātprayatnena nṛpasya rakṣā sarveṇa kāryā bhṛguvaṃśacandra || 35 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0 saṃ0 rājarakṣāvarṇanannāmāṣṭāviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 28 || <2.29> rāma uvāca || || vāstuvidyāṃ samācakṣva yādogaṇanṛpātmaja ||| hitāya mānavendrāṇāṃ tathānyeṣāṃ ca mānada || 1 || puṣkara uvāca || || bhūmimādau parīkṣeta śubhalakṣaṇalakṣitām || pūrvodakpravaṇāṃ dhanyāṃ tathā vai dakṣiṇonnatām ||2|| na tathā śikaṭacchinnāṃ nānyattoyapariplutām || valmīkamūṣikāvāsaśvabhrakaṇṭakitairdrumaiḥ|| 3|| vihīnāṃ mṛdusaṃsparśāṃ kaṭhināṃ cāpyanūṣarām || na tathā yavasaṃsthānāṃ nebhavajropamāṃ tathā ||4|| na śūrpakūrmasaṃsthānāṃ śaktihīnāṃ tathaiva ca|| sampūryamāṇāṃ kṛmibhistathādhikamṛdaṃ śubhām || 5 || garbhe ca kusumaṃ yasyāṃ na mlānimupagacchati || na nirvāṇamavāpnoti yasyāṃ dīpaśca bhārgava || 6 || udakaṃ ca tathā yasyāṃ śīghraṃ rāma na jīryate || sā praśastā kṣitistasyāṃ niveśaṃ kārayedbudhaḥ || 7 || śvetā raktā tathā pītā kṛṣṇā caiva yathākramam|| viprādīnāṃ praśastā syānmṛttikā ca tato dvija ||8|| ghṛtāsṛgannamadyānāṃ tulyagandhā tathaiva ca || madhurā ca kaṣāyā ca amloṣaṇarasā tathā ||9|| kuśaiḥ śaraistathā kāśairdūrvābhiryā ca sambhṛtā || parīkṣya yatnato bhūmiṃ tithinakṣatrasampadā ||10|| sampūjya brāhmaṇānpūrvaṃ niśśalyāṃ tāṃ tu kārayet|| khātapūrvāṃ tataḥ kṛtvā devabhāgāṃśca kalpayet || 11 || catuḥṣaṣṭipadaṃ kṛtvā vāstupūrvaṃ yathāvidhi || catuḥṣaṣṭivibhāgena kalpayitvā samantataḥ || || 12 || ekaikaṃ tu gṛhaṃ tatra tathaiva parikalpayet || yasmātpuravibhāgena dvāranyāsaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 13 || ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi devabhāgānyathāvidhi|| madhye catuṣpadaḥ svāmī brahmā śubhacaturmukhaḥ || 14.|| prāktathā nigrahaḥ svāmī kathitaśca tathāryamā || dakṣiṇena vivasvāṃśca mitraḥ paścimataḥ sthitaḥ || 15 || udakpṛthvīdharaścaiva vikoṇeṣvatha me śṛṇu || vikoṇe śivadaivatye kāmapakṣāvubhau surau || 16 || sāvitrīsavitārau tu tathāgneye prakīrtitau || tathā nairṛtakoṇe tu jayendrau rāma kīrtitau || 17 || bhadravyādhī tu vāyavye kathitau bhṛgunaṃdana || devatānāṃ tathaitāsāṃ bhūyo bāhye tu maṇḍale ||18|| pūrvādiṣu yathā dikṣu devatāstānnibodha me || mahendraśca ravissatyo bhṛśaḥ prāgrāma kīrtitāḥ || 19 || gṛhakṣito yamo bhṛṅgo gandharvaścaiva yāmyataḥ || bhallāṭaśca tathā soma aditirdhanadastathā || 20 || uttareṇa smṛtā devā vikoṇeṣvatha me śṛṇu || ditirīśau meghajayau śivakoṇe prakīrtitau || 21 || vyomāgnī pūṣavitathau śikhikoṇe ca bhārgava || mṛgapitrīśadauvārisugrīvāścaiva nairṛte || 22 || rogānāyuśca nāgaśca mukhyāśvāniladiksthitāḥ || tato'pi bāhyataścāṣṭau śṛṇuṣva gadato mama || 23 || aṣṭāvaṣṭau vinirdiṣṭā devā dikṣu vidikṣu ca || ādyantau tu tayordevau proktāvatha graheśvarau| parjanyaḥ prathamo devo dvitīyaśca karagrahaḥ || mahendraravisatyāśca bhṛśo'tha gamanastataḥ || 25 || pavanaśca mahābhāgāḥ pūrveṇaite prakīrtitāḥ || puṣyo'tha tritudaścaiva tathaiva ca graharkṣataḥ || 26 || yamo bhṛśaśca gandharvo mṛgo'tha pitarastathā || dakṣiṇena vinirdiṣṭā devā bhṛgukulodvaha || 27 || dauvārikaśca sugrīvaḥ puṣpadaṃtastathā suraḥ || varuṇastu tathā yakṣo rogaḥ śoṣastathaiva ca || 28 || paścimena vinirdiṣṭā devā dānavanāśanāḥ || nāgarājastathā mukhyo bhallāṭaśca tathā śaśī || 29 || aditiśca kuberaśca nāgaścātha hutāśanaḥ || ete devā vinirdiṣṭāstathā cottarato dvija || 30 || eteṣāmeva devānāṃ bhāge dvārāṇi kārayet || śubhāni teṣu vakṣyāmi śeṣāṇi parivarjayet || 31 || mahendrasomadaivatyau pūrvataḥ śubhadau smṛtau || gṛharkṣataśca puṣpaśca tathā dakṣiṇataḥ śubhau || 32 || sugrīvaḥ puṣpadantaśca śubhau paścimato dvija || bhallāṭaḥ somadevaśca dvāre śreṣṭhau tathā hyudak ||33|| dvātriṃśacca bahirdevāstathāntardvādaśa smṛtāḥ || madhye brahmā tathā prokta evaṃ te piṇḍadevatāḥ || 34 || catvāriṃśadvinirdiṣṭāstathā pañca ca bhārgava || vinyasyājiramevādau catuṣṣaṣṭipadaṃ dvija || 35 || tatra devavibhāgena gṛhakarma vidhīyate || candrasugrīvaparjanyasatyendrāryamavāruṇe || 36 || bhagavatsaṃgrahaṃ kuryādyathāsaṃsthānato dvija || sūryāntarikṣasatyāgnibhāgeṣu ca mahānasam || 37 || vāyvantarikṣasugrīvabhallāṭapitṛdaivate || gaṃdharvapuṣpadantākhye bhāge kūpaṃ tu kārayet || 38 || ekavṛkṣādhikaṃ tatra tathā kuryāddvijottama || athavā digvibhāgena gṛhakarma vidhīyate || 39 || aiśānyāṃ devatāveśma tathāgneyyāṃ mahānasam || agnyāgāraṃ ca tatraiva bhramaṃ nairṛtake tathā || 40 || koṣṭhāgārāyudhāgārau vāyavyāṃ ca tathā smṛtau || kūpādisthodakaṃ śastaṃ dikṣu caivottarāsu ca || 41 || anyāsu garhitaṃ rāma prayatnena vivarjayet || purāṇaṃ navamiśraṃ tu dāruveśmani varjayet || 42 || sakuḍyaṃ parakuḍyaṃ ca naiva kāryaṃ vijānatā || vinārkacandragrahaṇaṃ dvārasamparivartanam || 43 || vṛddhikṣayau na kartavyau bhūyaḥ karmaṇi veśmanaḥ || prāguttare'thavā kāryau brāhmaṇānumate tathā || brahmasthānaṃ śucirnityaṃ kāryaṃ bhavati bhārgava || 44 || na pīḍanīyaṃ ca tathā nāgadantādibhirbhavet || marmāṇi rāma jānīyāddevatāpadasandhiṣu || 45 || na pīḍayettathā tāni nāgadantādibhirdvija || ye drumā vaṭasaṃsiktāstathā ye ca sakoṭarāḥ ||46 || hastividyuddhatā ye ca devatāveśmajāśca ye || vahnispṛṣṭāḥ śmaśāne ca ye ca jātāścatuṣpathe||47|| rokavṛkṣāśca ye kecinna te śastāḥ kathañcana || vṛkṣasya mahatīṃ pūjāṃ kṛtvā tadvāsakasya ca || 48 || madhvājyadigdhena tathā chindyātparaśunā dvijaḥ || pūrvottareṇa patanaṃ praśastaṃ parikīrtitam ||49|| śeṣāsu patanaṃ dikṣu garhitaṃ dvijasattama || vaṭāśvatthau ca nirguṇḍī kovidāravibhītakau ||50 || puṣyakaṃ śālmaliścaiva palāśaṃ ca vivarjayeta || vistāraddviguṇocchrāyaṃ dvāraṃ kāryaṃ tathā gṛhe||51 || nidhiprathamako nāgahaṃsasārasacitritam || dvārako netramadvābhra catuṣpathasurālayaiḥ||52|| kūpaikavṛkṣarathyābhirviddhaṃ dvāraṃ vivarjayet|| dviguṇāttu gṛhocchāyādbhūmiṃ tyaktvā na doṣabhāk||53|| ādhmātaṃ sakaṭaṃ rāma tathāmbuplavi yadbhavet|| dvāraṃ na tatpraśaṃsanti tasmāttu parivarjayet||54|| puradvārādhikaṃ śrīdaṃ bhāgeṣu ca tathā bhramam|| dhanadasya tathā bhāgairdhanaveśma vidhīyate||55|| indrasatyendrasugrīvadvāramanyatra kārayet || stambhaṃ tu navadhā kṛtvā pīṭhe bhāgaṃ tu kārayet || 56 || bhāge kumbhastathā kāryo bhāge padmaṃ niveśayet || stambhaṃ bhāgatraye kāryamaṣṭāsramatha vartulam || 57 || tasyopari tathā bhāge bhavatyāmalasārakam || bhāgadoṣe tulā kāryā bhāge kāryā tathā tulā || 58 || ekaśālacatuśśālau kartavyau svecchayā sadā || pūrvottarābhiḥ śālābhirhīnaṃ kāryaṃ dviśālakam || 55 || anyathā garhitaṃ rāma sutārthakṣayadaṃ matam || aṣṭahastocchrayādūrdhvaṃ bhūmikāṃ tu na kārayet || 60 || vāstūcchrāyaṃ na kartavyaṃ tathā hastaśatādhikam || ārambhaṃ saśilānyāsaṃ dvārastambhocchrayāvubhau || 61 || tathārohaṇaniṣpattī tathā vāstupraveśanam || sarvāṇyetāni kāryāṇi divase rāma pūjite ||62|| śeṣeṣveteṣu kartavyaṃ devabrāhmaṇapūjanam || kālajñapūjanaṃ caiva sthapatīnāṃ ca bhārgava || 63 || prāvṛṭkāle na kartavyaṃ vāstukarma vijānatā|| kṛṣṇapakṣatribhāgānte śuklādye ca bhṛgūttama || 64 || tithiṃ caturthī navamīṃ varjayecca caturdaśīm || aṅgārakadinaṃ rāma karaṇaṃ viṣṭisaṃjñitam || 65 || divyāntarikṣakṣitijairutpātairbhaṃ ca pīḍitam || grahopaspṛṣṭaṃ ca tathā vyatīpātahataṃ ca yat || 66 || candratārānukūle bhe vāstukāryaṃ vijānatā || dhruvāṇi tāni śastāni śākraṃ vai nairṛtaṃ tathā ||67|| saumyaṃ ca vaiṣṇavaṃ puṣyaṃ pauṣṇaṃ sāvitrameva ca || sthiralagne sthirāṃśe ca kartuścopacayātmake ||68 || yasya saumyagrahāḥ kendre trikoṇe cāpi bhārgava || pāpāścopacayasthāne tasminkāryaṃ praveśanam || 69 || kendrasthaṃ varjayetpāpaṃ sarvayatnena karmasu || kendraṃ saumyayutaṃ devaṃ na tu śūnyaṃ kadācana || 70 || ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi śilānyāsavidhiṃ tava || catuḥṣaṣṭipadaṃ kṛtvā same sthāne tu maṇḍalam ||71|| kṛtvā tu devatānyāsaṃ tatra maṇḍalake dvija || śriyaḥ sampūjanaṃ kṛtvā vāsudevasya cāpyatha || 72 || pūjanaṃ maṇḍale kāryaṃ vāstudevagaṇasya ca || gandhārdhapuṣpa naivedyadhūpadīpairbhṛgūttama || 73 || teṣāṃ sampūjanaṃ kṛtvā samādāya hutāśanam || oṃkārapūrvamājyaṃ tu juhuyācchrīdharasya tu || 74 || śriyaḥ kṛtvā tato homaṃ brahmaṇaḥ kārayettataḥ || brahmāṇaṃ tu puraskṛtya vāstudevagaṇasya ca || 75 || hotavyamājyaṃ dharmajña yasya devasya hūyate || tatkālamāśu bhajate lakṣaṇegnau dvijottama || 76 || tasya devasya yatsthānaṃ tatra śalyaṃ vinirdiśet || śalyasyoddharaṇaṃ kāryaṃ rāma yatnena jānatā || 77 || madhye śailamayaṃ kumbhaṃ śaṃkuṃ ca sthāpayedbudhaḥ || aiśāne ca tataḥ koṇe śilāṃ pūrvaṃ pratiṣṭhayet || 78 || pradakṣiṇaṃ tato rāma śilānyāsaṃ vidhīyate || kumbhasya ca śilānāṃ ca tataḥ snānaṃ vidhīyate ||79|| vaṭāśvatthakaṣāyeṇa sarvauṣadhijalaistataḥ || tato'nulepanaṃ kāryaṃ candanena sugandhinā ||80|| ācchādanaṃ tataḥ kāryaṃ vāsobhiḥ kusumaiḥ śubhaiḥ || dhūpaṃ pradīpaṃ naivedyaṃ teṣāṃ rāma nivedayet || 81 || dakṣiṇābhirdvijendrāṇāṃ tataḥ pūjā vidhīyate || kālavitsthapatī pūjyau tato rāma vijānatā || 82 || tato mantraṃ japetkartā kālajñaḥ sthapatiḥ svayam || gṛhaṃ puṣṭikaraṃ rāma munivaktrādvinissṛtam || 83 || nande nandaya vāsiṣṭhe vasubhiḥ prajayā saha || jaye jayāvahe devi prajānāṃ jayamāvaha || 84 || pūrṇe'ṅgirasadāyāde pūrṇakāmaṃ kuruṣva māma || bhadre kaśyapadāyāde kuru bhadrāṃ matiṃ mama || 85 || sarvabījasamāyukte sarvaratnauṣadhairvṛte || rucire nandane nande vāsiṣṭhe ramyatāmiha || 86 || prajāpatisute devi caturagre mahīmaye || subhage suvrate bhadre gṛhe kāśyapi ramyatām || 87 || pūjite paramācāyairgandhamālyairalaṃkṛte || bhavabhūtikarī devi gṛhaṃ bhārgavi ramyatām || 88 || avyaṅge cākṛte pūrṇe sunetryaṅgirasaḥ sute || iṣṭake tvaṃ prayaccheṣṭaṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ kāmayāmyaham || 89|| deśasvāmipurasvāmigṛhasvāmigṛhe vasa || manuṣyadhanahastyaśvapaśuvṛddhikarī bhava || 90 || gṛhapraveśe'pi tathā śilānyāsasamo vidhiḥ || kartavyaḥ sakalo rāma śilānyāsavivarjitaḥ || 91 || pūjitāparalakṣmīkaṃ hutvāgniṃ cāpyalaṃkṛtam || pañcaraṅgena sūtreṇa baddhapratisaraṃ tathā || 92 || saphaleṣu ca bāṇeṣu diśāsu vidiśāsu ca || gavākṣakeṣu kartavyāścakrā rakṣohaṇāstathā || 93 || sarvasyāsya tathā nyāsaṃ mantrai rakṣohaṇairbhavet || gopṛṣṭhavinyastakaraḥ praviśecca gṛhī gṛham || 94 || sva'nuliptassukhī sragvī sapatnīkastathaiva ca || dvijapuṇyāhaghoṣeṇa vīṇāveṇuraveṇa ca || bandināṃ ca ninādena paṭahānāṃ svanena ca || 95 || kāle śubhe kālavidā pradiṣṭe satoraṇaṃ pūrṇaghaṭābhirāmam || praviśya kālajñasamarcitānāṃ kṛtvārcanaṃ tatra surottamānām || 96 || sampūjya vahniṃ dvijapuṅgavāṃśca māṅgalyamālabhya ca bhojayitvā || viprānmadhukṣīraghṛtotkaṭānnaiḥ sadakṣiṇāṃstāṃśca tathā visarjya || 97 || saptāhamagniṃ paricarya tatra sampūjya viprānvidhivacca rāma || gṛhe vasetpūjitadevavipre śucau sadā sarvaguṇopapanne || 98 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde rāmaṃ prati puṣkarakathāsu vāstuvidyāvarṇanannāmaikonatriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 29 || <2.30> || puṣkara uvāca || || uttareṇa śubhaḥ plakṣo vaṭaḥ prāgbhārgavottama || udumbaraśca yāmyena saumyenāśvattha eva ca || 1 || ete krameṇa neṣyanti dakṣiṇādisamudbhavāḥ || samīpajātāśca tathā varjyāḥ kaṇṭakino drumāḥ || 2 || vāmabhāge tathodyānaṃ kuryādvāsagṛhācchubham || vāpayetprāktilāṃstatra mṛndīyāttāṃśca puṣpitān || 3 || tatastu ropayedvṛkṣānprayataḥ susamāhitaḥ || snāto drumamathābhyarcya brāhmaṇāṃśca śivaṃ tathā || 4 || dhruvāṇi pañca vāyavyaṃ hastaḥ puṣyaḥ savaiṣṇavaḥ || nakṣatrāṇi tathā mūlaṃ śasyate drumaropaṇe 55|| udyānaṃ sajalaṃ rāma nābhirāmaṃ yadā tadā || praveśayenna vipaṭa kuruhān puṣkariṇyaśca kārayet || 6 || saṃskāryamudbhidaṃ toyaṃ kūpāḥ kāryāḥ prayatnataḥ || hastaṃ maghā tathā maitraṃ saumyaṃ puṣyaṃ ca vāsavam || 7 || uttarātritayaṃ rāma tathā pūrvā ca phalgunī || jalāśayasamāraṃbhe praśaste vāruṇaṃ tathā || 8 || sampūjya varuṇaṃ devaṃ viṣṇuṃ parjanyameva ca || tarpayitvā dvijānkāmaistadāraṃbhakaro bhavet || 9 || athodyāne pravakṣyāmi praśastānpādapāndvija || ariṣṭāśokapunnāgaśirīṣāmrapriyaṅgavaḥ || 10 || panasāśokadacalījambūlakucadāḍimāḥ || māṅgalyāḥ pūrvamārāme ropaṇīyā gṛheṣu vā || 11 || kṛtvā bahutvameteṣāṃ ropyāssarve hyanantaram || śālmaliṃ kovidāraṃ ca varjayitvā vibhītakam || 12 || asanaṃ devadāruṃ ca palāśaṃ puṣkaraṃ tathā || na vivarjyastathā kaściddevodyāneṣu jānatā || 13 || tatrāpi bahutā kāryā māṅgalyānāṃ dvijottama || sāyaṃ prātastu gharmānte śītakāle dināntare || 14 || varṣākāle bhuvaḥ śoṣe sektavyā ropitā drumāḥ || uttamaṃ viṃśatirhastaṃ madhyamaṃ ṣoḍaśāṃtaram || 15 || sthānātsthānāntaraṃ kāryaṃ vṛkṣāṇāṃ dvādaśāvaram || abhyāśajātāstaravaḥ saṃspṛśantaḥ parasparam || 16 || avyaktamiśramūlatvādbhavanti viphalā dvija || teṣāṃ vyādhisamutpattau śṛṇu rāma cikitsitam || 17 || ādau saṃśodhanaṃ teṣāṃ kiñcicchastreṇa kārayet || viḍaṅgaghṛtapaṅkāktānsecayecchītavāriṇā || 16 || phalanāśe kulutthaiśca māṣairmudgaistilairyaveḥ || śritaśītapayassekaḥ phalapuṣpāya sarvadā || || 19 || āvikājaśakṛccūrṇaṃ yavacūrṇaṃ tilāni ca || gomāṃsamudakaṃ ceti saptarātraṃ nidhāpayet || 20 || utsekaṃ sarvavṛkṣāṇāṃ phalapuṣpādivṛddhidam || raṃgatoyoṣitaṃ bījaṃ raṃgatoyābhiṣecitam || 21 || udagrapuṣpaṃ bhavati yauvane nātra saṃśayaḥ || matsyāmbhasā tu siktena vṛddhirbhavati śākhinām || 22 || tataḥ pradhānato vakṣye drumāṇāṃ dohadānyaham || matsyodakena śītena cāmrāṇāṃ seka iṣyate || 23 || mṛdvīkānāṃ tathā kāryastenaivaṃ ripusūdana || pakvāsṛgrudhiraṃ caiva dāḍimānāṃ praśasyate || 24 || tuṣaṃ deyaṃ ca bhavyānāṃ madyaṃ ca bakuladrume || viśeṣātkāminīvaktrasaṃsargāttu guṇaṃ ca yat || 25 || praśastaṃ cāpyaśokānāṃ kāminīpādatāḍanam || sṛgālamāṃsatoyaṃ ca nāraṅgākṣoṭayorhitam || 26 || madhuyaṣṭyudakaṃ caiva badarāṇāṃ praśasyate || gandhodakaṃ ca gomāṃsaṃ katakānāṃ praśasyate|| 27 || kṣīrasekena bhavati saptaparṇo manoharaḥ || māṃsapūto vasāmajjāsekaḥ kurabake hitaḥ || 28 || pūtimatsyaghṛtaṃ pūtikarpāsāphalameva ca || arimedasya seko'yaṃ pāṭaleṣu ca śasyate || 29 || kapitthabilvayoḥ sekaṃ guḍatoyena kārayet || jātīnāṃ mallikāyāśca gandhatoyaṃ paraṃ hitam || 30 || tathā kubjakajātīnāṃ kūrmamāṃsaṃ praśasyate || kharjūranārikerāṇāṃ vaṃśasya kadalasya ca || 31 || lavaṇena satoyena seko vṛddhikaraḥ smṛtaḥ || viḍaṅgaḥ taṇḍulopetaṃ matsyamāṃsaṃ bhṛgūttama || sarveṣāmaviśeṣeṇa dohadaṃ parikalpayeta || 32 || evaṅkṛte cārupalāśapuṣpāḥ sugandhino vyādhivivarjitāśca || bhavanti nityaṃ taravaḥ sarasyāścirāyuṣaḥ sādhuphalānvitāśca || 33 || || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde vṛkṣāyurvedavarṇanaṃ nāma triṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 30 || <2.31> || puṣkara uvāca || durge sarvaguṇopete vāstulakṣaṇasaṃyute || vasanvivardhayetkośaṃ dharmeṇa pṛthivīpatiḥ || 1 || prajānāṃ pālanaṃ kāryaṃ tatra sthāne mahīkṣitā || svadeśe devatāyāśca kṛtā rājñaḥ purātanaiḥ || 2 || dāyaṃ vittaṃ janaṃ tāsāṃ prayatnena ca pālayet || devadravyāpahāreṇa rājā narakamṛcchati || 3 || asminnapi tathā loke prāpnoti ca parābhavam || pālayanti mahīṃ devāḥ pūjitāḥ pṛthivīkṣitā || 4 || daivāyattamidaṃ sarvaṃ bhūtalaṃ dvijapuṅgava || dhūpadīpanamaskārapuṣpamālyānulepanaiḥ || 5 || ratnānusampradānaiśca pūjanīyāḥ surottamāḥ || pūjitāḥ pūjayantyete cāyuṣā yaśasā śriyā || 6 || prāpyate devatābhaktyā cānuṣṭhāne mahatpadam || pūjitāḥ saṃprayacchanti kāmānnṛṇāmabhīpsitān || 7 || ekamapyāśrito devaṃ rājā bhārgavanandana || sarvāsāṃ pūjanaṃ kuryāddevatānāmasaṃśayam ||8 || devatānāṃ na cocchindyātpūrvadāyaṃ kathañcana || prāksthitaṃ tanna cocchiṃdyānna ca cchiṃdyāttathā navam || 9 || tacchettā narakaṃ yāti saha pūrvaiḥ pitāmahaiḥ || api svalpaṃ na hartavyaṃ devadravyaṃ vijānatā || 10 || svalpasyāpi phalaṃ ghoraṃ yasmājjanmāntare bhavet || ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi ṣaṣṭivarṣaśatāni ca || 11 || devadravyāpaharaṇānnarakaṃ pratipadyate || santīha devatāḥ saumyāḥ santyugrāścāpi bhārgava || 12 || darśayanti ruṣaṃ saumya rājyabhraṃśādibhirnṛṇām || asmim̐lloke ruṣaṃ krūrāṃ naiva kurvanti devatāḥ || 13 || tāsāṃ vittāpaharaṇādrājā narakamṛcchati || pūrvaiḥ pitāmahaissārdhaṃ prāguktaṃ phalameva tu || 14 || devadravyāpaharaṇaṃ naiva jātu bhavedvṛthā || sarvasvarahitānkṛtvā devadravyāpahāriṇaḥ || 15 || aṅkayitvā dvijaśreṣṭha svarāṣṭrādvipravāsayet || traividyā vaṇijo vaiśyā liṅgino devapālakāḥ || 16 || tathā tatpratibaddhāśca na kuryuḥ kalahaṃ mithaḥ || teṣāṃ sahāyakaḥ svāmī nigrahānugrahī bhavet || 17 || rāgadveṣaviyuktastu vivāsyaścānyathā bhavet || daṇḍaṃ ca devatāgāmi devadravyasya sūcakam || 18 || sarvānvivāsayedrājā dhārmiko dharmakāraṇāt || rājñā sarvaprayatnena pālanīyāḥ surālayāḥ || 19 || kartavyāśca mahābhāga suralokamabhīpsatā || devatāstu pratiṣṭhāpya tallokaṃ dhruvamāpnuyāta || 20 || kṛtvā devagṛhaṃ śubhraṃ svargamāpnotyanuttamam || tadā bhogapramāṇena lakṣmīstatrāpi bhārgava || 21 || mṛtprāsādāddaśaguṇaṃ sthūladārukṛte bhavet || phalaṃ daśaguṇaṃ tasmāttathā pakveṣṭakākṛte || 22 || tasmāddaśaguṇaṃ śaile nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || yāvatsaṃkhyaṃ naraḥ kuryāddevaveśma sudhāsitam || 23 || tāvajjanmāntarāṇīha yaśasā sa virājate || kṛtvā ca citravinyāsaṃ gandharvaiḥ saha modate || 24 || kṛtvā saṃśodhanaṃ tatra virogaḥ samapadyate || prokṣayitvā manastāpānmānavaḥ pratimucyate || 25 || kṛtvopalepanaṃ rāma nākamāpnotyanuttamam || gāndharvalokamāpnoti kṛtvā varṇakarañjitam || 26 || gandhaiḥ samukṣitaṃ kṛtvā gandharvaissaha modate || upakārapradānena śriyamāpnotyanuttamām || 27 || gītavādyapradānena sukhamāpnotyanuttamam || prekṣaṇīyapradānena rūpavānabhijāyate || 28 || tathā aujjvalyamāpnoti yatrayatrābhijāyate || snāpayitvā ghṛtenārcāṃ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 29 || snāpayitvā ca tailena virogaḥ samapadyata || ambunā snāpayitvā tu saubhāgyamadhigacchati || 30 || virūkṣayitvā tāṃ rāma pāpaṃ jahati mānavāḥ || anulepanadānena rūpamāpnotyanuttamam || 31 || tathā puṣpapradānena śriyamāpnotyanuttamām || dhūpadānena dharmajña ratimāpnoti śobhanām || 32 || tathā dīpapradānena cakṣuṣmānabhijāyate || annadaḥ sarvamāpnoti yatkiṃcinmanasecchati ||33 || pānakānāṃ pradānena tṛptimāpnotyanuttamāma || vasudo rūpamāpnoti rūpamāpnoti rūpyadaḥ || 34 || rukmadassarvamāpnoti śriyamāpnoti sarvadaḥ || chatradaḥ svargamāpnoti tālavṛntaprado divam || 35 || cāmarāṇāṃ pradānena rājā bhavati dhārmikaḥ || patākāyāḥ pradānena sarvapāpānvyapohati || 36 || dhvajadānena loke'smindhvajabhūto bhavennaraḥ || nānāvidhānāṃ bhogānāṃ tathā rāma pradāyakaḥ || 37 || tāneva bhogānāpnoti sarvamāpnoti bhūmidaḥ || devamālyāpanayanādgodānaphalamāpnuyāt || 38 || tadāhutipradānena tallokamabhipadyate || namaskārapraṇāmābhyāmenobhiḥ pratimucyate || 39 || pradakṣiṇaṃ tathā kṛtvā bhavatyācāravārannaraḥ || stutvā ca devatāṃ rāma manoduḥkhātpramucyate ||40|| santarpayitvā toyena tṛptiṃ samadhigacchati || tasmātsarvaprayatnena viśuddhenāntarāpmanā || 41 || arcāsthāḥ pūjayetsarvā devatā bhūridarśana || tadāśritāṃśca yuñjīta tadā tadvidhipāragān || 42 || tatpūjane tathā rāma tāṃśca sampūjayetsadā || brāhmaṇāśca niyoktavyā vedoktasurapūjane ||43 || yasya rājñastu viṣaye devaveśma viśīryate || tasya sīdati tadrāṣṭraṃ devaveśma yathā tathā || 44 || saṃskāraṃ lambhayedyastu devaveśma purātanam || sa ca saukhyamavāpnoti yatrayatrābhijāyate || 45 || vāpīkūpataḍāgānāṃ sadā tridaśaveśmanām || bhūyaḥ saṃskārakartā ca labhate muktijaṃ phalam || 46 || devasampūjanādrāma vṛddhiṃ samupagacchati || rājñastu viṣaye yasya pūjyante satataṃ surāḥ ||47 || ativṛṣṭiranāvṛṣṭirmūṣakāḥ śalabhāḥ śukāḥ || rākṣasāśca piśācāśca ripavaśca sudāruṇāḥ ||48|| ītayaśca tathaivānyā na bhavanti dvijottama||49|| tasmātprayatnena sadā narendraiḥ pūjā vidheyā viṣaye surāṇām|| surārcanātpūtasamastapāpāssvargaṃ kṣitīśāściramāpnuvanti ||50|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0saṃ0surapūjāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ||31|| <2.32> puṣkara uvāca || brāhmaṇānpūjayedrājā brāhmaṇānpālayetsadā || brāhmaṇā hi mahābhāga devānāmapi daivatam ||1|| brāhmaṇānāṃ kṣitiṃ dadyādbhogānanyāṃśca pārthivaḥ || brāhmaṇeṣu tu yaddattaṃ nidhistatpāralaukikam || 2 || vedalāṅgalakṛṣṭeṣu dvijakṣetreṣu bhārata || uptasya dānabījasya phalasyānto na vidyate ||3|| brahmasvaṃ caiva nādadyādbrahmasvaṃ pālayettathā || brahmasvaharaṇādrāma narakaṃ paśyate naraḥ || 4 || na viṣaṃ viṣamityāhurbrahmasvaṃ viṣamucyatai || viṣamekākinaṃ hanti brahmasvaṃ saptapūruṣam || 5 || brahmasvaṃ praṇayādbhuktaṃ hinastyāsaptamaṃ kulam || drohādbhuktaṃ tadeveha kulānāṃ pātayecchatam || 6 || suvarṇamekaṃ gāmekāṃ bhūmerapyekamaṅgulam| || harannarakamāpnoti yāvadābhūtasamplavam || 7 || dṛṣṭvā viṭaṃ durācāraṃ brāhmaṇaṃ na dviṣetkvacit || brāhmaṇānāṃ parīvādānnāśamāpnoti mānavaḥ || 8 || na jātu brāhmaṇaṃ hanyātsarvapāpeṣvavasthitam || naivāsti brāhmaṇavadhātpāpaṃ gurutaraṃ kvacit || 9 || brahmahā narakaṃ yāti yāvadābhūtasamplavam || varṣāṇāmayutaṃ rāma pacyate snāyupūrite || 10 || śoṇitaṃ yāvataḥ pāṃśūngṛhṇātīha dvijanmanām || kartā tāvanti varṣāṇi kṛtakṛnnarake vaset || 11 || upadruto dvijo yena tyajejjīvitamātmanaḥ || brahmahatyā bhavettasya nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 12 || dehatyāgācca narakaṃ brāhmaṇo'pi prapadyate || tena cādhikamāpnoti rāma pāpaṃ narādhamaḥ ||13|| adaivaṃ daivataṃ kuryuḥ kuryurdaivamadaivatam || brāhmaṇāśca mahābhāgā namasyāste sadaiva hi || 14 || brāhmaṇānāṃ tathā kāryaṃ yatnātkurvīta pārthivaḥ || kālātipātaṃ ca tathā viprakārye na kārayet || 15 || niṣpīḍitastūpavasedyena vidvānniśāṃ janaḥ || sa rāma narakaṃ yāti varṣāṇāṃ tu daśāyutam || 16 || brāhmaṇī rudatī hanti kulaṃ rodāyate dhruvam || tadaśruvahnirdahati kulaṃ tripuruṣaṃ dhruvam || 17 || vidvānapyathavāvidvānbrāhmaṇo mānamarhati || praṇītaścāpraṇītaśca yathāgnirdvijapuṅgava || 18 || pratiṣṭhāṃ prāpnuvantīha surā viprapratiṣṭhitāḥ || 19 || tanmukhe tu tathāśnanti devāśca pitṛbhiḥ saha || vahnau hutācchreṣṭhatamaṃ hutaṃ vipramukhāgniṣu || 20 || askandamaviruddhaṃ ca prāyaścittairvivarjitam || yāvato grasate grāsānvidvānvipraḥ susaṃskṛtaḥ || 21 || annapradasya tāvantaḥ kratavaḥ parikīrtitāḥ || brāhmaṇānāṃ karānmuktaṃ toyaṃ śirasi dhārayet || 22 || brāhmaṇasya kare yasmātsarvatīrthasamāgamaḥ || brāhmaṇebhyaḥ samutpannaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram || 23 || amoghaśāpā dharmajña kathitāste jagattraye || āśīrvādamamoghaṃ ca brāhmaṇānāṃ prakīrtitam || 24 || āśīrvādaparāḥ kāryāstasmādrājñā dvijottamāḥ || yaiḥ kṛtaḥ sarvabhakṣyognirapeyaśca mahodadhiḥ || 25 || kṣayī somo'javṛṣaṇastathaiva ca śatakratuḥ || yeṣāṃ kopāgniradyāpi daṇḍake nopaśāmyati || 26 || vipulaśca tathā yeṣāṃ prasādo bhṛgunandana || yeṣāṃ prasādātkṣīṇo'pi vṛddhimicchati candramāḥ || 27 || yeṣāṃ prasādādrakṣobhirnābhibhūyeta bhāskaraḥ || yeṣāṃ prasādādvipulāṃ kārtavīryaḥ śriyaṃ gataḥ || 28 || yeṣāṃ prasādāddhanado dhanādhyakṣatvamāgataḥ || asnātaḥ snānamāpnoti vratamāpnotyathāvratī || 29|| yeṣāṃ vacanamātreṇa kimbhūtamadhikaṃ tataḥ || bhogaṃ rājyaṃ tathā svargaṃ yeṣāṃ vākyena labhyate || 30 || apāvanakaraḥ krodho yeṣāṃ rāma sadā sthitaḥ || te pūjyāste ca satkāryāsteṣāṃ dārāṇi dāpayet || 31 || dhārayanti jagatsarvaṃ brāhmaṇā vedapāragāḥ|| devānāpyāyayantīha brāhmaṇā bhṛgunandana ||32|| te tṛptāstarpayantīha bhuvanaṃ sakalaṃ surāḥ || brāhmaṇenāhutirdattā vahnau bhṛgukulodvaha || 33 || ādityamāpnotyādityādvṛṣṭirbhavati bhūtale || annasya ca tathotpattirannādbhūtodbhavaḥ smṛtaḥ || 34 || tasmāttribhuvanaṃ sarvaṃ brāhmaṇaireva dhāryate || brāhmaṇaprabhavā bhūmirbrāhmaṇaprabhavo divaḥ || 35 || brāhmaṇānāmime lokāḥ paralokāstathaiva ca || ijyāsvādhyāyatapasāmuparodhādyadā dvijāḥ || 36 || svāmyaṃ bhuvi na vindanti kṣattriyāstu tadā kṛtāḥ || brāhmaṇānāṃ vacaḥ kāryaṃ rājabhiḥ satatotthitaiḥ || 37 || dharmamarthaṃ ca kāmaṃ ca teṣāṃ vāci pratiṣṭhitam || brāhmaṇānāṃ tu vākyena nigrahānugrahāvubhau || || 38 || loke kāryau bhūmibhṛtā bhūtikāmena nityadā || rājā brāhmaṇavākyena yaḥ kuryācchāsanādikam || 39 || samyagvāpyathavāsamyaktena nāke mahīyate || ullaṃghya śāstraṃ nṛpatiryo yathāruci vartate || 40 || sa rāma narakaṃ yāti sukṛtenāpi karmaṇā || yatra brāhmaṇavākyāni na karotīha yo naraḥ||| 41 || na tatra doṣavānvipro rājā doṣeṇa lipyate || brāhmaṇaṃ daśavarṣaṃ ca śatavarṣaṃ ca bhūmipam || 42 || pitāputrau vijānīyādbrāhmaṇastu tayoḥ pitā || yasya rājñastu viṣaye brāhmaṇaḥ sīdati kṣudhā || tasya sīdati tadrāṣṭraṃ durbhikṣavyādhitaskaraiḥ || 43 || tasmātpūjyā namaskāryāssaṃ vibhājyāstathā dvijāḥ || rājñā sarvaprayatnena lokadvayamabhīpsatā || 44 || yadbrāhmaṇāstuṣṭatamā vadanti taddevatāḥ pratyabhinandayanti || tuṣṭeṣu tuṣṭāḥ satataṃ bhavanti pratyakṣadeveṣu parokṣadevāḥ || 45 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvi0khaṇḍe mā0 saṃ0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaravākye brāhmaṇapraśaṃsāvarṇanaṃnāma dvātriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 32 || <2.33> || puṣkara uvāca || sādhvīnāṃ pālanaṃ kuryātpūjanaṃ ca mahīpatiḥ || ekapatnyaḥ striyaḥ sarvā dhārayanti jagattrayam || 1 || bhartṛvratā bhartṛparā bhartṛpūjanatatparā || yā tu strī sā divaṃ yāti saha bhartrā dvijottama || 2 ||| ekapatnyastu yadduḥkhaṃ sahante dvija sānugāḥ || tena tāḥ svargamāsādya sukhamāyantyanekadhā || 3 || tāsāṃ prabhāvo hi mahāṃstejaścaivātiduḥsahama ||| na kopanīyā nopekṣyā naiva tāśca vimānayet || 4 || nāhūyedaparādheṣu daṇḍyastāsāṃ patirbhavet || putro vāpyathavā nītau naiva rājā prabhuḥ kvacita ||| || 5 || naiva sādhvī vinirdiṣṭā kevalopastharakṣaṇāt || vipriyaṃ nācaretkiñcitpatyuḥ sādhvīti sā smṛtā || 6 || karmaṇā manasā vācā bhartuḥ priyahitaiṣiṇī || yā nārī sā smṛtā sādhvī patipūjanatatparā || 7 || namaskāryāśca pūjyāśca vandanīyāśca bhārgava || rājñā sarvaprayatnena tathā lokaiśca sarvaśaḥ || 8 || anāthāṃ ca tathā sādhvīṃ bibhṛyātpārthivottamaḥ || tasyai yaddīyate dānaṃ tadanantaṃ prakīrtitam || 9 || sādhvīnāmapamānena kulaṃ dahati pūruṣaḥ || tāsāṃ sampūjanādrāma svakulaṃ connatiṃ nayet || 10 || na dhanena na dhānyena na śīlena na bandhubhiḥ || na yajñairdakṣiṇāvadbhirnādhītena tathaiva ca || 11 || akulāni kulānyāhuḥ kintu strīṇāṃ viceṣṭitaiḥ || yeṣu sādhvyaḥ striyo rāma kuleṣu kuladhūrvahāḥ || ||| 12 || mahākulāni tānīha kṛśānyapi dhanairyadi || putrāṇāmapi tatputraṃ sādhvī yasyāraṇirbhavet || 13 || havyeṣu sādhvītanayaṃ tathā kavyaṣu yojayet || tatrālpasyāpi dānasya mahatpuṇyaṃ prakīrtitam || 14 || gāyatrī tu yathā rāma yathā gaṅgā saridvarā || pāvanī kīrtanādeva tathā sādhvī varāṅganā || 15 || rāmāstu bhṛguśārdūla na praduṣyanti karhicit || māsimāsi rajastāsāṃ duṣkṛtānyapakarṣati || 16 || somastāsāṃ dadau śaucaṃ gandharvaḥ śikṣitāṃ giram || agniśca sarvamedhyatvaṃ tasmānniṣkalmaṣāḥ striyaḥ || 17 || brāhmaṇāḥ pādato medhyā gāvo medhyāstu pṛṣṭhataḥ || ajāśvau mukhato medhyau striyo medhyāstu sarvataḥ || 18 || yāmayo yāni gehāni śapantyapratipūjitāḥ || tāni kṛtyāha tānīva vinaśyanti samantataḥ || 19 || striyaḥ śriyaśca geheṣu na viśeṣo'sti kaścana || tasmātsarvaprayatnena pūjanīyāḥ sadā striyaḥ || 20 || mithyā na sādhvī bhavatīha loke bhavatyathāsminnapare ca rāma || sādhvyastathā pūjyatamā pradiṣṭā lokeṣu sarveṣu carācareṣu || 21 || || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde sādhvīmāhātmyaṃ nāma trayastriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || || 33 || <2.34> rāma uvāca || || sādhvīnāṃ śrotumicchāmi deva dharmānaśeṣataḥ || sādhvyo hi nāryo lokānāmādhāra iha kīrtitaḥ || 1 || || puṣkara uvāca || || etadeva paraṃ rāma rāmāṇāṃ dharmakāraṇam || yadāsāṃ sarvakāryeṣu nityaṃ hi paratantratā || 2 || bālye piturvaśe tiṣṭhetpāṇigrāhasya yauvane || putrāṇāṃ bhartari prete na strī svātantryamarhati || 3 || pitrā bhartrā suteneha necchedvirahamātmanaḥ || teṣāṃ ca viraheṇa strī garhye kuryādubhe kule || 4 || sadā prahṛṣṭayā bhāvyaṃ gṛhakārye ca dakṣayā || susaṃskṛtopaskarayā vyaye cāmuktahastayā || 5 || yaḥ pradadyātpitā tvenāṃ tadabhāvepi kārakaḥ || taṃ śuśrūṣeta jīvantaṃ saṃsthitaṃ na tu laṃghayet || 6 || maṅgalārthaṃ svastyayanaṃ yajñaścāsāṃ prajāyate || prayujyate vivāheṣu pradānaṃ svāmikāritam || 7 || anṛtāvṛtukālokte mantrasaṃskārakṛtpatiḥ || sukhaṃ nityaṃ dadātīha paraloke ca yoṣitaḥ || 8 || viśīlaḥ kāmavṛtto vā guṇairvā parivarjitaḥ || upacaryaḥ striyā sādhvyā satataṃ devavatpatiḥ || 9 || nāsti strīṇāṃ pṛthagyajño na vrataṃ nāpyupoṣitam || patiṃ śuśrūṣate yattu tena svarge mahīyate || 10 || pāṇigrāhasya sādhvī strī jīvato vā mṛtasya vā || patilokamabhīpsantī nācaretkiñcidapriyam ||11|| kāmaṃ tu kṣapayeddehaṃ puṣpamūlaphalaiḥ śubhaiḥ || na tu nāmāpi gṛhṇīyātpatyau prete parasya tu||12|| āsītāmaraṇātkṣāntā niyatā brahmacāriṇī || yo dharma ekapatnīnāṃ kāṅkṣantī tamanuttamam||13|| anekāni sahasrāṇi sumugdhabrahmacāriṇām || divaṅgatānāṃ viprāṇāmakṛtvā kulasantatim || 14 || mṛte bhartari sādhvī strī brahmacarye vyavasthitā|| svargaṃ gacchatyaputrāpi yathā te brahmacāriṇaḥ || 15|| apatyalobhādyā tu strī bhartāramativarttate || seha nindāmavāpnoti paralokācca hīyate || 16 || nānyotpannā prajāstīha na cāpyanyaparigrahā || na dvitīyaśca sādhvīnāṃ kaścidbhartopadiśyate||17|| patiṃ hitvā nikṛṣṭaṃ svaṃ cotkṛṣṭaṃ yā niṣevate|| nindyaiva loke bhavati parapūrveti cocyate || 18 || vyabhicārāttu bhartuḥ strī lokānprāpnoti ninditān || śṛgālayoniṃ cāpnoti pāparogaiśca pīḍyate || 19 || patiṃ yā nābhicarati manovāgdehasaṃyatā || ihāgryāṃ kīrttimāpnoti paraloke ca śasyate || 20 || patyurabhyadhikaṃ nārī nopavāsavrataṃ caret || anāyuṣyaṃ dvijaśreṣṭha patyustasyāstaducyate ||21|| devatārādhanaṃ kuryātkāmaṃ vā brāhmaṇottama || nārī pativratā rāma prāptānujñāṃ tu bharttṛtaḥ || 22 || nārī khalvananujñātā pitrā bhartrā sutena vā || viphalaṃ tadbhavettasyā yatkarotyaurdhvadaihikam ||23|| strīṇāṃ pūjyatamā loke devatāgṛhavāsinām || yā stāḥ sampūjanīyāḥ syustāsāmeva yathāvidhi || 24 || tāsāṃ ca pūjanaṃ kāryaṃ viditaṃ svāminastathā || anyathā cetpravartteta nirgrāhyā sā prakīrtitā || 25 || gatvānyapuruṣaṃ nārī narakaṃ pratipadyate || kūṭaśālmalimityuktaṃ yāvadābhūtasamplavam || 26 || garhitā ca tathā patyurnarakaṃ yāti bhārgava || daśavarṣasahasrāṇi tathaivāpriyavādinī || 27 || sarvāvasthāsvapi strīṣu na vadho vidyate dvija || pareṇa śaṅkitāmenāṃ saṃyatāṃ vāsayedgṛhe || 28 || hṛtādhikārāṃ malināṃ piṇḍamātropajīvinīm || paribhūtāmadhaḥśayyāṃ vāsayedvyabhicāriṇīm || 29 || mūlakarma na karttavyaṃ kathañcidapi yoṣitā || mūlakarmaratā nārī kalpaṃ narakamāvaseta || 30|| daurbhāgyaṃ mahadāpnoti tatra yatrābhijāyate || yā ca nārī sapatnīnāṃ kuryāddaurbhāgyakāraṇam || 31 || kuhakaiḥ paśyati sāpi kalpānāṃ narake dvija || puṃstvamūlaṃ tathā lakṣmoṃ patyurhiṃsati sā tathā ||32|| yakṣarakṣaḥpiśācānāṃ mūlakarmaratā sadā || vaśyo bhavati lokeṣu bhartā tasyāstathaiva ca || 33 || nārī kṛtvā patiṃ vaśyaṃ satataṃ mūlakarmaṇā || labhatente tu daurbhāgyaṃ bhūtairvā bhakṣyate dhruvam ||34|| tasmātsarvaprayatnena mūlakarma vivarjayet || ātmānamatha bhartāraṃ nāśayenmūlakarmaṇā || 35 || brāhmaṇī na pibenmadyaṃ na ca viṭkṣatriyastriyaḥ || surāṃ pibeyurdharmajña tatpānānnāśamāpnuyuḥ || 36 || tato bhavati dharmajña jalaukā raktapāyikā || kalpāvaśeṣaṃ sakalaṃ tena ghoreṇa karmaṇā || 37 || paraveśmarucirna syānna syātkalahaśālinī || na ca tiṣṭhettathā dvāri na ca rāma gavākṣake ||38|| maṇḍanaṃ varjayennārī tathā proṣita bhartṛkā || devatārādhanaparā bhavedbhartṛhite ratā || 39 || dhārayenmaṅgalārthāya kiñcidābharaṇaṃ tathā || na jātu vidhavā veṣaṃ kadācidapi kārayet ||40| pativratā tu yā nārī saha bhartrā divaṅgatā || kalpāvaśeṣaṃ muditā pūjyate tridaśālaye || 41 || pativratāṃ savarṇāṃ strīṃ dvijātiḥ pūrvamāriṇīma || dāhayedagnihotreṇa yajñapātraiśca dharmavit || 42 || bhāryāyai pūrvamāriṇyai dattvāgnīnantyakarmaṇi || punardārakriyāṃ kuryātpunarādhānameva ca || 43 || mṛte bhartari yā sādhvī putramāśritya bhārgava || tapasā śātayeddehaṃ tena svarge mahīyate || 44 || patipakṣe naraṃ kañcitputrābhāve samāśrayet || bibhṛyāddhi sa cāpyenāṃ bhojanācchādanaiḥ sadā || 45 || patipakṣe samucchinne pitṛpakṣaḥ prabhuḥ striyaḥ || viṣamasthāpi bhartavyā pitṛpakṣe svabandhubhiḥ || 46 || mṛtaṃ bhartāramādāya yadi vātha pativratā || praviśeddvijaśārdūla jvalitaṃ jātavedasam || 47 || tisraḥ koṭyorddhakoṭī ca yāni lomāni mānave || tāvantyeva śatābdāni svargaloke mahīyate || 48 || vyālagrāhī yathā sarpaṃ bilāduddharate balāt || evaṃ bharttāramādāya saha tenaiva gacchati || 49 | sadvṛttamadhyāpayituṃ gatānāṃ strīṇāṃ viyogakṣatakātarāṇām || tāsāṃ mṛte jīvitavallabhe hi nāgnipraveśādaparo hi dharma || 50 ||| iti viṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0 saṃ0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne strīdharmo nāma catustriṃśattamodhyāyaḥ || 34 || <2.35> rāma uvāca || || strīṇāṃ pūjyatamā loke devatāstvaṃ prakīrtaya || tāsāṃ kālaṃ vidhānaṃ ca phalaṃ pūjanatastathā || 1 || puṣkara uvāca || śriyaḥ sampūjanaṃ kāryaṃ strībhistu satataṃ gṛhe || puppārghamālyanaivedyadhūpadīpānulepanaiḥ || 2 || gṛhasammārjanaṃ rāma tathā tasyopalepanam || puṣpopahārakaraṇaṃ sudhāśuklatvameva ca || 3 || sarvametadvijānīyācchriyaḥ sampūjanaṃ dvija || snānānulepanaṃ yacca gandhavarṇāvadhāraṇam || 4 || suvarṇatā ca nārīṇāṃ śriyaḥ sampūjanādbhavet ||| aṣṭamīṣu ca sarvāsu pūjanīyāpyaśokikā || 5 || gandhamālyanamaskāradhūpadīpādibhistathā || tasminnahani yā bhuṅkte naktaṃ tailavivarjitam || 6 || bhavatyatha viśokā sā yatrayatrābhijāyate || aṣṭamīṣu ca sarvāsu na cecchaknoti bhārgava || 7 || proṣṭhapadyāṃ vyatītāyāṃ yā syātkṛṣṇāṣṭamī dvija || tasyāmavaśyaṃ karttavyā devyāḥ pūjā yathāvidhi || 8 || apāmiva trilokeṣu prakṛtiḥ strīṣu cocyate || yā prerayati karmāṇi lokeṣu dvijasattama || || 9 || tasyāṃ sampūjanaṃ kāryaṃ śuklāṃ pañcadaśīṃ tathā || mālyānulepanaiḥ śuklairdhūpena ca sugandhinā || 10 || raktavastrapradānena dīpadānena cāpyatha || vaidalaiśca tathā bhakṣyairbhojyaiścoṣyaistathaiva ca || 11 || pūjayitvā ca tāṃ devīṃ bhoktavyaṃ niśi bhārgava || yadi pañcadaśīṃ sarvāṃ na śaknoti kadācana ||| || 12 || devyāḥ sampūjanaṃ kāryamavaśyamapi kārtike || upārtiṃ pūjayedyā tu sā tu nārī pativratā || 13 || sadā dharmaratā sādhvī loke bhavati bhārgava || nāśubhe ca matistasyāḥ kadācidapi jāyate || 14 || ekādaśīṃ tathā kṛṣṇāṃ phālgune māsi bhārgava|| śuddhe devasya karttavyā pūjā dharmabhṛtāṃ vara || 15 || pūjanācchandodevasya tanayaṃ guṇavarjitam || na prāpnoti tathā'pnoti guṇavantamasaṃśayam || 16 || gandhamālyādibhirbhaktyā tathā vai vāstudevatām || ekādaśīṃ tathā prāpya caitraśuklasya pūjayet || 17 || saṃpūjya tāṃ mahābhāga gṛhabhaṅgo na jāyate || śuklāṣṭamīṃ tu samprāpya māsi bhādrapade tathā || 18 || dūrvāpratānaṃ luppettaduttarāśābhigāminam || pūjayedgṛhamānīya gandhamālyānulepanaiḥ || 19 || phalamūlaistathā rāma dhūpadīpau vivarjayet || agnipakvaṃ tathā sarvaṃ na nivedyaṃ kathañcana || 20 || bhoktavyaṃ ca tathā rāma vahnipākavivarjitam || dūrvāṃkurasthāṃ sampūjya vidhinā yauvanaśriyam || 21 || yauvanaṃ sthiramāpnoti yatrayatrābhijāyate || sopavāsā tu yā nārī kṛṣṇapakṣasya kārtike || 22 || dvādaśyāṃ pūjayedviṣṇuṃ gāṃ savatsāmanantaram || gandhamālyanamaskāradhūpadīpānnasampadā || 23 || naivedyaṃ gorasaṃ sarvaṃ varjanīyaṃ prayatnataḥ || bhoktavyaṃ ca na dharmajña dogdhavyā naiva cārjune ||24|| gāvaḥ prāpnoti kṛtvaivaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || dhenuṃ tāṃ yadi viprāya pradadāti yathāvidhi||25|| svargalokamathāsādya na tato vinivartate || kārtike ca tathā māsi kṛttikāyāṃ ca pūjanam || 26 || kartavyaṃ gandhakalaśairgandhamālyānulepanaiḥ || bhakṣyaiśca paramānnaiśca kulmāṣaiḥ parpaṭaistathā||27|| śaktyā vastraiśca dharmajña mahārañjanarañjanaiḥ || guḍena madhunā caiva sitayā lavaṇena ca||28|| ārdrakeṇekṣuṇā caiva tathā kālodbhavaiḥ phalaiḥ|| sarvaiśca vividhairannairgandhairnānāvidhaistathā||29|| pānakaiśca tathā hṛdyaiḥ pūjanīyāśca kṛttikāḥ || saha candramasā rāma tena saubhāgyamaśnute ||30 || nārī ca rūpalāvaṇye dharme cāgryāṃ tathā matim || avaidhavyaṃ ca dharmajña yatrayatrābhijāyate ||31|| lavaṇasya tulāṃ kṛtvā mahārañjanaraṃjite || ||| vastre vastreṇa tenātha sālaṅkārāṃ sitacchavim || 32 || kṛtvā piṇḍaṃ haridrāktaṃ kṛttikānāṃ nivedayet || grāhayedbrāhmaṇaṃ tāṃ ca prāpte candrodaye tathā || 33|| anena karmaṇā nārī saubhāgyaṃ mahadaśnute || puruṣo'pyatha vai śuddho saubhāgyaṃ mahadaśnute || kṛttikāpratipāde tu tāsāṃ kṛtvaiva pūjanam||34|| | yā bhuṅkte gorasaprāyaṃ kṛtvā brāhmaṇapūjanam || sapta janmāntarāṇyeva saubhāgyaṃ rūpameva ca ||35|| svarge tu bhogānāpnoti saha bhartrā tu sā śubhā || || 36 || prāpya pañcadaśīṃ rāma tathā śuklāṃ ca kārtikīm || kārtikaṃ kārtikīṃ rāma gṛhabhittau samālikhet || 37 || upadvāraṃ gṛhādbāhyaṃ nānāvarṇaistu varṇakaiḥ || gṛhopakaraṇaṃ śaktyā tayoścaivābhito likhet || 38 || pīṭhakhaḍgāsanādyatra śakaṭolūkhalādikam || tatastau pūjayennārī nānābhaktiparā śuciḥ || 39 || gandhamālyanamaskāradhūpadīpānnasampadā || ikṣuṇekṣuvikārairvā viśeṣeṇa ca pūjayet || 40 || tayostu pūjanaṃ kṛtvā matsyaṃ ca sikatāyutam || || śuktinetraṃ nyasetkṣīre tacca dadyāddvijātaye || 41 || tataśca naktaṃ bhuñjīta tilatailavivarjitam || anayoḥ pūjanādrāma gṛhabhaṅgaṃ na cāpnuyāt||42|| pativratā mahābhāga dīrghamāpnoti jīvitam || kārtike ca tathā māsi sārdhaṃ candramasā sadā ||43|| rohiṇyāṃ rohiṇīpūjā kartavyā vidhinā dvija || sarvairavidhavācihnairlavaṇena ca bhūriṇā || 44 || gandhamālyanamaskāradhūpadīpānnasampadā || tathā kuṃkumaraktena śaktyā bhārgava vāsasā || 45 || saubhāgyaṃ paramāpnoti kṛtvaitatparamāṅganā || śuklapakṣatrayodaśyāṃ yā ca nārī pativratā || 46 || pūjayetsopavāsā ca kāmadevamatandritā || paṭṭavarṇakavinyāsaṃ tasya bhāryā tathā patim || 47 || gandhamālyanamaskāradhūpadīpānnasampadā || guḍena madhunā caiva sitayā cārdrakeṇa ca ||48|| lavaṇena rasaiścānyairgandhaiḥ sasyaiḥ pṛthakpṛthak || bhakṣyairnāvidhaiścaiva kuṃkumārdreṇa vāsasā ||49|| gandhatoyāmbupūrṇena drumapallavaśālinā || pūrṇakumbhena bhavyena mālyakaṇṭhena bhārgava || 50 || kāmadevāya no dadyādyadamlaṃ kiñcideva tu || tataśca paścāddhoktavyaṃ sarvamamlavivarjitam || 51 || sarvānkāmānavāpnoti kāmapūjāvidhāyinī || atha cennaiva śaknoti sarvāṃ rāma trayodaśīm || 52 || caitraśuklena sarvāsāṃ phalamāpnotyasaṃśayam|| tasmātsarvaprayatnena caitraśuklatrayodaśīm || 53 || kāmasya pūjā kartavyā sarvakāmapradāyinī || kāmadevaṃ samabhyarcya kāryamātmābhipūjanam || 54 || kuṃkumāṅkaistathā vastrairgandhamālyavibhūṣaṇaiḥ || bhartāraṃ pūjayetpaścānnārī tu kṛtamaṇḍanā || 55 || kukumāṃkena vastreṇa gandhamālyairmanoharaiḥ || puruṣo'pi samabhyarcya kāmadevamasaṃśayam || 56 || sarvānkāmānavāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || tathā śuklacaturthīṣu gaurīpūjā sadā bhavet || 57 || snātābhiḥ sopavāsābhiḥ sūryasyodayanaṃ prati || gandhamālyanamaskāradhūpadīpānnasampadā || 58 || guḍena sitayā cāpi madhunā cārdrakeṇa ca || sarvaiścāvidhavācihnairlavaṇena ca bhūriṇā || 59 || caturthīdvitaye pūjyā sarvaśaktyā viśeṣataḥ || āṣāḍhe'pyathavā māsi māghe cāpyathavā dvija || 60 || caturṇāmapi kuṇḍānāṃ madhye sūryāṃśusevinī || āṣāḍhe sopavāsā tu tṛtīyāyāṃ tathā vaset || 61 || na tasyā durlabhaṃ loke kiñcidbhavati bhārgava || māghe'pyupoṣitā māsi rātryante tuhinotkaraiḥ ||62|| śuklīkṛtyākhilānyaṅgānyadhyāste śayanaṃ yayā || tataśca śītatoyena paścātsnānaṃ samācaret || || 63 || sāpi kāmānavāpnoti yānrāma manasecchati|| pativratā sadā lolā subhagā rūpasaṃyutā || 64 || dharmapriyā ca bhavati gaurīpūjanatatparā || āṣāḍhe dāḍimaṃ puṣpaṃ madhau karpāsasambhavam || 65 || nivedya sarvamāryāyai saubhāgyaṃ mahadaśnute || śakrāṇī ca tathā pūjyā māsi bhādrapade bhavet || || 66 || strīṇāṃ gaurīvidhānena sarvakāmapradā hi sā || proṣṭhapadasya māsasya caturthyāṃ dvijasattama || 67 || śakrāṇīpūjanaṃ kṛtvā nākapṛṣṭhe mahīyate || pūjātithiṣu sarvāsu rāma brāhmaṇapūjanam ||68|| kartavyaṃ yacca naivedyaṃ deyaṃ tatsubhagāsu ca || anabhyarcya tathā gaurīṃ gaurīdīpaṃ prapaśyati || || 69 || daurbhāgyaṃ mahadāpnoti varjitaṃ tasya darśanam || gaurīpūjanakāmā strī tasminnahani yā dvija || 70 || snānamuṣṇāmbunā kuryātsāpi saubhāgyamaśnute || sampūjya vidhinā gaurīṃ yatrayatrābhijāyate || 71 || rūpalāvaṇyasaubhāgyayuktā bhavati cāpyatha || nityaṃ cāvidhavā rāma tathaiva ca pativratā || 72 || etāḥ pūjyatamā strīṣu daivatāstāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || ataḥ paraṃ tu yā kuryātsatīmārgavivarjanam || 73 || hiṃsātmakamanirdiṣṭamaśuddhaṃ vā dvijottama || devatārādhanaṃ sā tu ciraṃ narakamṛcchati || 74 || tatastu cāpyanāyuṣyaṃ grahabhūtavivardhanam || hiṃsātmakā tu yā nārī devatārādhane ratā || 75 || mūlakarmaratā bhartrā sā vivāhyā bhṛgūttama || pauṃścalyādapi nārīṇāṃ rāma hiṃsā vivarjitā || 76 || strīsvabhāvaṃ śubhaṃ rāma saumyatvaṃ mārdavaṃ dayā || nirdayā rākṣasī rāma piśācī vā dvijottama || 77 || athavā sarvamutsṛjya patipūjanatatparā || keśavārādhanaṃ kuryācchriyaśca puruṣarṣabha || 78 || tenaiva sarvamāpnoti yatkiñcitparamṛcchati || aphalaṃ sarvameva syādbhartranujñāṃ vinā kṛtam ||79|| keśavārādhanaṃ rāma tathāpi saphalaṃ striyaḥ || sarvabhūtāni govindo bhartā nānyastu yoṣitaḥ || bhartranujñāṃ vinā tasmāttataḥ pūjā vidhīyate || 80 || nārāyaṇaḥ pūjyatamo hi loke nārāyaṇaḥ sarvagataḥ pradhānaḥ || nārāyaṇārādhanatatparā strī kāmānavāpnoti na saṃśayo'tra || 81 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde rāmaṃ prati puṣkaravākye strīdevatāpūjananirūpaṇaṃ nāma pañcatriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 35 || <2.36> || puṣkara uvāca || vailomyaṃ dharmarājo'pi nācaratyatha yoṣitām || pativratānāṃ dharmajña pūjyāstasyāpi tāssadā || 1 || atra te varṇayiṣyāmi kathāṃ pāpapraṇāśinīm || yathā vimokṣito bhartā mṛtyupāśāvṛtaḥ striyā ||2 || madreṣu śākale rājā babhūvā'śvapatiḥ purā || aputrastapyamāno'sau putrārthe sarvakāmadam || 3 || sāvitryāḥ kārayāmāsa lakṣahomaṃ dvijottamaiḥ || siddhārthakairhūyamānā sāvitrī pratyahaṃ dvija || 4 || śatasaṃkhyaiścaturthyāṃ tu māsāddaśadine gate || kāle tu darśayāmāsa svāṃ tanuṃ manujeśvare || 5 || sāvitryuvāca || rājanbhakto'si me nityaṃ prāpsyase tanayāṃ śubhām || maddattāṃ yatprasādācca putrānprāpsyasi śobhanān || 6 || puṣkara uvāca || etāvaduktvā sā rājñaḥ praṇatasyaiva bhārgava || jagāmādarśanaṃ devī khe yathā rāma cañcalā || 7 || mālavyā nāma tasyāsti rājñaḥ patnī pativratā || suṣāva tanayāṃ kāle sāvitrīmeva rūpataḥ || 8 || sāvitryā hutayā dattā tadrūpasadṛśā tataḥ || sāvitryeva bhavedeṣā jagāda nṛpatirdvijān || || kālena yauvanaṃ prāptāṃ dadau satyavate pitā || nāradastu tataḥ prāha rājānaṃ dīptatejasam || 10 || kṣīṇāyureṣa varṣeṇa bhaviṣyati nṛpātmajaḥ || pradīyate sakṛtkanyā cintayitvā narādhipaḥ || 11 || tathāpi pradadau kanyāṃ dyumatsenātmaje śubhāma || sāvitryapi ca bhartāramāsādya nṛpanandanam || 12 || nāradasya tu vākyena dūyamānena cetasā || śuśrūṣāṃ paramāṃ cakre bhartṛśvaśurayorvane || 13 || rājyabhraṣṭassabhāryastu naṣṭacakṣurnarādhipaḥ || tutoṣa tāṃ samāsādya rājaputrīṃ tadā snuṣām || 14 || caturthe'hani martavyaṃ yadā satyavatā dvija || śvaśureṇābhyanujñātā tadā rājñā tu sā snuṣā || 15 || cakre trirātraṃ dharmajña prāpte tasmiṃstadā dine || cārupuṣpaphalāhāraṃ satyavānprayayau vanam || 16 || śvaśureṇābhyanujñātā yācanābhaṅgabhīruṇā || sāvitryapi jagāmāśu saha bhartrā mahadvanam || 17 || cetasā dūyamānena gūhamānā ca tadbhayam || vane papraccha bhartāraṃ drumāṃśca samṛgāṃstathā || 18 || āśvāsayāmāsa sa rājaputrīṃ klāntāṃ vane padmapalāśanetrām || sandarśanenātha mṛgadvijānāṃ tathā drumāṇāṃ vipine nṛvīraḥ|| 19 || || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne sāvitryupākhyāne vanapraveśo nāma ṣaṭtriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 36 || <2.37> || satyavānuvāca || || vane'sminṣaṭpadākīrṇaṃ sahakāraṃ manoharam || śrotraghrāṇamukhaṃ paśya vasante rativardhanam || 1 || vane sapuṣpaṃ dṛṣṭvaiṣā raktā ślokaṃ manoharam || hasatīva manaḥ serṣyaṃ tvāmivāyatalocane || 2 || dakṣiṇe dakṣiṇenaitāṃ paśya ramyāṃ vanasthalīm || puṣpitaiḥ kiṃśukairyuktāṃ jvalitāmiva saprabhaiḥ || 3 || sugandhikusumāmodī vanarājivinirgataḥ| | karoti vāyurdākṣiṇyādāvayoḥ klamanāśanam || 4 || apyutpalaviśālākṣi karṇikāraiḥ supuṣpitaiḥ || kāñcanairiva bhātyeṣā vanarājī manoharā || 5 || atimuktalatājālaruddhamārgavanasthalīḥ || paśyoccaiścārusarvāṅgi kusumotkara bhūṣaṇā || 6 || madhumattālijhāṅkāravyājena varavarṇini || cāpayaṣṭiṃ karotīva kāmaḥ pānthajighāṃsayā || 7 || phullacaṃpakasadvaktrā puṃskokilavinādinī || vibhāti cārutilakā tvamivaiṣā vanasthalī || 8 || kokilaścūtaśikhare mañjarīreṇupiñjaraḥ || gaditairvyaktatāmeti kulīnaśceṣṭitairiva || 9 || puṣpareṇvanuliptāṅgaḥ priyāmanusaranvane || kusumātkusumaṃ yāti kūjankāmī śilīmukhaḥ || 10 || mañjarīṃ sahakārasya kāntācañcvagrakhaṇḍitām || svādayatyatipuṣpe'pi puṃskokilayuvā drume || 11 || kākaḥ prasūtāṃ vṛkṣāgre sāmiṣāgreṇa cañcunā || kākīṃ sampāyayatyeṣa pakṣācchādita putrakām || 12 || bhūbhāgaṃ nimnamāsādya dayitāsahito yuvā || nāhāramapi cādatte kāmī kāmaṃ kapiñjalaḥ || 13 || kalaviṅkastu virutaiḥ sapriyo viṭape sthitaḥ || muhurmuhurviśālākṣi utkaṇṭhayati kāminaḥ ||14 || kṣudraśākhāṃ samārūḍhaḥ śuko'yaṃ kāntayā saha || bhāreṇa namayañśākhāṃ karoti saphalāmiva || 15 || vanebhapiśitāsvādatṛpto nidrāmupāgataḥ || śete siṃhayuvā kāntācaraṇāvaraṇānanaḥ || 16 || vyāghrayormidhunaṃ paśya śailakandara saṃsthitam || yayornetraprabhālokairguhā bhinneva lakṣyate || 17 || aya dvīpī priyāṃ leḍhi jihvāgreṇa punaḥpunaḥ || prītimāyāti mahatīṃ lihyamānaśca kāntyā || 18 || utsaṅgakṛtamūrdhānaṃ nidrāpahṛtacetasam || jantūddharaṇataḥ kāntaṃ sukhayatyeva vānarī || 19 || bhūmau nipatitā kāntaṃ mārjārī darśitodarā || nakhairdantaistudatyeṣā na ca pīḍayate tathā || 20 || śaśakaḥ śaśikā cobhe saṃsupte pīḍite ime || sam̐llīnagātracaraṇe karṇairvyaktimupāgate || 21 || snātaṃ sarasi padmāḍhye vāraṇaṃ madamantharam || sambhāvayati tanvaṅgi mṛṇālaśakalairvaśā || 22 || kāntapotrasamutkhātaiḥ kāntā mārgānusāriṇī || karoti kavalaṃ mustairvarāhī potakānane || 23 || dṛḍhāṅgasandhirmahiṣaḥ kardamārdratanurvane || anuvrajati dhāvantīṃ priyāṃ baddhacatuṣkakaḥ ||24|| paśya cārvaṅgi sāraṅgaḥ tvatkaṭākṣanibhaṃ vane || sabhāryāṃ māṃ tu paśyantaṃ kautūhalasamanvitam || 25 || paśya paścimapādena rohī kaṇḍūyate mukham || snehārdrabhāvaḥ kaṣati bhartā śṛṅgāgrakoṭinā || 26 || dāḍime camarīṃ paśya sitavālāmagacchatīm || anvāste camaraḥ kāmī vīkṣate māṃ ca garvitaḥ || || 27 || ātape gavayaḥ paśya niviṣṭo bhāryayā saha || romanthamāsye kurvāṇaḥ kākaṃ kakudi dhārayan || 28 || paśyājaṃ bhāryayā sārdhaṃ nyastāgracaraṇadvayam || vipule badarīskandhe tacchadagrāsakāmyayā || 29 || haṃsaṃ sabhāryaṃ sarasi vicarantaṃ sunirmale || suśuklasyendubimbasya paśyainaṃ sadṛśa śriyam || 30 || sabhāryaścakravāko'yaṃ kamalākaramadhyagaḥ || karoti padminīṃ kāntāṃ sapuṣpāmiva sundari || 31 || mayā phaloccayaḥ subhru tvayā puṣpoccayaḥ kṛtaḥ || indhanaṃ na kṛtaṃ kiñcittatkariṣyāmi sāṃpratam || 32 || tvamasya sarasastīre drumacchāyāmupāśritā || kṣaṇamātraṃ pratīkṣasva viśramasva ca bhāmini || 33 || || sāvitryuvāca || || evametatkariṣyāmi mama dṛṣṭipathāttvayā || dūre kānta na gantavyaṃ bibhemi gahane vane || 34 || || puṣkara uvāca || || tasya pātayataḥ kāṣṭhaṃ jajñe śirasi vedanā || sa vedanārttaḥ saṅgamya bhāryāṃ vacanamabravīt || 35 || || satyavānuvāca || || āyāsena mamānena jātā śirasi vedanā || tamaśca praviśāmīva na ca jānāmi kiñcana || 36 || tvadutsaṅge śiraḥ kṛtvā nidropahatalocanaḥ || puṣkara uvāca || tadutsaṅge śiraḥ kṛtvā suṣvāpa gatacetanaḥ || 37 || pativratā mahābhāgā tatassā rājakanyakā || dadarśa dharmarājaṃ tu svayaṃ taṃ deśamāgatam | 38|| nīlotpaladalaśyāmaṃ pītāmbaradharaṃ prabhum || vidyullatānibaddhāṅgaṃ satoyamiva toyadam || 39 || kirīṭenārkavarṇena kuṇḍalābhyāṃ virājitam || hārabhārārpitoraskaṃ tathāṅgadavibhūṣitam || 40 || tathānugamyamānaṃ ca kālena saha mṛtyunā || sa tu saṃprāpya taṃ deśaṃ dehātsatyavatastadā || 41 || aṅguṣṭhamātraṃ puruṣaṃ pāśabaddhaṃ vaśaṅgatam || ākṛṣya dakṣiṇāmāśāṃ prayayau satvaraṃ tadā || 42 || sāvitryapi varārohā tyaktvā taṃ gatajīvitam || anuvavrāja gacchantaṃ dharmarājamatandritā || 43 || tāmuvāca yamo gaccha yathāgatamanindite || aurdhvadaihikakāryeṣu yuktā bhartuḥ samācara ||44 || nānugantumasau śakyastvayā lokāntaraṃ gataḥ || pativratāsi tena tvaṃ muhūrtamanupaśyasi || ||45 || guruśuśrūṣaṇādbhadre tathā satyavato mahat || puṇyaṃ samarjitaṃ yena nayāmyenamahaṃ svayam || 46 || etāvadeva kartavyaṃ puruṣasya vijānataḥ || mātuḥ pituśca śuśrūṣā gurośca varavarṇini || 47 || gurutritayametacca sadā satyavatā vane || 48 || pūjitaṃ pūjitassvargastadānena ciraṃ śubhe || tapasā brahmacaryeṇa tvagniśuśrūṣayā tathā ||49|| puruṣāḥ svargamāyānti guruśuśrūṣaṇena ca || ācāryaśca pitā caiva mātā bhrātā ca pūrvajaḥ || 50 || nārtenāpyavamantavyā brāhmaṇena viśeṣataḥ || ācāryo brahmaṇo mūrtiḥ pitā mūrtiḥ prajāpateḥ ||51|| mātā pṛthivyā mūrtiśca bhrātā vai mūrtirātmanaḥ || yanmātāpitarau kleśaṃ sahete sambhave nṛṇām || 52 || na tasya niṣkṛtiḥ śakyā kartuṃ varṣaśatairapi || tayornityaṃ priyaṃ kuryādācāryasya ca sarvadā || 53 || teṣveva triṣu tuṣṭeṣu tapaḥ satyaṃ samāpyate || teṣāṃ trayāṇāṃ śuśrūṣā paramaṃ tapa ucyate || 54 || na tairanabhyanujñāto dharmamanyaṃ samācareta || ta eva hi trayo lokāsta eva traya āśramāḥ || 55 || ta eva ca trayo vedāsta evoktāstrayo'gnayaḥ || pitā vai gārhapatyo'gnirmātāgnirdakṣiṇaḥ smṛtaḥ || 56 || gururāhavanīyastu agnitretā garīyasī || triṣvapramādyanneteṣu trīṃllokāñjayate gṛhī || 57 || sa hi divyena vapuṣā devavaddivi modate || imaṃ lokaṃ mātṛbhaktaḥ pitṛbhaktastu madhyamam || 58 || guruśuśrūṣayā tvevaṃ brahmalokaṃ samaśnute || sarve tasyādṛtā dharmā yasyaite traya ādṛtāḥ || 59 || anādṛtāstu yasyaite sarvāstasyāphalāḥ kriyāḥ || yāvattrayaste jīveyustāvannānyatsamācaret || 60 || tanuṃ nivedayettebhyo mano vacanakarmabhiḥ || triṣveteṣvitikṛtyaṃ hi puruṣasya samāpyate || 61 || eṣa dharmaḥ paraḥ sākṣādupadharmo'nya ucyate || gurupūjāratirbhartā tvaṃ ca sādhvī pativratā || 62 || vinivartasva dharmajñe glānirbhavati te'dhunā || sāvitryuvāca || patirhi daivataṃ strīṇāṃ patireva parāyaṇam|| 63 || anugamyaḥ striyā sādhvyā patiḥ prāṇadhaneśvaraḥ || mitaṃ dadāti hi pitā mitaṃ bhrātā mitaṃ sutaḥ || 64 || amitasya hi dātāraṃ bhartāraṃ kā na pūjayeta || nīyate yatra bhartā me svayaṃ vā yatra gacchati || 65 || mayāpi tatra gantavyaṃ yathāśakti surottama || patimādāya gacchantamanugantumahaṃ yadā || 66 || tvāṃ deva na hi śakṣyāmi tadā tyakṣyāmi jīvitam || manasvinī tathā kā ca vaidhavyākṣaradūṣitā || 67 || muhūrtamapi jīveta maṇḍanārhāpyamaṇḍitā || yama uvāca || pativrate mahābhāge parituṣṭo'smi te śubhe || 68 || vinā satyavataḥ prāṇānvaraṃ varaya mā ciram || sāvitryuvāca || vinaṣṭacakṣuṣo rājyaṃ cakṣuṣā saha kāmaye || cyutarājyasya dharmajña śvaśurasya mahātmanaḥ || 69 || || yama uvāca || kṛtena kāmena nivarta bhadre bhaviṣyatīdaṃ sakalaṃ tvayoktam || mamoparodhastava ca klamaḥ syāttathādhvanā tena tava bravīmi || 70 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0 saṃ0 sāvitryupākhyāne saptatriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ||37|| <2.38> sāvittryuvāca|| kutaḥ klamaḥ kuto duḥkhaṃ sadbhiḥ saha samāgame || satāṃ tasmānna me glānistvatsamīpe surottama || 1 || sādhūnāṃ vāpyasādhūnāṃ santa eva parā gatiḥ || naivāsatāṃ naiva satāmasanto naiva cātmanaḥ || 2 || viṣāgnisarpaśastrebhyo na tathā jāyate bhayam || akāraṇajagadvairikhalebhyo jāyate yathā || 3 || santaḥ prāṇānapi tyaktvā parārthaṃ kurvate yathā || tathā'santo'pi manujāḥ parapīḍāsu tatparāḥ ||4 || tyajatyasūnayaṃ lokastṛṇavadyasya kāraṇāt|| paropadhānasaktāste paralokaṃ tathā satā || 5 || nikāyeṣunikāyeṣu purā brahmā jagadguruḥ || asatāmupaghātāya rājānaḥ kṛtavānsvayam || 6 || cāraiḥ parīkṣayedrājā dhūrtānsammārjayetsadā || nigrahaṃ cāsatāṃ kuryātsa tu lokajiduttamaḥ || 7 || dhānyasaṃrakṣaṇārthāya nirmārṣṭā kakṣamuddharan || yathā vardhayate dhānyaṃ varddhanīyāstathā prajāḥ || 8 || nigraheṇā satāṃ rājñā satāṃ ca paripālanaiḥ || etāvadeva kartavyaṃ rājñā svargamabhīpsatā || 9 || rājakṛtyaṃ hi lokeṣu nāstyanyajjagatīpate || asatāṃ nigrahādeva satāṃ ca paripālanāt || 10 || rājānuśāsitā teṣāmasatāṃ śāsitā bhavān || tena tvamadhiko deva devebhyaḥ pratibhāsi me || 11 || jagattu dhāryate sadbhiḥ satāmagryastathā bhavān || tena tvāmabhiyāntyā me klamo deva na vidyate || 12|| yama uvāca || tuṣṭosmi te viśālākṣi vacanairdharmasaṃhitaiḥ || vinā satyavataḥ prāṇānvaraṃ varaya mā ciram || 13 || sāvitryuvāca || sahodarāṇāṃ bhrātṝṇāṃ kāmayāmi śataṃ vibho || anapatyaḥ pitā prītiṃ putralābhātprayātu me||14|| yama uvāca || kṛtena kāmena nivarta bhadre bhaviṣyatīdaṃ sakalaṃ tavoktam || mamoparodhastava ca klamaḥ syāttathādhunā tena tava bravīmi ||15|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0 sa0 sāvitryupākhyāne dvitīyavaralābho nāmāṣṭatriṃśattamodhyāyaḥ || 38 || <2.39> sāvitryuvāca || dharmo hi daivataṃ strīṇāṃ patireva parāyaṇam || anugamyaḥ striyā sādhvyā patiḥ prāṇadhaneśvaraḥ || 1 || dharmārjane suraśreṣṭha kuto glāniḥ kutaḥ klamaḥ|| tvatpādamūlamevedaṃ paramaṃ dharmakāraṇam || 2 || dharmārjanaṃ sadā kāryaṃ puruṣeṇa vijānatā || tallābhaḥ sarvalābhebhyo yato deva viśiṣyate || 3 || dharmaścārthaśca kāmaśca trivargaṃ jīvataḥ phalam || dharmahīnasya kāmārthau vandhyāsutasamāvubhau || 4 || dharmādarthastathā kāmo dharmāllokadvayaṃ tathā || dharma eko'nuyātyenaṃ yatra kutra ca gāminam || 5 || śarīreṇa samaṃ nāśaṃ sarvamanyaddhi gacchati || eko hi jāyate jantureka eva vipadyate || 6 || dharmastamanuyātyeko na suhṛnna ca bāndhavāḥ || rūpasaubhāgyalāvaṇyaṃ sampaddharmeṇa labhyate|| 7|| brahmendropendraśarvendrayamārkāgnyanilāmbhasām || vasvaśvidhanadādyānāṃ ye lokāḥ sarvakāmadāḥ || 8 || dharmeṇa tānavāpnoti puruṣaḥ puruṣāntaka || manoharāṇi dvīpāni varṣāṇi sumukhāni ca|| 9 || prayānti dharmeṇa narāstathaivāmaratāmitāḥ || nandanādīni mukhyāni devodyānāni yāni ca || 10 || tāni puṇyena labhyante nākapṛṣṭhaṃ tathā naraiḥ || vimānāni vicitrāṇi tathaivāpsarasaḥ śubhāḥ || 11 || taijasāni śarīrāṇi sadā puṇyavatāṃ phalama || rājyaṃ nṛpatipūjā ca kāmasiddhistathepsitā || 12 || upaskarāṇi mukhyāni phalaṃ puṇyasya dṛśyate || rukmavaiḍūryadaṇḍāni candrāṃśusadṛśāni ca || 13 || cāmarāṇi surādhyakṣa bhavanti śubhakarmaṇām || pūrṇendumaṇḍalābhena raktāṃśukamitena ca ||14|| dhāryatāṃ yānti chatreṇa naraḥ puṇyena karmaṇā || jayaśaṅkhasvanādeva sūtamāgadhaniḥsvanama || 15 || varāsanaṃ sabhṛṅgāraṃ phalaṃ puṇyā karmaṇaḥ || varānnapānaṃ gītaṃ ca nṛtyamālyānulepanam || 16 || ratnavastrāṇi mukhyāni phalaṃ puṇyasya karmaṇaḥ || rūpaudāryaguṇopetāḥ striyaścātinoharāḥ || 17 || vāsaḥ prāsādapṛṣṭheṣu bhavanti śubhakarmaṇām || suvarṇakiṃkiṇī miśracāmarāḥ pīṭhadhāriṇaḥ || 18 || vahanti turagā deva naraṃ puṇyena karmaṇā || hemakakṣaiḥ samātaṅgaiścalatparvatasannibhaiḥ || 19 || khelāṃghripadavinyāsairyānti puṇyena karmaṇā || sarvakāmaprade deve sarvāpadduritāpahe ||20 || vahanti bhaktiṃ puruṣāssadā puṇyena karmaṇā || tasya dvārāṇi yajanaṃ tapo dānaṃ dayā kṣamā || 21 || brahmacaryaṃ ca satyaṃ ca tīrthānusaraṇaṃ śubhe || svādhyāyasevā sādhūnāṃ sahavāsaḥ surārcanam ||22|| gurūṇāṃ caiva śuśrūṣā brāhmaṇānāṃ ca pūjanam || indriyāṇāṃ jayaścaiva mārdavaṃ hrīramatsaram || 23 || tasmāddharmaḥ sadā kāryo nityameva vijānatā || na hi pratīkṣate mṛtyuḥ kṛtamasya na vā kṛtam || 24 || bāla evācareddharmamanityaṃ deva jīvitam || ko hi jānāti kasyādya mṛtyuḥ kena bhaviṣyati ||25|| paśyato'pyasya lokasya maraṇaṃ purataḥ sthitam || amarasyeva caritamatyāścaryaṃ surottama || 26 || yuvatvāpekṣayā bālo vṛddhatvāpekṣayā yuvā || mṛtyorutsaṅgamārūḍhaḥ sthaviraḥ kimapekṣate || 27 || bhuvaḥ śailaṃ samārūḍhaḥ tato vṛkṣāgramāśritaḥ || tatrāpyavindatastrāṇaṃ mṛtyodbhītasya kā gatiḥ || 28 || na bhayaṃ maraṇādeva prāṇināmadhikaṃ kvacita || tatrāpi nirbhayāḥ santaḥ sadā sukṛtakāriṇaḥ ||29 || yama uvāca || tuṣṭo'smi te viśālākṣi vacanairdharmasaṅgataiḥ || vinā satyavataḥ prāṇānvaraṃ varaya mā ciram || 30 || sāvitryuvāca || varayāmi tvayā dattaṃ putrāṇāṃ śatamaurasam || anapatyasya lokeṣu gatiḥ kila na vidyate || 31 || yama uvāca || kṛtena kāmena nivarta bhadre bhaviṣyatīdaṃ sakalaṃ tvayoktam || mamoparodhaśca tava klamaḥ syāttathādhunā tena tava bravīmi || 32 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0 saṃ0 sāvitryupākhyāne tṛtīyavaralābho nāmaikonacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||39|| <2.40> sāvitryuvāca || sarvadharmavidhānajñaḥ sarvadharmapravartakaḥ || tvameva jagatāṃ nāthaḥ prajāsaṃyamano yamaḥ || 1 || karmaṇāmānurūpyeṇa yasmādyamayasi prajāḥ ||| tasmāttvamucyase deva yama ityeva nāmataḥ || 2 || dharmeṇemāḥ prajāḥ sarvā yathā rañjayase prabho || tasmātte dharmarājeti nāma satyaṃ nigadyate || 3 || sukṛtaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ cobhe purodhāya yathā janāḥ || tvatsakāśamathāyānti tasmāttvaṃ mṛtyurucyase || 4 || sarveṣāmatha bhūtānāṃ yasmādantakaro bhavān |||| tasmātvamantakaḥ proktaḥ sarvadevairmahādyute || 5 || vivasvatastvaṃ tanayaḥ prathamaḥ parikīrtitaḥ || tasmādvaivasvato nāmnā sarvadeveṣu kathyase || 6 || kālaṃ kalādyaṃ kalayansarveṣāṃ tvaṃ hi tiṣṭhasi || tasmātkāleti te nāma procyate tatsudarśibhiḥ ||7 || āyuṣye karmaṇi kṣīṇe gṛhṇāsi prasabhaṃ janam ||||| tasmāttvaṃ kathyase loke sarvaprāṇahareti vai || 8 || tava prasādāddeveśa dharme tiṣṭhanti jantavaḥ || tava prasādāddeveśa saṅkaro naiva jāyate || 9 || satāṃ sadā gatirdeva tvameva parikīrtitaḥ || jagato'sya jagannātha maryādāparipālakaḥ ||10 || pāhi māṃ tridaśaśreṣṭha duḥkhitāṃ śaraṇāgatām || pitarau ca tathaivāsya rājaputrasya duḥkhitau || 11 || yama uvāca || stutena bhaktyā dharmajñe mayā tuṣṭena satyavān || tava bhartā vimukto'yaṃ labdhakāmā vrajābale || 12 || rājyaṃ kṛtvā tvayā sārdhaṃ vatsarāśītipañcakam || nākapṛṣṭhamathāruhya tridaśaissaha raṃsyate || 13 || stotreṇānena dharmajñe kalyamutthāya yaśca mām || kīrtayiṣyati tasyāpi dīrghamāyurbhaviṣyati || 14 || puṣkara uvāca || etāvaduktvā bhagavānyamastu vimucya taṃ rājasutaṃ mahātmā || adarśanaṃ tatra jagāma rāma kālena sārdhaṃ saha mṛtyunā ca||15|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0 saṃ0 sāvitryupākhyāne cattvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 40 || <2.41> || puṣkara uvāca || sāvitrī ca tataḥ sādhvī jagāma varavarṇinī || yathāyathāgatenaiva yatrāsau satyavānmṛtaḥ || 1 || sā samāsādya bhartāraṃ tasyotsaṅgagataṃ śiraḥ || kṛtvā viveśa tanvaṅgī lambamāne divākare || 2 || satyavānapi nirmukto dharmarājñā śanaiḥ śanaiḥ || unmīlayati te netre prasyandata ca bhārgava || 3 || tataḥ pratyāgataprāṇaḥ priyāṃ vacanamabravīt || kvā'sau prayātaḥ puruṣo yo māmākṛṣya gacchati || 4 || jānāmi na varārohe kaścāsau puruṣaḥ śubhe || vane'smim̐ścārusarvāṅgi suptasya ca ciraṃ gatam || 5 || upavāsapariklāntā karṣitā bhavatī mayā || asmāddurhṛdayenādya pitarau duḥkhitau tathā || 6 || draṣṭumicchāmyahaṃ subhru gamane tvaritā bhava || sāvitryuvāca || ādityo'stamanuprāpto yadi te rucitaṃ prabho || 7 || āśramantu prayāsyāvaḥ śvaśurau tapyato mama || yathāvṛttaṃ ca tatraiva tava vakṣyāmyathāśrame || 8 || puṣkara uvāca || etāvaduktvā bhartāraṃ saha bhartrā yayau tadā || āsasādāśramaṃ caiva saha bhartrā nṛpātmajā || 9 || etasminnavakāśe tu labdhacakṣurmahīpatiḥ || dyumatsenaḥ sabhāryastu paryatapyata bhārgava || 10 || sāvitryapi varārohā saha satyavatā tadā || vavande tatra rājānaṃ sabhāryaṃ bhṛgunandana || 11 || pariṣvaktastadā pitrā satyavānrājanandanaḥ || abhivādya tataḥ sarvānvane tasmim̐stapodhanān || 12 || uvāsa tāṃ tadā rātrimṛṣibhiḥ saha dharmavit || sāvitryapi jagādātha yathā vṛttamaninditā || 13 || vrataṃ samāpayāmāsa tasyāmeva tadā niśi || tatastu rāma rātryante śālvebhyastasya bhūpateḥ || 14 || ājagāma janaḥ sarvo rājyārthāya nimantraṇe || ājñāpayāmāsa tadā tathā prakṛtiśāsanam || 15 || vicakṣuṣaste nṛpate yena rājyaṃ purā hṛtam || amātyaiḥ saha bhoktavyaṃ rājyamastu pure nṛpa || 16 || etacchrutvā yayau tatra balena caturaṅgiṇā || lebhe ca sakalaṃ vākyaṃ dharmarājño mahātmanaḥ || 17 || bhrātṝṇāṃ ca śataṃ lebhe sāvitryapi varāṅganā || evaṃ pativratā sādhvī pitṛpakṣaṃ nṛpātmajā || 18 || ujjahāra varārohā bhartṛpakṣaṃ tathaiva ca || mocayāmāsa bhartāraṃ mṛtyupāśavaśīkṛtam || 19 || tasmātsādhvyaḥ striyaḥ pūjyāḥ satataṃ devavajjanaiḥ || tāsāṃ rāma prasādena dhāryate vai jagattrayam || 20 || tāsāṃ na vākyaṃ bhavatīha mithyā na jātu lokeṣu carācareṣu || tasmātsadā tāḥ paripūjanīyāḥ kāmānsamagrānabhikāmayānaiḥ || 21 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde sāvitryupākhyāne ekacatvāriṃśāttamo'dhyāyaḥ || 41 || <2.42> puṣkara uvāca || gavāṃ hi pālanaṃ rājñā kartavyaṃ bhṛgunandana || gāvaḥ pavitrāḥ saṃgatyā goṣu lokāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ || 1 || gāvo vitanvate yajñaṃ gāvo viśvasya mātaraḥ || śakṛnmūtraṃ paraṃ tāsāmalakṣmīnāśanaṃ smṛtam || 2 || taddhi sevyaṃ prayatnena tatra lakṣmīḥ pratiṣṭhitā || udvegaṃ ca na gantavyaṃ śakṛnmūtrasya jānatā || 3 || gavāṃ mūtrapurīṣeṣu ṣṭhīvanādyaṃ na santyajet || gorajaḥ paramaṃ puṇyamalakṣmīvighnanāśanam || 4 || gavāṃ kaṇḍūyanaṃ caiva sarvakalmaṣanāśanam || tāsāṃ śṛṅgodakaścaiva jāhnavījalasannibham || 5 || gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi sarpiśca rocanam || ṣaḍaṅgametanmāṅgalyaṃ pavitraṃ tu pṛthakpṛthak || 6 || gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi sarpiḥ kuśodakam || pavitraṃ paramaṃ jñeyaṃ snāne pāne ca bhārgava || 7 || rakṣoghnametanmāṅgalyaṃ kaliduḥkhapraṇāśanam || rocanā ca tathā dhanyā rakṣoragagadāpahā || yastu kalye samutthāya mukhamājye nirīkṣate || tasyālakṣmīḥ kṣayaṃ yāti vardhate na tu kilbiṣam || 9 || gavāṃ grāsapradānena puṇyaṃ sumahadaśnute || yāvatyaḥ śaknuyādgāvaḥ sukhaṃ dhārayituṃ gṛhe || 10 || dhārayettāvatīrnityaṃ kṣudhitāstu na dhārayet || duḥkhitā dhenavo yasya vasanti dvija mandire || 11 || narakaṃ samavāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || dattvā paragave grāsaṃ puṇyaṃ sumahadaśnute || 12 || śaiśiraṃ sakalaṃ kālaṃ grāsaṃ paragave tathā || dattvā svargamavāpnoti saṃvatsaraśatāni ṣaṭ || 13 || agrabhaktaṃ naro dattvā nityameva tathā gavām || māsaṣaṭkena labhate nākalokaṃ samāyutam || 14 || sāyaṃ prātarmanuṣyāṇāmaśanaṃ devanirmitam || tatraivamaśanaṃ dattvā gavāṃ nityamatandritaḥ || 15 || dvitīyaṃ yaḥ samaśnāti tena saṃvatsarānnaraḥ || gavāṃ lokamavāpnoti yāvanmanvantaraṃ dvija || 16 || gavāṃ pracāre pānīyaṃ dattvā puruṣasattamaḥ || vāruṇaṃ lokamāsādya krīḍatyabdagaṇāyutam || parāṃ tṛptimavāpnoti yatrayatrābhijāyate || 17 || gavāṃ pracārabhūmiṃ tu vāhayitvā halādinā || narakaṃ mahadāpnoti yāvadindrāścaturdaśa || 16 || gavāṃ pānapravṛtānāṃ yastu vighnaṃ samācareta || brahmahatyā kṛtā tena ghorā bhavati bhārgava || siṃhavyāghrabhayatrastāṃ paṅkamagnāṃ jale gatām || 19 || gāmuddhṛtya naraḥ svarge kalpabhogānupāśnute || gavāṃ yavasadānena rūpavānabhijāyate || 20 || saubhāgyaṃ mahadāpnoti lāvaṇyaṃ ca dvijottama || auṣadhaṃ ca tathā dattvā virogastvabhijāyate || || 21 || auṣadhaṃ lavaṇaṃ toyamāhāraṃ ca prayacchataḥ || vipattau pātakaṃ nāsya bhavatyudbandhanādikama || 22 || vaktavyatā divāpāle rātrau svāmī na tadgṛhe || tatrāpi tanniyuktaśca kaścidanyo na cedbhavet || 23 || tāsāṃ cedaviruddhānāṃ carantīnāṃ mitho vane || yāmutpatya vṛko hanyānnapālastatra kilbiṣī || 24 || saṃruddhāsu tathaivāsu vṛkaḥ pāle tvanāyati || yāmutpatya vṛko hanyātpāle tatkilbiṣaṃ bhaveta || 25 || govadhena naro yāti narakānekaviṃśatim || tasmātsarvaprayatnena kāryaṃ tāsāṃ tu pālanam || 26 || vikrayācca gavāṃ rāma na bhadraṃ pratipadyate || tāsāṃ ca kīrtanādeva naraḥ pāpādvimucyate || 27 || tāsāṃ saṃsparśanaṃ dhanyaṃ sarvakalmaṣanāśanam || dānena ca tathā tāsāṃ kulānyapi samuddharet || 28 || udakyā sūtiko doṣo naiva tatra gṛhe bhavet || bhūmidoṣāstathānye'pi yatraikā vasate tu gauḥ || 29 || gavāṃ niśvāsavātena parā śāntirgṛhe bhaveta || nīrājanaṃ tatparamaṃ sarvasthāneṣu kīrtitam || 30 || gavāṃ saṃsparśanādrāma kṣīyate kilbiṣaṃ nṛṇām || gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi sarpiḥ kuśodakam || 31 || ekarātropavāsaṃ ca śvapākamapi śodhayet || pṛthaktvapratyayābhyastamatisantapanaṃ smṛtam || 32 || sarvāśubhavimokṣāya purā caritamīśvareḥ || pratyekaṃ ca tryahābhyastaṃ cātisāṃtapanaṃ smṛtam || 33 || sarvakāmapradaṃ rāma sarvāśubhavināśanam || kṛcchrātikṛcchraṃ payasā divasānekaviṃśatim || 34 || nirmalāstena cīrṇena bhavanti puruṣottamāḥ || tryahamuṣṇaṃ pibenmūtraṃ tryahamuṣṇaṃ ghṛtaṃ pibet || || 35 || tryahamuṣṇaṃ payaḥ pītvā vāyubhakṣaḥ paraṃ tryaham || taptakṛcchramidaṃ proktaṃ sarvāśubhavināśanam || 36 || śītakṛcchrastathaivaiṣa kramācchītaiḥ prakīrtitaḥ || sarvāśubhavināśāya nirmito brahmaṇā svayam || 37 || gomūtreṇa caretsnānaṃ vṛttiṃ kuryāttu gorasaiḥ || utthitāmutthitastiṣṭhedupaviṣṭāsu nā sthitaḥ || 38 || abhuktavatsu nāśnīyādapītāsu ca no pibet || trāṇaṃ tu rāmākṛtvaiva tathā deve pravarṣati || 39 || trāṇaṃ naivātmanaḥ kāryaṃ bhayā rttāśca samuddharet || ātmānamapi santyajya govrataṃ tatprakīrtitam || 40 || sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ māsenaikena bhārgava || vratenānena cīrṇena golokaṃ puruṣo vrajet || 41 || abhīṣṭamatha vā rāma yāvadindrāścaturdaśa || gavāṃ nirhāranirmuktānaśnanpratidinaṃ yavān || 42 || māsena tadavāpnoti yatki ñcinmanasecchati || gomatīṃ ca tathā vidyāṃ sāyaṃ prātastathā japan || 43 || golokamāpnoti naro nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || uparyupari sarveṣāṃ gavāṃ lokaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 44 || nivasanti sadā yatra gāvastvākāśagā divi || vimāneṣu vicitreṣu vṛteṣvapsarasāṃ gaṇaiḥ || 45 || kiṅkiṇī jālacitreṣu vīṇāmurajanādiṣu || sadā kāmajalā nadyaḥ kṣīrapāyasakardamāḥ || 46 || śītalāmalapānīyāḥ suvarṇasikatāstathā || puṣkariṇyaḥ śubhāstatra vaiḍūryakamalotpalāḥ || 47 || mānasī ca tathā siddhiḥ tatra loke bhṛgūttama || tañca lokaṃ narā yānti gavāṃ bhaktyā na saṃśayaḥ || 48 || gomatīṃ kīrtayiṣyāmi sarvapāpapraṇāśinīm || tāṃ tu me vadato vipra śṛṇuṣva susamāhitaḥ || 49 || gāvaḥ surabhayo nityaṃ gāvo guggu lugandhikāḥ||| gāvaḥ pratiṣṭhā bhūtānāṃ gāvaḥ svastyayanaṃ param || 50 || annameva paraṃ gāvo devānāṃ haviruttamam || pāvanaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ rakṣanti ca vahanti ca ||51|| haviṣā mantrapūtena tarpayantyamarāndivi || ṛṣīṇāmagnihotreṣu gāvo home prayojitāḥ || 52 || sarveṣāmeva bhūtānāṃ gāvaḥ śaraṇamuttamam || gāvaḥ pavitraṃ paramaṃ gāvo maṅgalamuttamam || 53 || gāvaḥ svargasya sopānaṃ gāvo dhanyāssanātanāḥ || oṃ namo gobhyaḥ śrīmatībhyaḥ saurabheyībhya eva ca || 54 || namo brahmasutābhyaśca pavitrābhyo namonamaḥ || brāhmaṇāścaiva gāvaśca kulamekaṃ dvidhā sthitam || 55 || ekatra mantrāstiṣṭhanti havirekatra tiṣṭhati || devabrāhmaṇagosādhusādhvībhiḥ sakalaṃ jagat || 56 || dhāryate vai sadā tasmātsarve pūjyatamā sadā || yatra tīrthe sadā gāvaḥ pibanti tṛṣi tā jalam || uttaranti pathā yena sthitā tatra sarasvatī ||57|| gavāṃ hi tīrthe vasatīha gaṅgā puṣṭistathā tadrajasi pravṛddhā || lakṣmīḥ karīṣe praṇatau ca dharmastāsāṃ praṇāmaṃ satataṃ ca kuryāt || 58 || || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0 saṃ0 gomāhātmye gomatīvidyā nāma dvicatvāriṃ śattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 42 || <2.43> || puṣkara uvāca || || ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi tava rāma cikitsitam || saṃkṣepeṇa gavāṃ puṇyaṃ sārabhūtaṃ śṛṇuṣva tat || || 1 || śṛṅgamūleṣu dhenūnāṃ tailaṃ dadyātsasaindhavam || śṛṅgīvīrabalāmāṃsīkalkasiddhaṃ samākṣikam || 2 || simicūrṇayutaṃ deyamathavāpi tathā ghṛtam || karṇamūleṣu sarveṣu mañjiṣṭhāhiṅgusaindhavaiḥ || 3 || siddhaṃ tailaṃ pradātavyaṃ goraso vāthavā punaḥ || mākṣikaṃ saindhavaṃ śaṃkhaṃ tagarīṃ pippalīṃ sihām || 4 || ajākṣīreṇa saṃpeṣya gulikāṃ kārayedbhiṣak || etannetrāñjanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ ghṛtamākṣikasaṃyutam || 5 || bilvamūlamapāmārgaṃ dhātakīṃ ca sapāṭalām || kuṭajaṃ dantamūleṣu lepaṃ tacchūlanāśanam || 6 || dantaśūlaharairdravyairghṛtaṃ rāma vipācitam || mukharogaharaṃ jñeyaṃ jihvārogeṣu saindhavam || 7 || śṛṅgaveraṃ haridre dve triphalāṃ ca galagrahe || śṛṅgaveraṃ haridre dve valkalaṃ kuṭajasya ca || 8 || apāmārgaviḍaṃgāṃśca lavaṇena vimiśritam || auṣadhaṃ mukharogaghnaṃ jvaradāhavināśanam || 9 || hṛcchūle bastiśūle ca vātaroge kṣate tathā || triphalāghṛtasamiśraṃ gavāṃ pānaṃ praśasyate || 10 || śatapuṣpāyutaṃ pakvaṃ tailaṃ kuṭajacitrakaiḥ || gavāṃ rāma pradātavyaṃ sarvahṛdroganāśanam || 11 || atīsāre haridre dve pāṭhāṃ caiva pradāpayet || ānāhe ghṛtasaṃyuktāṃ dāpayetpadmacāriṇīm || || 12 || sarveṣu kuṣṭharogeṣu tathā śākhāgadeṣu ca || śṛṅgaveraṃ ca dārvīṃ ca kāse śvāse pradāpayet ||13|| dātavyā bhagnasandhāne priyaṅgurlavaṇānvitā | vātarogeṣu sarveṣu śatapuṣpāvipācitam || 14 || gavāṃ tailaṃ pradātavyaṃ sarvavātagadāpaham || yūṣaṇaṃ madhusaṃmiśraṃ kapharogeṣu dāpayet || 15 || pitta rogeṣu sarveṣu madhuyaṣṭivipācitam || gavyamājyaṃ pradātavyaṃ sarvapittagadāpaham || 16 || śākhoṭakaramāpānaṃ raktapitte praśasyate || godhūmānāṃ ca cūrṇāni māṣāścaiva sasarṣapāḥ || 17 || payasā ca samāloḍya gurumiśrāḥ pradāpayet || raktasrāveṣu kṛcchreṣu gavāmetatpraśasyate || 18 || tilāmbhakaruhāṃścaiva haritālaṃ ghṛtaṃ tathā || bhagnakṣatānāṃ dhenūnāṃ lepane tatpraśasyate || 19 || vatsānāṃ ca sarogāṇāṃ pāṭhāṃ takreṇa pāyayet || haridrāṃ kṣīrasaṃyuktāmathavā rogaśāntaye || 20 || māṣāstilāḥ sagodhūmāḥ paśukṣīraṃ ghṛtaṃ tathā || eṣāṃ piṇḍāḥ pradātavyā lavaṇena susam̐skṛtāḥ|| puṣṭipradā tu vatsānāṃ vṛṣabhāṇāṃ balapradā || 21 || devadāruvacāmāṃsīguggulurhiṅgusarṣapāḥ || eṣa dhūpaḥ pradātavyaḥ kiñcidghṛtapariplutaḥ || 22 || sarvagraha vināśāya palaṅkaśayutaḥ śubhaḥ || ghaṇṭā cāpi gavāṃ kāryā dhūpenānena dhūpitā || 23 || aśvagandhā tilaṃ cukraṃ vastiyoge praśasyate || aśvagandhāyutaṃ takraṃ tilānvasti praśasyate || bhavati kṣīriṇī tena dhenurbhṛgukulodbhava || 24 || piṇyākameva nirdiṣṭaṃ gavāṃ rāma rasāyanam || śītodapānamārdrañca yavasaṃ ca vivarjayet || 25 || jarānvitā tathā sthānaṃ tacca śītaṃ dvijottama || dhāryaṃ caiva gavāṃ madhye mattojaḥ sarvathā bhavet || || 26 || gavāṃ veśmani dīpāstu dātavyā rāma rātrikāḥ || 27 || gavāṃ hi rogopaśamāya śastaṃ gate'rdhamāse lavaṇaṃ sadaiva || ānāhaśūlārucināśanaṃ tadajāvikasyāpi tathā praśastam ||28|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0 saṃ0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne gocikitsitaṃ nāma tricatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 43 || <2.44> puṣkara uvāca || ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi śāntikarma gavāṃ tava || nityaṃ naimittikaṃ kāmyaṃ tathā puṣṭivivardhanam || 1 || pañcamīṣu ca śuklāsu śriyaḥ pūjā vidhīyate || gavāṃ purīṣe dharmajña dhūpadīpānnasampadā || 2 || vanyaiḥ sukusumairbhaktyā brāhmaṇānāṃ ca pūjanam || tatraivāhani kartavyaṃ vāsudevasya pūjanam || 3 || sa hi sarvagato devaḥ kṣīrodadhiniketanaḥ || trailokyādhārabhūtānāṃ viśeṣeṇa tathā gavām || 4 || āśvayukśuklapakṣasya pañcadaśyāṃ bhṛgūttama || vṛtrāntakasya kartavyastadā yāgastu gomatā || '5 || gandhadhūpanamaskārapuṣpadīpānnasampadā || iha prajāyāḥ sāmrādhaḥ pṛṣadaśvā tathaiva ca || 6 || ghṛtapratīkaśca tathā raudrībhiśca bhṛgūttama || nityābhiśca tathā vahniṃ ghṛtena juhuyādbudhaḥ || 7 || ambhastheti ca mantreṇa lavaṇaṃ cābhimantrayet || dadhnā saṃprāśanaṃ kāryaṃ dadhikrāvṇetyanantaram || 8 || yajamānena deyā ca dhenuḥ syācchatadhenunā || tadūnavitto dadyācca hotre śaktyaiva dakṣiṇām||9|| gāvaḥ svalaṃkṛtāḥ paścādgandhamālyaphalādibhiḥ || svāśitā muktavatsāśca kuryurvahniṃ pradakṣiṇam || 10 || kṣveḍākilakilāśabdaiḥ śaṅakhavādyaravaistathā || vṛṣāṇāṃ yojayedyuddhaṃ gopālānāṃ tathaiva ca || 11 || dvitīye'hani dhenūnāṃ vṛṣāṇāṃ saha vatsakaiḥ || lavaṇaṃ tatpradātavyaṃ brāhmaṇenābhimantritama||12|| bhojanaṃ gorasaprāyaṃ brāhmaṇāṃścātra bhojayet || svasti vācyaṃ tataḥ paścāddattadāyānvisarjayeta || 1 3|| nityametattu vo diṣṭaṃ śāntikarma śubhaṃ gavām || ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi karma naimittikaṃ tava || 14 || dhenūnāṃ mārake prāpte tathā rogā'dyupadrave || kṣīrakṣaye tathānyasminprakṛtestu viparyaye || 15 || trirātropoṣito vidvānekarātroṣito'tha vā || gavāṃ madhye śubhe deśe sthaṇḍilaṃ parikalpayeta||16|| aṣṭapatraṃ likhetpadmaṃ karṇikākesarānvitam || pūjayetkarṇikāmadhye vāsudevaṃ śriyā saha || 17 || kṛsaraiḥ pūjana kāryaṃ devatānāṃ yathākramam || yāsāṃ tāsāṃ pravakṣyāmi tava nāmāni bhārgava || 18 || subhadrāṃ nāma digdhenuṃ pūrvabhāge samarcayet || pūjanīyastato brahmā surabhistadanantaram || || 19 || tataḥ sūryastato dhenurbahurūpā dvijottama || tatastu pṛthivīṃ devīṃ tato'nantaṃ prapūjayet || 20 || tataśca viśvarūpākṣaṃ digdhenuṃ tadanantaram || tataḥ siddhiṃ tato ṛddhiṃ tataḥ śāntiṃ samarcayet || 21 || rohiṇī nāma digdhenustataḥ pūjyā dvijottama || tataścandramasaṃ devaṃ mahādevavṛṣaṃ tataḥ || 22 || mahādevaṃ tato devaṃ pūjayettadanantaram || ityetā devatāḥ proktāḥ kṛsare tava ṣoḍaśa || 23 || patreṣu pūjanīyāśca dikpālāśca yathādiśam || gandhamālyanamaskāradhūpadīpānnasampadā || 24 || pratyekāṃ pūjayedrāma devatāṃ prayato dvijaḥ || pūrṇakumbhāni sarvāṇi pratyekaṃ vinivedayeta || 25 || bhaktyāsthagitavaktrāṇi vardhamānaissataṇḍulaiḥ || sahiraṇyairyathāśakti tato homaṃ samārabhet || 26 || vediṃ kṛtvā yathaśāstraṃ samidhya ca hutāśanam || ekaikaṃ daivataṃ rāma samuddiśya yathāvidhi || 27 || caturthyantena dharmajña nāmnā tu praṇavādinā || homadravyaistathaikaikaṃ śatasaṃkhyaṃ tu homayet || 28 || samidhaḥ kṣīravṛkṣasya akṣatāni tilām̐stathā || siddhārthakānyathājyaṃ ca pratyekaṃ juhuyātkramāt || 29 || tato rakṣohaṇairmantrairjuhuyādgaurasarṣapān || tataḥ samāpayedvidvānagnikarma yathāvidhi || 30 || suvarṇaṃ ca tathā kāṃsyaṃ dhenuṃ vastrayugaṃ tathā || karturdeyamupasraṣṭurvastrayugmaṃ gurostathā || 31 || bhojanaṃ gorasaprāyaṃ brāhmaṇāṃścātra bhojayet || svasti vācyaṃ tataḥ paścāddattadāyā dvijottamāḥ || 32 || rakṣohaṇaistathā mantraiḥ kuryurabhyukṣaṇaṃ gavām || gavāṃ ca pūjā kartavyā gandhamālyānulepanaiḥ || 33 || moktavyāśca tadā vatsā yathākāmaṃ dvijottama || śāntikarma gavāmetatsarvotpātapraśāntaye || 34 || kartavyaṃ bhṛguśārdūla paramaṃ karma dāruṇam || ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi kāmyaṃ karma tavānagha || 35 || kartā tūpavasettatra kārakaiśca tathaiva ca || pūrvabhādrapadāyogamāhirbudhnyagate tathā || 36 || snānaṃ niśākare kuryāddvitīye'hani śāstravit || udumbarasya patrāṇi pañcagavyaṃ kuśodakam || 37 || rocanāṃ ca samaṃgāṃ ca kṣipetkumbhadvaye tataḥ || kumbhadvayaṃ budhaḥ kuryādgandhamālyojjvalaṃ dṛḍham || 36 || akālamūlaṃ saṃsthāpya kartā tena tadā bhavet || snātvā govālacīrāṇi paridhāya samāhitaḥ || 39 || pūjayeccāpyahirbudhnyamādityaṃ ca tathaiva ca || varuṇaṃ ca śaśāṅkaṃ ca gandhamālyānnasampadā || || 40 || dhūpadīpanamaskāraistathaiva balikarmaṇā || akṣatānāṃ ca pātrāṇi tato rāma caturdaśa || 41 || ahirbudhnyāya rudrāya saphalāṃśca nivedayet|| khaṭvāṃgena tu dātavyaṃ tathā dhūpaṃ dvijottama || 42 || tatastu pūjā kartavyā devadevasya cakriṇaḥ || oṃkārapūrvamājyaṃ ca sarvāsāṃ juhuyāttataḥ || 43 || devatānāṃ yathoktānāmekaikasya śataṃśatam || govālaśaphaśṛṅgaiśca trivṛtaṃ kārayenmaṇim || 44 ||
