dhāraṇaṃ tasya kartavyaṃ kaṇṭhe mūrdhnyathavā bhuje || kartre caivopadraṣṭre ca śaktyā deyā ca dakṣiṇā || 45 || brāhmaṇānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ || alaṃghayanbhadrapadāmathāntyāṃ karoti yaḥ snānamidaṃ sadaiva || bhavanti tasyāyutaśaśca gāvaḥ parāmavāpnoti tathaiva vṛddhim || 46 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0 va0 saṃ0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne gavāṃ śāntikarma nāma catuścatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 44 || <2.45> puṣkara uvāca || rājñāṃ turaṅgamāyatto vijayo bhṛgunandana || tasmātsarvaṃ prayatnena turaṅgāṇāṃ samarjanam || 1 || rājñā yatnavatā bhāvyaṃ pālane ca viśeṣataḥ || tāvantasturagā dhāryā yāvatāṃ poṣaṇaṃ sukham || 2 || kartuṃ śakyaṃ na dhāryāste duḥkhitāḥ kṣudhitāstathā || duḥkhitāste śriyaṃ loke vinighnanti jayaṃ tathā || 3 || dhāraṇīyāḥ suvihitā vidhinā yavasāditāḥ|| vidhṛtāste tathā kuryurlokadvayajayaṃ tathā ||4|| maṅgalyāste pavitrāste rajasteṣāṃ tathaiva ca || kaivalyasyaiva te bhaktā devasya parameṣṭhinaḥ ||5|| anti madhye tathā tena nānujñātā divaukasām || tato'śvamedhaturagastasyaivaikasya hūyate || 6 || sarvaratnādhiko jātasturago'mṛtamanthanāt || uccaiḥśravāstena hayaḥ sarvaratnottamaḥ smṛtaḥ || 7 || sapakṣā devavāhyāste manuṣyāṇāmapakṣakāḥ || padmanā śālihotreṇa vāhanārthaṃ purā kṛtāḥ || 8 || nīrājayanti te deśānhreṣitairbalaśālinaḥ || gandharvāste vinirdiṣṭāḥ śriyaḥ putrā jitaśramāḥ || 9 || pradhānamaṃgaṃ sainyasya śobhā ca paramā hayāḥ || sudūragamane yuddhe yānaśreṣṭhāsturaṅgamāḥ || 10 || valgantamuccaisturagaṃ cāmarāpīḍadhāriṇam || āruhya yā bhavettuṣṭirna sā rāma triviṣṭape || 11 || sannaddhapuruṣārūḍhaiḥ susannaddhaisturaṅgamaiḥ || dṛṣṭairevārisainyasya patanti hṛdayānyalam || 12 || turaṅgapādoddhṛtadhūlidaṇḍaṃ yasyātapatrānukṛtiṃ karoti || nabhaḥ samagrā vasudhā tu tasya śailāvataṃsā bhavatīha vaśyā || 13 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0 va0 saṃ0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne aśvapraśaṃsā nāma pañcacatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 45 || <2.46> || puṣkara uvāca || || ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu teṣāṃ cikitsitam || vṛṣo nimba bṛhatyau ca guḍūcī ca samāṃsikā || 1 || śiṅghāṇakaharāpiṇḍī svedasya śirasastathā || yāvaśūkaṃ samadanaṃ pippalī viśvabheṣajam || 2 || sarṣapā gṛhadhūmaśca nirguṇḍī surasā vacā || nimbapatrayutā pāyau vartiḥ śūlavināśinī || 3 || hiṅgu puṣkaramūlaṃ ca nāgaraṃ sāmlavetasam || pippalī saindhavayutaṃ śūlaghnaṃ tūṣṇavāriṇā || 4 || nāgarātiviṣau mustā sānantā bilvamālakā || kvātho māsaṃ pibedvājī sarvātīsāranāśanam || 5 || priyaṃguśārivābhyāṃ ca yuktamājaṃ śṛtaṃ payaḥ || paryāptaśarkaraṃ pītvā śramādvājyavamucyate || 6 || droṇikāyāṃ tu dātavyā tailavastisturaṅgame || koṣṭhajāśca śirā vedhyāstena tasya sukhaṃ bhavet || 7 || dāḍimaṃ triphalāṃ vyoṣaṃ guḍaṃ ca samabhāgikam || piṇḍametatpradātavyamaśvānāṃ kāsanāśanam || 8 || priyaṅgurodhramadhubhiḥ pibanti sma rasaṃ hayāḥ || kṣīraṃ vāmaṃ ca kāloḍyaṃ kaśmalādvipramucyate || 9 || praskanneṣu ca sarveṣu śreya ādau viśoṣaṇam || abhyaṅgodvartanasnehanasyavartikramastataḥ || 2.46.10 || praskannaṃ praśamaṃ yāti yadi nānena karmaṇā || urasyupāntapārśve ca tato visrāvayecchirām || 11 || jvalitānāṃ turaṅgāṇāmayameva kriyākramaḥ || nasyamekaṃ vinā rāma sarvametatpraśasyate || 12 || rodhrakarañjayormūlaṃ mātuluṅgāgnināgarāḥ || kuṣṭhahiṅguvacārāsnālepo'yaṃ śophanāśanaḥ || 13 || samāsena śirāṃ vidhyāddeyā vāpi jalaukasaḥ || tryahetryahe vā dharmajña nasyakarma samācaret || 14 || mañjiṣṭhā madhukaṃ drākṣā bṛhatyau raktacandanam || trapusībījamūlāni śṛṅgāṭakakaśerukam || 15 || ajāpayaḥ śṛtamidaṃ suśītaṃ śarkarānvitam|| pītvā niraśano vājī raktamehātpramucyate || 16 || manyāhanunigālasthaḥ śiraḥśopho galagraha || abhyaṅgaḥ kaṭutailena tatra teṣveva śasyate || 17 || yavaiḥ snigdhakulatthaiśca tataḥ svedaṃ prayojayet || mṛdūkṛte tataḥ śophe nasyakarma samācaret ||18|| vacā…. saindhavaṃ svaraso rasaḥ || kṛṣṇāhiṅuyutairebhiḥ kṛtvā nasyaṃ na sīdati ||19|| niśā jyotiṣmatī pāṭhā kṛṣṇā kuṣṭhā vacā madhu || jihvāstambhe ca lepo'yaṃ guḍamūtrayuto hitaḥ || 2.46.20 || tilairyuktā rajanyā ca nimbapatraiśca yojitā || kṣaudreṇa śodhanī piṇḍī sarpiṣā vraṇaropiṇī || 21 || abhighātena khañjanti yenāśvāstīvravedanāḥ || pariṣekakriyā teṣāṃ tailenāśu rujāpahā ||22|| doṣakopābhighātābhyāṃ tilaje jṛmbhate sadā || śāntirmadhvājyabandhābhyāṃ pakvambhinne vraṇe kramaḥ || 23 || aśvatthodumbaraplakṣamadhūkavaṭakalkakaiḥ|| prabhūtasalilaḥ kvāthaḥ sukhoṣṇo vraṇaśodhanaḥ || 24 || śatāhvā nāgaraṃ rāsnā mañjiṣṭhākuṣṭhasaindhavaiḥ || devadāruvacāyugmarajanīraktacandanaiḥ || 25 || tailaṃ siddhaṃ kaṣāyeṇa guḍūcyā payasā saha || prakṣīṇe vastinasye ca yojyaṃ sarvatra laṃghane || 26 || raktasrāvo jalaukābhirnetrānte netrarogiṇaḥ || khadirodumbarāśvatthakaṣāyeṇa ca dhāvanam || 27 || dhātrīdurālabhātiktā priyaṅgukuṅkumaiḥ samaiḥ || guḍūcyā kṛtakaḥ kalko hitamuṣṇāvalambite || || 28 || upānte ca śirāsrāve muṣkaśophe tathaiva ca || kṣiprakāriṇi doṣe ca sadyo vedhanamiṣyate || 29 || gośakṛtsarjikākuṣṭharajanītilasarṣapaiḥ || gavāṃ mūtreṇa piṣṭaiśca mardanaṃ kaṇḍunāśanam || 2.46.30 || sitāmadhuyutaḥ kvātho vāśikāyāḥ saśarkaraḥ || raktapittaharaḥ pānādaśvakarṇāttathaiva ca || 31 || āme pariṇate pakvaṃ pakvamāṃse jarāṃ gate || pakvamāṃsayutaṃ neṣṭaṃ sarvaṃ jīrṇaṃ praśasyate || 32 || saptamesaptame deyamaśvānāṃ lavaṇaṃ dine || tathā bhuktavatāṃ deyā paripāne tu vāruṇī || 33 || jīvanīyaiḥ sumadhurairmṛdvīkāśarkarāyutaiḥ || sapippalīkaiḥ śaradi pratimānaṃ sapadmakam || 34 || viḍaṅgapippalīdhānyāśatāhvā rodhrasaindhavaiḥ || sāvitrakaisturaṅgāṇāṃ pratipānaṃ himāgame || 35 ||| rodhraṃ priyaṅgukā rāsnā pippalīviśvabheṣajaiḥ || sakṣaudraiḥ pratipānaṃ syādvasante kaphanāśanam || 36 || priyaṅgupippalīraudrayaṣṭyāhvaiḥ samahauṣadhaiḥ || nidāghe saguḍā deyā madirāpratipānake || 37 || bhadrakāṣṭhā salavaṇaṃ pippalyā viśvabheṣajam || bhavettailayutairebhiḥ pratipānaṃ ghanāgame || 38 || nidāghāvṛtapittānāṃ kṣaranmadoṣṇaśoṇitāḥ || prāvṛḍbhinnapurīṣāśca pibeyurvājino ghṛtam || 39 || pibeyurvājinastailaṃ kaphavāyvadhikāstu ye || snehavyāpadbhavedyeṣāṃ teṣāṃ kāryaṃ virūkṣaṇam || 2.46.40 || tryahaṃ yavāgū rūkṣā syātsurā ca lavaṇānvitā || bhojane takrasaṃyuktaṃ hyeṣa vai rūkṣaṇe vidhiḥ || 41 || prāyogikastathā deyo vastistasya niratyayaḥ || ye pibanti hayāḥ snehaṃ teṣāṃ vastiṃ na dāpayet || 42 || śarannidāghayoḥ sarpistailaṃ śītavasantayoḥ || varṣāsu śiśire caiva vastau deyamiheṣyate || 43 || gurvabhiṣyandibhaktāni vyāyāmaḥ snānamātapam || pāyurvastaṃ ca vāhasya snehapīḍasya varjitam|| 44 || snānaṃ pānaṃ sakṛddṛṣṭamaśvānāṃ salilāgame || atyarthadurdine kāle snānamekaṃ praśasyate || 45 || yuktaśītātape kāle dviḥ pānaṃ lavaṇaṃ sakṛt || grīṣme triḥ snānapānaṃ syācciraṃ tasyāvagāhanam || 46 || nistuṣāṇāṃ pradātavyaṃ yavānāṃ caturāḍhakam || vavarṇavrīhimaudālākalanāṃ vāpi dāpayet || 47 || ahorātreṇa cāndrasya yavasasya tulā daśa || aṣṭau śuṣkasya dātavyāścatasro'tha busasya vā || 48 || dūrvā pittaṃ busaḥ kārśyaṃ tadbusaḥ śleṣmasañcayam || nāśayatyarjunaḥ śvāsaṃ tathā māṣo balakṣayam || 49 || vātikāḥ paittikāścaiva śleṣmajāḥ sānnipātikāḥ || na rogāḥ pīḍayiṣyanti dūrvāhāraṃ turaṅgamam || 2.46.50|| dvau rajjubandhau duṣṭānāṃ pakṣayorubhayorapi || paścādbandhaśca kartavyo harakīlavyapāśrayaḥ || 51 || keśānurūpamāsyasya keśapucchaprakalpanam || chedaḥ khurapravṛddhau ca varjayettu kanīnikām || 52 || yatnopanyastayavasaḥ kṛtadhūpanabhūmayaḥ || vaseyuḥ sambhṛte sthāne pradīpaiḥ sārvarātrikaiḥ || 53 || śākhāmṛgojāḥ kṛkavākavaśca dhāryāśca śālāsu tathaiva dhenuḥ || kuryurniśīthe puruṣāḥ saśastrāḥ saṃrakṣaṇaṃ rāma turaṅgamāṇām || 54 || || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0 saṃ0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne aśvacikitsā nāma ṣaṭcatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 46 || || cha || <2.47> || puṣkara uvāca || || nityaṃ naimittikaṃ kāmyaṃ śāntikarma nibodha me || pañcamīṣu ca sarvāsu śrīdharaṃ pūjayedbhṛśam ||1|| śriyaśca pūjanaṃ kāryaṃ hayarājñastathaiva va || rāmoccaiḥśravaso nityaṃ gandhamālyānulepanaiḥ || || 2 || dhūpadīpanamaskāraistathā caivānnasampadā || śaradvasantayoḥ kāryamekadantasya pūjanam || 3 || pratipatpañcamī ṣaṣṭhī saptamī dvādaśī tathā || praśastāstithayo rāma sūryavāro viśeṣataḥ || 4 || kṛttikāṃ rohiṇīṃ bhāgyaṃ cāryamṇamaśvinīṃ tathā || tvāṣṭraṃ sāvitramādityaṃ vāyavyaṃ ca bhṛgūttama || || 5 || nakṣatrāṇi praśastāni śuklapakṣastathaiva ca || udyāneṣu vicitreṣu nadīnāṃ pulineṣu ca || 6 || devatāyatanaṃ rāma pūjanaṃ tasya kārayet || arghadhūpanamaskāradīpapuṣpānnasampadā || 7 || kulmāṣollopikābhakṣyamadyamāṃsasurāsavaiḥ || odanaiḥ paramānnena phalaiḥ kālodbhavaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 8 || nṛtya gītena vādyena śaṅkhaśabdaistathaiva ca || sāvitraiśca tathaivājyaṃ juhuyājjātavedasi || 9 || oṃkārapūrvaṃ ca tathā revantāya punaḥpunaḥ || dvijātipūjanaṃ kāryaṃ mālyamodakacandanaiḥ || 2.47.10 || dakṣiṇābhiśca dharmajña yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ || nārīṣu varjayetsarvaṃ revantasya niveditam || 11 || evaṃ sampūjito dadyātturaṅgamaśatānyapi || balaṃ tejastathārogyaṃ turaṅgāṇāṃ ca bhārgava || 12|| aśvayukśuklapakṣasya pañcadaśyāṃ narottama || turaṅgamāṇāṃ kartavyaṃ śāntikaṃ tannibodha me||13|| digīśānīṃ viniṣkṛṣya grāmāddeśe manorame|| prāgudakpravaṇe rāma sthaṇḍilaṃ parikalpayet ||14|| nāsatyau varuṇaṃ devaṃ tathaivāśvayuje dvija || pūjayetprayato vidvāngandhamālyānulepanaiḥ||15|| dhūpairdīpairnamaskāraistathā cānnena bhūriṇā || samullikhya tato vediṃ śākhābhiḥ parivārayet ||16|| samantatastathārdrābhirvastraiścāpyahataistathā || ghaṭānsarvarasaiḥ pūrṇāndikṣu dadyādyathāvidhi ||17|| vidikṣu ca tathā dadyāddhvajacchatrāṇi buddhimān || tataḥ samupadhāyāgniṃ jayaprabhṛtibhiḥ punaḥ || 18|| hutvoktadevatāliṅgairmantraiśca juhuyādghṛtam || tataḥ sampūjanīyāstu gandhamālyaisturaṅgamā ||19|| sannaddhapuruṣārūḍhāḥ susannaddhāsturaṅgamāḥ || sāyudhaiḥ puruṣaiḥ sārdhaṃ vahniṃ kuryuḥ pradakṣiṇam ||2.47.20|| triḥ parikrāmato vahniṃ kṣveḍotkṛṣṭanināditaiḥ || śaṅkhavādyaravonmiśrairnetavyāḥ svagṛhaṃ tataḥ || 21 || rasāni tāni vāsāṃsi gauḥ kāṃsyaṃ kanakaṃ tathā || dakṣiṇāyai pradātavyaṃ karturdvijavarottama || 22 || karmaṇānena bhavati prabhūtaṃ rāma vāhanam || hṛṣṭapuṣṭaṃ ca dharmajña gadāmayavivarjitam || 23 || nityametattavoddiṣṭaṃ śṛṇu naimittikaṃ tathā || aśvānāṃ mārake prāpte vyādhau vāpyatidāruṇe || 24 || prakṛteśca viparyāse tathā bhṛgukulodbhava || hayacāre śubhe deśe sthaṇḍilaṃ parikalpayet || 25 || vinyasetkamalaṃ tatra tanmadhye pūjayeddharim || śriyaṃ ca devīṃ tatraiva kesareṣu ca devatāḥ || 26 || brahmāṇaṃ śaṅkaraṃ somamādityaṃ ca tathāśvinau || revantamuccaiḥśravasaṃ dikpālām̐śca daleṣvapi || 27 || sarveṣāṃ pūjanaṃ kāryaṃ gandhadhūpānnasampadā || dīpamālyanamaskārapuṣpairmūlaiḥ sagorasaiḥ||28|| pratyekaṃ pūrṇakumbhaiśca gandhamālyādyalaṅkṛtaiḥ || tathā piśitavastraiśca vardhamānaiḥ sataṇḍulaiḥ || 29 || tathā pratisarāsūtraiḥ patākābhiśca bhārgava || tasyai vottarato vediṃ kalpayitvā yathāvidhi || 2.47.30 || tataḥ samupadhāyāgniṃ yathoktānāṃ pṛthakpṛthak || tato'gnihavanasyānu kāṃsyaṃ gāṃ kāñcanaṃ tathā || 31 || deyaṃ vastrayugaṃ kartre kārayitre tathaiva ca || karmaitatsarvarogaghnaṃ sarvabādhāvināśanam || 32 || upoṣitena kartavyaṃ brāhmaṇena yathāvidhi || upoṣitastadā tiṣṭhedyajamāno'pi bhārgava || 33 || ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi kāmyaṃ karma tavānagha || upoṣitau sadā pauṣṇe yajamānapurohitau ||34|| aśvinarkṣe sadā snānaṃ kuryuryanme nibodhata || akālamūlau dvau kumbhau madhūkakusumotkaṭau || 35 || aśvagandhāyutau kṛtvā snāpyastābhyāṃ tadā bhavet || uttamaṃ pūjayedvidvānnāsatyau śaśinaṃ tathā || 36 || aśvinau varuṇaṃ caiva śuklavāsāstathā harim || gandhamālyanamaskāradhūpadīpānnasampadā || 37 || tato'śvamithunaṃ kāryaṃ sarvauṣadhiyutaṃ mṛdā || praṇatena tato vidvānnāsatyābhyāṃ nivedayet || 38 || dhūpamaśvaśaphaṃ dadyāddaivatānāṃ tathaiva ca || yathoktānāṃ dvijaśreṣṭha juhuyācca pṛthakpṛthak || 39 || caturthyantena nāmnā tu praṇavādyena bhārgava || svāhāntenātha śataśo mantrapūtaṃ ghṛtaṃ dvija || 2.47.40 || aśvaloma tathā dhāryaṃ phalamūle tathaiva ca || ekatra trivṛtaṃ kṛtvā maṇirdhāryastu pūrvavat || 41 || alaṃghayannaśvinatiṃ sadaiva snānaṃ ca kuryātprayatā manuṣyaḥ || aśvānavāpnoti sahasrasaṃkhyānkulodbhavānvīryabalopapannān ||42|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0 saṃ0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne aśvānāṃ śāntikarmavidhānannāma saptacatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ||47|| <2.48> puṣkara uvāca || kuñjarāḥ paramā śobhā śibirasya balasya ca|| āyāti kuñjareṣveva vijayaḥ pṛthivīkṣitām || 1 || teṣāṃ saṃmārjane yatnaṃ pālane ca bhṛgūttama || yathāvannṛpatiḥ kuryādgandharvāḥ kuñjarā matāḥ ||2|| jayantāśca tathā dhāryā yāvatāṃ poṣaṇaṃ sukham || kartuṃ śakyaṃ na dhāryāste kṣudhitā duḥkhitāstathā || 3 || duḥkhitāste nṛṇāṃ hanyuḥ kulāni ca bhṛgūttama || tasmātteṣāṃ sukhaṃ kāryaṃ yaśaḥśrīvijayapradam || 4 || sannaddhapuruṣārūḍhaiḥ susannaddhaisturaṅgamaiḥ || analpairapi yadyuktaṃ balaṃ parabalapraṇut || 5||| tadaikasyāpi samare kuñjarasya savarmaṇaḥ || na śakyaṃ pramukhe sthātuṃ vegādāpatato dvija ||6|| abhinnānāṃ tu saṃghānāṃ saṃhṛtānāṃ ca bhedanam || ekaḥ kruddho raṇe kuryātkuñjaraḥ sādhu coditaḥ ||7|| madaklinnakapolasya kiñcidañcitacakṣuṣaḥ || bṛhadābhogaśuṇḍasya kaḥ śobhāṃ kathituṃ kṣamaḥ ||8|| vegena dhāvamānasya prasāritakarasya ca || kaḥ samarthaḥ puraḥ sthātuṃ stabdhakarṇasya dantinaḥ ||9|| yasya phūtkāramātreṇa turaṅgamaśatānyapi|| svārūḍhānyapi vegena vidravanti diśo daśa||2.48.10|| tatsainyaṃ kuñjarā yatra sa nṛpo yasya kuñjarāḥ | mūrtimānvijayo rāma kuñjarā madagarvitāḥ || 11 || sapakṣā devavāhyāste manujānāṃ tvapakṣakāḥ || vāhanārthaṃ kṛtā rāma svayameva tu vedhasā ||12|| dṛṣṭvā patākābhiralaṃkṛtaṃ tu nāgendrasainyaṃ prabalaṃ yathādrim|| patanti śīghraṃ hṛdayānyarīṇāṃ tasmātpradhānāḥ satataṃ gajendrāḥ 13 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0 saṃ0 gajapraśaṃsā nāmāṣṭacatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ||48|| <2.49> puṣkara uvāca || ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi kuñjarāṇāṃ cikitsitam || pākaleṣu tu sarveṣu kartavyamanuvāsaram || 1 || ghṛtatailaparīṣekaḥ sthānaṃ vātavivarjitam || skandheṣu ca tathā kāryā kriyā pākalavaddvija ||2|| gomūtraṃ pāṇḍuroge tu rajanībhiryutaṃ hitam || ānāhe tailasiktasya nivātasthaṃ praśasyate ||3|| lavaṇaiḥ pañcabhirmiśrā pratipānāya vāruṇī || viḍaṅgatriphalāvyoṣasaindhavaiḥ kavalāḥ kṛtāḥ ||4|| mūrcchāsvabhojayennāgaṃ kṣaudratoyaṃ tu pāyayet || abhyaṅgaḥ śirasaḥ kāryo nasyaścaiva praśasyate || 5 || nāgānāṃ snehakaṭukaiḥ pādarogānupakramet || pañcakalkakaṣāyeṇa śodhanaṃ ca vidhīyate || 6 || .......mandanaṃ kāryaṃ mṛdusnigdhaṃ ca bhojayet || śikhitittiralāvānāṃ pippalīmaricānvitaiḥ || 7 || rasaiḥ sambhojayennāgaṃ vepadhuryasya jāyate || bālabilvaṃ tathā rodhraṃ dhātukīṃ vituṣā saha ||8|| atīsāravināśāya piṇḍaṃ bhuñjīta kuñjaraḥ|| nasyaṃ karagrahe deyaṃ ghṛtaṃ lavaṇasaṃyutam ||9|| māgadhī maricāḍhyā ca yavāgurmastusādhitaḥ|| tatkarṇake ca dātavyaṃ vārāhaṃ ca tathā rasam||2.49.10|| daśamūlakulatthāmla kākamācī vipācitam|| tailamūṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ galagrahagadāpaham ||11|| aṣṭabhirlavaṇaiḥ piṣṭaiḥ prasannāṃ pāyayedyutām || mūtrasaṃghe'thavā bījaṃ kvathitaṃ trapusasya ca || 12 || tvagdoṣeṣu pibennimbaṃ vṛṣaṃ vā kvathitaṃ dvipaḥ || gavāṃ mūtraṃ viḍaṅgāni kṛmidoṣeṣu śasyate || 13 || śṛṅgaberakaṇādrākṣāśarkarābhiḥ śṛtaṃ payaḥ || kṣatakṣayaharaṃ pānāttathā māṃsarasaḥ śubhaḥ || 14 || mudgodanaṃ vyoṣayutaṃ hyarucau ca praśasyate || droṇikāśāntaye yūṣaṃ paṭolīnimbadurgajam || 15 || trivṛdyoṣāgnidantyarkaśyāmakṣīrebhapippalī || eṣa gulmaharaḥ snehaḥ kṛtaścaiva tathāsavaḥ || 16 || kṣīravṛkṣanadījambumallakīnāṃ tvacaḥ śubhāḥ || hṛdrogaśāntaye deyā vidāryaśca rasodanāt || 17 || bhedanaśrāvāṇabhyaṅgasnehapānānuvāsanaiḥ || sarvāneva samutpannānvidravetsamupācaret || 18 || yaṣṭikaṃ mudgayūṣeṇa śāradeṣu tathā pibet || bālabilvaistathā lepaḥ kaṭirogeṣu śasyate || 19 || viḍaṃgendrayavā hiṅgusaralaṃ rajanīdvayam || pūrvāhṇe dāpayetpiṇḍaṃ sarvaśūlopaśāntaye || 2.49.20 || bhāreṇa calitaṃ dantaṃ kuñjarasya samuddharet || pradhānā bhojane teṣāṃ yaṣṭikāvrīhiśālayaḥ || 21 || madhyamau yavagodhūmau śeṣāḥ pratyavarāḥ smṛtāḥ || vidhau yoge prayatnena dagdhikāṃ tu vivarjayet || 22 || yavaseṣu tathaivekṣurnāgānāṃ balavardhanam || nāgānāṃ yavasaṃ śuṣkaṃ kaphavātaprakopanam || 23 || madakṣīṇasya nāgasya payaḥpānaṃ praśasyate || jīvanīyaistathā dravyaiḥ śṛto māṃsarasaḥ śubhaḥ || 24 || madavṛddhikarānyogānvakṣyāmyahamataḥ param || raṇakāle samāpanne yānrājā saṃprayojayet || 25 || vāyasaḥ kuravaścobhau kākolī nākulī hariḥ || bhavetkṣaudreṇa saṃyuktaḥ piṇḍaḥ sadyaḥ prabhedanaḥ || 26 || jātibhaṃgaṃ samūlaśca kapotatvaktatheṅgudī || aśvasārakabhaṅgaśca piṇḍo'yamaparastathā || 27 || ajaśṛṅgyarkamūlābhyāṃ sakuñjamadhusaṃyutaḥ || madhumiśropyayaṃ piṇḍaḥ puṣpamūlaphalānvitaḥ || 28 || yuddhakāle'tra nāgasya kartavyā madavardhinī || kaṭumatsyā viḍaṅgāni kṣāraḥ kośātakī payaḥ || 29 || haridrā ceti dhūpo'yaṃ kuñjarasya jayāvahaḥ || pippalyaḥ śvetalaśunaṃ haritālaṃ manaḥśilā || 2.49.30 || aśvamūtroṣito dhūpaḥ syātsūryapariśoṣitaḥ || mārdvīkaṃ kaṭumatsyāśca tathā kaṭukarohiṇī||31|| ābhayaṃ ca trayaḥ śailaṃ dhūpo'yamaparaḥ śubhaḥ || agnikaḥ sarvavarṇaśca pīlurityeṣa dīpanaḥ||32|| pradeyaḥ kavalo yuddhe manuṣyāsthipradhūpitaḥ || jīrṇe vidhāno deyaḥ syātpiṇḍaśca tṛṭkṣayaṅkaraḥ ||33|| pippalī taṇḍulastailaṃ mārdvīkaṃ mākṣikaṃ tathā || netrayoḥ pariṣeko'yaṃ dīpanīyaḥ praśasyate || 34 || purīṣaṃ vṛścikāyāśca tathā pārāvatasya ca || kṣīravṛkṣakarīrāśca prapannāviṣṭamañjanam || 35 || anenāñjitanetrastu karoti kadanaṃ raṇe || utpalāni ca nīlāni mustaṃ tagarameva ca || 36 || taṇḍulodakapiṣṭāni netranirvāpaṇaṃ param || pravṛddhaye nadījānāṃ pañcame'bde vanaukasām || 37 || dantamūlaparīṇāhādviguṇātkalpayetparam || vanevṛddhairnnave cchedaḥ kartavyaśca tadā bhavet || 38|| śayyāsthānaṃ bhaveccāsya karīṣaiḥ pāṃsubhistathā || tailāvasekaḥ śīte syānmāsimāsi tathaiva ca || 39 || śarannidāghayoḥ sekaḥ sarpiṣā ca tatheṣyate || rājyadvipādabhyadhikāṃ tu śobhāṃ nāgasya cānyasya na jātu kuryāt || śobhāvidhānaṃ tvadhikaṃ sadaiva rājyadvipasyaiva nṛpastu kuryāt || 2.49.40 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0saṃ0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne hasticikitsā nāmaikonapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 49 || <2.50> puṣkara uvāca || ataḥ paraṃ tu nāgānāṃ śāntikarma nibodha me || nityaṃ naimittikaṃ kāmyaṃ yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ || 1 || pañcamīṣu ca śuklāsu vāsudevasya pūjanam || śriyaśca rāma kartavyaṃ nāgasyairāvaṇasya ca || 2 || gandhamālyanamaskāradhūpadīpānnasampadā || tathā ca kṛṣṇapakṣānte māsimāsi dvijottama || 3 || bhūtejyā satataṃ kāryā tilamāṃsapayoguḍaiḥ || matsyaiḥ pakvāmiṣairbhakṣyaiḥ sumanobhiśca bhārgava || 4 || catuṣpatheṣu rathyāsu tathā śūnyagṛheṣu ca || eka vṛkṣaśmaśāneṣu gopurāṭṭālakeṣu ca || 5 || saṅgameṣu nadīnāṃ ca parvatānāṃ guhāsu ca || trikaṇṭakeṣu mukhyeṣu śūnyadevagṛheṣu ca || 6 || śuklapakṣāvasāneṣu devatejyā vidhīyate || gajasthānottare bhāge prāgudakpravaṇe śubhe || 7 || brahmāṇaṃ śaṅkaraṃ viṣṇuṃ śakraṃ vaiśravaṇaṃ yamam || candrārkau varuṇaṃ vāyuṃ tvagniṃ pṛthvīṃ tathā khagam || 8 || śeṣaṃ ca nāgarājaṃ tu bhūdharām̐ścaiva kuñjarān || virūpākṣaṃ mahāpadmaṃ bhadraṃ sumanasaṃ tathā || 9 || aṣṭau ca diggajā ye vai te smṛtā devayonayaḥ || kumadairāvaṇau padmaḥ puṣpadanto'tha vāmanaḥ || 2.50.10 || supratīkāñjanau nīla ete'ṣṭau devayonayaḥ || yathoktānāṃ sukartavyaṃ pūjanaṃ vai pṛthakpṛthak || 11 || gandhamālyanamaskāradhūpadīpānnasampadā || oṃkārapūtenājyena tathāgnihavanaṃ bhavet || 12 || pṛthakpṛthak ca sarveṣāṃ caturthyantaiśca nāmabhiḥ || dakṣiṇābhistato rāma brāhmaṇānsvasti vācayet || 13 || tataḥ śāntyudakaṃ kṛtvā mantrai rakṣohaṇairdvipān || abhyukṣayetkuśāgreṇa pūjyāste ca tathā tadā || 14 || ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi karma naimittikaṃ tava || gajānāṃ maraṇe prāpte tathā vyādhau ca dāruṇe || 19 || dantacchedāśubhotpattau mṛte gajadvipe tathā || dantabhaṅge tathā jāte vā supakṣamṛte gaje || 16 || kṛṣṇapakṣe mṛte nāge vahnipṛṣṭhe mṛte tathā || dāruṇāsu ca velāsu dakṣiṇāparamūrdhani || 17 || hastinyātha made jāte prakṛteśca viparyaye || pūrvottare ca digbhāge nagarātsumanohare || 18 || snigdhaprāśana toyeṣu drumavītavanaspatau || prāgudakpravaṇaṃ rāma sthaṇḍilaṃ parikalpayet || 19 || kamalaṃ vinyasettatra karṇikākamale harim || śriyaṃ ca vinyasettatra kesareṣu ca vinyaset || 2.50.20 || brahmāṇaṃ bhārgavaṃ pṛthvīṃ tathā skandaṃ ca bhārgava || anantaṃ khaṃ śivaṃ somaṃ sarvāṇyetāni bhārgava || 21 || daleṣu tatra dikpālānvinyasetsaha kuñjaraiḥ || patrāntareṣu cāstrāṇi yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ || 22 || vajraṃ tu vinyaseddhīmānśakrapatrādanantaram || tataścakraṃ tato daṇḍaṃ toraṇaṃ tadanantaram || 23 || tataśca vinyasetpāśaṃ tomaraṃ saśaraṃ dhanuḥ || tato gadāṃ mahābhāga tataḥ śūlaṃ ca vinyaset || 24 || padmañca sāntaradalaṃ vṛttayā lekhayā bhajet || ādityaiḥ saha nāsatyau tataḥ pūrveṇa vinyaset || 25 || vasūnagnidiśābhāge sādhyānyāmye ca vinyaseta || tathā ca nairṛte bhāge devānaṅgiraso nyaset || 26 || paścime bhṛgavo bhāge vāyavye marutastathā || viśvedevāstathodak ca rudrāñśivadiśi nyaset || 27 || kṛtvaitaddevatānyāsaṃ vṛttayā rekhayā bhajet || bāhyena vinyasettasyāḥ sūtrakārānṝṣīndvija || 28 || pūrveṇa rāma yāmyena tathā devīṃ sarasvatīm || nadīḥ paścimataḥ śailāṃstathodagbhṛgunandana||29|| mahābhūtāni vedīṣu koṇahastagatāni tu|| padmaṃ cakraṃ gadāṃ śaṅkhamīśānyādiṣu vinyaset|| | || 2.50.30 || caturasraṃ tathā kāryaṃ caturdvāraṃ ca maṇḍalam || pramāṇaṃ maṇḍalasyātra bhavedbhūmivaśāttathā || vidikṣu pūrṇakalaśānpūrṇapātrayutānnyaseta || 31 ||| saptahasteṣu daṇḍeṣu patākāśca tathā nyaset || sitā raktāḥ sitāḥ pītā yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ || dikṣu toraṇavinyāsaṃ toraṇānāṃ ca veṣṭanam || 32 || kṣīravṛkṣadrumadalaiḥ kusumaiḥ saphalairbhavet || toraṇasya pramāṇaṃ ca ṣaḍḍhastaṃ parikīrtitam || 33 || ucchrāyeṇa tathā yāmājjñeyaṃ rāma samadvayam || tārkṣyaṃ tālaṃ ca makaraṃ ṛṣyaṃ caivānupūrvaśaḥ || 34 || toraṇopari madhye tu dānavānviniveśayet || karṇakairlakṣaṇopetānvinyaseddevatāgaṇān || 35 || sāyudhānsapatākām̐śca sātapatraṃ śatakratum || diggajānāṃ ca vinyāsamoṣadhībhiḥ prakalpayet || 36 || airāvaṇaṃ dale śakre lājābhirvinyasedbudhaḥ || nāgaṃ puṣpamayaṃ padmamāgneye vinyaseddale || 37 || puṣpadantastathā yāmye nāgaḥ kāryaḥ priyaṃgubhiḥ || tathā ca nairṛte bhāge nāgaḥ puṣpeṇa vāmanaḥ ||| || 38 || vāyavye cāñjanaṃ patre māṣaiḥ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ || nīlaśca patre kaubere śatapuṣpāmayo bhavet || 39 || aiśānye kumudaṃ kuryānnāgendraṃ sitatandulaiḥ || tatastu pūjanaṃ kāryaṃ sopavāsena bhārgava || 2.50.40 || jitendriyeṇa dāntena śiraḥsnātena cāpyatha || śuklavastrāvṛtenāpi soṣṇīṣeṇa tathaiva ca || 41 || kāñcanālaṃkṛtenāpi sapavitreṇa bhārgava || sarvāsāṃ pūjanaṃ kuryāddevatānāṃ pṛthakpṛthaka || 42 || astrāṇāṃ kuñjarāṇāṃ ca padmādīnāṃ tathaiva ca || toraṇe tu niviṣṭānāṃ tārkṣyādīnāṃ pṛthakpṛthak || 43 || sāgarāṇāṃ tu kumbheṣu gandhamālyānulepanaiḥ || dhūpairdīpairnamaskārairvāsobhiśca pṛthakpṛthak || 44 || tathā pratisarābhiśca bhūṣaṇaiśca pṛthakpṛthak || bhūriṇā ca tathānnena pānaiśca vividhaistathā || 45 || kulmāṣaparamānnābhyāṃ pūjyāste kṛsareṇa ca || bhūdakollopikābhakṣyaiḥ sitayā guḍaphāṇitaiḥ || 46 || māsaudanapayaḥkṣaudradadhipāyasasaktubhiḥ || apūpaphalamūlānnarāgakhaṇḍavakairdalaiḥ || 47 || evaṃ sampūjanaṃ kṛttvā śaṅkhavādyaravairdvija || gītena ca mahābhāga subhagānartitena ca || 48 || tatastu pūjanaṃ kṛtvā pūjāsthānāttathāpyudak|| āhitāgnikulādagniṃ vedimullikhya bodhayet || 49 || devatānāṃ tu sarvāsāmekaikaṃ tu pṛthakpṛthak || caturthyantena nāmnā tu praṇavādyena bhārgava || 2.50.50 || śatamājyena juhayānmahāvyāhṛtayastathā || tatastu pūjitā nāgā vahniṃ devagaṇāndvijān||51|| kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ sarve vrajeyuḥ svagṛhāṇi te || upadraṣṭre tathā kartre sarvaṃ tatra nivedayet ||52|| bhavenniṣkaṃ ca niṣkaṃ ca dhenudhenuṃ bhuvaṃbhuvam || aśvamaśvaṃ tathānyā ca dakṣiṇā śaktito bhavet || 53 || na bhavetsā mahādroṇā kathañcidapi kasyacit || tathā ca hastibhiṣajā pravṛttena ca bhūriṇā || 54 || pūjanīyau tathaivātra sāṃvatsara purohitau || hastinyāṃ madamattāyāṃ śāntike'smindvijottama || 55 || rāṣṭrānnirvāsya tāṃ kuryācchāntimetāṃ dvijottama || nāgarājñi mṛte kṛtvā tatraivānyaṃ mataṅgajam || 56 || snātaṃ sarvauṣadhairnāgaṃ sarvagandhaistathaiva ca || sarvabījaiśca ratnaiśca sarvatīrthajalaistathā || 57 || āhatāmbarasaṃvītadarśanaṃ śvetalakṣaṇam || kāñcanāpīḍite vādyagītapuṇyāhanisvanaiḥ || 58 || arcitaṃ daivato vahniṃ kṛtaviprapradakṣiṇam || kariṇīṃ tu samāruhya vadetkarṇe tu kālavit || 59 || śrīgajastvatkṛte rājā bhavasvāsya gajāgraṇīḥ || gandhamālyāgrabhaktaistvāṃ pūjayiṣyati pārthivaḥ || 2.50.60 || lokastadājñayā pūjāṃ kariṣyati tathānagha || pālanīyastvayā rājā ghorayuddhe tathāhave || 61 || tiryagbhāvaṃ samutsṛjya divyaṃ bhāvamanusmara || devāsurāṇāṃ yuddhe ca śrīgajastridaśaiḥ kṛtaḥ || 62 || airāvaṇasutaḥ śrīmānariṣṭo nāma rāvaṇaḥ || śrīgajānāṃ tu tattejaḥ sarvamevātra tiṣṭhati || 63 || tattejastava nāgendra divyabhāgasamanvitam || upatiṣṭhatu bhadraṃ te rakṣa rājānamāhave || 64 || ityevamabhiṣiktvena śubhe'hani narādhipaḥ || nityaṃ caivāsya kartavyaṃ brāhmaṇaiḥ svastivācanam || 65 || tasyānugamanaṃ kuryuḥ śastrahastāśca mānavāḥ || sitavarṇaśca kartavyo rājñaḥ puṇyāhakarmasu || 66 || etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ gajānāṃ śāntikarmasu || nakṣatrāṇi praśastāni tithayaśca tathā śṛṇu || 67 || caturdaśīṃ caturthīṃ ca navamīṃ ca vivarjayet || aṅgārakadine rāma dinaṃ bhāskarajasya ca || 68 || ṛkṣāṇi vaiṣṇavaṃ tvāṣṭraṃ śasyate śakradaivatam || nakṣatrāṇi muhūrtāśca eta eva mahābala || 69 || deśakālopasampannaṃ vidhinā ca tathā kṛtam || śāntikarma gajendrāṇāṃ sarvabādhāvināśanam || 2.50.70 || dhanyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ rājñāṃ ca vijayāvaham || bhārgavaścyavanaḥ kruddho yathā śakrasya bhārgava || 71 || mado nāma samutpannastathā daityaḥ sudāruṇaḥ || indranāśāya śakrārthī tataḥ paścātprasāditaḥ || 72 || madaṃ sa bahudhā cakre prajāpatisamo dvija || strīṣvakṣeṣu tathā pāne mṛgayāyāṃ dhane tathā || 73 || vidyāsu caiva sarvāsu sarvaśilpeṣu cāpyatha || jīveṣu rāma sarveṣu tathā rūpe bale kule || 74 || eko'sya dhāraṇe śakto na kaściditicintayan || yathokteṣvadhikaṃ bhāgaṃ kiñcitpāne niveśayet || 75 || prāṇināmatha sarveṣāṃ nāgeṣvabhyadhikaṃ tathā || mado yadā samabhyeti nāgaṃ brāhmaṇasattama || 76 || rāma śāntistadā kāryā yādṛśī tāṃ nibodha me || śālāprāguttare bhāge sthaṇḍilaṃ kalpayedbudhaḥ || 77 || sthaṇḍile kamalaṃ kṛtvā dikpatreṣu tatheśvarān || kesaraṃ cyavanaṃ nāgānbhuvaṃ kaṃ ca sarasvatīm || 78 || pūjayeḍḍiṇḍimaṃ madhye gandhamālyānulepanaiḥ || dhūpadīpanamaskārairvāsobhiśca pṛthakpṛthak || 79 || sarvāsāṃ pūjanaṃ kṛtvā pādyādyanurato dvija || devatānāṃ ghṛtaṃ hutvā yathāśraddhamaninditam|| 2.50.80 rasapūrṇo ghaṭo deyo dakṣiṇārthe ca kāñcanam || dattvā vāsāṃsi nāgasya gajādhyakṣaṃ ca pūjayet || 81 || hastipaṃ karmiṇaścānyāndakṣiṇābhirdvijottamān || sāṃvatsare ca vittena yataḥ sāṃvatsaraḥ svayam||82|| gajādhyakṣāya taṃ dadyāddiṇḍimaṃ prayataḥ svayam|| prāṅmukhaśca gajādhyakṣo vādayettaṃ yathāvidhi || 83 || uccairgambhīranirghoṣe ḍiṇḍime tu śubhaṃ vadet || antarā pātite tasmim̐stathaivāpyaśubhaṃ vadet || 84 || ḍiṇḍime samyagādatte śubhameva vinirdiśet || tadā prabhṛti mattasya tadā nāgasya vai nṛpa || 85 || aśubhe lakṣaṇe jāte bhūyastatkarma cācaret || śubhe tu lakṣaṇe jāte gajādhyakṣasya ḍiṇḍimam || 86|| jaye saṃsthāpya nandādyāgrajapāya..........................sarvabādhāvināśanam || 87 || ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi kāmyaṃ karma tavānagha || upoṣitastathā yāmye yajamāne purohitaḥ || 88 || śubhapradamidaṃ snānaṃ yajamānasya kārayet || nyagrodhodumbarāśvatthamadhukodakasaṃyutaiḥ || 89 || akālamūlaiḥ kalaśaiḥ pañcabhirgajalakṣaṇaiḥ || snātaḥ śuklāmbaro viṣṇuṃ candrārkau varuṇaṃ tathā || 2.50.90 || hastinaṃ pūjayedvidvāngandhamālyānnasampadā || dhūpadīpanamaskārairvāsobhiśca tathaiva ca || 91 || hastidantena sūryāya dattvā dhūpamataḥ param || caturthyantena vai nāmnā praṇavādyena bhārgava || sahasraśo gajāścātra dakṣiṇā kāñcanaṃ tathā || 92 || yaḥ svāsate snānamidaṃ prakurvangajendramukhyāngirisannikāśān || bahūnavāpnoti tathāsya nāgā bhavantyarogā vinimuktadoṣāḥ ||93 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0 saṃ0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne gajānāṃ śāntikarmavidhānaṃ nāma pañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 50 || <2.51> puṣkara uvāca || durgamāyudhasaṃghātaṃ kuñjarāsturagāstathā || puruṣaiśca vinā rāma sarvametadapārthakam || 1 || tasmātprayatnaṃ kurvīta puruṣāṇāṃ samarjane || teṣāṃ caivāntarajñāne mūlametadyataḥ śriyaḥ ||2|| susahāyārthasampanna balaṃ yasya mahīpateḥ || saṃgrāme tumule rāma nūnaṃ tasya jayo bhavet || 3 || sakṛdyena kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tasya rājā na viśvaset || pāpaṃ tu sukaraṃ tasya sukṛtaścāsya duṣkaram || 4 || yathā hi malinairvastrairyatra tatropaviśyate || tathā calitavṛttastu vṛttaśeṣaṃ na rakṣati|| 5 || rājā na veśayetkārye jano yo nāstiko bhavet || āstikā api tatsaṅgātprāpnuyuḥ saṃśayaṃ dvija || 6 || anāhāryaprabhasyāpi trailokyodbhāsitātmanaḥ || kṛṣṇatā rāhusaṃsargātkinna sūryasya vā bhavet ||7|| akāryamityakāryāṇi kuryātkāryavaśena yaḥ || vicikitsurdhruvaṃ rāma paścādapi nivartate || 8 || kāryaṃ buddhvā tvakāryāṇi yaḥ karoti narādhamaḥ || akāryakaraṇe śraddhā tasya bhūyobhivardhate || 9 || lokaḥ sarvo mahābhāga paralokanibandhanaḥ || nirapekṣasya tatrānyā kā gatiḥ syānnibandhane || 2.51.10 || mahāpātakino ye'pi tebhyo'pi ca mahattaraḥ || pāpakṛnnāstiko lokastasmāttaṃ parivarjayet || 11 || āstikānāṃ ca sādhūnāṃ saṃgrahaḥ śasyate sadā || te sahāyā narendrāṇāṃ tathā ye rāma paṇḍitāḥ || 12 || na paṇḍito mato rāma bahupustakadhāraṇāt || paralokabhayaṃ yasya tamāhuḥ paṇḍitaṃ budhāḥ || 13 || agnihotraphalā vedā dattabhuktaphalaṃ dhanam || ratiputraphalā dārāḥ śīlavṛttaphalaṃ śrutam || 14 || śīlopapanno nṛpatiḥ sahāyaiḥ śaraistathālpairapi samprayuktaḥ || prabhūtanāgāśvabalotkaṭānāṃ karotyarīṇāṃ kadanaṃ raṇeṣu || 15 || || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0 saṃ0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne puruṣapraśaṃsā nāmaikapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 51 || <2.52> || puṣkara uvāca || || ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi narāṇāṃ te cikitsitam || tatrāpyādau tathā strīṇāṃ yanmūlaṃ prajanaṃ yataḥ || 1 || mahājambūdvayaṃ rodhraṃ madhukaṃ madhu śarkarā || taṇḍulodakasaṃyuktaṃ śoṇitapradare pibet || 2 || ūrdhvaṃ saṃvatsarānnārīṃ raktagulme virecayet || snigdhasvinnaśarīrāñca rāma tīkṣṇaurvirecanaiḥ || 3 || jvareṇa ca palāśasya saṃsiddhaṃ yāvakaṃ pibet || agnisandhukṣaṇaṃ cānyāstathā kāryaṃ prayatnataḥ || 4 || prasthaṃ vṛṣakamūlasya tailaṃ prasthaṃ vipācayet || yonīnāṃ parikopeṣu vedanāmapakarṣati ||5 || saurāṣṭrī rocanā rodhraṃ madhūkaṃ triphalā madhu || bhadramustāni cūrṇāni vājīkaraṇamuttam || 6 || aśvagandhāvipakvena varāhasya tu medasā || granthīkaraṇamabhyaṅgaṃ yoṣitāṃ parikīrtitam || 7 || ekamāmalakaṃ kāle salilāṃjalinā pibet || sṛṣṭaṃ kṛṣṇāyase bhāṇḍe tena śātodarī bhavet || 8 || triphalāṃ citrakaṃ śuṇṭhīṃ madhunā tu lihetsadā || sthūlānāṃ varanārīṇāṃ kṛṣīkaraṇamuttamam || 9 || aśvagandhāṃ payasyāṃ ca saṃsṛjya payasā pibet || māsametatprayuñjānā kṛśā bhavati māṃsalā || 2.52.10 || varāhavasayā kāryamaśvagandhāvipakvayā || stanānāṃ mardanaṃ tena nārī pīnastanī bhavet || 11 || mūlakasya cyutaṃ bījaṃ tathaiva tagarasya ca || saptarātraṃ tu gomūtre sidhmanāśanamuttamam || 12 || kṣāreṇa hastipiṇḍasya avalgujarasena ca || etena prokṣitaṃ śvitraṃ trirātreṇa vinaśyati || 13 || guñjāyāḥ saphalaṃ mūlaṃ citrakaṃ tagaraṃ tathā || bhallātakānāṃ ca phalaṃ mūlaṃ caivāśvamārakam || 14 || arkakṣīrasamaṃ tailaṃ dravyairetairvipācayet || prokṣaṇena vinirdiṣṭaṃ romaśātanamuttamam || 15 || hastidantamayīṃ piṣṭvā payasā lepayecchiraḥ || ajāteṣvapi keśeṣu romasañjananaṃ param || 16 || bhṛṅgarājarasaistailaṃ siddhamabhyañjanāddrutam || dṛḍhamūlāni keśāni kuryātkṛṣṇāsitāni ca || 17 || kaṭukaṃ dantakāṣṭhaṃ tu gomūtraparibhāvitam || bhuktvā tailena gaṇḍūṣaṃ vaktragandhaharaṃ param || ||18|| indīvarāṇi śuṣkāṇi prāśyāni taṇḍulaissaha || sarvarātraṃ mukhe vāti sugandhiviśadaṃ śuci ||19|| sarṣaponmathitaṃ kṛtvā śālmalīnāṃ tu kaṇṭakaiḥ || payaḥpiṣṭairmukhe lepānmukhaṃ syātkamalopamam || 2.52.20 || vyaṅgānāṃ tilakānāṃ ca śamanaṃ tatprakīrtitam || yauvane piṭakānāṃ ca ye ca doṣā mukhe smṛtāḥ || 21 || kaṣāyakalkasiddhena śatāvaryā ghṛtena ca || abhyaṅgapānairbhavati nārī varṇayutā param || 22 || ṣoḍaśartuniśāḥ strīṇāmādyāstisrastu ninditāḥ || aspṛśyā tāsu nārī syātspṛṣṭvā tāṃ snānamācaret || 23 || dinatrayaṃ tu tannārī snānābhyaṅgau vivarjayet || āhāraṃ gorasānāṃ ca puṣpālaṅkāradhāraṇam || 24 || añjanaṃ kaṅkaṇaṃ gandhāḥ pītaṃ śayyādhirohaṇam || mṛllohabhāṇḍavarjyeṣu tathā bhāṇḍeṣu bhojanam || 25 || agnisaṃsparśanaṃ caiva varjayettu dinatrayam || caturthe'hani kurvīta snānaṃ sā tu yathāvidhi || 26 || abhiṣekoditābhiśca mṛddhiradbhiśca mānasaiḥ || oṣadhyaśca tathā kumbhe nikṣipya snāpayettu tām ||27|| jyotiṣmatīṃ trāyamāṇāmabhayāmaparājitām || jīvāṃ viśveśvarīṃ pāṭhāṃ samaṅgāṃ vijayāṃ tathā || 28 || sahāṃ ca sahadevīṃ ca pūrṇakośāṃ śatāvarīm || ariṣṭāṃ śivāṃ bhadrāṃ golomīṃ vijayapradām || 29 || brāhmīṃ kṣetrāmajāṃ caiva sarvabījāni cāñjanam || bilvaṃ gandhāni ratnāni pañcagavyaṃ tathaiva ca || 2.52.30 || kumbhe nikṣipya kumbhaṃ ca gandhamālyānulepanaiḥ || pūjayitvā tato devaṃ tasyātra śubhavardhanam || 31 || mantraṃ rājābhiṣekoktaṃ paṭhedatra ca kālavit || vastracchannamukhī snātā snāpake ca vinirgate || || 32 || paśyettadeva pratimāṃ vāsudevasya rūpiṇaḥ || athavā rāma bhartāraṃ nānyaṃ kaṃcana satvaram || 33 || tatkāle vadanaṃ tasya paśyatyatha yathā vidhi || sā prasūte sutaṃ rāma śubhaṃ vā'pyathavā śucim || 34 || pūjanaṃ vāsudevasya sā kṛtvātmana eva ca || maṇḍanaṃ ca yathānyāyaṃ śuklavastrottaracchadā| ||35 || ṣaṣṭikānnaṃ tu payasā samaśnīyād ghṛtena sā || ghṛtasya pītvā prasṛtiṃ nāgapuṣpāvacūrṇitam || 36 || ṛtukāle samāpnoti nārī garbhaṃ dvijottama || upoṣitena śucinā śuklapakṣe samuddhṛtam || 37 || puṣyeṇa bṛhatīmūlamuttarāṃ vā mukhe nayeta || śvetapuṣpā tu bṛhatī drumūlasyaiṣa niścayaḥ ||38|| nasyā deyāśca catvāra unmūlā drumabindavaḥ || tasminnahani sā tena garbhaṃ dhatte varāṃganā || 39 || evamapyabhavantī tu putrīyāṃ rāma saptamīm || putrīyamathavā snānaṃ keśavārādhanaṃ vratam || 2.52.40 || putrīyameva vā kuryātkeśavārādhanaṃ priyā || snātānuliptā bhartāraṃ hṛṣṭairbṛṃhitameva ca || 41 || yāyādrātrau tathā nārī gandhadhūpādivāsitā || āttagarbhāṃ cikitseta tatastāmaparājita || 42 || madhurauṣadhisiddhena payasā sarpiṣā tathā || icchāvimānagāḥ kāścinnāsyāḥ kāryā kathañcana || 43 || kaṭutiktakaṣāyāṇi cātyuṣṇalavaṇāni ca || āyāsaṃ ca vyavāyaṃ ca garbhiṇī varjayetsadā || 44 || vinā karma na tiṣṭheta tathā sā rāhudarśane || prādurbhāvāṇi vedesya viṣṇoramitatejasaḥ || 45 || śṛṇuyāttanmanā bhūtvā caritaṃ ca mahātmanaḥ || punnāmni nāmanakṣatre hyāsannaprasavā gṛham || 46 || praviśetsūtikāsaṃjñaṃ kṛtarakṣaṃ samantataḥ || subhūmau nirmitaṃ ramyaṃ vāstuvidyāviśāradaiḥ || 47 || prāgdvāramuttaradvāramathavā sudṛḍhaṃ śubham || devānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca gavāṃ kṛtvā ca pūjanam || 48 || vipra puṇyāhaghoṣeṇa śaṃkhavādyaraveṇa ca || prasūtā bahuśastatra tathā kleśakṣamāśca yāḥ || 49 || hṛdyā viśvasanīyāśca paricareyuḥ striyaśca tām || vātānulomanairhṛdyaistatraināmupacārayet || 2.52.50 || āhāraiśca vihāraiśca prasavāya sukhaṃ dvija || eraṇḍamūlamiśreṇa saghṛtena tathaiva tām || 51 || sukhaprasavanārthāya paścātkāye tu mrakṣayet || balākalkakaṣāyeṇa siddhaṃ kṣīraṃ caturguṇam || 52 || tailamabhyañjanārthāya sūtāyāmupakalpayet || atha jātānna pānecchāṃ pañcakolaprasāditām || 53 || pibedyavāgūṃ sasnehāṃ tathā vai nīlakuñcikām || daśāhaṃ sūtikāgāraṃ cāyudhaiśca viśeṣataḥ || 54 || vahni kātindukālātaiḥ pūrṇakumbhaiḥ pradīpakaiḥ || musalena tathā dvāri varṇakaiścitritena ca || 55 || rakṣaṇīyā tathā ṣaṣṭhī niśā tatra viśeṣataḥ || rāma jāgaraṇaṃ kāryaṃ janmadānāṃ tathārcanam || 56 || puruṣāḥ śastrahastāśca nṛtyagītaiśca yoṣitaḥ || rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryurdaśame'hani sūtikā || 57 || snātā pūrvavidhānena rakṣaṇīyā samīraṇāt || bālasya jātamātrasya nābhiṃ chittvā yathāvidhi || 58 || tālumuttāpayennārī picunā śodhayenmukham || brāhmī suvarcalā somaṃ saindhavaṃ pippalī vacā || 59 || kanakaṃ sarpiṣā dadyāllehyametaddvijottama || lehyenānena medhāvī śūraḥ paṇḍita eva ca || 2.52.60 || darśanīyo yaśasvī ca subhagaḥ sa bhaviṣyati || bibhītakāsthi kṣaudreṇa ghṛṣṭaṃ śreṣṭhamathāñjanam || 61 || netrarogeṣu bālānāṃ saharidraṃ ca gorasam || śārivā candanaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ samabhāgāni kārayet ||62|| śirolepamidaṃ dadyādakṣirogavināśanam || āmrāsthi saindhavaṃ lājā madhunā saha lehayet ||63|| eṣa lehavaraḥ śreṣṭhaśchardipraśamanaḥ śubhaḥ || apāmārgaviḍaṅgāni pippalī maricaṃ tathā || 64 || saindhavaṃ taṇḍulaṃ caiva madhusarpiḥsamanvitam || vyāghrīrasena leho'yaṃ hikkāśvāsavināśanaḥ || 65 || bibhītakatvacā śreṣṭhaṃ haritālaṃ manaḥśilā || etattailaṃ paceddadrupāmākiṭibhanāśanam || 66 || kṣaudreṇa lehyā tuvarā pippalyativiṣāpahā || śleṣmarogeṣu sarveṣu bālānāṃ bheṣajaṃ param || 67 || rodhratvaṅmadhunā sārdhamatīsāravināśinī || sapta parṇatvak ca dūrvā tathā kaṭukarohiṇī || 68 || etadudvartanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sarvagrahavināśanam || bhaṅgāṃ vacāṃ śaṅkhapuṣpīmeraṇḍasaptaparṇakam || 69 || samantapuṣpīsaṃyuktamapāmārgaṃ ca puṣkaram || kvāthayitvā ca dātavyaṃ snānaṃ sadyaḥ sukhāvaham ||2.52.70 || sarpiṣā nimbapatrāṇi goviṣāṇaṃ ghṛtaṃ madhu || etena dhūpito bālo grahadoṣairvimucyate || 71 || apāmārgasya bījāni bilvamūlaphalāni ca || aguruṃ candanaṃ caiva saptaparṇasya valkalam || 72 || etadālepanaṃ kuryātsarvagrahavināśanam || mātaraśca grahāścaiva bālaṃ tu balikarmaṇā || 73 || kṣiprameva pramuñcanti tasmādyatnena kārayet || tarakṣvarkṣa varāhāṇāṃ daṃṣṭrā gorocanā vacā || 74 || ratnānyayastathā kṛṣṇaṃ vastraṃ dhāryaṃ tu bālakaiḥ || jātasya rāma bālasya hemante prathame'thavā || 75 || śiśire vāpi kartavyaṃ karṇavedhaṃ tathā śṛṇu || grahāṇāṃ tatra sarveṣāṃ dinavāraḥ praśasyate || 76 || tithiṃ caturthīṃ navamīṃ varjayitvā caturdaśīm || sāvitraṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ tvāṣṭramādityaṃ pauṣṇamāśvinam || 77 || karṇavedhe praśasyante somadevaṃ tathaiva ca || pūrvāhṇe pūjanaṃ kṛtvā keśavasya harasya ca || 78 || brahmaṇaścandrasūryābhyāṃ digīśānāṃ tathaiva ca || nāsatyayoḥ sarasvatyā brāhmaṇānāṃ gavāṃ tathā || 79 || gurūṇāṃ maṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā tatra dattvā sukhāsanam || dattvopaveśayettatra dhātrīṃ śuklāmbarāṃ tathā ||2.52.80|| svalaṃkṛtāṃ tadutsaṃge bālaṃ kṛtvā tu sāntvitam || dhṛtasya niścalaṃ samyaggale kukarasāṃkite||81|| vidhyeddaivakṛte chidre sakṛdeva tu lāghavāt || prāgdakṣiṇaṃ kumārasya bhiṣagvāmaṃ tu yoṣitaḥ || snehāktaṃ sūcyanusyūtaṃ sūtraṃ vānunidhāpayet || 82 || tailābhyakte tataḥ karṇe kāryamābharaṇaṃ bhavet || karṇavedhadine vipraṃ sāṃvatsaracikitsakau || pūjyāścāvidhavā nāryaḥ suhṛdaśca tathā dvijāḥ || || 83 || caturthe māsi kartavyaṃ śiśorniṣkramaṇaṃ gṛhāt || saurabhaumadinaṃ caiva tithiṃ riktāṃ ca varjayet || 84 || caturthīṃ navamīṃ caiva riktāṃ caiva caturdaśīm || āryamṇaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ hastamādityaṃ pauṣamaśvinam || 85 || bhāgyaṃ tvāṣṭraṃ ca puṣyaṃ ca tatra karmaṇi śasyate || digīśānāṃ diśaṃ tatra tathā candrārkayordvija || 86 || pūjanaṃ vāsudevasya gaganasya ca kārayet || tatra svalaṃkṛtā dhātrī bālamādāya pūjitam || 87 || bahirniṣkrāmayedgehācchaṅkhapuṇyāhanisvanaiḥ || tatastatra paṭhenmaṃtraṃ yaṃ tu rāma nibodha me||88|| candrārkayordigīśānāṃ diśāṃ ca gaganasya ca || nikṣepārthamidaṃ dadmi te me rakṣantu sarvadā ||89|| apramattaṃ pramattaṃ vā divā rātrāvathāpi vā || rakṣantu sarvataḥ sarve devāḥ śakrapurogamāḥ || 2.52.90 || strīṇāmavidhavānāṃ tu dvijānāṃ suhṛdāṃ tathā || tadā tu pūjā kartavyā gītanṛtyaistathotsavaiḥ || 91 || pañcame ca tathā māsi bhūmau tamupaveśayet || tatra sarve grahāḥ śastā bhaumo rāma viśeṣataḥ || 92 || tithiṃ ca varjayedriktāmṛkṣāṇi śṛṇu bhārgava || uttarātritayaṃ saumyaṃ cāśvatthaṃ śakradaivatam || 93 || prājāpatyaṃ ca hastaṃ ca śastamāśvinadaivatam || varāhaṃ pūjayeddevaṃ pṛthivīṃ ca dvijottama || 94 || pūjanaṃ sarvataḥ kṛtvā gurudevadvijanmanām || bhūbhāgamupalipyātha kṛtvā tatra tu maṇḍalam || 95 || śaṅkhapuṇyāhaśabdena bhūmau tamupaveśayet || mantraścātra bhavedrāma tanme nigadataḥ śṛṇu || 96 || rakṣaṇaṃ vasudhe devi sadā sarvagataṃ śubhe || āyuḥpramāṇaṃ sakalaṃ nikṣepaste haripriye || 97 || antarādāyuṣastasya ye kecitparipanthinaḥ || jīvitārogyavitteṣu nirdahasvācireṇa tān || 98 || vareṇyāśeṣabhūtānāṃ mātā tvamasi kāmadhuk || ajarā cāprameyā ca sarvabhūtanamaskṛtā || 99 || carācarāṇāṃ bhūtānāṃ pratiṣṭhā tvaṃ tvarhamasi || kumāraṃ pāhi mātastvaṃ bālaṃ tadanumanyatām || 2.52.100 || tasyopaveśanaṃ kṛtvā bhūmau brāhmaṇabhojanam || śaktyā kṛtvā tataḥ kāryaścotsavaḥ pūrvavaddvija || 101 || ṣaṣṭhe'nnaprāśanaṃ māsi kartavyaṃ bhaumavarjite || dinavāre tithiṃ riktāṃ varjanīyā tathaiva ca || 102 || nakṣatrāṇi tathaivātra dāruṇogrāṇi varjayet || sādhāraṇe tathā rāma jyeṣṭhānteṣvapi śasyate || 103 || brahmāṇaṃ śaṅkaraṃ viṣṇuṃ candrārkau ca digīśvarān || bhuvaṃ diśaśca sampūjya hutvā vahnau tathā carum || 104 || eteṣāmeva devānāṃ kṛtvā brāhmaṇapūjanam || devatāpuratastasya dhātryutsaṅgagatasya ca || 105 || alaṃkṛtasya dātavyaṃ vīra kāṃsye tu kāñcane || madhvājyakanakopetaṃ prāśayetpāyasaṃ tataḥ || 106 || tatastvannapate rāma mantraścātra vidhīyate || kṛtaprāśaṃ tadotsaṅgāddhātrī bālaṃ tu vinyaset || 107 || devāgrato'tha vinyasya śilpabhaṇḍāni sarvaśaḥ || śastrāṇi caiva śāstrāṇi tataḥ paśyeta lakṣaṇam || 105 || prathamaṃ yaṃ spṛśedbālaḥ śilpabhāṇḍaṃ svayaṃ tathā || jīvikā tasya bālasya tenaiva tu bhaviṣyati || 109 || danta janmani bālānāṃ tenaiva tu bhaviṣyati || dantajanmani bālānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ tu nibodha me || 2.52.110 || upari prathamaṃ yasya jāyante ca śiśordvijāḥ || dantairvā saha yasya syājjanma bhārgava jāyate || 111 || mātaraṃ pitaraṃ vāpi khādedātmānameva ca || tatra śāntiṃ pravakṣyāmi tanme nigadataḥ śṛṇu ||| ||112|| gajapṛṣṭhagataṃ bālaṃ nausthaṃ vā sthāpayeddvija || tadabhāve tu dharmajña kāñcane tu varāsane ||113|| sarvauṣadhaiḥ sarvagandhairbījaiḥ puṣpaiḥ phalaistathā || pañcagavye tu ratnaiśca patākābhiśca bhārgava ||114|| sthālīpākena dhātāraṃ pūjayettadanantaram || saptāhaṃ cātra kartavyaṃ tathā brāhmaṇabhojanam || 115 || aṣṭame'hani viprāṇāṃ tathā deyā ca dakṣiṇā || kāñcanaṃ rajataṃ gāśca bhuvaṃ cātmānameva vā || 116 || dantajanmani māsānyasambhave saptamādapi || aṣṭame'hani viprāṇāṃ śṛṇu snānamataḥ param ||117|| bhadrāsane niveśyainaṃ mṛdbhirmūlaiḥ phalaistathā || sarvauṣadhaiḥ sarvagandhaiḥ sarvabījaistathaiva ca ||118|| snāpayetpūjayeccātra vahniṃ somaṃ samīraṇam || pūrvataśca tathā khyātāndevadevaṃ ca keśavam ||119|| eteṣāmeva juhuyādghṛtamagnau yathāvidhi || brāhmaṇānāṃ ca dātavyā tataḥ pūjā ca dakṣiṇā || 2.52.120 || tatastvalaṃkṛtaṃ bālaṃ cāsane tūpaveśayet || āsanaṃ chatramūrdhānaṃ bījaistaṃ snāpayettataḥ || 121 || susvinnairbālakānāṃ ca taiśca kāryaṃ ca pūjanam || pūjyāścāvidhavā nāryo brāhmaṇāḥ suhṛdastathā || 122 || prāpte'tha pañcame varṣe tvaprasupte janārdane || pratipadāṃ tathā ṣaṣṭhīṃ varjayitvā tathāṣṭamīm ||123|| riktāṃ pañcadaśīṃ caiva saurabhaumadine tathā || dhuvāṇi yāmyaṃ ca tathā nakṣatrāṇi vivarjayet||124|| saumyavargaścare lagne hite tatra navāṃśake || trikoṇakendragāḥ saumyāḥ pāpāścopacaye śubhāḥ || 125 || nakṣatrāṇāṃ vivarjyānāṃ muhūrtāśca vivarjayet || evaṃ suniścite kāle vidyārambhaṃ ca kārayet || 126 || pūjayitvā hariṃ lakṣmīṃ tathā devīṃ sarasvatīm || suvidyāṃ sūtrakārām̐śca svāṃ vidyāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ || 127 || eteṣāmeva devānāṃ nāmnā tu juhuyādghṛtam || dakṣiṇābhirdvijendrāṇāṃ kartavyaṃ cātra pūjanam || 128 || dhātryutsaṅgādathādāya bālaṃ tu kṛtavāpanam || svalaṃkṛtaṃ pradātavyamutsaṅge tu tadā guroḥ || 129 || guruścātra bhavedvidvānsnātaḥ śuklāmbaraḥ śuciḥ || pragṛhya taṃ tu nikṣepaṃ gururapyatha bhārgava || 2.52.130 || prāṅmukhaḥ sumukhāsīno vāruṇāśāmukhaṃ śiśum || adhyāpayettu prathamaṃ kuryādbālo'pi vandanam || 131 || brāhmaṇānāṃ gurūṇāṃ ca devatānāmanantaram || tatastu pūjyā vittena dhātrī rāma gurustathā || 132 || dakṣiṇābhirdvijendrāṇāṃ kartavyaṃ tarpaṇaṃ tathā || tataḥ prabhṛtyanadhyāyānvarjanīyānvivarjayet ||133 || aṣṭamīdvitayaṃ rāma pakṣānte ca dinadvayam || aśaucamindrayātrāṃ ca bhūkampaṃ rāhudarśanam || 134 || vyatītaṃ cāpyahorātramulkāpātaṃ ca bhārgava || akālastanitaṃ caiva nirjyotiṣamathāmbaram || 135 || tathā kāle pracaṇḍaśca yadā vāyustadā bhavet || pradoṣe cāpyasaṃśraddhe caityavṛkṣacatuṣpathe || 136 || goyāne kuñjare cāśve na ca nāvi tathā bhavet || śvaśṛgālarave ghore tathā ca kharanisvane||137|| tathā vāditraśabde ca tathaiva nagarotsave || 138 || kāleṣu deśeṣu mayoditeṣu paṭhanti ye nāma na teṣu vidyā || phalaṃ prayacchetyathavā'riśatrorloke pare vā yadi vā'pi cāsmin || 139 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0 saṃ0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne bālatantro nāma dvipañcāśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ||52|| <2.53> śrīparaśurāma uvāca || putrīyaṃ bhagavansnānaṃ putrīyamatha saptamīm || putrīyaṃ ca samācakṣva tathā vai keśavavratam||1|| puṣkara uvāca || upoṣitau kṛttikāsu yajamānapurohitau || rohiṇyāṃ snapanaṃ kuryuryajamānasya bhārgava || 2 || kṣīravṛkṣaprarohābhyāṃ sitamālyavibhūṣitam|| priyaṅgucandanopetānpañca kumbhānprapūjayet || 3 || prāṅmukhaṃ vrīhirāśisthaṃ kumbhaistairabhiṣecayet || viṣṇuṃ śaśāṅkaṃ varuṇaṃ rohiṇīṃ ca prajāpatim || 4 || pūjayetprayataḥ śraddhī gandhamālyānulepanaiḥ || dhūpaḥ prajāpaterdeyastathaiva śaṭakeśayāḥ ||5|| pañcapṛṣṭhavṛṣāndigdhāndadhnā ca vinivedayet || prajādhyakṣāya homañca devatānāṃ tu kārayet ||6|| ghṛtena sarvabījaiśca śuklavāsā jitendriyaḥ || dakṣiṇāṃ gurave deyātkāmyaṃ gaurvāsasī śubhe || 7 || suvarṇaṃ ca mahābhāga viprāṇāmatha śaktitaḥ || śuklā ca gaurvṛṣaḥ śuklastayorloma śaphaṃ tathā ||8|| śṛṅgāṇi trivṛtaṃ kṛtvā maṇirdhāryastato bhavet ||9|| alaṃkṛtaṃ keśamidaṃ sadaiva snānaṃ tu kurvanpuruṣo'thavā strī || putrānavāpnoti tatheṣṭatāṃ ca puṣṭiṃ tathāgryāṃ vipulāṃ ca kīrtim|| 2.53.10 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0 saṃ0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne putrīyarohiṇīsnānavarṇanaṃnāma tripañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 53 || <2.54> || puṣkara uvāca || mārgaśīrṣe śubhe māsi śuklapakṣe dvijottama || putrīyāṃ saptamīṃ rāma gṛhṇīyātprayataḥ śuciḥ || 1 || athavā putrakāmā strī vidhinā yena tacchṛṇu || haviṣyāśī śiraḥsnātaḥ kṛtvā brāhmaṇapūjanam || 2 || adhaḥśāyī dvitīye'hni goviṣāṇodakena ca || snātvopaviśya ca tathā śubhe deśe tu maṇḍalam || 3 || tatrāṣṭapatraṃ kamalaṃ vinyasedvarṇakaiḥ śubhaiḥ || tasyaiva karṇikāmadhye bhāskaraṃ candanena tu || 4 || raktena pūjayeddevaṃ gandhamālyānulepanaiḥ || bhakṣyairbhojyaistathā peyairdhūpairdīpaistathaiva ca||5|| evaṃ saṃpūjanaṃ kṛtvā sarvakāmapradasya tu || naktaṃ bhuñjīta dharmajña sarvakarmavivarjitaḥ ||6|| dantolūkhalako bhūtvā kṛtvā saṃvatsaravratam || vratāvasāne dātavyā śaktyā brāhmaṇadakṣiṇā ||7|| tathātrimadhuraprāyaṃ kartavyaṃ dvijabhojanam || adhaḥśāyyaniśaṃ tāṃ ca bhūya eva tathā bhavet || 8 || putrīyametadvratamuttamaṃ te mayoditaṃ kalmaṣanāśakāri || ārādhanaṃ devavarasya rāma sarvāmayaghnaṃ ca tathaitaduktam || 9 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0 saṃ0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne putrīyāsaptamīvrataṃ nāma catuṣpañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 54 || <2.55> puṣkara uvāca || proṣṭhapadyāmatītāyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣāṣṭamī tu yā || sopavāso narastasyāṃ yoṣidvā tanayārthinī ||1 || snātā sarasi dharmajña toye cāpyatha sārase || pūjanaṃ vāsudevasya yathā kuryāttathā śṛṇu || 2 || ghṛtaprasthena govindaṃ snāpayitvā jagadgurum || kṣaudreṇa ca tataḥ paścāddadhnā ca snapayettataḥ || 3 || kṣīreṇa snapanaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ paścādvivakṣitam || sarvauṣadhaiśca gandhaiśca sarvabījaphalaistathā || 4 || snāpayitvānulipyeta candanāgurukuṅkumaiḥ || karpūreṇa tathā rāma tathā jātīphalaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 5 || tataḥ kālodbhavaiḥ puṣpaiḥ pūjayitvā janārdanam || dhūpaṃ cāguruṇā dattvā kṛtvā naivedyamuttamam || || 6 || viśeṣādgorasaprāyaṃ punnāgairanvitaiḥ phalaiḥ || pauruṣeṇa ca sūktena hutvā cānantaraṃ ghṛtam || 7 || śūdro vāpyathavā nārī nāmnā hutvā jagadgurum || yavapātrāṇi dadyāttu phalguni kanakaṃ tathā || 8|| putrārthaṃ prāśanaṃ kuryātphalaiḥ punnāmabhiḥ śubhaiḥ || strīnāmabhiśca kanyārthī tato bhuktvā yathepsitam || 9 || putrakāmānavāpnoti tathā sarvamabhīpsitam || haviṣyaṃ devadevasya bhūmiśobhāṃ tu kārayet || 2.55.10 || saṃvatsaramidaṃ kṛtvā vratamāpnotyabhīpsitam || putrakāmānavāpnoti tathā sarvānabhīpsitān || 11 || putrīyametadvratamuttamaṃ te mayeritaṃ yadyapi dharmanityam || tathāpyanenaiva samasta kāmānkṛtena loke puruṣā labhante || 12 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne putrīyāṣṭamīvrataṃ nāma pañcapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 55 || <2.56> || śrīparaśurāma uvāca || bhagavañcchrotumicchāmi puruṣāṇāṃ cikitsitam || tanmamācakṣva deveśa tatra me saṃśayo mahān || 3 || puṣkara uvāca || rakṣanbalaṃ mahābhāga laṅghayejjvaritaṃ naram || saviśvaṃ lājamaṇḍaṃ tu laṃghitaṃ tattu bhojayet || ||2|| mustaparpaṭakośīracandanoddīpyanāgaraiḥ || ghṛtaṃ śītaṃ payaścātra dātavyaṃ tṛṭpraśāntaye || 3 || ṣaḍahe ca vyatikrānte tiktakaṃ pāyayedrasam || snehayetpākadoṣaṃ ca tatastaṃ ca virecayet || 4 || jīrṇaṣaṣṭikanīvāraraktaśālipramodakāḥ || tadvidhāścaturaḥ śreṣṭhāḥ yavānāṃ vikṛtistathā || 5 || mudgā masūrāścaṇakāḥ kulatthāḥ samakuṇṭhakāḥ || āḍhakī ca phalaṃ mūle yūṣārthaṃ jvariṇāṃ hitam || 6 || kṛṣṇaśuklakavantīrkatittiraiṇakapiñjalāḥ || lāvādyā jāṅgalaśreṣṭhāḥ jvariṇāṃ tadvidhāśca ye || 7 || paṭolaṃ saphalaṃ nimbaṃ karkoṭakakaṭillakam || śākaṃ parpaṭakaṃ cādyādamlārthe dāḍimaṃ hitam || || 8 || ayoge vamanaṃ śastamūrddhage ca virecanam || raktapitte tathā pāne ṣaḍaṅgaṃ śuṇṭhivarjitam || 9 || lājā siñcati kāmaṃ tu yavagodhūmaśālayaḥ || masūramudgacaṇakāḥ khaṇḍitāḥ samakuṣṭhikāḥ || 2.56.10 || hṛdyā godhūmikā bhakṣyā ghṛtakṣīropasādhitāḥ || sakṣaudraśarkaropetāstathā vṛṣaraso hitaḥ|| 11 || atīsāre purāṇānāṃ śālīnāṃ bhakṣaṇaṃ hitam || anabhiṣyadi vā cānyadraudravatsakasaṃyutam || 12 || mārutānāṃ jaye yatnaḥ kāryo gulmeṣu sarvathā || vāṭyakṣīreṇa cāśnīyādvastukaṃ ghṛtasādhitam || 13 || kukkuṭā barhiṇaḥ śreṣṭhāstiktā godhūmaśālayaḥ || hitā jaṭhariṇāṃ bhojye yavagodhūmaśālayaḥ ||14 || mudgāḥ kulatthāḥ kaulāni jāṅgalā mṛgapakṣiṇaḥ || paṭolanimbadhānyāstu śuṣkamūlakasaindhavaiḥ || 15 || mātuluṅgarasā jātihiṅguvṛkṣāmlavetasaiḥ || āhāraṃ jaṭhare yuktyā yathādoṣaṃ prakalpayet|| 16 || kuṣṭhināṃ ca tathā śastaṃ pānārthe khadirodakam|| masūramudgau yūṣārthe bhojye jīrṇāśca śālayaḥ || 17 || nimbaparpaṭakau śākau chāgalānāṃ tathā rasaḥ || viḍaṅgaṃ maricaṃ śuṇṭhī kuṣṭhaṃ rodhraṃ sasarjikam|| 18 || manaḥśilaiḥ kṛto lepaḥ kuṣṭhahā mūtrapeṣitaḥ || apūpasaktukulmāṣavājyādyā mehināṃ hitāḥ || 19 || yavānnavikṛtirmudgāḥ kulatthājīrṇaśālayaḥ || tiktarūkṣāṇi śākāni tiktāni haritāni ca || 2.56.20 || tilāni tilaśigrurvā bibhīteṅgudajāni tu || anabhiṣyandi yaccānyadbhojane tatpraśasyate || 21 ||| mudgāḥ sayavagodhūmā dhānyaṃ varṣasthitaṃ ca yat || jāṅgālasvarasaḥ prokto bhojane rājayakṣmiṇām|| 22|| kulatthamudgakālābuśuṣkamūlakajāṅgalaiḥ || yūṣairvā vāṣkiraiḥ snigdhairdadhidāḍimasādhitaiḥ || 23 || mātuluṅgarasakṣaudradrākṣāvyoṣādisaṃskṛtaiḥ || yavagodhūmaśālyannairbhojayecchāvasaṃ param || 24 ||| daśamūlaphalārāsnākulatthairupasādhitaiḥ || payovyūṣarasakvāthaḥ śvāsahikkānivāraṇaḥ || 25 || śuṣkamūlakakaulatthamaudgajāṃgalajai rasaiḥ || yavagodhūmaśālyannaṃ jīrṇāśoṃ'śaṃ samācaret || 26 || jīrṇa pakvarasaṃ śīdhumārdvīkām̐stvatha vā pibet || śothavānsaguḍāṃ pathyāṃ khādedvā guḍalāvanam || || 27 || citraṃ vicitrakaṃ cobhau grahaṇīroganāśanau || purāṇayavagodhūmaśālayo jāṅgalaṃ rasam || 28 || mudgāmalakakharjūramṛdvīkābadarāṇi ca || madhusarpiḥpayastakraṃ nimbaparpaṭakau vṛṣam || 29 || takravṛddhyānuśasyante satataṃ vātarogiṇām || hṛdrogiṇe pradātavyaṃ prayatnena virecanam ||2.56.30|| pippalīnāṃ prayogaśca pramṛte dharmiṇastathā || cakāra nāḍī śīdhūni yuktā ca śiśirāmbhasā || 31 || yuktasauvarcalājākṣimatha śastaṃ madātyaye || sakṣaudrapayasā lākṣāṃ pibeta kṣatavānnaraḥ || 32 || kṣayaṃ māṃsarasāhāro vahnisaṃrakṣaṇājjayet || śālayo bhojane śaktā nīvārakalamādayaḥ || 33 || yavānnavikṛtirmāṃsaṃ śākaṃ sauvarcalaṃ sudhīḥ || pathyaṃ tathaiva tāsāṃ ca maṇḍaṃ takraṃ ca vāruṇī || 34 || mustābhyāsastathā lepaḥ citrakeṇa haridrayā || yavānnavikṛtiḥ śālirvāstukī ca suvarcalam || 35 || trapusī cārugodhūmāḥ kṣīrekṣughṛtasaṃyutāḥ || mūtrakṛcche ca śastāḥ syuḥ pāne maṇḍasurādayaḥ .|| 36 || lājā saktu tathā kṣaudraṃ śālyaṃ māṃsaparūṣakam || vṛntākālābuśikhinaśchardighnāḥ pānakāni ca || || 37 || śālyannaṃ toyapayasī kevaloṣṇaśrite'pi vā || tṛṣṇāghnā mustaguḍayorgulikā vā mukhe dhṛtā || 38 || yavānnavikṛtiryūṣaṃ śuṣkamūlakajaṃ tathā || śākaṃ paṭolavetrāśramūrustambhavināśanam || 39 || muktāḍhakamasūrāṇāmatīrairjāṅgalaistathā || sasaindhavaghṛtadrākṣāśuṇṭhyāmalakolajaiḥ || 2.56.40 || yūṣaiḥ purāṇagodhūmayavaśālyannamabhyaset || visarpaṃ sasitākṣaudramṛdvīkādāḍimodaraḥ || 41 || raktaṣaṣṭikagodhūmayavamudgādivallaghu || kācamācī ca vetrāgraṃ vāstukaṃ ca suvarcalā || 42 || vātaśoṣitanāśāya toyaṃ śastaṃ sitā madhu || nāsāroge ca sahitaṃ ghṛtadūrvāprasādhitam || 43 || bhṛṅgarājarase siddhe tailaṃ dhātrīraso'pi vā || na syātsarvāmayeṣviṣṭaṃ mūrdhajatrūdbhaveṣvatha || 44 || śītatoyānvapatanaṃ tilānāṃ rāma bhakṣaṇam || dvijadārḍhyakaraṃ proktaṃ tathā puṣṭikaraṃ śubham || 45 || gaṇḍūṣastilatailena dvijadārḍhyakaraḥ paraḥ || viḍaṅgacūrṇaṃ gomūtraṃ sarvatra kṛmināśanam || 46 || dhātrīphalānyathājyaṃ ca śirolepanamuttamam|| śirorogavināśāya snigdhaśītaṃ ca bhojanam||47|| tailaṃ vā vasti mūtraṃ vā karṇapūraṇamuttamam || karṇaśūlavināśāya śuddhaṃ tailaṃ niṣecayet || 48 || giribhṛccandanaṃ mālyaṃ mālatīkālikāstathā || saṃyojya yākṛtāvartiḥ kṣatacakraharītusā ||49 || vyoṣaṃ triphalayāyuktaṃ surūkaṃ ca rasāñjanam || sarvākṣirogaśamanaṃ tathā caiva rasāñjanam || 2.56.50 || ājyabhṛṣṭaṃ śilāpiṣṭarothakāñjikasaindhavaiḥ || āścyotanavināśāya sarvarogāmayeṣu ca || 51 || giribhṛccandanairlepo bahirlepasya śasyate || netrāmayavighātārthaṃ triphalāṃ śīlayetsadā || 52|| rātrau tu madhusarpibhyāṃ dīrghamāyurjijīviṣuḥ || śatāvare rase siddhau vṛṣyau kṣīraghṛtau smṛtau||53|| kalaviṅkāni māṣāśca vṛṣau kṣīraṃ ghṛtaṃ tathā || āyuṣyā triphalā caiva pūrvavanmadhukānvitā || 54 || madhukāyorajopetā valīpalitanāśinī || vacasiddhaṃ ghṛtaṃ rāma tadā bhūtavināśanam || 55 || kaṇṭhe buddhipradaṃ caiva tathā sarvārthasādhakam || valgakalkakaṣāyeṇa siddhamabhyañjanaṃ hitam||56|| rāsnā sahacarairvāpi tailaṃ vātavikāriṇām || anabhiṣyandi yaccānyattadvraṇeṣu praśasyate || 57 || pakvasya ca tathā bhedaṃ nimbaśīlaṃ ca ropaṇe || tathā tasyopacāraśca balikarmārthiśeṣataḥ || 58 || sūtikā ca tathā rakṣā vraṇināṃ tu sadā hitā || jaṅgame viṣadaṃśe tu dātavyaṃ sthāvaraṃ viṣam || ||59|| sthāvare sarpadaṣṭasya hitaṃ māṃsasya bhakṣaṇam || bhakṣaṇaṃ nimbapatrāṇāṃ sarpadaṣṭasya bheṣajam || 2.56.60 || vandhyākārkoṭajaṃ mūlaṃ chāgamūtrābhibhāvitam || nasyaṃ kāñcikasaṃpiṣṭaṃ viṣavegavināśanam ||61|| bandhanāddūṣaṇaṃ chedadāhasrāvāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || pūrvadaṣṭasya pāne ca hṛdayāvaraṇa ghṛtam || ||62|| tālanimbadalaṃ keśā jīrṇacailaṃ yavā ghṛtam || dhūpo vṛścikaviddhasya śikhipatraṃ ghṛtena vā||63|| arkakṣīreṇa saṃpiṣṭaṃ lepabījaṃ palāśajam|| vṛścikārttasya kṛṣṇā vā śirīṣaphalasaṃyutā || 64 || tilakāsphoṭayordūnaṃ girikarṇyāstilasya ca || śarkarāmadhusarpīṃṣi pānamākhuviṣāpaham || ||65|| ārkakṣīraṃ tilāstailaṃ palalaṃ ca guru samam || pānājjayati durvāramaviṣaṃ śīghrameva ca||66|| pītvā mūlaṃ trivṛttulyaṃ taṇḍulīyasya sarpiṣā|| sarpakīṭaviṣāṇyāśu jayatyatibalānyapi || 67 || candanaṃ padmakaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ natāmbūśīrapāṭalāḥ || nirguṇḍīśākhiśailūṣalūtāviṣaharo'gadaḥ || 68 || śirovirecanaṃ śastaṃ guḍanāgarakaṃ dvija || nasyakarmaṇi vastau ca tathā bhṛṅge ca bhārgava || 69 || tailameva paraṃ vidyātsnehapāne tathā ghṛtam || svedanīyaḥ paro vahniḥ sitāmbhaḥstambhanaṃ param || 2.56.70 || trivṛddhi recane śreṣṭhā vamane madanaṃ tathā || vastirvireko vamanaṃ tailaṃ sarpistathā madhu ||71|| raktapitte balā rāsnā krameṇa paramauṣadham || śārīramānasāgraṃ tu sahajā vyādhayo matāḥ || 72 || śārīrajvarakuṣṭhādyāḥ krodhādyā mānasā matāḥ || āgantavo'bhighātotthāḥ sahajāḥ kṣuttṛṣādayaḥ || 73 || śārīrāgantunāśāya satataṃ sūryavāsare || guḍājyalavaṇopetaṃ sahiraṇyaṃ dvijātaye ||74|| dadyācca dhūpaṃ dharmajña prīṇayecca divākaram || ārogyametenāpnoti kāmām̐śca manasepsitān || 75 || satataṃ divase cāndre snānamabhyaṅgapūrvakan || yaḥ prayacchati viprāya so'pi rogairvimucyate || ||76 || śanaiścaradine dattvā tailaṃ vipreṣu śaktitaḥ|| nityameva mahābhāga roganāśanamāpnuyāt || 77 || āśvinaṃ sakalaṃ māsaṃ pratyahaṃ gorasairdvijān || bhojayitvā mahābhāga roganāśanamāpnuyāt ||78|| snāpayitvā tathā liṅgaṃ devadevasya śūlinaḥ || ghṛtena payasā caiva sarvarogairvimucyate || 79 || gāyatryāvāhayedvidvāndūrvāṃ trimadhunāplutām || pūtaśca brāhmaṇāśīrbhiḥ sarvarogairvimucyate || 2.56.80 || yasminbhe vyādhimāpnoti kṛtvā tasya balikriyām || bhapūjāvidhinā rāma tasmādrogādvimucyate||81|| kartavyamathavā snānaṃ tathārogyavivardhanam || ārogyadāṃ dvitīyāṃ vā pratipadvā bhṛgūttama || 82 || kartavyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ vāpi vratamārogyakārakam || mānasānāṃ nijānāṃ ca tathā caivāvipattaye ||83 || śaraṇaṃ devadeveśaṃ vrajeta madhusūdanam || sarvagaṃ taṃ jagannāthamajeyaṃ puruṣottamam || 84 || stuvannāmasahasreṇa vyādhīnsarvānvyapohati || doṣadhātumalādhāraṃ śarīraṃ prāṇināṃ dvija || 85 || vātapittakaphā doṣā dhātavaśca tathā śṛṇu || bhuktaṃ pakvāśayādannaṃ dvidhā yāti bhṛgūttama || 86 || aṃśenaikena kiṭṭatvaṃ rasatāṃ cāpareṇa ca || kiṭṭabhāgo malastatra viṇmūtrasvedadūṣakaḥ || 87 || nāsāmalaṃ dehamalaṃ tathā karṇamalaṃ ca yat || rasabhāge rasaṃ tatra samyakśoṇitatāṃ vrajet || 88 || māṃsaṃ raktantato medo medasosthnāṃ ca sambhavaḥ || asthno majjā tataḥ śukraṃ śukrādrāma tato rasaḥ ||89 || sarveṣāmeva dhātūnāṃ sāramojaḥ prakīrtitam || deśaṃ sātmyaṃ ca yāṃ śaktiṃ kālaṃ prakṛtimeva ca ||2.56.90 || jñātvā cikitsitaṃ kuryādbheṣajasya tathā balam || tithiṃ riktāṃ dineśaṃ ca tathaiva ca kujārkajau|| || 91 || dāruṇogrāṇi carkṣāṇi varjayedbheṣaje sadā || harigodvijacandrārkasurāgnīnpratipūjya ca|| 92 || śrutvā mantramimaṃ vidvānbheṣajārambhamācaret || brahmatryakṣāśvirudrendrabhūcandrārkanalānilāḥ || 93 || ṛṣaya oṣadhigrāmā bhūtasargāśca pāntu te|| rasāyanamivarṣīṇāṃ devānāmamṛtaṃ yathā || 94 || svadhevottamanāgānāṃ bhaiṣajyamidamaśnute || vātaśleṣmātmako deśo bahuvṛkṣo bahūdakaḥ || 95 || anūpa iti vikhyāto jāṅgalastadvivarjitaḥ || kiṃñcidvṛkṣādhiko deśastathā sādhāraṇaḥ smṛtaḥ ||96|| jāṅgalaḥ pittabahulo madhyaḥ sādhāraṇo mataḥ|| rūkṣaśītaścalo vātaḥ pittamuṣṇakaṭudravam || 97 || sthirāmlasnigdhamadhuraṃ balāsaṃ ca pracakṣate || vṛddhiḥ samānaiḥ sarveṣāṃ viparītairviparyayaḥ || 98 || samāḥ svādvamlalavaṇāḥ śleṣmalā vāyunāśanāḥ || kaṭutiktakaṣāyāśca vātalāḥ śleṣmanāśanāḥ || 99 || kaṭvamlalavaṇā jñeyāstathā pittavivardhanāḥ || tiktāḥ svādukaṣāyāśca tathā pittavināśanāḥ || 2.56.100 || svabhāvatastathā karma te ca kurvanti bhārgava || śiśire ca vasante ca nidāghe ca tathā kramāt || 101 || cayaprakopapraśamāstathā pittasya kīrtitāḥ || nidāghe vāridā rātre tathā śaradi bhārgava || 102 || cayaprakopapraśamāstathā vātasya kīrtitāḥ || cayaprakopapraśamāḥ śleṣmaṇaśca prakīrtitāḥ || 103 || saṃvatsaro dvādaśāṅgo māsabhedena kīrtitaḥ || dvidhā tu matabhedena bhūya eva prakīrtitaḥ || 104 || ādānaśca visargaśca tatrāpi parikīrtitau || varṣādayo visargāśca hemantādyāḥ smṛtāstrayaḥ || 105 || meghakāle ca śaradi hemante ca yathākramāt || cayaprakopapraśamastathā pittasya kīrtitaḥ || 106 || śiśirādyāstathādānaṃ grīṣmāntā ṛtavastrayaḥ || saumyo visargastvādānaṃ cāgneyaṃ parikīrtitam || 107 || varṣādīnstrīnṛtūnrāma catuḥparyāyagorasān || vivardhayettathā tiktakaṣāyakaṭukānkramāt || 108 || yathā rajanyo vardhante balamevaṃ vivardhate || kramaśo'tha manuṣyāṇāṃ hīyamānāsu hīyate || 109 || rātribhuktaṃ dinānte tu divasasya tathaiva ca || ādimadhyāvasāneṣu kaphapittasamīraṇāḥ || 2.56.110 || prakopaṃ yānti kopādau kāle yeṣāṃ cayaḥ smṛtaḥ || prakopāntaraje kāle śamasteṣāṃ prakīrtitaḥ || 111 || atibhojanato rāma tathā cābhojanena ca || sarve'pi rogā jāyante vegodīraṇadhāraṇaiḥ || 112 || annena kukṣerdvāvaṃśau pānenaikaṃ prapūrayet || āśrayaṃ pavanādīnāṃ tathaikamavaśeṣayeta || 113 || vyādhernidānasya tathā viparītamathauṣadham || kartavyametadevātra mayā sārdhaṃ prakīrtitam || 114 || nābherūrdhvamadhaścaiva gudaśroṇyostathaiva ca || balāsapittavātānāṃ dehe sthānaṃ prakīrtitam || 115 || tathāpi sarvagā ete dehe vāyurviśeṣataḥ || dehasya madhye hṛdayaṃ sthānaṃ tu manasaḥ smṛtam || 116 || kṛśolpakeśaścapalo bahuvāgviṣamānalaḥ || vyomagaśca tathā svapne vātaprakṛtirucyate || 117 || akālapalitaḥ krodhī prasvedī madhurapriyaḥ || svapne ca dīptimatprekṣī pittaprakṛtirucyate || 118 || dṛḍhāṅgaḥ sthiracittaśca suprajaḥ sthiramūrdhajaḥ || śuklāmbudarśau svapne ca kaphaprakṛtiko naraḥ || 119 || tāmasā rājasāścaiva sāttvikāśca tathā smṛtāḥ || mānuṣā bhṛguśārdūla vātapittakaphādhikāḥ || 2.56.120 || rūkṣaśītavyavāyādhvaguru karma pravartate || kadannabhojanādvāyurdehe śokācca kupyati || 121 || vidāhināṃ tathoṣṇānāmuccairadhvaniṣeviṇām || pittaṃ prakopamāyāti bhayena ca tathā dvija || 122 || atyaṃbupānaviṣamabhojināṃ bhuvi śāyinām || śleṣmā prakopamāyāti tathā ye cālpabhojanāḥ || 123 || vātapittakaphotthāni sarvarogāṇi dehinām || lakṣayellakṣaṇaṃ vidvāñśamayettadanantaram || 124 || asthibhaṅgaḥ kaṣāyitvamāsye śuṣkāsyatā tathā || jṛṃbhaṇaṃ lomaharṣaśca vātikavyādhilakṣaṇam || 125 || nakhanetraśirāṇāṃ ca pītatā kaṭutā mukhe ||| tṛṣṇā dāho'mlatā caiva pittavyādhinidarśanam ||| 126 || ālasyaṃ ca prasekaśca gurutā madhurāsyatā || uṣṇābhilāṣitā ceti ślaiṣmikaṃ vyādhi lakṣaṇam || 127 || snigdhoṣṇamannaṃ sasukhā ca śayyā mano'nukūlāḥ suhṛdaḥ kathāśca || abhyañjanaṃ cāpyatitailapānaṃ vātaprakopapraśamāya dṛṣṭam ||| || 128 || sarāṃsi vāpyaḥ saritaḥ suśītāścandrāṃśavaścandanapaṅkalepāḥ || saṃsevitenāśu śamaṃ prayāti vilāsamagryaṃ manasaḥ praharṣāt || 129 || sarvāmayārtipraśamārthamekāṃ tvamoṣadhīṃ rāma nibodha guhyām|| bhaktiḥ prabhordevavarasya viṣṇoryā sarvakāmaiḥ puruṣaṃ yunakti || 2.56.130 || || iti śrīviṣṇudhamottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0 saṃ0 puruṣacikitsānāma ṣaṭpañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 56 || <2.57> || rāma uvāca || || ārogyakaraṇaṃ nāma dvitīyā pratipattathā || ārogyadaṃ vrataṃ caiva vaiṣṇavaṃ kathayasva me || 1 || || puṣkara uvāca || || dhaniṣṭhāsu mahābhāga yajamānapurohitau ||| upoṣya vāruṇaṃ snānaṃ yajamānasya kārayet || 2 || kṛtvā kumbhaśataṃ sāgraṃ śaṃkhamuktāphalodakaiḥ || bhadrāsanopaviṣṭastaiḥ snātaścaivāhatāmbaraḥ || 3 ||| keśavaṃ vāruṇaṃ candraṃ nakṣatraṃ vāruṇaṃ tathā || pūjayetprayato rāma gandhamālyānulepanaiḥ || 4 || dhūpadīpanamaskāraistathā caivānnasampadā || devatānāṃ yathoktānāṃ kurvīta havanaṃ tathā || 5 || sarvauṣadhaistathājyena yathāśakti vidhānataḥ || gurave vāsasī deye rasakumbhaṃ ca kāñcanam|| 6 || brāhmaṇānāṃ pradātavyā vittaśaktyā ca dakṣiṇā || śamīśālmalijaiḥ patraivaṃśāgreṇa tathaiva ca || 7 || trivṛtastu baliḥ kāryaḥ sarvarogavināśanaḥ || śākāni haritaṃ mālyaṃ sarvasasyāni vāsasī || varuṇāyāśu nikṣipya gandhairdhūpairnivedayet ||8 || alaṅghyamānasya hi vāruṇaṃ taṃ snānena dānena kṛtena samyak || rogāḥ samastāḥ praśamaṃ prayānti baddhastathā mokṣamavāpnuyācca || 9 || || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0 saṃ0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne śatabhiṣāsnānavarṇanaṃ nāma saptapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 57 || <2.58> || puṣkara uvāca || || pauṣaśukladvitīyāyāṃ gavāṃ śṛṅgodakena tu || snātvā śuklāmbaro bhūtvā sūryestaṃ samupāgate || 1 || bālendoḥ pūjanaṃ kṛtvā gandhamālyānulepanaiḥ || dhūpadīpanamaskāraistathā caivānnasampadā || 2 || dadhnā ca paramānnena guḍena lavaṇena ca || pūjanairbrāhmaṇānāṃ ca pūjayitvā niśākaram || 3 || yāvadastaṃ na yātīndustāvadeva samācaret || āhāraṃ gorasaprāyamadhaḥśāyī niśaṃ nayet || 4 || tataḥ saṃvatsare pūrṇe saumyamāse dvijottama || bālendoḥ pūjanaṃ kṛtvā brāhmaṇānāṃ ca pūjanam || 5 || vāsasī rasakumbhaṃ ca kāñcanaṃ ca dvijātaye || dattvā ca pūjayitvā ca vratapāraṅgato bhavet || 6 || vratenānena dharmajña rogamevaṃ vyapohati || sarvasaukhyaṃ tathā dravyaṃ puṣṭiṃ ca manujottama || 7 || kāmaṃ samāpnotyathavaikamiṣṭaṃ yena vratenātha samastadharmam || abhyāsatastasya samastakāmānnaraḥ samāpnoti kimatra citram || 8 || || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0 saṃ0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne āroyadvitīyānāmāṣṭapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 58 || <2.59> || puṣkara uvāca || || saṃvatsarāvasāne tu pañcadaśyāmupoṣitaḥ || pūjayedbhāskaraṃ devaṃ varṇakaiḥ kamale kṛte || 1 || śuklena gandhamālyena candanena sitena ca || tathā kūrmeṇa dhūpena ghṛtadīpena bhārgava || 2 || apūpaiḥ saikatairdadhnā paramānnena bhūriṇā || odanena ca śuklena sitālavaṇasarpiṣā || 3 || kṣīreṇa ca phalaiḥ śuklairvahnibrāhmaṇatarpaṇaiḥ || pūjayitvā jagaddhāma dinabhāge caturthake || 4 || āhāraṃ prathamaṃ kuryātsaghṛtaṃ manujottamaḥ || rasaṃ ca manujaśreṣṭha ghṛtahīnaṃ vivarjayet || 5 || bhuktvā ca sakṛdevānnaṃ nāhāraṃ samupācaret || pānīyapānaṃ kurvīta brāhmaṇānumate punaḥ || 6 || saṃvatsaramidaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ kṛtvā trayodaśam || pūjanaṃ devadevasya tasminnahani bhārgava || 7 || samāpayedvrataṃ puṇyaṃ rāma kumbhaṃ dvijātaye || sahiraṇyaṃ savastraṃ ca tathā dadyāddvijottama || 8 || vratenānena dharmajña rogameva vyapohati || ārogyamāpnoti gatiṃ tathāgryāṃ yaśastathāgryaṃ vipulāṃśca bhogān || vratena samyakpuruṣo dhanārthī sampūjayedyaśca jagatpradhānam || 9 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0saṃ0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne arogyapratipannāmaikonaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 59 || <2.60> puṣkara uvāca || śuklapakṣāvasāne tu yadrāma dinapañcakam || tatra sampūjayedviṣṇuṃ vidhinā yena taṃ śṛṇu || 1 || gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhisarpistathaiva ca | ekaikena caretsnānamekādaśyādiṣu kramāta || 2 || kaupatāḍāganādeyaiḥ padminīsārasairjalaiḥ || kartavyaṃ kramaśaḥ snānaṃ snātaḥ sampūjayeddharim || 3 || tailamikṣurasaṃ kṣaudraṃ kṣīraṃ sarpiśca bhārgava || snapayeddevadevasya kartavyaṃ syāddinakramāt || 4 || kālāgurumuśīraṃ ca tathā jātīphalaṃ dvija || karpūraṃ candanaṃ caiva kalpayedanulepane ||5|| kusumeṣvambujāteṣu gandhavatsu siteṣu ca || ekaikaṃ kalpayejjātiṃ śraddhayā divasakramāt ||6|| kṛṣṇā gaurī tathā tāmrā kapilā ca sitā tathā|| || yā dhenustadghṛtaṃ deyaṃ dīpārthaṃ divasakramāt || 7 māṣamudgakalāpānāṃ caṇakasya tilasya ca || bhakṣyāṇi vinivedyāni tathaiva divasakramāt || 8 || phāṇitaṃ ca guḍaṃ caiva tathā matsyaṇḍikā śubhā || khaṇḍaṃ ca śarkarāṃ caiva kramaśo vinivedayet ||9 || kṣīravṛkṣasya samidhastathā dūrvāstilānapi ||| siddhārthakānyathājyaṃ ca bhāvayeddivasakramāt || 2.60.10 || aniruddhāya devāya pradyumnāya tathaiva ca || saṃkarṣaṇāya devāya vāsudevāya cāpyatha || 11 || nāmnā tu juhuyādvahniṃ praṇavenāntime'hani || ayaḥ sīsaṃ tathā tāmraṃ rajataṃ kanakaṃ tathā || 12 || dakṣiṇārthaṃ pradātavyaṃ dvijebhyo divasakramāt || naktaṃ ca gorasaprāyaṃ bhoktavyaṃ tailavarjitam || 13 || bhūśodhanaṃ ca kartavyaṃ devasya puratastathā || gītavādyastavaiścaiva pūjayeddinapañcakam || 14 || evaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ kṛtvā sarvānrogānvyapohati || grahaṇe ca vratasyāsya na kālaniyamaḥ smṛtaḥ || 15 || nityābhyāsena caivāsya viṣṇuloke mahīyate|| vrataṃ śreṣṭhamidaṃ proktaṃ mayā te bhṛgunandana || 16 || dhanyaṃ yaśasyaṃ ripunāśakāri saubhāgyadaṃ pāpaharaṃ pavitram || āyuṣyamagryaṃ sugatipradaṃ ca vratottamaṃ vighnavināśanaṃ ca ||17|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0saṃ0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne ārogyavratannāma ṣaṣṭitamodhyāyaḥ || 60 || <2.61> puṣkara uvāca || rājadharmavrataṃ śreṣṭhaṃ kṛtvā puruṣavigraham || pūruṣānviniyuñjīta cottamādhamakarmasu || 1|| grāmasyādhipatiṃ kuryāddaśagrāmādhipaṃ tathā || śatagrāmādhipaṃ cāpi tathaiva viṣayeśvaram || 2 || teṣāṃ bhāgavibhāgaśca bhavetkarmānurūpataḥ || nityameva tathā kāryaṃ teṣāṃ cāraiḥ parīkṣayet || 3 || grāmadoṣānsamutpannāngrāmeśaḥ praśamaṃ nayen || aśaktau deśapālasya sa tu gatvā nivedayet || 4 || śrutvā tu deśapālopi tatra yuktimupācaret || sopyaśaktaḥ śateśāya yathāvadvinivedayet || 5 || śateśo viṣayeśāya sopi rājñe nivedayet || aśaktau śaktimān rāma svayaṃ yuktimupācaret || 6 || rājā sarvātmanā kuryādviṣaye rāma rakṣaṇam || vittamāpnoti dharmajña viṣayācca surakṣitāt || 7 || ripughātasamarthaḥ syādvittavāneva pārthivaḥ || paracakropamardeṣu vittavāneva mucyate || 8 || vittavāneva sahati sudīrghamapi vigraham || bahudaṇḍānapi parāṃstathā bhindyāddhanādhipaḥ || 9 || anne prāṇāḥ prajāḥ sarvā dhane tacca pratiṣṭhitam || dhanavāndharmamāpnoti dhanavānkāmamaśnute || 2.61.10 || yasyārthastasya mitrāṇi yasyārthastasya bandhavāḥ || yasyārthaḥ sa pumām̐lloke yasyārthaḥ sopi paṇḍitaḥ || 11 || arthena hi vihīnasya puruṣasyālpamedhasaḥ || vicchidyante kriyāḥ sarvā grīṣme kusarito yathā ||12|| viśeṣo nāsti lokeṣu patitasyādhanasya ca || patitānāṃ na gṛhṇanti daridro na prayacchati ||13 || dhanahīnasya bhāryāpi naiva syādvaśavartinī || guṇaughamapi caivāsya naiva kaścitprakāśayet || 14 || bāndhavā vinivartante dhanahīnāttathā narāt || yathā puṣpaphalairhīnācchakuntā dvija pādapāt || || 15 || dāridryamaraṇe cobhe keṣāṃcitsadṛśe mate || satyaṃ hāsāddaridrasya mṛtaḥ śreyānmate mama || 16 || kośaṃ rājyatarormūlaṃ tasmādyatnaṃ tadarjane || dharmeṇaiva tataḥ kuryānnādharmeṇa kathaṃcana || 17 || dhanairadharmasamprāptairyaddṛḍhaṃ hi pidhīyate || tadeva yāti vistāraṃ vināśāya durātmanām ||18 || sukṛtasya purāṇasya balena balināṃ vara || yadyadharmātphalaṃ śīghraṃ nāpnuvanti durātmanaḥ || 19 || tathāpi pūrvakarmānte tena pāpena karmaṇā || vinaśyanti samūlāste saputradhanabāndhavāḥ || 2.61.20 || narakeṣu tathā teṣāṃ yātanā vividhāḥ smṛtāḥ || bahūnyabdasahasrāṇi ye nṛpā rāṣṭrapīḍakāḥ || 21 || nityaṃ rājñā tathā bhāvyaṃ garbhiṇīsahadharmiṇā || yathā svaṃ sukhamutsṛjya garbhasya sukhamāvahet | 22 || garbhiṇī tadvadeveha bhāvyaṃ bhūpatinā sadā || prajāsukhaṃ tu kartavyaṃ sukhamuddiśya cātmanaḥ || 23 || kiṃ yajñaistapasā tasya prajā yasya surakṣitāḥ || surakṣitāḥ prajāstasya svargastasya gṛhopamaḥ || || 24 || arakṣitāḥ prajā yasya narakaṃ tasya mandiram || rājā ṣaḍbhāgamādatte sukṛtādduṣkṛtādapi || 25 || dharmo nāma mahābhāga sampadrakṣaṇa tatparaḥ || arakṣitastathā sarvaṃ pāpamāpnoti bhārgava || 26 || naiva kiñcidavāpnoti puṇyabhākpṛthivīpatiḥ || āpannamapi dharmiṣṭhaṃ prajā rakṣatyathāpadi| | 27 || tasmāddharmārthakāmena prajā rakṣyā mahīkṣitā || subhagaiścātha durvṛttarājavallabhataskaraiḥ || 28 || bhakṣyamāṇāḥ prajā rakṣyā kāyasthaiśca viśeṣataḥ || rakṣitāstadbhayebhyastu prajā rājñāṃ bhavanti tāḥ || 29 || arakṣitā sā bhavati teṣāmeveha bhojanam || sādhusaṃrakṣaṇārthāya rājā duṣṭa nibarhaṇam || 2.61.30 || tṛṇānāmiva nirmātā sadā kuryājjitendriyaḥ || śāstroktaṃ balimādadyāddharmaṃ tattasya jīvitam || 31 || tasya santyajanaṃ rājā na samṛddhopi kārayet || ākārāṇi ca sarvāṇi śulkaṃ śāstrodito baliḥ || 32 || daṇḍaṃ vinayanādrājño dharmyaṃ tattasya jīvitam || dhartā karāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ prabhurukto mahīpatiḥ || 33 || nidhiṃ purāṇaṃ saṃprāpya keśavaṃ tu praveśayet || arthaṃ brāhmaṇasātkuryāddharmakāmo mahīpatiḥ || || 34 || nidhiṃ dvijottamaḥ prāpya gṛhṇīyātsakalaṃ tathā || jagatosya samagrasya prabhurukto dvijottamaḥ || 35|| nidhiṃ jñātvā purāṇaṃ tu kṣatraviṭśūdrayonayaḥ || nivedayeyurbhūpāya rājā labdhvāpi taṃ nidhim || 36 || caturthamaṣṭamaṃ cāṃśaṃ tathā ṣoḍaśamaṃ dvija || varṇakrameṇa visṛjedākhyātaṃ dharma kāraṇam || 37 || te'pi labdhvā tadā tena saṃvibhajya dvijottamān || śeṣeṇa kuryuḥ kāmārthau viditau pṛthivīpateḥ || 38 || prakāśavibhavo loke yasya rājñaḥ sa bhūpatiḥ || aprakāśadhano yastu narakaṃ tasya mandiram || 39 || mamedamiti yo brūyānnidhiṃ satyena mānavaḥ || tasyādadīta nṛpatirbhāgamabrāhmaṇasya tu || 2.61.40 || caturviṃśatikaṃ rāma dvādaśaṃ ṣaṣṭhameva ca || kṣatriyāśca tathā vaiśyāḥ śūdrāśca bhṛgunandana || 41 || anṛtaṃ ca vadandaṇḍyaḥ svavittasyāṃśamaṣṭakam || praṇaṣṭasvāmikaṃ rikthaṃ rājā tryabdaṃ nidhāpayet || 42 || arvāktryabdāddharetsvāmī pareṇa nṛpatirharet || mamedamiti yo brūyādanuyukto yathāvidhi || 43 || saṃpādya rūpaṃ dravyādīnsvāmī taddravyamarhati || avedayāno naṣṭasya deśaṃ kālaṃ ca tattvataḥ || || 44 || varṇarūpaṃ pramāṇaṃ ca tatsamaṃ daṇḍamarhati || nidhivadbhāgamādadyātpranaṣṭādhigatānnṛpaḥ ||45|| bāladāyādikaṃ rikthaṃ tāvadrājā tu pālayet || yāvatsa syātsamāvṛtto yāvadvātītaśaiśavaḥ || 46 || bālaputreṣu caivaṃ syādrakṣaṇaṃ niṣkulāsu ca || pativratāsu ca strīṣu vidhavāsvāturāsu ca || || 47 || jīvantīnāṃ tu tāsāṃ ye dhārayeyuḥ svabāndhavāḥ || tāñchiṣyāccauradaṇḍena dhārmikaḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ || 48 || sarveṣāmeva varṇānāṃ caurairapahṛtaṃ dhanam || tatpramāṇaṃ svakātkośāddātavyamavidhārayan || 49 || tatastu paścātkartavyaṃ caurānveṣaṇamañjasā || caurarakṣādhikāribhyo rājāpi tadavāpnuyāt || 2.61.50 || ahṛte ca tathā vitte hṛtamityeva vādinam || nirdhanaṃ pārthivaḥ kṛtvā viṣayātsvādvivāsayet || 51 || na tadrājñā pradātavyaṃ gṛhe yatparicārakaiḥ || pracaradbhirhṛtaṃ dravyaṃ kāryaṃ tatrānvavekṣaṇam || 52 || svarāṣṭrapaṇyādādadyādrājā viṃśatimaṃ dvija || śulkāṃśaṃ paradeśācca nibodha gadato mama || 53 || kṣayavyayapravāsāṃśca yathāyāmaṃ dvijottama || jñātvā tu kalpayettatra śulkāṃśaṃ pṛthavīpatiḥ || 54 || tathā kāryaṃ yathā lābhaṃ vaṇijaḥ samavāpnuyuḥ || puṇyacchedaśca naiva syātsvadeśe pṛthavīpateḥ || 55 || vyayaṃ śulkapravāsādi laṅghayitvā tathā dvija || viṃśāṃśabhāgamādadyurdaṇḍanīyā atonyathā || 56 || diśi diśyekameva syācchulkasthānaṃ nṛpasya tu || tadatikramato dravyaṃ rājagāmi vidhīyate || 57 || dūtānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca rājājñāgāmināṃ tathā || strīṇāṃ pravrajitānāṃ ca tāraśulkaṃ vivarjayet || 58 || bhinnakarṣāpaṇaṃ śulkaṃ na grāhyaṃ pṛthivīkṣitā || tāreṣu dāśadoṣeṇa naṣṭaṃ dāśātpradāpayet || 59 || daivadoṣavinaṣṭaṃ ca naṣṭaṃ yasyaiva tasya tat || śūkadhānyeṣu ṣaḍbhāgaṃ śiṃbidhānyeṣvathāṣṭakam || 2.61.60 || rājā balyarthamādadyāddeśakālānurūpakam || rājāṃśabhāgamādadyādrājā paśuhiraṇyayoḥ || 61 || gandhauṣadhirasānāṃ ca puṣpamūlaphalasya ca || patraśākatṛṇānāṃ ca vatsareṇa ca carmaṇām || 65 || vaidalānāṃ ca bhāṃḍānāṃ sarvasyāśmamayasya ca || ṣaḍbhāgameva cādadyādbrāhmaṇebhyastathā karam || 63 || tebhyastaddharmalābhena rājño lābhaḥ paraṃ bhavet || na ca kṣudhāvasīdeta śrotriyo viṣaye vasan || 64 || yasya rājñastu viṣaye śrotriyaḥ sīdati kṣudhā || tasya sīdati tadrāṣṭraṃ durbhikṣavyādhitaskaraiḥ || 65 || śrutavṛtte tu vijñāya vṛttiṃ tasya prakalpayet || rakṣecca sarvatastvenaṃ pitā putramivaurasam || 66 || saṃrakṣyamāṇo rājñā yaḥ kurute dharma saṃgraham || tenāyurvarddhate rājño draviṇaṃ rāṣṭrameva ca || 67 || karma kuryurnarendrasya māsenaikaṃ ca śilpinaḥ || bhaktamātreṇa ye cānye svaśarīropajīvinaḥ || 68 || snātānuliptāśca vibhūṣitāśca veśyāṅganāvāravivartitena || saṃvītagātraḥ pṛthivīśvarasya sadābhyupāsāṃ paritastrikuryuḥ || ||69|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare mā0saṃ0 dvitīyakhaṇḍe rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne rājadharmavarṇanonāmaikaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||61||| <2.62> puṣkara uvāca || dharmaścārthaśca kāmaśca puruṣārthaḥ paraḥ smṛtaḥ || anyonyarakṣaṇātteṣāṃ sevā kāryā mahīkṣitā || 1 || dharmamūlorthaviṭapastathā kāmaphalo mahān || trivargapādapastasya rakṣaṇātphalabhāgbhavet || 2 || dharmāvirodhinī kāryā kāmasevā sadaiva tu || mūlacchede bhavennāśo viṭapasya phalasya ca ||3 || kāmasevāvihīnasya dharmārthāvapi niṣphalau || oṣadhīnāṃ phalārthāya kīnāśo yatnavāṃstathā ||4|| kāmārthī yatnavānevaṃ lobho dharmārthayordvija || kāmasyāpi paraṃ nāryo dharmarāgamadotkaṭāḥ || 5 || tadarthaṃ ratnanidhayo vibhavāśca tathā pare || gītaṃ vādyaṃ sumadhuraṃ bhojyaṃ pānaṃ srajistathā ||6|| bhūṣaṇāni sugandhīni tadarthaṃ sarvameva hi || tapaścāpi tapasyanti duḥkhaṃ paramupāśritāḥ || 7 || durgamāṇi ca tīrthāni vrajanti puruṣāstathā || tyajanti samare prāṇānprāṇebhyo'pyadhikaṃ dhanam || 8 || tyajanti brahmaṇādibhyastathā svargepsavo janāḥ || svargasyāpi dhanaṃ rāma kāraṇaṃ viddhi bhārgava || 9 || tā eva capalāpāṅgavikṣepavijitāḥ prajāḥ || kṣayameva kṣayaṃ tasya yasya nādhyasitaṃ sadā || 2.62.10 || adhaḥ kṛtvendubimbāgravadanābhiḥ purandhribhiḥ || tasyaikaṃ saphalaṃ janma sampadaśca manorathāḥ || 11 || yasyaitāścañcalāpāṅgyastaruṇyo vaśamāgatāḥ || sevyāstā nātisevyāśca bhūbhujā vijigīṣuṇā || 12 || asevanādvṛthā janma doṣagrāmo'tisevanāt || ūrustambhatrayaṃ proktaṃ śarīreṣu śarīriṇām || 13 || āhāraṃ maithunaṃ nidrā yairvṛtaṃ sakalaṃ jagat || asevanādathaitasya tathaivātyantasevanāt || 14 || rogagrāmo nṛṇāṃ dehe sambhavatyatidāruṇaḥ || viśvāsamatisaktiṃ ca tīkṣṇatāṃ strīṣu varjayet || 15 || na cādhikāre kartavyā bhūṣaṇācchādanāśanaiḥ || suvibhaktāśca kartavyā lālanīyāstathaiva ca || 16 || jñeyau rāgāparāgau ca tathā tāsāṃ viśeṣataḥ || nārī rāgavate loke nānṛtena viśiṣyate || 17 || viraktābhirmahīpāla chadmanā bahavo hatāḥ || dviṣṭānyācarate yā tu nābhinandati tatkathām || 18 || aikyaṃ dviṣadbhirvrajati garvaṃ vahati coddhatā || cumbitā mārṣṭi vadanaṃ dattaṃ na bahumanyate || 19 || svapityādau prasuptāpi tathā paścādvibudhyati || spṛṣṭvā dhunoti gātrāṇi kāntaṃ caiva ruṇaddhi yā || 2.62.20 || īṣatsmitena vākyāni priyāṇyapi parāṅmukhī || nayatyaśrutavadyā tu jaghanaṃ ca vigūhati ||21 || dṛṣṭe vivarṇavadanā mitreṣvapi parāṅmukhī || tatkāmitāsu ca strīṣu madhyasthaiva ca lakṣyate || 22 || jñātamaṅgalakālāpi na karoti ca maṇḍanam || yā sā viraktā raktā ca nibodha gadato mama || 23 || dṛṣṭvaiva hṛṣṭā bhavati vīkṣate ca parāṅmukham || dṛśyamānā tathānyatra dṛṣṭiṃ kṣipati cañcalām || 24 || tathāpyapāvartayati naiva śaknotyaśeṣataḥ || vivṛṇoti tathāṅgāni suguhyānyapi bhārgava || 25 || garhitaṃ ca tathaivāṃgaṃ prayatnena vigūhate || taddarśanena kurute bālāliṅganacumbanam || 26 || ābhāṣyamāṇā bhavati sannavākyā tathaiva ca|| spṛṣṭvā pulakitairaṃgaiḥ sakhe dairvāpi bhajyate || 27 || karoti ca tathā rāma sulabhadravyayācanam || tataḥ svalpamapi prāpya prayāti paramāṃ mudam || 28 || nāma saṃkīrtanādeva muditā bahu manyate || karajāṅkākitānyasya phalāni preṣayatyapi || 29 || tatpreṣitāni hṛdaye vinyasyatyapi cādarāt || āliṅganaiśca gātrāṇi limpantīvāmṛtena ca || 2.62.30 || supte svapityathādau tu tathā tasya vibudhyate || ūrū spṛśati cātyarthaṃ suptaṃ cainaṃ vicumbate || 31 || evaṃ raktāṃ tu vijñāya kāmayetātmavānnaraḥ || kāmaṃ ca bhojanaṃ sakhyaṃ jñeyāḥ kṛtrimaputrikāḥ || 32 || svīkartumicchanbālāyāḥ krīḍanādistathaiva ca || gandhamālyapradānena yauvanasthāṃ vaśaṃ nayet || 33 || vastrabhūṣaṇadānena tayā yauvanavicyutām || krīḍāsādhupriyā bālā tathā yauvanavicyutā || 34 || ratipriyā tu vijñeyā taruṇī cobhayapriyā || ātmasaṃbhāvanā strīṣu na kartavyā kathaṃcana || 35 || asūyā jāyate'tyarthamātmasaṃbhāvite nare || na cāsāṃ darśanaṃ deyaṃ na cātyantamadarśanam || 36 || ubhayenāpyathaitāsāmutkaṇṭhā tu vihanyate || hṛdyaiḥ suvihitairbhogairgandhayuktaiśca kauśalaiḥ || kāryamārādhanaṃ strīṇāṃ ratikāmaiḥ sadaiva tu || 37 || evaṃ sadā yastu karoti rāma strīcetasāṃ svīkaraṇaṃ manuṣyaḥ || tasyāntarāyā na bhavanti kiñcitstrīdvāramāsādya sadāsapatnaḥ ||38 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0saṃ0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne antaḥpuracintā nāma dviṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 62|| <2.63> rāma uvāca || kalpanā bhojanīyānāṃ gandhānāṃ yā ca kalpanā || tānahaṃ śrotumicchāmi tvatto dharmabhṛtāṃ vara ||1 || puṣkara uvāca || bhojyaṃ bhakṣyaṃ tathā lehyaṃ coṣyaṃ pānaṃ tathaiva ca || kalpanā pañcadhā rāma bhojyasyaiṣā prakīrtitā || 2 || abhyāsagamyā cāpyeṣā vaktavyaṃ tatra me śṛṇu || kaṭutoyodakaṃ kvāthaṃ śodhitānāmasaṃśayam || 3 || purāṇadhānyajātīnāṃ gandhamāśu vinaśyati || śreṣṭhaṃ sārṣapakaṃ tailaṃ śākānāṃ pariśodhane || 4 || māṃsaṃ kāṭhinyamāyāti kaumalyaṃ cārdrakāmbunā || varuṇakṣārasaṃyogānmatsyasyāsthi vilīyate || || 5 || gaṇḍikābhiḥ palāśasya kṣīramāyāti pakvatām || kapitthacūrṇayogena tathā caiva sujātakaiḥ || 6 || ghṛtaiḥ sugandhī bhavati dagdhaiḥ kṣiptaistathā yavaiḥ || padmavāriṇi yogena kāñjikasyāmlatā bhavet || 7 || guḍādyaṃ śuddhimāpnoti kṣīreṇa ca tathā yutam || padmarāgasamaṃ varṇaṃ cāṃśumatyāḥ prajāyate || 8 || pānakānāṃ mahābhāga yasyāpyanyasya cecchati || kṣārayogena cāmlasya tathāmlatvaṃ vinaśyati || 9 || lavaṇādhikavikṣepaṃ saṃjātavirasaṃ dhruvam || sikatāpiṇḍikākṣepaiḥ surasatvamavāpnuyāt || 2.63.10 || caṇakakṣārayogena puṣpāṇi ca phalāni ca || sarvāṇi drutimāyānti drutānāṃ kalpanā bhavet || 11 || gandhavarṇarasādhānaṃ pānakādiṣu sarvataḥ || yathākālaṃ yathādeśaṃ yathāsātmyaṃ ca kārayet || 12 || nātyarthadīptena hutāśanena nātyantamandena ca sādhyamannam|| rasaṃ na cāpyatra bhavetprabhūtaṃ nātyalpametatkathitaṃ mayā te||13|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0saṃ0 śrīparaśurāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne bhojyakalpano nāma triṣaṣṭitamodhyāyaḥ||63|| <2.64> puṣkara uvāca|| śodhanaṃ vasanaṃ caiva tathaiva ca virecanam || bhāvanā caiva pākaśca bodhanaṃ dhūpanaṃ tathā || 1 || vāsanaṃ caiva nirdiṣṭaṃ karmāṣṭakamidaṃ śubham || kapitthabilvajambāmrabījapūrakapallavaiḥ || 2 || kṛtvodakaṃ tu yaddravyaṃ śodhitaṃ śaucitaṃ tu tat || teṣāmabhāve śaucaṃ tu mṛtadarśāmbhasā bhavet || 3 || tadabhāve tu kartavyaṃ tadā mustāmbhasā dvija||| śuṣkaṃ śuṣkaṃ punardravyaṃ pañcapallavavāriṇā || 4 || prakṣālitaṃ cāpyasakṛdvamitaṃ tatprakīrtitam || pañcapallavatoyena kvāthayitvā punaḥpunaḥ || 5 || dravyaṃ saṃśoṣitaṃ kṛtvā cūrṇaṃ tasya tu kārayet || harītakīṃ tataḥ piṣṭvā pañcapallavavāriṇā || 6 || tena pathyākaṣāyeṇa taccūrṇaṃ bhāvayetsakṛt || śoṣitaṃ śodhayedetadvirekaṃ tatprakīrtitam || 7 || tatastu gandhadravyeṇa yatheṣṭaṃ kuṅkumādinā || bhāvayettena taddravyaṃ bhāvanā sā prakīrtitā || 8 || tenaiva bhāvayeddravyaṃ pañcapallavavāriṇā || āśvatthenaiva tenātha dravyaṃ rāma tathāstu tat || 9 || mṛdā pihitasattvo tu mṛṇmaye bhājanadvaye|| vipacettu vidhūmāgnāvartadhūmaḥ punaḥpunaḥ ||2.64.10|| tāveva kvāthayettāvattatraivānugato rasaḥ || etatpākavidhānaṃ te pañcamaṃ parikīrtitam ||11|| tatastu bhāvanādravyaṃ kalkapiṣṭaṃ niyojayet || kalkapiṣṭe tathā dravye bodhanaṃ parikīrtitam || 12 ||| tatastu pūjayeddravyaṃ pūrvameva tu pathyayā || tatastu guruśuktibhyāṃ candanāgarubhistataḥ || 13 || karpūramṛgadarpābhyāṃ tataścainaṃ pradhūpayet || ityetadvāsanaṃ rāma karma te'bhihitaṃ mayā ||14|| tatastu gulikāṃ kṛtvā yathākāmamatandritaḥ || puṣpairbakulajātīnāṃ tathānyeṣāṃ sugandhibhiḥ || 15 || chāyāsu śoṣyamāṇasya vāsanā kriyate tu yā || vāsanā sā vinirdiṣṭā karmaitaccāṣṭamaṃ
