śubham || 16 || karmāṣṭakamidaṃ kṛtvā vacāṃ piṇḍanibhāṃ tathā || mustaṃ śaileyakaṃ vāpi sevyaṃ vā dvijasattama || 17 || śodhayedgāndhiko vidyādyathānyatkarmasetsyati || niryāsānāṃ ca puṣpāṇāṃ karmāṣṭakamidaṃ śubham || 18 || viduṣā naiva kartavyaṃ kāryamanyatra bhārgava || aśodhitaistathā dhūpāḥ kāryā dravyairyathāvidhi || 19 || ataḥ paraṃ tu te yogānkāṃścidvakṣyāmi tāñchṛṇu || nakhaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ dhanaṃ māṃsīspṛktvā śaileyakaṃ jalam || 2.64.20 || tathaiva kuṅkumaṃ lākṣā candanāguruṇī natam || saralā devakāṣṭhaṃ ca karpūraṃ kārtayā saha||21|| bolaṃ kandurakaścaiva guggulaḥ śrīnivāsakaḥ || saha sarjaraseneyaṃ dhūpadravyaikaviṃśatiḥ || 22 || dhūpadravyagaṇādasmādekaviṃśādyathecchayā || dvedve dravye samādāya sarjabhāge niyojayet || 23 || nave piṇyākavalayaiḥ saṃyojya madhunā tathā || dhūpayogyā bhavantīha yathāvatsvecchayā kṛtāḥ || 24 || tvacaṃ jātīphalaṃ tailaṃ kuṅkumaṃ granthiparṇakam || śaileyaṃ tagaraṃ kāṣṭhaṃ tāmbūlaṃ tagaraṃ tathā ||25 || māṃsīsarāvakuṣṭhaṃ ca nava dravyāṇi nirdiśet|| etebhyastu samādāya dravyaṃ tatra yathecchayā || 26 || mṛgadarpayutaṃ snānaṃ kāryaṃ kandarpavardhanam || druksurānaladaistulyairvānyakārasamāyutaiḥ || 27 || snānamutpalagandhi syātsatailaṃ kuṅkumairyutam || jātīpuṣpasugandhi syāttagarārdhena yojitam 528 || bālakāñcanasaṃyuktaṃ pāṭalākusumāyate || savyāpakaṃ syādbakulaistulyagandhi manoharam || 29 || nālikāvaṃśasahitaṃ kuṭṭipādena cāryakam || dvikesaraṃ veṇupādaṃ kundapuṣpāyate tathā || 2.64.30|| śailapādārthasaṃyuktaṃ vyaktaṃ madanakaṃ bhavet || mañjiṣṭhā tagaraṃ bālaṃ dvayaṃ vyāghranakhaṃ nakham || 31 || gandhapatraṃ ca vinyasya gandhatailaṃ bhavecchubham || tailaṃ niṣpīḍitaṃ rāma tilaiḥ puṣpādhivāsitaiḥ || 32 || vāsanāpuṣpasadṛśaṃ gandhane tu bhaveddrutam || pūrvavacchodhayitvā tu mustaṃ sevyaṃ vacāṃ niśām || 33 || abhīṣṭamanyatkaluṣaṃ yathāvadanulepayet || uddhṛtya candanādiṃ ca śodhanaṃ vamanaṃ tathā || 34 || varjayitvā virekaṃ ca śeṣakarmāṇi kārayet || tadvā bhavati dharmajña varṇakaṃ tridivapriyam || 35 || paṭavāsāṃsi kāryāṇi varṇakaiḥ ślakṣṇacūrṇitaiḥ || elālavaṅgakakkolajātīphalaniśākarāḥ || 36 || jātipatrikayā sārddhaṃ svatantraṃ mukhavāsakam || karpūraṃ kuṅkumaṃ kāntaṃ mṛgadarpaṃ hareṇukam || 37 || kakkolailālavaṅgaṃ ca jātī kośakameva ca || drukpatraṃ truṭimustaṃ ca latākastūrikaṃ tathā || 38 || kaṇṭakāni lavaṅgasya phalapatraiśca jātitaḥ || kaṭukaṃ ca phalaṃ rāma karṣikāṇḍāṃ prakalpayet ||39|| taccūrṇe khādiraṃ sāraṃ dadyāttulyatulārpitam || sahakaṇyārasenāsya kartavyā gulikāḥ śubhāḥ || 2.64.40 || mukhe nyastāḥ sugaṃdhāstā mukharogavināśanāḥ || pūrvaṃ prakṣālitaṃ samyakpadyapallavavāriṇā || 41 || śaktyā tu gulikadravyairvāsikaṃ mukhavāsakam || kaṭukaṃ dantakāṣṭhaṃ ca gomūtre vāsitaṃ tryaham || 42 || kṛtaṃ ca pūgavadrāma mukhasaugandhyakārakam || tvakpathyayoḥ samāvaṃśau sitabhāgārdhasaṃyutau || 43 || nāgavallīsamo bhāti mukhavāso manoharaḥ ||44|| kaṭukaphalanatāmbutvaktruṭivyādhipattrairnaladanatasurābhistulyabhāgānvitāni || dviguṇitakṛtamātrāprātikakkolasaimyaiḥ śaśirasarasamo'yaṃ gandhapatraṃ vidadhyāt || 45 || nihitamidamanarghaṃ karṇapatraṃ yuvatyāḥ śamayati vividhāni śrotrapālīgadāni || aparamapi ca yāvatkāmamāmodamattuṃ bhramadalipaṭalena vyāpyate vaktrabhāgaḥ ||46 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṃḍe mā0 saṃ0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne gandhayuktirnāma catuṣṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||64|| <2.65> puṣkara uvāca || evaṃ kuryātsadā strīṇāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ pṛthivīpatiḥ || na cemāṃ viśvasejjātu putramātrāviśeṣataḥ || 1 || na svapetstrīgṛhe rātrau viśvāsaṃ kṛtrimaṃ bhajet || rājaputrasya rakṣāṃ ca kartavyā pṛthivīkṣitā || 2 || ācāryaiścāsya kartavyaṃ nityaṃ yuktyaiva rakṣaṇam || dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ dhanurvedaṃ ca śikṣayet || 3|| rathe'śve kuñjare cainaṃ vyāyāmaṃ kārayetsadā || śilpāni śikṣayeccaivamāptairmithyā priyaṃvadaiḥ || 4 || śarīrarakṣāvyājena rakṣiṇo'sya niyojayet || na cāsya saṅgo dātavyaḥ kruddhalubdhavimānitaiḥ || 5 || tathā ca vinayedenaṃ yathāyauvanagaṃ sukhe || viṣayairyairna kṛṣyeta satāṃ mārgātsudurgamāt || 6 || guṇādhānaṃ na śakyaṃ tu yasya kartuṃ svabhāvataḥ || bandhanaṃ tasya kartavyaṃ guptadeśe sukhānvitam || 7 || avinītakumāraṃ hi kulamāśu viśīryate || adhikāreṣu sarveṣu vinītaṃ viniyojayet || 8 || ādau svalpe tataḥ paścātkrameṇātha mahatsvapi || mṛgayāpānamakṣāṃśca varjayecca mahīpatiḥ || 9 || etānsaṃsevamānāstu vinaṣṭāḥ pṛthivīkṣitaḥ || bahavo bhṛguśārdūla yeṣāṃ saṃkhyā na vidyate || 2.65.10 || divāsvāpaṃ vṛthāvādaṃ viśeṣeṇa vivarjayeta || vākpāruṣyaṃ na kartavyaṃ daṇḍapāruṣyameva ca || 11 || parokṣanindā ca tathā varjanīyā mahīkṣitā || arthasya dūṣaṇaṃ rāma dviprakāraṃ vivarjayet || 12 || arthānāṃ dūṣaṇaṃ caikaṃ tathā cārthena dūṣaṇam || prākārāṇāṃ samucchedo durgādīnāṃ samakriyā || 13 || arthānāṃ dūṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ viprakīrṇatvameva ca || adeśakāle yaddānamapātre dānameva ca || 14|| arthaistu dūṣaṇaṃ proktamasatkarmapravartanam || kāmaḥ krodho mado mānaṃ lobho harṣastathaiva ca || 15 || jetavyamariṣaḍvargamāhustu pṛthivīkṣitām || eteṣāṃ vijayaṃ kṛtvā kāryo bhṛtyajayastataḥ || 16 || kṛtvā bhṛtyajayaṃ rājā paurajānapādāñjayet || kṛtvā ca vijayaṃ teṣāṃ śatrūnbāhyāṃstato jayet || 17 || bāhyāśca trividhā jñeyāstulyānantarakṛtrimāḥ || guravaste yathāpūrvaṃ teṣu yatnaḥ sadā bhavet || 18 || pitṛpaitāmahaṃ mitramāśritañca tathā ripoḥ || kṛtrimaṃ ca mahābhāga mitraṃ trividhamucyate || 19 || tathāpi ca guruḥ pūrvaṃ bhavettatrāpi cāśritam || svāmyamātyajanapadā balaṃ durgaṃ tathaiva ca||2.65.20|| kośo mitraṃ ca dharmajña saptāṅgaṃ rājyamucyate || saptāṅgasyāpi rājyasya mūlaṃ svāmī prakīrtitaḥ ||21|| tanmūlatvāttathāṅgānāṃ sa tu rakṣyaḥ prayatnataḥ || ṣaḍaṅgarakṣā kartavyā tena cāpi prayatnataḥ || 22 || || aṅgebhyo yastvathaikasya drohamācarate'lpadhīḥ || vadhastasya tu kartavyaḥ śīghrameva mahīkṣitā || 23 || na rājñā mṛdunā bhāvyaṃ mṛdurhi paribhūyate || na bhāvyaṃ dāruṇenāpi tīkṣṇādudvijate janaḥ || 24 || kāle mṛduryo bhavati kāle bhavati dāruṇaḥ || rājā lokadvayāpekṣī tasya lokadvayaṃ bhavet || 25 || bhṛtyaiḥ saha mahīpālaḥ parihāsaṃ vivarjayet || bhṛtyāḥ paribhavantīha nṛpaṃ harṣalasatkatham || 26 || vyasanāni ca sarvāṇi bhūpatiḥ parivarjayet || lokasaṃgrahaṇārthāya kṛtakavyasanī bhavet || || 27 || śauṇḍīryasya narendrasya nityamutkṣiptacetasaḥ || jano virāgamāyāti sadā duḥsevyabhāvataḥ || 28 || smitapūrvābhibhāṣī syātsarvasyaiva mahīpatiḥ || madhyeṣvapi mahābhāgaḥ bhrukuṭiṃ na samācaret || 29 || bhāvyaṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ śreṣṭha sthūlalakṣyeṇa bhūbhujā || sthūlalakṣyasya vaśagā sarvā bhavati medinī || 2.65.30 || adīrghasūtraśca bhavetsarvakarmasu pārthivaḥ || dīrghasūtrasya nṛpateḥ karmahānirdhruvaṃ bhavet || 31 || rāge darpe ca māne ca drohe pāpe ca karmaṇi || apriye caiva vaktavye dīrghasūtraḥ praśasyate || 32 || rājñā saṃvṛtamantreṇa saṃbhāvyaṃ dvijasattama || tasyāsaṃvṛtamantrasya jñeyāḥ sarvāpado dhruvāḥ || 33 || kṛtānyeva hi karmāṇi jñāyante yasya bhūpateḥ || nārabdhāni mahābhāga tasya syādvasudhā vaśe || 34 || mantramūlaṃ sadā rājyaṃ tasmānmantraḥ surakṣitaḥ || kartavyaḥ pṛthivīpālairmantrabhedabhayātsadā || 35 || mantravitsādhito mantraḥ saṃyatānāṃ sukhāvahaḥ || mantrabhedena bahavo vinaṣṭāḥ pṛthivīkṣitaḥ || 36|| ākārairiṅgitairgatyā ceṣṭayā bhāṣitena ca || netravaktravikāraiśca jñāyate'ntargataṃ manaḥ || 37 || na yasya kuśalaistasya vaśe sarvā vasundharā || bhavatīha mahībhartuḥ sadā bhārgavanandana || 38 || naikastu mantrayenmantraṃ na rājā bahubhiḥ saha || bahubhirmantrayetkāmaṃ rājā mantrānpṛthakpṛthak || 39 || mantriṇāmapi no kuryānmantrī mantraprakāśanam || kvacitkaścicca viśvāsyo bhavatīha sadā nṛṇām || 2.65.40 || niścayaśca tathā mantrī kārya ekena sūriṇā || bhavedvā niścayāvāptiḥ parabuddhyupajīvanāt || 41 || ekasyaiva mahībharturbhūyaḥ kārye suniścite || brāhmaṇānparyupāsīta trayyāṃ rāma munīṃśca tān || 42 || nāsacchāstraratānmūḍhāṃste hi lokasya kaṇṭakāḥ || vṛddhāṃśca nityaṃ seveta viprānvedavidaḥ śucīn || 43 || tebhyo hi śikṣedvinayaṃ vinītātmā hi nityaśaḥ || samagrāṃ vaśagāṃ kuryātpṛthivīṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || || 44 || bahavo'vinayānnaṣṭā rājānaḥ saparicchadāḥ || vanasthāścaiva rājyāni vinayātpratipedire || 45 || traividyebhyastrayīṃ vidyāddaṇḍanītiṃ ca śāśvatīm || ānvīkṣikīṃ cātmavidyāṃ vārtārambhaṃ ca lokataḥ || 46 || indriyāṇāṃ jaye yogaṃ samātiṣṭheddivāniśam || jitendriyo hi śaknoti vaśe sthāpayituṃ prajāḥ || 47 || yajeta rājā kratubhirbahubhiścāptadakṣiṇaiḥ || dharmārthaṃ caiva viprebhyo dadyādbhogāndhanāni ca ||48|| sāṃvatsarikairāptaiśca rāṣṭrādāhārayedbalim || syāccāmnāyaparo loke varteta pitṛvannṛṣu || 49 || āvṛtānāṃ gurukulāddvijānāṃ pūjanaṃ bhavet|| nṛpāṇāmakṣayo hyeṣa nidhirbrāhmo vidhīyate ||2.65.50|| na taṃ stenā nāpyamitrā haranti na ca naśyati|| tasmādrājñā nidhātavyo brāhmaṇeṣvakṣayo nidhiḥ || 51 || samottamādhamai rājā hyāhūtāḥ pālayanprajāḥ || na nivarteta saṃgrāmātkṣātraṃ vratamanusmaran 52|| saṃgrāmeṣvanivartitvaṃ prajānāṃ paripālanam || śuśrūṣā brāhmaṇānāṃ ca rājñāṃ niśreyasaṃ param || 53|| kṛpaṇānāṃ ca vṛddhānāṃ vidhavānāṃ ca yoṣitām || yogaṃ kṣemaṃ ca vṛttiṃ ca tathaiva parikalpayet || || 54 || varṇāśramavyavasthā tu tathā kāryā viśeṣataḥ || svadharmapracyutānrājā svadharme viniyojayet || 55 || āśrameṣu yathākālaṃ tailabhājanabhojanam || svayameva nayedrājā satkṛtānnavamanya ca || 56 || tāpase sarvakāryāṇi rājyamātmānameva ca || nivedayetprayatnena devavaccainamarcayet || 57 || dve prajñe veditavye ca ṛjvī vakrā ca mānavaiḥ || śaṭhāñjñātvā na seveta pratibodhaṃ tadā gatān || 58 || nāsyacchidraṃ paro vidyādvidyācchidraṃ parasya tu || gūhetkūrma ivāṅgāni rakṣedvivaramātmanaḥ || 59 || na viśvasedaviśvaste viśvaste nātiviśvaset || viśvāsādbhayamutpannaṃ mūlānyapi nikṛntati || 2.65.60 || viśvāsayeccāpi paraṃ tattvabhūtena hetunā || bakavaccintayedarthānsiṃhavacca parākramet || 61 || bakavaccāvalumpeta śaśavacca viniṣpatet || dṛḍhaprahārī ca bhavettathā sūkaravannṛpaḥ || 62 || citrākāraśca śikhivaddṛḍhabhaktastathāndhavat || bhavecca madhurābhāṣī śukakokilavannṛpaḥ ||63 || kākaśaṃkī bhavennityamajñātavasatiṃ vaset || nāparīkṣitapūrvaṃ ca bhojanaṃ śayanaṃ spṛśet || 64 || vastraṃ puṣpamalaṅkāraṃ yaccānyanmanujottama || na gāhejjanasaṃbādhaṃ na cājñātaṃ jalāśayam || 65 || nāparīkṣitapūrvaistu puruṣairāptakāribhiḥ || nārohetkuñjaraṃ vyālaṃ nādāntaṃ turagaṃ tathā || 66 || nāvijñātāṃ striyaṃ gacchennaiva cāśubhavāsasam || nārohedviṣamāṃ nāvaṃ nāparīkṣitanāvikām || 67 || ye cāsya bhūmiṃ jayato bhaveyuḥ paripanthinaḥ || tānānayedvaśaṃ sarvānsāmādibhirupakramaiḥ || 68|| yathā na syātkṛśībhāvaḥ prajānāmanavekṣayā || tathā rājñā vidhātavyaṃ svarāṣṭraṃ parirakṣatā || 69 || mohādrājā svarāṣṭraṃ yatkarṣayatyanavekṣayā || so'cirādbhraṃśate rājyājjīvitācca sabāndhavaḥ || 2.65.70 || bhṛto vatso jātabalaḥ karmayogyo yathā bhavet || tathā rāṣṭraṃ mahābhāga bhṛtaṃ karmamahadbhavet || 71 || yo rāṣṭramanugṛhṇāti rājā suparirakṣati || taṃ prajāścopajīvanti vindate sumahatphalam || 72 || duhyāddhiraṇyaṃ dhānyaṃ ca mahī rājñā surakṣitā || nityaṃ svebhyaḥ parebhyaśca yathā mātā yathā pitā || 73 || gopino hi sadā kāryaḥ saṃvibhāgaḥ priyāṇi ca || ajasramupayoktavyaṃ phalaṃ tebhyastathaiva ca || 74 || sarvaṃ karmedamāyattaṃ vidhānaṃ caiva pauruṣam || tayordaivamacintyaṃ hi pauruṣe vidyate kriyā || 75 || evaṃ mahīṃ pālayato'sya bharturlokānurāgaḥ paramo bhavettu|| lokānurāgaprabhavā hi lakṣmīrlakṣmyā bhaveccaiva paraśca lokaḥ ||76|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0saṃ0rāma puṣkarasaṃvāde rājadharmavarṇanannāma pañcaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||65|| <2.66> rāma uvāca || daive puruṣakāre ca kiṃ jyāyastadvadasva me|| atra me saṃśayo deva saṃśayacchidbhavām̐stathā || 1 || puṣkara uvāca || svameva karma daivākhyaṃ viddhi dehāntarārjitam || tasmātpauruṣameveha śreṣṭhamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ ||2|| pratikūlaṃ tathā daivaṃ pauruṣeṇa vihanyate|| maṅgalācārayuktānāṃ nityamutthānaśālinām ||3|| yeṣāṃ pūrvakṛtaṃ karma sāttvikaṃ manujottama || pauruṣeṇa vinā teṣāṃ keṣāñciddṛśyate phalam || 4 || karmaṇā prāpyate loke rājansamyaktathā phalam || pauruṣeṇāpyate rāma mārgitavyaṃ phalaṃ naraiḥ || 5 || daivameva na jānāti naraḥ pauruṣavarjitaḥ || tasmātsatkāryayuktasya daivaṃ tu saphalaṃ bhavet || 6 || pauruṣaṃ caiva sampattyā kāle phalati bhārgava || daivaṃ puruṣakāraśca kālaśca manujottama || 7 || trayametanmanuṣyasya piṇḍitaṃ syātphalāvaham || kṛṣivṛṣṭisamāyogāddṛśyante phalasiddhayaḥ || 8 || tāstu kālena dṛśyante naivākāle kathañcana || tasmātsadaiva kartavyaṃ sadharmaṃ pauruṣaṃ nṛbhiḥ || 9 || vipattāvapi yasyeha paraloke phalaṃ dhuvam || nālasāḥ prāpnuvantyarthānna ca daivaparāyaṇāḥ || tasmātsarvaprayatnena pauruṣe yatnamācaret ||2.66.1 0|| tyaktālasāndaivaparānmanuṣyānutthānayuktānpuruṣānhi lakṣmīḥ|| anviṣya yatnādvṛṇute dvijendra tasmātsamutthānavatā hi bhāvyam||11|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0saṃ0 rāmapuṣkarasaṃvāde puruṣakārādhyāyo nāma ṣaṭṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 66 || <2.67> rāma uvāca || upāyāṃstvaṃ samācakṣva sāmapūrvānmahādyute || lakṣaṇaṃ ca tathā teṣāṃ prayogaṃ varuṇātmaja || 1 || puṣkara uvāca || sāmabhedau tathā rāma daṇḍaṃ ca manujottama || upekṣā ca tathā māyā indrajālañca bhārgava || 2 || prayogāḥ kathitāḥ sapta tanme nigadataḥ śṛṇu || dvividhaṃ kathitaṃ sāma tathyaṃ cātathyameva ca || 3 || tatrāpyatathyaṃ sādhūnāmākrośāyaiva jāyate || tacca sādhupriyaṃ te ca sāmasādhyā na rāma te || 4 || mahākulīnā ṛjavo dharmaniṣṭhā jitendriyāḥ || sāmasādhyā na cātathyaṃ teṣu sāma prayojayet || 5 || tathyaṃ ca sāma kartavyaṃ kulaśīlādivarṇanam || tathā tadubhayaṃ rāma kṛtānāṃ caiva varṇanam||6|| anayaiva tathā yuktyā kṛtajñakhyāpanaṃ svakam || evaṃ sāntvena kartavyā vaśagā dharmatatparāḥ || 7 || sāmnā yadyapi rakṣāṃsi gṛhṇantīti parā śrutiḥ || tathāpyetadasādhūnāṃ prayuktaṃ nopakārakam || 8 || atisandhikamityeva puruṣaṃ sāmavādinam || asādhavo vijānanti tasmāttatteṣu varjitam||9|| ye śuddhavaṃśā ṛjavaḥ pratītā dharme sthitāḥ satyaparā vinītāḥ || te sāmasādhyāḥ puruṣāḥ pradiṣṭā mānonnatā ye satataṃ ca rāma || 2.67.10|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0saṃ0 rāmapuṣkarasaṃvāde sāmavidhirnāma saptaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||67|| <2.68> puṣkara uvāca || parasparaṃ tu ye duṣṭāḥ kruddhā bhītāvamānitāḥ || teṣāṃ bhedaṃ prayuñjīta bhedasādhyā hi te matāḥ || 1 || ye tu yenaiva doṣeṇa parasmādrāma bibhyati || te tu taddoṣapālena bhedanīyā bhṛśaṃ tataḥ || 2 || ātmīyāddarśayedāśāṃ parasmāddarśayedbhayam || evaṃ hi bhedayedbhinnānyathāvadvaśamānayet || 3 || saṃhitā hi vinā bhedaṃ śakreṇāpi sadaḥsahā || bhedameva praśaṃsanti tasmānnayaviśāradāḥ ||4|| svamukhenātha yaddhedaṃ bhedaṃ paramukhena ca || parīkṣya sādhu manye'haṃ bhedaṃ paramukhācchrutam || 5 || bhedyā svakāryamuddiśya kuśalairye hi bheditāḥ || bheditāste vinirdiṣṭā naiva rājārthavādibhiḥ || 6 || antaḥkopabahiḥkopau yatra syātāṃ mahīkṣitām || antaḥkopo mahāṃstatra nāśanaḥ pṛthivī kṣitām || 7 || sāmantakopo bāhyastu kopaḥ prokto manīṣibhiḥ || mahiṣībhlavarājābhyāṃ tathā senāpaterdvija || 8 || amātyānmantriputrācca rājaputrāttathaiva ca || antaḥkopo vinirdiṣṭo dāruṇaḥ pṛthivīkṣitām || 9 || bahiḥkope samutpanne sumahatyapi pārthivaḥ || śuddhāntastu mahābhāga śīghrameva jayedarīn || 2.68.10 || api śakrasamo rājā kopenāntarvinaśyati || svāntaḥkopaṃ prayatnena tasmādyatnātparīkṣatā || 11 || parāntaḥkopamutpādya bhedena vijigīṣuṇā || rakṣyaścaiva prayatnena jñātibhedastathātmanaḥ || 12 || jñātayaḥ paritapyante satataṃ yadyapi śriyā || tathāpi teṣāṃ kartavyaṃ sugambhīreṇa cetasā || 13 || grāhaṇaṃ dānamānābhyāṃ bhedastebhyo bhayaṅkaraḥ||| nājñātiranugṛhṇāti nājñātiḥ snehamicchati ||14||| jñātibhirbhedanīyāstu ripavastena pārthivaiḥ||15|| bhinnā hi śakyā ripavaḥ prabhūtāḥ svalpena senyena nihantumājau || susaṃhitenātha tatastu bhedaḥ kāryo ripūṇāṃ nayaśāstravidbhiḥ ||16|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0 saṃ0 bhedavidhānannāmāṣṭaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||68|| <2.69> puṣkara uvāca || sarveṣāmapyupāyānāṃ dānaṃ śreṣṭhatamaṃ matam || sudattenaiva bhavati dānenobhayalokajit ||1|| sa nāsti rāma dānena vaśago yo na jāyate || dānavāngocaraṃ naiti tathā rāmāpadāṃ kvacita || 2 || dānavāneva śaknoti saṃhatānbhedituṃ parān || yadyapyalubdhā gambhīrāḥ puruṣāḥ sāgaropamāḥ ||3|| na gṛhṇaṃti tathāpyete jāyante pakṣapātinaḥ || anyatrāpi kṛtaṃ dānaṃ karotyanyāṃstathā paraiḥ || || 4 || upāyebhyaḥ prayacchaṃti dānaṃ śreṣṭhatamaṃ narāḥ || dānaṃ saṃvardhanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ dānaṃ śreyaskaraṃ param || 5 || dānavāneva lokeṣu putravatprīyate sadā || na kevalaṃ dānaparā jayanti bhūlokamekaṃ puruṣapravīra || jayanti te rāma surendralokaṃ sudurjayaṃ yadvibudhādhivāsam || 6 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0saṃ0rāmapuṣkarasaṃvāde dānavidhirnāmaikonasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||69|| <2.70> puṣkara uvāca|| na śakyā ye svayaṃ kartuṃ copāyatritayena tu|| daṇḍena tānvaśīkuryāddaṇḍo hi vaśakṛtparaḥ || 1 || samyakpraṇayanaṃ tasya sadā kāryaṃ mahīkṣitā || dharmaśāstrānusāreṇa susahāyena dhīmatā || 2 || tasya samyakpraṇayanaṃ tridaśānapi pīḍayet || vānaprasthāṃśca dharmajña nirdeśānniṣparigrahān || 3 || svadeśe paradeśe ca dharmaśāstraviśāradāḥ || samīkṣya praṇayeddaṇḍaṃ sarvaṃ daṇḍe pratiṣṭhitam||4|| āśramī yadi vā varṇī pūjyo'thavā gururmahān|| nādaṇḍyo rāma rājñā tu yaḥ svadharme na tiṣṭhati||||| adaṇḍyāndaṇḍayanrājā daṇḍyāṃścaivāpyadaṇḍayan || iha rājyaparibhraṣṭo narakaṃ pratipadyate || 6 || tasmādrājñā vinītena dharmaśāstrānusārataḥ || daṇḍapraṇayanaṃ kāryaṃ lokānugrahakāmyayā || 7 || yatra śyāmo lohitākṣo daṇḍaścarati nirbhayaḥ || prajāstatra na muhyanti netā cetsādhu paśyati || 8 || bāla vṛddhātura yati dvijāti vikalābalāḥ || matsyanyāyena bhakṣeranyadi daṇḍo na pālayet || 9 || devadaityoraganarāḥ siddhabhūtapatatriṇaḥ || utkrāmeyuḥ svamaryādāṃ yadi daṇḍo na pālayet || 2.70.10 || eṣa brahmābhiśāpeṣu sarvapraharaṇeṣu ca || sarvavikramakopeṣu vyavasāye ca tiṣṭhati || 11 || pūjyante daṇḍino devā na pūjyante tvadaṇḍinaḥ || na brāhmaṇaṃ na dhātāraṃ na pūṣāryamaṇāvapi || 12 || yajante mānavāḥ kecitpraśāntāḥ sarvakarmasu || rudramagniṃ ca śakraṃ ca sūryācandramasau tathā || 13 || viṣṇuṃ devagaṇām̐ścānye daṇḍinaḥ pūjayanti hi || daṇḍaḥ śāsti prajāḥ sarvā daṇḍa evābhirakṣati || 14 || daṇḍaḥ supteṣu jāgarti daṇḍaṃ dharmaṃ vidurbudhāḥ || rājadaṇḍabhayādeva pāpāḥ pāpaṃ na kurvate || 15 || yamadaṇḍabhayādanye parasparabhayādapi || evaṃ sāṃsiddhike loke sarvaṃ daṇḍe pratiṣṭhitam || 16 || andhe tamasi majjeyuryadi daṇḍo na pālayet || || tasmāddamyāndamayati uddaṇḍāndaṇḍayatyapi || 17 || damanāddaṇḍanāccaiva tasmāddaṇḍaṃ vidurbudhāḥ || daṇḍasya bhītaistridaśaiḥ samastairbhāgo dhṛtaḥ śūladharasya yajñe || cakruḥ kumāraṃ dhvajinīpatiṃ ca varaṃ śiśūnāṃ ca bhayādbalastham || 18 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0saṃ0 puṣkaropākhyāneṣu daṇḍapraśaṃsā nāma saptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 70 || <2.71> rāma uvāca || daṇḍapraṇayanārthāya rājā sṛṣṭaḥ svayaṃbhuvā || devabhāgānupādāya sarvabhūtābhiguptaye || || 1 || tejasā yadayaṃ kaścinnaiva śaknoti vīkṣitum || tadā bhavati lokeṣu rājā bhāskaravatprabhuḥ || 2 || yadasya darśane lokaḥ prasādamupagacchati || nayanānandakāritvāttadā bhavati candramāḥ || 3 || cārairyadāyaṃ vyāpnoti sarvalokaṃ yadṛcchayā || tadā bhavati lokeṣu rājā devaḥ samīraṇaḥ || 4 || yadā'parādhināṃ caiva vidhatte nigrahaṃ nṛpaḥ || tadā bhavati lokeṣu rājā vaivasvataḥ sadā || 5 || yadā bhavati māhātmyātkruddhabuddhānnarānnṛpaḥ || anicchannapi lokeṣu tadā bhavati pāvakaḥ || 6 || karoti ca yadā dānaṃ dhanānāṃ sarvato nṛpaḥ || visargārthaṃ suraśreṣṭha tadā bhavati vittadaḥ || 7 || yadā ca dhanadhārābhirvarṣanplāvayate jagat || tadā sa varuṇaḥ prokto rājā nayaviśāradaiḥ || 8 || kṣamā balena manasā dhārayansakalāḥ prajāḥ || aviśeṣeṇa dharmajña pārthivaḥ pārthivo bhavet || 9 || yadādhipatyena janānsamagrānparirakṣati || tadā bhavati devendraḥ sarvabhūtānukampitā ||2.71.10|| utsāhamaṃtraśaktiryā prabhuśaktiśca daivikī || catasraḥ śaktayastatra vaiṣṇavyaḥ parikīrtitāḥ || 11 || kaḥ samarthaḥ prajāḥ pātuṃ vinā vaiṣṇavatejasā || tisrastu śaktayastasya vaiṣṇavyaḥ pṛthivīpate || 12 || daṇḍapraṇayanaṃ samyak śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ || kathaṃ svaviṣaye tasya daṇḍanītirbhaveddhruvā || 13 || kathaṃ ca daṇḍaṃ praṇayannarendro dharmeṇa yujyedyaśasā ca vīra || arthena kāmena ca sa sarvametadbravīhi yādogaṇa nāthaputra || 14 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0 saṃ0 rāmavākyādhyāyo nāmaikasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ||71|| <2.72> puṣkara uvāca || daṇḍapraṇayanaṃ rāma svadeśe śṛṇu bhūbhujām || yasya samyakpraṇayanātsvargabhākpārthivo bhavet || 1 || triyavaṃ kṛṣṇalaṃ viddhi māṣastatpañcakaṃ bhavet || kṛṣṇalānāṃ tathā ṣaṣṭyā karṣārdhaṃ rāma kīrtitam || 2 || suvarṇaśca vinirdiṣṭo rāma ṣoḍaśamāṣakaḥ || niṣkaṃ suvarṇāścatvāro dharaṇaṃ daśabhistu taiḥ || 3 || tāmrarūpyasuvarṇānāṃ mānametatprakīrtitam || tāmrakarṣāpako rāma proktaḥ kārṣāpaṇo budhaiḥ || 4 || paṇānāṃ dve śate sārdhe prathamaṃ sāhasaḥ smṛtaḥ || madhyamaḥ pañca vijñeyaḥ sahasramapi cottamaḥ || 5 || bāladāyādakaṃ rikthaṃ tāvadrājānupālayet || yāvatsa syātsamāvṛtto yāvadvātītaśaiśavaḥ || 6 || veśyāputrāsu caivaṃ syādrakṣaṇaṃ niṣkulāsu ca || pativratāsu ca strīṣu vidhavāsvāturāsu ca || 7 || jīvantīnāṃ tu tāsāṃ ye taddhareyuḥ svabāndhavāḥ || tāñśiṣyāccauradaṇḍena dhārmikaḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ || 8 || pranaṣṭasvāmikaṃ rikthaṃ rājā tryabdaṃ nidhāpayet || arvāk tryabdāddharetsvāmī pareṇa nṛpatirharet || 9 || mamedamiti yo brūyātso'nuyukto yathāvidhi || sampādya rūpasaṃkhyādīnsvāmī taddravyamarhati || 2.72.10 || avedayāno naṣṭasya deśaṃ kālaṃ ca tattvataḥ || varṇarūpaṃ pramāṇaṃ ca tatsamaṃ daṇḍamarhati || 11 || pranaṣṭādhigataṃ rikthaṃ tiṣṭhedarthairadhiṣṭhitam || yāṃstatra caurāngṛhṇīyādghātayetkuñjareṇa tān || 12 || mamedamiti yo brūyādasatyenā tathā nidhim || tasya daṇḍaṃ haredrājā svavittasyāṣṭamāṃśakam || 13 || caurairamuṣito yastu muṣito'smīti bhāṣate || tatpradātari bhūpāle sa daṇḍyastāvadeva tu || 14 || yo yāvannihnu tārthaṃ mithyā yo vā vadettataḥ || tau nṛpeṇa hyadharmajñau dāpyau taddviguṇaṃ dhanam || 15 || kūṭasākṣyaṃ tu kurvāṇāṃstrīnvarṇāndhārmiko nṛpaḥ || pramāpayenmahābhāga brāhmaṇaṃ tu vivāsayet || 16 || yatsvāminānanujñātamādhiṃ bhuṅkte vicakṣaṇaḥ || avadhyamūlaṃ kartavyaṃ tasya daṇḍaṃ mahīkṣitā || vasā ….. tathā dharmo na hīyate || 17 || yo nikṣepaṃ yācayati yaśca nikṣipya yācate || tāvubhau cauravacchāsyau dāpyau vā dviguṇaṃ dhanam || 18 || upadābhiśca yaḥ kaścitparadravyaṃ harennaraḥ || sasahāyaḥ sa hantavyaḥ prakāśaṃ vividhairvadhaiḥ || 19 || yo yācitakamādāya na taddadyādyathākramam || sa nigṛhya balāddāpyo daṇḍo vai pūrvasāhasam || 2.72.20 || ajñānādyaḥ pumānkuryātparadravyasya vikrayam || nirdoṣo jñānaparyantaṃ cauravadvadhamarhati || 21 || mūlyamādāya yo vidyāṃ śilpaṃ vā na prayacchati|| daṇḍyaḥ samūlaṃ sakalaṃ dharmajñena mahīkṣitā || 22 || dvijabhojye tu samprāpte prātiveśyamabhojanam || hiraṇyamāṣakaṃ daṇḍyaḥ pāpe nāsti hyatikramaḥ || 23 || āmantrito dvijo yastu vartamānaḥ pratigrahe || niṣkāraṇaṃ na gacchedyaḥ sa dāpyo'ṣṭaśataṃ damam || 24 || pratiśrutyāpradātāraṃ suvarṇaṃ daṇḍayennṛpaḥ || || 25 || bhṛto'nārto na kuryādyo darpātkarma yathoditam || sa daṇḍyaḥ kṛṣṇalānyaṣṭau na deyaṃ cāsya vetanam || 26 || akāle yastyajedbhṛtyaṃ daṇḍyaḥ syāttāvadeva tu || yo grāmadeśasaṃghānāṃ kṛtvā satyena saṃvidam || visaṃvadennaro lobhāttaṃ rāṣṭrādvipravāsayet || 27 || krītvā vikrīya vā kiñcidyasyehānuśayo bhavet || sontardaśāhāttatsāmyāddadyāścaivādadīta ca || 28 || pareṇa tu daśāhasya na dadyānnaiva dāpayet || ādadadvidadaccaiva rājñā daṇḍyaḥ śatāni ṣaṭ || 29 || yastu doṣavatīṃ kanyāṃ tvanākhyāya prayacchati || tasya kuryānnṛpo daṇḍaṃ svayaṃ ṣaṇṇavatiṃ paṇān || 2.72.30 || akanyeti tu yaḥ kanyāṃ brūyāddveṣeṇa mānavaḥ || sa śataṃ prāpnuyāddaṇḍaṃ kanyādoṣamadarśayan || 31 || yastvanyāṃ darśayitvānyāṃ voḍhuḥ kanyāṃ prayacchati || uttamaṃ tasya kurvīta rājā daṇḍaṃ tu sāhasam || 32 || varo doṣānabhikhyāpya yaḥ kanyāṃ varayediha || dattāpyadattā sā tasya rājñā daṇḍyaḥ śatadvayam || 33 || pradāya kanyāṃ yo'nyasmai punastāṃ samprayacchati || daṇḍaḥ kāryo narendreṇa tasyāpyuttamasāhasaḥ || 34 || satyaṃkāreṇa vācā ca yuktaṃ paryāsamaṃ śayam || lubdho'nyatra tu vikretā ṣaṭśataṃ daṇḍamarhati || 35 || vahecchulkaṃ tu vikretā satyaṃkāraṃ tu saṃtyajet || dviguṇaṃ daṇḍayedenamiti dharmo vyavasthitaḥ || 36 || mūlyaikadeśaṃ dattvā tu yadi kretā dhanaṃ tyajet || daṇḍayaḥ sa madhyamaṃ daṇḍaṃ tasya daṇḍasya mokṣaṇāt || 37 || druhyādbhṛtastu yaḥ pālaṃ gṛhītvā bhaktavetanam || sa tu daṇḍyaḥ śataṃ rājñā suvarṇaṃ svāmyarakṣiṇā || || 38 || daṇḍaṃ dattvā na virametsvāmibhiḥ kṛtalakṣaṇaḥ || baddhaḥ kṛtvāyasaiḥ pāśaistasya karmakaro bhavet || 39 || dhanuścatuḥparīmāṇaṃ grāmasya tu samantataḥ || dviguṇaṃ triguṇaṃ vāpi nagarasya tu kalpayet ||2.72.40 || vṛtiṃ tatra prakurvīta yāmuṣṭro nāvalokayet || chidraṃ nivārayetsarvaṃ śvasūkaramukhānugam || 41 || tatrāparadhṛtaṃ dhānyaṃ mahiṣyaḥ paśavo yadi || na tatra kārayeddaṇḍaṃ nṛpatiḥ paśurakṣiṇām ||42 || anirdaśāhāṃ gāṃ sūtāṃ vṛṣāndevapaśūṃstathā || sapālānvā vipālānvā na daṇḍyānmanurabravīt || 43 || ato'nyathā vinaṣṭasya daśāṃśaṃ daṇḍamarhati || 44 || pālastvapālakī svāmī vināśe kṣattriyasya tu || bhakṣayitvopaviṣṭāsu dviguṇaṃ daṇḍamarhati || 45 || vairāddaśaguṇaṃ daṇḍaṃ vināśātkṣattriyasya tu || gṛhaṃ taḍāgamārāmaṃ kṣetraṃ buddhvā hyapāharan || śatāni pañca daṇḍyaḥ syādajñānāddviśato damaḥ || 46 || sīmābandhanakāle tu sīmābandhanakāriṇām || teṣāṃ saṃjñāṃ dadhānastu jihvācchedanamāpnuyāt ||47 || arthenāpi ca yo vidyātsaṃvidaṃ vāpi gacchati || uttamaṃ sāhasaṃ daṇḍya iti svāyaṃbhuvo 'bravīt || 48 || sthāpitāṃ cāpi maryādāṃ ye bhindyuḥ pāpakāriṇaḥ || 49 || sarve pṛthakpṛthagdaṇḍyā rājñā prathamasāhasam || śataṃ brāhmaṇamākruśya kṣattriyo daṇḍamarhati || 2.72.50 || vaiśyaśca dviśataṃ rāma śūdraśca vadhamarhati || pañcāśadbrāhmaṇo daṇḍyaḥ kṣattriyasyāpi śāsane || 51 || vaiśye cāpyardhapañcāśacchūdro dvādaśako'dhamaḥ || kṣattriyasyāpnuyādvaiśyaḥ sāhasaṃ pūrvameva tu || 52 || śūdraḥ kṣatriyamātrasya jihvācchedanamāpnuyāt || pañcāśatkṣatriyo daṇḍyastathā vaiśyābhiśāsane || 53 || śūdre caivārdhapañcāśattathā dharmo na hīyate || vaiśyasyākrośane daṇḍyaḥ śūdraścottama sāhasam || 54 || śūdrākrośe tathā vaiśyaḥ śatārdhaṃ daṇḍamarhati || savarṇākrośane daṇḍastathā dvādaśikaḥ smṛtaḥ || 55|| vādeṣu vacanīyeṣu tadeva dviguṇaṃ bhaveta || ekajātirdvijātiṃ tu vācā dāruṇayā kṣipan || jihvāyāḥ prāpnuyācchedaṃ jaghanyaprabhavo hi saḥ || 56 || nāmajātigrahaṃ teṣāmabhidroheṇa kurvataḥ || nikhanyo'yomayaḥ śaṅkurjvalannāsye daśāṅgulaḥ || 57 || dharmopadeśadharmeṇa dvijānāmasya kurvataḥ || taptamāsiñcayettailaṃ vaktre śrotre ca pārthivaḥ ||58|| śṛtaṃ deśaṃ ca jātiṃ ca karma śārīrameva ca || vitathaṃ tu bruvandaṇḍyo rājñā dviguṇasāhasam || 59 || yastu pātakasaṃyuktaiḥ kṣipedvarṇāntarau viśaḥ || uttamaṃ sāhasaṃ tasmindaṇḍaḥ pātyo yathākramam || 2.72.60 || rājño niveśya niyamaṃ prathamaṃ yānti ye mithaḥ || 61 || sarve dviguṇadaṇḍyāste vipralambhānnṛpasya tu || prītyā mayāsyābhihitaṃ pramādenāthavā vadet || bhūyo na caivaṃ vakṣyāmi sa tu daṇḍārdhabhāgbhavet || 62 || kāṇaṃ vāpyathavā khañjamandhaṃ vāpi tathāvidham || tathyenāpi bruvandāpyo daṇḍaḥ kārṣāpaṇāvaram || 63 || mātaraṃ pitaraṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ bhrātaraṃ śvaśuraṃ gurum || ākṣārayacchataṃ daṇḍyaḥ panthānaṃ cādadadguroḥ ||64 || guruvarjyaṃ tu mārgārhe yo mārgaṃ na prayacchati || sa rājñā kṛṣṇalaṃ daṇḍyastasya pāpasya śāntaye ||65|| ekajātirdvijātintu yenāṅgenāparādhnuyāt || tadeva cchedayettasya kṣipramevāvicārayan ||66|| avaniṣṭhīvato darpāddvāvoṣṭhau chedayennṛpaḥ || avasecayato meḍhramavaśabdayato gudam || 67 || mahāsanamabhiprepsurutkṛṣṭasyāvakṛṣṭajaḥ || 68 || kṛtāṅkaḥ sa vinirvāsyo hyaṅgaṃ vāsya vikartayet || keśeṣu gṛhṇato hastau chedayedavicārayan || pādayordaṇḍikāyāṃ tu grīvāyāṃ vṛṣaṇeṣu vā || 69 || tvagbhedakaḥ śataṃ daṇḍyo lohitasya ca darśakaḥ || 2.72.70 || asthibhettā ca ṣaṇṇiṣkānpramāpyaśca pramāpakaḥ || aṅgabhaṅgakarasyāṃgaṃ tadevāpaharennṛpaḥ || 71 || daṇḍapāruṣyakṛddadyātsamutthānavyayaṃ tathā || ardhapādakarāḥ kāryā gogajāśvoṣṭraghātakāḥ || 72 || paśukṣudramṛgāṇāṃ ca hiṃsāyāṃ dviguṇo damaḥ || pañcāśattu bhaveddaṇḍastathaiva mṛgapakṣiṣu || 73 || kṛmikīṭeṣu daṇḍaḥ syādrajatasya tu māṣakam || tasyānurūpaṃ mūlyaṃ ca pradadyātsvāmine tathā ||74|| sasvāmikānāṃ marake śeṣāṇāṃ daṇḍameva tu || vṛkṣaṃ tu saphalaṃ chittvā suvarṇaṃ daṇḍamarhati || 75 || dviguṇaṃ daṇḍayeccaitye pathi sīmni jalāśaye || chedanādaphalasyāpi madhyamaḥ sāhasaḥ smṛtaḥ || 76 || gulmavallīlatānāṃ tu suvarṇasya ca māṣakam || vṛthā chede tṛṇasyāpi daṇḍaḥ kārṣāpaṇaṃ bhavet || 77 || tribhāgaṃ kṛṣṇalāndaṇḍayaḥ prāṇinastāḍane tathā || deśakālānurūpeṇa mūlyaṃ rāma drumādiṣu || 78 || tatsvāmini tathā dadyāddaṇḍamuktaṃ ca pārthive || yatrātivartate yugyaṃ vaiguṇyādrajakasya tu ||79 || tatra svāmī bhaveddaṇḍyo nāptaścedvyājako bhavet || prāṇakaśca bhavedāptaḥ prājako daṇḍamarhati || 2.72.80|| nāsti daṇḍaṃ ca tasyāpi tathā trāhīti jalpataḥ || 81 || dravyāṇi yo haredyasya jānato'jānato'pi vā || sa tasyotpādayettuṣṭiṃ rājño dadyāttato damam || 82 || yastu rajjuṃ ghaṭaṃ kūpāddharedbhindyācca tāṃ prapām || sa daṇḍaṃ prāpnuyānmāṣaṃ tacca saṃpratipādayet || 83 || dhānyaṃ daśabhyaḥ kumbhebhyo harato'bhyadhikaṃ budhaḥ || śeṣe'pyekādaśaguṇaṃ daṇḍaṃ tasya prakalpayet ||84|| suvarṇarajatādīnāṃ cottamānāṃ ca vāsasām || puruṣāṇāṃ kulīnānāṃ nārīṇāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ || mukhyānāṃ caiva ratnānāṃ haraṇe vadhamarhati||85|| mahāpaśūnāṃ haraṇe vastrāṇāmauṣadhasya ca || kālamāsādya kāryaṃ ca rājā daṇḍaṃ prakalpayet || 86 || goṣu brāhmaṇasaṃsthāsu sthūlakāryāvibhedane || aśvāpahārakaścaiva sadyaḥ kāryordhapādikaḥ || 87 || sūtrakārpāsakilvānāṃ gomayasya guḍasya ca || dadhnaḥ kṣīrasya takrasya pānīyasya phalasya ca || 88 || veṇuvaidalabhāṇḍānāṃ lavaṇānāṃ tathaiva ca || mṛṇmayānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ mṛdo bhasmana eva ca ||89|| madyānāṃ pakṣiṇāṃ caiva tailasya ca ghṛtasya ca || māṃsasya madhunaścaiva yaccānyatpaśusambhavam||2.72.90|| anyeṣāmevamādīnāṃ matsyānāmodanasya ca || pakvānnānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ tanmūlyāddviguṇo damaḥ || 91 || puṣpeṣu harite dhānye gulmavallīlatāsu ca ||| alpeṣu paripūrṇeṣu daṇḍaḥ syātpañcamāṣakaḥ || 92 || paripūrṇeṣu dhānyeṣu śākamūlaphaleṣu ca || niranvaye śataṃ daṇḍyaḥ sānvaye ca śataṃ damaḥ || 93 || yenayena yathāṅgena steno nṛṣu viceṣṭate || tattadeva haredasya pratyādeśāya pārthivaḥ || 94 || dvijo'dhvagaḥ kṣīṇavṛttirdvāvikṣu dve ca mūlake || trapusorvārukau dvaudvau tāvanmānaṃ phaleṣu ca || 95 || tathā ca sarvadhānyānāṃ muṣṭigrāheṇa bhārgava || śākaṃ śākapramāṇena gṛhyamāṇo na duṣyati || 96 || vānaspatyaṃ mūlaphalaṃ dārvagnyarthaṃ tathaiva ca || tṛṇaṃ ca gobhyo dānārthamasteyaṃ manurabravīt || 97 || adevavāṭajaṃ puṣpaṃ devatārthaṃ tathaiva ca || ādadānaḥ parakṣetrānna daṇḍaṃ dātumarhati || 98 || śṛṅgiṇaṃ nakhinaṃ cāpi daṃṣṭriṇaṃ vā vadhodyatam || yo hanyānna sa pāpena lipyate manujaḥ kvacit || 99 || guruṃ vā bālavṛddhau vā brāhmaṇaṃ vā bahuśrutam || ātatāyinamāyāntaṃ hanyādevāvicārayan || 2.72.100 || nātatāyivadhe doṣaḥ karturbhavati kaścana || prakāśaṃ vā'prakāśaṃ vā manyustaṃ manyumarhati || 101 || gṛhakṣetrābhihartāraṃ tathā patnyabhigāminam || agnidaṃ garadaṃ caiva tathā hastodyatāyudham || 102 || abhicāraṃ ca kurvāṇaṃ rājagāmi ca paiśunam || ete hi kathitā loke dharmajñairātatāyinaḥ || 103 || parastriyaṃ na saṃbhāṣettīrthe'raṇye gṛhe'pi vā || nadīnāṃ caiva saṃbhede saṃgrahaṇamavāpnuyāt || 104 || na saṃbhāṣaṃ saha strībhiḥ pratiṣiddhaṃ samācaret || pratiṣiddhastu saṃbhāṣaḥ suvarṇaṃ daṇḍamarhati || 105 || naiṣa cāreṇadāreṣu vidhirnātmopajīviṣu || sajjayanti manuṣyaiste nigūḍhaṃ vicarantyuta || 106 || kiñcideva tu sakhyaṃ syātsaṃbhāṣetābhicārayan || preṣyāsu caiva sarvābhirahaḥ pravrajitāsu ca || 107 || yo'kāmāṃ dūṣayetkanyāṃ sa sadyo vadhamarhati || sakāmāṃ dūṣayāṇastu prāpyaḥ prathamasāhasam || 108 || bhikṣuko'pyathavā nārī yo'pi ca syātkuśīlavaḥ || praviśetpratiṣiddhastu prāpnuyāddviśataṃ damam || 109 || yaśca saṃcārakastatra puruṣaḥ sa tathā bhavet || pāradārikavaddaṇḍyo yaśca syādavakāśadaḥ || 2.72.110 || balātsaṃdūṣayanyastu parabhāryāṃ naraḥ kvacit || vadhadaṇḍo bhavettasya nāparādho bhavetstriyāḥ || 111 || rajastṛtīyaṃ yā kanyā svagṛhe pratipadyate || adaṇḍyā sā bhavedrājñā varayantī patiṃ svayam || 112 || svadeśe kanyakāṃ dattvā tāmādāya tathā vrajan || paradeśe bhavedvadhyaḥ strīcauraḥ sa tathā bhavet || 113 || adravyāṃ mṛtapatnīṃ tu saṃgṛhṇannāparādhyati || sārthāṃ vai tāṃ ca gṛhṇāno daṇḍamuttamamarhati || 114 || utkṛṣṭaṃ yā bhajetkanyā deyā tasyaiva sā bhavet || jaghanyaṃ sevamānāṃ ca saṃyatāṃ vāsayedgṛhe || 115 || uttamāṃ sevamānastu jaghanyo vadhamarhati || jaghanyamuttamā nārī sevamānā tathaiva ca || 116 || bhartāraṃ laṅghayedyā tu strī jñātibaladarpitā || tāṃ śvabhiḥ khādayedrājā saṃsthāne bahusaṃsthite || 117 || hṛtādhikārāṃ malināṃ piṇḍamātropajīvinīm || vāsayetsvairiṇīṃ nityaṃ savarṇenābhidūṣitām || 118 || jyāyasā dūṣitā nārī muṇḍanaṃ samavāpnuyāt || māsaṃ ca malinā nityaṃ sā grāsānprāpnuyāddaśa || 119 || brāhmaṇaḥ kṣattriyo vaiśyaḥ kṣattraviṭśūdrayonayaḥ ||| vrajandāpyo bhavedrāma daṇḍa uttamasāhasam || 2.72.120 || vaiśyāgame tu viprasya kṣattriyasyantyajāgame || madhyamaṃ prathamaṃ vaiśyo daṇḍyaḥ śadrāgame bhavet || 121 || śūdraḥ savarṇā'gamane śataṃ daṇḍyo mahībhujā || vaiśyaśca dviguṇaṃ rāma kṣattriyastriguṇaṃ tathā || 122 || brāhmaṇaśca bhaveddaṇḍyastathā rāma caturguṇam || guptāsveva bhaveddaṇḍamaguptāsvapi tatsmṛtam || 123 || mātā mātṛṣvasā śvaśrūrmātulānī pitṛṣvasā || pitṛvyasakhiśiṣyastrī bhaginī tatsakhī tathā || 124 || bhāgineyī tathā caiva rājapatnī tathaiva ca || ityagamyāstu nirdiṣṭāstāsāṃ tu gamane naraḥ || 125 ||| śiśnasyotkartanaṃ kṛtvā tatastu vadhamarhati || bhrātṛbhāryāgame pūrvāddaṇḍastu vadhamarhati || 126 || caṇḍālīṃ vā śvapākīṃ vā gacchanvadhamavāpnuyāt || tiryagyonau tu govarjyaṃ maithunaṃ yo niṣevate || 127 || sa paṇaṃ prāpnuyāddaṇḍaṃ tasyāśca yavasodakam || suvarṇaṃ ca bhaveddaṇḍyo gāṃ vrajanmanujottama || 128 || veśyāgāmī bhaveddaṇḍyo veśyāśulkasamaṃ paṇam || gṛhītvā vetanaṃ veśyā lobhādanyatra gacchati || 129 || vetanaṃ dviguṇaṃ dadyāddaṇḍaṃ ca triguṇaṃ tathā || anyamuddiśya veśyāṃ yo nayedanyasya kāraṇāt || 2.72.130 || tasya daṇḍaṃ bhavedrāma suvarṇasya ca māṣakam || nītvā bhogaṃ na yo dadyāddāpyo dviguṇavetanam || 131 || rājñā ca dviguṇaṃ daṇḍyastathā dharmo na hīyate || bahūnāṃ vrajatāmekāṃ sarve taddviguṇaṃ damam || 132 || sarve pṛthakpṛthagrāma daṇḍaṃ ca dviguṇaṃ paṇāt || na mātā na pitā na strī ṛtvigyājyasya sūnavaḥ || 133 || anyonyāḥ patitāstyājyāstyāge daṇḍyaḥ śatāni ṣaṭ || patitā guravastyājyā na tu mātā kadācana ||134|| garbhadhāraṇapoṣābhyāṃ tena mātā garīyasī || saṃdaṃśahīnau kartavyau kūṭākṣopadhidevinau || 135 || adhīyānamanadhyāye daṇḍaḥ karṣāpaṇatrayam || adhyāpakaśca dviguṇaṃ tathācārasya laṅghane || 136 || antaṃ sasyabhave daṇḍaḥ suvarṇasya ca kṛṣṇalam || bhāryā putraśca dāsaśca śiṣyo bhrātā ca sodaraḥ || 137 || prāptāparādhāste daṇḍyā rajvā veṇudalena vā || pṛṣṭhatastu śarīrasya nottamāṅge kathaṃcana || 138 || atonyathā yatpraharetprāptaḥ syāccaurakilbiṣam || dyūtaṃ samāhvayaṃ caiva yo niṣiddhaṃ samācaret || 139 || pracchannaṃ vā prakāśaṃ vā sa daṇḍyaḥ pārthivecchayā || vāsāṃsi phalake ślakṣṇe nenijyādrajakaḥ śanaiḥ || 2.72.140 || ato'nyathā tu kurvīta daṇḍassyādrukmakṛṣṇalam || rakṣāṃsyadhikṛtā rāma prajeyaṃ yairvilipyate || 141 || kāryikebhyo'rthamādāya hanyuḥ kāryāṇi kāryiṇām || teṣāṃ sarvasvamādāya rājā kuryātpravāsanam || 142 || ye niyuktāḥ svakāryeṣu hanyuḥ kāryāṇi kāryiṇām || nirghṛṇāḥ krūramanasaḥ sarvakāryoparodhinaḥ || 143 || dhanoṣmaṇā pacyamānāṃstānniḥsvānkārayennṛpaḥ || kūṭaśāsanakartṝṃśca prakṛtīnāṃ ca dūṣakān || 144 || strībālabrāhmaṇaghnāṃśca vadhyāṃścāsevinastathā || amātyaḥ prāḍvivāko vā yaḥ kuryātkāryamanyathā || 145 || tasya sarvasvamādāya taṃ rājā vipravāsayet || brahmaghnaśca surāpaśca steyī ca gurutalpagaḥ || 146 || etānsarvānpṛthagvidyānmahāpātakino narān || mahāpātakino vadhyā brāhmaṇaṃ tu vivāsayet || 147 || kṛtacihnaṃ svakāddeśācchṛṇu cihnakramaṃ tathā|| gurutalpe bhagaḥ kāryaḥ surāpāne surādhvajaḥ || 148 || steye tu śvapadaṃ vidyādbrahmahaṇyaśirāḥ pumān || asambhāṣyā hyasaṃlāpyā asampādyā viśeṣataḥ || 149 || tyaktavyāśca tathā rāma jñātisambandhibāndhavaiḥ || mahāpātakino vittamādāya nṛpatiḥ svayam || 2.72.150 || apsu praveśayeddaṇḍaṃ varuṇāyopapādayet || sahoḍhaṃ na vinā cauraṃ ghātayeddhārmiko nṛpaḥ || 151 || sahoḍhaṃ sopakaraṇaṃ ghātayedavicārayan|| grāmeṣvapi ca ye keciccaurāṇāṃ bhaktadāyakāḥ || 152 || bhāṇḍāvakāśadāścaiva sarvāṃstānapi ghātayet || rāṣṭreṣu rāṣṭrādhipateḥ samantāccaiva dūṣakān || 153 || abhyāghāteṣu madhyasthāḥ kṣipraṃ śāsyāstu cauravat || dasyuprapīḍitānāṃ hi pathi mohādidarśane || 154 ||| śaktitonābhidhāvanto nirvāsyāḥ saparicchadāḥ || rājñaḥ koṣāpahartṝṃśca pratikūleṣu ca sthitān ||195 || arīṇāmupajaptṝm̐śca ghātayedvividhairvadhaiḥ || sandhiṃ bhittvā tu ye cauryaṃ rājñaḥ kurvaṃti taskarāḥ || 156 || teṣāṃ chittvā nṛpo hastau tīkṣṇe śūle niveśayet || taḍākabhedakaṃ hanyādapsu śuddhavadhena tu ||157|| yastu pūrvaṃ nivṛttasya taḍākasyodakaṃ haret || āgamaṃ vāpyapāṃ kuryātsa dāpyaḥ pūrvasāhasam ||158|| koṣṭhāgārāyudhāgāradevatāgārabhedakān || pāpānpāpasamācārānghātayecchīghrameva tān||159|| samutsṛjedrājamārge yastvamedhyamanāpadi || sa hi kārṣāpaṇaṃ daṇḍyastamamedhyaṃ ca śodhayet|| ||2.72.160|| āpadgato'thavā vṛddho garbhiṇī bāla eva vā || paribhāṣaṇamarhanti tacca śodhyamiti sthitiḥ||161|| prathamaṃ sāhasaṃ daṇḍyaḥ yaśca mithyācikitsakaḥ || puruṣe madhyamaṃ daṇḍyastūttame ca tathottamam ||162|| saṃkramadhvajayaṣṭīnāṃ pratimānāṃ ca bhedakān || pratikuryuśca tatsarvaṃ dadyuḥ pañcaśatāni ca||163|| adūṣitānāṃ dravyāṇāṃ dūṣaṇe bhedane tathā || maṇīnāmapi bhedasya daṇḍaḥ prathamasāhasaḥ || 164 || samaiśca viṣamaṃ yo vai kurute mūlyato'pi vā || samāpnuyānnaraḥ pūrvaṃ samaṃ vādhamameva vā || 165 || bandhanāni ca sarvāṇi rājamārge niveśayet || kliśyanto yatra dṛśyante vikṛtāḥ pāpacāriṇaḥ || 166 || prākārasya tu bhettāraṃ parikhānāṃ ca bhedakam || dvārāṇāṃ caiva bhettāraṃ kṣipraṃ nirvāsayetpurāt || 167 || mūlakarmābhicāreṣu kartavyo dviguṇo damaḥ || abījavikrayī daivabījotkṛṣṭastathaiva ca || 168 || maryādābhedakaścaiva vikṛtaṃ vadhamāpnuyāt || sarvasaṅkarapāpiṣṭhaṃ hemakāraṃ narādhipaḥ || 169 || anyāye vartamānaṃ tu lavaśaśchedayeccharaiḥ || dravyamādāya vaṇijāmanargheṇāvarundhatām || 2.72.170 || rājā pṛthakpṛthakkuryāddaṇḍamuttamasāhasam || dvyāvadūṣako yaśca praticchandakavikrayī|| 171 || madhyamaṃ prāpnuyāddaṇḍaṃ kūṭakartā tathottamam || śāstrāṇāṃ yajñatapasāṃ deśānāṃ kṣepako naraḥ || 172 || devatānāṃ satīnāṃ vai tūttamaṃ daṇḍamarhati || ekasya daṇḍapāruṣye bahūnāṃ dviguṇo damaḥ ||173 || kalahāpahṛtaṃ deyaṃ daṇḍaśca dviguṇastataḥ || madhyamaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ rājā viṣayādvipravāsayet || 174 || laśunaṃ ca palāṇḍuṃ ca sūkaraṃ grāmakukkuṭam || tathā pañcanakhaṃ sarvaṃ bhakṣyādanyatra bhakṣiṇam || 175 || vivāsayetkṣiprameva brāhmaṇaṃ viṣayātsvakāt || abhakṣyabhakṣaṇe daṇḍyaḥ śūdro bhavati kṛṣṇalam || 176 || brāhmaṇakṣattriyaviśāṃ catustridviguṇaṃ hitam || yaḥ sāhasaṃ kārayati sa dadyāddviguṇa damam || 177 || yaścedamuktvāhaṃ dātā kārayetsa caturguṇam || saṃdiṣṭasyāpradātāraṃ samudragṛhabhedakam || 178 || pañcāśatpaṇiko daṃḍastayoḥ kāryo mahīkṣitā || aspṛśyeṣu śatārdhantu madhyo'dho yogakarmakṛt || 179 || puṃstvahartā paśūnāṃ ca dāsīgarbhavināśakṛt || śūdrapravrajitānāṃ ca daive pitrye ca bhojakaḥ || 2.72.180|| avrajanbāḍhamuktvā ca tathaiva ca nimantraṇāt || ete kārṣāpaṇaśataṃ sarve daṇḍyā mahīkṣitā || 181 || duḥkhotpādi gṛhe dravyaṃ kṣipandaṇḍyastu kṛṣṇalam || pitāputravirodhe tu sākṣiṇāṃ dviśato damaḥ || 182 || tulāśāsanamānānāṃ kūṭakṛnnāṇakasya ca || ebhiśca vyavahartā yaḥ sa dāpyo daṇḍamuttamam || 183 || viṣāgnidāṃ patigurunijāpatyapramāpaṇīm || vikarṇakaranāsauṣṭhīṃ kṛtvā gobhiḥ pramāpayet || 184 || kṣetraveśmagrāmavananivītakhaladāhakāḥ || rājapatnyabhigāmī ca dagdhavyāśca kaṭāgninā || 185 || ūnaṃ vāpyadhikaṃ vāpi likhedyo rājaśāsanam || pāradārikacaurau ca muñcato daṇḍamuttamam || 186 || abhakṣyeṇa dvijaṃ dūṣya daṇḍamuttamasāhasam || kṣatriyo madhyamaṃ vaiśyaḥ prathamaṃ śūdramardhikam || 187|| mṛtāṅgalagnavikreturgurostāḍayitustathā|| rājayānāsanāroḍhurdaṇḍa uttamasāhasaḥ || || 188 || yo manyetājito'smīti nyāyenāpi parājitaḥ ||| tamāyātaṃ punarjitvā daṇḍadyeddviguṇaṃ damam||189|| āhvānakārī vadhyaḥ syādanāhūtamathāhvayan|| daṇḍikasya yo hastādabhiyuktaḥ palāyate||2.72.190|| hīnaḥ puruṣakāreṇa taddadyāddāṇḍiko dhanam|| preṣyāparādhātpreṣyasya sa daṇḍaṃ dātumarhati || 191 || daṇḍārthaṃ niyamārthaṃ ca nīyamānastu bandhanam || pathi kaścitpalāyeta daṇḍamaṣṭaguṇaṃ bhavet || 192 | aniṣṭhitavivāde tu nakharomāvatāraṇam || kārayedyaḥ sa puruṣo madhyamaṃ daṇḍamarhati || 193 || bandhanaṃ vāthavā vadhyaṃ balānmocayato bhavet || vadhye vimocite vadhyo daṇḍye dviguṇadaṇḍabhāk || 194 || durmṛṣṭavyavahārāṇāṃ sabhyānāṃ dviguṇo damaḥ || jñātvā triṃśadguṇaṃ daṇḍaṃ prakṣepyamudake bhavet|| || 195 || alpe daṇḍedhikaṃ kṛtvā vipule cālpameva ca || ūnādhikaṃ tu taddaṇḍaṃ sadyo dadyātsvakādgṛhāt || 196 || yāvadvadhyaḥ sa vadhyeta tāvadvadhyasya mokṣaṇāt || na jātu brāhmaṇaṃ hanyātsarvapāpeṣvavasthitam || 197 || vadhye vivāsayedrāṣṭrātsamagradhanamakṣatam || na jātu brāhmaṇavadhātpāpamapyadhikaṃ kvacit || 198 || yasmāttasmātprayatnena brahmahatyāṃ vivarjayet || adaṇḍyāndaṇḍayanrājā daṇḍyāṃścaivāpyadaṇḍayan || ayaśomahadāpnoti narakaṃ caiva gacchati || 199 || jñātvāparādhaṃ puruṣaṃ ca rājā kālaṃ tathā cānumate dvijānām || daṇḍyeṣu daṇḍaṃ parikalpayeta pāpasya ye tacchamanaṃ na kuryuḥ || 2.72.200 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0 saṃ0 paraśurāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāneṣu daṇḍapraṇayanannāma dvisaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||72|| <2.73> rāma uvāca || kuryāddaṇḍapraṇayanaṃ prāyaścittamakurvatām || nṛṇāṃ rājā tato brūhi prāyaścittavidhiṃ mama || 1 || puṣkara uvāca || akāmataḥ kṛte pāpe prāyaścittaṃ vidurbudhāḥ || kāmacārakṛte'pyetanmataṃ me śrutidarśanāt || 2|| prāyaścittaiḥ śamaṃ yāti pāpaṃ kṛtamasaṃśayam || rājadaṇḍācchamaṃ yāti prāyaścittamakurvatām || 3 || prāyaścittavihīnā ye rājabhiścāpyavāsitāḥ || narakaṃ pratipadyante tiryagyoniṃ tathaiva ca || 4 || mānuṣyamapi cāsādya bhavantīha tathāṃkitāḥ || prāyaścittamataḥ kāryaṃ kalmaṣasyāpanuttaye||5|| rājakruddhāturānnaṃ ca na bhuñjīta kadācana || tathaivāhvāyakasyānnaṃ padā spṛṣṭaṃ ca kāmataḥ||6||| mahāpātakinā spṛṣṭamavalīḍhaṃ patatriṇā || tryṛbīmapakvaṃ yaścāpi spṛṣṭaṃ yaccāpyudakyayā || 7 || gaṇānnaṃ gaṇikānnaṃ ca vidviṣāṃ yajjugupsitama || stenasya caiva tīkṣṇasya vārdhuṣergāyanasya ca ||8 || dīkṣitasya kadaryasya baddhasya nigaḍairapi || abhiśastasya ṣaṇḍhasya puṃścalyā dāṃbhikasya ca ||9|| cikitsakasya mṛgayoḥ krūrasyocchiṣṭabhojinaḥ || anarcitaṃ vṛthā māṃsamavīrāyāśca yoṣitaḥ || 2.73.10 || dviṣadannaṃ ca dāsānnamugrānnaṃ cāpyacākṣuṣam || piśunānṛtinoścānnamastravikrayiṇastathā || 11 || rajakasya nṛśaṃsasya yasya copapatirgṛhe || śailūṣatunnavāyānnaṃ kṛtaghnasyānnameva ca || 12 || parivitteśca duṣṭasya bandinaḥ kitavasya ca || kuṇḍagolakayoścaiva strījitasya tathaiva ca || 13 || karmārasya niṣādasya raṅgāvatarakasya ca || suvarṇakartuvenasya cailanirṇejakasya ca || 14 || mithyāpravrajitasyānnaṃ tailikasya tathaiva ca || tathaiva vṛṣalasyānnaṃ brāhmaṇenānimantritam || 15 || eṣāmanyatamasyānnamamatyāttvā tryahaṃ kṣipeta || matyā bhuktvā caretkṛcchraṃ retoviṇmūtrameva ca || 16 || mahāpātakayuktasya sūtikasya tathaiva ca || bhuktvānnaṃ carmakārasya matyā kṛcchraṃ careddvijaḥ || 17|| caṇḍālaśvapacānnaṃ ca bhuktvā cāndrāyaṇaṃ careta|| antaścaturthipretānnaṃ gavāghrātaṃ tathaiva ca || 18 || śūdrocchiṣṭaṃ laghūcchiṣṭaṃ sūtikānnaṃ tathaiva ca || taptakṛcchraṃ tu kurvīta tasya pāpasya śāntaye || 19 || bhuktvā tu brāhmaṇāśauce caretsāntapanaṃ dvijaḥ || bhuktvā tu kṣatriyāśauce tathā kṛcchraṃ vidhīyate || 2.73.20 || vaiśyāśauce tathā bhuktvā taptakṛcchraṃ samācaret || śūdrāśauce dvijo bhuktvā tathā cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret||21|| aśauce yasya yo bhuktvā so'pyaśuddhastathā bhavet|| tāvadyāvadaśaucaṃ tu tasya rāma prakīrtitam||22|| tasyāśaucavyapagame prāyaścittaṃ samācaret || bhuktvottamasya cāśauce kṣapeta divasaṃ tathā ||23|| mṛtapañcanakhātkūpādamedhyena sakṛdyutāt || apaḥ pītvā tryahaṃ tiṣṭhetsopavāso dvijottamaḥ || 24 || dvidinaṃ kṣattriyastiṣṭhedekāhaṃ vaiśya eva ca || naktāśī ca tathā śūdraḥ pañcagavyena śudhyati || 25 || bhuktvāpyatha kaṣāyāṃśca pītvāmedhyānyapi dvijaḥ || tāvadbhavatyaprayato yāvadannaṃ vrajatyadhaḥ || 26 || viḍvarāhakharoṣṭrāṇāṃ gomāyukapikāhvayoḥ || prāśya mūtrapurīṣāṇi dvijaścāndrāyaṇaṃ caret || 27 || śuṣkāṇi jagdhvā māṃsāni bhaumāni kavakāni ca || ajñātaṃ caiva sūnāsthaṃ caitadeva vrataṃ caret || 28|| kravyādasūkaroṣṭrāṇāṃ gomāyoḥ kapikākayoḥ|| gonarāśvakharoṣṭrāṇāṃ bhoktā pañcanakhāśca ye ||29|| māṃsaṃ ca kauñjaraṃ bhuktvā taptakṛcchreṇa śuddhyati|| grāmakukkuṭacchatrākau bhuktvā cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret||2.73.30|| keśakīṭāvapanne'pi pibedbrahmasuvarcalām|| āmaśrāddhe tathā bhuktvā taptakṛcchreṇa śuddhyati||31|| saṃkalpite tathā bhuktvā trirātropoṣaṇaṃ bhavet || vratacārī tathā bhuktvā madhumāṃsaṃ ca bhārgava||32|| laśunaṃ gṛñjanaṃ caiva pālaṇḍuṃ madyameva ca|| laśunādisamaṃ yacca gandhena manujottama||33|| bhuktvā cāndrāyaṇaṃ kuryānmāsaṃ kravyabhujastathā || lohitānvṛkṣaniryāsānkusthānaprabhavāṃstathā||34|| śeluṃ gavyaṃ ca peyūṣaṃ viṣaṃ śleṣmātakaṃ mṛdam || vṛthā kṛsarasaṃyāvapāyasāpūpaśaṣkulīḥ||35|| gavāṃ ca mahiṣīṇāṃ ca varjayitvā tathāpyajāma || sarvakṣīrāṇi varjyāni teṣāṃ caivāpyanirdaśam||36|| syaṃdane'medhyabhakṣāyā vivatsāyāśca varjayet || dadhivarjyaṃ ca śuktāni sarvāṇyeva vivarjayet ||37|| śubhaiḥ puṣpaphalairyāni bhaktairabhiyutāni ca || viṣkirāñjālapādāṃśca raktapādāṃstathaiva ca||38|| sarvaśuṣkāṃśca cūḍālānpratodāṃśca vivarjayet || vartiko vartikā ceti tittiraśca kapiñjalaḥ || 39 || bhakṣyo mayūraśca tathā pakṣiṇāṃ ye vivarjitāḥ || śaśakaḥ śallako godhā khaḍgaḥ kūrmastathaiva ca||2.73.40|| bhakṣyāḥ pañcanakhāḥ proktāḥ pariveṣāśca varjitāḥ || pāṭhīnānrohitānmatsyām̐llohatuṇḍāṃśca bhakṣayet || 41|| rājīvāṃśca saśalkāṃśca bhakṣyānāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ || ato'nyānvarjayetsarvāṃstathā vai jalacāriṇaḥ || 42|| eteṣāṃ bhakṣaṇādrāma trirātrau kṣapaṇaṃ bhavet || cakravākaṃ plavaṃ haṃsaṃ ṭiṭṭibhaṃ madgumeva ca || 43 || kākolaṃ ca śukaṃ bhāsaṃ dātyūhaṃ sārikāṃ tathā || bakaśyenabalākāṃśca bhuktvā ṣaḍrātra mācaret || 44 || upavāsastathā kāryaḥ sūnāmāṃsāśane bhavet || ajāvikānurohāṃśca pṛṣatānmāhiṣāṃstathā || 45 || raṅkunyaṃkūṃstathaiṇāṃśca gavayāṃścaiva bhakṣayet || bhuktvā māṃsaṃ tato'nyasya tryahaṃ tiṣṭhedbubhukṣitaḥ |46|| yavagodhūmajaṃ sarvaṃ payasaścaiva vikriyāḥ || rāgaṣāḍavacukrādīnsasnehaṃ yacca kiñcana ||| ||47|| etadvinā paryuṣitaṃ bhuktvā copavaseddinam || madyabhāṇḍagatā mohātpītvā vāpo dvijottamaḥ||48|| śaṅkhapuṣpāśritaṃ kṣīraṃ pibettu divasatrayam ||| surābhāṇḍagatā pītvā saptarātraṃ tathā pibet||49|| śūdrocchiṣṭāttathā pītvā pañcarātraṃ tathā pibet|| svapne siktvā brahmacārī dvijaḥ śukramakāmataḥ||2.73.50||| snātvā'rkamarcayitvā triḥ punarmāmityṛcaṃ japet || agnihotrāpaviddhāgnirbrāhmaṇaḥ kāmacārataḥ ||51|| cāndrāyaṇaṃ carenmāsaṃ vīramapyāsanaṃ hitam || brahmahatyā surāpānaṃ steyaṃ gurvaṅganāgamaḥ || 52 || mahānti pātakānyāhuḥ saṃyogaścaiva taiḥ saha || anṛtaṃ ca samutkarṣe rājagāmi ca paiśunam || 53 || guroścālīkanirbandhaḥ samāni brahmahatyayā || brahmojjhatā vedanindā kauṭasākṣyaṃ suhṛdvadhaḥ||54|| varjitānnādyayorjagdhiḥ surāpānasamāni ṣaṭ|| nikṣepasyāpaharaṇaṃ narā'śvarajatasya ca||55|| bhūmivajramaṇīnāṃ ca rukmasteyasamaṃ smṛtam|| retaḥsekassvayonīṣu kumārīṣvantyajāsu ca||56|| sakhyuḥ putrasya ca strīṣu gurutalpasamaṃ viduḥ || govadho'yājyasaṃyājyapāradāryātmavikrayaḥ||57|| gurumātṛpitṛtyāgaḥ svādhyāyāgnyoḥ sutasya ca || parivartitānujena parivedanameva ca || 58|| tayormānaṃ ca kanyāyāstayoreva ca yājanam || kanyāyā dūṣaṇaṃ caiva vārdhuṣyaṃ vratalopanam ||59|| taḍāgārāmadārāṇāmapatyasya ca vikrayaḥ || vrātyatā bāndhavatyāgo bhṛtādhyāpanameva ca || 2.73.60 || bhṛtādadhyayanādānamavikreyasya vikrayam || sarvākareṣvadhīkāro mahāyantra pravartanam || 61 || hiṃsrauṣadhistriyājīvī kriyā yācanakarma ca || indhanārthamaśuṣkāṇāṃ drumāṇāṃ caiva pātanam || 62 || ātmārthaṃ ca kriyārambho ninditānnādanaṃ tathā || anāhitāgnitā steyamagamyāstrīniṣevaṇam || 63|| strīśūdraviṭkṣattrivadho nāstikyañcopapātakam || brāhmaṇasya rujā kṛtyaṃ ghrātiraghreyamadyayoḥ || 64 || jaihmaṃ ca puṃsi maithunyaṃ jātibhraṃśakaraṃ smṛtam || śvakharoṣṭramṛgebhānāmajāvyoścaiva māraṇam || 65 || saṃkīrṇakaraṇaṃ jñeyaṃ mīnāhinakulasya ca || ninditebhyo dhanādānaṃ vāṇijyaṃ śūdrasevanam || 66 || apātrīkaraṇaṃ jñeyamasatyasya ca bhāṣaṇam || kṛmi kīṭavayohatyāmanyānugatabhojanam || 67 || phalaidhakusumasteyamadhairyaṃ capalātmatā || etānyenāṃsi sarvāṇi yathoktāni pṛthakpṛthak || 68 || yairyairvratairapoheta tāni samyaṅnibodhata || brahmahā dvādaśābdāni kuṭiṃ kṛtvā vane vaset || 69 || bhikṣetātha viśuddhyarthamupāsīno vṛṣadhvajam || lakṣaṃ śastrabhṛtāṃ vā syādvidviṣāmicchayātmanaḥ || 2.73.70 || prāśyedātmānamagnau vā samiddhe triravākchirāḥ || yajeta vāśvamedhena svarjitāgosavena ca || || 71 || abhijidviśvajidbhyāṃ vā trivṛtāgniṣṭutāpi vā || japanvānyatamaṃ vedaṃ yojanānāṃ śataṃ vrajet || 72 || brahmahatyāpanuttvarthaṃ mitabhuṅ niyatendriyaḥ || sarvasvaṃ vā vedavide brāhmaṇāyopapādayet || 73 || dhanaṃ vā jīvanāyālaṃ gṛhaṃ vā saparicchadam || vratairetairapoheta mahāpātakitāndvija || 74 || upapātakasaṃyukto goghno māsaṃ yavānadet || kṛtapāpo vā nivaseccarmaṇā tena saṃvṛtaḥ || 75 || caturthakālamaśnīyādakṣāralavaṇa mitam || gomūtreṇācaretsnānaṃ dvau māsau niyatendriyaḥ || 76 || divā'nugacchettā gāśca tiṣṭhannūrdhvamapaḥ pibet || śuśrūṣitvā namaskṛtya rātrau vīrāsanaṃ caret || 77 || tiṣṭhaṃtīṣvanutiṣṭhettu vrajantīṣvapyanuvrajet || āsīnāsu tathāsīno niyato vītamatsaraḥ || 78 || āturāmabhiṣiktāṃ ca cauravyāghrādibhirbhayaiḥ || patita ṅkalīnāṃ vā sarvaprāṇairvimokṣayet || 79 || uṣṇairvarṣātiśītairvā mārute vāti vā bhṛśam || na kurvītātmanastrāṇaṃ gorakṛtvā tu śaktitaḥ || 2.73.80 || ātmano yadi vā'nyeṣāṃ gṛhe kṣetre'tha vā khale || khādamānāṃ na śaṃseta pibantaṃ caiva vatsakam || 81 || vṛṣabhaikādaśā gāstu dadhyāddhi caritavrataḥ || avidyamāne sarvasvaṃ vedavidbhyo nivedayet || 82 || bandhane rodhane vāpi yojane ca gavāṃ rujā || bhavedvā maraṇaṃ yatra nimitte tatra lipyate || 83 || pādamekaṃ caredgoṣṭhe dvau pādau bandhane caret || | yojane pādahīnaṃ syāccaretsarvaṃ nipātane || 84 || kāntāreṣvatha durgeṣu viṣameṣu guhāsu ca || yadi tatra vipattiḥ syādekaḥ pādo vidhīyate || 85 || bādhāmaraṇadoṣeṣu tathaivārdhaṃ vinirdiśet || damane vāhane rodhe śakaṭasya ca yoktraṇe||86|| nadyāṃ śakalapāśeṣu mṛte pādau samācaret || vyāpannānāṃ bahūnāṃ tu bandhane rodhane'pi vā||87|| bhiṣaṅ mithyācaraṃśceha dviguṇaṃ govrataṃ caret || śṛṅgabhaṅge'sthibhaṅge vā lāṃgūlacchedane'thavā ||88|| yāvakaṃ tu pibettāvadyāvatsvasthā tu gaurbhavet || ekā cedbahubhirdaivādyatra vyāpāditā bhavet || 89 || pādaṃpādaṃ tu hatyāyāṃ careyuste pṛthakpṛthak || yantreṇa gościkitsārthe mūḍhagarbhavimokṣaṇe || 2.73.90 || yadi tatra vipattiḥ syāddoṣastatra na vidyate || auṣadhaṃ snehamāhāraṃ dadyācca brāhmaṇādiṣu ||91 || dīyamāne vipattiḥ syāddāturdoṣo na vidyate || etadeva vrataṃ kuryurupapātakinastathā || 92 || avakīrṇī viśuddhyarthaṃ cāndrāyaṇamathāpi vā || avakīrṇī tu kālena saptamena catuṣpathe || 93 || pākayajñavidhānena yajate nibhṛtaṃ niśi || hutvāgnau vidhivaddhomāṃstatastu samitityṛcam || 94 || vātendraguruvahnīnāṃ juhuyātsarpiṣāhutīḥ || kāmato retasaḥ seke vratasthasya dvijanmanaḥ || 95 || ākramaṃ ca vratasyāhurdharmajñāḥ satyavādinaḥ || etasminneva siddhārthe vasitvā gardabhājinam || 96 || saptāgāraṃ caredbhaikṣyaṃ svakarmaparidevayan || tebhyo labdhena bhaikṣyeṇa vartayanneva kālikam || 97 || upa spṛśaṃstriṣavaṇamabdena sa viśudhyati || hatvā garbhamavijñātaṃ brahmahatyāvrataṃ caret || 98 || rājanyavaiśyau cejānā ātreyīmeva ca striyam || uktvā caivānṛtaṃ sākṣye prativadya gurūm̐stathā||99|| apahṛtya ca nikṣepaṃ kṛtvā ca strīsuhṛdvadham || surāṃ pītvā dvijo mohādagnivarṇāṃ surāṃ pibet ||2.73.100|| tayā sakāye nirdagdhe mucyate kilbiṣāttataḥ || gomūtramagnivarṇaṃ vā pibedudakameva ||101|| payo ghṛtaṃ vā maraṇādgośakṛdrasameva vā|| kaṇānvā bhakṣayedabdaṃ piṇyākaṃ vā sakṛnniśi||102|| surāpānāpanuttyarthaṃ cīravāsā jaṭī dhvajī|| surā vai malannānāṃ pāpmā ca malamucyate||103|| tasmādbrāhmaṇarājanyau vaiśyaśca na surāṃ pibet || gauḍī paiṣṭī ca mādhvī ca vijñeyā trividhā surā ||104|| yathaivaikā tathā sarvā na pātavyā dvijottamaiḥ || yakṣarakṣaḥpiśācānāṃ madyaṃ māṃsaṃ surāśanam ||105|| tadbrāhmaṇena nāttavyaṃ devānāmaśnatā haviḥ || mādhvīkamaikṣavaṃ ṭākaṃ kaulaṃ khārjūrapānasam ||106|| mṛdvīkārasamārdvīke mereyaṃ nārikelajam || asevyāni daśaitāni madyāni brāhmaṇasya ca || 107 || yasya kāmagataṃ brahma madyenāplāvyate sakṛt || tasya vyapaiti brāhmaṇyaṃ śūdratvaṃ ca sa gacchati || 108 || ata ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi suvarṇasteyanirṇayam || suvarṇasteyakṛdvipro rājānamabhiśasya tu ||109|| svakarma khyāpanbrūyānmāṃ bhavānapi śāstviti || gṛhītvā musalaṃ rājā sakṛddadyāttu taṃ svayam || 2.73.110 || vadhena śudhyate steno brāhmaṇastapasaiva vā || tapasā tvapanutsustu suvarṇasteyajaṃ malam || 111 || cīravāsā dvijo'raṇye caredbrahmahaṇo vratam || gurutalpo'bhibhāṣyainaṃ talpe svapyādayomaye || 112 || sūrmīṃ jvalaṃtīmāśliṣya mṛtyunā tu viśudhyati || svayaṃ vā śiśnavṛṣaṇāvutkṛtyādhāya svāñjalau || 113 || nairṛtīṃ diśamātiṣṭhedānipātādajihmagaḥ || khaṭvāṅgī cīravāsā vā śmaśrulo vijane vane || 114 || prājāpatyaṃ caretkṛcchraṃ tvabdamekaṃ samāhitaḥ || cāndrāyaṇaṃ tu trīnmāsānabhyasenniyatendriyaḥ || 115 || haviṣyeṇa yavāgvā ca gurutalpāpanuttaye || jātibhraṃśakaraṃ karma kṛtvānyataramicchayā || || 116 || caretsāntapanaṃ kṛcchraṃ prājāpatyamanicchayā || śaṃkarāyātra kṛtyāsu cāsaṃśodhanamaindavam || 117 || malinīkaraṇīyeṣu taptaḥ syādyāvakaṃ tryaham || turīyaṃ brahmahatyāyāḥ kṣatriyasya vadhe smṛtam || 118 || vaiśye'ṣṭameṃśo hyanyattu śūdre jñeyastu ṣoḍaśa || akāmatastu rājanyaṃ vinipātya dvijottamaḥ || 119 || vṛṣabhaikasahasraṃ gā dadyācchuddhyarthamātmanaḥ || tryabdaṃ caredvā niyato jaṭī brahmahaṇo vratam || 2.73.120 || vaseddūratare grāmādvṛkṣamūlaniketanam || etadevācaredabdaṃ prāyaścittaṃ dvijottamaḥ || 121 || pramāpya vaiśyaṃ vṛttasthaṃ dadyāccaikaśataṃ gavām || etadeva vrataṃ kṛtsnaṃ ṣaṇmāsāñchūdrahā caret || 122 || vṛṣabhaikādaśā vāpi dadyādviprāya gāḥ sitāḥ || mārjāranakulau hatvā cāṣaṃ maṇḍūkameva vā || 123 || śvagodholūka kākāṃśca śūdrahatyāvrataṃ caret || payaḥ pibettrirātraṃ vā yojanaṃ vādhvano vrajet || 124 || upaspṛśetsravantyāṃ vā sūktaṃ vā trivṛtaṃ japet || abhrīṃ kālāyasīṃ dadyātsarpaṃ hatvā dvijottamaḥ || 125 || palālabhārakaṃ ṣaṇḍhaṃ somakaṃ caiva māṣakam || ghṛtakumbhaṃ varāhe tu tiladroṇaṃ tu tittire || || 126 || śuke dvihāyanaṃ vatsaṃ krauñcaṃ hatvā dvihāyanam || hatvā haṃsaṃ balākāṃ ca vakaṃ barhiṇameva ca || 127 || vānaraṃ śyenabhāsau vā sparśayedbrāhmaṇāya gām || vāso dadyāddhayaṃ hatvā pañcanīlānvṛṣāngajam || 128 || ajaṃ meṣamanaḍvāhaṃ kharaṃ hatvaikahāyanam || kravyādāṃ hariṇīṃ hatvā dhenuṃ dadyātpayasvinīm || 129 || akravyādaṃ vatsatarīmuṣṭraṃ hatvā tu kṛṣṇalam || jīvakārmukavatsādīnpṛthagdadyādviśuddhaye || 2.73.130 || caturṇāmapi varṇānāṃ nārīṃ hatvā na rāgataḥ || varṇānāmānupūrvyeṇa trayāṇāmaviśeṣataḥ || 131 || pramāpya cāpramāpya strīṃ śūdrahatyāvrataṃ careta || dhanena vadhanirṇekaṃ sarpādīnāmaśaknuvan || 132 || ekaikaśaścaretkṛcchraṃ dvijaḥ pāpāpanuttaye || phaladānāṃ tu vṛkṣāṇāṃ chedane japyamṛkśatam || 133 || gulmavallīlatānāṃ ca puṣpitānāṃ ca vīrudhām || asthanvatāṃ tu sattvānāṃ sahasrasya pramāpaṇe || 134 || pūrṇe vā tadanasthnāṃ tu śūdrahatyāvrataṃ caret || kiñcideva tu viprāya dadyādasthimatāṃ vadhe || 135 || anasthnāṃ caiva hiṃsāyāṃ prāṇāyāmena śudhyati || annādyajānāṃ sattvānāṃ rasajānāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ || 136 || phalapuṣpodbhavānāṃ ca ghṛtaprāśo viśodhanam || kṛṣṇajānāmauṣadhīnāṃ jātānāṃ ca svayaṃ vane || 137 || vṛthārambheṇa gacchedgāṃ dinamekaṃ payovrataḥ || etairvratairapohyaṃ syādeno hiṃsāsamudbhavam || 138 || steyadoṣāpahartṝṇāṃ vratānāṃ śrūyatāṃ vidhiḥ || dhānyāni dhanacauryāṇi kṛtvā kāmāddvijottamaḥ || 139 || svajātīyagṛhādeva kṛcchrābdena viśudhyati || manuṣyāṇāṃ tu haraṇe strīṇāṃ kṣetragṛhasya ca || 2.73.140 || kūpavāpījalānāṃ tu śuddhiścāndrāyaṇaṃ smṛtam || dravyāṇāmalpasārāṇāṃ steyaṃ kṛtvā'nyaveśmataḥ || 141 || caretsāntapanaṃ kṛcchraṃ taṃ niryātyātmaśuddhaye || bhakṣyabhojyāpaharaṇe yānaśayyāsanasya ca || 142 || puṣpamūlaphalānāṃ ca pañcagavyaṃ viśodhanam || tṛṇakāṣṭhadrumāṇāṃ tu śuṣkānnasya guḍasya ca || 143 || cailacarmā'miṣāṇāṃ ca trirātraṃ syādabhojanam || maṇimuktāpravālānāṃ tāmrasya rajatasya ca || 144 || ayaskāṃsyopalānāṃ ca dvādaśāhaṃ kaṇānnabhuk || kārpāsakīṭakorṇānāṃ dviśaphaikaśaphasya ca || 145 || pakṣigandhauṣadhīnāṃ ca rajvāścaiva tryahaṃ payaḥ || etairvratairapoheta pāpaṃ steyakṛtaṃ dvijaḥ || 146 || agamyagamanīyena vratairebhirapānudet || gurutalpavrataṃ kuryādretaḥ siktvānyayoniṣu || 147 || sakhyuḥ putrasya ca strīṣu kumārīṣvantyajāsu ca || paitṛṣvaseyīṃ bhaginīṃ svasrīyāṃ mātureva ca || 148 || mātuśca bhrātustanayāṃ gatvā cādrāyaṇaṃ caret || etāstisrastu bhāryārthe nopayaccheta buddhimān || 149 || jñātayo nopayamanāḥ pituśca hyupayannadhaḥ || amānuṣīṣu puruṣa udakyāṃ vāmayoniṣu || 2.73.150 || retaḥ siktvā jale caiva kṛcchraṃ sāntapanaṃ caret || maithunaṃ tu samāsevya puṃsi yoṣiti vā dvijaḥ || 151 || goyāneṣu divā caiva savāsāḥ snānamācaret || caṇḍālāntyajastrīyogādbhuktvā ca pratigṛhya ca || 152 || patatyajñānato vipro jñānātsāmyaṃ ca gacchati || vipraduṣṭāṃ striyaṃ bhartā nirundhyādekaveśmani || 153 || yatpuṃsaḥ paradāreṣu taccaināṃ cārayedvratam || sā cetpunaḥ praduṣyeta sadṛśenopamantritā || 154 || kṛcchraṃ cāndrāyaṇaṃ caiva tadasyāḥ pāvanaṃ smṛtam || yatkarotyekarātreṇa vṛṣalīsevanāddvijaḥ || 155 || tadbhaikṣyabhugjapannityaṃ tribhirvarṣairvyapohati || eṣā pāpakṛtāmuktā caturṇāmapi niṣkṛtiḥ || 156 || patitaiḥ saṃprayuktānāmimāḥ śṛṇuta niṣkṛtīḥ || saṃvatsareṇa patati patitena sahācaran || 157 || yājanādhyāpanāddānāduktipānāśanāsanāt || yo yena patitenaiṣāṃ saṃsargaṃ yāti mānavaḥ || 158 || sa tasyaiva vrataṃ kuryāttatsaṃsargasya śuddhaye || patitasyodakaṃ kāryaṃ sapiṇḍairbāndhavaiḥ saha || 159 || nindite'hani sāyāhne jñātyṛtviggurusannidhau || dāsīghaṭamapāṃ pūrṇaṃ paryasyetpretavatsadā || 2.73.160 || ahorātramupāsīranna śaucaṃ bāndhavaiḥ saha || nivartayerantasmāttu saṃbhāṣaṇasahāsane || 161 || dāyādasya pradānaṃ ca yātrāmeva ca laukikīm || jyeṣṭhabhāgaṃ nivarteta jyeṣṭhāvāptaṃ ca yadvasu || 162 || jyeṣṭhāṃśaṃ prāpnuyāccāpi yavīyānguṇato'dhikaḥ || prāyaścitte tu carite pūrṇaṃ kumbhamapāṃ navam || 163 || tenaiva sārdhaṃ prāpyeyuḥ snātvā puṇye jalāśaye || satsvapsu taṃ ghaṭaṃ prāpya praviśya bhavanaṃ svakam || 164 || sarvāṇi jñātikāryāṇi yathāpūrvaṃ samācaret || enameva vidhiṃ kuryādyoṣitsu patitāsvapi || 165 || vastrānnapānaṃ deyaṃ tu vaseyuśca gṛhāntike || enasvibhiranirṇiktairnārthaṃ kiñcitsamācaret|| 166 || kṛtanirṇejanāṃścaitānna jugupseta karhicit || bālaghnāṃśca kṛtaghnāṃśca viśuddhānapi dharmataḥ ||167|| śaraṇāgatahaṃtṝśca strīhaṃtṝśca na saṃvaset || yeṣāṃ dvijānāṃ sāvitrī nānucyeta yathāvidhi || 168 || tāṃścārayitvā trīnkṛcchrānyathāvidhyupanāyayet || prāyaścittaṃ cikīrṣanti vikarmasthāstu ye dvijāḥ || 169 || brāhmaṇāśca parityaktā yeṣāṃ madhye tadādiśet || yadgarhitenārjayanti brāhmaṇāḥ karmaṇā dhanama | 2.73.170 || tasyotsargeṇa śudhyanti japyena tapasaiva ca || japitvā trīṇi sāvitryāḥ sahasrāṇi samāhitaḥ || 171 || māsaṃ goṣṭhe payaḥ pītvā mucyate'satpratigrahāt || upavāsakṛśaṃ taṃ tu govrajātpunarāgatam ||172 || praṇataṃ paripṛccheyuḥ saumya saumyecchasīti kim || satyamuktvā tu viprebhyo vitaredyavasaṃ gavām || 173 || gobhiḥ pravartite tīrthe kuryustasya parigrahama || vrātyānāṃ yājanaṃ kṛtvā pareṣāmaṃtyakarma ca ||174 || abhicāramahīnaṃ ca tribhiḥ kṛcchrairviśudhyati || śaraṇāgataṃ parityajya vedaṃ viplāvya ca dvijaḥ||175|| saṃvatsaraṃ yatāhārastatpāpamapagacchati|| śvaśṛgāloragairdaṣṭo grāmyaiḥ kravyādbhireva ca || 176|| gavāśvoṣṭravarāhaiśca prāṇāyāmena śuddhyati|| ṣaṣṭhānnakālamaśanaṃ saṃhitājāpa eva ca|| 177|| homaśca śākalo nityamapaṅktyānāṃ viśodhanam|| uṣṭrayānaṃ samāruhya kharayānaṃ ca kāmataḥ||178|| snātvā tu vipro digvāsāḥ prāṇāyāmena śudhyati|| vinā bhinnāpsu cādyantaḥ śarīraṃ saṃniveśayet||179|| sacailo bahirāplutya gāmālabhya viśudhyati|| vedoditānāṃ nityānāṃ karmaṇāṃ samatikrame||2.73.180|| snātakavratalope ca prāyaścittamabhojanam|| huṅkāraṃ brāhmaṇasyoktvā tvaṃkāraṃ tu garīyasaḥ||181|| snātvānaśnannahaścaikamabhivādya prasādayet|| tāḍayitvā tṛṇenāpi kaṇṭhe baddhvāpi vāsasā|| 182|| vivādenāpi nirjitya praṇipatya prasādayet|| avagūrya tvabdaśataṃ sahasramabhihatya ca||183|| jighāṃsayā brāhmaṇasya narakaṃ pratipadyate|| śoṇitaṃ yāvataḥ pāṃsūnsaṃgṛhṇāti dvijanmanaḥ||184|| tāvantyabdasahasrāṇi tatkartā narakaṃ vrajet|| avagūrya caretkṛcchramatikṛcchraṃ nipātane||185|| kṛcchrātikṛcchraṃ kurvīta viprasyotpādya śoṇitam|| caṇḍālādiravijñāto yasya tiṣṭheta veśmani||186|| samyagjñātastu kālena tasya kurvīta śodhanam|| cāndrāyaṇaṃ parākaṃ vā dvijānāṃ tu viśodhanam||187|| prājāpatyaṃ tu śūdrāṇāṃ śeṣaṃ tadanusārataḥ|| guḍaṃ kusumbhaṃ lavaṇaṃ tathā dhānyāni yāni ca||188|| kṛtvā gṛhe tato dvāri teṣāṃ dadyāddhutāśanam|| mṛṇmayānāṃ tu bhāṇḍānāṃ tyāga eva vidhīyate||189|| dravyāṇāṃ pariśeṣāṇāṃ dravyaśuddhirvidhīyate|| yastasya bhuṅkte pakvānnaṃ kṛcchrārdhaṃ tasya dāpayet||2.73.190|| śuṣkānnabhojinaḥ pādamityāha bhagavānmanuḥ|| kūpe tā nava saṃtārya sparśasaṃkalpadūṣitāḥ||191|| śuddheyurupavāsena pañcagavyena cāpyatha|| yastu saṃspṛśya cāṇḍālamaśnīyādvā tvakāmataḥ||192|| dvijaścāndrāyaṇaṃ kuryāttaptakṛcchramathāpi vā|| varṇasaṃkarasaṃkīrṇāścaṇḍālādijugupsitāḥ||193|| bhuktvā pītvā tathā teṣāṃ ṣaḍrātreṇa viśudhyati|| antyānāṃ bhuktaśeṣaṃ tu bhakṣayitvā dvijātayaḥ|| 194|| vrataṃ cāndrāyaṇaṃ kuryustrirātraṃ śūdra eva ca|| caṇḍālakūpabhāṇḍeṣu ajñānādyaḥ pibejjalam || 195 || dvijaḥ sāntapanaṃ kuryācchūdraścopavaseddinam || ucchiṣṭo yadi saṃspṛṣṭaḥ śunā śūdreṇa vā dvijaḥ || 196 || upoṣya rajanīmekāṃ pañcagavyena śudhyati || ucchiṣṭena yadi spṛṣṭa ucchiṣṭo brāhmaṇottamaḥ || 197 || trikālamācaretsnānaṃ naktaṃ bhuṃjīta vāgyataḥ || kṣattriyeṇa tathā spṛṣṭaḥ snānaṃ naktaṃ samācaret || 198 || spṛṣṭaḥ savarṇenācāmedamedhyaṃ spṛśate yadi || ahorātroṣito bhūtvā pañcagavyena śuddhyati ||199|| adhvānaṃ prasthito vipraḥ kāntāre yadyanūdake || pakvānnena gṛhītena mūtroccāraṃ karoti vai || 2.73.200 || anidhāyaiva taddravyaṃ kṛtvāṃge uttame sthitam || śaucaṃ kṛtvā yathānyāyamupaviśya yathāvidhi||201|| annamabhyukṣayeccāpi uddhṛtyārkasya darśayet || arkābhāve'pyathāgneśca bastasyātha pradarśayet ||202 || tyaktvā grāsatrayaṃ tasmāccheṣaṃ śuddhimavāpnuyāt || mlecchairhṛtānāṃ caurairvā kāntāre vā pravāsinām||203||| bhakṣyābhakṣyaviśuddhyarthaṃ teṣāṃ vakṣyāmi niṣkṛtim || punaḥ prāpya svadeśaṃ ca varṇānāmanupūrvaśaḥ || 204 || kṛcchrasyārdhe brāhmaṇastu punaḥ saṃskāramarhati || pādonānte kṣatriyastu ardhārdhe vaiśya eva ca || 205 || pādaṃ kṛtvā tathā śūdro dānaṃ dattvā viśudhyati || udakyā tu savarṇā yā spṛṣṭā cetsyādudakyayā || 206 || ahorātroṣitā sā ca śuddhā snānena śudhyati || mūtraṃ kṛtvā vrajenmārgaṃ smṛtibhraṃśājjalaṃ pibet || 207 || ahorātroṣito bhūtvā pañcagavyena śudhyati || mūtroccāraṃ ddvijaḥ kṛtvā'pyakṛtvā śaucamātmanaḥ || 208 || mohādbhuktvā trirātraṃ tu yavān pītvā viśudhyati || parityaktamahāyajñā pravrajyāvicyutāśca ye ||209|| anāśakanivṛttāśca teṣāṃ śuddhiḥ pravakṣyate || cārayettrīṇi kṛcchrāṇi cāndrāyaṇamathāpi vā || 2.73.210 || jātakarmādisaṃskāraiḥ saṃskuryāttaṃ tathā punaḥ || upānahamamedhyaṃ vā cāsya saṃspṛśate mukham || 211 || putrikāgomayau tasya pañcagavyaṃ viśodhanam || vāpana vikrayaṃ caiva nīlavṛttyupajīvanam || 212 || patanīyaṃ hi viprasya nīlasūtrasya dhāraṇāt || snānaṃ dānaṃ tapo homaḥ svādhyāyaḥ pitṛtarpaṇam || 213 || vṛthā tasya mahāyajñā sūtrasūtrasya dhāraṇāt || nīlaraktaṃ yadā vastraṃ dvijoṃgeṣu hi dhārayet || 214 || upoṣya rajanīmekāṃ pañcagavyena śudhyati|| nīladāru yadā bhajyedbrāhmaṇasya tu pādayoḥ || 215 || śoṇitaṃ dṛśyate cāsya dvijaścāndrāyaṇaṃ caret|| vāpitaṃ yatra nīlaṃ tu tāvadevāśucirmahī || 216 || pramāṇaṃ dvādaśābdāni ata ūrdhvaṃ śucirbhavet || antyajātiḥ śvapākena saṃspṛṣṭā strī rajasvalā || 217 ||| caturthe'hani śuddhāyāḥ prāyaścittaṃ viśodhanam || trirātramupavāsaḥ syātpañcagavyaṃ tathaiva ca || 218 || ucchiṣṭena tu saṃspṛṣṭā kadācitstrī rajasvalā ||| yāvanna śuddhimāpnoti nāśnīyāttāvadeva tu || 219 || caṇḍālaśvapacau spṛṣṭvā śavadhūmañca sūtikām || śavaṃ sparśayitā śvānaṃ sadyaḥ snānena śudhyati ||2.73.220|| nā spṛṣṭvā'sthi tu sasnehaṃ snātvā vipro viśudhyati|| ācamyaiva tu niḥsnehaṃ gāmālabhyārkamīkṣya vā||221|| rathyākardamatoyena nābhispṛṣṭo bhavatyadhaḥ|| mṛttoyaiścarcayedaṅgaṃ tataḥ śuddhimavāpnuyāt||222|| vāntaṃ viviktaḥ snātvā tu ghṛtaṃ pītvā viśudhyati|| kṣurakarma tataḥ kṛtvā snānenaiva viśudhyati||223|| apāṅkteyaistu yaḥ paṅktyāṃ bhuṃkte kaściddvijottamaḥ|| ahorātroṣito bhūtvā pañcagavyena śudhyati||224|| candrārkagrahaṇe bhuktvā dvijaścāndrāyaṇaṃ caret|| brahmacārī śunādaṣṭastryahaṃ sāyaṃ payaḥ pibet||225|| gṛhastho vā trirātraṃ tu caikāhaṃ tvagnihotravān|| nābherūrdhvaṃ tu daṣṭasya tadeva dviguṇaṃ bhavet||226|| bāhvośca triguṇaṃ jñeyaṃ mūrdhani syāccaturguṇam|| udgranthamṛtakaṃ pretaṃ yaḥ spṛśedbrāhmaṇaḥ kvacit||227|| tasya śuddhiṃ vijānīyāttaptakṛcchreṇa nityaśaḥ|| ātmānaṃ ghātayedyastu rajjvādibhirupakramaiḥ||228|| tasya pretakriyāṃ kṛtvā taptakṛcchreṇa śudhyati|| indriyeṣu praviṣṭaṃ syādamedhyaṃ yasya kasya cit||229|| ahorātroṣitaḥ snātvā pañcagavyena śudhyati|| etairdvijātayaḥ śodhyā vratairāviṣkṛtairmayā||2.73.230|| anāviṣkṛtapāpāṃśca mantrairhomaiśca sādhayet|| khyāpanenānutāpena tapasā'dhyayanena ca||231|| pāpakṛnmucyate pāpāttathā dānena cāpare|| yathā yathānaro dharmaṃ svayaṃ kṛtvā na bhāṣate||232|| tathā tathā ca yenaiva tasmātpāpātpramucyate|| kṛtvā pāpaṃ hi smartavyaṃ tasmātpāptpramucyate||233|| yathāyathā manastasya duṣkṛtaṃ karma garhati|| tathātathā śarīraṃ tattenādharmeṇa mucyate||234|| naitatkuryāṃ punariti nivṛtyāṃ prayatennaraḥ|| evaṃ saṃcintya manasā pretyakarmaphalodayam||235|| manovākkarmabhirnnityaṃ śubhaṃ karma samācaret|| ajñānādyadi vā jñānātkṛtvā karma vigarhitam||236|| tasmāddhi mucyate nityaṃ dvitīyaṃ na samācaret|| yasminkarmaṇyasya kṛte manasaḥ syādalāghavam|| tasmiṃstāvattapaḥ kuryādyāvattuṣṭikaraṃ bhavet||237|| gurulaghutāṃ tu vicārya yathāvadyeṣu mayāgamanaṃ ca tavoktam|| teṣu na cetsahaniścitabuddhirvipravaraiḥ kuśalaiḥ sudhiyā vā||238|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0saṃ0 prāyaścittādhyāyo nāma trisaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ||73|| <2.74> puṣkara uvāca|| ityetadenasāmuktaṃ prāyaścittaṃ yathāvidhi|| ata ūrdhvaṃ rahasyānāṃ prāyaścittaṃ nibodha me||1|| pauruṣeṇa tu sūktena japyahomairdavijottamāḥ|| māsenaikena mucyante pātakaiḥ saṃyatendriyāḥ||2|| savyāhṛtīkapraṇavāḥ prāṇāyāmāstu ṣoḍaśa|| api bhrūṇahanaṃ māsātpunantyaharahaḥ kṛtāḥ ||3|| kautsaṃ japtvāpa ityetadvasiṣṭhaṃ prati ca tryṛcam|| māheśaṃ śuddhavatyaśca surāpo'pi viśudhyati||4|| sakṛjjaptvāsyavāmīyaṃ śivasaṃkalpameva ca|| apahṛtya suvarṇaṃ tu kṣaṇādbhavati nirmalaḥ||5|| haviṣmatīyamasyeti tataḥ saṃhā itīti ca || japtvā ca pauruṣaṃ sūktaṃ mucyate gurutalpagaḥ || 6 || enasāṃ sthūlasūkṣmāṇāṃ cikīrṣannapanodanam || avetryṛcaṃ japedabdaṃ yatkiñcidapi tāni cet || 7 || pratigṛhyāpratigṛhyaṃ bhuktvā cānnaṃ vigarhitam || japaṃstaratsamaṃdīyaṃ prayato mānavastryaham || 8 || somāraudraṃ tu vahnīnāṃ japansatyasya śudhyati || sravantyāmācaretsnānaṃ paryasyamiti vā tryṛcam || 9 || advā rasānamityetadenasvī saptakaṃ japet || aprakāśaṃ tu kṛtveno māsamāsīta bhaikṣyabhuk || 2.74.10 || mantraiḥ śākalahomīyairabdaṃ hutvā ghṛtaṃ dvijaḥ || sugurvapyapahantyeno japtvā vāmana iṣyate || 11 || drupadā nāma sā devī yajurvede pratiṣṭhitā||| antarjale trirāvṛtya mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ || 12 || mahāpātakasaṃyukto na gacchedgāḥ samāhitaḥ || svabhyasya pāvamānīyaṃ bhaikṣyāhāro viśudhyati || ||13|| araṇye vā trirabhyasya prayato vedasaṃhitām || mucyate pātakaiḥ sarvaiḥ parākaiḥ śodhitastribhiḥ || 14|| tryahaṃ tūpavasedyuktastriraho'bhyupayannapaḥ || mucyate pātakaiḥ sarvairjaptvā triraghamarṣaṇam || 15 || yathāśvamedhaḥ sutarāṃ sarvapāpāpanodanaḥ || tathāghamarṣaṇaṃ sūktaṃ sarvapāpāpanodanam ||16|| hatvā lokānapīmāṃstrīnaśnannapi yatastataḥ || ṛgvedaṃ dhārayanvipro nainaḥ prāpnoti kiñcana||17|| ṛksaṃhitāṃ samabhyasya yajuṣāṃ vā samāhitaḥ || sāmnāṃ vā sarahasyānāṃ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate||18|| yathā mahāhradaṃ prāpya kṣipraṃ loṣṭho vinaśyati|| tathā duścaritaṃ sarvaṃ vede trivṛti majjati||19|| ṛco yajūṃṣi cādyāni sāmāni vividhāni ca || eṣa jñeyastrivṛdvedo yo vai veda sa vedavit ||2.74.20|| ādyaṃ vai tryakṣaraṃ brahma trayī yasminpratiṣṭhitā || sa guhyo'nyastrivṛdvedo yo vedainaṃ sa vedavit||21|| vedābhyāso'nvahaṃ śaktyā mahāyajñakriyāsamaḥ|| nāśayantyāśu pāpāni mahāpātakajānyapi ||22|| yathaidhāṃsi samiddho'gnirbhasmasātkurute kṣaṇāt|| tathā jñānāgninā pāpaṃ kṣipraṃ dahati vedavit||23|| ye vāsudevaṃ jagatāmadhīśaṃ bhaktyā gatāḥ sarvajagatpradhānam || te pātakānyāśu vidhūya loke bhavanti candrārkasamaprabhāvāḥ||24|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0saṃ0 prāyaścitto nāma catuḥsaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ||74|| <2.75> rāma uvāca || pretaśuddhiṃ samācakṣva sūtikāśuddhimeva ca || dravyaśuddhiṃ ca bhagavaṃstvaṃ hi vetsi yathātathā || 1 || puṣkara uvāca || daśāhaṃ śāvamāśaucaṃ sapiṇḍeṣu vidhīyate || janane ca tathāpyevaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ bhṛgūttama || 2 || dvādaśāhena rājanyaḥ pakṣādvaiśyo viśudhyati || māsena śuddhimāpnoti tathā śūdro'pi bhārgava || 3 || ānulomyena patnīnāṃ dāsīnāṃ ca bhṛgūttama || svāmitulyaṃ bhavecchaucaṃ mṛte svāmini yautukam || 4 || ṣaḍbhistribhirathaikena kṣatraviṭśūdrayoniṣu || brāhmaṇaḥ śuddhimāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 5 || viṭśūdrayonau śuddhiḥ syātkṣattriyasya tathaiva ca || ṣaḍrātreṇa trirātreṇa ṣaḍbhiḥ śūdrastathā viśaḥ ||6 || adantajātabāle tu sadyaḥ śaucaṃ vidhīyate || bāle tvakṛtacūḍe ca viśuddhirnaiśikī smṛtā || 7 || tathā cānupanīte tu trirātrācchuddhiriṣyate || tataḥ paraṃ daśāhena śuddheyustasya bāndhavāḥ||8|| ūnatrivārṣike śuddhe pañcāhā śuddhiriṣyate || dvādaśāhena śuddhiḥ syādatīte vatsaratraye||9|| gataiḥ saṃvatsaraiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ śuddhirmāsena kīrtitā|| strīṇāmakṛtacūḍānāṃ viśuddhirnaiśikī smṛtā||2.75.10|| tathā hi kṛtacūḍānāṃ tryahācchudhyanti bāndhavāḥ || vivāhitāsu nāśaucaṃ pitṛpakṣe vidhīyate || 11 || pitṛgṛhe prasūtāyāṃ viśuddhirnaiśikī smṛtā || sūtikā daśarātreṇa śuddhimāpnoti nānyathā || 12 ||| vivāhitā'pi cetkanyā mriyate pitṛveśmani || tasyāstrirātrācchudhyanti bāndhavā nātra saṃśayaḥ || 13|| pitṛveśmani yā kanyā rajaḥ paśyatyasaṃskṛtā || tasyāṃ mṛtāyāṃ nāśaucaṃ kadācidapi śāmyati || 14 || sasnānaṃ khalu śaucaṃ ca prathamena samāpayet || asamānaṃ dvitīyena dharmarājavaco yathā || 19 || deśāntarasthāḥ śrutvā tu kulyānāṃ maraṇodbhavau || yaccheṣaṃ daśarātrasya tāvadeva śucirbhavet || 16 || atīte daśarātre tu trirātramaśucirbhavet|| tathā saṃvatsare'tīte snāta eva ca śuddhyati || 17 || mātāmahe tathātīte ācārye ca tathā mṛte || anauraseṣu putreṣu bhāryāsvanyagatāsu ca || 18 || parapūrvāsu bhāryāsu trirātrācchuddhiriṣyate || nivāse rājani prete mātule śvaśure tathā || 19 || ācāryapatnīputreṣu śiṣye sabrahmacāriṇi || ekarātramaśaucaṃ syādannadāne tathā mṛte || 2.75.20 || rātribhirmāsatulyābhirgarbhasrāve viśodhanam || sapiṇḍe brāhmaṇe varṇāḥ sarva evāviśeṣataḥ || 21 || daśarātreṇa śuddhayanti dvādaśāhena bhūmipāḥ || vaiśyaḥ pañcadaśāhena śūdro māsena bhārgava ||22|| bhṛgvagnyanāśanāṃbhobhirmṛtānāmātmaghātinām || patitānāṃ ca nāśaucaṃ vidyucchastrahatāśca ye || 23 || satī vratī brahmacārī nṛpakārakadīkṣitāḥ || nāśaucabhājaḥ kathitā rājakāryakarāśca ye ||24|| anugamyecchayā pretaṃ jñātimajñātimeva vā || savāsā jalamāplutya ghṛtaṃ prāśya viśudhyati|| maithune kaṭadhūme ca sadyaḥ snānaṃ vidhīyate || 25|| jananamaraṇayoḥ śucirdaśāhena bhavati śaucavidherna viprayojyam || na ca bhavati pratigraheṣu doṣo dvipada catuṣpadadhānyadakṣiṇāsu||26|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0saṃ0rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne śaucavidhirnāma pañcasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ||75|| <2.76> puṣkara uvāca | dvijaṃ na nirharetpretaṃ śūdreṇa tu kathaṃcana | na ca śūdraṃ dvijenāpi tayordoṣo'bhijāyate || 1 || anāthaṃ brāhmaṇapretaṃ ye vahanti dvijātayaḥ | padepade kratuphalaṃ cānupūrvāllabhanti te||2|| saṃskārārthamanāthasya yastu kāṣṭhaṃ prayacchati || kāṣṭhāgnidātā prākāśyaṃ saṃgrāme labhate jayam ||3|| saṃjvālya bāndhavaṃ pretamapasavyena tāṃ citim || parikramya tataḥ snānaṃ kuryuḥ sarve svabāndhavāḥ ||4|| pretāya ca tathā dadyustisro vai codakāñjalīḥ || dvāryaśmani padaṃ dattvā praviśeyustathā gṛham || ||5|| akṣatā nikṣipeyuśca tathā vahnau samāhitāḥ || vidaśya nimbapatrāṇi śayīraṃśca pṛthak kṣitau|||| krītalabdhāśanāścaiva bhaveyuḥ susamāhitāḥ || na caiva māṃsamaśnīyurvrajeyurna ca yoṣitam || 7 || nivartayeyustathaivaikaṃ piṇḍaṃ pretasya nityadā || aśaucaṃ yāvadeva syāttasminvyapagate punaḥ ||8|| śmaśrukarma tadā kṛtvā snātāḥ siddhārthakaistilaiḥ || pūjayeyurdvijānrāma parivartitavāsasaḥ ||9|| adantajātestanaye śiśau garbhacyute tathā || kāryo naivā'gnisaṃskāro naiva cāsyodakakriyā ||2.76.10|| caturthe ca dine kāryaścaivāsthnāṃ rāma saṃcayaḥ || asthisaṃcayanādūrdhvaṃ kulasparśo vidhīyate || 11 || mṛtasya bāndhavaiḥ sārdhaṃ kṛtvāśrupatanaṃ naraḥ || asthisaṃcayanādarvāk sacailaṃ snānamācaret ||12|| snātaśca śuddhimāpnoti tataḥ paramiti śrutiḥ || asthnāṃ gaṅgāmbhasi kṣepātpretasyābhyudayo bhavet || 13 || asthnāṃ hi plāvanārthāya sāgarāṇāṃ mahātmanām || gaganādbhuvamānītā gaṅgā gaganamekhalā || 14 || bhagīrathena dharmajña tapasā mahatā purā || sagarasya sutāḥ sarve narakasthā bhṛgūttama || 15 || gaṅgātoyāplutā rāma divamakṣayyamāgatāḥ || gaṅgātoyena yasyāsthi yāvatsaṃkhyaṃ nimajjati || 16 || tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi svargaloke mahīyate || ātmanastyāgināṃ nāsti patitānāṃ tathā kriyā || 17 || teṣāmapi tathā gaṅgātoye syātpatanaṃ hitam || patitānāṃ tu yaddattaṃ śrāddhaṃ cātha jalāñjaliḥ || 18 || na tatpretaḥ samāpnoti gagane pravilīyate || anugraheṇa sahitā pretasya patitasya tu || 19 || nārāyaṇabaliḥ kāryastenānugrahamaśnute || anādinidhano devaḥ śaṃkhacakragadādharaḥ || 2.76.20 || akṣayaḥ puṇḍarīkākṣastatra dattaṃ na naśyati || yathākathaṃcidyaddattaṃ devadeve janārdane || 21 || avināśi tu tadviddhi pātrameko janārdanaḥ || parasmāttrāyate yasmāttasmātpātraṃ prakīrtitam || patatāṃ trāṇadastveko devo madhuniṣūdanaḥ ||22|| amitabalaparākramo mahaujā duritabhayāpaharo harirmahātmā || aghaśatamalinaiśca sevyamāno bhavati nṛṇāṃ tridivāya vāsudeva||23|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0saṃ0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne pretanirhaṇonāma ṣaṭsaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 76 || <2.77> || puṣkara uvāca || aśauce tu vyatikrānte snātaḥ prayatamānasaḥ || snātānalaṅkṛtānbhaktyā gandhavastrojjvalāndvijān |||3|| udaṅmukhānbhojayīta svāsīnānsusamāhitān || mantrohāścātra kartavyāstathaikavacanena ca || 2 || ucchiṣṭasannidhāvekaṃ tathā piṇḍaṃ niveśayet || kīrtayecca tathā tasya nāmagotre samāhitaḥ |||3 || bhuktavatsu ca vipreṣu pūjiteṣu tathā dhanaiḥ || visṛṣṭākṣayatoyeṣu gotranāmānukīrtanaiḥ || 4 || caturaṅgulavistāramutkhātaṃ tāvadantaram || vitastidīrghaṃ kartavyaṃ karṣūṇāṃ ca tathā trayam || 5 || karṣūṇāṃ tu samīpe ca jvālayejjvalanatrayam || somāya vahnaye rāma yamāya ca samāhitaḥ || 6 || juhuyādāhutīḥ samyak tathaiva ca trayastrayaḥ || piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ kuryātprāgvadeva pṛthakpṛthak || 7 || annena dadhnā madhunā tathā māṃsena pūrayet || madhye cedadhivāsaḥ syātkuryādabhyadhikaṃ tataḥ || 8 || athavā dvādaśāhena sarvametatsamāpayet || saṃvatsarasya madhye cedyadi syādadhimāsakaḥ || 9 || tato dvādaśake śrāddhe kāryaṃ tadadhimāsikam || tato dvādaśake śrāddhe kāryaṃ tadadhikaṃ bhavet||2.77.10|| saṃvatsare samāpte tu śrāddhaṃ śrāddhavadācaret || pretāya tasmādūrdhvaṃ ca tasyaiva puruṣatraye || 11 || piṇḍānvinirvapeccātra caturaḥ susamāhitaḥ || saṃsṛjaṃ pṛthivīṃ dattvā samānāveti cāpyatha || 12 || yojayetpretapiṇḍaṃ tu piṇḍeṣvanyeṣu bhārgava || pretapātraṃ ca pātreṣu tathaiva viniyojayet ||13|| pṛthakpṛthak ca kartavyaṃ karmaitatkarmaṇāṃ traye || mantravarjamidaṃ karma śūdrasyāpi vidhīyate || 14 || amantroccāraṇaṃ strīṇāṃ kāryametattathā bhavet || yāvajjīvaṃ tathā kuryācchrāddhaṃ tu prativatsaram || anenaiva vidhānena bhakttyā prayatamānasaḥ||15| pretāyānnaṃ sodakumbhaṃ pradeyaṃ nityaṃ bhaktyā yāvadabdāvasānam || etatkāryaṃ bāndhavairnaiva kāryaḥ śokaḥ śocannaiva kiñcitprakuryāt||16|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0 saṃ0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaravākye pretakriyā nāma saptasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 77 || <2.78> puṣkara uvāca || budhairāśvasanīyāśca bāndhavairmṛtabāndhavāḥ || vacanairdharmasaṃyuktaistāni cānyāni me śṛṇu || 1 || nityamasminnirālambe kāle satatayāyini || na tadbhūtaṃ prapasyāmi sthitiryasya bhaveddhruvā || 2 || gaṅgāyāḥ sikatādhārāstathā varṣati vāsave || śakyā gaṇayituṃ loke na vyatītāḥ pitāmahāḥ || 3 || caturdaśa vinaśyanti kalpekalpe sureśvarāḥ || sarvalokapradhānāśca manavaśca caturdaśa || 4 || bahūnīndrasahasrāṇi daityendraniyutāni ca || vinaṣṭānīha kālena manujeṣvatha kā kathā || 5 || rājarṣayaśca bahavaḥ sarve samuditā guṇaiḥ || devā brahmarṣayaścaiva kālena nidhanaṃ gatāḥ || 6 || ye samarthā jagatyasminsṛṣṭisaṃhārakāraṇe|| te'pi kālena nīyante kālo hi duratikramaḥ||7|| ākramya sarvaṃ kālena paralokāya nīyate || karma paśyati no jantustatra kā paridevanā ||8|| jātasya hi dhruvo mṛtyurdhruvaṃ janma mṛtasya ca || asminduṣparihārye'rthe nāsti loke sahāyatā || 9 || śocanto nopakurvanti mṛtasya hi janā yadā || ato na śocitavyaṃ syātkriyā kāryā suyatnataḥ || 2.78.10 || sukṛtaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ cobhau sahāyau yasya gacchataḥ || bāndhavaistasya kiṃ kāryaṃ śocadbhiratha vā na vā || 11 || bāndhavānāmaśauce tu sthitiṃ preto na vindati || atastvabhyeti tāneva piṇḍatoyapradāyinaḥ || 12 || arvāk sapiṇḍīkaraṇātpreto bhavati yo mṛtaḥ || pretalokagatasyānnaṃ sodakumbhaṃ prayacchata || 13 || pitṛlokagataścānnaṃ śrāddhaṃ bhuṅkte sudhāsamam || pitṛlokagatasyāsya tasmācchrāddhaṃ prayatnataḥ || 14 || devatve yātanāsthāne tiryagyonau tathaiva ca || mānuṣye ca tathā'pnoti śrāddhe datte svabāndhavaiḥ || 15|| pretasya śrāddhakartuśca puṣṭiḥ śrāddhe kṛte dhruvam || tasmācchrāddhaṃ sadā kāryaṃ śokaṃ tyaktvā nirarthakam ||16|| etāvadeva kartavyaṃ sadā pretasya bandhubhiḥ|| nopakuryānnaraḥ śocanpretasyātmana eva ca||17|| dṛṣṭvā lokamanākrandaṃ mriyamāṇāṃśca bāndhavān || dharmamekaṃ sahāyārthe kārayadhvaṃ sadā narāḥ || 18|| mṛto'pi bāndhavaḥ śakto nānugantuṃ narairyataḥ || jāyāvarjyaṃ hi sarvasya yasyā bhartā vibhidyate || 19 || dharma eko'nuyātyenaṃ yatra kutra ca gāminam || nanvasāre triloke 'smindharma kuru mā ciram || 2.78.20 || śvaḥ kāryamadya kurvīta pūrvāhṇe tvaparāhṇikam || na hi pratīkṣate mṛtyuḥ kṛtamasya na vā kṛtama || 21 || kṣetrāpaṇagṛhāsaktamanyatra gatamānasam || vṛkīvā'raṇyamāsādya mṛtyurādāya gacchati||22|| na kālasya priyaḥ kaścidveṣyaścāsya na vidyate || āyuṣye karmaṇi kṣīṇe prasahya harate janam||23|| nāprāptakālo mriyate viddhaḥ śaraśatairapi || kuśāgreṇāpi saṃspṛṣṭaḥ prāptakālo na jīvati ||24|| nauṣadhāni na mantrāśca na homā na punarjapāḥ || trāyante mṛtyunopetaṃ jarayā vāpi mānavam||25|| āgāminamanarthaṃ tu pratighātaśatairapi || na nivārayituṃ śaktāstatra kā paridevanā ||26|| yathā dhenusahasreṣu vatso vindati mātaram || tathā pūrvakṛtaṃ karma kartāraṃ vindate dhruvam |||27|| avyaktādīni sarvāṇi vyaktamadhyāni cāpyatha || avyaktanidhanānyeva tatra kā paridevanā ||28|| dehinosminyathā dehaṃ kaumāraṃ yauvanaṃ jarā || tathā janmāntaraprāptirdhīrastatra na muhyati || 29 || gṛhṇātīva yathā vastraṃ tyaktvā pūrvadhṛtaṃ naraḥ|| gṛhṇātyevaṃ navaṃ dehaṃ dehīkarmanibandhanaḥ||2.78.30|| nainaṃ chindanti śastrāṇi nainaṃ dahati pāvakaḥ || na cainaṃ kledayantyāpo na śoṣayati mārutaḥ || 31 || acchedyo'yamadāhyo'yamakledyo'śoṣya eva ca || nityaḥ sarvagataḥsthāṇuracalo'yaṃ sanātanaḥ||32|| avyakto'yamacintyo'yamavikāryo'yameva ca || tasmādevaṃ vidittvainaṃ nānuśocitumarhatha || 33 || āścaryavatpaśyati kaścidenamāścaryavadvadati tathaiva cānyaḥ || āścaryavaścainamanyaḥ śṛṇoti śrutvāpyenaṃ veda na caiva kaścit ||34||| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0 saṃ0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne bāndhavasamāśvāsanaṃ nāmāṣṭasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 78 || <2.79> || puṣkara uvāca | | mṛnmayaṃ bhājanaṃ sarvaṃ punaḥ pākena śudhyati || madyairmūtrapurīṣairvā ṣṭhīvanaiḥ pūyaśoṇitaiḥ||1|| saṃspṛṣṭaṃ naiva śudhyeta punaḥpākena mṛnmayam || etaireva tathā spṛṣṭaṃ tāmrasauvarṇarājatam||2|| śudhyatyātāpitaṃ paścādanyathā kevalāmbhasā|| amlodakena tāmrasya sīsasya trapusastathā||3|| kṣāreṇa śuddhiṃ kāṃsyasya lohasya ca vinirdiśet|| muktāmaṇipravālānāṃ śuddhiḥ prakṣālanena tu||4|| anyeṣāṃ caiva bhāṇḍānāṃ sarvasyāśmamayasya ca || śākarajjumūlaphalavaidalānāṃ tathaiva ca||5|| mārjanādyajñabhāṇḍānāṃ pāṇinā cāgnikarmaṇi || uṣṇāmbhasā tathā śuddhiḥ sasnehānāṃ vinirdiśet || 6 || śayanāsanayānānāṃ sphyaśūrpaśakaṭasya ca || śuddhiḥ saṃkṣepaṇājjñeyā palālendhanayostathā || 7 || mārjanādveśmanāṃ śuddhiḥ kṣitau śodhanataḥ kṣaṇāt || saṃmārjitena toyena vāsasāṃ śuddhiriṣyate || || 8 || bahūnāṃ prokṣaṇācchuddhiḥ dhānyānāṃ ca vinirdiśet || śuddhirdrumāṇā vijñeyā nityasatpavanena tu || 9 || prokṣaṇātsaṃhatānāṃ tu dāravāṇāṃ ca takṣaṇāt || siddhārthakāṇāṃ kalkena śṛṅgadantamayasya ca || 2.79.10 || govālaiḥ phalapatrāṇāmasthnāṃ syācchṛṅgavastathā || niryāsānāṃ guḍānāṃ ca lavaṇānāṃ tathaiva ca || 11 || kusumbhakuṃkumānāṃ ca ūrṇākārpāsayostathā || prokṣaṇātkathitā śuddhirityāha bhagavān hi saḥ || 12 || bhūmiṣṭhamudakaṃ śuddhaṃ tathaiva ca śilāgatam || varṇagandharasairduṣṭairvarjitaṃ yadi tadbhavet || 13 || śuddhaṃ nadīgataṃ toyaṃ sarva eva tathākarāḥ || śuddhaṃ prasāritaṃ paṇyaṃ śuddhe cāśvājayormukhe || 14 || mukhavarjaṃ
