ca gauḥ śuddhā mārjāraḥ śvā ca no śuciḥ || śayyā bhāryā śiśurvastramupavītaṃ kamaṇḍaluḥ || || 15 || ātmanaḥ kathitaṃ śuddhaṃ na parasya kathañcana || nārīṇāṃ caiva vatsānāṃ śakunīnāṃ śunāṃ mukham || 16 || ratau prasravaṇe vṛkṣe mṛgayāyāṃ sadā śuciḥ || śuddhā bhartuścaturthe'hni snātā nārī rajasvalā || 17 || daivakarmaṇi pitrye ca pañcame'hani śudhyati || kṛtvā mūtrapurīṣaṃ vā snātvā bhoktumanāstathā || 18 || bhuktvā kṣuttvā tathā suptvā pītvā cāmbho'vagāhya ca || rathyāmākramya vācāmedvāso viparidhāya ca || 19 || kṛtvā mūtrapurīṣaṃ ca lepagandhāpahaṃ budhaḥ || uddhṛtenāmbhasā śaucaṃ mṛdā śaucaṃ samācaret || 2.79.20 || mehane mṛttikāḥ pañca liṅge dve parikīrtite || ekasminviṃśatirhaste dvayo jñeyāścaturdaśa || 21 || tisrastu mṛttikā jñeyāḥ kṛtvā tu nakhaśodhanam || tisrastisraḥ pādayośca śaucakāmaistu nityadā || 22 || śaucametadgṛhasthānāṃ dviguṇaṃ brahmacāriṇām || triguṇaṃ tu vanasthānāṃ yatīnāṃ ca caturguṇam || 23 || mṛttikā ca vinirdiṣṭā tripūrvaṃ pūryate yayā || śuddhiśca kācabhāṇḍānāṃ kevalena tathāmbhasā || 24 || śrīphalairaṃśupaṭṭānāṃ kṣaumāṇāṃ gaurasarṣapaiḥ || śuddhiḥ padmākṣatoyena mṛgalomnāṃ prakīrtitā || puṣpāṇāṃ candanānāṃ ca prokṣaṇācchuddhiriṣyate || 25 || siddhārthakaiḥ śuddhimudāharanti lomnāṃ tathā bhārgavavaṃśamukhya || sarvasya jīvasya viśuddhiruktā mṛdā ca toyena vigandhalepāt ||26|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0saṃ0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne dravyaśuddhirnāmaikonaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 79 || <2.80> rāma uvāca || varṇānāmāśramāṇāṃ ca vetti sarvamidaṃ bhavān || puṣkara uvāca || ahiṃsāsatyavacanaṃ te syādbhūteṣvanugrahaḥ || 1 || tīrthānusaraṇaṃ dānaṃ brahmacaryamamatsaram || devadvijātiśuśrūṣā gurūṇāṃ ca bhṛgūttama || 2 || śravaṇaṃ sarvadharmāṇāṃ pitṝṇāṃ pūjanaṃ tathā || bhaktiśca bhūpatau nityaṃ tathā sacchāstranetratā || 3 || ānṛśaṃsyantitikṣā ca tathā cāstikyameva hi || dharmasāmānyametatte kathitaṃ bhṛgusattama || 4 || yajanaṃ yājanaṃ dānaṃ tathaivādhyāpanakriyā || pratigrahaṃ cādhyayanaṃ viprakarmāṇi nirdiśet ||5|| dānamadhyayanaṃ caiva yajanaṃ ca yathāvidhi|| kṣattriyasya ca vaiśyasya karmedaṃ parikīrtitam || 6 || kṣatriyasya viśeṣastu prajānāṃ paripālanam || kṛṣigorakṣavāṇijyaṃ vaiśyasya parikīrtitam || 7 || śūdrasya dvijaśuśrūṣā sarvaśilpāni cāpyatha || brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyastrayo varṇā dvijātayaḥ || 8 || teṣāṃ janmādvitīyaṃ tu vijñeyaṃ mauñjibandhanam || ācāryastu pitā tatra sāvitrī jananī tathā || brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviśāṃ mauñjībandhanajanmani || 9 || vṛttyā dvijāḥ śūdrasamā bhavanti yāvanna vede prabhavanti rāma || tataḥ paraṃ te dvijatāṃ labhante samastakāryeṣvadhidaivataṃ ca ||2.80.10|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0 saṃ0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne varṇadharmādhyāyo nāmāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 80 || <2.81> || puṣkara uvāca || ānulomyena varṇānāṃ jātirmātṛsamā smṛtā || caṇḍālo brāhmaṇīputraḥ śūdraḥ syātpratilomajaḥ || 1 || māgadhaśca tathā vaiśyācchūdrādāyogavo bhavet || vaiśyāyāḥ prātilomyena pratilomātsahasraśaḥ || 2 || vivāhasadṛśaisteṣāṃ nottamairnādhamaistathā || caṇḍālakarma nirdiṣṭaṃ vadhyānāṃ ghātanaṃ tathā || 3 || strījīvanaṃ ca tadrakṣā proktaṃ vaidehakasya ca || sūtānāmaśvasārathyaṃ pukkasānāṃ ca vyādhatā || 4 || stutikriyā māgadhānāṃ tathā cāyogavasya ca || raṅgāvataraṇaṃ proktaṃ tathā śilpaiśca jīvanam || 5 || sūtānāmasti saṃskārastathā vai yājanakriyā || bahirgrāmanivāsaśca mṛtacailasya dhāraṇam || 6 || asaṃsparśastathaivānyaiścaṇḍālasya vidhīyate || brāhmaṇārthe gavārthe vā deha tyāgānupaskṛtaḥ || 7 || strībālādyupapattau ca bāhyānāṃ śuddhikāraṇam || saṃkare jātayastvetāḥ pitṛmātṛpradarśitāḥ || 8 || pracchannā vā prakāśā vā veditavyāḥ svakarmabhiḥ || anāryatā niṣṭhuratā purato niṣkriyātmatā || 9 || puruṣaṃ vyañjayantīha loke kaluṣayonijam || piturvā bhajate śīlaṃ māturvobhayameva vā || 2.81.10 || na kathaṃcana duryoniḥ prakṛtiṃ svāṃ na gacchati || kule mukhye'pi jātasya yasya syādyonisaṅkaraḥ || 11 || sa śrayatyeva tacchīlaṃ naro'lpamapi vā bahu || yatra tvete paridhvaṃsā jāyante varṇasaṅkarāḥ || 12 || rāṣṭriyaiḥ saha tadrāṣṭraṃ kṣiprameva vinaśyati || śūdrāyāṃ brāhmaṇājjātaḥ śreyasā cetprajāyate || aśreyāñśreyasīṃ jātiṃ gacchatyāsaptamādyugāt||13|| rājñā svakālaṃ parirakṣaṇīyaṃ ghoraṃ nṛṇāṃ saṅkarametadeva || āsādya ghorāṇi hi saṅkarāṇi naśyanti rāṣṭrāṇi sarājakāni|| 14 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0saṃ0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne saṅkaradharmonāmaikāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 81 || <2.82> puṣkara uvāca || ājīvaṃ tu yathoktena brāhmaṇaḥ svena karmaṇā || jīvetkṣatriyadharmeṇa sā hyasya vṛttyanantarā || 1 || ubhābhyāmapyajīvanvai vaiśyavṛttiṃ samācaret || brāhmaṇaḥ kṣattriyo vaiśyaḥ śūdravṛttiṃ vivarjayet || || 2 || śūdro brāhmaṇavṛttiṃ ca viśeṣeṇa vivarjayet || ājīvatsu sa vṛtyā ca madhyavṛttiṃ samācaret || 3 || brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vāpi vaiśyavṛttyā tu vartayan || ayaḥ śastraṃ viṣaṃ māṃsaṃ somaṃ gandhāṃśca sarvaśaḥ || 4 || kṣīraṃ kṣaudraṃ dadhi ghṛtaṃ tailaṃ majjāṃ guḍaṃ kuśam || madyaṃ nīlaṃ ca lākṣāṃ ca lavaṇaṃ prāṇino'pi ca || 5 || vikrīṇīta tilānnaiva pakvānnaṃ gorasāṃstathā || rasā rasairnihantavyā gandhena lavaṇaṃ rasaiḥ || 6 || kṛtānnaṃ ca kṛtānnena tiladhānyena tatsamam || vaiśyo vā kṣattriyo vāpi varjayeddvijajīvikām ||7 || sadyaḥ patati māṃsena lākṣayā lavaṇena ca|| tryahācca śūdro bhavati brāhmaṇaḥ kṣīravikrayī || 8 || itareṣāṃ hi paṇyānāṃ vikrayāṃ manujottama || brāhmaṇaḥ saptarātreṇa vaiśyabhāvaṃ hi gacchati ||9|| kṣiprāṇi yāni rūkṣāṇi carāṇi ca mṛdūni ca || vāṇijye tāni śasyante tithiṃ riktāṃ vivarjayet ||2.82.1 0 || || dvikaṃ śataṃ tu gṛhṇīyātkusīdenāpi vardhayan || tato'dhikaṃ tu gṛhṇānaścaurasyāpnoti kilbiṣam || 11 || pratipaddvādaśī ṣaṣṭhī nakṣatrāṇi dhruvāṇi ca || kusīde varjanīyāni nityaṃ sūryasutasya ca||12|| kṛṣibhūmipaterbhāgaṃ dattvā kuryādyathoditam || dhruvāṇi saumyaṃ maitraṃ ca vāyavyaṃ pauṣṇmāśvinam|| |||13|| vāsavaṃ śravaṇaṃ citrā viśākhā mūlameva ca || kṛṣyārambhe praśasyante tathā puṣyapunarvasū||14|| kṛṣyārambhe prayatnena tithiṃ riktāṃ vivarjayeta|| aṅgārakadinaṃ varjyaṃ divasaṃ sūryajasya ca || 15 || nakṣatrāṇāṃ yathoktānāṃ muhūrteṣu ca kārayet || muhurte yadi vā brāhme sarvakarmasu pūjite||16|| varāhaṃ pūjeyaddevaṃ śeṣaṃ pṛthvīṃ tathaiva ca || parjanyaṃ bhāskaraṃ vāyuṃ deveśaṃ śaśinaṃ tathā || 17 || phālaṃ ca goyugaṃ caiva gandhamālyānnasampadā || tato'gnihavanaṃ kuryātsusamiddhe hutāśane || 18 || devatānāṃ yathoktānāṃ juhuyācca ghṛtāhutīḥ || gāvo bhaga iti dvābhyāṃ sīrāṃ yuñjantyatastribhiḥ || 19 || phālaṃ śunāṃ suphāleti lāṅgalaṃ ca tatheti vai || hutvā viprānsamabhyarcya dakṣiṇābhiryathāvidhi || 2.82.20 || pūrvodakpravaṇāṃ bhūmiṃ vāhayetprāgghalena tu || sīrāyuñjanta ityetadṛktrayaṃ kīrtayedbudhaḥ || 21 || yā oṣadhaya ityevaṃ bījaṃ tadanu mantrayet || kṛtvā suvarṇatoyāktaṃ lakṣaṇyo vāpayetpumān|| 22 || prāṅmukhairvāhayedgobhiḥ prāṅmukhaiścaiva vāpayet || śaṃkhapuṇyāhaghoṣeṇa bījavāpaḥ praśasyate || 23 || bījavāpe tathā mantraṃ nibodha gadato mama || prajāpate kaśyapāya devalāya namaḥ sadā || 24 || sadā me ṛddhatāṃ devī bījeṣu ca dhaneṣu ca || bhojayedbrāhmaṇāṃścātra tathaiva ca kṛṣīvalān || 25 || kālaśca sarvaḥ pūrvoktaḥ saṃgrahe'pi praśasyate || devatānāṃ pitṝṇāṃ ca kṛtvā tatrāpi pūjanam || 26 || navavastraparīdhānaḥ śvetamālyānulepanaḥ|| prāṅmukhaḥ prāśanaṃ kuryātpātre sauvarṇarājate||27|| tatrāpi bhojayedviprāṃstathaiva ca kṛṣīvalān|| kṛṣye viśeṣataḥ kāryaṃ phalayajñaṃ bhṛgūdvaha||28|| yūpoyaṃ nihito madhye peṣīvāsaiṣakārṣakaiḥ|| tasmādatandrito dadyādannaṃ dhānyārthadakṣiṇā||29|| bhūmiṃ bhittvauṣadhīśchittvā hatvā kīṭapipīlikam|| punanti khalu yajñena karṣikā nātra saṃśayaḥ|| 2.82.30 aṣṭāgavaṃ dharmahalaṃ ṣaḍgavaṃ jīvitārthinām|| caturgavaṃ nṛśaṃsānāṃ dvigavaṃ brahmaghātinām||31|| āpadaṃ ca samuttīrya tyaktvā vittaṃ ca karmaṇā|| yadarjitaṃ tataḥ kuryātprāyaścittaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ||32|| śreyānsvadharmo viguṇaḥ paradharmātsvanuṣṭhitāt|| svadharme nidhanaṃ śreyaḥ paradharmo bhayāvahaḥ||33|| ṛtena jīvedanṛtena jīvenmitena jīvetpramitena jīvet|| satyānṛtābhyāmathavāpi jīvecchvavṛttimekāṃ parivarjayettu||34|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0saṃ0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne āpaddharmo nāma dvyaśītitamo'dhyāya || 82 || <2.83> || rāma uvāca || kāmyaṃ karma samācakṣva vāṇijyaṃ yena śudhyati|| kṛṣiṃ ca bahulāṃ caiva karmaṇā kena cāśnute||1|| ||puṣkara uvāca|| mūlenopoṣitaḥ kuryādidaṃ karma purohitaḥ|| upoṣitasya dharmajña jayamānasya nityaśaḥ||2|| prāptāmuttaraṣāḍhāsu prāṅmukhaṃ snāpayennaram|| yuktairvetasamūlena śaṅkhamuktāphalaistathā||3|| maṇibhiśca yathālābhaṃ kanakena tathaiva ca|| akālamūlaiḥ kalaśaiścaturbhirbhṛgunandana||4|| navaistu pūjayeddevaṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam|| pūrvāṣāḍhāṃ tathaivā'po varuṇaṃ ca niśākaram||5|| gandhamālyanamaskāradhūpadīpānnasampadā|| eteṣāmeva juhuyāttathā nāmnā ghṛtaṃ dvija||6|| nīlavāsāvṛto bhūtvā kṣipedapsu samāhitaḥ|| nīlāni rāma vāsāṃsi payāṃsi vividhāni ca||7|| tadā maṃthaṃ surāṃ caiva maireyaṃ vividhaṃ tathā|| śuklāni caiva mālyāni dhūpaṃ dadyāttu kambunā||8|| timyasthi makarādasthi śaṅkhamuktāphale tathā|| suvarṇāntaritaṃ kṛtvā dhārayecca tathā maṇim||9|| kṛtvaitatsiddhimāpnoti vāṇijye nātra saṃśayaḥ|| samudrayāne ca tathā kāntāre na viṣīdati||2.83.10|| nīlāni rāma vāsāṃsi dakṣiṇā cātra śasyate|| śaṅkhaṃ suvarṇaṃ rūpyaṃ ca tathā muktāphalāni ca||11|| hotre kartre dvijebhyaśca sarvametadvidhīyate|| brāhmaṇānbhojayeccātra paramānnaṃ tu saṃskṛtam||12|| alaṃghayannityamathāpyamṛkṣaṃ karoti karmaitadatandritātmā|| na jātu lābhādvinivartate'sau samudramārgādiva nimnagā vai|| 13|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0saṃ0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne pūrvāṣāḍhāsnānavarṇano nāma tryaśītitamo'dhyāya || 83 || <2.84> puṣkara uvāca|| svayaṃ sūpoṣito vidvānyajamānamupoṣitam|| mūlena snāpayennityaṃ tathāpyāśāmukhāsthitam||1|| dūrvākuśa śamīpatrapūrṇena sudṛḍhena ca || kumbhadvayena snātastu pūjayenmadhumūdanam || 2 || virūpākṣaṃ savaruṇaṃ candraṃ mūlaṃ tathaiva ca || gandhamālyanamaskāradhūpadīpānnasampadā || 3 || eteṣāmeva juhuyāttathā nāmnā ghṛtaṃ dvija || pītavāsāstato bhūtvā matsyakulmāṣasūkaraiḥ || 4 || surākṛsarasaṃyuktaiḥ snānoktāśāmukhasthitaḥ || baliṃ nirṛtaye dadyājjānu kṛtvā tataḥ kṣitau || 5 || tatoṣṭādaśabhiḥ puṣpairmūlaiḥ pañcabhireva ca || suvarṇagarbhaṃ ca maṇiṃ vidvāñśirasi dhārayet || 6 || kṛtvaitatsakalaṃ karma kṛṣiṃ bahuphalāṃ labhet || dakṣiṇā cātra dātavyā mūlāni ca phalāni ca ||7|| pītāni caiva vastrāṇi kanakaṃ rajataṃ tathā || bhojanaṃ cātra dātavyaṃ brāhmaṇānāmabhīpsitam || 8 || alaṃghayanmūlamidaṃ hi kurvansnānaṃ sadā bhārgava vaṃśamukhya || kṛṣiṃ samāpnoti sadaiva vidvānyathepsitaṃ nātra vicāramasti||9|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0saṃ0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne mūlasnānavarṇano nāma caturaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 84 || <2.85> rāma uvāca || dharmamārgamahaṃ tvattaḥ śrotumicchāmi me vada || tvaṃ hi vettha mahābhāga sarvadharmānyathāvidhi || 1 || puṣkara uvāca || ṣoḍaśartu niśāḥ strīṇāmādyāstisrastu garhitāḥ || vrajedyugmāsu putrārthī tataḥ paramiti śrutiḥ || 2 || ayugmāsu tathā rāma duhitārthī striyaṃ vrajet || vikṛṣṭayugmāmuta ye praśastāḥ priyadarśanāḥ || 3 || dīrghāyuṣo dharmaparā bhavantīha dhanānvitāḥ || garbhasya sṛṣṭatādhāne garbhādhānikamiṣyate || 4 || purā tu sparśanaṃ kāryaṃ sevanaṃ tu vicakṣaṇaiḥ || ṣaṣṭhe'ṣṭame vā sīmantakarmasveteṣu ca triṣu || 5 || punnāmadheyaṃ nakṣatraṃ putrakāmasya śasyate || ādityapuṣyasāvitrasaumyamūlāḥ savaiṣṇavāḥ || 6 || punnāmadheyā nirdiṣṭāḥ svātiścaivātra saptamam || aṅgārakadinaṃ varjyaṃ tithiṃ riktāṃ ca varjayet || 7 || acchinnanābhyāṃ kartavyaṃ jātakarma vicakṣaṇaiḥ || āśauce tu vyatikrānte nāmakarma vidhīyate || 8 || athavā bhārgavaśreṣṭha dine pūjitalakṣaṇe || mṛdudhruveṣu ṛkṣeṣu nāmakarma vidhīyate ||9|| tatrāpyaṅgārakadinaṃ tithiṃ riktāṃ ca varjayet || nāmadheyaṃ tu varṇānāṃ kartavyaṃ tu samākṣaram ||2.85.1 0|| māṅgalyaṃ brāhmaṇasyoktaṃ kṣatriyasya balānvitam || vaiśyasya dhanasaṃyuktaṃ śūdrasya tu jugupsitam||11|| śarma varma dhanārthaṃ tu dāsāntaṃ cānupūrvaśaḥ || nāmadheyaṃ tu kartavyaṃ svakulānugamena vā || 12 || strīṇāṃ sukhodyamakrūraṃ vispaṣṭārthaṃ manoharam || nāma kāryaṃ mahābhāga na kāryaṃ viṣamākṣaram || 13 || bālaṃ tu kṛtanāmānaṃ pūjitasya gadābhṛtaḥ || nivedayenmahābhāga tava putro'yamityuta || 14 || śiṣyaḥ preṣyaśca dāsaśca saṃvibhājyaśca keśavaḥ || nityaṃ santi vibhāgena śubhena madhusūdanaḥ || 15 || tatastu pūjanaṃ kāryaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ yathāvidhi || bhojayedbrāhmaṇāṃścātra paramānnaṃ sadakṣiṇam || 16 || cūḍākarma tataḥ kāryaṃ bhṛguputra yathākulam || nakṣatrāṇyatra śasyante mṛdu kṣipracarāṇi ca || 17 || tithiṃ vivarjayedriktāṃ sūryārārkidinānyapi || tatrāpi vāsudevasya pūjāṃ kṛtvā viśeṣataḥ || 18 || garbhāṣṭame'bde kartavyaṃ brāhmaṇasyopanāyanam || garbhādekādaśe rājñaḥ garbhācca dvādaśe viśaḥ || 19 || cūḍākarmaṇi yaḥ proktaḥ kālaḥ so'trāpi śasyate || nakṣatrāṇāṃ yathoktānāṃ muhūrtāśca śubhapradāḥ || 2.85.20 || ṣoḍaśā'bde hi viprasya rājanyasya daviviṃśatiḥ|| viṃśateśca catuṣkaṃ tu vaiśyasya parikīrtitam||21|| sāvitrī nātivarteta ata ūrdhvaṃ nivartate || vijñātavyāstrayo'pyete yathākālamasaṃskṛtāḥ || 2 || sāvitrīpatitā vrātyā vrātyastomakramādṛte || muñjasya bilvajānāṃ ca kramānmauñjaḥ prakīrtitaḥ|| 23 || mārgavaiyāghracarmāṇi vastrāṇi vratacāriṇām || parṇapippalabilvānāṃ kramāddaṇḍāḥ prakīrtitāḥ||24|| kacadeśalalāṭāṃsatulyāḥ proktāḥ krameṇa tu || avakrā satvacaḥ sarve nāgniśuṣkāstathaiva ca || 25 || vāsopavītakārpāsakṣaumorṇānāṃ yathākramam || ādimadhyāvasāneṣu bhavacchabdopalakṣitam || 26|| prathamaṃ tatra bhikṣeta yatra bhikṣā dhruvaṃ bhavet || pūjayedvāsudevaṃ ca tatra devaṃ viśeṣataḥ || 27 || hṛṣīkeśaṃ vrateśaṃ ca sarvavighneśvaraṃ prabhum || yathokteṣu ca ṛkṣeṣu traividyāṃ kārayedguruḥ || 28 || naivādhikarī vede syādvinā traividyakena tu || strīṇāṃ saṃskāramatroktaṃ sakṛtkāryaṃ vijānatā || 29 || kṣetrasaṃskārametaddhi sakṛdeva vijāyate || saṃskārāṇi pitā kuryānmekhalābandhanātmanaḥ || mekhalā bandhanādyāni kāryāṇi guruṇā tathā ||2.85.30|| sarvāṇi kāryāṇi hi laukike'gnau svakalpamālokya bhṛgupradhāna || sarveṣu pūjā ca tathā vidheyā tasyāprameyasya janārdanasya||31|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0saṃ0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne saṃskāravarṇanonāma pañcāśītitamodhyāyaḥ||85|| <2.86> puṣkara uvāca || upanīya guruḥ śiṣyaṃ śikṣayecchaucamāditaḥ || ācāramagnikāryaṃ ca sandhyopāsanameva ca || 1 || prayataḥ kalyamutthāya snāto hutahutāśanaḥ || bhaktyā gurostu kurvīta abhigamyābhivādanam ||2|| gurostu vāmaṃ caraṇaṃ vāmahastena saṃspṛśet || dakṣiṇaṃ dakṣiṇenaiva svanāma parikīrtayan || 3 || anujñātastu guruṇā tato'dhyayanamācaret || kṛtvā brahmāñjaliṃ paśyangurorvadanamānataḥ || 4 || brahmāvasāne prārambhe praṇavaṃ caiva kīrtayet || anadhyāyeṣvadhyayanaṃ varjayettu prayatnataḥ || 5 || bhaikṣyacaryāṃ tataḥ kuryādbrāhmaṇeṣu yathāvidhi || guroḥ kule na bhikṣeta bhuñjīta tadanujñayā || 6 || āyuṣyaṃ prāṅmukho bhuṅkte yaśasyaṃ dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ || śriyaḥ pratyaṅmukho bhuṅkte ṛtaṃ bhuṅkte hyudaṅmukhaḥ || 7 || hitaṃ priyaṃ guroḥ kuryādbhaktyāhaṃkāravarjitaḥ || anvāsya paścimāṃ sandhyāṃ pūjayitvā hutāśanam || 8 || abhivādya guruṃ paścādgurorvacanakṛdbhavet || madhumāṃsāñjanaṃ śrāddhaṃ gītaṃ nṛtyaṃ ca varjayet || 9 || hiṃsāṃ parāpavādaṃ ca aślīlaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ || mekhalāmajinaṃ daṇḍaṃ dhārayetprayataḥ sadā || 2.86.10 || vinaṣṭānapsu nikṣipya tathānyāndhārayetpunaḥ || ādiṣṭī nodakaṃ kuryādāvratasya samāpanāt || 11 || samāpte tu vrataṃ kuryāttrirātreṇaiva śuddhyati || adhaḥśāyī bhavennityaṃ brahmacārī samāhitaḥ || 12 || evaṃ mataṃ tu kurvīta vedasvīkaraṇaṃ dvijaḥ || gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā snāyācca tadanantaram||13|| āśarīravimokṣādvā vasedgurukule sadā || naiṣṭhiko brahmacārī ca vāyubhūtaḥ khamūrtimān ||14|| tatpadaṃ samavāpnoti yatra gatvā na śocati || snāne caiva sagodāne kālaḥ pūrvo vidhīyate || pūjanaṃ vāsudevasya sarvatra ca vidhīyate||15|| saṃpūjya devaṃ gurave ca dattvā dhanaṃ yathāvatparipūrṇavidyaḥ || gṛhāśramī syādvidhivannṛsiṃha yatrāsya lokadvitayaṃ pradiṣṭam || 16 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0 saṃ0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne brahmacaryavarṇano nāma ṣaḍaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 86 || <2.87> puṣkara uvāca || vipraścatasro vindeta bhāryāstisrastu bhūmipaḥ || dve ca vaiśyastathā kāmaṃ bhāryaikāmapi cāntyajaḥ || 1 || brāhmaṇī kṣatriyā vaiśyā śūdrī viprasya kīrtitāḥ || krameṇa kāmasaktasya vivāhāḥ parikīrtitāḥ ||2|| vivāhamutkramātkṛtvā narakaṃ pratipadyate || dharmakāryāṇi sarvāṇi na kāryāṇyasavarṇayā ||3 || asavarṇā tu yā nārī ratyarthe sā prakīrtitā || ādhānaṃ tasya dharmārthaṃ na praśaṃsanti sādhavaḥ || 4 || pāṇirgrāhyaḥ savarṇāsu gṛhṇīyātkṣatriyā śaram || vaiśyā pratodamādadyāddaśāṃ caivāntyajā tathā||5|| utkṛṣṭavedane'pyetadvidhānaṃ parikīrtitam || sakṛtkanyā pradātavyā haraṃstāṃ cauradaṇḍabhāk || 6 || na kanyāvikayaṃ kāryaṃ kadācidapi kenacit || keśavikrayiṇo yānti narakāneka viṃśatīn||7|| apatyavikrayāttasya niṣkṛtirna vidhīyate || kanyāprajīvanātkiṃcinnopajīvati yaḥ pumān || 8 || na tacchulkaṃ samuddiṣṭamānṛśaṃsyaṃ hi tatkṛtam || kanyādānaṃ śacīyāgo vivāho'tha caturthikā || 9 || vivāhametatkathitaṃ rāma karmacatuṣṭayam || dattāmapi haretkanyāṃ varaśceddoṣabhāgbhavet || 2.87.10 || naṣṭe mṛte pravrajite klībe'tha patite'patau || pañcasvāpatsu nārīṇāṃ patiranyo vidhīyate || 11 || | mṛte tu devare deyā tadabhāve yadṛcchayā || pūrvātritayamāgneyaṃ vāyavyaṃ cottarātrayam || 12 || rohiṇī ceti varuṇaṃ bhagaṇaḥ śasyate sadā || naikagotrāṃ ca varayennaikārṣīyāṃ ca bhārgava || 13 || pitṛtaḥ saptamādūrdhvaṃ mātṛtaḥ pañcamāttathā || varayellakṣaṇopetāṃ sadā lokadvayecchayā || 14 || brāhmo daivastathaivārṣaḥ prājāpatyastathāsuraḥ || gāndharvo rākṣasaścaiva paiśācaścāṣṭamaḥ smṛtaḥ || 15 || āhuḥ pradānaṃ brāhmeṇa kulaśīlayutāya tu || tajjaḥ punātyubhayataḥ puruṣānekaviṃśatīn||16|| daivaśca ṛtvije dānaṃ sa tu yajñaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || tajjaḥ punāti dharmajña svakule puruṣatrayān||17|| śulkena cāsuraṃ vidyātsa tu dharmādṛte mataḥ || parasparecchayā rāma kanyakāvarayostathā|| 18 || gāndharvo nāma nirdiṣṭaḥ sa tu manmathalakṣaṇaḥ || rākṣaso yuddhaharaṇātpaiśācaḥ kanyakāchalāt || 19 || prājāpatyastathā brāhmaḥ samavarṇeṣu pūjyate || daivastu brāhmaṇasyaiva naiva cānyasya kasyacit || 2.87.20 || gāndharvarākṣasau śreṣṭhau kṣattriyasyaiva bhārgava || pūrvaṃ vivāhātkartavyaḥ śacīyāgo bhṛgūttama || 21 || vaivāhikendau kurvīta kumbhakāramṛdā śacīm || sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyuktāṃ kuśalena ca śilpinā || 22 || tāṃ nayetsarasastīraṃ nadītīramathāpi vā || sarvabhūṣaṇasaṃpannā sarvāstvavidhavāḥ striyaḥ || 23 || kausuṃbharaktavasanāḥ sarvāḥ syuḥ śastrapāṇayaḥ || mālyānulepanairbhakṣyairdīpairdhūpaistathaiva ca || 24 || kausuṃbharaktairvastraiśca bhūṣaṇaiścaiva śaktitaḥ || tataḥ śūrpeṇa tāḥ sādhvyo dikṣu dattvā baliṃ śubham || 25 || saṃyamya keśānprayatā gṛhītvā ca tathā śacīm || vādyagītena mahatā dvijavācanakena ca || 26 || gṛhe praveśayetpuṃsāṃ śakrapatnīmaniṃditām || trisandhyaṃ tatra sā pūjyā gandhamālyānnasampadā || 27 || vandanīyodvāhasamaye tatra kālaṃ nibodha me || prasupte keśave rāma na tu kāryaṃ kathañcana || 28 || na pauṣe na tathā caitre na cārkakujavāsare || kṛṣṇatribhāge naivāntye nādye śuklasya bhārgava||29|| tathā riktatithau naiva na viṣṭau karaṇe tathā || na śukre'stamanaṃ prāpte tathā cāste bṛhaspatau ||2.87.30|| śaśāṃke'nyagrahāścaiva vivāho na praśasyate || arkārkibhaumayukte bhe vyatīpātahate tathā ||31|| divyāntarikṣabhaumena tathotpātena ghātite || tathā śikhiśikhādhvaste saiṃhikeyayute tathā ||32|| vaivāhikānyato vakṣye nakṣatrāṇi bhṛgūttama || saumyaṃ pitryaṃ ca vāyavyaṃ sāvitraṃ rauhiṇaṃ tathā||33|| uttarātritayaṃ mūlaṃ maitraṃ pauṣṇaṃ tathaiva ca || mūhūrtāśca tathaiteṣāṃ śubhā abhijitā saha ||34|| mānuṣyākhyastathā lagno mānuṣyākhyastathāṃśakaḥ || amānuṣyākhye lagne'pi mānuṣyākhyeṃśako hitaḥ ||35|| tṛtīye ca tathā ṣaṣṭhe daśamaikādaśāṣṭame || arkārkibhaumatanayāḥ praśastā na kujoṣṭamaḥ || 36 || saptāntyāṣṭamavarjyeṣu śeṣāḥ śastā grahottamāḥ || teṣāmapi tathā sūryaścandraḥ ṣaṣṭho na śasyate || 37 saṃkalpavidhinā kāryo vivāhastadanantaram || vaivāhike'hni kartavyāstathaiva ca caturthike || || 38 || na dātavyā grahāstatra caturādyāstathaikagāḥ || ataḥ paraṃ gṛhe gacchedṛtukāle sadā striyam || 39 || parvavarjyaṃ sadā gacchetstrīṇāṃ vā saṃsmaranvaram || sarvakālaṃ ratirdattā tāsāṃ satyaṃ bhṛgūttama ||2.87.40 || parasparātikramaṇaṃ daṃpatyoḥ parivarjayet || niṣkāraṇaṃ tathā rāma na kāryamadhivedanam ||41|| aprajā rogiṇī mūḍhā tathā ca kalahapriyā || kanyāprajā tathā yā ca yā caivāpriyavādinī || 42 || etāḥ khalvadhivettavyā gṛhakāryaparāṅmukhīḥ || adhivinnā viśeṣeṇa pālanīyā sutaṃ bhavet ||43|| dharmakāryeṣu sarveṣu tathā jyeṣṭhāṃ niyojayet || dharmādharmau samau rāma dampatyorubhayātmakau || 44|| poṣyā ca nityaṃ paripālanīyā bhāryā bhaveddharmaparāyaṇasya || dharmārthakāmānsatataṃ dvijendra tānrakṣayetsamyagathānayā svān|| 45 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0 saṃ0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne dharmavarṇanannāma saptāśītitamodhyām || 87 <2.88> || puṣkara uvāca || nidrāṃ jahyād gṛhī rāma nityamevāruṇodaye || vegotsargaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā dantadhāvanapūrvakam || 1 || snānaṃ samācaretprātaḥ sarvakalmaṣanāśanam || vegotsargaṃ na kurvīta phālakṛṣṭe tathā śucau || 2 || goṣṭhe na cāgnau na taṭe drumacchāyāsu śādvale || pathi bhasmani toye ca nāṃgaṇe na ca gopathe || 3 || nāgnyarkānāgatoyeṣu prativāte tathaiva ca || na vegito na kāryastho vegotsargaṃ samācaret || 4 || udaṅmukhastu sandhyāsu divā vai bhṛgunandana || dakṣiṇābhimukho rātrau nākāśe tu kathañcana || 5 || karṇasthabrahmasūtrastu vastrācchāditamastakaḥ || abhyuddhṛtābhiradbhistu mṛdbhiḥ śaucaṃ samācaret || 6 || kṛtaśaucaḥ śucau deśe prāṅmukhaḥ susamāhitaḥ || udaṅmukhastu dharmajña tathāntarjānureva ca || 7 || upaspṛśecca dharmajña śuddhapādakaraḥ sadā || ekahastārpitenā'tha pheṇabudbudinā tathā || 8 || agnipakvena toyena nanu nopaspṛśedbudhaḥ || aṅgulyagre bhaveddaivaṃ brāhmamaṅgulimūlake ||9|| paitryaṃ tarjanimūle syātkaniṣṭhāyāśca mānuṣam || brāhmeṇa triḥ pibedāpaḥ pramṛjyāttu tato mukham ||2.88.10 || khānyadbhiḥ saṃspṛśetpaścānmūrdhānaṃ nābhimeva ca || upaspṛśya tataḥ paścādbhakṣayeddantadhāvanam || 11 || bhuktvā ca nikṣipedrāma nityameva samāhitaḥ || udaṅmukhaḥ prāṅmukho vā na yāmyāśāparāṅmukhaḥ||12|| māṃsanna bhakṣayeccaiva nordhaśuṣkaṃ na picchilam|| suśiraṃ madhuraṃ cāmlaṃ vitvacaṃ patrasaṃyutama||13|| samapūrvamatisthūlaṃ kubjakīṭavināśitam || śālmalyaśvatthabhavyānāṃ dhavakiṃśukayorapi || 14|| kovidāraśamīpīluśleṣmātakabibhītakān || varjayeddantakāṣṭheṣu guggulaṃ kramuka tathā ||15|| vaṭāsanārkakhadirakaravīrāṃśca bhakṣayet || jātyaśvabilvabadaraṃ mūlaṃ ca kakubhasya ca || 16|| arimedaṃ priyaṅguṃ ca kaṇṭakinyāśca bhārgava || prakṣālya bhakṣayetpūrvaṃ prakṣālyaiva ca saṃtyajet ||17|| patite'bhimukhaṃ śastaṃ śāntāśābhimukhe dinam || saubhāgyakāmo vāmena bhakṣayetprāk susaṃyataḥ ||18|| mukhabhāgena dharmajña vāgyataścaiva bhakṣayet || malaśaucaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā samyak snānamathācaret || 19 || na snānamācaredbhuktvā nāvijñāte jalāśaye || nāturo nāruṇakarairanākrānte nabhastale || 2.88.20|| apraśastaṃ niśi snānaṃ rāhoranyatra darśanāta || parāṃbhasi tathaivālpe nāsiraskaḥ kathañcana ||21|| nityaṃ naimittikaṃ kāmyaṃ kriyāṅgaṃ malakarṣaṇam || kriyāsnānaṃ tathā ṣaṣṭhaṃ ṣoḍhā snānaṃ prakīrtitam || 22 || khāni rātrau śayānasya sravanti puruṣasya ca|| tasmātsarvaprayatnena prātaḥsnānaṃ samācaret||23|| prātaḥsnāyī sadā rāma narakaṃ na ca paśyati || yaḥ karoti sadā rāma snānaṃ tu savanadvayam ||24|| sa tu svargamanuprāpya tridaśairapi pūjyate || tathā triṣavaṇasnāyī svargaloke mahīyate || 25 || mānuṣyaṃ prāpya bhavati rūpayauvanasaṃyutaḥ || dhanadhānyavati sphīte kule caiva prasūyate || 26|| rūpaudāryaguṇopetāḥ striyaścāpnotyaninditāḥ || dharme matiścāsya bhavedyaśasā ca virājate || 27 || tasmātsadā dharmapareṇa rāma tīrtheṣu mukhyeṣu sarassu caiva || snānaṃ ca kāryaṃ sumalāpahartṛ nākapradaṃ kāmakaraṃ sukhāya ||28|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0saṃ0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne snānavarṇano nāmāṣṭāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 88|| <2.89> puṣkara uvāca|| mālyaṃ lakṣmīkaraṃ nāma nityaṃ śirasi dhārayet || nānyatra dhārayetprājño bahirgandhaṃ na dhārayet || 1|| yaśca kaṇṭakisambhūtaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ raktaṃ ca bhārgava ||| kaṇṭakibhyo'pi yajjātaṃ śuklaṃ dhāryaṃ tu tadbhavet ||2 || kṛṣṇarakte tathā dhārye yadi syātāṃ jalodbhave || candanenānuliptena kuṃkumāgurubhistathā ||3 ||| karpūreṇa tathāṅgāni śubhena ca priyaṅgunā || vastraṃ nānyadhṛtaṃ dhāryaṃ na raktaṃ malinaṃ tathā || 4 || jīrṇaṃ nāpadaśaṃ caiva śvetaṃ dhāryaṃ prayatnataḥ || upānahaṃ nānyadhṛtaṃ brahmasūtraṃ ca dhārayet || 5 || hīnāṅgairadhikāṅgaiśca bālairvṛddhairbubhukṣitaiḥ || vyālairadāntairvāhaiśca na vrajecca kadācana || 6 snānabhojanapānādi teṣāmādyo na vācaret || naikaḥ prapadyedadhvānaṃ nādhārmikasahāyavān || 7 || na rātrau na ca madhyāhne na ca deve pravarṣati || na cātiviṣame vāte sandhyayośca tathā dvija || 8 || nāsannihitapāne vā na vegānna ca santatam || sātapatra padatrāṇaḥ soṣṇīṣaśca tathā caret || 9 || catuṣpathaṃ na saḥ kuryādvikhyātāṃśca vanaspatīn || maṅgalyāni ca sarvāṇi pathi kuryātpradakṣiṇam || 2.89.10 || amaṅgalyāni vāmāni kartavyāni vijānatā || varasya bhūmipālasya snātakasyātha cakriṇaḥ || 11|| bhārākrāntasya gurviṇyāḥ panthā deyaḥ prayatnataḥ || vyālayuddhaṃ na cekṣeta vinā viṣamamāsthitaḥ ||12|| na paśyeccārkamudyantaṃ nāstaṃ yāntaṃ na cāmbhasi || tiraskṛtaṃ tu vastreṇa na kuddhasya gurormukham ||13|| na strīṃ sravantīṃ nodakyāṃ na nagnāṃ nānyasaṅgatām || na patnīṃ bhojanasvapnasnānāsaktāṃ vibhūṣaṇām || 14 || nāñjayantīṃ svake netre nāślīlaṃ kiñcideva tu || nānāsthānaṃ na paśyecca na paśyecca mahānasam || 15 || jalāśayataṭasthāṃśca na paśyettu kadācana || hīnāṅgairadhikāṅgaiśca bālairvṛddhairbubhukṣitaiḥ || 16 || vyālairadāntairvāhaiśca na vrajettu kadācana || snānabhojanapānādi teṣāmādau na cācaret || 17 || catuṣpathastuṣāṅgāraśanyaveśmāṭavīstathā || 18 || kārpāsāsthi tathā bhasma nākramedyaśca kutsitam || antaḥpuraṃ ṛtugṛhaṃ paradūtagṛhaṃ tathā || 19 || nārohedviṣamāṃ nāvaṃ na vṛkṣaṃ na ca parvatam || na loṣṭena na kāṣṭhena nāśmanā ca phaladrumān|| 2.89.20 || na pātayenna kurvīta sarvatra ca kutūhalam || arthāyatanaśāstreṣu sarvatra syātkutūhalī || 21 || daṇḍena karapātairvā na kuryādambuvādanam || tṛṇacchedaṃ na kurvīta na ca loṣṭābhimardanam || 22 || nakhānāṃ bhakṣaṇaṃ caiva dantānāṃ kuṭṭanaṃ tathā || chedanaṃ ca nakhairlomnāṃ vṛthā ceṣṭāṃ vivarjayet || 23 || mukhāṅgavādanaṃ caiva kṣveḍotkruṣṭaṃ tathā vṛthā || avaguṃṭhya śiro rātrau na śayīta kadācana |||| || 24 || paryaṭenna tathā rātrau vinā rāma pradīpikām || nādvāreṇa paśugṛhe nādvāreṇa riporgṛham || 25 || praviśenna ca tiṣṭhecca nidritaṃ na ca bodhayet || nākṣipetparavākyaṃ tu na ca raktaṃ virāgayet || 26 || kathābhaṅgaṃ na kurvīta na ca vāsoviparyayam ||| nordhvajānuściraṃ tiṣṭhedutpatantīṃ na laṃghayet || 27 || parakṣetre carantīṃ gāṃ pāyayantīṃ ca vatsakam|| nācakṣīta tathānyasya śakracāpaṃ na darśayet || 28 || bhadraṃ bhadramiti brūyānnāniṣṭaṃ vartayetkvacit || pālāśamāsanaṃ varjyaṃ pādapīṭhaṃ ca pāduke || 29 || surārcā gurubhūpānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ viśeṣataḥ || nākramecca tathā chāyāṃ śvapacasya ca bhārgava || 2.89.30 || dvijayoścaiva dampatyorbhūpayoryudhyamānayoḥ || agnibrāhmaṇayoścaiva dvijabhūpālayostathā || 31 || śiṣyopādhyāyayoścaiva na ca madhye na pūjyayoḥ || taile jale tathā vaktramādarśe ca malānvite || 32 || na paśyenna tathā paśyeduparaktaṃ divākaram || nocchiṣṭastārakārāhuḥ stutināśaṃ hutāśanam || 33 || na tiṣṭhetprativātaṃ ca tathā ca pratibhāskaram || na saṃhatābhyāṃ pāṇibhyāṃ kaṇḍūyedātmanaḥ śiraḥ || 34 || rodanaṃ ca tathā nagnaḥ kuryāttoyāvagāhanam || niṣkāraṇaṃ nadīpāraṃ bāhubhyāṃ na tarettathā || 35 || na praśaṃsennadī toye nadīmanyāṃ kathaṃcana || na girau parvataṃ rāma na rājñaḥ purato nṛpam ||36|| asaṃtarpya piturdeyaṃ nadīpāraṃ na ca vrajet || bhojanaṃ varjayennāvi ṣṭhīvanaṃ ca tathāṃbhasi || 37 || naivāpsu prakṣipedvidvānamedhyaṃ rudhiraṃ viṣam || samālyo nācaretsnānaṃ na dvivāsā vikāraṇam ||38 || ātmanaśca tathā rāma naiva tvapanayetsrajam || snātaḥ śiro nāvadhunennāṃgebhyastoyamuddharet || 39 || taddine cānuliptāṃgaṃ tathā snānaṃ vivarjayet || śiraḥsnātaśca tailena spṛśedaṃgaṃ na kiñcana || 2.89.40 || vāsasā vāmabhāgasya rajasā pūrvavāsasā || saṃmārjanaṃ rajovarjyaḥ kharāśvādestathaiva ca || 41 || medhyāni ca tathā rāma gogajāśvarajāṃsi ca || nādhaḥ kurvīta dahanaṃ na ca pādau pratāpayet || 42 || darbhairna mārjayetpādau na ca kāṃsye pradhāpayet || gogajāśvājapuccheṣu kharasya ca viśeṣataḥ || 43 || yallagnamudakaṃ tasmādvipruṣo dūratastyajet || akasmādapyaśastāstāḥ khañjāṃgasparśanaṃ tathā || 44 || hīnaṃ vā na vahedrāma śrutarūpadhanādibhiḥ|| hīnairna ca vasetsārdhaṃ na deśe vaidyavarjite || 45 || na bhūpālavihīne ca na sāṃvatsaravarjite || duṣṭakūpānvite rāma tathā ca bahunāyake || 46 || strīnāyake bālapatau śūdrarājye tathaiva ca || mlecchaveṣo na kartavyo mlecchabhāṣā tathaiva ca || 47 || caṇḍālaiḥ patitairmlecchairbhāṣaṇaṃ na kadācana || nakāraṃ kāyataḥ kṛtvā kīrtayetkeśavaṃ vibhum || 48 || nāsaṃvṛtamukhaḥ kuryāddhāsaṃ jṛmbhāṃ tathā kṣutam || gopayejjanmanakṣatramṛṇasāraṃ gṛhe malam || 49 || prabhorapyavamānaṃ svaṃ tasya duścaritaṃ ca yat || nānukūlyaṃ tathā kāryamindriyāṇāṃ sukhepsunā || 2.89.50 || yuktyā ca kāmasevī syānnākasmānniḥsukhī bhavet || vegarodhaṃ na kartavyamanyatra krodhavegataḥ || 51 ||| nopekṣitavyo vyādhiḥ syādripuralpo'pi bhārgava || snātvā bhuktvā ca dharmajña bhaktikāmaḥ surārcane || 52 || malāyanānāṃ saṃsparśe malānāṃ caiva bhārgava || vāsasaśca parīdhāne rathyācaṃkramaṇe tathā || 53 || ācamecca tathā rāma tathā svapnotthito naraḥ || na huṃkuryācchivaṃ pūjyaṃ bibhṛyānnāgnicāriṇīm||54|| na bhuktamātraṃ prāyasyennīcasevāṃ vivarjayet || pādena nākrametpādaṃ na kaṇḍūyenna śaucayet ||55 || varjayecchavadhūmaṃ ca giraṃ cāślīlasaṃyutām || pratyakṣaṃ vā parokṣaṃ vā kasyacinnāpriyaṃ vadet || 56 || vedaśāstranarendrarṣidevanindāṃ vivarjayet || nāstikyamanṛtaṃ caiva cetaso dūṣaṇaṃ tathā || 57 || strīṇāmīrṣyā na kartavyā viśvāsaṃ tāsu varjayet || lāḍitāstāḍitāḥ kāryā dehe sve strīkumārikāḥ || || 58 || sarveṣāmeva dharmāṇāṃ kartavyaṃ śravaṇaṃ tathā || namaskāraṃ ca devānāṃ sarveṣāmeva kārayet || 59 || sarveṣāṃ caritaṃ rāma dharmato na vikutsayet || na cācarecca dharmajña te hi tejopahāhatāḥ ||2.89.60|| dharmasyārthasya kāmasya pīḍāvarjyā parasparam || devasya vayasaścaiva śilpasya svakulasya ca ||61|| ācaretsadṛśaṃ veṣaṃ vyavasāyānurūpataḥ || snāta evāśu bibhṛyātsoṣṇīṣe dhautavāsasī || 62 || anulipyettathāṃgāni sitaṃ mālyaṃ ca dhārayet || nāsaṃskṛtaṃ ca bibhṛyātkāñcanaṃ puruṣottama ||63|| nirāśanasya suptasya śayānasya tathaiva ca || tathā bhuktavato rāma snātasya bhāṣitasya ca ||64|| yātrāyuddhotsukasyāpi śmaśrukarma vivarjayet || vaiṣṇavaṃ vāruṇaṃ tvāṣṭraṃ sāvitraṃ vāsavaṃ tathā || 65 || vāyavyamindrikaṃ pauṣṇaṃ śākramāśvinameva ca || maitrāditye tathā puṣyaḥ śaṃkhacakragaṇaṃ bhavet || 66 || nakṣatrāṇāmathaiteṣāṃ muhūrtāśca hitapradāḥ || arkārkibhaumavārāśca riktāśca tithayastathā || 67 || pratipacca tathā ṣaṣṭhī varjayetkṣaurakarmaṇi || varjayejjanmanakṣatraṃ nānukūlaṃ tathaiva ca || 68 || janmanakṣatrage saumye śiraḥsnānena yatnataḥ || pūjā somasya kartavyā nakṣatrasya tathātmanaḥ || 69 || śrāddhaṃ kuryātprayatnena vahnibrāhmaṇapūjanam || vāhanāyudhacchatrādyaṃ pūjanīyaṃ prayatnataḥ || 2.89.70 || surāṇāmarcanaṃ kāryaṃ keśavasya viśeṣataḥ || samaṃ svalaṃkṛtastiṣṭhecchirasnātaśca mānavaḥ || 71 || nirmalāni ca kāryāṇi dantakeśanakhāni ca || aṣṭamīṃ ca tathā ṣaṣṭhīṃ navamīṃ ca caturdaśīm || 72 || śirobhyaṅgaṃ na kurvīta parvasandhau tathaiva ca || tathaivāmalakasnānaṃ saptamīṣu vivarjayet ||73|| vinā tu satataṃ snānaṃ na snāyāddaśamīṣu ca || amāvasyāṃ surārcāsu navavastraṃ na dhārayet || 74 || na ca bhaumadine rāma teṣvanakteṣu cāpyatha || sāvitra rauhiṇaṃ maitramādityaṃ tiṣyamāśvinam || 75 || uttarātritayaṃ citrā vāyavyaṃ vasudaivatam || indrāgnidaivataṃ pauṣṇaṃ tāni śastāni nirdiśet || 76 || nakṣatrāṇāmathaiteṣāṃ muhūrtāśca hitapradāḥ || paradrohaṃ tathā hiṃsāṃ prayatnena vivarjayet || 77 || keśagrahānprahārāṃśca śirasyetāṃ tathaiva ca || dūrādāvasanthāmūtraṃ pūrīṣaṃ ca samutsajet || 78 || pādaprakṣālanaṃ caiva bhinnabhāṇḍādikaṃ ca yat || sarvametattyajetprājño yena syādarimardanam || 79 || | taṇḍulodakanikṣepaṃ viparītaṃ tu kārayet || tathaikamanasā kāryaṃ devatānāṃ ca pūjanam || 2.89.80 || vahnisaṃpūjanaṃ caiva na cāsnātena bhārgava || mālyānulepanādīni na prapadyāttu kasyacit || 81 || anye ca devatāvipragurūṇāṃ bhṛgunandana || kovidāragaṇāśākaṃ caturthī pippalī tathā || 82 || varjaye ..nmāṃsaṃ sukhārthī sarvameva tu || rājadviṣṭaṃ na kartavyaṃ virodhaṃ ca mahājanaiḥ ||83|| śuṣkavairaṃ vivādaṃ ca prayatnena vivarjayet || na vasecca tathā vāsaṃ vāstuvidyāvigarhitam ||84|| āgārādyākhughātāṃ ca parocchiṣṭāṃ tathaiva ca|| ūṣarāccaiva valmīkānmṛdaṃ śauce vivarjayet ||85|| yenecchedvipulāṃ prītiṃ tena sārdhamarindama || na kuryādarthasaṃbandhaṃ dārasaṃdarśanaṃ tathā||86|| ātmābhiṣṭavanaṃ nindāṃ parasya ca vivarjayet || dṛḍhabhakto bhavennityaṃ kṛtajñaśca viśeṣataḥ ||87|| indriyāṇāṃ jaye yogamātiṣṭhecca sadā naraḥ || indriyāṇāṃ jayāccaiva lokayoḥ sukhamāpnuyāt ||88|| abhigatvā tu dharmajño yogakṣemārthamīśvaram || gṛhaṃ praviśya kurvīta svādhyāyaṃ satataṃ budhaḥ ||89|| arthalābhe'pi mahati svādhyāyaṃ na samutsṛjet || kulānyakulatāṃ yānti svādhyāyasya vivarjanāt || 2.89.90 || yastu varṣaśataṃ pūrṇaṃ tvaraṇye tapate tapaḥ || ṛcamekāṃ ca yodhyeti samau syātāṃ na cādhikaḥ || svādhyāyā'nantaraṃ snātaḥ kṛtajapyaḥ samāhitaḥ||91|| saṃpūjanaṃ devavarasya kuryāttasyāprameyasya janārdanasya || saṃpūjanādyasya samastayajñaiḥ kṛtaiḥ phalaṃ śīghramavāpnuvanti || 92 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0saṃ0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne ācārādhyāyo nāmaikonanavatitamodhyāyaḥ || 89 <2.90> || puṣkara uvāca|| svācāntaḥ prayataḥ snātaḥ praviśeddevatāgṛham || namaskāraṃ tu kurvīta tatra bhaktyā samāhitaḥ||1|| āpohiṣṭheti tisṛbhistato'rghyaṃ vinivedayet || hiraṇyavarṇā iti ca pādyaṃ ca tisṛbhirdvijaḥ || 2 || śanna āpa ityanena deyaṃ saudāmanaṃ bhavet || idamāpaḥ pravahata snānamantraḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||| || 3 || rathe akṣeṣu ca tathā catasrastvanulepane || yuvā suvāsa iti ca mantro vāsasa īritaḥ || 4 || puṣpaṃ puṣpavatītyeva dhūpaṃ dhūrasi cāpyatha || tejosi śukramasi dīpaṃ dadyādvicakṣaṇaḥ || 5 || dadhikrāvṇo iti tathā madhuparkaṃ nivedayet || hiraṇyagarbha ityaṣṭau ṛcaḥ proktā nivedane || 6 || annasya manujaśreṣṭha pānasya ca sugandhinaḥ || cāmaravyajane mātrāṃ chatraṃ yānāsane tathā ||7|| yatkiñcidevamādiḥ syātsāvitreṇa nivedayet || pauruṣaṃ ca japetsūktaṃ tadeva juhuyāttathā || 8 || arcābhāve tathā vedyāṃ sthale pūrṇaghaṭe tathā || nadītīre'tha kamale keśavaṃ pūjayennaraḥ || 9 || sarvāśubhānāṃ parighātakāri saṃpūjanaṃ devavarasya viṣṇoḥ || kṛtvānaghānkṣipramanuprayāti yatraikyatāṃ yāti pitāmahasya ||2.90.10|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0 saṃ0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne devakarmādhyāyo nāma navatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||90|| <2.91> puṣkara uvāca|| naktaṃ gṛhītamudakaṃ devakarmaṇi varjayet || candanāgarukarpūra mṛgadarpaṃ tathaiva ca || 1 || jātīphalaṃ tathā dadyādanulepasya kāraṇāt || atonyaṃ naiva dātavyaṃ kiñcidevānulepanam || 2 || dāridryaṃ padmakaḥ kuryādasvāsthyaṃ raktacandanam || uśīraśca tu vibhraṃśaṃ manye kuryurupadravam || 3 || na vastraṃ malinaṃ deyaṃ nīlaṃ raktaṃ tu yadbhavet || tau dattvā devadevāya śokamāpnotyasaṃśayam || 4 || kṛtrimaṃ tu na dātavyaṃ tathaivābharaṇaṃ dvija || pratirūpakṛtaṃ dattvā kṣipraṃ puṣṭyā viyujyate || 5 || puṣpaṃ kaṇṭakisaṃjātaṃ tathā gandhavivarjitam || ugragandhaṃ na dātavyaṃ tvanyadevagṛhodbhavam || 6 || śmaśānacaityadrumajaṃ bhūmāvaśanipātitam || kalikā na tu dātavyā devadevasya cakriṇaḥ || 7 || śuklānyavarṇaṃ kusumaṃ na deyaṃ ca tathā bhavet || sugandhi śuklaṃ deyaṃ syājjātaṃ kaṇṭakite drume|8|| dattvā kaṇṭakisaṃbhūtaṃ kusumaṃ paribhūyate || śuklānyavarṇaṃ dātavyaṃ kusumaṃ kuṃkumasya yat || 9 || padmotpale ca dharmajña tathā vai pītayūthikām || tathā ca vanyakaṃ dadyāccūtaketakijaṃ ca yat || 2.91.10 || raktāśokasya kusumamatasīkusumaṃ tathā || vṛkṣāyurvedavidbhiśca śuklaṃ raktīkṛtaṃ ca yat ||11|| tadraktamapi dātavyaṃ bilvapatraṃ tathaiva ca || dūrvāgraṃ ca tathā deyaṃ patraṃ bhṛṅgirajasya tu || 12 || patrāṇi ca sugandhīni tathā deyāni cakriṇaḥ || madhyo'nyavarṇo yasya syācchuklasya kusumasya ca || 13 || puṣpaṃ śuklaṃ tu tadvidyānmanojñaṃ keśavapriyam || bandhujīvakapuṣpāṇi raktānyapi ca dāpayet || 14 || anuktaraktakusuma dānāddaurbhāgyamāpnuyāt || sugandhi dattvā nāpnoti śubhaṃ vā yadi vāśubham || 15 || mṛgadarpaṃ vinā kiñcidatha cejjīvasaṃbhavam || devadevasya dātavyaṃ dīpe majjānameva vā || 16 || nīlāṃ raktāṃ daśāṃ dīpe prayatnena vivarjayet || anyā ca dīpamātraṃ tu tathā varjaṃ prayatnataḥ ||17 || kṛṣṇāgarustathā devadhūpaṃ devasya yatnataḥ || abhakṣaṃ cāpyahṛdyaṃ ca naivedyaṃ na nivedayet || 18 || keśakīṭāvapannaṃ ca nakhāṃśavihitaṃ ca yat || mūṣikālāṃgalopetamavadhūtamavakṣatam||19|| na bhakṣyamannamakṣīraṃ māhiṣaṃ kṣīrameva ca || varāhamatsyamāṃsaṃ ca māṃsaṃ pañcanakhasya ca || durāmodau tathā varjyau devakarmaṇi paṃḍitaiḥ||2.91.20|| niveśya cittaṃ puruṣottamasya bhaktiṃ samāsthāya tathā viśuddhām || karoti śraddhāṃ satataṃ yathoktāṃ sa yāti lokaṃ madhusūdanasya ||21|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0saṃ0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne puṣpādideyādeyakathanannāmaikanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 91 || <2.92> puṣkara uvāca || tato'gniśaraṇaṃ gatvā smārte'gnau vidhipūrvakam || vaiśvadevaṃ tu kartavyaṃ hutotsṛṣṭaṃ tu laukike || 1 || yatra kvacana vā rāma dīpyamāne'tha codake || parisamūhya paryukṣya paristīrya paristaret || 2 || sarvānnamagnāvuddhṛtya juhuyātprayatastataḥ || vāsudevāya devāya prabhave nāpyayena ca || 3 || agnaye caiva somāya mitrāya varuṇāya ca || indrāya ca mahābhāga indrāgnibhyāṃ tathaiva ca || 4 || viśvebhyaścaiva devebhyaḥ prajānāṃ pataye tathā || anumatyai tathā rāma dhanvaṃtariṇa eva ca || 5 || vāstoṣpatyai tathā devyai tataḥ sviṣṭikṛte'gnaye || caturthyantena natvā ca hutvaitebhyo baliṃ haret || 6 || takṣopatakṣāvabhitaḥ pūrveṇāgnimataḥ param || ambānāmāsi dharmajña durgā nāmāni cāpyatha || 7 || nivantī ca panīkā ca prabhavantī tathaiva ca || medhavantī ca nāmāsi sarveṣāmeva bhārgava||8| āgneyādyākrameṇātha tataḥ sūktiṣu nikṣipet || nirdityai vasubhāgyai ca sumaṅgalyai ca bhārgava || 9|| bhadraṃkaryai tato dattvā sthūṇāyai ca tathā śriyai || hiraṇyakeśyai ca tathā vanaspataya eva ca ||2.92.10|| dharmādharmābhyāṃ ca dvāre gṛhamadhye dhruvāya ca || mṛtyave ca bahirdadyādvaruṇāyodakāśaye||11|| bhūtebhyaśca bahirdadyāccharaṇe dhanadāya ca || indrāyendrapuruṣebhyo dadyātpūrveṇa mānavaḥ || 12 || yamāya tatpuruṣebhyo dadyāddakṣiṇatastataḥ || varuṇāya tatpuruṣebhyo dadyātpaścimatastataḥ || 13 || somāya somapuruṣebhya udagdadyādanantaram || brahmaṇe brahmapuruṣebhyo madhye dadyāttathaiva ca || 14 || ākāśe ca tathaivordhvaṃ sthaṇḍile ca tathā kṣitau || divācarebhyaśca divā rātrau rātricarāya ca || 15 || baliṃ bahistathā dadyātsāyaṃ prātastu pratyaham || piṇḍanirvāpaṇaṃ kāryaṃ sāyaṃ prātarna kārayet || 16 || pitre tu prathamaṃ piṇḍaṃ tatpitre tadanantaram || tato dadyācca tatpitre mātre ca tadanantaram || 17 || pitṛmātre tato dadyācchvaśrvai tadanantaram || dakṣiṇāgreṣu darbheṣu salileṣu viśeṣataḥ || 18 || yatkiñcitpaśyate gehe bhakṣyaṃ vā bhojyameva vā || nivedayecca tatsarvaṃ śubhaṃ pānaṃ viśeṣataḥ || 19 || puṣpairdhūpena dīpena pūjayetsatataṃ pitṝn || nāmagotre sadā vācye piṇḍanirvāpaṇe tathā || 2.92.20 || piṇḍaṃ dadyācca kākānāṃ tatra mantramimaṃ paṭhet || aindrā varuṇavāyavyā yāmyā vai nairṛtāstathā || 21 || te kākāḥ pratigṛhṇantu imaṃ piṇḍaṃ mayoddhṛtam || tataḥ piṇḍaṃ śunāṃ dadyānmantraṃ tatra nibodha me ||22 || vaivasvatakule jātau dvau śyāmaśabalau śunau || tābhyāṃ piṇḍaṃ pradāsyāmi pathi rakṣantu māṃ sadā || 23 || tato grāsaṃ gavāṃ dadyādatra mantraṃ nibodha me || saurabheyyaḥ sarvahitāḥ pavitrāḥ pāpanāśinīḥ ||24|| pratigṛhṇantu me grāsaṃ gāvastrailokyamātaraḥ || tataḥ svastayayanaṃ kāryaṃ bhikṣā deyā ca bhikṣave||25|| dattvā tu saṃskṛtāṃ bhikṣāṃ godānaphalamāpnuyāt || bālaḥ suvāsinī vṛddhā garbhiṇyāturakanyakāḥ||26|| bhṛtyām̐śca bhojayedrāma pūjayitvā tathātithīn || naikagrāmīṇamatithiṃ vidyānnābrāhmaṇaṃ tathā ||27|| atithiṃ bhojayetpūrvaṃ tato bhṛtyāṃśca pūjayet || rājanyamathavā vaiśyaṃ śūdraṃ vā dvijasattama ||28|| vaiśvadeve ca saṃprāptaṃ bhṛtyaiḥ saha ca bhojayet|| vayobhyaśca tathā dadyāccaṇḍālebhyastathā bhuvi||29|| sādhāraṇaṃ tatsarveṣāṃ śeṣakaṃ gṛhiṇāṃ gṛhe || vaiśvadeve ca saṃprāpte na kathaṃcidavamānayet||2.92.30|| ādāya sukṛtaṃ yāti bhagnāśaścātithirgataḥ || adhvanā yastu bhagnāya brāhmaṇāya tathā divi||31|| satkṛtya bhojanaṃ dadyāttena svarge mahīyate || devā brāhmaṇarūpeṇa caranti pṛthivīmimām|| 32|| tasmātsaṃprāptamatithiṃ prayatnena tu pūjayet || atithiṃ pūjayeccāgre daśagodaphalaṃ labhet||33|| pādaśaucaṃ tato dattvā prāptāyāṃtithaye gṛhe || godānaphalamāpnoti dattvā caiva tathāsanam ||34|| pratiśrayapradānena nākapṛṣṭhe mahīyate || tālavṛntānilaṃ kṛtvā tathā prāptāya mānavaḥ ||35|| godānaphalamāpnoti vāyulokaṃ sa gacchati || tālavyajanahastastu kṛtvā tadabhicāraṇam||36|| atithirbhojane prāpte godānaphalamāpnuyāt || śītāhatātithiṃ prāpya kāṣṭhānprajvālayennaraḥ || 37 || pratāpayenmahābhāga daśadhenuphalaṃ labhet || kāyāgnidīptimāpnoti prākāśyaṃ paramaṃ tathā || 38 || tṛṣṇārtāyodakaṃ dattvā pāne godānamāpnuyāt || śrāntasaṃvāhanaṃ kṛtvā dhenudānaphalaṃ labhet || 39 || rogiṇaḥ paricaryāṃ ca kṛtvā daśaguṇaṃ labhet || pādābhyaṃgaṃ naraḥ kṛtvā prāptāyātithaye gṛhe ||2.92.40|| godānaphalamāpnoti nāgalokaṃ ca gacchati|| pratiśrayaṃ tathā dīnaṃ dattvā cātithaye naraḥ||41|| dhenudānaphalaṃ prāpya sūryaloke mahīyate || cakṣuṣmāṃśca prakāśāṃśca virodhaścaiva jāyate ||42|| śayanīyapradānena vasudānaphalaṃ labhet || dantakāṣṭhapradānena saubhāgyaṃ mahadāpnuyāt||43|| śaucodakapradānena godānaphalamāpnuyāt || mṛtpradānena dharmajña virodho nābhijā yate||44|| dattvānulepanaṃ mālāṃ parāṃ lakṣmīmupāsate || tathauṣadhipradānena virogastvabhijāyate|| 45 || snānābhyaṅgapradānena rūpavānabhijāyate || tathā snānīyadānena gandharvaiḥ saha modate || 46 || snānodakapradānena vāruṇaṃ lokamāpnuyāt || upānahaḥ pradānena vimānamadhirohati || 47 || tathā chatrapradānena gāṇapatyamavāpnuyāt || vastrapradānādbhavati rūpavānsubhagastathā || 48 || aśvamedhamavāpnoti tathā bhūmiprado naraḥ || yānadaḥ svargamāpnoti pauṇḍarīkapadaṃ tathā ||49|| vāridhānīstathā dattvā pūrṇāḥ śītena vāriṇā || sarvā sabhakṣāḥ prāpnoti golokaṃ mānuṣottama || 2.92.50 || trapuṣairvārukāyuktaiḥ śarkarāghṛtasaṃyutaiḥ || saktubhirlavaṇopetaighṛrtairharitasaṃyutaiḥ || 51|| tarpayitvātithiṃ samyagvāridhānyaiśca gorasaiḥ || golokaṃ ciramāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 52 || tṛptimāpnoti ca tathā yatrayatrābhijāyate || kimicchakena saṃyojya cāśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet || 53 || tāṃbūlasya pradānena gandharvaiḥ saha modate || uptimāsāvṛtaṃ kṛtvā svargaloke mahīyate || 54 || itihāsānathāśrāvya godānaphalamāpnuyāta || gopradānena vittena toṣayitvā tathātithim || 55 || mahatphalamavāpnoti gandharvaiḥ saha modate || anuvrajyātithiṃ rāma godānaphalamāpnuyāt || 56 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena pūjayedatithiṃ sadā || rājanyā vipradaivatyā nāryaśca patidevatāḥ || gṛhastho'tithidaivatyastasmāttaṃ pūjayetsadā ||57|| satatamiha naro yaḥ pūjanaṃ cātithīnāṃ tṛṇajalamṛduvākyaiḥ sāraśaktyā vidadhyāt || surasadasi sa pūjyo devatānāṃ tathā syādbhavati ca naraloke jāyamānaḥ samṛddhaḥ || || 58 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0 saṃ0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaravākye vaiśvadevakathanannāma dvinavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 92 || <2.93> || puṣkara uvāca || candrasya yadi vā bhānoryasminnahani bhārgava || grahaṇaṃ tu bhavettatra na pūrvaṃ bhojanakriyā || 1 || nācaretsagrahe tasmiṃstathaivāstamupāgate || yāvatsyādudayaṃ tasya nāśnīyāttāvadeva tu ||2|| gobrāhmaṇaścoparāge na cāśnīyātprayatnataḥ || na rājño viplave'śnīyātsurārcāviplave tathā || || 3 || na hutvā na ca dattvā ca nāśauce na ca garhitam || nāpathyaṃ na ca bālānāṃ tathā bhārgava paśyatām || 4 || prārthitaṃ bālakānāṃ ca dātavyaṃ syātprayatnataḥ || bālānāṃ prārthitaṃ dattvā nākaloke mahīyate || 5 || bālakā lālanīyāśca dharmakāmaiḥ sadā naraiḥ || teṣāṃ bhojyapradānena godānaphalamāpnuyāt || 6 || teṣāṃ krīḍanakaṃ dattvā modate nandane ciram || āhlādaṃ yānti satataṃ yasmindṛṣṭvā tu bālakāḥ || 7 || saubhāgyaṃ mahadāpnoti yatrayatrābhijāyate || tasmātsarvaprayatnena bālānagre tu bhojayet ||8|| abhuktavatsu bāleṣu na cāśnīyātkathañcana || yo na dadyānna cāśnī yātkadācidapi tanmayam || 9 || ya eko miṣṭamaśnāti na tato'nyo'sti pātakī || naikavāsāstathāśnīyādbhinnabhāṇḍe na mānavaḥ || 2.93.10 || bhinnāsanopaviṣṭaśca śayanīyagatastathā || anārdrapāṇipādāntastathā caivārdramastakaḥ || 11 || notsaṅge bhakṣayedbhakṣyānna pāṇau lavaṇaṃ tathā || sakṛddānaṃ pṛthakpānaṃ māṃsena payasā niśi || 12 || dantacchedanamuṣṇaṃ ca saptakantu suvarjayet || dadhi rātrau na cāśnīyājjalannāñjalinā pibet || || 13 || sarvaṃ tailasamṛddhaṃ ca nādyādastamite ravau || varjanīyā divā dhānāḥ kovidāraḥ sadaiva tu || 14 || divā dhānāḥ svaraṃ hanti rātrau ca dadhi saktuṣu || alakṣmīḥ kovidāreṣu nityameva kṛtālayā || 15 || niḥśeṣakṛttathā rāma na syādanyatra mākṣikāt || kṣīrasya rāma saktūnāṃ pāthasasyodakasya ca || 16 || śeṣaṃ tu kāryamanyasya na tu niḥśeṣakṛdbhavet || śūdrāya dadyānnocchiṣṭaṃ nocchiṣṭaśca ghṛtaṃ spṛśet || 17 || mūrdhānaṃ na spṛśedrāma na spṛśecca hutāśanam || nānukutsā ca kartavyā sumanāstanmanāstathā || 18 || bhuñjīta prayato bhūtvā diśaścānavalokayan || vāmahastena pānīyaṃ pītocchiṣṭaṃ tathaiva ca || 19 || na pibenna tathāśnīyātkṛtvā paryastikaṃ naraḥ || pādaprasāraṇaṃ kṛtvā na ca veṣṭitamastakaḥ || 2.93.20 || ācamya tu tataḥ kāryaṃ dantakāṣṭhasya bhakṣaṇam || bhūyo'pyācamya kartavyaṃ tatastāmbūladhāraṇam ||21 || śravaṇaṃ cetihāsasya tataḥ kuryātsamāhitaḥ || śāstrānveṣā ca kartavyā tataḥ samyagbhṛgūttama || 22 || śāstrānvavekṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā kṛtvā caṃkramaṇaṃ tataḥ || upāsya paścimāṃ sandhyāṃ tiṣṭhetprayatamānasaḥ || 23 ||| pūrvāṃ sandhyāṃ japaṃstiṣṭhedupaviṣṭaśca paścimām || arkkasyodayanāttāvadyāvadbhāskaradarśanam || 24 || pūrvāṃ sandhyāṃ japetsnātaḥ paścimāṃ sati bhāskare || upaviṣṭo japettāvadyāvattārakadarśanam || 25 || sampūjanaṃ devavarasya kṛtvā tataśca kuryātkhalu vaiśvadevam || bhuktvā tato'nnaṃ laghu yacca hṛdyaṃ tataḥ svapedbhārgavavaṃśamukhya ||26|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0saṃ0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne bhojanavidhirnāma trinavatitamodhyāyaḥ ||93|| <2.94> puṣkara uvāca|| śūnyālaye śmaśāne vānekavṛkṣe catuṣpathe || mahādevagṛhe vāpi mātṛveśmani vā svapet||1|| na yakṣanāgāyatane skandasyāyatane tathā|| kūlacchāyāsu ca tathā śarkarāloṣṭapāṃsuṣu ||2|| prasvapecca tathā darbhe vinā dīkṣāṃ vrataṃ na ca || dhānyagodevaviprāṇāṃ gurūṇāṃ ca tathopari || 3 ||| na cāpi bhinnaviṣaye nāśucau nāśucistathā || nārdrapādaśca nagnaśca nottarāparamastakaḥ ||4|| nākāśe sarvataḥ śūnye na ca caityadrume tathā|| na gacchedgurviṇīṃ nārīṃ na gacchetsitamūrdhajām ||5|| rajasvalāṃ rogavatīṃ nāyonau na bubhukṣitaḥ || nābhyakto na tathābhyaktāṃ na ca parvaṇi bhārgava || śukramokṣamathākāśe tiryagyonau ca varjayet ||6|| evaṃ sadā yaḥ kurute nṛvīra samyagyathoktaṃ sumanāstarasvī || tasyāśu pāpaṃ vilayaṃ prayāti śriyaṃ ca mukhyāṃ labhate sukhaṃ ca || 7 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0saṃ0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne ācārakathanannāma caturnavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||94|| <2.95> puṣkara uvāca|| vaivāhike'gnau kurvīta karma smārtaṃ sadā gṛhī || dāyakālāhṛte vāpi piturmaraṇakālike || 1 || māturvā bhṛgujaśreṣṭha śrautaṃ vaitānikāgniṣu || devatānāṃ pitṝṇāṃ ca ṛṣīṇāṃ ca tathā naraḥ || 2 || ṛṇavāñjāyate yasmāttanmokṣe prayatetsadā || devānāmanṛṇo janturyajñairbhavati mānada || 3 || svalpavittaśca pūjābhirupavāsairvrataistathā || śrāddhena pūjayā caiva pitṝṇāmanṛṇo bhavet || 4 || ṛṣīṇāṃ brahmacaryeṇa śrutena tapasā tathā || hutaṃ caivāhutaṃ caiva nirvāpyaṃ prahutaṃ tathā || 5 || prāśitaṃ ca mahābhāga pañcayajñānna hāpayet || hutamagnau vijānīyādahutaṃ balikarma yat ||6 || piṇḍanirvāpaṇaṃ rāma nirvāpyaṃ parikīrtitam || prahutaṃ ca yathāyajñaṃ pitṛyajñaṃ tathaiva ca || 7 || prāśanaṃ ca tathā proktaṃ yadbhuktaṃ tadanantaram || pañcayajñānsadā kuryād gṛhī pāpāpanuttaye || 8 || devayajñaṃ bhūtayajñaṃ pitṛyajñaṃ tathaiva ca || mānuṣyamṛṣiyajñaṃ ca kuryānnityamatandritaḥ || 9 || devayajñaṃ hutaṃ vidyādbhūtayajñaṃ balikriyā || pitṛyajñaṃ tathā piṇḍairṛṣiyajñaṃ ca bhārgava || 2.95.10 || svādhyāyasevā vijñeyā tathai vātithipūjanam || manuṣyayajño vijñeyaḥ pañcayajñānna hāpayet || 11 || viṣṇuṃ yajettathā devaṃ haviryajñaiśca saptabhiḥ || agnyādhānaṃ mahābhāga tathāgnihavanakriyā || 12 || darśaṃ ca paurṇamāsaṃ ca cāturmāsyaṃ tathaiva ca || dvirāgrahāyaṇeṣṭiśca pāke ca yavadhānyayoḥ ||13|| virūḍhā paśubandhaśca tathā sautrāmaṇirdvijaḥ || saptabhiḥ somasaṃsthābhiryajeddevaṃ sanātanam || 14 || agniṣṭomaṃ mahābhāga cātyagniṣṭomameva ca || ukthaṃ ca pāvanīṃ caiva pratirātraṃ tathaiva ca || 15 || vājapeyañca dharmajña āptoryāmaṃ tathaiva ca || anyaiśca vividhairyajñaiḥ pauṇḍarīkādibhistathā || 16 || gosavenāśvamedhena rājasūyena vā punaḥ || tathā puruṣamedhena sarvamedhena bhārgava || 17 || anyaiśca vividhairyajñairnāmakalpocitaistathā || yajanaṃ devadevasya vāsudevasya kārayet || 18 || yajño viṣṇurmahātejā yajamānaḥ sa eva hi || ta eva yajñapātrāṇi yajñadravyāṇi yāni ca || 19 || taṃ yajetsatataṃ rāma sarvadevamayaṃ harim || satyena vai yajeddevaṃ pratyabdaṃ munipuṅgava || 2.95.20 || paśupratyayanaṃ kuryāccāturmāsikameva ca || iṣṭiṃ vaiśvānarīṃ kuryāttathā svalpadhano naraḥ || 21 || atyevālpe dhane somaṃ pibedbhārgavasattama || āyuḥ putrānyaśo medhāṃ dhanamantragaṇaṃ tathā || |22 || hantyalpadakṣiṇo yajñastasmānnālpadhano yajet || yasya traivārṣikaṃ bhaktaṃ paryāptaṃ bhṛtyatṛptaye || 23 || adhikaṃ vāpi vidyeta sa somaṃ pātumarhati || prājāpatyamadattvā ca agnyādheyasya dakṣiṇā || 24 || anāhitāgnirbhavati brāhmaṇo vibhave sati|| sarvadevamayo viṣṇuḥ pratyahaṃ tasya pūjanam || 25 || pratimāyāmapi tathā kartavyaṃ bhṛgusattama || viṣṇumevābhijānanti sarvayajñeṣu vai dvijāḥ || 26 || pāyasaiḥ sumanobhiśca tasyāpi yajanaṃ smṛtam || tattaddevanikāyeṣu tathaiva svayameva vā || 27 || pūjā kāryā bahirvedau śraddhayā bhṛgunandana || natvalpadakṣiṇairyajñairyajeteha kadācana || 28 || viṣṇuṃ devanikāyasthaṃ yathāśraddhamarindama || tapasā pūjayennityaṃ tasmādalpadhano naraḥ || 29 || saṃpūjya devaṃ paramānnagandhairdhūpaiḥ sugandhaiśca phalaiśca mukhyaiḥ || tasmādavāpnoti sa sarvayajñāṃstasmātprapūjyaḥ satataṃ mahātmā||2.95.30|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0saṃ0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne gṛhasthadharma varṇanannāma pañcanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 95 || <2.96> rāma uvāca || karmāṇi śrotumicchāmi kāmyāni gṛhiṇāmaham || tvattaḥ samastadharmajña yādogaṇa nṛpātmaja || 1 || puṣkara uvāca || kṛtopavāso yāmyarkṣe sopavāsasya bhārgava || purodhāḥ snapanaṃ kuryātkṛttikāsu yathāvidhi ||2|| akālamūlaiḥ kalaśairmṛnmayairatha kāñcanaiḥ || ujvalairlakṣaṇaiḥ pūrṇaistathā tīrthodakaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 3 || agnimanthaśirīṣāṇāṃ nyagrodhāśvatthayorapi || patrapūrṇaistathāyuktaistilaiḥ kṛṣṇairdvijottama || 4 || vahniṃ kumāraṃ śaśinaṃ khaṅgaṃ varuṇameva ca || pūjayetkṛttikāścaiva gandhamālyānnasampadā || 5 || pītaraktaistathā varṇairghṛtadīpaistathaiva ca || dadhnā gavyena lājābhiragnimanthena cāpyatha || 6 || kṛsarollopikābhiśca apūpaiśca pṛthagvidhaiḥ || devatānāṃ yathoktānāṃ priyaṅguṃ juhuyāttataḥ || 7 || candanañca mayūrāṇāṃ lomāni manujottama || agnimanthagṛhāddhūmaṃ kṛtvā rukmāṅgadaṃ maṇim || 8 || dhārayeddakṣiṇāṃ dadyācchaktyā kanakameva ca || śvetavāsāstataḥ paścātpūjayenmadhusūdanam || 9 || karmaitatsatataṃ kṛtvā vahnyādhānamathāpnuyāt || | karmaitaduktaṃ ripunāśakāri sarvāgnikarmaprasamṛddhidaṃ ca || dhanyaṃ yaśasyaṃ ca tathaiva kāmyaṃ nityaṃ kṛtaṃ dharmavidāṃ variṣṭha || 2.96.10 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakāṇḍe mā0 saṃ0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne kṛttikāsnānavarṇanannāma ṣaṣṇavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 96 || <2.97> rāma uvāca || || agnyādhānamathāpnoti śatrunāśamathāpi vā || svecchayā karmaṇā kena sadā yādonṛpātmaja || 1 || śatrunāśakaraṃ karma kathayasva tataḥ param || tadahaṃ śrotumicchāmi tatra śraddhā sadā mama || 2 || puṣkara uvāca || kṛtopavāso yāmyarkṣe kṛttikāsu sadaiva tu || pūjayedvāsudevaṃ tu kuṅkumena suga ndhinā ||3|| raktaiśca kusumairhṛdyairdhūpaṃ dadyācca guggulam || ghṛtena dīpaṃ dadyācca raktavarṇaṃ tathaiva ca||4|| nivedanīyaṃ devāya tathā sarvaṃ nivedayet || hotavyaṃ susamiddhe'gnau tathaivātra śubhaṃ haviḥ || āyudhāni ca deyāni brāhmaṇebhyaśca dakṣiṇā ||5 || karmaitaduktaṃ ripunāśakāri dhāryaṃ sadā śatrugaṇapramāthi || kṛtvaitadagryaṃ ripunāśamāśu prāpnoti martyo na hi saṃśayo'tra || 6 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0sa0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne śatrunāśakarmavarṇanannāma saptanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 97 || <2.98> rāma uvāca || kāmyāni tvaṃ samācakṣva snānānyanyāni devaja || kena snānena dharmajña kaṃ kaṃ kāmamavāpnuyāt ||1|| puṣkara uvāca || purodhāḥ sopavāsastu sarvasnānāni kārayet || sopavāsasya dharmajña tathā sarvatra mānavaḥ || 2 || akālamūlāḥ kalaśāḥ kāryāḥ sarveṣu bhārgava || pūjā candramasaḥ kāryā varuṇasya tathaiva ca || 3 || nakṣatradevatānāṃ ca nakṣatrasya tathaiva ca || sarvagasyāprameyasya vāsudevasya cāpyathā||4|| yeṣāṃ ca pūjā kartavyā teṣāṃ ca juhuyāddhaviḥ || kāmyaṃ snānaṃ sadā kuryānnakṣatraṃ tu na laṃghayet|| mantrayetsnānakalaśaṃ mantreṇānena bhārgava ||5 || mantraḥ āpaḥ somādyāḥ saṃbabhūvuḥ pavitrāgniḥ pāvanaḥ somasūryasaṃsthitā vāyunā naṣṭadoṣāśca yo nitya macchreyase satkṛtyāpsu syuḥ svāhā śāntiḥ śrīrnavapuṣṭirmahyaṃ bhūyāsaṃ sarvaśiraḥ || sādhusvāheti sūryaḥ saṃsthitā vāyunāmāṣṭadoṣā ||' karmaitaduktaṃ ripunāśakāri sādhāraṇaṃ snānamidaṃ pavitram || ataḥ paraṃ te kathayāmi rāma snānāni kāmyāni sukhapradāni || 6 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0sa0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne sādhāraṇasnānavarṇanannāmāṣṭanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 98 || <2.99> puṣkara uvāca || kṛttikāsnānamuktaṃ te vahnikarmaprasādhanam || tathārināśanaṃ mukhyaṃ vahnyādhyeyapradaṃ tathā || 1|| rohiṇīṣu tathā snānaṃ proktaṃ putrapradaṃ putrapradaṃ tava || brahmavarcasakāmasya snānaṃ saumyamidaṃ śṛṇu || 2 || pūrṇamaudumbaraiḥ patraiḥ kṛtvā rāma ghaṭatrayam || pūrṇacandrāṅkitaiḥ śuklaiḥ sūtramālyairalaṃkṛtam || 3 || tena saṃsnāpitaḥ paścātkṣaumavāsā yathāvidhi || devatāpūjanaṃ kṛtvā ghṛtaṃ hutvā hutāśane || 4 || oṅkārapūtaṃ somāya kṣīraṃ hutvā tathā jale || nivedanīyaṃ somāya tathā pṛṣṭhamṛgatrayam || 5 || mṛgaśṛṅgeṇa dhūpaṃ ca tathā dadyādanantaram || somena ca maṇirdhāryo jātarūpapariṣkṛtaḥ || 6 || dakṣiṇā cātra dātavyā śubhadhenuḥ payasvinī || kṛtvā tannityamāpnoti brahmavarcasamuttamam || 7 || ghṛtāmramadhupūrṇena snātaḥ kumbhena mānavaḥ || paṭṭiśālaṃkṛtenātha raktacandanavāriṇā || 8 || | rudrāya māṃsaṃ rudhiraṃ tathā ca madhu pāyasam || kṛṣṇāni vāsāṃsi tathā dhūpaṃ guggulameva ca ||9|| dadyādghṛtena ca tathā homo mantrairvidhīyate || kṛṣṇāni vāsāṃsi tathā dātavyā dakṣiṇā bhavet || 2.99.10 || meṣāśvanaralomāni gardabhasya viśeṣataḥ || āyasī tu maṇau kṛtvā dvāri śatrornidhāpayet || 11 || ārdrāsnānamidaṃ rāma sarvaśatruvināśanam || sarvagandhaiḥ phalairbījaiḥ pūrṇaṃ kṛtvā ghaṭatrayam || 12 || snāpanaṃ tena kartavyamādityaistadanantaram || navanītaṃ ca kulmāṣaṃ matsyāṃścaiva svarāṃstathā || 13 || nivedayeccaiva tathā matsyāni surabhīṇi ca || ghṛtākṣatābhyāṃ dhūpena homaścaiva vidhīyate || 14 || taddine tu nadī yatra yoge gacchatu tāṃ mudā || suvarṇarūpyagandhaśca dhāraṇīyastathā maṇiḥ || 15 || dakṣiṇā cātra dātavyā rāma dhenuḥ payasvinī || snātaḥ punarvasāveva jātiśraiṣṭhyamavāpnuyāt || 16 || putrānvā sumahābhāga yadīcchati tadāpnuyāt || gaurasarṣapakalkena rāmotsāditavigrahaḥ ||17|| gavyājyapūrṇakumbhena snātaḥ snātastathauṣadhaiḥ || ahatāmbarasaṃvītaḥ pāyasaṃ vinivedayet || 18 || śuklāni caiva mālyāni vāsāṃsyapahatāni ca || homaśca pāyasenātra dhūpaṃ gandhaiśca dāpayet || 19 || maṇiḥ śirasi dhāryaśca daṇḍāgre brahmacāriṇaḥ || suvarṇagarbhaṃ puṣpeṇa snānaṃ puṣṭikaraṃ bhavet ||2.99.20||| dakṣiṇā cātra dātavyā ghṛtaṃ kanakasaṃyutam || ṣaḍdhvajāṃ nīlasūtreṇa nīlapuṣpaiśca veṣṭitām || 21 || sarṣapānveṣṭayedrāma nāgapuṣpeṇa bhūriṇā || valmīkānāṃ sahastasya tathaivāgramṛdā dvija||22|| tai snātaḥ sarvanāgebhyo madhulājāṃ nivedayet|| gandhodakaṃ tathā dhānāḥ ṣaṭkṛtvātha punaḥpunaḥ||23||| kṣīreṇa homaḥ kartavyo dhūpaḥ sarvatvacā tathā || sarpatvaṅ nāgapuṣpaṃ ca suvarṇaṃ ca maṇirbhavet || 24 || dakṣiṇā cātra dātavyā śayanīyaṃ manoharam || snānaṃ sārpeṇa te proktaṃ bhogyaṃ siddhikaraṃ bhavet ||25|| śrīpradaṃ vā mahābhāga kathitaṃ kāmatastava || plakṣapatraistilaiḥ kṛṣṇairghaṭaṣaṭkaṃ tu pūrayet ||26|| veṣṭayetkṛṣṇamālyaiśca tena snāto'hatāmbaraḥ || dakṣiṇāgreṣu darbheṣu saptapiṇḍānupāharet || 27 || subhāsvaro barhiṣado hyagniṣvāttāstathaiva ca || kravyādaścopahūtāśca ājyapāśca sukālinaḥ || 28 || pitaraḥ kathitāsteṣāṃ piṇḍaṃ dadyātkrameṇa ca || dhūpaṃ vrīhiyavairdadyāttilairhomaṃ tu kārayet || 29 ||| dātavyā dakṣiṇā cātra tilānrajatameva ca || vacā ca korakaṃ caiva trivṛtaṃ dhārayenmaṇim || 2.99.30 || pitṛprasādaṃ prāpnoti karmasiddhimathāpi ca || maghāsnānamidaṃ kṛtvā nityameva samāhitaḥ || 31 || mākṣikaṃ ca madhūkaṃ ca tathaiva madhuyaṣṭikām || kṛtvā kumbhadvayaṃ pūrṇaṃ bhagnāṅgaḥ snāpayennaram || 32 || śālipiṣṭaṃ tataḥ snāto ghṛtena madhunā yutam || gandhamālyaṃ bahuvidhaṃ bahukṛtvā bhagāya tu || 33 || nivedayitvā deyāni citramāṃsāni cāpyatha || ghṛtena dhūpo dātavyo homaḥ kāryaḥ priyaṅgunā || 34 || dakṣiṇā cātra dātavyā citravāsāṃsi cāpyatha || pārāvatasya pakṣāṇi cakravākasya mānada || 35 || trivṛtāni tathā kṛtvā maṇiṃ śirasi dhārayet || saubhāgyaṃ mahadāpnoti snātvaiva bhagadaivate || 36 || tilamākṣikapūrṇena snātaḥ kumbhadvayena tu || āryakṣe pāyasaṃ dadyātpītarakte ca vāsasī || 37 || dhūpe śatāvarī deyā homaḥ kāryastathākṣataiḥ || tejovantī priyaṅguśca trivṛtaṃ dhārayenmaṇim || 38 || dakṣiṇā cātra dātavyā tathā rakte ca vāsasī || uttarāphalgunīsnānaṃ sarvārambhaprasiddhidam || 39 || vīryasya vardhanaṃ cāpi kartavyamanusūnunā || gajakāmasya te snānaṃ haste pūrvaṃ mayoditam || 2.99.40 || parasainyajayārthāya snānaṃ tadapi śasyate || maṃjiṣṭhāṃ ca samaṅgāṃ ca misikāntāṃ ca bhārgava || 41 || kanakaṃ rajataṃ caiva pūrṇakumbhe vinikṣipet || tenābhiṣiktaścitrāṇi mālyavāsāṃsyanantaram || 42 || tvāṣṭre nivedayedbhaktyā homaṃ kṣīreṇa kārayet || dakṣiṇā cātra dātavyā citravastrāṇi mānada || 43 || sarvagandhaistathā dhūpaṃ baliṃ citraṃ tathaiva ca || pṛthaksrutiprasūtānāṃ puṣpānāṃ kanakairvṛtam || 44 || aṣṭādaśānāṃ ca tathā maṇiṃ śirasi dhārayet || evaṃ snātastu citrāsu saubhāgyaṃ mahadaśnute || 45 || sarvabhūteṣu cādhikyaṃ yadicchati tadāpnuyāt || rukmamaśvavatthapatraṃ ca khaḍgaśṛṅgaṃ tathaiva ca || 46 || pūrṇakumbhe vinikṣipya snātaḥ śīdhusurāsavam || vāyavye prayato dadyātkṣīraṃ sapalalaṃ dadhi || 47 || gandhaṃ dhūpaṃ tathā dadyāddhome kāryaṃ tathā ghṛtam || | dakṣiṇā cātra dātavyā vāsāṃsi vividhāni ca || 48 || dvaṣṭāśvaśyāmahārītahaṃsapakṣaiḥ payo'nvitam || dhārayecca maṇiṃ vidvānsvātāvevaṃ samācaret || || 49 || vāṇijye samyagāpnoti siddhiṃ ca mahatīṃ naraḥ || viśākhāsu tathā snānaṃ kāryaṃ kumbhadvayena tu || 2.99.50 || kṛttikāsu mahābhāga tataḥ śākaṃ nivedayet || indrāgnibhyāṃ ca vāsāṃsi pītaraktāni cāpyatha || 51 || mālyāni ca mahābhāga dhūpaṃ ca ghṛtaguggulam || homārthe ca ghṛtaṃ kuryāddakṣiṇā kanakaṃ tathā || 52 || gaṇādhipatyamāpnoti kṛtvaivaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || sahasravīryaṃ cānantāṃ madhūkaṃ ca tathā misim || 53 || pūrṇakumbhatraye kṛtvā kṛtasvastikalakṣaṇe || ahatāmbarasaṃvītaḥ sarvagandhaphalākṣataiḥ || 54 || madhunā ca baliṃ dadyānmitrāya ca mahātmane || vṛścikena tathā dhūpaṃ yavairhomaṃ ca mānada || 55 || puradvāraṃ kaṭāhāśca cūḍākāṣṭhaṃ sakāñcanam || dhārayeddakṣiṇāṃ dadyāttathā ca kanakaṃ dvija || 56 || evaṃ maitre sadā snātaḥ sarvabhūtaiḥ samāpnuyāt || maitrīṃ manujaśārdūla puraṃ vā kurute vaśe || 57 || taḍāgapadminīkūlanadīnadasamudbhavaiḥ || toyaiḥ pūrṇa ghaṭānkṛtvā sarvabījasamanvitān || 58 || sarvaratnauṣadhīpūrṇānstrīsnānaṃ taiḥ samācaret || kṣaumavāsāstu ratnāni mālyāni ca phalāni ca || || 59 || ratnāni dadyācchakrāya prāṅmukhaḥ susamāhitaḥ || dhūpaṃ dadyācca śīrṣeṇa viśākhāvanmaṇirbhavet || 2.99.60 || chatraṃ ca dakṣiṇā deyā jyeṣṭhāyāṃ bhṛgunandana || snānameva sadā kṛtvā rājyamāpnotyakaṇṭakam || 61 || kṛṣikāmasya mūlena snānamuktaṃ mayā purā || tathā vāṇijyakāmasya prāgaṣāḍhāsu bhārgava || 62 || athottarāsu ṣāḍhāsu kuryādghaṭacatuṣṭayam || puṣpabījaphalopetaṃ tena snātastu mānavaḥ || 63 || kṣaumavāsāḥ surāṃ caiva pāyasaṃ ca nivedayet || mudgamiśraṃ ca dharmajña mālyavāsāṃsi cecchayā || 64 || home ca pāyasaṃ kuryāddhūpe gośṛṅgameva ca || dhātrīpuṣpaśamībilvairmaṇirdhāryaḥ sakāñcanaiḥ || 65 || dakṣiṇā cātra dātavyā suvarṇaṃ raupyameva ca || rājaśreṣṭhatvamāpnoti vivādeṣu jayaṃ tathā || 66 || bilvaṃ ca tagaraṃ caiva candanaṃ madhuyaṣṭikām || priyaṅguṃ ca madhūkaṃ ca triṣu kumbheṣu nikṣipet || 67 || saṃgamādāhṛtaṃ toyaṃ tanmṛdaṃ ca bhṛgūttama || tena snātastataḥ snānaṃ kuryātsarvauṣadhairdvija || 68 || kulatthā'nnaṃ saśālyannaṃ mukhyāni ca phalāni ca || baliṃ ca viṣṇave dadyānmudgairdhūpaṃ tathaiva ca || 69 || rājacchatrasya daṇḍāgrātkāṣṭhaṃ śakradhvajāttathā || siṃhadaṃṣṭrāmaṇiścātra sarukmaḥ śirasi smṛtaḥ || 2.99.70 || dakṣiṇā cātra dātavyā dhenuḥ kāṃsyopadohinī|| evaṃ tu śravaṇasnāyī rājyamāpnotyakaṇṭakam || 71 || anyadeśādhipatyaṃ vā rājyamāpnoti bhārgava || atimuktakapatrāṇi bilvasya ca tathā kṣipet || 72 || kumbheṣu pañcasu tataḥ snānaṃ taistu samācaret || vāstubhyastu baliṃ dadyātsuvarṇaṃ mākṣike tataḥ || 73 || dhūpaṃ vāyasapakṣaistu homaḥ kāryo ghṛtena tu || brahmacāriśilālopakākapakṣaṃ tathaiva ca || 74 || kākamācīṃ rukmayutāṃ maṇiṃ śirasi dhārayet || dakṣiṇā cātra dātavyā dhenu kāṃsyopadohinī || 75 || dhanaṃ prāpnoti sumahadvivāhe vāpi kanyakām || evaṃ snāto dhaniṣṭhāsu nityameva bhṛgūttama || 76 || ārogyakārakaṃ snānaṃ pūrvamuktaṃ tu vāruṇam || ratnodakena snātastu naraḥ kumbhadvayena tu || 77 || ajaikapādāya baliṃ chāgaṃ dadyāttu pāyasam || śuklāni caiva mālyāni phalāni vividhāni ca || 78 || khaṭvāṅgañca tathā dhūpaṃ homaṃ ca payasā tathā || vyāghradaṃṣṭrā tathā lomanakhaṃ kanakameva ca || 79 || maṇirdhāryo bhavedrāma chāgo deyā ca dakṣiṇā || ajaikapāde snātastu nityameva samāhitaḥ || 2.99.80 || uddharettu nidhiṃ rāma śatrūnvā vijayeddhruvam || āhirbudhnyaṃ tathā snānaṃ godamuktaṃ purā tava || 81|| candanaṃ ca haridrā ca darbhamūlaṃ tathaiva ca|| kṛtvā kumbhe naraḥ snāyātkṛtvā piṣṭena kanyakām|| || 82 || snānālaṅkāravastrādyānpūṣṇe dadyādbaliṃ tataḥ || madhulājāstathaivātra dhūpaṃ dadyādghṛtena ca || 83|| homaṃ ghṛtena kartavyaṃ dakṣiṇā kanakaṃ bhavet || brāhmīṃ suvarcalāṃ homaṃ homagarbho maṇirbhavet || 84 || evaṃ pauṣṇe sadā snāto yaḥ sadā yujyate naraḥ || āśvine supradaṃ snānaṃ pūrvamuktaṃ mayā tava || || 85 || vaijayantīṃ balāṃ caiva samaṅgāṃ ca bhṛgūttama || indrahastāṃ madhūkaṃ ca kuryādrāma ghaṭatraye || 86 || tena snāto yamāyātha prapadyāttilataṇḍulam || mālyāni caiva citrāṇi pītāni vasanāni ca || 87 || urabhraśṛṅgaṃ dhūpārthe homārthe ca tathā tilam || dakṣiṇā cātra dātavyā tilaṃ kanakameva ca || 88 || darbhamūlairmaṇiḥ kāryaḥ kanakena ca veṣṭitaḥ || evaṃ snāto naro yāmye dīrghaṃ jīvitamāpnuyāt || 89 || snānāni mukhyāni tavoditāni kāmyāni pāpapraśamāya rāma || etāni kāryāṇi sadā dvijendra dharānvitenātha vicakṣaṇena ||2.99.90|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0saṃ0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne nakṣatrasnānakathanannāma navanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 99 || <2.100> puṣkara uvāca || upoṣya cottarāṣāḍhāṃ brahmasnānaṃ vidhīyate || sūrye madhyamanuprāpte narendro .. || sarvairbījaistathā ratnaiḥ phalaiḥ puṣpaistathauṣadhaiḥ || snātaśca sodakaiḥ kuryāttataḥ pūjāṃ svayaṃbhuvaḥ || 2 || dhūpaṃ ca dadyāddharmajña kuśamūlaghṛtākṣataiḥ || homaṃ ghṛtākṣataiḥ kuryāddadyātkanakameva ca || 3 || kriyamāṇe sruve cūrṇaṃ tathā caiva raṇo dvijaḥ || somaṃ cūrṇaṃ ca trivṛtaṃ maṇiṃ śirasi dhārayet || 4 || snānaṃ tu rājyakāmasya proktametanmayā tava || brahmavarcasakāmasya svecchayā ca yathoditam || 5 || brāhmaṃ tava snānamidaṃ pradiṣṭaṃ sarvādhināśāya bhṛgupradhāna || kāryaṃ sadā vā dinamadhyayāte divākare kāmakaraṃ praśastam || 6 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0 saṃ0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne abhijitsnānavarṇanannāma śatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 100 || <2.101> rāma uvāca || snānamanyatsamācakṣva bhagavanpuṣṭikārakam || yena nityaṃ kṛteneha puruṣaḥ puṣṭimāpnuyāt|| 1 || puṣkara uvāca || śravaṇarkṣamanuprāpte devadeve nirākare| bhaktyā samācaretsnānaṃ nadīdvitayasaṅgame ||2 || nimnagāyāṃ sarasi yā nadīsāgarasaṅgame || snātaḥ saṃpūjayeddevaṃ viṣṇuṃ mālyānulepanaiḥ || 3 || dhūpadīpanamaskāraistathā caivānnasampadā || śālyannaṃ dadhisaṃyuktaṃ viṣṇave vinivedayet || 4 || pauruṣeṇa ca sūktena pāyasaṃ juhuyāttataḥ || rajataṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadyādbrāhmaṇāya bhṛgūttama || upavāsa vināpyetatsnānaṃ puṣṭipradaṃ param || 5 || snātaḥ samāpnoti sadā manuṣyaḥ kāmānabhīṣṭāñchravaṇarkṣayoge || pāpaṃ samastaṃ vijahāti rāma dharmaṃ samāpnoti yaśaśca mukhyam ||6|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0saṃ0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne puṣṭikāraka śravaṇasnānakathanannāmaikottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 101 || <2.102> puṣkara uvāca || janmanakṣatrage some sarvauṣadhisamanvitam || kumbhaṃ supūjitaṃ kṛtvā snapanaṃ tena kārayet || 1 || snātaścaivārcayeddevaṃ vāsudevaṃ jagatpatim || nakṣatradaivataṃ candraṃ nakṣatraṃ vāruṇaṃ tathā ||2|| vāyuṃ cāyudhapīṭhādyaṃ chatraṃ saṃpūjayettathā || yathoktadevatāliṅgairmantraiśca juhuyādghṛtam || 3 || | śaktyā ca dakṣiṇā deyā brāhmaṇebhyo bhṛgūttama || tatonuliptaḥ surabhiḥ sragvī vividhabhūṣaṇaḥ || 4 || tiṣṭhanmanujaśārdūla haviṣyāśī jitendriyaḥ ||| upavāsaṃ vināpyetatpavitraṃ pāpanāśam || 5 || mātṛsthāne tu jagatāṃ janmatārā vidhīyate || candrarūpī ca bhagavānpitā viṣṇuḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 6 || ] tasmātsarvaprayatnena yamanakṣatrasaṃsthitam || bhaktyā taṃ pūjayeccandraṃ janmarkṣaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ ||7|| pūjāṃ sadā candramasastu kṛtvā janmarkṣasaṃsthasya bhṛgupradhāna || kāmānavāpnoti narastu sarvānsukhī sadā syādbhuvi naṣṭapāpmā||8|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0sa0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne janmarkṣasnānavarṇanannāma dvyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||102|| <2.103> puṣkara uvāca || candramaṃḍalavṛddhau tu tathā caivottarāyaṇe || śubhe divasanakṣatre muhūrte ca tathā śubhe || 1 || tiṣyāśvinagate candre hastaśravaṇage'pi ca || prācīṃ vāpyathavodīcīṃ niṣkramya nagarāddiśam || 2 || vāstuvidyāvinirdiṣṭe bhūmibhāge manohare || aṣṭahastaṃ śubhaṃ kuryāccaturasraṃ ca maṇḍalam || 3 || balyarthamaparaṃ kuryādvahnivedyarthameva ca || gomaye nopalipte tu sudhālekhāsamanvite || 4 || dhvajātapatravyajanamālyadāmakuśākṣataiḥ || lājāgandhādibhirmukhyairmaṅgalyaistaṃ samarcayet||5|| lājālājopakaraṇaistathaiva ca vibhūṣayet || tataḥ prasravaṇebhyastu caturbhyastu ghaṭānnavān || 6 || pratyekaṃ kalpayedvidvānkalpite maṇḍaladvaye || sūktiṣvatha mahābhāga bījamātrasamanvitān || 7 || tatastu kalpayetkumbhānsaptamukhyānnadījalaiḥ || sarvauṣadhiyutaḥ kāryaḥ kumbha eko dvijanmanā || 8 || sarvabījayuto dhānyaratnopetastathā paraḥ || tathā caivāparaṃ yuktaṃ kāryaṃ vṛkṣāgrapallavaiḥ || 9 || puṣpaiścaivāparaṃ yuktaṃ phalaiścaivāparaṃ tathā || sarvagandhayutaṃ cānyaṃ sarvāneva samarcayet || 2.103.10 || pūrvamantreṇa ca tathā sarvānevābhimantrayet || tato bhadrāsanaṃ dattvā tatra carmāstared budhaḥ || 11 || viprasya snātukāmasya sauramārṣabhakaṃ śubham || kṣattriyasya tathā saiṃhaṃ vaiyāghraṃ ca tathā viśaḥ||12|| dvīpicarma ca vaiśyasya snāpyastatropaveśayet || praśastalakṣaṇāṃ bhāryāṃ vāmabhāge tathaiva ca||13|| upoṣitaḥ śiraḥ snātaḥ siddhārthaiḥ kaṅkataṃ vinā || snāpayedbrāhmaṇo vidvānbahubhirbrāhmaṇaiḥ saha || 14|| śaṅkhapuṇyāhaghoṣeṇa vīṇāveṇuraveṇa ca || jayaśabdena mahatā bandināṃ nisvanena ca ||15|| sauvarṇaṃ ca śatacchidraṃ pātraṃ śirasi dhārayet || tatra dadyādghaṭaistoyaṃ krameṇānena śāstravit || 16 || yā auṣadhaya ityeṣa mantraḥ syādauṣadhīghaṭe || ābrahman brahmaṇetyeṣa bījakumbhe prakīrtitaḥ || 17 || āśuḥ śiśāna iti ca tathā ratnaghaṭe bhavet || mantraḥ puṣpavatītyeṣa puṣpakumbhe prakīrtitaḥ || 18 || eṣa eva tathā mantraḥ phalakumbhe prakīrtitaḥ || gandhadvāreṇa ca tathā gandhakumbhe vidhīyate || 19 || evaṃ snātaḥ parīdhāya suśukle vāsasī śubhe || maṅgalyāni spṛśedrāma saṃpaśyedvadanaṃ ghṛte || 2.103.20 || vimale ca tathādarśe tataḥ saṃpūjayeddharim || vaiṣṇavāṃśca tathā mantrāñjuhuyājjātavedasi || 21 || tatastūttaradigbhāge vahniṃ tasyopakalpayeta || bhadrāsanaṃ śubhe deśe yuktaṃ pūrvoktacarmaṇā || 22 || śvetānulepanaḥ sragvī maṅgalyābharaṇastathā || niviśetāsane tasminsabhāryo bhṛgunandana || 23 || gandhadvāretimantreṇa tasya rocanayā tataḥ || kaṇṭhe mūrdhni tataḥ kuryāttilakaṃ brāhmaṇaḥ svayam || 24 || yena devā jyotiṣeti darbhārgrairbrāhmaṇastataḥ || pādatastu prabhṛtyenaṃ sarvāṅgeṣu pramārjayet || 25 || gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dadyādbrāhmaṇebhyaśca śaktitaḥ || gandharatnājyamālyāni kanakaṃ rajataṃ tathā || 26 || śatacchidraṃ ca tatpātraṃ gurave vinivedayet || maṅgalālambhanaṃ kṛtvā gatapāpo dvijāśiṣā||27|| śaṅkhapuṇyāhaghoṣeṇa praviśecca gṛhaṃ svakam || vināpi bhāryayā rāma snānaṃ kāryamidaṃ tathā ||28|| saptarātramidaṃ snānaṃ sarvakalmaṣanāśanam || madhu māṃsaṃ tathā kṣaudraṃ maithunaṃ ca vivarjayet ||29|| alakṣmīśamanaṃ puṇyaṃ rakṣoghnaṃ buddhivardhanam || ārogyadaṃ dīptikaraṃ yaśasyaṃ śatrusūdanam || 2.103.30 || maṅgalyaṃ pāpaśamanaṃ kalidusvapnanāśanam || bṛhaspatiridaṃ cakre snānaṃ maghavataḥ svayam || brahmahatyābhibhūtasya vṛtte vṛtravadhe purā ||31|| tato'sya dattaḥ svayameva vajriṇā varo nṛlokepi varo'sya kārakaḥ || kāmānabhīṣṭānsamavāpya pūjito mahendralokaṃ sa sukhī prayāsyati || 32 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0 saṃ0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne bārhaspatyasnānavarṇanannāma tryuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 103 || || <2.104> rāma uvāca || snānamanyatsamācakṣva bhagavanduritāpaham || sakṛdeva kṛtaṃ yattu pāpebhyo vipramocayet || 1 || puṣkara uvāca || rājayakṣmābhibhūteṣu viṣamajvariteṣu ca || chāyonmādopatapteṣu viṣamajvariteṣu ca || 2 || vināyakagrahārtteṣu mūḍhacitteṣvatīva hi || yeṣāṃ na sidhyate vidyā sasyaṃ yeṣāṃ na rohati || 3 || sīdedyasya kuṭumbaṃ ca paṇyaṃ nāyāti vikrayam || na labhettu jayaṃ yuddhe balavānapi yo naraḥ || 4 || yuktānyapi ca kāryāṇi vipadyante punaḥpunaḥ || kalahaśca bhavedyeṣāṃ suhṛtsvajanabāndhavaiḥ|| || 5 || garbhaḥ prasravate yasyā jāto vāpi vinaśyati || puṣpaṃ yasyāḥ kṣayaṃ yāti na ca kiñcitprajāyate || 6 || gṛhṇāti yā na bījaṃ ca janayedvāpyamānuṣān || nāpnoti ca patiṃ kanyā tasmātsnehamathāpi vā || 7 || saubhāgyaṃ ca na cāyāti suhṛtsvajanabandhuṣu || evamukteṣu cānyeṣu tvanukteṣu ca bhārgava || 8 || prasamīkṣya vidhānajñaḥ snānametatsamācaret || snāpayetsaritastīre grahāviṣṭānvicakṣaṇaḥ || 9 || rājayakṣmābhibhūtā ye viṣama jvaritāśca ye || teṣāṃ devālaye snānaṃ kuryādvā siddhasevite || 2.104.10 || chāyonmādopataptā ye ye cāpasmāraśoṣiṇaḥ || teṣāṃ munigaṇāvāse tīrthe vā snānamiṣyate || 11 || vināyakagrahārtā ye ye ca mūḍhā vicetasaḥ || sajjanācarite deśe teṣāṃ snānaṃ vidhīyate || 12 || traividyā yena sidhyanti guṇā yeṣāṃ prapūjitāḥ || teṣāṃ snānamihoddiṣṭaṃ siddhadevasya mandire || 13 || yeṣāṃ nāsti jayo yuddhe yeṣāṃ svajanasaṃkṣayaḥ || kāntāre vā vane tīrthe teṣāṃ snānaṃ praśasyate || 14 || satataṃ kalaho yeṣāṃ jāyate ca yatastataḥ || tripathe vā taḍāge vā snānaṃ teṣāṃ prakalpayet || 15 || padminyāṃ snapayennārīṃ garbho yasyāḥ sravettathā || aśokasannidhau snāpyā jāto yasyāḥ vinaśyati || 16 || na ca gṛhṇāti yā śukraṃ snāpyā sā saphale tarau || mahodadhitaṭe snāpyā yadāpatyaṃ vinaśyati || 17 || amānuṣānyā janayetsnāpayettāṃ catuṣpathe || yādṛśaṃ yā ca bhartāraṃ na labheta varāṅganā || 18 || snāpayedekaliṅge tāṃ sthāne vā vṛkṣasaṃkule || rūpalāvaṇyayuktā yā saubhāgyaṃ yā na vindati || 19 || snānaṃ vṛddhikaraṃ tasyā veśyāgāre prakalpayet|| anyeṣāmatha kartavyaṃ sadā snānaṃ manoharam||2.104.20|| same sajjanasaṃkīrṇe śucau deśe vikaṇṭake|| sahāyaiḥ prayataiḥ sārdhamahorātroṣito dvijaḥ||21|| snānakarma prayuñjīta sopavāsasya mānada|| ahorātrāsamarthasya kāryaṃ vā haviṣāśanam||22|| śaradvasantayoḥ kāryaṃ snānaṃ svasthasya bhārgava || sarvakāleṣvathārttasya grahavyādhinibarhaṇam || 23 || muhūrte tatra sāvitre brāhmaṇaḥ snāpayeddvija || maitre'tha vijaye caiva rājanyaṃ snāpayettathā || 24 || vaiśyaṃ paitāmahe śūdraṃ śeṣeṣu snāpayettathā || pañcamī saptamī śreṣṭhā snapane brāhmaṇasya va || 25 || trayodaśī tṛtīyā ca kṣattriyasya viśiṣyate || dvitīyā daśamī caiva tathā vaiśyasya mānada || 26 || ṣaṣṭhī caturdaśī caiva śūdrāṇāṃ snānakarmaṇi || ekādaśī dvādaśī ca tathā kṛṣṇacaturdaśī || 27 || sarveṣāmeva varṇānāṃ snānakarmaṇi pūjitā || dhruveṣu vaiṣṇave puṣye revatyāṃ bhagadaivate || 28 || haste punarvasau saumye jyeṣṭhāyāmatha vāruṇe || dhaniṣṭhāyāṃ tathā snānaṃ sarveṣāmeva pūjitam || 29 || vetrāsanaṃ bhadrapīṭhaṃ vaidalaṃ dāravaṃ tathā || varṇānāmānupūrvyeṇa parikīrtitamāsanam || 2.104.30|| kṛṣṇājinaṃ ca vaiyāghraṃ rauravaṃ bāstameva ca || pādopadhānaṃ varṇānāmānupūrvyeṇa kalpayeta || 31 || vṛṣāśvaratha pṛṣṭhe ca gajapṛṣṭhe tathaiva ca || || naraskandheṅganāṅge vā prāyaśaḥ snāpayecchiśūn || 32 || snātukāmasya tasyātha pūrvamutsārasaḥ smṛtam || yairdravyairbhṛguśārdūla tāni vakṣyāmyataḥ param || 33 || punarnavāṃ rocanāṃ ca śatāhvāguruṇīṃ tvacam || madhūkaṃ ca rajanyau dve tagaraṃ nāgakesaram || 34 || āsurīṃ sarjikāṃ caiva māṃsīṃ rāmaṭha candanam || priyaṅguṃ sarṣapānkuṣṭhaṃ kuṃkumaṃ bahuputrikām || 35 || balendrahastīṃ brāhmīṃ ca pañcagavyaṃ tathaiva ca || saktunā miśrayitvā ca kāryamudvartanaṃ bhavet || 36|| tataḥ snānadine prāpte prāgvadutsādayetpunaḥ || tato manohare deśe maṇḍalaṃ kalpayed budhaḥ ||37 || caturasraṃ gomayena sarvato'ṣṭadiśaṃ samam || satoraṇaṃ caturdvāraṃ prākārairupaśobhitam || 38 || tatra madhye likhetpadmamaṣṭapatraṃ suśobhitam || karṇikāyāṃ likhedviṣṇuṃ meghābhaṃ pītavāsasam ||39|| kaustubhodbhāsitoraskaṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam|| brahmāṇaṃ dakṣiṇe nyasya padmavarṇaṃ samālikhet || 2.104.40|| ajināmbarasaṃyuktaṃ śvetayajñopavītinam || rajatābhranibhaṃ vāme bhāge rudraṃ samālikhet || 41 || vyāghracarmāmbaradharaṃ trinetraṃ śūladhāriṇam || pūrvapatre likhecchakraṃ savajraṃ ca sudarśanam || 42 || gajapṛṣṭhādhirūḍhaṃ tu svarṇābhaṃ pītavāsasam || prāgdakṣiṇe tathā patre likhedvahniṃ mahāprabham || 43 || dhūmābhavasanaṃ devaṃ śukayānagataṃ prabhum || atasīpuṣpasaṃkāśaṃ pītāmbaradharaṃ śubham || 44 || sadaṇḍaṃ mahiṣārūḍhaṃ likhetpatre tu dakṣiṇe || uṣṭrārūḍhaṃ virūpākṣaṃ likheddakṣiṇapaścime || 45 || raktāmbaradharaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ khaḍgapāṇiṃ vibhīṣaṇam || paścime varuṇaṃ devaṃ sapāśaṃ haṃsavāhanam || 46 || saśuklavasanaṃ devaṃ svacchavaiḍūryasannibham || paścimottarato vāyuṃ vāyumaṇḍalamadhyagam || 47 || likhecchubhrāmbaraṃ śvetaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam || kuberamuttare patre vyomayānagataṃ likhet || 48 || kavacottamasaṃyuktaṃ gadinaṃ kamalaprabham || vṛṣārūḍhamatheśānaṃ patre pūrvottare likhet ||49|| vyāghracarmāmbaradharaṃ bhālacandra vibhūṣitam || caturbhiḥ sāgaraiḥ padmaṃ caturasraṃ samantataḥ || 2.104.50 || yādogaṇayutaiścaiva krameṇa parivārayet || sāgarāṇāṃ tu pūrveṇa likhetpadmaṃ manoharam || 51 || tataścakraṃ tathā daṇḍaṃ vajraṃ makarameva ca || śaktiṃ dhvajaṃ triśūlaṃ tu krameṇaiva tu vinyaset || 52 || tataḥ prākārasaṃlagnāniṣūndvādaśa vinyaset || caturaḥ sūktiṣu tathā dvāreṣvaṣṭau bhṛgūttama || 53 || susaṃhatānsamāñślakṣṇānduraṅgānpatranirgatān || vyāmārdhasammitāṃstīkṣṇānpārśve takṣavibhūṣitān || 94 || pañcaraṅgaṃ tataḥ sūtraṃ badhnīyātteṣu bhārgava || arundhandvāramārgāṃstu sudṛḍhaṃ sumanoharam || 55 || vitānaṃ maṇḍalīkuryācchvetavarṇaṃ manoharam || dhvajaṃ chatrāṇi khaḍgāṃśca ghaṇṭādarśāṃścaturdiśam || 56 || prākāropari daṇḍeṣu sudṛḍheṣvanirodhayet|| snāne maṇḍalakānkuryātprākārasya tato bahiḥ || 57 || trisamānbhṛguśārdūla caturasrānmanoharān || jvālāmālyārgharacitāndiśāsu vidiśāsu ca || 58 || snānamaṇḍalakānāṃ tu samīpe susamantataḥ || gāvaḥ savatsāḥ saṃsthāpyā vṛṣabhāśca supūjitāḥ || 59 || ajāścārbhakasampannā jīvamokṣāśca pakṣiṇaḥ || prākārasyottare bhāge vediṃ kuryātsuśobhitām || 2.104.60 || darbhairācchādya tānsarvānsalilena samukṣayet || tatrāgniṃ juhuyānmantrairmahāvyāhṛtipūrvakam || 61 || yathoktadevatāliṃgaistathā mantraiśca bhārgava || oṃkāreṇa tathāstrāṇāṃ nāmayuktena vai pṛthak || 62 || aśvatthodumbaraplakṣabilvārkakhadirāḥ śamī || svarāhvayamapāmārgaṃ palāśayavakānyapi || 63 || vaṃśikā cāśvagandhā ca kadambaścārjunāsanau || eteṣāṃ samidhaḥ śastāḥ kiṣkumātrā ghṛtaplutāḥ || 64 || ekaikamapyaṣṭaśataṃ havyaṃ sarṣapasaṃyutam || tilānyavāṃstathākṣoṭām̐llājāścāgnau samāvapet || 65|| tataścāvapayecchāntiṃ brāhmaṇānguṇasaṃyutān || abhyarcya dakṣiṇābhiśca puṣpākṣataphalaistathā ||66|| tatastu sthāpayetkumbhānmaṇḍale sāgaropari || yathā digdevanāmāṅkāndiśāsu vidiśāsu ca || 67 ||| kāñcanānrājatāṃstāmrānatha vāpi mahīmayān || nāmānyathaiṣāṃ vakṣyāmi tāni me gadataḥ śṛṇu || 68 || bhadraḥ subhadraḥ siddhārthaścaturthaḥ puṣṭivardhanaḥ || amokaścitrabhānuśca parjanyo'tha sudarśanaḥ ||69 || vāpīkūpasaridbhyaśca pūjayitvā jalena tān || vanaspatisamāyuktānarghyamālyādipūjitān||2.104.70|| mantrānumantritānetāṃstatra mantraṃ nibodha me || sthāpayantu ghaṭānetānsāśvirudramarudgaṇāḥ || 71|| viśvedevāstathādityā vasavo munayastathā || adhiśrayantu suprītāstathānyā api devatāḥ ||72|| evaṃ saṃsthāpya tānkumbhānsthāpyā maṇḍalakeṣvatha|| aindrādikramaśaḥ sthāpyāstvāsane pūrvacodite || 73|| pūrve maṇḍalake sthāpyaḥ śuklapuṣpānvarānvitaḥ || sarvatra grāhayedviprairvakṣyamāṇaguṇānghaṭān || 74 || pratyekaṃ syāccaturbhistu dvārasyopari bhārgava || apāṃ pūrṇaṃ ghaṭaṃ tatra yathāśaṃ ca yathāsvakam || 75 || tathā dadyādyathāsnānaṃ samyaksnāpyasya jāyate || oṣadhīścātra vakṣyāmi yāstu kumbheṣu nikṣipet || 76 || asthāpiteṣu dharmajña tataḥ saṃsthāpanaṃ bhavet || jayāṃ jayantīṃ vijayāṃ sūkarīṃ markaṭīṃ vacām|| 77 || kāyasthāṃ ca vayasthāṃ ca bṛhatīṃ bahuputrikām || sahastaśatavīrye ca trāyamāṇāṃ kaṭumbarām || 78 || aticchatrāṃ tathā cchatrāṃ jīvantīmaparājitām || jaṭilāṃ pūtanāṃ kīśāṃ surāṃ yakṣasurāṃ tathā || 79 || avītarākṣasīṃ vīrāṃ sthirāṃ bhadrāṃ yaśobalām || śaṅkhapuṣpīṃ viṣṇudattāṃ nākulīṃ gandhanākulīm || 2.104.80 || golomyatibale caiva vyāghrīmaśvavatīṃ tathā || śyāmāṃ jyotiṣmatīṃ caiva teṣu kumbheṣu nikṣipet || 81 || candanośīratagarakumbhamāgurukesarān|| tvakpatramustahrīberapriyaṅgvelārasāṃstathā||82|| gandhamāṃsīṃ tathā spṛkkāṃ rocanaṃ rāmakaṃ buṭim|| kaśīrukāmṛtānaṃ ca kakubhaṃ padmakaṃ tathā || 83 || kastūrikāṃ taruṣkaṃ ca karpūraṃ nāḍikaṃ tathā || jātīphalaṃ lavaṅgāśca kakkolaiḥ saha cūrṇitāḥ || 84 || gandhadravyāṇi cānyāni yathālābhaṃ vinikṣipet || śvetā raktā tathā pītā kṛṣṇā caiva hi mṛttikā || 85 || yāścānyā vividhāḥ śastā mṛttikāstā nibodha me || vṛṣāgraśṛṅgādvalmīkāddevatāyatanādvrajāt || 86 || agnyāgārāddhastidantātsubhagāgaṇikāgṛhāt || rājadvārātpuradvārātkūpāddānagṛhāttathā || 87 || kumbhakāragṛhānnadyāḥ padminyāḥ śrotriyālayāt || indranīlataḍāgācca hradātprasravaṇādapi || 88 || catuṣpathātsaptapathānmṛttikāśakaṭāttathā || gajāśvagaṇaśālābhyastathātharvaṇaveśmanaḥ || 89 || ajāvikānvitāgārādrājakośānmahāsanāt || aśokātkṣīravṛkṣāṇāṃ samīpātsaphalasya ca || 2.104.90 || sadādhyayanaśālāto yajñabhūmeśca mṛttikāḥ || pragṛhya sarvāḥ sambhṛtya pañcagavyasamanvitāḥ || || 91 || sarvabījaiḥ samāyojya snānakumbheṣu nikṣipet || tataḥ kumbhānpratiṣṭhāpya snāpyaṃ saṃsthāpayeddvijaḥ || 92 || maṇḍaleṣu krameṇaiva diśāsu vidiśāsu ca || pūrve maṇḍalake snāpyaḥ śvetamālyānulepanaḥ || 93 || śvetaścaiva paṭo dhāryaścaturbhirbrāhmaṇairbhavet || evaṃ dakṣiṇatastasya sarvaṃ nīlaṃ prakalpayet || 94 || kṛṣṇaṃ ca kalpayetsarvaṃ tathā dakṣiṇapaścime || pītaṃ prakalpayetsarvaṃ tathā bhāge tu paścime || paścimottarayoḥ sarvaṃ śuklavarṇaṃ prakalpayet || 95 || tathaivottaradigbhāge padmavarṇaṃ prakalpayet || prāguttare tathā bhāge citraṃ sarvaṃ prakalpayet|| 96 || rājyābhiṣekavihito mantraścātra vidhīyate || pratyekamatha kumbheṣu diśāsu vidiśāsu ca || 97 || evaṃ snāpyo mahābhāga śaṅkhapuṇyāhanisvanaiḥ || snātaḥ śuklāmbaradharaḥ śvetamālyānulepanaḥ || 98 || maṇḍale tu niviṣṭānāṃ surāṇāṃ pūjanaṃ tataḥ || kurvīta prayataḥ śuddhiṃ gandhamālyārghasampadā || 99 || dīpairdhūpairnamaskārairvastrairābharaṇaistathā || apūpānpāyasaṃ bhakṣyāñśuklamālyānulepanam || 2.104.100 || vividhaṃ ca phalaṃ kṣīraṃ brahmaṇebhyo nivedayet || dadhnā ca paramānnena śvetamālyānulepanaiḥ || 101 || phalaiḥ prasūnaiśca tathā keśavāya haredbalim || kṣīreṇa paramānnena dadhnā sakṛsareṇa ca || 102 || phalaiḥ kālodbhavaiḥ puṣpaiḥ śaṅkarāya haredbalim || apūpaiḥ paramānnena bhakṣyaiḥ kṣīreṇa sarpiṣā || 103 || mālyānulepanaiḥ śuklairmahendrāya haredbalim || yavānāṃ ca tilānāṃ ca godhūmānāṃ tathā sakṛt ||104 || bhakṣyaiḥ saguḍasarpiṣkairbaliṃ kuryāttu vahnaye || guḍodanaguḍāpūpānpakvamāṃsaṃ tathāmiṣam || 105 || | yamāya ca baliṃ dadyādraktamālyānulepanam || pakvamāṃsaṃ tathā māṃsaṃ kṛṣṇamālyānulepanam || 106 || virūpākṣāya tu surāṃ dadyātsauvīrakaṃ tathā || mudgāpūpāṃstilāpūpāñjalajānmandirāṃstathā || 107 || varuṇāya baliṃ dadyātpītaṃ mālyādikaṃ tathā || yavagodhūmacaṇakamāṣasaktūnsagorasān || || 108 || kulmāṣaghṛtasaṃyuktānbaliṃ dadyāttu vāyave || bhakṣyāṃśca madhusaṃyuktānmudgamiśrāṃstathāmiṣam || 109 || citraṃ mālyaṃ kuṃkumaṃ ca kuberāya haredbalim || śimbidhānyabhavānbhakṣyāñśālyannaṃ saguḍaṃ dadhi ||2.104.110|| īśānāya baliṃ dadyācchuklamālyānulepanaiḥ || śuklaudanaṃ śuklamālyaṃ śūlāyopaharedbalim ||111|| tathā pañcarasaiḥ siddhaṃ dadyādvijñāya buddhimān || kṛsaraṃ gandhapuṣpāḍhyaṃ dadyācchakrāya pāyasam||112|| phalodanaṃ raktamālyaṃ dadyācchaktyai tathā balim || snānamaṇḍalakebhyo'pi baliṃ dadyāttato
