balim||113|| bālakrīḍanakānbhakṣyānphalāni vividhāni ca || matsyāmiṣaṃ sarudhiraṃ pāyasaṃ tilataṇḍulam || 114 || sakṛdantrāṇi hṛdayaṃ bhūtebhyo balimāharet || oṃkārādyaiścaturthyantaiḥ svāhākārasamanvitaiḥ ||115|| rājyābhiṣekamantroktadevatānāṃ pṛthakpṛthak || nāmabhirjuhuyādvahnau yathāśraddhaṃ yathāghṛtam || 116|| pūrṇāhutiṃ tato dattvā deyā vipreṣu dakṣiṇā || kanakaṃ rajataṃ gāvo vāsāṃsi vividhāni ca || 117 || kartre ca dakṣiṇā deyā tathā rāma viśeṣataḥ || dattaṃ vastrādi devebhyastathā stānaghaṭādikam || 118 || kartā yatheṣṭaṃ vibhajettasya bhāgo hi sa smṛtaḥ || ghṛte'tha vadanaṃ dṛṣṭvā namaskṛtya ca devatāḥ ||119 || maṅgalyālambhanaṃ kṛtvā phalapāṇirudaṅmukhaḥ || tasmāddeśādvinirgatya gṛhaṃ yāyāttataḥ svakam || 2.104.120 || tatra tiṣṭheddhaviṣyāśī brahmacārī ca tāṃ niśām || snāpito brahmapūtena snānenāyaṃ yathā bhavet || 121 || sarvānkāmānavāpnoti svargalokaṃ ca gacchati || purā devāsure yuddhe śakrāyaitadbṛhaspatiḥ || 122|| kṛtavānpuruhūtāya tataḥ śakraḥ surādhipaḥ || jaghāna daityamukhyānāṃ navatīrnava bhārgava || 123|| dhanyaṃ yaśasyaṃ ripunāśakāri rakṣohaṇaṃ pāpaharaṃ pavitram || rogāpahaṃ vighnavināśakāri snānaṃ mayā te vihitaṃ yathārtham||124|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṃḍe mā0saṃ0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne dikpālasnānavarṇanannāma caturuttara śatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 104 || <2.105> rāma uvāca || snānamanyatsamācakṣva bhagavanduritāpaham || vināyakopasṛṣṭānāṃ sarvakarmaprasādhakam || 1 || puṣkara uvāca || vināyakaḥ karmavighnasidhyarthaṃ viniyojitaḥ || gaṇānāmadhipatye ca keśavena pitāmahaiḥ || 2 || tenopasṛṣṭo yastasya lakṣaṇāni nibodha me || svapne'vagāhate'tyarthaṃ jalaṃ muṇḍaṃ ca paśyati || 3 || kāṣāyavāsasaścaiva kravyādāṃścādhirohati || antyajairgardabhairuṣṭraiḥ sahaikatrāvatiṣṭhate || 4 || vrajamānastathātmānaṃ manyate'nugataṃ paraiḥ || vimanā viphalārambhaḥ saṃsīdannanimittataḥ || 5 || tenopasṛṣṭo labhate na rājyaṃ rājanandanaḥ || yā kumārī ca bhartāramapatyaṃ garbhamaṅganā || 6 || ācāryatvaṃ śrotriyaśca na śiṣyo'dhyayanaṃ tathā || vaṇiṅ na lābhamāpnoti na kṛṣiṃ tu kṛṣīvalaḥ || 7|| snapanaṃ tasya kartavyaṃ puṇyehni vidhipūrvakam || hastapuṣyāśvayuksaumyavaiṣṇavānyatame śubhe || 8|| nakṣatre ca muhūrte ca maitre vā brahmadaivate || carmaṇyānuḍuhe rakte sthāpyaṃ bhadrāsanaṃ bhavet || 9 || bhadrāsanopaviṣṭasya svasti vācyaṃ dvijottamān || gaurasarṣapakalkena medhyenotsāditasya ca || 2.105.10 || sarvauṣadhaiḥ sarvagandhaiḥ praliptaśirasastathā || caturbhiḥ kalaśaiḥ kāryaṃ snapanaṃ mantrasaṃyutam ||11 || tathaikavarṇāḥ kalaśāḥ kartavyāste hradāmbhasā || aśvasthānādgajasthānādvalmīkātsaṅgamāddhṛdāt || 12 || mṛttikāṃ rocanaṃ gandhānguggulaṃ teṣu nikṣipet || sarvauṣadhīśca bījāni snānamantrānataḥ śṛṇu || 13 || sahasrākṣaṃ śatadhāramṛṣibhiḥ pāvanaṃ kṛtam || tena tvāmabhiṣiñcāmaḥ pāvamānīḥ punantu te || 14 || bhagaṃ te varuṇo rājā bhagaṃ śukro bṛhaspatiḥ || bhagamindraśca vāyuśca bhagaṃ saptarṣayo daduḥ || 15 || yatte keśeṣu daurbhāgyaṃ sīmante yacca mūrdhani || lalāṭakarṇayorakṣṇorāpastaddhantu te sadā || 16 || darbhapiñjalamādāya vāmahaste tato guruḥ || snātasya sārṣapaṃ tailaṃ suveṇaudumbareṇa tu || 17 || juhuyānmūrdhni dharmajña caturthyantaiśca nāmabhiḥ || oṃkārapūtairdharmajña svāhākārasamanvitaiḥ || 18 || mitāya saṃmitāyātha sālaṅkaṭakaṭāya ca || kūṣmāṇḍarājaputrāya tathaiva ca mahātmane || 19 || nāmabhirbalimantraiśca vaṣaṭkārasamanvitaiḥ|| dadyāccatuṣpathe śīrṣe kuśānāstīrya sarvataḥ ||2.105.20|| | kṛtaraktāṃstaṇḍulāṃśca palalaudanameva ca || matsyānpakvāṃstathaivāmānmāṃsametāvadeva tu || 21 || puṣpaṃ citraṃ sugandhaṃ tu surāṃ ca trividhāmapi || mūlakaṃ pūrikāpūpāstathaivaiṇḍaryakāṇi ca || 22|| etānsarvānupāhṛtya bhūmau kṛtvā tataḥ śiraḥ|| vināyakasya jananīmupatiṣṭhettato'mbikām||23|| rūpaṃ dehi yaśo dehi saubhāgyaṃ subhage mama|| putrāndehi dhanaṃ dehi sarvānkāmāṃśca dehi me||24|| tataḥ śuklāmbaradharaḥ śuklamālyānulepanaḥ|| bhojayedbrāhmaṇāndadyādvastrayugmaṃ gurorapi || 25 || vināyakasnānamidaṃ yaśasyaṃ rakṣohaṇaṃ vighnavināśakāri|| sarvāmayaghnaṃ ripunāśakaṃ ca kartavyametanniyamena rāma||26|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0 saṃ0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne vināyakasnānavarṇanannāma pañcottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 105 || <2.106> puṣkara uvāca || snānamanyatpravakṣyāmi tavāhaṃ duritāpaham || dānavendrāya bhuvane yajjagādośanāḥ purā || 1 || dhanyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ sarvaśatrukṣayaṃkaram || prabhātāyāṃ tu śarvaryāṃ bhāskare'nudite tathā || 2|| snāyīta bhārgavaśreṣṭha vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā || sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ kumbhamathavāpi mahīmayam || 3 || nādeyaiḥ sāgaraistoyaiḥ kalpayitvā yathāvidhiḥ || oṣadhīrvinyasettatra samabhāgāḥ sucūrṇitāḥ || 4 || jayā ca vijayā caiva tathā sūkṣmaphalāni ca || prasannamukhabījāni bhāṇḍīrakusumāni ca || 9 || kṣīrajāpatranirmālyaṃ devīnissārameva ca || kallīvarāṅganā caiva gajendrasya ca mañjarī || 6 || kṣudrajaṃ karajaṃ caiva dhane dvedve vibhāvarī || mahaughaṃ pūrtagaṃ caiva bhuvaṃ yakṣabhuvaṃ tathā || 7 || śaśāṅkamṛgadarpaṃ ca dānaṃ ca kariṇastathā || oṣadhyaḥ kathitāstubhyaṃ dāne mantramataḥ śṛṇu || 8|| oṃnamo bhagavate rudrāya dhavalapāṇḍuropacitabhasmānuliptagātrāya || tadyathā || jaya jaya vijayavijaya sarvāñchatrūnamukasya kalahavigrahavivādeṣu bhañjabhañja mathamatha sarvatra pratyakṣikāṃ yo'sau yugāntakāle dadhyakṣatairimāṃ pūjāṃ raudrī mūrtisahastāṃ susattvāṃ rakṣatu jīvikāṃ saṃvartakāgnitulyaśca tripurārtikaraḥ yaḥ sarvadevamayaḥ so'pi tava rakṣatu jīvitaṃ nikhi nikhi nikhi svāhā || evaṃ snātastvanenaiva gātreṇa tilataṇḍulam || ghṛtāktaṃ jvalite vahnau juhuyātprayataḥ sadā ||9 ||| tataḥ sampūjanaṃ kuryāddevadevasya śūlinaḥ || ghṛtakṣīrābhiṣekeṇa gandhapuṣpaphalākṣataiḥ || 2.106.10 ||| dīpadhūpanamaskāraistathā vānnena bhūriṇā || gītavādyaiḥ sumadhurairbrāhmaṇānsvastivācanaiḥ || 11 || māheśvarasnānamidaṃ hi kṛtvā rakṣohaṇaṃ śatrunibarhaṇaṃ ca || kāmānavāpnoti narastu sarvānyānrāma kāṃścinmanasecchatīti || 12 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0 saṃ0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne māheśvarasnānavarṇanannāma ṣaḍuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 106 ||| <2.107> puṣkara uvāca || snānānyanyāni te vacmi nibodha gadato mama || rakṣoghnāni yaśasyāni maṅgalyāni viśeṣataḥ || 1 || snānaṃ ghṛtena kathitaṃ cāyuṣo vardhanaṃ param || rāma gośakṛtā snānaṃ paraṃ lakṣmīvivardhanam || 2 || snānaṃ ca kathitaṃ dadhnā paraṃ lakṣmīvivardhanam|| tathā darbhodakasnānaṃ sarvapāpanibarhaṇam || 3|| palāśabilva kamalakuśasnānaṃ puro hitam || vacā haridrā mañjiṣṭhā tagaraṃ cārakaṃ tathā || 4|| snānametadvinirdiṣṭaṃ rakṣoghnaṃ pāpasūdanam || vacāharidrayā yuktaṃ snānaṃ rakṣohaṇaṃ param || 5 || āyuṣyaṃ ca yaśasyaṃ ca dhanyaṃ medhāvivardhanam || snānaṃ pavitraṃ maṅgalyaṃ tathā kāñcanavāriṇā || 6 ||| kramādūnatare kiñcidrūpyatāmrodakaistataḥ || tathā ratnodakasnānaṃ saṅgrāmavijayāvaham || 7 || vaiḍūryaṃ madhyataḥ kṛtvā pravālaiḥ parivārayet || tena pātreṇa yatsnānaṃ sarvakāmakaraṃ hitam || 8 || snānaṃ sarvauṣadhairmukhyaṃ vivāde vijayapradam || sarvagandhodakasnānaṃ saubhāgyārogyakārakam || 9 || tathā bījodakasnānaṃ sarvakarmaprasādhakam || tathaivāmalakasnānamalakṣmīnāśanaṃ param || 2.107.10 || tilasiddhārthakaiḥ snānamamaṅgalyapraṇāśanam || kevalairvā tilaiḥ snānamathavā gaurasarṣapaiḥ || 11 || snānaṃ priyaṅgunā proktaṃ tathā saubhāgyavardhanam || saubhāgyakaṃ tathā snānaṃ nāgakāntāpriyaṅgubhiḥ || 12 || purocārukakuṣṭhaiśca tathaiva ca vinirdiśet || dhātrīphalena padmaiśca tathāmalakavāriṇā || 13 || lakṣmīvṛddhikaraṃ snānaṃ kathitaṃ bhārgavottama || padmotpalakadambaiśca tathā lakṣmīvivardhanam || 14 || balāmatibalāṃ caiva tathā nāgabalāmapi || balāṃ moṭāṃ caturthī tu snānaṃ vai balavardhanam || 15 || brahmākarkoṭakīmūlaṃ kumārī padmacāriṇī || snāne rogavināśāya smṛtāḥ pratyekaśo dvija || 16 || māṃsīmurācorakanāgapuṣpaiḥ sanāgadānairatināśakāri || turuṣkakakkolakajātipūgaiḥ phalaiḥ samastaiḥ sutarāṃ pradadyāt || 17 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0saṃ0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne nānāvidhasnānavarṇanannāma saptottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 107|| <2.108> rāma uvāca || snānānāmiha sarveṣāṃ yatsnānamatiricyate || tanmamācakṣva sakalaṃ sarvakalmaṣanāśanam ||1|| puṣkara uvāca || śṛṇu pādodakasnānaṃ sarvakilbiṣanāśanam || śravaṇarkṣaṃ vinā hyetadbhavatyardhaphalaṃ yataḥ || 2 || tataḥ kāryaṃ prayatnena śravaṇarkṣe viśeṣataḥ || athottarāsu ṣāḍhāsu nirāhāro jitendriyaḥ || 3 || sarvauṣadhaiḥ sarvagandhairdevadevasya cakriṇaḥ || pādaṃ pralepayedvidvānkrameṇa caturātmanaḥ || 4 || tatastu kalaśānkuryāccaturaḥ sudṛḍhānnavān || sauvarṇānrājatāntāmrānatha vāpi mahīmayān|| 5 || tato'niruddhacaraṇau kṛpādbhiḥ kṣālayettataḥ || tābhistu kalaśaṃ pūrṇaṃ sthāpanīyaṃ tadagrataḥ || 6 || tataḥ pradyumnacaraṇau kṣālyau prasravaṇodakaiḥ || kalaśaṃ pūritaṃ tacca bhavetsthāpyaṃ tadagrataḥ |7 || saṃkarṣaṇasya caraṇau kṣālyau toyaiśca sārasaiḥ || taistu saṃpūrṇakalaśaṃ sthāpyaṃ tasyāgrato bhavet || 8 || vāsudevasya caraṇau nādeyaiḥ kṣālayedbudhaḥ || kalaśaṃ pūritaṃ taiśca sthāpanīyaṃ tadagrataḥ || 9 || tataḥ pūjā tu kartavyā yathāvaccaturātmanaḥ || kalaśānpūjayettāṃśca gandhamālyaphalākṣataiḥ || 2.108.10 || tataḥ prāpte dvitīye'hni snātaḥ pūrvamupoṣitaḥ || sammukhaścāniruddhasya snāpyaśca kaṭuko bhavet || 11 || pradyumnasya ca devasya tataḥ saṃkarṣaṇasya ca || tataśca vāsudevasya yathā rāmasya cakriṇaḥ || 12 || pavitramantraiḥ sarveṣāṃ ghaṇṭānāmabhimantraṇam|| kartavyaṃ sāttvatenātha śucinā bhārgavottama ||13|| atha mantrānpravakṣyāmi kalaśeṣu caturṣu te|| maṅgalyāṃśca yaśaśyāṃścā sarvāghaviniṣūdanān || 14 || aruddhamārgāḥ sarvatra sarvaśaścāparājitāḥ || vāyumūrtiracintyātmā so'niruddhaḥ svayaṃ prabhuḥ || 15 || pādodakena divyena śivenāghavināśinā || tathāghamapahṛtyāśu śivaṃ vardhayatāṃ prabhuḥ || 16 || lokānpradyotayati yaḥ prayumno bhāskaraprabhaḥ || hutāśanaḥ sa tejasvī maṅgalaṃ vidadhātu me || |17 || kāmadevo jagadyoniḥ sarvaśaḥ prabhurīśvaraḥ || duḥkhahartā jagannātho maṅgalāni dadātu te || 18 || jagatāṃ karṣaṇāddevo yaḥ sa saṅkarṣaṇaḥ prabhuḥ || rudramūrtiracintyātmā sarvagaḥ sarvahārakaḥ || 19 || kāmapālo'ridamanaḥ sarvabhūtasya śaṅkaraḥ|| viśvayonirmahātejā maṅgalāni dadātu te || 2.108.20 || sarvāvāso vāsudevo bhūtātmā bhūtabhāvanaḥ || sarvagaścāprameyaśca puruṣaḥ parameśvaraḥ || 21 || anantaḥ sarvadeveśo jagadādhārakāraṇaḥ || aghāpahārī varado vidadhātu śriyaṃ tava || 22 || evaṃ snātastatastyaktvā tatraiva snānavāsasī || śuklavāsā upaspṛśya pūjāṃ kuryātkrameṇa tu || 23 || gandhaiḥ puṣpaiḥ phalairmukhyairdīpairdhūpaiḥ sugandhibhiḥ || naivedyairvividhaiścaiva sāttvatānāṃ ca pūjanaiḥ ||24|| evaṃ devārcanaṃ kṛtvā sāttvatāṃ śāntidaṃ śubham || bhojanaṃ gorasaprāyaṃ kṛtvā tiṣṭhetsuyantritam || 26 || prādurbhāvāṇi mukhyāni śṛṇuyātkeśavasya ca || pākhaṇḍipatitānāṃ ca varjayeddarśanaṃ tathā || 26 || iti pādodakasnānaṃ proktaṃ rakṣohaṇaṃ tava || maṅgalyaṃ pāpaśamanamalakṣmīnāśanaṃ param || 27 || sarvavighnapraśamanaṃ sarvabādhāvināśanam || duḥsvapnāriṣṭaśamanaṃ sarvavyādhiharaṃ śivam || 28 || yātrāsiddhikaraṃ dhanyaṃ karmaṇāṃ siddhikārakam || śatrughnaṃ buddhidaṃ medhyaṃ balāyuḥsmṛtivardhanam || saubhāgyadaṃ kāmaparaṃ yaśaḥputravivardhanam || 29 || amoghavīryaṃ puruṣottamasya pādodakasnānamidaṃ pradiṣṭam || snānottaraṃ te raṇacaṇḍavega bhūyastu te kiṃ kathayāmi rāma || 2.108.30 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0saṃ0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne puruṣottamapādodakasnānavarṇanannāmāṣṭottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 108 || <2.109> rāma uvāca || maṇīnāmatha kāmyānāṃ śrotumicchāmyahaṃ vidhim || sarvakāmakaraṃ mukhyaṃ tathā ca duritāpaham || 1 || puṣkara uvāca || ātharvaṇena vidhinā maṇikarma nibodha me || dhruvastiṣṭhetyṛcā vṛkṣaṃ pratyakṣamanumantrayet || 2 || pādonayā maṇisthānaṃ prokṣayettu dvitīyayā || asyāḥ pādenottareṇa nirmimīta maṇiṃ tataḥ || 3 || sabandhuśceti tamṛcā tasmācchindyāditi śrutiḥ || āhareta maṇiṃ tasmātsūktādasmāttṛtīyayā || 4 || sarvatra tu maṇīnāṃ ca nirmāṇaṃ kevalaṃ bhavet || upayuktāstu kevākṣā dravyāste parikīrtitāḥ ||5|| aṅguṣṭhaparvamātrāste kartavyāstu samantataḥ || samyagutpādayetteṣāṃ samyaggranthicatuṣṭayam || 6 || agrato mūlato vāpi kalpamāne'tiricyate || arātīyorityanayā chindyācchastreṇa tattvavit || 7 || arthaṃ ca suśiraḥ kṛtvā tataḥ prakṣālya vāriṇā || pātraṃ tamagnau kṛtvā tu samyageva yathāvidhi || 8 || yatrācakrurityanayā sasūtramata uttaram || kuryāttadagnikuṇḍaṃ ca prabodhya juhuyād ghṛtam || 9 || pratyṛcā svena mantreṇa sampātānayanaṃ bhavet || kṛtaśāntyudake pātre ramye lohamaye dṛḍhe || 2.109.10 || svaliṅgoddhṛmantreṇa darvidaṇḍādataḥ param || vimucya sarvaṃ tenaiva mantreṇa bhrāmayenmaṇim || 11 || pātre tasmiṃstatastasmāduddhṛtyā bandhanaṃ bhavet || sakalenaiva mantreṇa mantrayecca tathodgatam || 12 || sāmānyamidamuktaṃ te śṛṇu vaiśeṣikaṃ dvija || abhīvartamaṇau karma tava vakṣyāmyataḥ param || 13 || abhīvarttena maṇinetyādyābhistisṛbhirmaṇau || atrāyaṃ vāsavaṃ pātraṃ dvebhyaśca pratyṛcaṃ punaḥ 14 || dattvā sarveṇa sūktena maṇerādhanvanaṃ bhavet || abhīvartamaṇiḥ prokto no vā kāṣṭhānbhṛgūttama || 15 || ayaṃ yonirata iti tasya homo vidhīyate || śaśakeṣviha ye śrāntavatsabhaiṣajyabhājanama || 16 || kṣudreṣu yadapāmārgaṃ maṇiḥ śāntavisaṃjñakaḥ || ityete yāvaduktāḥ syurvivāhamadhurāśca ye || 17 || pūrvoktena bhaveddharma eteṣāmiti me matiḥ || dravyauṣadhimaṇīnāṃ ca sabhāryāṇāṃ tathaiva ca || 18 || dākṣāyaṇamaṇīnāṃ ca bhaveddhomādhiko vidhiḥ || oṣadhīnāmihedānīṃ vidhānaṃ śṛṇu bhārgava || 19 || vrīhīṇāṃ vā yavānāṃ vā mūle tu paritaḥ kiret || yadi saumya sumantreṇa phalakānyekaviṃśatiḥ || 2.109.20 || amuṣminsthānarūḍhāsu yathābhilaṣitāṃ budhaḥ || yojayennāma sambhūtāmamukasya vibhūtaye || 21 || ghṛtāhuteti ca dvābhyāṃ ghṛtena prokṣayettataḥ || mā te riṣasītyanayā hyā tvā tamabhimantrayet || 22 || gandhaṃ saṃchādayeccaiva tato bhūmetyanantaram || ityauṣadhīnāṃ sarvāsāṃ sāmānyo'yaṃ vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ || 23 || ekakādyāstu maṇayaḥ saliṅgaṃ nikhanedbudhaḥ || mantreṇa tānpravakṣyāmi yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ || 24 || ekāṅka ekakāmāyetyekāṃke vidhivatkhanet || ākrandayati sūktena pradadhnāṃ yadyathāvidhi || 25 || iyaṃ vīrudityanayā vidhivanmadhughaḥ khanet || sūktena sukalenāsya maṇerābandhanaṃ bhavet || 26 || imāṃ khanāmītyanayā nitanīliṅgayā khanim || pratīcī saumamasitāṃ badhnīyāttu yathāvidhi || 27 || yātvā gandharva indrābhyāṃ kapikacchuṃ khanedvadhaḥ || sūktenānena tanmeḍhre prabadhnīyāditi sthitaḥ || 28 || imāṃ khanāmītyanayā daśadhāsrutayā khanet || pāṭhāsūktena badhnīyādekā rājñīmiti śrutiḥ || 29 || daśaśīrṣa iti dvābhyāṃ mahākhyaṃ vidhivatkhanet || āpaḥ punantvityanena badhnīyāttāṃ yathāvidhi || 2.109.30 || imāṃ khanāmyauṣadhīṃ tvāṃ ḍhabīṃ nāma tathotkhanet || kāṇḍīyāṛktayā tvete badhnīyāttu yathāvidhi || 31 || ya ātmajā ityanayā khanyāditi tathaiva tām || anenaiva prabadhnīyādvidvānsūktena taṃ maṇim || 32 || ariṣṭastvā khanatu vai pippalaṃ tu khanettathā || yāvaddyauriti sūktena tasya cābandhanaṃ bhavet || 33 || sāhasīnāvacetyevaṃ saidhakaṃ ca tathā khanet || anevaiva prabadhnīyātsūtreṇa tu yathāvidhi || 34 || payo'sītyathavā hanyātsvargapatrīṃ yathāvidhi || sūktena tāṃ prabadhnīyādanenaiva yathākramam || 35 || imāṃ khanāmītyanayā māṣaparṇīṃ tathā khanet || dvābhyāṃ cānarthasaktatvaprabadhnīyāditi śrutiḥ ||36|| tataḥ khaṇḍārikāṃ khanyādrājā tvāṃ varuṇaḥ khanet|| ṛcānayā samastena sūktenābandhanaṃ bhavet ||37|| ekārkaprabhṛtīnāṃ tu liṅgaḥ kalpyaṃ phalaṃ budhaiḥ || sāmīyātvāha varuṇetyevamādiṣu saṃśritāḥ || 38 || sāmīdayaḥ padārthāste upaklṛptāstathā smṛtāḥ || dravyaistaistu maṇiṃ kuryādāmnāyoktairyathāvidhi || 39 || talliṅgena tu mantreṇa yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ || kuṣṭhasya maṇayaḥ pañca udapātre vidurbudhāḥ || 2.109.40 || pratyaikapāṭhasaṃskāra śuddhaye veti naḥ śrutam || caturasraṃ prabadhnīyānmaṇimañjanavattathā || 41 || saindhavaṃ lavaṇaṃ siddhamubhayatra parigrahāt || kuryādvākṣyaṃ ca saṃskāraṃ vyāghratyapamaṇau tathā||42 || caturasrau tu kartavyau maṇī kāraṇakālajau || naimittikāśca maṇayo maṇayaḥ saṃviduśca ye || 43 || svaṃsvaṃ mantraṃ bhavetteṣāmiti me niścitā matiḥ || naimittikānāṃ ghorāste teṣāṃ naimittikaṃ bhavet || 44 || sampadānāṃ tathā madhye sāmpadaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || sīmātryātvāhetyanena sīmasaṃ janavadbhavet || 45 || piśācaśātanaḥ puṃsāṃ yātudhānavināśanaḥ || mantraliṅgādayaṃ jñeyo mantraścāsya pravakṣyate || 46 || śarakāṣṭhe tu saṃyojya sīsaṃ kṛtveti buddhimān || bhārṅgīṃ jyāṃ dhanuṣaḥ kṛtvā bādhakenātha tena tata || 47 || bhūmau piśācamālikhya bhagavena tu tāḍayet || uttareṇa śareṇaiva piśāco nāśamāpnuyāt || 48 || śaṃkudhāramaṇermantra anusūryamiti smṛtiḥ || prajñātavarṇaśābdāśca rohitasya parigrahaḥ || 49 || carmaṇaḥ syāttathā vargo rohitāsābhavecca gāḥ || śaṃkurnidhīyate yatra vistarārthaṃ tu carmaṇaḥ || 2.109.50 || tasmāddeśānmaṇiḥ kāryaḥ śaṃkurdhanaparigrahaḥ || maṇidhanaṃ ca dugdhaṃ syādupaviṣṭāya carmaṇi || 51 || yajamānāya dharmajña udapātraṃ tathāmayā || atikāmala rogaghnamāyuṣyaśca tathā maṇiḥ || 52 || imaṃ me kuṣṭhetyanena pañcānāṃ syātparigrahaḥ || atyarthameva naiteṣāṃ jalaṃ kuṣṭhena saṃyutam || 53 || satkṛtya pānayogatvādyajamānaḥ pibettataḥ | maṇayaḥ pañcakuṣṭhe dvau maṇiśabdaparigraham || 54 || tulyena vidhinā kāryāḥ phalaṃ teṣāṃ pṛthakpṛthak || śirortināśanaḥ pūrvo dvitīyo viṣadūṣakaḥ || 59 || tṛtīyaśca tathā prokto viṣamajvaranāśanaḥ || caturthaśca tathā proktaḥ satatajvaranāśanaḥ || 56 || cakṣuṣyaḥ pañcamaḥ prokto maṇirbhārgavanandana || kṛtvodapātraṃ kuṣṭhāmbho navanītavimiśritam || 57 || bhūyaḥ kuṣṭhaṃ kṣipettatra maṇiṃ tatrāvatārayet || maṇibandhaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā toyaṃ tatpāyayennaram || 58 || lipyecca sarujaṃ deśamudapātrajalena tu || yāḥ purastādityanena maṇiḥ syāllavaṇasya tu || 59 || piturvastrapuṭe baddhvā lavaṇasya tu tanmaṇim || ābandhe kuṣṭhavatsyācca yātudhānavināśanaḥ || 2.109.60 || vyāghrarūpa ityanena khaṃtavyaṃ vāṭarūṣakam || vyāghrarūpa iti dvābhyāmṛgbhyāmābandhanaṃ bhavet || 61 || piśācanāśakastvevaṃ sa maṇiḥ syādasaṃśayam || evamevottarābhyāṃ ca bhavepratyabhicārakaḥ || || 62 || viṣkandasyetyanenāha triparṇī viśvabheṣajī || skandasyopari yaḥ skando bhavettasya vināśinī || 63 || yasmādaṅgāditi bhavedgaṇāditvātparigrahaḥ || gaṇasya karma sāmānyaṃ pratisūktaṃ na kārayeta || 64 || gorācavāri karmāṇi hantavyānīvamādibhiḥ || pataṅgādyāśca catvāraḥ saṃskṛtya prāṇino budhaḥ || 65 || tṛṣṇatvaptaiśca mantreṇa gātraṃ prakṣālayetkhilam || prathamena tu sūktena veṇupautre dravo maṇiḥ || 66 || veṇuḥ kuryādbhaveddharmo vākṣavaddevadāruṇaḥ || saṃskṛtya pūrvamantreṇa māṣakādīnpramardayet || 67 || gātrasaṃskārasahitaiḥ piṣṭairvā prakṛtirbhṛśam || kevalenaiva mantreṇa mardayettu vinaśyati || 68 || tathā svalomaprabhṛtī vidhūlo dhūśiro yutiḥ || devapraveśaṃ jatunā sthagayitvā tu raktikā || 69 || dūṣyā iti pratīkena kuryātpratisaraṃ maṇim|| kṛtvā dūṣaṇamāyuṣyaṃ tadā pratyabhivādakaḥ||2.109.70|| ayaṃ pratisaraḥ pāṇau yātrākāle sapatnahā || sūtreṇānena badhnīyālliṅgātpratisaro paraḥ||71|| anena vidhinā vṛtraṃ nijaghāna śatakratuḥ || aśaṃsa iti mantreṇa prabadhnīyādyathāvidhi||72|| bhūtiśrīprabhṛtīnāṃ ca vighnamevaṃ karoti yaḥ || vināśanaṃ tasya bhavedābandhādyakṣanāśanam||73|| jyāsūtraprothitāḥ sapta vaṃśaprāptāḥ samudbhavāḥ || rattayāntaravyavahitā garbhiṇyā uddhared budhaḥ || 74|| māse caturthe badhnīyānmantreṇānena buddhimān || ekaikasminnatīte tu māse sūtrāntare maṇiḥ || 75|| ekaikaṃ prakṣipeddhīmānsasūtraṃ paścimaṃ tathā || prācī digiti mantreṇa udīcī bhayanāśanī ||76 || akṣīyābhyāmityanena dāpyaḥ syādyakṣmanāśanaḥ || sandhānārthaṃ śītamagne rātrīmāteta mohanaḥ || mayūragosuravṛddhau dvau vetīti prakīrtitam ||77|| proktāstathaite maṇayo nṛvīra kāmyā mayā sarvahitāya puṇyāḥ || yeṣāṃ hi bandho duritāpahārī bhayāpahaḥ kevalavṛddhikārī ||78|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0saṃ0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne maṇibandhavarṇanannāma navottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || || 109|| <2.110> rāma uvāca || bhagavañchrotumicchāmi karma kāmyamahaṃ nṛṇām || kṛtena yena kāmānāṃ naro bhavati bhājanam || 1|| puṣkara uvāca || sarveṣāmeva kāmānāmīśvaro bhagavānhariḥ || tasya sampūjanādeva sarvānkāmānupāśnute || 2 || snāpayitvā ghṛtakṣīraiścandanenānulepayet || śuklaiḥ sampūjya puṣpaiśca saptamasya baliṃ haret || 3 || raktapittānnaro ghorānmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || tailakṣaudraghṛtairdevaṃ snāpayitvā janārdanam || 4 || bhasmatrayeṇānulipya sampūjya kusumaiḥ sitaiḥ || pañcamudgabaliṃ dadyādatīsārātpramucyate || 5 || saṃsnāpya pañcagavyena dattvā pañcānulepanam || pañcasasyabaliṃ dattvā sukhaṃ kuṣṭhātpramucyate || 6 || trirasasnāpitaṃ devaṃ trisugandhena lepitam || kṛtvā dattvā trisūtraṃ ca baliṃ kāmādvimucyate || 7 || snāpayitvā tu tailena tribhiruṣṇairvilepayet || pañcamāṣabaliṃ dattvā vātavyādhiṃ vimuñcati || 8 || dvisnehasnapitaṃ devaṃ śītoṣṇenānulepitam || pañcabhiḥ snāpayitvā ca rasairdevaṃ janārdanam || 9 || anulipya ca dharmajña tathā pañcasugandhinā || pañcavarṇāni puṣpāṇi tathā dattvā yathāvidhi || 2.110.10 || dhūpaṃ ca pañcaniryāsaṃ dattvā caivāpyanuttaram || tataśca pañcamadhuraṃ baliṃ samyaṅ nivedayet || 11 || anena rogataḥ śīghraṃ mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || viṣṇuṃ sahasramūrdhānaṃ carācaraguruṃ harim || 12 || stuvannāmasahasreṇa jvarānsarvānvyapohati || ghṛtena snāpitaṃ devaṃ candanenānulepayet || 13 || pañcabhirjalajaiḥ puṣpaistataḥ sampūjayedvibhum || dhūpaṃ dadyāttrivāraṃ ca pañcagavyaṃ tathā balim || || 14 || pañcagauḍaṃ tathā rāma baddho mucyeta bandhanāt || triśītasnāpitaṃ devaṃ triśītenānulepayet || 15 || triśītaiḥ kusumaiḥ pūjyaṃ dhūpaṃ dadyāttriśītalam || triśītaṃ ca baliṃ dattvā rājakopādvimucyate 16 || śītoṣṇasnāpitaṃ devaṃ triśītairanulepayet || dhūpaṃ dattvā ca śītoṣṇaṃ śītoṣṇaṃ ca tathā balim || 17 || guruprasādamāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || yamalasnāpitaṃ devaṃ yamalenānulepitam || 18 || abhyarcya yamalaiḥ puṣpairdhūpaṃ ca yamalaṃ dahet || yamalaṃ ca baliṃ dattvā saubhāgyaṃ prāpnuyānnaraḥ || 19 || saubhāgyakāmā nārī ca saubhāgyaṃ mahadāpnuyāt || saubhāgyakāmo'pi naraḥ saubhāgyaṃ mahadaśnute || 2.110.20 || tribhiḥ saṃsnāpitaṃ devaṃ saubhāgyaṃ mahadāpnuyāt || tribhiḥ phalaiḥ snāpayitvā trisāreṇānulepayet ||21|| triśītaṃ ca baliṃ dadyādyaśaḥ prāpnotyanuttamam || tritailasnāpitaṃ devaṃ triraktenānulepitam ||22|| dhūpayenmahiṣākṣeṇa triraktaṃ ca baliṃ haret || raudrakarma tu prāpnoti siddhirasti na saṃśayaḥ||23|| trigandhasnāpitaṃ devaṃ triśītenānulepitam || pūjayecchvetapadmānāṃ sahasreṇa mahābhujam|| || 24|| nivedya paramānnaṃ ca śriyaṃ prāpnotyanuttamām || ghṛtena snāpitaṃ devaṃ candanenānulepitam||25|| paramānnaṃ baliṃ dattvā yatheṣṭaṃ kāmamāpnuyāt || ghṛtena snāpitaṃ devaṃ candanenānulepitam ||26|| apūpaiḥ paramānnena kulmāṣeṇa ca pūjayet || āmrātakānāṃ mukhyānāṃ tatastvaṣṭādhikaṃ śatam || 27 || kṣaudrantrivṛttaṃ devāya yathāvadvinivedayet || saubhāgyaṃ mahadāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 28 || pañcagavyabaliṃ dattvā dhanamāpnotyanuttamam || triraktasnāpitaṃ devaṃ triraktenānulepitam ||29|| raktapuṣpaiḥ samabhyarcya tribhireva yathāvidhi || triraktaṃ ca baliṃ dattvā hutvā vai sarṣapatrayam || 2.110.30 || trilohaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā śatrunāśamavāpnuyāt|| triphalasnāpitaṃ devaṃ triraktenānulepitam||531 || triśītaṃ ca baliṃ dattvā punnāmakusumāni ca || punnāmakāni mukhyāni phalāni vividhāni ca||32|| putrajanma samāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || ghṛtena snāpitaṃ devaṃ triraktenānulepitam||33|| kṛtvā tadeva dhūpaṃ tu dattvā kṣīraṃ nivedayet || ghṛtapūraṃ baliṃ dattvā naraḥ prāpnoti jīvikām || 34 || kṣīrājyasnāpitaṃ devaṃ candanenānulepitam || tadeva dhūpaṃ dātavyaṃ jātīpuṣpāṇi cāpyatha || 35 || pañcagavyabaliṃ dattvā hutvā vahnau tathā ghṛtam || gāṃ ca dattvā mahābhāga gāḥ samāpnoti mānavaḥ || 36 || yamalasnāpitaṃ devaṃ yamalenānulepitama || abhyarcya yamalaiḥ puṣpairdhūpaṃ ca yamalaṃ dahet || 37 || yamalaṃ ca baliṃ dattvā juhuyādakṣatāṃstathā || tilasiddhārthakayutānsarpiḥ kṣīraṃ ghṛtaṃ tathā || 38 || aśvaṃ ca dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā hayānprāpnotyanuttamān || ghṛtena snāpitaṃ devaṃ tathaiva ghṛtalepitam || 39 || puṣpaiścaturbhiḥ sampūjya dhūpaṃ dattvā catuḥsamam || triśukaṃ ca tathā dattvā tathaiva pānakatrayam || 2.110.40 || triśukaṃ ca tathā hutvā trisnehena samanvitam || trilohaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā gāṇapatyamavāpnuyāt || 41 || madhuratritayenātha snāpayitvā janārdanam || anulimpettriśītena pūjayeccamakaistathā || 42 || dhūpaṃ dahettriśītena dadyāttrimadhuraṃ balim || madhūkapuṣpāṇi tathā drākṣāṃ kharjūrameva ca || 43 || sarvabhūtaiḥ sahāpnopi sakhyameva na saṃśayaḥ || ghṛtena snāpitaṃ devaṃ vacayā niśayā tathā || 44|| candanenānulimpettu jātīpuṣpairathārcayet || ghṛtakṣaudrayutaṃ dattvā tathā dhūpaṃ ca guggulam || 45 || triśūkaṃ ca baliṃ dattvā tathā trilavaṇaṃ naraḥ || kanakaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā vidyāmāpnotyabhīpsitām || 46 || candanamājyaṃ jātī paramānnaṃ gugguluṃ ca devāya|| dattvā bhaktyā puruṣaḥ sarvānkāmānavāpnoti||47|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0saṃ0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne bhagavadanulepanasnānavarṇanannāma daśottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||110|| <2.111> rāma uvāca || bhagavañchrotumicchāmi pāpānāṃ karmaṇāṃ phalam || tvattaḥ kamalapatrākṣa tanmamācakṣva pṛcchataḥ ||1|| puṣkara uvāca || bhuktvaivānnamabhojyaṃ tu narakaṃ yāti mānavaḥ || vratalope tadardhaṃ ca prakīrṇe tu daśāhakam || 2 || agnihotrasamidyādīnsahasraṃ yāti vatsarān || mahāpātakinaḥ sarve kalpaṃ paśyanti bhārgava || 3 || manvantaraṃ tu tāṃ kṛtvā narakaṃ pratipadyate || caturyugaṃ kṣattriyahā vaiśyahā triyugaṃ tathā||4|| śūdraṃ hatvā mahābhāga yugaṃ tu narakaṃ vrajet || yāvanti paśuromāṇi tāvatkṛtveha mānavaḥ ||5|| vṛthāpaśughnaḥ prāpnoti varṣāṇi narakaṃ naraḥ || dravyāṇāmalpasārāṇāṃ steyaṃ kṛtvānyaveśmataḥ || 6 || yāti saṃvatsaraśataṃ gurubrāhmaṇatāḍanāt || tacchastravartī nṛpatiḥ kalpaṃ paśyati mānada || 7 || pakṣapātī tathā sabhyastāvadeva bhṛgūttama || brāhmaṇasya ca śūdrasya sahasraṃ bhṛgusattama || 8 || śoṇitaṃ yāvataḥ pāṃsūnnigṛhṇāti mahītale || tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi narakaṃ pratipadyate || 9 || rājani praharedyastu kṛtagāmyāti durmatiḥ || arājā narakaṃ yāti sa tu kalpaśataṃ naraḥ || 2.111.10 || nityānyakurvandharmāṇi tathā varṣaśataṃ vrajet || drumāṇāṃ chedane rāma pañcāśadvarṣameva tu || || 11 || gulmavallīlatānāṃ tu daśavarṣāṇi bhārgava || anāgasāmathākrośe tiraścāmatha tāḍane || 12 || tāvadeva yathākālaṃ narakaṃ pratipadyate || agamyāgāminaḥ sarve mahāpātakibhiḥ samāḥ || 13 || aniviṣṭāṃ bhṛtiṃ bhuktvā dve śate pratipadyate || tathā pustakahārī ca sahasraṃ yāti vatsarān || 14 || sasyānāṃ nāśakārī ca narakaṃ pratipadyate || agāravanadāhī ca nāstikaśca tathā naraḥ || 15 || kalpamekaṃ prapadyante narakaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ|| devatānāṃ dvijātīnāṃ śāstrāṇāṃ nindakastathā||16|| śrutīnāṃ dūṣakaścaiva tāvadeva dvijottama|| pratiśrutya tathā cārthaṃ yo na dadyānmahābhuja || 17 || āśritasya parityāgaṃ vṛthā kuryāddvijottama || aparādhaṃ tathā rāma vṛthā bhāryāvamantakaḥ || 18 || kratuhā caiva dharmajña sahasraṃ patipadyate || bahūni rāma pāpāni pāpeṣūkteṣu bhārgava || antarbhāvaṃ prapadyante tāni cintyāni dharmataḥ ||19 || narakāṇāṃ gaṇanamuditaṃ pāpānāṃ te mayā rāma || etacca bhavati ghoraṃ tvanubandhakṛtaṃ manuṣyāṇām||20|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0saṃ0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne pāpaniścayo nāmaikādaśottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||111 || <2.112> rāma uvāca || jantuḥ kathaṃ sambhavati kathaṃ caiva vipadyate || kathaṃ dehāntaraṃ yāti tanmamācakṣva pṛcchataḥ || 1 || puṣkara uvāca || viśvasyāvaraṇaṃ rāma tathaivāṇḍaṃ na hema yat || tathā prāṇiśarīrasya pārthivatvaṃ mahābhuja || 2 || ākāśe naraśārdūla yathaivāṇḍaṃ vyavasthitam || suṣiraṃ tadvadeveha puruṣasya śarīragam || 3 || dhārayanti yathā viśvamaṇḍasyābhyantare sthitāḥ || vāyvagnisomāḥ satataṃ tathā dehaṃ śarīriṇām || 4 || ādhārabhūte dve bhūte ādyante sarvadehinām || prapadyante mahābhāga kalalatvaṃ hi tatkṣaṇāt || 5 || karoti tatra ca tataḥ praveśaṃ karmacoditaḥ || vāyubhūtastathā jīvastyaktvā bhogavivardhanam || svargādvā narakāddehaṃ tiryagyonāvathāpi vā || 6 || evaṃ praveśaṃ sa karoti garbhe jīvastadā karmavaśānubandhāt || tataḥ praviṣṭastu tathā sa mūḍho māsāṃśca ṣaṭ tiṣṭhati veda nityaḥ||7|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0saṃ0rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne garbhasaṃkrāntivarṇanannāma dvādaśottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 112 || <2.113> rāma uvāca || bhogadehaṃ kathaṃ tyaktvā jīvo garbhaṃ prapadyate || bhogadehaśca kaḥ proktastaṃ mamācakṣva pṛcchataḥ || 1 || puṣkara uvāca || ātivāhikā garbhasya deho bhavati bhārgava || kevalaṃ taṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ mṛtyukāla upasthite || 2 || yāmyairnarairmanuṣyāṇāṃ taccharīraṃ bhṛgūttama || nīyate yāmyamārgeṇa nānyeṣāṃ prāṇināṃ dvija || 3 || manuṣyāḥ pratipadyante svargaṃ narakameva vā || naivā'nye prāṇinaḥ kecitsarvaṃ te phalabhoginaḥ || 4 || śubhānāmaśubhānāṃ vā karmaṇāṃ bhṛgunandana || saṃcayaḥ kriyate loke manuṣyaireva kevalam || 5 || tasmānmanuṣyastu mṛto yamalokaṃ prapadyate || nānyaḥ prāṇī mahābhāga phalayonau vyavasthitaḥ||6|| gaccham̐lloke prapannasya puruṣasya tathā yamaḥ|| yonīśca narakāṃścaiva nirūpayati karmaṇām||7|| pūjanīyāśca te tena vaivasvatamapaśyata|| maraṇānantaraṃ proktaṃ tiraścāṃ garbhasambhavam ||8|| vāyubhūtāśca te garbhaṃ prapadyante na saṃśayaḥ || manuṣyastu mṛto rāma nīyate yamamandiram||9|| tathā karmānurūpeṇa yamaṃ paśyatyasau tataḥ || ghoraṃ pāpastathā dharme niviṣṭaḥ saumyadarśanam || 2.113.10 || dharmiṣṭhaḥ pūjyate tatra hyāsanenodakena ca || pāśabaddhagalaḥ pāpaḥ pīḍyate vai yamāgrataḥ || 11 || citraguptāstatastasya svargaṃ narakameva ca || nivedayanti dharmajña sa tu piṇḍāśanastataḥ || 12 || tadā tyaktvā tu taddehaṃ pretadehaṃ prapadyate || pretaloke tu vasatirvarṣaṃ tasya tu kīrtitā || 13 || kṣuttṛṣṇe pratyahaṃ tatra bhavato bhṛgunandana || ahorātraṃ tu tatrāpi mānuṣyaṃ parikīrtitam || 14 || āmaśrāddhāstathā dattā bhujyaṃte tatra mānavaiḥ || ativāhikadehāttu pretapiṇḍairvinā naraḥ || 15|| na hi mokṣamavāpnoti piṇḍāṃstatraiva so'śnute || kṛte sapiṇḍīkaraṇe naraḥ saṃvatsarātparam || 16 || pretadehaṃ samutsṛjya bhogadehaṃ prapadyate || tadādau bhujyate tatra yatstokaṃ bhṛgunandana || 17 || bhogadehāvubhau proktau śubhāśubhakasaṃjñakau || bhogadehaṃ śubhaṃ tasya devarūpasya jāyate || 18 || nānāprakāramaśubhaṃ nīrūpaṃ ghoradarśanam || yādṛśaṃ tasya mānuṣyaṃ rūpamāsītpurātanam || 19 || kiñcittasya tu sādṛśyaṃ tatrāpi pratipadyate || bhuktvā sa bhogadehena yathākālaṃ triviṣṭapam || 2.113.20 || karmaṇyalpāvaśeṣe tu tridivādvinipātyate || tridivātpatitaṃ tasya bhogadehaṃ tu rākṣasāḥ || 21 || bhakṣayanti tadā bhūmau vikṛtā bhīmadarśanāḥ || pāpe tiṣṭhati cetsvarge tena bhukta tathā dvija || 22 || tadā dvitīyaṃ gṛhṇāti bhogadehaṃ tu pāpinam || bhuktvā pāpaṃ tu te paścāttena bhuktaṃ triviṣṭapam || 23 || śucīnāṃ śrīmatāṃ gehe svargabhraṣṭo'bhijāyate || puṇye tiṣṭhati cetpāpaṃ tena bhuktaṃ tadā bhavet || 24 || tasminsambhakṣite dehe śubhaṃ gṛhṇāti vigraham || karmaṇyalpāvaśeṣe tu narakādapi mucyate || 25 || yuktastu narakādyāti tiryagyonimasaṃśayam || tatrāpyaśeṣataḥ pāpaṃ na tadaśnāti bhārgava || tato'vaśeṣaṃ mānuṣyaṃ bhuṃkte'sau kṛtalakṣaṇaḥ ||26|| rajjuryathā syādbahutantubaddhā vikarṣaṇaṃ śaktimanī gurūṇām || svargāya puṇyaṃ narakāya pāpaṃ tathā nṛṇāṃ syādiha bhārgavāgrya || 27 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0saṃ0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne bhogadehavarṇanannāma trayodaśottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 113 || <2.114> puṣkara uvāca || jīvaḥ praviṣṭo garbhe tu kalalaṃ prati tiṣṭhati || mūḍhastu kalale tasminmāsamātraṃ hi tiṣṭhati ||1|| dvitīyaṃ tu tadā māsaṃ ghanībhūtaḥ sa tiṣṭhati || tasyāvayavanirmāṇaṃ tṛtīye māsi jāyate || 2 || tvakcarmapañcame māsi ṣaṣṭhe romṇāṃ samudbhavaḥ || saptame ca tathā māsi prabodhaścāsya jāyate || 3 || sa jīvo'pi hi māṇḍūkaḥ śīte śītāditobhyasuḥ || mūḍhastiṣṭhati dharmajña ṣaṇmāsāngarbhagastathā || 4 || māturāhārapītaṃ tu saptame māsyupāśnute || aṣṭame navame māsi bhṛśamudvijate tadā || 5 || jarāyuveṣṭito deho mūrdhni baddhāñjaliḥ sadā || madhye klībastu vāme strī dakṣiṇe puruṣastathā || 6 || tiṣṭhatyuttarabhāge tu pṛṣṭhasyābhimukhastathā || yasyāṃ tiṣṭhati sā yonau tāṃ tu vetti na saṃśayam || 7 || sarvaṃ smarati vṛttāntaṃ tvārabhya janmatastathā || andhakāre ca mahati pīḍāṃ vindati bhārgava || 8 || kīṭagandhena mahatā kalmaṣaṃ vindate param || mātrānīte jale pīte paraṃ śītamupāśnute || 9 || uṣṇe bhukte tadā dāhaṃ paramāpnoti bhārgava || vyādhibhiḥ paramāṃ pīḍāṃ tīvrāṃ prāpnoti duḥsahām || 2.114.10 || vyāyāme ca tathā mātuḥ klamaṃ mahadupāśnute || vyādhitāyāṃ tathā tīvrāṃ vedanāṃ samupāśnute || 11 || bhavanti vyādhayaścāsya tatra ghorāḥ punaḥpunaḥ || na ca mātā pitā vetti tadā kaściccikitsakaḥ || 12 || saukumāryādrujaṃ tīvrāṃ janayanti tu tasya tāḥ || ādhibhirvyādhibhiścaiva pīḍyamānasya dāruṇaiḥ || 13 || svalpamadhye'tha tatkālaṃ yāti varṣaśatopamam || santapyate tathā garbhe karmabhiśca purātanaiḥ || 14 || manorathāni kurute sukṛtārthaṃ punaḥpunaḥ || janma cedahamāpsyāmi mānuṣye daivayogataḥ || 15 || tataḥ karma kariṣyāmi yena mokṣo bhavenmama || nāsti mokṣaṃ vinā saukhyaṃ garbhavāse kathañcana || 16 || garbhavāsaśca sumahalloke duḥkhaikakāraṇam || evaṃ vicintayānasya tasya varṣaśatopamam || 17 || māsatrayaṃ tadbhavati garbhasthasya prapīḍyataḥ || tatastu kāle sampūrṇe prabalaiḥ sūtimārutaiḥ || 18 || bhavatyavāṅmukho jantuḥ pīḍāmanubhavanparām || adhomukhaḥ saṃkaṭena yonidvāreṇa vāyunā || 19 || niḥsāryate bāṇa iva yantracchidreṇa sajvaraḥ || yoniniṣkramaṇātpīḍāṃ carmotkartanasannibhām || 2.114.20 || prāpnoti ca tato jātaḥ tīvraṃ śītamasaṃśayam || janmajvarābhibhūtasya vijñānaṃ tasya naśyati || 21 || karasaṃsparśanānmāturna ca jānātyasau tadā || karapatrasya saṃsparśānmāsamātraṃ vimohitaḥ || 22 || saṃbhavametadgarbhe proktaṃ jantormayā tubhyam || kramato vacmi tavāhaṃ tatsatyaṃ brūhi dharmajña || 23 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0saṃ0rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne sambhavavarṇanannāma caturdaśottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 114 || <2.115> || rāma uvāca || śarīraṃ sakalaṃ deva tanmamākhyātumarhasi || etadeva paraṃ jñānaṃ tvaṃ hi vetsi mahābhuja || 1 || puṣkara uvāca || bhūmiḥ pañcaguṇā jñeyā jalaṃ jñeyaṃ caturguṇam || tejastu triguṇaṃ rāma pavano dviguṇo mataḥ || 2 || tatraikaguṇamākāśaṃ nityaṃ jñeyaṃ manīṣibhiḥ || śabdaḥ sparśaśca rūpaṃ ca raso gandhaśca pañcamaḥ || 3 || bhūmerguṇaṃ vijānīyādupānte gandhavarjitāḥ || rasagandhavihīnāstu tejasaḥ parikīrtitāḥ || 4 || gandho rasastathā rūpaṃ nāsti vāyorbhṛgūttama || gandho rasastathā rūpaṃ sparśaḥ khe na ca vidyate || 5 || raso gandhastathā rūpaṃ sparśanaṃ śabda eva ca || bhūmyādīnāṃ guṇāḥ proktāḥ pradhānā bhṛgunandana || 6 || ākāśajāni srotāṃsi tathā śrotraṃ viviktatā || śvāsocchvāsau parispando vāk ca saṃsparśanaṃ tathā || 7 || vāyavīyāni jānīyātsarvāṇyetāni paṇḍitaḥ || rūpaṃ saṃdarśanaṃ paktiṃ pittamūṣmāṇameva ca || 8 || medhā varṇaṃ balaṃ chāyā tejaḥ śauryaṃ tathaiva ca || sarvāṇyetāni jānīyāttaijasāni śarīriṇām || 9 || ambhasānīha rasanaṃ svedaḥ kledo vasā tathā || rasāsṛkchukramūtrādi dehe dravacayastathā || 2.115.10 || śaityaṃ snehaśca dharmajña tathā śleṣmāṇameva ca || pārthivānīha jānīhi prāṇakeśanakhādi ca || 11 || asthnāṃ samūho dhairyaṃ ca gauravaṃ sthiratā tathā || mātṛjāni mṛdūnyatra tvak ca māṃsaṃ ca bhārgava || 12 || hadayaṃ ca tathā nābhiḥ svedo majjā yakṛttathā || klomāntaṃ ca gudaṃ rāma āmasyāśayameva ca || 13 || pitṛjāni sthirāṇyagrabhūmijānīha yāni tu || snāyuśukraśirāścaiva ātmajāni nibodha me || 14 || kāmaḥ krodho bhayo harṣo dharmādharmātmatā tathā || ākṛtiḥ svaravarṇau ca cetanādyaṃ tathā vayaḥ || 153 || tāmasāni tathā jñānapramādālasyatṛṭkṣudhaḥ || mohamātsaryavaiguṇyaśokāyāsabhayāni ca || 16 || kāmakrodhau tathā śauryaṃ yajñepsā bahubhāṣitā || ahaṅkāraḥ parāvajñā rājasāni mahābhuja || ||17 || dharmecchā mokṣakāmitvaṃ parā bhaktiśca keśave || dākṣiṇyaṃ vyavasāyaśca sāttvikāni vinirdiśet || 18 || caturaḥ krodhano bhīrurbahubhāṣī kalipriyaḥ || svapne gaganagaścaiva vahuvāto naro bhavet || 19 || akālapalitaḥ krodhī mahāprajño raṇapriyaḥ || svapne ca dīptimatprekṣī bahupitto naro bhavet|| 2.115.20 || sthiracittaḥ sthirotsāhaḥ sthirāṅgaracanānvitaḥ || svapne jalasitālokī bahuśleṣmā naro bhavet || 21 || rasastu prīṇano dehe jīvano rudhirastathā || lepanaṃ ca tathā māṃse medaḥ snehakaraṃ ca tat || 22 || dhāraṇaṃ tvasthi kathitaṃ majjā bhavati pūraṇī || garbhotpādakaraṃ śukraṃ tathā vīryavivardhanam || 23 || tejaḥ prāṇakaraṃ nityaṃ tatra jīvo vyavasthitaḥ || śukrādapi paraṃ sāramapītaṃ hṛdayopamam || 24 || ṣaḍaṅgāni pradhānāni kathayiṣyāmi te śṛṇu || dvau bāhū sakthinī dve ca mūrdhā jaṭharameva ca || 25 || ṣaṭtvacaśca śarīre'sminkīrtyamānā nibodha me || bāhyato hyadharā rāma tvacā rudhiradhāriṇī || 26 || vilāsakāriṇī cānyā caturthī kuṣṭhakāriṇī || pañcamī vidradhisthānaṃ ṣaṣṭhī prāṇadharā matā || 27 || kalāḥ satyasmṛtā dehe tāsāṃvakṣyāmi lakṣaṇam || ekā māṃsadharā rāma dhamanyo yatra saṃsthitāḥ || 28 || asṛgdharā dvitīyā tu yakṛtplīhāśrayā matā || medodharā tṛtīyā syātsūkṣmasthūlāśrayā tu yā || 29 || majjāśrayā caturthī tu tathā śleṣmaparā matā || purīṣadhāriṇī cānyā yathā pakvāśaye sthiteḥ || 2.115.30 || ṣaṣṭhī pittadharā nāma jaṭharāgnau samāśritā || śukrāśayā śukadharā tathā jñeyā ca saptamī || 31 || buddhīndriyāṇi pañcātra śrotraṃ prāṇaṃ ca cakṣuṣī || tvaktathā rasanā caiva mahābhūtāśrayāṇi tu || 32 || indryārthāstathā pañca teṣāṃ nāmāni me śṛṇu || śrotrasya śabdaḥ kathito gandho prāṇasya pārthivaḥ || 33 || rūpaṃ ca cakṣuṣo jñeyaṃ tvak ca saṃsparśanaṃ tathā || rasanasya rasaścaiva mahābhūtāśrayāstu te || 34 || karmendriyāṇi pañcātra teṣāṃ nāmāni me śṛṇu || pāyūpasthaṃ hastapādau jihvā caivātra pañcamī || 35 || teṣāmarthāstathā pañca tānpravakṣyāmyataḥ param || utsargaṃ ca tathānandaṃ ādānagamane tathā || 36 || indriyāṇi daśaitāni teṣāṃ vai nāyakaṃ manaḥ || pañca karmendriyāṇyatra pañca buddhīndriyāṇi ca || 37 || indriyārthāśca pañcātra mahābhūtāni pañca ca || indriyebhyaḥ parāḥ proktāścatvāro bhṛgunandana || 38 || mano buddhistathaivātmā avyaktaśca mahābhuja || tadāśrayāṇīndriyāṇi indriyebhyaḥ parāśca te || 39 || tattvānyetāni jānīhi caturviṃśatisaṃkhyayā || yeṣāmaikyaṃ mahābhāga puruṣaḥ pañcaviṃśakaḥ || 2.115.40 || saṃyuktastairviyuktaśca tathā matsyodake ubhe || manaḥ saṃśayakṛnnityaṃ tathā buddhirvivecanī || 41 || ātmā jīvaḥ smṛto rāma yo bhoktā sukhaduḥkhayoḥ || avyakto miśritānīha rajaḥsattvatamāṃsi ca || 42 || puruṣastvaparo jñeyo yaśca sarvagato mahān || caturviśatikātsaṃkhyādyaḥ sa nityaḥ pṛthak sthitaḥ || 43 || ekatritāni tattvāni puruṣasya tathaikataḥ || na caiva vyatiriktāni tattvāni puruṣātparam || 44 || prakṛtiḥ puruṣo rāma niṣphalaḥ pañcaviṃśakaḥ || vikṛtistasya vijñeyā śeṣastattvagaṇo budhaḥ || 45 || sarvataḥ pāṇipādo'sau sarvatokṣiśiromukhaḥ || puruṣaḥ sa paro jñeyaḥ sarvaśaktistu sarvataḥ||46|| nādirna madhyo naivānto vyāptisambhavayordvayoḥ || yasya jānanti munayo yastaṃ veda sa vedavit || 47|| sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yo vetti puruṣaṃ param || etadeva ca vijñānaṃ prastutaṃ śṛṇu bhārgava || 48 || saptāśayāḥ smṛtā dehe śṛṇu tānapi bhārgava || āśayo rudhirasyaikaḥ kaphasya ca tathā paraḥ || 49|| āmapittāśayau cānyau jñeyaḥ pakvāśayo'paraḥ || vāyumātrāśayau cānyau āśayā sapta kīrtitaḥ||2.115.50|| strīṇāṃ garbhāśayo rāma pittapakvāśayāntare || aṣṭamaḥ sa bhavettāsāṃ yatra garbhaḥ sa tiṣṭhati || 51 || ṛtau vikośā bhavati yoniḥ kamalavatsadā || garbhāśaye tataḥ śukra dhatte raktasamanvitam || 52 || anyatra kāle mukulā yonirbhavati yoṣitām || nyastaṃ śukramato yonau naiti garbhāśayaṃ mune || 53 || ṛtāvapi ca yoniścedvātapittakaphāvṛtā || bhavettasyā viśaucārthaṃ naiva tasyāḥ prajāyate || 54 || vṛkkā tu puṣpasaplīhaṃ hṛtkoṣṭhāṅgayakṛd ghanāḥ || taṇḍulaśca mahābhāga nibaddhānyāśaye tu te || 55 || rasasya pacyamānasya sārādbhavati dehinām || plīhā yakṛcca dharmajña raktaphenācca pukkasaḥ || 56 || raktakiṭṭācca bhavati tathā daṇḍakasaṃjñakaḥ || medo raktaprasādācca vṛkkayoḥ sambhavaḥ smṛtaḥ || 57 || raktamāṃsaprasādācca bhavantyantrāṇi dehinām || sāvitrivyomasaṃkhyāni tāni strīṇāṃ vinirdiśet || 58 || trivyomāni tathā strīṇāṃ prāhurvedavido janāḥ || raktavāyusamāyogātkālo yasyodbhavaḥ smṛtaḥ || 59 || kaphaprasādādbhavati hṛdayaṃ padmasannibham || adhomukhaṃ tatsuṣiraṃ yatra jīvo vyavasthitaḥ || 2.115.60 || caitanyānugatā bhāvā sarve tatra vyavasthitāḥ || tasya vāme tathā plīhā dakṣiṇe ca tathā yakṛt || 61 || dakṣiṇe ca tathā kloma padmasyaiva prakīrtitam || srotāṃsi yāni dehe'sminkapharaktavahāni tu ||62|| teṣāṃ bhūtānugānāṃ tu bhavatīndriyasambhavaḥ || netrayormaṇḍalaṃ śuklaṃ kaphādbhavati paittikam || 63 || kṛṣṇaṃ ca maṇḍalaṃ vātāttathā bhavati mātṛkam|| sarvahṛnmaṇḍalaṃ jñeyaṃ mātāpitṛsamudbhavam || 64 || pakṣmamaṇḍalamekaṃ tu dvitīyaṃ vartmamaṇḍalam || śukle tṛtīyaṃ kathitaṃ caturthaṃ kṛṣṇamaṇḍalam||65|| dṛṅmaṇḍalaṃ pañcamaṃ tu netraṃ syātpañcamaṇḍalam || anye tu netrabhāge dve tathā'pāṅgakanīnike||66|| yābhyāṃ netrasya janitā matsyasaṃsthānatā dvija || nāsāsamīpe kathitaṃ tadapāṅgetisaṃjñitam || 67 || kapolayoḥ samīpe tu tathā proktā kanīnikā || māṃsāsṛkkaphajā jihvā medo'sṛkkaphamāṃsajā || 68 || vṛṣaṇau ca tathā jñeyau sarveṣāmeva dehinām || prāṇasyāyatānānyatra daśaitāni nibodha me ||69|| mūrdhā ca hṛdayaṃ nābhi kaṇṭho jihvā nibandhanam || raktaṃ śukraṃ gudo vastistathā gulphau ca bhārgava ||2.115.70|| kaṇḍarāḥ ṣoḍaśa proktāstathā dehe śarīriṇām || dve karasthe tathā dve ca caraṇasthe pṛthakpṛthak || 71 || catasraḥ pṛṣṭhagā jñeyā grīvāyāṃ tāvadeva tu || jalāni ṣoḍaśaivātra vibhāgasteṣu kathyate || 72 || māṃsasnāyuśirāsthibhyaḥ catvārastu pṛthakpṛthak || maṇibandhāni gulpheṣu nibaddhāni parasparam || 73 || śaṃkūni ca smṛtānīha hastayoḥ pādayostathā || grīvāyāṃ ca tathā meḍhre kathitāni manīṣibhiḥ || 74 || dehe'smiṃśca tathā jñeyāścatasro māṃsarajjavaḥ|| pṛṣṭhavaṃśobhayagate dve dve tatra prakīrtite || 75 || tāvantyaśca tathāpyetāstāsāṃ bandhanakārakāḥ || sīvanyaśca tathā sapta pañca mūrdhānamāśritāḥ || 76|| ekā meḍhragatā caikā tathā jihvāgatā parā|| asthnāmatra śatāni syustrīṇi ṣaṣṭyadhikāni tu||77|| sūkṣmaiḥ saha catuḥṣaṣṭiṃ daśanā viṃśatirnnakhāḥ || pāṇipādaśalākāśca tāsāṃ sthānacatuṣṭayam || 78 || catvāriṃśattathāsthīni jaṃghayostāvadeva tu || dvedve jānukapolauṣṭhaphalakāṃsasamudbhave || 79 || akṣisthale'ṣṭakaṃ śroṇiphalake caivamādiśet || bhagāsthyekaṃ tathā pṛṣṭhe catvāriṃśacca pañca ca || 2.115.80 || grīvāpañcadaśāsthīni jatrvekaṃ ca tathā hanuḥ || bhrūmūlaṃ dve lalāṭākṣigaṇḍanāsā tathāsthikā || 81 || sarjukāsthālakaiḥ sārdhamarbudaiśca dvisaptatiḥ || dvau śaṅkhakau kapālāni catvāryeva śirastathā || 82 || uraḥ saptadaśāsthīni puruṣasyāsthisaṃgrahaḥ || tathā caivātra sandhīnāṃ dve śate tu śatādhike || 83 || aṣṭaṣaṣṭiśca śākhāsu ṣaṣṭiścaikavivarjitā || antarādhau tvaśītiśca kathitā bhṛgunandana || 84 || na ca snāyuśatānyatra dve tu triṃśādhike mate || antarādhau tu kathitā hyūrdhvagāścaiva saptatiḥ || 85 || ṣaṭkṛtāni ca śākhāsu kathitāni manīṣibhiḥ || pañcapeśīśatānyatra catvāriṃśattathordhvagāḥ || 86 || catvāriṃśacchatānyatra tathā śākhāsu paṇḍitaiḥ || antarādhau tathā ṣaṣṭiḥ peśyastu kathitā budhaiḥ||87|| strīṇāṃ caivādhikā jñeyā triṃśatiścaturuttarā || stanayordaśa vijñeyā yonau rāma tathā daśa || 88 || garbhāśaye tathā jñeyāścatasro garbhacintakaiḥ || triṃśacchatasahasrāṇi tathānyāni daśaiva tu || 89 || ṣaṭpañcāśatsahasrāṇi śirāṇāṃ kathitāni tu || tā vahanti rasaṃ dehe kedāramiva kulyakāḥ || 2.115.90 || abhyaṃgādi tathā sarvaṃ svedalepādikaṃ ca yat || dvisaptatistathā koṭyo romṇāṃ viddhi mahābhuja || 91 || majjāyā medasaścaiva vasāyāśca tathā dvija || mūtrasya caiva pittasya śleṣmaṇaḥ śakṛtastathā || 92 || raktasya ca rasasyātha kramaśoñjalayaḥ smṛtāḥ || ardhārdhābhyadhikāḥ sarvāḥ pūrvārdhāñjalitaḥ smṛtāḥ ||93|| ardhāṃjaliśca śukrasya tathārdhā ca tathaujasaḥ || rajasastu tathā strīṇāṃ catasraḥ kathitā budhaiḥ ||94|| samadhātoridaṃ proktaṃ pramāṇaṃ dehacintakaiḥ || vilakṣaṇāni dehāni nityameva śarīriṇām || teṣāṃ bhedena bhidyante maladoṣānurūpataḥ || 95 || etaccharīraṃ maladoṣapiṇḍaṃ dhātvāśrayaṃ karmavaśānubaddham || mokṣāya yasyeha bhavetsa dhanyo mokṣe ca hetuḥ paramo hi viṣṇuḥ ||96|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0saṃ0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne śarīraviṣayavarṇanannāma pañcadaśottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 115 || <2.116> puṣkara uvāca || āyuṣi karmaṇi kṣīṇe saṃprāpte maraṇe nṛṇām || ūṣmā prakupitaḥ kāye tīvravāyusamīritaḥ || 1 || śarīramuparudhyātha kṛtsnāndoṣānruṇaddhi vai || bhinatti prāṇasthānāni punarmarmāṇi caiva hi || 2 || śaityātprakupito vāyuśchidramanviṣyate tataḥ || dve netre ca tathā karṇau dvau tu nāsāpuṭau tathā ||3|| ūrdhva tu sapta cchidrāṇi saptakaṃ vadanaṃ tathā || etaiḥ prāṇo viniryāti prāyaśaḥ śubhakarmaṇām || 4 || adhaḥ pāyurupasthaṃ ca chidradvayamudāhṛtam || chidradvayena tenātha mriyante'śubhakāriṇaḥ || 5 || mūrdhānaṃ yogināṃ bhittvā jīvo vrajati bhārgava || athavā svecchayā rāma yena cecchanti yoginaḥ || 6 || antakāle tu saṃprāpte prāṇāpāneṣvavasthitaḥ || tamasā saṃvṛte jñāne saṃvṛteṣu ca marmasu || 7 || sa jīvo nābhyadhiṣṭhānaścālyate mātariśvanā || sa jīvaścālyamānastu karmabhistaiḥ purātanaiḥ || 8 || aṣṭāṅgāṃ prāṇavṛttiṃ tāṃ śanaiścyāvayate dvija || śarīraṃ prajahātyasmānniśvāsastu bhavettataḥ || 9 || cyavantaṃ jāyamānaṃ vā praviśantaṃ ca yoniṣu || paśyantyevaṃvidhaṃ siddhā jīvaṃ divyena cakṣuṣā || 10 || sa tu dehaparityāgakāle prāpte tadānagha || tatkṣaṇādeva gṛhṇāti śarīramativāhikam || 11 || ūrdhvaṃ bhajanti bhūtāni trīṇyasmāttasya vigrahāt || ākāśavāyutejāṃsi dve cādho bhṛgunandana || 12 || salilaṃ ca mahābhāga tathaiva ca vasundharā ||| evaṃ pañcatvamāpannaḥ puruṣastvabhidhīyate || 13 || evaṃ pañcatvamāpanne taddehamativāhikam || bhayānakairmahāghorairnānāveṣadharaistathā || 14 || uccaistasya tadā baddhaṃ kālapāśena satvaram || nīyate kālapuruṣairyāmyaṃ mārgaṃ sudustaram || 15 || taptāmbarīṣasaṃkāśaṃ tvayoguṇanibhaṃ mahat || saṃtaptasikataṃ ghoraṃ tāmraparṇanibhaṃ tathā || 16 || ṣaḍaśītisahasrāṇi yojanānāṃ mahītalam || yamasya tu purī rāma ghorā saṃyamanī smṛtā || 17 || nīyate tena mārgeṇa tādṛśena tu tāṃ purīm || ākṛṣyamāṇaṃ puruṣairyāmyairghorairmahītale || 18 || pīḍāmanubhavam̐statra mriyate na ca mānada || atyarthaviṣamaḥ proktaḥ sa mārgo ghoradarśanaḥ|||| viśvarūpadharo rāma bhuvi śītāvṛto mahān || himaprapātabahulaścātiśītaḥ sudustaraḥ ||20|| andhakāravṛte durge garbhavāsopamastathā|| agnisaṃsparśavadanaiḥ kākakākolajambukaiḥ || 21 || makṣikādaṃśamaśakairāvṛtaḥ sarpavṛścikaiḥ || bhakṣyamāṇo'pi tairjanturbhakṣyate cāpi rākṣasaiḥ || 22 || utkṛtyotkṛtya sahasā na ca prāṇairviyujyate || mudgaraiścūrṇyate ghoraistudyate lohakaṇṭakaiḥ || 23 || kṣudhayā tṛṣayā caiva ghorayā cāpi pīḍyate || dahyamāno'tighoreṇa saikatena ca nīyate || 24 || evaṃ saṃyāpyamānastu prāpyate yamamandiram || daśabhiḥ sa muhūrtaistu panthānamatidustaram || 25 || prāpnoti bhīmanirghoṣaṃ durgandhibhayadarśanam || tatkālaṃ sumahadvetti puruṣo devamāyayā || 26 || pāpānurūpaṃ tatkālaṃ tasya tatrābhijāyate || kasyacidviśataṃ kālaṃ kasyacicchatasambhavam || 27 || kṣuttṛṣṇāsambhavāścaiva bhavantyatha mahābhayāḥ || daṇḍapiṇḍasya dharmajña pretatvamupajāyate || 28 || preta loke sa vasati tataḥ saṃvatsaraṃ naraḥ || sodakumbhamatonnādyaṃ bāndhavaistasya dīyate || 29 || dinedine yaddharmajña tadbhuṅkte nātra saṃśayaḥ || na dīyate tu yasyaitatsa tu tatra yathā svayam || 30 || pūrvadattamathānnādyaṃ prāpnoti svayameva tu || svayameva na dattaṃ tu tathā dātā na vidyate || 31 || na cāstyudakadātā ca sa tu tatparitapyate || bāndhavaistūdakaṃ datta tatra tatrāsya jāyate|| 32 || nadī śītajalā nāma bahupānīyasaṃyutā || māsimāsi ca yacchrāddhaṃ tasya tatra pradīyate || 33 || tena tṛptimavāpnoti paramāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || mānuṣyeṇa tu māsena pitṛloke dinaṃ smṛtam || 34 ||| pretaloke tu divaso mānuṣyeṇa vidhīyate || tasmāddinedine deyaṃ pretāyānnaṃ tu vatsaram || 35 || evaṃ sa yāpyamānastu prāpnoti yamamandiram || tataḥ paśyatyasau devaṃ pāpātmā ghoradarśanam || 36 || citraguptastatastasya jñātvā karma yathāvidham || ājñāpayati dharmajña śubhaṃ vā yadi vāśubham ||37|| tataḥ śmaśānikā nāma devā yāmyā bhayāvahāḥ || śītavātātapopetaṃ tadā rakṣanti mānavam || 38 || yatheha bandhane kaścidrakṣyate viṣamairnaraiḥ || preta piṇḍaistato dattairdehamāpnoti bhārgava || 39 || bhogadehamiti proktaṃ kramādeva na saṃśayaḥ || pretapiṇḍā na dīyante yasya tasya vimokṣaṇam || 40 || śmaśānikebhyo devebhya ākalpaṃ naiva vidyate || tatrāsya yātanā ghorāḥ śītavātātapodbhavāḥ || 41 || tataḥ sapiṇḍīkaraṇe bāndhavaiśca kṛte naraḥ ||| pūrṇe saṃvatsare dehamato'nyaṃ pratipadyate || 42 || tataḥ sa narakaṃ yāti svargaṃ vā svena karmaṇā || tataḥ sa kālaṃ vasati karmaṇāmanurūpataḥ || 43 || arvāk sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ yasya saṃvatsarātkṛtam || pretatvamapi tasyāpi proktaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ dhuvam || 44 || yairiṣṭaṃ vividhairyajñaiḥ pūjito yaiśca keśavaḥ || pretalokaṃ na te yānti tathā ye samare hatāḥ || 45|| śmaśānikānāṃ devānāṃ bhavanti vaśagā na te|| pretalokaṃ prapadyante tathā ghoraṃ bhayāvaham || 46 ||| evaṃ yāmyena mārgeṇa yānti pāpā narādhamāḥ || ārāmasadanaṃ yānti tathaiva drumaropakāḥ ||47|| śītalena tu mārgeṇa phalapuṣpavatā sukham || chatradāśca sukhaṃ yānti mārgeṇa sasukhena te || 48 || yānamaśvatarīyuktamāsthāyopānahapradāḥ || vimānairyānadā yānti tathā śayyāsanapradāḥ || 49 || gṛhadāḥ savihārantu yānti tṛptā jalapradāḥ || bhakṣyairbhojyaistathā tṛptā yānti bhojanadāyinaḥ || 50 || dīpapradāḥ prakāśena yānti mārgeṇa te sukham || pūjyamānā yamabhaṭairyānti bhaktā janārdanam || 51 || nāsti teṣāṃ bhayaṃ kiñcidihaloke paratra ca || te tṛptāḥ sarvakāmaiśca tarasā yānti mānavāḥ || || 52 || buddhiṃ samāsthāya tu sāttvikīṃ ye bhaktāḥ sureśasya janārdanasya || teṣāṃ gatistatra tu yatra rāma śvetāḥ pumāṃso gatasarvapāpāḥ || 53 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0 sa0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne yamamārgavarṇanannāma ṣoḍaśottaraśatatamodhyāyaḥ ||116|| <2.117> rāma uvāca || bhagavañchrotumicchāmi ye narāḥ svargagāminaḥ || kena dharmabhṛtāṃ śreṣṭha tathā nirayagāminaḥ || 1 || puṣkara uvāca || āśrameṣu yathokteṣu vartante ye dvijottamāḥ || svadharmasaktāḥ satataṃ te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ||2|| vartante ye mahīpāla rājadharmānusārataḥ || purohitamate yuktā rājānaḥ svargagāminaḥ || 3 || prajāsukhe sukhaṃ yeṣāṃ tadduḥkhe ye ca duḥkhitāḥ || duṣṭanigrahakartāro jñeyāste svargagāminaḥ ||4|| svāmyarthe brāhmaṇārthe vā mitrakārye ca ye hatāḥ || gograhe nihatā ye ca te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ || 5 || dehadhātūnparityajya salilāraṇyavahniṣu || anāśane vā dharmajña mṛtāḥ syuḥ svargagāminaḥ || 6 || tīrthayātrāprasaktāśca nityamadhvani karṣitāḥ || tapasā karṣitā ye ca te jñeyāḥ svargagāminaḥ || 7 || madhumāṃsanivṛttāśca nivṛttā madhupānataḥ || kāmamaithunataścāpi vijñeyāḥ svargagāminaḥ || 8 || mātāpitṛparā dāntā gurubhaktāḥ priyaṃvadāḥ || satyārjavaratā ye ca te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ || 9 || vaivāhikānāṃ vastrāṇāṃ prapāṇāṃ ye pradāyinaḥ || udyānārāmakartāraste narāḥ svargagāminaḥ || 10 || taḍāgakūpakartārastathā kanyāpradāyakāḥ || chatropānahadātāraste narāḥ svargagāminaḥ || 11 || indhanānāṃ pradātārastathā gogrāmadāyinaḥ || gavāṃ śuśrūṣakā ye ca te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ || 12 || paropakārasaktāśca parabandhavivarjakāḥ || pūjyapūjayitāraśca te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ || 13 || svādhyāyasaktā dhīmanto guruśuśrūṣaṇe ratāḥ || upāsakāśca vṛddhānāṃ te jñeyāḥ svargagāminaḥ ||14|| pratiśrayapradātārastathā ye satradāyakāḥ || bhaktā godevaviprāṇāṃ te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ || 15 || śrotāro ye ca dharmāṇāṃ ye tathā yajñayājinaḥ || upavāsaratā ye ca te jñeyāḥ svargagāminaḥ || 16 || kleśānanubhavantīha śāstrādhyayanatatparāḥ || śāstrāṇāṃ ca hite yuktāste jñeyāḥ svargagāminaḥ ||17|| ārtaprāṇapradā ye ca ye ca hiṃsāvivarjakāḥ || apīḍakāśca bhūtānāṃ te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ|| ||18|| daridrāya ca dātāraḥ prabhavaśca kṣamānvitāḥ || yauvanasthāśca ye śāntāste narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ||19|| pautradauhitrasaṃyuktā ye tathā cirajīvinaḥ|| priyaṅkarāśca bālānāṃ te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ|| poṣakāṇāmanāthānāṃ ye caivodvāhakāriṇaḥ|| dvirāgamanadā ye ca te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ||21|| grahāṇāṃ pūjakā ye ca ye tathā śrāddhakāriṇaḥ || saṃvibhāgakarā ye ca te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ || 22 || sarvāsāṃ devatānāṃ ca ye ca pūjāratāḥ sadā || sarvadānaratā ye ca te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ || 23 || ahatāśca tathā tatra kṛtvā karmātiduṣkaram || kālenāpi mṛtā rāma te narāḥ svargagāminaḥ ||24|| ye bhaktimanto madhusūdanasya deveśvarasyāpratimasya nityam || sattvena hīnā rajasā viyuktāste yānti nākaṃ surasaṃghapūjyāḥ||25|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0 saṃ0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne svargabhāgvarṇanannāma saptadaśottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||117|| <2.118> puṣkara uvāca || mahāpātakino ye ca ye ca pātakino janāḥ || māṃsāśino narā ye ca tathā ye'gamyāgāminaḥ || paradāraratā ye ca te vai nirayagāminaḥ || 1 || atikrāmanti ye bhāryāṃ pīḍayanti ca ye narān || ye sabhāsvavanyante te vai nirayagāminaḥ || 2 || bahubhāryāśca bhāryāsu vartante na samaṃ ca ye || ṛtukālaharā ye ca te vai nirayagāminaḥ||||| samyagbhartṛṣu yā nāryo vartante nāvalepataḥ || apriye ca tathā saktā jñeyāstā nirayaṅgamāḥ||4|| bhartāramavamanyante bhāṣante vipriyāṇi ca || svātantryeṇa ca vartante jñātavyā nirayaṅgamāḥ || 5 || rājaśāstropadeśaṃ ye saṃtyajya vasudhādhipāḥ || vartante sarvakāryeṣu te vai nirayagāminaḥ || 6 || varṇāśramoktaṃ vartante dharmaṃ tyaktvā tu ye narāḥ || bahiḥśāstrānmahābhāga te vai nirayagāminaḥ || 7 || ayājyayājino ye ca kūṭasākṣyapradāśca ye || tathānṛtaratā ye ca te vai nirayagāminaḥ || 8 || vyavahāreṣu ye saktāḥ pakṣapātābhidhāyinaḥ || asamyagdarśino ye ca te vai nirayagāminaḥ || 9 || prekṣyamāṇe parijane miṣṭamaśnanti ye narāḥ || asaṃvibhajya dharmajña te vai nirayagāminaḥ || 10 || bhṛtakāstu mahābhāga kurvante naiva ye bhṛtam || anirdiṣṭabhujaścaiva te vai nirayagāminaḥ ||11 || vañcakā bhṛtakānāṃ ca tathaivāśritavañcakāḥ || vañcakāśca tathā'nyeṣāṃ jñeyā nirayagāminaḥ || 12 || kṛtaghnā nirghṛṇā ye ca parasvādāyinaśca ye || śaṭhācārāśca mitrāṇāṃ te vai nirayagāminaḥ || 13 || gavāṃ pānapravṛttānāṃ ye tathā vighnakāriṇaḥ || tathā'nyeṣāṃ ca bhūtānāṃ te vai nirayagāminaḥ || 14 || dharmakāryapravṛttasya ye narā vighnakāriṇaḥ || pāpaprotsāhakāścaiva te vai nirayagāminaḥ ||15|| tyāginastvāśritānāṃ ye ṛtvijāṃ tyāginaśca ye || yājyānāṃ ca gurūṇāṃ ca te vai nirayagāminaḥ || 16 || tyāgino devatānāṃ ca vahnīnāṃ tyāginaśca ye || śāstrāṇāṃ tyāgino ye ca te vai nirayagāminaḥ || 17 || bālakātithiviprāṇāṃ surāṇāṃ caiva mānada || ye ca pūrvabhujo nityaṃ te vai nirayagāminaḥ || 18 || rajasvalāṃ ca ye yānti ye ca preṣyakarā striyam || viyoniṃ ye ca gacchanti te vai nirayagāminaḥ || 19 || śukraṃ tyajantyayonau ye tathākāśe ca nirghṛṇāḥ || parvasvapi ca dharmajña te vai nirayagāminaḥ ||20|| anadhyāyeṣu ye rāma svādhyāyamiha kurvate || nindati ca gurūnye vai te vai nirayagāminaḥ ||21|| devatānāṃ ca vedānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca nindakāḥ || purāṇacaritānāṃ ca te vai nirayagāminaḥ || 22 || ye nāstikā narā rāma ye ca śraddhāvivarjitāḥ || ahaṅkāragṛhītāśca te vai nirayagāminaḥ ||23|| kukarmasaktā manujāḥ sukarmaparivarjakāḥ || svāmimitradruho ye ca te vai nirayagāminaḥ ||24|| ye ca droharatā rājñāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ gavāmapi || suhṛdāmapi dharmajña te vai nirayagāminaḥ ||25 || ye tu paiśunyasaṃsaktāḥ paramarmaspṛśo'pi ca || aśucaśca tathā martyāste vai nirayagāminaḥ || 26 || somavikrayiṇo ye ca bījavikrayiṇastathā || ātmavikrayiṇo ye ca jñeyā nirayagāminaḥ || 27 || rajaḥ paśyanti dharmajña yeṣāṃ veśmani kanyakāḥ || śulke ca dattā sā yaiśca te vai nirayagāminaḥ || 28 || brahmeśakeśavānāṃ ca ye narā bhedavādinaḥ || tamo'bhibhūtāḥ paritaste vai nirayagāminaḥ||29|| kulajānāṃ sapiṇḍānāṃ ye ca piṇḍavilopakāḥ || aśrāddhadāśca pūrveṣāṃ te vai nirayagāminaḥ ||30|| kāmātmāno narā ye ca ye tathārthaparāyaṇāḥ || ye ca dharmadviṣo loke te vai nirayagāminaḥ || 31 || nābhipaśyanti ye śaktyā dīnamāturamāśritam || ārtaṃ ca nābhidhāvanti te vai nirayagāminaḥ ||32|| ye cāvahāsaṃ kurvanti dīnānāṃ mānagarvitāḥ || anāgasaṃ paribhavantyete nirayagāminaḥ || 33 || pīḍāmathotpādya narasya rāma yathākathaṃcinnarakaṃ prayāti || tasmātprayatnena vivarjanīyā parasya pīḍā manujena rāma ||| || 34 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0saṃ0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne nirayagāmivarṇanannāmāṣṭādaśottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 118 || <2.119> || rāma uvāca || nāmāni narakāṇāṃ ca yātanā vividhāstathā || bhagavañchrotumicchāmi puṃsāṃ narakagāminām || 1 || puṣkara uvāca || tāmisra mandhatāmisraṃ mahārauravarauravau || narakaṃ kālasūtraṃ ca mahānarakameva ca ||2|| saṃjīvanaṃ mahāvīciṃ tapanaṃ saṃpratāpanam || saṃghātaṃ ca sakākolaṃ kaśmalaṃ pūtimṛttikam || 3 || lohaśaṃkuṃ nṛbhīmaṃ ca manthānaṃ śālmaliṃ nadīm || asipatravanaṃ caiva lohakāraṃ tathaiva ca || 4 || pātāleṣu mahābāho trīṃstrīnvṛddhikrameṇa tu || ekaikasya tathaivāṣṭau dikṣu cāpi vidikṣvapi || 5|| sthitāstathā ye vijñeyā narakā ghoradarśanāḥ || yāntyete pāpakarmāṇo narā yeṣu bhṛgūttama||6|| ekasminnarake kecitkramādanye bahuṣvapi || yāṃtyete mānavā rāma pīḍyamānāḥ punaḥpunaḥ||7|| narakāṇāṃ narāṇāṃ tu yātanākāriṇaśca ye|| ghorarūpāstu te proktā dṛṣṭamātrabhayāvahāḥ || 8 || mārjārolūkagomāyugṛdhraśyenakharānanāḥ || gajāśvoṣṭravarāhāṇāṃ siṃhānāṃ ca tathā pare || 9|| godhāmahiṣakākānāṃ madgusārasayostathā || urabhrājapataṅgānāṃ sarpamūṣakayostathā || 10 || anyeṣāṃ caiva sattvānāṃ tathānye jaṭharā narāḥ || skandānanāstathaivānye kabandhākāradarśanāḥ || 11 || bhīmānanā bhayakarā nānāyudhadharāstathā || ugravāco durādharṣāḥ sarpavṛścikaveṣṭitāḥ || 12 || tailadroṇyāṃ narānkṣiptvā jvālayitvā hutāśanam || susamiddhaṃ narānkāṃścitkvāthayanti punaḥpunaḥ || 13|| ambarīṣeṣu caivānyāṃstāmrapātreṣu cāparān || ayaḥpātreṣu caivānyāndravadvahnikaṇeṣvapi ||14|| śūleṣu ropitānanyāñśuṣkāgnāvaparāṃstathā || utkṛtya vipacantyetānanyāṃśchitvā tathā parān || 15 || kaśābhistāḍayantyanyāṃstathānyānapi mānavān || bhojayanti mahābhāga vahnitaptānayoguḍān ||16|| pāṃsūnapi tathaivānyānvāntamanyatra cāparam || viṣṭhāmanyatra ca kaphaṃ tathānyatra ca kaṇṭakān || 17 || anyatra vahnisaṃkāśāstathā bhārgava vālukāḥ || pāyayanti tathānyatra vahnivarṇāṃ ca vāruṇīm || 18 || anyatra nārakāṇāṃ te chindantyaṅgāni bhāgaśaḥ || pāṭayanti tathānyatra karapatraiḥ punaḥpunaḥ || 19 || pīḍayanti tathānyatra kṛtvā yantreṣu nārakān || ulūkhalakṛtānanyānmusalaistāḍayanti ca || 20 || kumbhīgatāṃstathānyatra kumbhītaḥ kiñcidudgatān || ghnanti mudgarakūṭena mahatīṃ vedanāṃ gatān || 21 || tvacamutkṛtya cānyatra śunāṃ narakavāsinaḥ || tyajanti te ca bhakṣyante tīkṣṇadantairmuhurmuhuḥ || 22 || andhakāre tathānyatra bhīmagandhe bhayāvahe || atyuṣṇe taiśca pātyante garbhavāsasame janāḥ || 23 || kākairgomāyubhiḥ sarpairvṛścikairmūṣakairapi || makṣikābhiśca bhakṣyante teṣāmanyatra śāsanāt || 24 || anyatra śālmaliṃ ghoraṃ saṃtaptaṃ tīkṣṇakaṇṭakam || sarpakīṭādibahulamāropyante narādhamāḥ || 25 || anyatra ca tathā ghorāṃ santaptāmayasaḥ śilām || āliṅgante suduḥsparśā teṣāmeva tu śāsanāt ||26|| anyatrāsevyavasatau vasanti bhayapīḍitāḥ|| tatra teṣāṃ tu nāsākṣikarṇavaktreṣu mānada || 27 || praviśanti mahābhogāḥ kṛmayo māṃsabhojinaḥ || kṣāranadyāṃ tathaivānye pātyante nārakānmuhuḥ ||28|| bahuśītāndhakāre ca pātyante narake pare || raktatoyavahāmanye prapadyante mahānadīm ||29|| asipatravane cānye kṛṣyante bhīmadarśanāḥ || tṛṣṇayā kṣudhayā cānye bādhyante tatra mānavāḥ || 30 || parānnapānaṃ lipsantastāḍyante kūṭamudgaraiḥ || pāyayanti tathānyatra parānyamabhaṭāstathā || 31 || tīvradhūmamadhovaktrānbaddhvā vṛkṣeṣu mānada || tvacotkartanamanyatra tilaśaḥ kriyate bhaṭaiḥ ||32|| kāṣṭhānyanyatra badhyante nārakāṇāṃ tathāsthiṣu || kūṭāgārapramāṇaiśca tathā dehairbhayārditāḥ ||33 || sūcīvaktrāṃstathānyatra yāpyante kṣudhayā bhṛśam || sicyante ca tathānyatra tailena ca guḍena ca ||34|| santaptena mahābhāga bhṛśaṃ duḥkhapradāyinām || anyatra jātapiṭakāḥ srastajihvāḥ suvihvalāḥ||35|| ghorātapavinikṣiptā bhakṣyante ca pipīlakaiḥ|| sūtreṇānyatra chidyante pādataḥ prabhṛti kramāt || 36 || tilaśo bhṛguśārdūla nārakāḥ parvatopamāḥ || yāvacca teṣāṃ mūrdhānaṃ tāvadeva punaḥpunaḥ || 37 || kṛtvā ca piṣṭaṃ pacanaṃ pacyante'nye tathā bhṛśam || ayaḥpātreṣu cānyatra tīkṣṇaśaṅkubhirāyasaiḥ || 38 || kriyante saṃyatā ghoraiḥ santapteṣu mahābhuja || āpothyante tathānyatra vinigṛhya śilāsu te || 39 || garteṣu te mṛdaṃ dattvā pūryante musalairbhṛśam || baddhāstambhe tathānyatra kṣipyante sāyakairnarāḥ || || 40 || śṛṅkhalābhiśca badhyante loṭhyante kaṇṭakeṣu ca || gandhenānyatra bodhyante viṣameṇa punaḥpunaḥ || 41 || nārakaiśca tathā sattvairnānāveṣairbhayānakaiḥ || yātanābhiśca bahvībhiryāpyante narake bhṛśam || 42 || anyonyasya ca māṃsāni bhakṣayantyapare tathā || hā tāta māteti tathā krandamānāḥ punaḥpunaḥ || 43 || nindantaḥ svāni karmāṇi tāḍyamānāśca tairbhaṭaiḥ || yātanābhiśca bahvībhiryāpyante bhṛgu nandana || 44 || vimuktanārakā hyanye vahnimanye suśītalam || vijānanti mahābhāga sukhasparśatamaṃ tathā || 45 ||| vimukto nārakācchītātsukhoṣṇaṃ himasaṃcayam || manyate sarvamevānyatsukhasparśatamaṃ tathā || 46 || narakebhyaśca śastrebhyo vimukto yo narādhamaḥ || śastrāṇyanyāni jātāni sukhasparśasamāni ca ||47|| sukhaduḥkhe tu mānuṣye tridive kevalaṃ sukham || narake duḥkhamevograṃ satataṃ bhṛgunandana || 48|||| tṛṣṇā tatra kṣudhā tatra gandhastīvro bhayaṅkaraḥ || yātanā vividhāḥ proktā bhayaṃ tatrātidāruṇam || 49 || durgandhikaṃṭakākīrṇaṃ tathā kuṇapasaṃkulam |||| keśāsthibahulaṃ bhīmaṃ narakaṃ duḥkhameva tu || 50 || ārtanādamahānādakākakravyādasaṃkulam || kṛmikīṭapataṅgāḍhyaṃ pūyāsṛgbahulaṃ tathā || 51 ||| anyo'nyakleśasaṃyuktamanyo'nyakarṣakārakam || anyo'nyatāḍakaṃ ghoraṃ tathā'nyonyabhayaṅkaram || 52 || evameteṣu te pāpā narakeṣu samāgatāḥ || bahavaḥ khalu yāpyante mānavāḥ pāpakāriṇaḥ || 53 || yāvatteṣāṃ na pāpāni kṣayaṃ yānti bhṛgūttama || tāvatte na vimucyante narakād ghoradarśanāt || 54 || atyantabhīmā narakāḥ sughorā bhayāvahavyālagaṇāvakīrṇāḥ || bhaktiṃ vahantaḥ puruṣottamasya na yānti te bhārgavavaṃśamukhya || 55 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0saṃ0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne narakayātanāvarṇanannāmaikonaviṃśatyuttaraśatatamodhyāyaḥ||119|| <2.120> rāma uvāca || karmaṇā kena dharmajña narā narakavāsinaḥ || kāṃ kāṃ yoniṃ prapadyante tiraśco brūhi tanmama || 1 || puṣkara uvāca || amedhyamadhye kṛmayo mahāpātakino janāḥ || bhavanti bahudhā bhūmyāṃ tataścaiva śilāsu te || 2 || tṛṇagucchalatāgulmadrumatvaṃ prāpyate kramāt || bhavanti ca mṛgāḥ paścānnityaṃ vyādhabhayārditāḥ || 3 || brahmasvahāriṇo hiṃsrā raudrācārāḥ sadaiva tu || aṭavyāṃ ghorarūpāyāṃ jāyante brahmarākṣasāḥ || 4 || paradāraratā mūḍhāḥ santaptāyāṃ tathā bhuvi || kṛkalāsā hi jāyante piśācāścāpyanantaram || aṭavyāṃ ghorarūpāyāṃ saṃśuṣkadrumakoṭare || kṛṣṇāhayo hi jāyante tataḥ paścānna saṃśayaḥ || 6 || kūṭasākṣipradāḥ pāpāstvamedhye kṛmayaściram || kṛtvā bhavanti sarpāste piśācāstadanantaram || 7 || gurumitradruhaḥ pāpā ye ca svā miduho janāḥ || dvijaśiṣyadruhaścaiva kṛtaghnā nāstikāstathā || 8 || tyāgino bāndhavānāṃ ca tyāginaḥ śaraṇārthinām || nikṣepahāriṇo ye ca kanyakākrayiṇaśca ye || 9 || amedhye kṛmayaḥ sarpā mṛgā vyālamṛgāstathā || tato ghoragaṇopetā jāyante jambukāḥ khalāḥ || 10 || parasvahāriṇaḥ pāpāḥ kuñjarāsturagāḥ kharāḥ || balīvardāstathaivoṣṭrā jāyante nātra saṃśayaḥ || 11 || hṛtaṃ yasya tu tairdravyaṃ tasya bhāgyānurūpataḥ || ātmadoṣānusāreṇa jāyante dhaninastu te || 12 || candrārkagrahaṇe bhuktvā jāyante kuñjarā narāḥ || āmaśrāddhaṃ tathā bhuktvā jāyante gṛdhrayoniṣu ||13 || asatpratigrahaṃ rāma gṛhītvā vānarāstathā || āśābhaṅgaṃ tathā kṛtvā śṛgālāśca tathādhamāḥ || 14 || sūcakastu durācāro vāgurirnāma jāyate || bahu kālaṃ mahābhāga bhūyobhūya iti śrutiḥ ||15 || māṃsabhugyāvatāṃ rāma māṃsamaśnāti dehinām || tāvatāṃ yonimāpnoti bhūyobhūyo na saṃśayaḥ || 16 || bhoktavyāni ca taistasya rāma māṃsānyasaṃśayam || yāvantaḥ prāṇino yena bahirvedyāṃ nipātitāḥ|| 17|| tāvatyo yonayastena gantavyā bhṛgusattama ||| yonauyonau ca hantavyastenāsau nātra saṃśayaḥ || 18|| vāntāśī guṇapāśī ca pūyabhugrudhirāśinaḥ || svakarmavicyutā varṇā jāyante pretayoniṣu||19||| dhānyaṃ hṛtvā bhavatyākhuḥ kāṃsyaṃ haṃso jalaṃ plavaḥ || madhu daṃśaḥ payaḥ kāko rasaṃ śvā nakulo ghṛtam || 20 || māṃsaṃ gṛdhro vasāṃ madgustailaṃ tailāpagaḥ khagaḥ || cīrīvākastu lavaṇaṃ balākā śakunirdadhi || 21 || kauśeyaṃ tittirirhṛtvā kṣaumaṃ hṛtvā ca darduraḥ || karpāsaṃ tāntavaṃ krauñcaṃ gāṃ godhā vāgudo guḍam || 22 || chucchundariḥ śubhāngandhānpatraśākaṃ śikhī tathā || makṣikāstu tathaivānnamakṛtānnaṃ tu śalyakaḥ || 23 || bheko bhavati hattvāgniṃ gṛhahārī ca taskaraḥ || raktāni hṛtvā vāsāṃsi jāyate jīvajīvakaḥ || 24 || vṛko mṛgebhaṃ vyāghrāśvaṃ phalapuṣpaṃ tu markaṭaḥ ||| striyaṃ hṛtvā bhavedyakṣo yānamuṣṭraḥ paśūnajaḥ || 25 || yadvā tadvā paradravyamapahṛtya balānnaraḥ || avaśyaṃ yāti tiryaktvaṃ jagdhvā caivāhutaṃ haviḥ || || 26 || tiryakṣu duḥkhaṃ paramaṃ viditvā pāpāni varjyāni nareṇa nityam || bhaktiśca kāryā madhusūdanasya tayā sa duḥkhaṃ sakalaṃ jahāti || 27 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0 sa0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne tiryagyonivarṇanannāma viṃśatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 120 || <2.121> rāma uvāca || narakādyānti tiryaktvaṃ tato mānuṣyameva ca || teṣāṃ cihnāni me brūhi mānuṣye varuṇātmaja ||1|| puṣkara uvāca || maṇimuktāpravālāni ratnāni vividhāni ca || apahṛtya naro rāma jāyate hemakartṛṣu || 2 || yadvā tadvā paradravyamapahṛtya naro balāt || prāpnoti bhṛguśārdūla mānuṣye bhāravāhitām || 3 || yaṃ kañcid ghātayitvāpi prāṇinaṃ bhṛgunandana || māṃsaṃ bhuktvā tu dharmajña bhavatīha gadāturaḥ || 4 || suvarṇacoraḥ kunakhī surāpaḥ śyāvadantakaḥ || brahmahā kṣayarogī syāhuścarmā gurutalpagaḥ || 5 || piśunaḥ pūtināsaḥ syātsūcakaḥ pūtivaktrakaḥ || dhānyacauroṅgahīnaḥ syādavyaṅgo miśrahṛdbhavet || 6 || vyādhitaścānnahartā syānmūko vāgapahārakaḥ || vastrāpahārakaḥ śvitrī paṅguścāśvāpahārakaḥ || 7 || khalvāṭo matsarī rāma nāstiko vedanindakaḥ || bhūya eva samāpnoti tathā nāstikatāṃ dvija || 8|| andho dīpāpahārī syātkāṇo nirvāpakastathā || andho bhavati goghnastu ghāṇṭikastailikastathā || 9 || daridraḥ paravittaghno unmattaśca tathāgnidaḥ || pratikūlo guroryastu so'pasmārī prajāyate || 2.121.10 || miṣṭāśyeko mahābhāga vātagulmī bhavennaraḥ || khagabhakṣyastu kuṇḍāśī dīrgharogī ca pīḍakaḥ || 11 || bhavatīha mṛgavyādhastvavikreyasya vikrayāt || ślīpadī cāvakīrṇī syānmūrkhaścākrośako bhavet ||12|| uktāstu mukhyā hi mayā tiraścāṃ yā yonayo yāni ca lakṣaṇāni || śakyaṃ na kārtsyena mayā pravaktuṃ yā yātanāścaiva narādhamānām ||13|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0 saṃ0 nārakicihnavarṇanannāmaikaviṃśatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 121 || <2.122> mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || etacchrutvā yaduśreṣṭha rāmo ratikaraḥ pituḥ || papāta bhuvi niśceṣṭaśchinnamūla iva drumaḥ || || 1 || taṃ visaṃjñaṃ mahābhāga pīnonnatapayodharāḥ || sacandanaiḥ śītajalaiḥ siṣicurdevayoṣitaḥ || 2 || vāruṇerājñayā cānyāstālavṛntairmanoramaiḥ || vījayanti mahābhāga rāmaṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ varam || 3 || labdhasaṃjñaṃ muhūrtena bhārgavaṃ cittavihvalam || āśvāsayāmāsa tadā vāruṇiḥ paravīrahā || 4 || | samāśvastastato rāmaḥ papraccha varuṇātmajam || durgātitaraṇaṃ vīro rāmo dharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ || 5 || rāma uvāca || || kliśyamāneṣu bhūteṣu taistairbhāvaistatastataḥ || durgāṇyatitaredyena brūhi me varuṇātmaja || 6 || puṣkara uvāca || āśrameṣu yathokteṣu yathoktaṃ te dvijātayaḥ || vartante saṃyatātmāno durgāṇyatitaranti te || 7 || ye dambhānna jahatīha yeṣāṃ vṛttiśca saṃvṛtā || viṣayām̐śca na gṛhṇanti durgāṇyatitaranti te || 8 || vāsayantyatithīnnityaṃ nityaṃ ye cānasūyakāḥ || nityaṃ svādhyāyaśīlāśca durgāṇyatitaranti te || 9 || mātāpitrośca ye vṛttiṃ vartante dharmakovidāḥ || varjayanti divāsvāpaṃ durgāṇyatitaranti te || 2.122.10 || sveṣu dāreṣu vartante nyāyavṛttimṛtāvṛtau || agnihotraparāḥ santo durgāṇyati taranti te || 11 || āhaveṣu ca ye śūrāstyaktvā maraṇajaṃ bhayam || dharmeṇa jayamicchanti durgāṇyatitaranti te || 12 || ye pāpāni na kurvanti karmaṇā manasā girā || nikṣiptadaṇḍā bhūtānāṃ durgāṇyatitaranti te || 13 || karmāṇyakuhakārthāni yeṣāṃ vācaśca sūnṛtāḥ || yeṣāmarthaśca sādhvartho durgāṇyatitaranti te || 14 || ye tapaśca tapasyanti kaumārabrahmacāriṇaḥ || vidyāvedavratasnātā durgāṇyatitaranti te || 15 || yeṣāṃ na kaścittrasati trasyanti na ca kasyacit || yeṣāmātmasamo loko durgāṇyatitaranti te||16|| paraśriyā na tapyante santaḥ puruṣasattamāḥ || grāmyāsvāda nivṛttāśca durgāṇyatitaranti te||17|| sarvāndevānnamasyanti sarvāndharmāṃśca śṛṇvate || ye śraddadhānāḥ puruṣā durgāṇyatitaranti te||18|| ye na lobhānnayantyarthānrājāno rajasā vṛtāḥ || viṣayānparirakṣanto durgāṇyatitaranti te||19|| ye na mānitumicchanti mānayanti ca ye narān || mānyamānānnamasyanti durgāṇyatitaranti te ||2.122.20|| ye ca śrāddhāni kurvanti tithyāṃtithyāṃ prajārthinaḥ || suviśuddhena manasā durgāṇyatitaranti te||21|| ye krodhaṃ naiva kurvanti krodhārtaṃ śamayanti ca || na ca kupyanti bhṛtyānāṃ durgāṇyatitaranti te||22|| madhu māṃsaṃ ca ye nityaṃ varjayantīha mānavāḥ|| janmaprabhṛti madyaṃ ca durgāṇyatitaranti te||23|| yātrārthaṃ bhojanaṃ yeṣāṃ santānārthaṃ ca maithunam || vāk satyavacanārthāya durgāṇyatitaranti te ||24|| taḍāgārāmakartārastathānye vṛkṣaropakāḥ || kūpānāṃ ye ca kartāro durgāṇyatitaranti te || 25 || gavāṃ grāsapradātāro gavāṃ kaṇḍūyakāśca ye|| bhaktimanto gavāṃ ye ca durgāṇyati taranti te || 26 || pūjayanti sadā viprānsādhūnapi gurūm̐stathā || tapasvinaśca dharmajña durgāṇyatitaranti te || 27 || gāyatrījāpaniratāstīrthayātrāratāśca ye || ye caikamāśritāstīrthaṃ durgāṇyatitaranti te || 28 || ye caikamāśritā devaṃ sarvabhāvena bhārgava || dharmajñāśca vinītāśca durgāṇyati taranti te || 29 || sāyaṃ prātaśca bhuñjānāḥ pibantyāpastu ye narāḥ || sadopavāsino rāma durgāṇyatitaranti te || 2.122.30 || upavāsaratā nityaṃ nityaṃ vrataparāyaṇāḥ|| nityaṃ saṃyatacittāśca durgāṇyatitaranti te||33|| durgātitaraṇaṃ ye ca paṭhanti śrāvayanti ca || kathayanti ca viprebhyo durgāṇyati taranti te || 32 || īśvaraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ jagatāṃ prabhavo'pyayaḥ || bhaktā nārāyaṇe caiva durgāṇyatitaranti te || 33 || bhaktānāṃ keśave rāma na bhayaṃ vidyate kvacit || tathā gītaśca śloko'yaṃ yamena śṛṇu bhārgava || 34 || pṛthvīśataskarabhujaṅgahutāśavipraduḥsvapnaduṣṭagatamṛtyusapatnajātam || saṃvidyate na hi bhayaṃ bhuvanaikabharturbhaktāśca ye madhuripormanujeṣu teṣu || 35 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0 saṃ0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne durgātitaraṇavarṇanannāma dvāviṃśatyuttaraśatatamodhyāyaḥ|| 122 || <2.123> rāma uvāca || bhūya eva samācakṣva karmaṇā yena mānavāḥ || durgāṇyatitarantyāśu sarvadharmabhṛtāṃ vara || 1 || puṣkara uvāca || durgāṇyatitarantyāśu ye narā kṛcchrakāriṇaḥ || prāpnuvanti tathā kāmānsarvānvai manasepsitān || 2 || rāma uvāca || kṛcchrāṇāṃ śrotumicchāmi nāmāni ca vidhīṃstathā || evaṃ me brūhi dharmajña tvaṃ hi vetsi yathātatham || 3 || puṣkara uvāca || kṛcchrāṇyetāni kāryāṇi rāma varṇatrayeṇa ca || kṛcchreṣveteṣu śūdrasya nādhikāro vidhīyate || 4 || ādau tu muṇḍanaṃ kāryaṃ sarvakṛcchre bhārgava || nityaṃ triṣavaṇasnānaṃ keśavasya ca pūjanam || 5 || homaḥ pavitramantraiśca tathānte jāpya eva ca || strīśūdrapatitānāṃ ca tathālāpaṃ vivarjayet || 6 || etatkṛcchreṣu sarveṣu kartavyaṃ cāviśeṣataḥ || vīrāsanaṃ ca kartavyaṃ kāmato'pyathavā na vā ||7|| vīrāsanena sahitaṃ kṛcchraṃ bahuguṇaṃ bhavet || vīrāsanena rahitaṃ vidhihīnaṃ prakīrtitam || 8 || rāma uvāca || vīrāsanamahaṃ tvattaḥ śrotumicchāmi suvrata || vīrāsanena sahitaṃ kṛcchraṃ bahuguṇaṃ yataḥ || 9 || puṣkara uvāca || utthitastu divā tiṣṭhedupaviṣṭastathā niśi || etadvīrāsanaṃ proktaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam || 2.123.10 || āmikṣayā tu dvau māsau pakṣaṃ tu payasā tathā || aṣṭarātraṃ tathā dadhnā trirātramatha sarpiṣā || 11 || nirāhārastrirātraṃ tu kuryādvā tālakavratam || sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ sarvakāmapradaṃ tathā || 12 || snapayedātmano'rthāya pāvakaṃ bhṛgunandana || vahnau tato''nujuhuyāddadyādannañca kasyacit || 13 || brahmā deveti mantreṇa sādhyamāne vicakṣaṇaḥ || darbhāṃstu khalu badhnīyādrakṣārthamiti naḥ śrutiḥ || 14 || śritaṃ ca śrāpyamāṇaṃ ca bhāṇḍe nyasta tathā punaḥ || anena rāma mantreṇa narastrirabhimantrayet || 15 || yavo'si dhānyarājo'si vāruṇo madhusaṃyutaḥ || nirṇodaḥ sarvapāpānāṃ pavitramṛṣibhiḥ| smṛtam || 16 || ghṛtaṃ yavā madhu yavā āpo vā amṛtaṃ yavāḥ || sarvaṃ punīta me pāpaṃ yanmayā duṣkṛtaṃ kṛtam || 17 || vācā kṛtaṃ karmakṛtaṃ duḥsvapnaṃ durvicintitam || alakṣmīṃ nāśaya tathā sarvaṃ punīta me yavāḥ || 18 || śvasukarāvalīḍhaṃ ca hyucchiṣṭopahṛtaṃ ca yat || māturguroraśuśrūṣā sarvaṃ punīta me yavāḥ || 19 || gaṇānnaṃ gaṇikānnaṃ ca śūdrānnaṃ ca tathā viśām || caurasyānnaṃ navaśrāddhaṃ sarvaṃ punīta me yavāḥ || 2.123.20 || bālavṛttamadharmaṃ ca rājadharmakṛtaṃ ca yat || suvarṇasteyamavrātyamayājyasya ca yājanam || 21 || brāhmaṇānāṃ parīvādaṃ sarvaṃ punīta me yavāḥ || bhāṇḍenyastasya mantro'yaṃ tatastu parikīrtayeta||22|| ye devā manojātā manoyujaḥ sudakṣā dakṣapitaraste naḥ pāntu te no'vantu tebhyaḥ svāhā anenātmani dharmajña juhuyātprayataḥ sadā || na kuryādatisauhityaṃ vratametaddhi yāvakam || 23 || medhārthinastrirātraṃ tu ṣaḍrātramatipāpinaḥ || upapātakinaḥ proktaṃ saptarātramarindama ||24||| mahāpātakinaścaiva ṣaḍrāttraṃ dviguṇaṃ smṛtam || ekaviṃśatirātreṇa kāmānāpnotyabhīpsitān || 25 || māsena sarvapāpebhyo mokṣamāpnotyasaṃśayam || gavāṃ nirhāramuktaistu yavaiḥ kṛtvaitadeva hi || ||26 || phalaṃ prāpnoti dharmajña tathā daśaguṇaṃ dhruvam || māsena sākṣāttridaśānvedānvidyāśca paśyati || 27 || varaśāpasamarthastu tathā bhavati bhārgava || śuklapakṣasamārambhādārabhetpratyahaṃ naraḥ || 28 || ekaikavṛddhyā hyaśnīyātpiṇḍāñśrīkhaṇḍasaṃyutān || ekaikaṃ hrāsayetkṛṣṇe pratipatprabhṛti kramāt || 29 || haviṣyasya mahābhāga nāśnīyāccandrasaṃkṣaye || etaccāndrāyaṇaṃ proktaṃ yavamadhyaṃ mahātmabhiḥ || 2.123.30 || etadeva viparyastaṃ vajramadhyaṃ prakīrtitam || aṣṭabhiḥ pratyahaṃ grāsairyaticāndrāyaṇaṃ smṛtam || 31 || prātaścaturbhiḥ sāyaṃ ca śiśucāndrāyaṇaṃ smṛtam ||| | yathākathaṃcitpiṇḍānāṃ catvāriṃśacchatadvayam || 32 || māsena bhakṣayedetatsuracāndrāyaṇaṃ smṛtam || gokṣīraṃ saptarātraṃ tu pibetstanacatuṣṭayam |33| stanatrayātsaptarātraṃ saptarātraṃ stanadvayāt || stanāttathaiva ṣaḍrātraṃ trirātraṃ vāyubhugbhavet || 34 || etatsomāyanaṃ nāma vrataṃ kalmaṣanāśanam || tryahaṃ pibedapastūṣṇāstryahamuṣṇaṃ payaḥ pibet || 35 || tryahamuṣṇaṃ ghṛtaṃ pītvā vāyubhakṣyo bhavettrayaham || taptakṛcchramidaṃ proktaṃ śītaiḥ śītaṃ prakīrtitam || 36 || kṛcchrātikṛcchraṃ payasā divasānekaviṃśatīn || gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi sarpiḥ kuśodakam || 37 || ekarātropavāsaśca kṛcchraṃ sāntapanaṃ smṛtam || etacca pratyahābhyastaṃ mahāsāntapanaṃ smṛtam || 38 || kṛcchraṃ parākasaṃjñaṃ syāddvādaśāhamabhojanam || ekabhuktena naktena tathaivāyācitena ca || 39 || upavāsena caikena kṛcchrapādaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || etadeva trirabhyastaṃ śiśukṛcchraṃ prakīrtitam || 2.123.40 || tryahaṃ sāyaṃ tryahaṃ prātastryahamadyādayācitam || tryahaṃ paraṃ ca nāśnīyātprājāpatyaṃ carandvijaḥ || 41 || piṇyākācāmatakrāmbusaktūnāṃ prativāsaram || ekaikamupavāsaṃ ca saumyakṛcchaṃ prakīrtitam || 42 || ambusiddhaistathā māsaḥ kevalairvāruṇaṃ samaiḥ || phalairmāsena kathitaṃ phalakṛcchraṃ manīṣibhiḥ || 43 || śrīkṛcchraṃ śrīphalaiḥ proktaṃ padmākṣairaparaṃ tathā || māsamāmalakaireva śrīkṛcchramaparaṃ smṛtam 44 || patrairmataṃ patrakṛcchraṃ puṣpaistatkṛcchramucyate || mūlakṛcchraṃ tathā mūlaistoyakṛcchraṃ jalena tu || 45 || dadhnā kṣīreṇa takreṇa piṇyākena kaṇaistathā || śākairmāsaṃ tu kāryāṇi sunāmāni vicakṣaṇaiḥ || 46 || sāyaṃ prātastu bhuñjāno naro yo nāntarā pibet || ṣaḍabhirvarṣairidaṃ proktaṃ kṛcchraṃ nityopavāsitā || 47 || ekabhaktena māsena kathitaṃ caikabhaktakam || na tu kṛcchraṃ tu naktena mahatsaṃvatsarādbhavet || 48 || naktāśinastu dharmajña ekabhuktasya vā punaḥ || tryahaṃ vopavasedyuktaḥ snāyīta savanatrayam||49|| nimnavatsu tathaivāpsu triḥ paṭhedaghamarṣaṇam || | devatābhāvavṛttastu cchandaścaivāpyanuṣṭubham || 2.123.50 || saṃsmarettasya ca tathā ṛṣiṃ caivāghamarṣaṇam || caturthe'hani dātavyā brāhmaṇāya tapasvine || 51 || tryahaṃ japedyathāśakti śuciścaivāghamarṣaṇam || bhāvavṛttastathā devastathā ca puruṣaḥ paraḥ || 52 || taddaivatyaṃ vijānīyātsūktaṃ tadaghamarṣaṇam || yathāśvamedhaḥ kraturāṭ sarvapāpāpanodanaḥ || 53 || tathāghamarṣaṇaṃ sūktaṃ sarvakalmaṣanāśanam || kṛṣṇājinaṃ vā kutapaṃ paridhāyātha valkalam||54|| saṃvatsaraṃ vrataṃ kuryātsammitaṃ nāma bhārgava || gṛhaṃ na praviśettatra bhavedākāśaśāyakaḥ || 55 || aśaktau vā bhavedrāma tathā śailaguhāśayaḥ || nityaṃ triṣavaṇasnāyī tathā syāddvijasattama||56|| bhaikṣyaśākaphalāhāraḥ kāmaṃ syāddvijapuṅgava || vīrāsanaṃ tathā kuryātkāṣṭhamaunaṃ tathaiva ca||57|| sarvakāmapradaṃ hyetatsarvakalmaṣanāśanam || vāyavyaṃ kṛcchramuktaṃ tu pāṇipūrānnabhojinaḥ || 58 || māsenaikena dharmajña sarvakalmaṣanāśanam || tilairdvādaśarātreṇa kṛcchramāgneyamucyate || 59 || lājāprasṛtimapyekāṃ kanakena samanvitām || bhuñjānasya tathā māsaṃ kṛcchraṃ dhanadadaivatam || 2.123.60 || gavāṃ nirhāranirmuktairyavaiḥ saktūnsamantrataḥ || yāmyaṃ kṛcchraṃ vinirdiṣṭaṃ māsena bhṛgunandana || 61 || gomūtreṇa caretsnānaṃ vṛttiṃ gomayamācaret || gavāṃ madhye sadā tiṣṭhedgopurīṣe ca saṃvaset||62|| goṣvatṛptāsu na pibedudakaṃ bhṛgunandana || abhuktāsu tu nāśrīyādutthitāsūtthito bhavet||63|| tathā caivopaviṣṭāsu sarvāsūpaviśennaraḥ || māsenaikena kathitaṃ gomūtraṃ kalmaṣāpaham || 64 || ajākṛcchraṃ tathaivaitadajāmadhye tu vartataḥ || tṛṇānāṃ bhakṣaṇeneha samatulyaphale ubhe || 65 || dvādaśāhena kathitaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam || upoṣitaścaturdaśyāṃ pañcadaśyāmanantaram || 66 || pañcagavyaṃ samaśnīyāddhaviṣyāśī tvanantaram || brahmakūrcamidaṃ kuryāduktapraśamanāya vai || 67 || pakṣānte tvatha vā kāryaṃ māsamadhye tu vā punaḥ || brahmakūrcaṃ naraḥ kuryātpaurṇamāseṣu yaḥ sadā ||68|| tasya pāpaṃ kṣayaṃ yāti durbhuktādi na saṃśayaḥ || māsābhyāṃ ca naraḥ kṛtvā brahmakūrcaṃ samāhitaḥ || 69 || sarvapāpavinirmukto yatheṣṭāṃ gatimāpnuyāt || brahmabhūtamamāvasyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ tathaiva ca || 2.123.70 || yogabhūtaṃ paricaretkeśavaṃ mahadāpnuyāt || evametāni kṛcchrāṇi kathitāni mayā tava ||71 || śāsanānīha pāpānāṃ duritānāṃ ca bhārgava || saṃvatsarasyaikamapi caretkṛcchraṃ dvijottamaḥ || 72 || ajñātabhuktaśuddhyarthaṃ jñātasya tu viśeṣataḥ || ajñātaṃ yadi vā jñātaṃ kṛcchraṃ pāpaṃ viśodhayet || 73 || kṛcchrasaṃśuddhapāpānāṃ narakaṃ na vidhīyate || śrīkāmaḥ puṣṭikāmaśca svargakāmastathaiva ca || 74 || devatārādhanaparastathā kṛcchraṃ samācaret || rasāyanāni mantrāśca tathā caivauṣadhāśca ye || 75 || tasya sarve hi sidhyanti yo naraḥ kṛcchrakṛdbhavet || vaidikāni ca karmāṇi yāni kāmyāni kānicit || 76 || sidhyanti sarvāṇi sadā kṛcchrakarturbhṛgūttama || tejasā tasya saṃyogo mahatā caiva jāyate || 77 || vāñchitānmānasānkāmānsa cāpnoti na saṃśayaḥ || jñāto bhavati deveṣu tathā carṣigaṇeṣu ca || vipāpmā vitamaskaśca saṃśuddhaśca viśeṣataḥ ||78|| ārādhanārthaṃ puruṣottamasya kṛcchrāṇi kṛtvā madhusūdanasya || surottamānāṃ samatītalabdhaṃ tallokamāpnoti janārdanasya || 79 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0 saṃ0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne kṛcchraprāyaścittavarṇannāma trayoviṃśatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 123 || <2.124> || rāma uvāca || vaidikāni samācakṣva karmāṇi surasattama || adhikārī bhavedyeṣāṃ kṛcchrakārī tvanantaram || 1 || puṣkara uvāca || śṛṇu kāmyāni karmāṇi puṣkalāni mamānagha || prativedaṃ mahābhāga gadato bhṛgunandana || 2 || antarjale tathā home japecca mānasepsitam || kāmaṃ karoti gāyatrī prāṇāyāmādviśeṣataḥ || 3 || gāyatryā daśasāhasro japo naktāśino dvija || bahiḥ snātasya tatraiva sarvakalmaṣanāśanaḥ || 4 || daśāyutāni japtvā ca haviṣyāśī susaṃyataḥ || vāyubhūtastadāpnoti yadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam ||5|| parasya brahmaṇo rāma vācakaḥ praṇavaḥ smṛtaḥ || puruṣasyāprameyasya sarvagasyāvināśinaḥ || 6|| tajjapeneha pūyante ye'pi duṣkṛtakāriṇaḥ || kārapūtaṃ salilaṃ nābhimātrodakasthitaḥ || 7 || śatajaptaṃ pibedyastu sa pāpairvipramucyate || akāraścāpyukāraśca makāraśca bhṛgūttama || 8 || yajurvedaḥ sāmaveda ṛgvedaśca vicakṣaṇaiḥ || kathitastu trimātraśca praṇavaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ||9|| mātrātrayaṃ tu praṇavastrayo devāḥ sanātanāḥ || eta eva trayo lokāstrayaścaivāgnayastathā || 2.124.10 || mahāvyāhṛtibhirhomātsarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || mahāvyāhṛtayo jñeyāḥ saptalokā vicakṣaṇaiḥ || 11 || gāyatrī paramā japye home vyāhṛtayastathā || antarjale tathā rāma proktaścaivāghamarṣaṇaḥ || 12 || agnimīle purohita sūkto'yaṃ vahnidevataḥ || śirasā dhārayedvahniṃ yo japetparivatsaram || 13 || homaṃ triṣavaṇaṃ caiva tathā tena samācaret || anagnijvalanaṃ kuryādbhaikṣāhārastu vatsarān || 14 || ataḥ paramṛcaḥ sapta cāgneyyaḥ parikīrtitāḥ || tā japanprayato nityamiṣṭānkāmānsamaśnute || 15 || medhākāmo japennityaṃ sadasatpadamityṛcam || ambayo yānti yāḥ proktā na bandhomṛtyunāśinī || 16 || śunaḥśephamṛṣiṃ tadvatsaṃniruddho'tha vā japet || mucyate sarvapāpebhyo gadācāpagadī gadan || 17 || yadīcchecchāśvataṃ kāmamindrātprāptaṃ purandarāt || ṛgbhiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ stūyādindrameti dinedine || 18 || hiraṇyastūpamityetajjapañśatrūnprabādhate || kṣemī bhavati cādhmāne ye te paktā japannaraḥ || 19 || raudrībhiḥ ṣaḍbhirīśānaṃ stūyādyo vai dinedine || caruṃ vā kalpayedraudraṃ tasya śāntiḥ parā bhavet || 2.124.20 || udityudyantamādityamupatiṣṭheddinedine || kṣipejjalāñjalīnsapta manoduḥkhavināśanam || 21 || dviṣantamityathānarcya dviṣyantaṃ ca japansmaret || agacchansaptarātreṇa vidveṣamadhigacchati||22|| ārogyakāmo rogī ca praskannasyottamaṃ japet || uttamastasya cāvajapedvairavināśane || 23 || || udayatyāyurakṣayyaṃ tejomadhyandine japet || astaṃ vrajati sūrye ca dviṣantaṃ pratipāditam || || 24 || navapadyeti sūktāni japañśatrūnniyacchati || ekādaśa suvarṇasya sarvakāmāṃstu nirdiśet || 25 || ādhyātmikaiḥ ka ityetajjapanmokṣamavāpnuyāt || āsano rudramityetaddīrghamāyuravāpnuyāt || 26 || tvaṃ someti ca sūktena navaṃ paśyenniśākaram || upatiṣṭhetsamitpāṇirvāsāṃsyāpnotyasaṃśayam || 27 || āyuripsannidamiti kautsasūktaṃ yadābhyaset || apa naḥ śośucaditi stutvā madhye divākaram || 28 || yathā muñjādiveṣīkā tathā pāpaṃ pramuñcati ||
