jātavedasa ityetajjapetsvastyayanaṃ pathi || 29 || bhayairvimucyate sarvaiḥ svastimānāpnuyādgṛham || vyuṣṭāyāṃ ca tathā rātrāvetadduḥsvapnanāśanam || 2.124.30 || pramanditeti sūryasya japedgarbhavimocanam || japannindramiti snāto vaiśvadevaṃ tu saptakam || 31 || muñcatyājyaṃ tathā juhvatsakalaṃ kilbiṣaṃ naraḥ || imāmiti japañśaśvatkāmānāpnotyabhīpsitān || 32 || mānastoka iti dvābhyāṃ trirātropoṣitaḥ śuci || audumbarīstu juhuyāddadhimadhvājyasaṃskṛtāḥ || 33 || chitvā sarvānmṛtyupāśāñjīvedrogavivarjitaḥ || ūrdhvabāhuranenaiva stutvā śastraṃ tathaiva ca || 34 || mānastoketi ca ṛcā śikhābandhe kṛte naraḥ || adṛśyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ jāyate saṃśayaṃ vinā || 35 || citramityupatiṣṭheta trisandhyaṃ bhāskaraṃ tathā || samitpāṇirnaro nityaṃ prāpnuyāttu dhanāyuṣī || 36 || etad duḥsvapnasyeti ca japanprātardinedine|| duḥsvapnaṃ dahate kṛtsnaṃ bhojanaṃ cāpnuyācchubham || 37 || ubheṣunāmīti tathā rakṣā ca parikīrtitā || nirvartya pañcayajñāṃśca hutvā cāgniṃ kṛtāhnikaḥ || 38 || devāsāviti devyedaṃ japankāmānavāpnuyāt || ātatāyinamāyāntaṃ dṛṣṭvā vyāghrādikaṃ naraḥ || 39 || na mā giranniti japaṃstebhya eva pramucyate || kayā śubheti ca japañjñātiśraiṣṭhyamavāpnuyāt || 2.124.40 || imaṃ nu somamityetatsarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt || pitrantvityupatiṣṭheta nityamannamupasthitam || 41 || nāsya syādannato vyādhirviṣamapyannatāmiyāt || agne nayeti sūktena pratyṛcaṃ juhuyād ghṛtam || 42 || pakvānnaṃ pratipadyeta kṛtvā cākarma garhitam || vīrānvayaṃ samāpnoti saślokaṃ yo japetsadā||43|| kaṃ katā ceti sūktena vighnānsarvānapohati || yo jāta iti sūktena sukhamāpnotyanuttamam|| 44|| ye parājannitīmāṃ tu duḥsvapnaśamanāmṛcam || ekāmāhamitīyāṃ tu vijñeyā śrīkarī tathā || 45 || caturdaśīmupoṣyaikāṃ kṛṣṇāsu juhuyād ghṛtam || āttasūktena raudreṇa vyādhimekaṃ vimuñcati || 46|| snātvānaśnañjapedapsu śītatrayamatandritaḥ || āmiṣasyetayormohātkṛtvā vā karma garhitam ||47|| adhvani prasthito yastu paśyecchakunamutthitam || apraśaste praśaste vā kanikradamidaṃ japet || 48 || aspṛṣṭvaiva ca japtavyametattaskaramohanam || oṃṣvityṛcamapāṃ madhye japedyo vai nadīṃ taret ||49|| uddhaurmibhiritīmāṃ tu japedrathagatastaran || adhvānaṃ prasthitaścaiva mantrairiti ca saṃsmaret || 2.124.50 || sudātāraṃ supuṣṭyarthaṃ sarvavede sthitaṃ naram || nāsti vidyāgamo yasya suyuktasyāpi bhārgava || 51 || sa sarpīriti ca japanmāsāttaṃ pratipadyate || yānākṣaṃ samabhajyantaṃ dṛṣṭvā durge'dhvani dvija || 52 || abhityavasyeti japedṛkṣamakṣabalaṃ dadhat || kṛṣṇapakṣacaturdaśyāṃ trirātropoṣitaḥ śuciḥ || 53 || dakṣiṇāpravaṇe deśe śmaśānasthaḥ samāhitaḥ || raktoṣṇīṣyasipāṇiśca taulākībhyo'nilāśanaḥ || 54 || saptāhaṃ juhuyāttailaṃ sārṣapaṃ lavaṇānvitam || samidho rājavṛkṣasya vasiṣṭhe dveṣiṇīḥ paṭhan || 55 || yaṃ dviṣyāttasya kṛtvā tu śamyā kenāhṛtaṃ niśi || adhiṣṭhāya ca taṃ kuryādṛgbhiśca tisṛbhirdvijaḥ || 56 || uddiśya rāma homo'yaṃ saptarātraṃ na jīvati || dvāviṃśakaṃ japansūktamadhyātmikamanuttamam || 57 || parvasu prayato nityamiṣṭānkāmānupāśnute || bṛhaspatimajāśvaṃ ca satāraṃ babhrumeva ca || 58 || pañcarcena stuvannetānpañcakāmānavāpnuyāt|| kṛṇuṣveti japansūktaṃ juhvadājyaṃ samāhitaḥ||59|| arātīnāṃ haretprāṇānrakṣāṃsyapi ca nāśayet|| upatiṣṭheta yo vahniṃ parītya ca dine dine||2.124.60|| taṃ rakṣati svayaṃ vahnirviśvato viśvatomukhaḥ|| ko adyeti ca sūktena vāsāṃsi labhate param||61|| kāyeti vāmadevena kuryātsvastyayanaṃ niśi||| haṃsaḥ śuciṣadityetacchucirīkṣandivākaram || 62|| kṛṣiṃ prapadyamānastu sthālīpākaṃ yathāvidhi || juhuyātkṣetramadhye tu śunā vāhastu pañcabhiḥ||63||| indrāya ca marudbhyaśca parjanyāya bhagāya ca || yathāliṅgaṃ tu viharellāṅgalaṃ tu kṛṣīvalaḥ || 64 || pūṣṇe dhānyāya sītāyai śunāsīramathottaram || | gandhamālyopahāraiśca yajedetāśca devatāḥ || 65 || pravāpaṇe pralapane khalasītopahārayoḥ || amoghaṃ karma bhavati vardhate sarvadā kṛṣiḥ || 66 ||| kṣetrasya patye tatkṣetraṃ sūryadṛgvindate bhuvam || ākhūtkareṣu caraṇau yajedetena mūṣikām || 67 || citrā indreti ca stūyānnāsya vṛṣṭibhayaṃ bhavet ||| vijyetiṣyeti jvalayedyatrecchejjātavedasam||68|| samudrāditi sūktena kāmānāpnoti pāvakāt|| viśvāni ca iti dvābhyāmṛgbhyāṃ yo vahnimarcati|| ||69|| sa taratyāpadaḥ sarvāḥ yaśaḥ prāpnoti cākṣayam || agne tvamiti ca stutvā dhanamāpnoti vāñchitam||2.124.70|| uroṣṭa iti sūktena vittamāpnotyasaṃśayam || prajākāmo japennityaṃ varuṇādevasannayā || 71 || svastyātreyaṃ japetprātaḥ sadā svastyayanaṃ japet || svastipanthāmiti prodya svastimānvrajate'dhvani ||72|| vijahīṣurvanasyānte śatrūṇāṃ bādhanaṃ bhavet || striyo garbhapramūḍhāyā garbhamokṣaṇamuttamam||73|| avacchāditi sūktena vṛṣṭikāmaḥ prayojayet|| nirāhāraḥ klinnavāsā na cireṇa pravarṣati||74|| śriyaḥ pañcadaśarcaṃ tu japañjuhuyād ghṛtena vā|| upaitu māṃ devasakha iti sarvauṣadhījalaiḥ ||75|| sadā snātaḥ śriyaṃ dīptāṃ kule prāpnotyasaṃśayam || manasaḥ kāma ityetāṃ paśukāmo naro japet ||76 || kardameneti ca snāyātprajākāmaḥ śuci vrataḥ|| aśvapūrvāmiti snāyādrājyakāmastu mānavaḥ||77|| rohite carmaṇi snāyādbrāhmaṇastu yathāvidhi || rājā carmaṇi vaiyāghre chāge vaiśyastathaiva ca ||78|| daśasāhasriko homaḥ pratyekaṃ parikīrtitaḥ || apsu vā juhuyādrāma padmānyayutaśo'gniṣu||79 || iṣṭāna ityṛcā vahniṃ stuvañśatrūnvināśayet|| ācāra iti sūktena goṣṭhe gāṃ lokamātaram||2.124.80 || upatiṣṭhedvrajeccaiva ya icchedgāḥ sadākṣayāḥ|| vāksiddhiṃ tu stuvañśakraṃ mahaddhanamavāpnuyāt || 81 || upaiteti mṛtī rājño dundubhīnabhimantrayet || tejo balaṃ ca prāpnoti śatrūṃścaiva niyacchati || 82 || tṛṇapāṇirjapetsūktaṃ rakṣoghnaṃ dasyubhirvṛtaḥ || ye ke ca metyṛcaṃ japtvā dīrghamāyuravāpnuyāt ||83|| yasya naṣṭaṃ bhaveddravya sampūjya sa japenniśi || saumāraudraṃ japansūktaṃ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate ||84|| jīmūtasūktena tathā senāṅgānabhimantrayet || yathāliṅgaṃ tato rājā vinihanti raṇe ripūn || 85 || agniṃ nareti sūktena stuvannagniṃ sukhī bhavet || prāṇapeti tribhiḥ sūktairdhanamāpnoti cākṣayam || 86 || abhītayaḥ pragāthena stutvā śakraṃ dhanī bhavet || śaṃvatīḥ śanna indrāgnī japedvyādhivināśanam || 87 || samudrajyeṣṭheti japetsūktametajjayāvaham | vāstoṣpate pratītyetatsūktaṃ vātoṣpaterjapet || 88 || anīvaheti sūktena bhūtānniḥsvāpayenniśi || sambādhe viṣame durge bandhe vā nigaḍaiḥ kvacit || 89 || palāyitvā gṛhīto vā sūktametattathā japet || trirātraṃ niyatopoṣya śrapayetpāyasaṃ carum || 2.124.90 || tenāyutaśataṃ pūrṇaṃ juhuyāttryambaketyṛcā || samuddiśya mahādevaṃ jīvedabdaśataṃ sukhī || 91|| taccakṣurityṛcā snāta upatiṣṭheddivākaram || udyantaṃ madhyamaṃ caiva dīrghamāyurjijīviṣuḥ || 92 || vyuṣā ityupatiṣṭheta yaḥ prātaḥ prayataḥ śuciḥ || prāpnuyātsahiraṇyādi nānārūpadharaṃ bahu || 93 || dhruvaṃ sandhyāsu kṣitiṣu japanbaddhaḥ pramucyate || idamāpaḥ pravahata yatkiṃcidduritaṃ punaḥ || 94 || apaḥ praviśya tu japansarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || sūktābhyāṃ para etābhyāṃ hutābhyāṃ bhūtimāpnuyāt || 95 || sūktābhyāṃ tisra etābhyāmāsyadalpodakasthitaḥ || upatiṣṭhanraviṃ devaṃ pañcarātre gate naraḥ || 96 || anaśnanbhārgavaśreṣṭha mahaddharṣamavāpnuyāt || indrāsometi sūktaṃ tu kathitaṃ śatrunāśanam || 97 || yasya lupyedvrataṃ mohādvātyairvā saṃsṛjetsaha || upoṣyājyasya juhuyāttvamagne vratapā iti|| 98 || ādityadṛkpramādraujaṃ japtvā vādī jayī bhavet || samagniragnibhiśceti prapadyedvāyubhāskarau || 99 || agniṃ prathamataḥ stutvā mahatkaṣṭātpramucyate || na hīti ca catuṣkeṇa mucyate mahato bhayāt || 2.124.100 || ṛcaṃ japtvā ya ityetatsarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt || prāgbhojanamidaṃ brahma mānavānāṃ maharṣiṇām || 101 || pūrvāhṇe japato nityaṃ tvarthasiddhiḥ parā bhavet || agninetyāśvinaṃ sūktaṃ mṛjākaramudāhṛtam || 102 || samidheti juhotyagnau prāpnuyātkīrtimuttamām || dvicatvāriṃśakaṃ caindraṃ japtvā nāśayate ripūn || 103 || nāśaṃ mahīti japtvā ca prāpnotyārogyameva ca || duḥsvapnaghnāḥ parā japyā naraḥ pāpaiḥ pramucyate || 104 || śanno bhaveti dvābhyāṃ tu bhuktvānnaṃ prayataḥ śuciḥ ||| hṛdayaṃ pāṇinā spṛṣṭvā vyādhibhirnābhibhūyate || 105 || ahorātroṣitaḥ snātvā śakraṃ sampūjya mānavaḥ || ita ityājyamutpūya juhuyādindramacaryet || 106 || ghṛtaṃ tilaṃ vā dharmajña bhayebhyo vipramucyate || tattvāmandamiti snāto hutvā śatrūnpramāpayet ||107|| tānvidyādityadaivatyaṃ japtvā mucyeta bandhanāt || yaddyāva iti japtvā ca sarvānkāmānsamaśnute || 108 || pavitrāṇāṃ pavitraṃ tu pāvamānaṛcaḥ smṛtāḥ || vaikhānasaṛcastriṃśatpavitrāḥ paramāḥ smṛtāḥ || 109 || ṛcāṃ dviṣaṣṭiḥ proktaṃ copavasedṛṣisattamaiḥ || sarvakalmaṣanāśāya pāvanāya śivāya ca || 2.124.110 || svādiṣṭayeti sūktānāṃ saptaṣaṣṭirudāhatāḥ || daśottarā ṛcaścaitāḥ pāvamānyaḥ śatāni ṣaṭ 111 || etajjuhvañjapaṃścaiva ghoraṃ mṛtyubhayaṃ jayet || ādhyātmikaṃ pavitraṃ ca sūktaṃ japtvālpataḥ kvacit || 112 || gatimiṣṭāmavāpnoti vindate mahatīṃ śriyam || āpohiṣṭheti mahataḥ prayuñjītodakasthitaḥ || 113 || sarvapāpavinirmuktastvaśeṣaphalamaśnute || upatiṣṭheta rājānaṃ yamasūktena vai dvija || || 114 || caturdaśyā tu kurvīta sthālīpākaṃ yathāvidhi || pareyivāṃsamityetatsūktamatra prayojayet || 115 || purāyuṣaḥ pramīyeta na sa jātu kathañcana || mṛtyumeva prapadyeta paraṃ mṛtyoriva dvija || 116 || vaiśākhyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ tu naktabhojī sadā naraḥ || purāyuṣaḥ pramīyeta na sa jātu kathañcana || 117 || phalāhāro jayenmṛtyuṃ tribhirvarṣaiḥ sadā naraḥ || daśākṣaraṃ tu śāntyarthaṃ bhadraṃ na iti saṃsmaran || 118 || phalāhāro bhavenmāsaṃ māsānmāsaṃ payaḥ pibet || vāyubhakṣyo bhavenmāsaṃ japannetatsahasraśaḥ || 119 || antardhānamavāpnoti siddhānpaśyati cāraṇān || pradevateti niyato japeta marudhanvasu || 2.124.120 || prāṇāntike bhaye prāpte kṣipramāyustu vindati || vaibhītakāṃstu trīnakṣāngandhaiḥ samadhivāsayet || 121 || puṣpairavakireccaiva sthāpayitvā vihāyasi || saṃhṛtya pādau tau tatra tiṣṭheddakṣastutiṃ japet || 122 || prāve māsetyṛcāmekāṃ japecca manasā niśi || vyuṣṭāyāmudite sūrye dyūte jayamavāpnuyāt || 123 || abradhnamuṣasānaktetyetatsvastyayanaṃ japet || namo mitrasya varuṇasya cakṣuṣeti ca nityaśaḥ || 124 || tathājyaṃ juhuyānnityaṃ bhītibhyo vipramucyate || devasyarīti nityaṃ tu japeddevaṃ samaśnute || 125 || mā pragāmīti mūḍhastu panthānaṃ pathi vindati || kṣīṇāyuriti manyeta yaṃ kacitsuhṛdaṃ priyam ||126|| yatteyamiti tu snātastasya mūrdhānamālabhet || sahasrakṛtvā pañcāhaṃ tenāyurvindate punaḥ||127|| sruksruve daśamenaiva idhmamaudumbaraṃ bhavet || idamidhmeti juhuyād ghṛtaṃ prājñaḥ sahasraśaḥ || 128|| paśukāmo gavāṃ goṣṭhe annakāmaścatuṣpathe || pārāvataḥ svastyayanaṃ snātakasya vidhīyate || 129 || bṛhaspate prathamamiti jñānakāmasya bhārgava || vayaḥ suparṇamityetāṃ japanvai vindate śriyam ||2.124.130|| yaste manyo iti sadā mayatnaghnaṃ vidhīyate || haviṣmatīyamabhyasya sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 131 || yā oṣadhīḥ svastyayanaṃ sarvapāpavināśanam || | tasya māyā vinaśyeta kāyāgnirvardhate tathā || 132 || bṛhaspatiḥ pratītyetad vṛṣṭikāmaḥ prayojayet || sarvatra tu parā śaktirjñeyā pratirathā tathā || || 133 || bhūtāṃśaṃ kāśyapaṃ nityaṃ prajākāmasya kīrtitam || ahaṃ rudrebhirityetadvāggmī bhavati mānavaḥ || 134 || na yonau jāyate vidvāṃñjapannatrīti rātriṣu || rātrisūktaṃ japanrātrau rātrikṣemī bhavennaraḥ || 135 || yā kalpayatīti japennityaṃ kṛtvā vināśanam || āyuṣyaṃ caiva varcasyaṃ sūktaṃ dākṣāyaṇaṃ mahat || 136 || uta devā iti japedāmayaghnaṃ dhṛtavrataḥ || agne agnāva ityeddhanakāmaḥ prayojayet || 137 || vaibhītake'bdaṃ hutvāgniṃ dviṣaddveṣaṃ tato japet || dviṣantu dhanvinaṃ hutvā dviṣato vindate dhanam || 138 || ayamagne janiteti japedagniṃ bhaye sati || dvimārjanniti pāṭhaṃ tu japannutthāpayeddvijaḥ || 139 || prātaśca pāṭhayedenaṃ saṃsadi brahmacāriṇām || imāmiti ca sūktena śatakṛtvo'bhimantritam || 2.124.140 || ghṛtena pītvā taṃ prātaḥ sapatnībhirvimucyate || araṇyānītyaraṇyeṣu japettadbhayanāśanam || 141 || śraddhāsūktaṃ japennityaṃ śraddhākāmavivardhanam || brāhmī yadyasya sūkte dve japeta niyataḥ sadā || 142|| śaṃkhapuṣpīṃ tu payasā brāhmīpuṣpāṇi sarpiṣā || śatāvarī tu payasā vacāmadbhirghṛtena vā || 143 || sūktābhyāṃ hyanumantrābhyāṃ caikaikaṃ tu tryahaṃ pibet || śraddhāṃ medhāṃ smṛtiṃ puṣṭiṃ varṇaṃ lakṣmīṃ ca vindati || 144 || śāsannarthāñjapannityaṃ saṃgrāme vijigīṣataḥ || gṛhītadakṣiṇādarbhāngṛhītvā saṃspṛśejjapet || 145 || muñcāmi tvā haviṣeti yakṣmāṇamapakarṣati || brahmaṇāgniḥ saṃvidānaṃ garbhamṛtyuvināśanam || 146 || apehīti japetsūktaṃ śucirduḥsvapnanāśanam || devāḥ kapota iti tu kapotasyopaveśane || 147 || kauśikasya japetsūktaṃ ghṛtena juhuyāttathā || sapatnaghnaṃ prayuñjīta ṛṣabhaṃ japahomayoḥ || 148 || yenedamiti japtvā vai samādhiṃ vindate parām || mayobhūrvāta iti tu gavāṃ svastyayanaṃ param || 149 || yavānāṃ ca ghṛtāktānāṃ gomayāgnau samāhitaḥ || juhuyādgoṣṭha madhye tu dadhimadhvājyasaṃskṛtam || 2.124.150 || patantamiti nityaṃ tu japeta vijane vane || śāmbarīmindrajālāṃ vā mālāmetena dhārayet || 151 || adṛśyānāṃ ca sattvānāṃ māyāmetena bādhate || na pratiṣṭheti svastyayanaṃ nārīgarbhavivardhanam || 152 || viṣṇurṇyānamitīmaṃ ca tathaivāparamucyate || mahityṛṇāṃ mavosviti parisvastyayanaṃ japet || 153 | prāpayedvidviṣadveṣaṃ japecca ripunāśanam || āyaṅgauḥ saptarājñastu sarpānetaiḥ prasādhayet || || 154 || saṃsamidyuvaseccaitatsaubhrātṛkaraṇaṃ mahata || tacchaṃyorāvṛṇīmahe japetsvastyayanaṃ sadā || 155 || pitṝṇāṃ saṃhitāṃ vidyātpitṝnprīṇāti vai tathā || vāstoṣpatena mantreṇa yajeta gṛhadevatām || 156 || talliṅgairdevatāmantrairdevārādhanamucyate || japasyeṣa vidhiḥ prokto hute yajñe viśeṣataḥ || ||157|| homānte dakṣiṇā deyā yathāśaktyā ca bhārgava || hutena śamyate pāpaṃ hutamannena śamyate ||158|| annaṃ hiraṇyadānena amoghā brāhmaṇāśiṣaḥ|| siddhārthakā yavā dhānyaṃ payo dadhi ghṛtaṃ tathā||159|| kṣīravṛkṣāstathedhmāśca sarvakāmapradāḥ smṛtāḥ || samidhaḥ kaṇṭakinyaśca rājikā rudhiraṃ viṣam || || 2.124.160|| tailaṃ ca bhṛguśārdūla vijñeyamabhicārakam || saktavaḥ phalamūlāni śākāni vividhāni ca || 161 || payo dadhi suvarṇaṃ ca bhaikṣyaṃ nāśanamucyate || haviḥsnānaṃ ca kartavyaṃ sarvatra bhṛgusattama||162|| ṛcāṃ vidhānaṃ kathitaṃ tavaitatsamāsataḥ karmakaraṃ dvijānām || tato vidhānaṃ yajuṣāṃ nibodha samāsato dharmabhṛtāṃ variṣṭha || 163 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0 saṃ0 ṛgvidhānaṃ nāma caturviṃśatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 124 || <2.125> puṣkara uvāca || oṃkārapūrvikā nāma mahāvyāhatayaḥ smṛtāḥ || sarvakalmaṣanāśinyaḥ sarvakarmapradāstathā||1|| ājyāhutisahasreṇa devamārādhayeddvija|| manasaḥ kāṃkṣitaṃ rāma manaseptitakāmadam || 2 || śāntikāmo yavaiḥ kuryāttilaiḥ pāpāpanuttaye || dhānyaiḥ siddhārthakaiścaiva sarvakāmakaraṃ tathā || 3 || audumbarībhiridhmābhiḥ paśukāmasya śasyate || daśa caivānnakāmasya payasā śāntimicchataḥ || 4 || apāmārgasamidbhiśca kāmayankanakaṃ bahu || kanyākāmo ghṛtāktāni yugmaśo grathitāni ca||5|| jātīpuṣpāṇi juhuyādvāmārthī tilataṇḍulam || vaśīkarmaṇi śākhoṭavāśāpāmārgameva ca || 6 || vasāsṛṅmiśrasamidho vyādhighātasya bhārgava || kruddhastu juhuyātsamyak śatrūṇāṃ vadhakāmyayā || 7 || sarvavrīhimayīṃ kṛtvā rājñaḥ pratikṛtiṃ dvijaḥ || sahasraśastu juhuyātprajāvaśagato bhavet || 8 || vastrakāmasya puṣpāṇi dūrvā vyādhivināśanī || brahmavarcasakāmasya vāmāgraṃ ca vidhīyate || 9 || pratyaṅgirepsurjuhuyāttuṣakaṇṭakabhasmabhiḥ || vidveṣaṇe ca pakṣāṇi kākakauśikayostathā || 2.125.10 || kāpilaṃ tu ghṛtaṃ hutvā tathā candragrahe dvija || vacācūrṇena saṃpītāṃstānānīya ca tāṃ vacām || 11 || sahasramantritāṃ bhuktvā medhāvī jāyate naraḥ || sūryodaye'rkābhimukhaṃ putrakāmo japennaraḥ || 12|| ekādaśyāṃ guggulaṃ lauhaṃ bailvaṃ khādirameva vā || dviṣantantvāṃ badhānīti nikhanedripuveśmani || 13 || uccāṭanamidaṃ karma śatrūṇāṃ kathitaṃ tava || śakraṃ dhruvaṃ bhūpataye mahāvyāhṛtibhirbhavet || 14 || sūryastveti tathā mantraṃ jñeyā pratyaṅgirā parā || etenaudumbarairidhmairdevaṃ varṣāpayeddhruvam || 15 || ahorātraṃ jale japtvā cakṣuṣmānityayaṃ dvija || praṇaṣṭacakṣurdharmajña yogamāpnoti cakṣuṣaḥ ||16 || upaprayantamityetaddhutvā vipro mahānase || anuvākaṃ mahābhāga nityasannena yujyate || 17 || tanūpāgne'si iti ca dūrvā hutvā rujānvitaḥ || vyādhimokṣamavāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 18 || ihaiva tebhyaḥ patitaṃ gṛhītvā gomayaṃ dvija || ghṛtājyamadhusaṃyuktaṃ hutvā dhenuṃ tu tāṃ labhet || 19 || eṣa te rudrabhāgeti hutvā rāma gavedhukām || ardharcena tathāpnoti dhanaṃ nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ || 2.125.20 || ardharcena dvitīyena kṣetramadhye baliṃ haret || mūṣikāśalabhotpāte surāmāṃsāsavādibhiḥ||21|| bheṣajamiti mantreṇa dadhyājyamadhuhomakaḥ || catuṣpadānāṃ sarveṣāmupasargaṃ vināśayet || 22 || tryambakaṃ yajāmaheti homaḥ sarvārthasādhakaḥ || kanyānāma gṛhītvā ca kanyālābhakaraḥ paraḥ || 23 || bhayeṣu ca japennityaṃ bhayebhyo vipramucyate || dhattūrapuṣpaṃ saghṛtaṃ tathā hutvā catuṣpathe || 24 || | śūnye śivālaye vāpi śivātkāmānavāpnuyāt || hutvā ca guggulaṃ rāma svayaṃ paśyati śaṅkaram || 25 || akṛtyā iti caivāṣṭau ṛco hutvā ghṛtādibhiḥ || anvahaṃ tvāpadāṃ nāśaṃ svakule kurute dhuvam || 26 || bhavatyuttaravādī ca japtvā ca vidasītyṛcam || agnestanoriti tathā hutvā ca tila taṇḍulaiḥ || 27 || sahasraśastu dharmajña bhavetsarvātithirnaraḥ || yuñjate mana ityetadanuvākaṃ tu vaiṣṇavam || 28 || sāyaṃ prātaḥ samāsīta dīrghamāyuravāpnuyāt || divo vā viṣṇa ityasya karma vyāhṛtivadbhavet || 29 || viṣṇorarāṭamityetatsarvabādhāvināśanam || rakṣoghnaṃ ca yaśasyaṃ ca tathaiva vivara pradam||2.125.30|| ayanno yajña ityetatsaṃgrāme vijayapradam || idamāpaḥ pravahata snāne pāpāpanodanam || 31 || daivāṃśa iti daivetadabhicāreṣu yojayet || vyādhighātaḥ samidbhistu rājikāsṛgviṣaistathā||32|| yakṣmāhīti tathā hutvā bahirnirgamya mānavaḥ|| upaśrutiṃ tu gṛhṇīyātsā tasyāvitathā bhavet||33|| agne pavasveti hutaṃ brahmavarcasakārakam || udutyaṃ citramityasya karma vyāhativadbhavet || 34 || yasmānnarādabhyadhiko naro bhavitumicchati || svasti nendreti tu japettasya nāmāntasaṃyutam || 35 || bhavatyabhyadhikastasmādvidyayā yaśasā śriyā || tathā homādanenaiva dāsalābhamavāpnuyāt || 36 || viśvakarma haviṣyaṃ ca sūcīṃ lauhīṃ daśāṅgulīm || kanyāgre nikhaneddvāri tatassāsmai pradīyate || 37 || devasyeti tarītena hutenaivānnavānbhavet || vājasyasati caitena hutvājyaṃ saptabhirdvijaḥ || 38 || yadeva juhuyātpaścāttadevākṣayamāpnuyāt || agne accheti juhuyāddhanakāmo dvijottamaḥ || || 39 || tilairyavaiśca dharmajñastathāpāmārgataṇḍulaiḥ || sahasramantritāṃ kṛtvā tathā gorocanāṃ dvijaḥ || 2.125.40 || tilakaṃ ca tathā kṛtvā janasya priyatāṃ vrajet || paurṇamāsyāṃ tathā hutvā meghaṃ rājānamityapi || 41 || upasthānaṃ tathā kṛtvā dattvā cānnaṃ dvijanmane || somayājī bhavedrāma nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 42 || eṣa te nirṛtetyābhirabhicārakakarmaṇā || gṛhānnairṛtyake bhāge hutvā snātvā nadījale || 43 || kāpilādgomayānnityaṃ pañcagavyābhiṣecitam || kṛtvā rudrāṃstathā japtvā maitryamāpnoti guhyakaiḥ || 44 || rudrāṇāṃ ca tathā japyaṃ sarvāghaviniṣūdanam || sarvakarmakaraṃ homaṃ tathā sarvatra śāntidam || 45 || ajāvikānāmaśvānāṃ kuñjarāṇāṃ tathā gavām || manuṣyāṇāṃ narendrāṇāṃ bālānāṃ yoṣitāmapi || 46 || grāmāṇāṃ nagarāṇāṃ ca deśānāmapi bhārgava || anidrutānāṃ dharmajña vyādhitānāṃ tathaiva ca || 47 || maraṇe samanuprāpte ripuje ca tathā bhaye || rudrahomaḥ parā śāntiḥ pāyasena ghṛtena ca || 48 || kūṣmāṇḍairghṛtahomena sarvānpāpānapohati || saktuyāvakabhaikṣyāśī naktaṃ manujasattama || 49 || bahiḥ snānarato māsānmucyate brahmahatyayā || madhuvāteti mantreṇa hutvaivājyamatandritaḥ || 2.125.50 || sahasraśastu dharmajña dīrghamāpnoti jīvitam || hutvā dadhnā tathā putrānprāpnoti manasepsitān || 51 || gugguloḥ kaṇikābhistu saubhāgyaṃ vindate dhruvam || kṛtvāṣṭapatraṃ kamalaṃ tanmadhye śaśinaṃ likhet || 52 || lavaṇena tatastasya pūjāṃ kṛtvā yathāvidhi || saubhāgyaṃ mahadāpnoti madhuvāteti vai japan ||53 || japtvā puṣpavatītyevaṃ mantraṃ rāma sahasraśaḥ || devatāyai nivedyaiva kusumāni śivaṃ bhavet || 54 || jīmūtasyaiva bhavati mantraṃ jayakaraṃ dvija || payasvatīti payasā tathā hutvā sahasraśaḥ || 55 || brahmavarcasamāpnoti dadhnā vā bhṛgunandana || dadhikrāvṇeti hutvā tu putrānprāpnotyasaṃśayam || 56 || tathā ghṛtavatītyetadāyuṣyaṃ syād ghṛtena tu || bodhaśca meti kathitaṃ tathā svastyayanaṃ param || 57 || svasti na indretyetaṃ ca sarvabādhāvināśanam || iha gāvaḥ prajāyadhvamiti puṣṭivivardhanam || 58 || sruveṇa devasya tveti hutvāpāmārgataṇḍulam || mucyate vikṛtācchīghramabhicārānna saṃśayaḥ || 59 || bahitvadanyadityetatkarma vyāhṛtivadbhavet || bhadrayante palāśasya samidbhiḥ kanakaṃ labhet ||2.125.60 || haṃsaḥ śuciṣadityetajjapaṃstoye'ghanāśanam || catvāri śṛṅgetyetacca sarvapāpaharaṃ jale ||61 || deva yajñeti japtvā tu brahmaloke mahīyate || japtvā pitṛbhya ityetattṛptiṃ prāpnuyānnaraḥ || 62 || vasanteti ca hutvājyamādityāddhanamāpnuyāt || śivo bhavasvāgnyutpāte vrīhibhirjuhuyānnaraḥ || 63 || yāmyena iti caitacca taskarebhyo bhayāvaham || daṃṣṭrābhyāmiti caitacca vrīhibhirjuhuyānnaraḥ || 64 || yo asmabhyamarātīyānhutvā kṛṣṇatilairnaraḥ || sahasraśo'bhicārāttu mucyate vikṛtiṃ dvijaḥ || 65 || annenānnapatetvetaddhutvā cānnamavāpnuyāt || suparṇo'sīti daityasya karma vyāhṛtivadbhavet || 66 || manaḥ svatīti japtvā ca bandhanānmokṣamāpnuyāt || ropayeta vacāṃ rājā candre graste jalāśaye || 67 || yā oṣadhaya ityetajjapaṃstāmuddharetpunaḥ || tirātropoṣitaḥ kūrcāṃ kṛtvā tāṃ tāmrabhājane || 68 || tenaiva mantritāṃ candraṃ dṛṣṭvā māsaṃ sadā japet || sakāpilaghṛtakṣīre pītvā śrutidharo bhavet || || 69 || etamevauṣadhīpāne sadā mantraṃ japeddvija || siddhā bhavantyoṣadhayo mantreṇānena mantritāḥ || 2.125.70 || drupadā nāma sā devī yajurvede pratiṣṭhitā || antarjale trirāvṛtya mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ || 71 || iha gāvaḥ prajāyadhvaṃ mantro'yaṃ puṣṭivardhanaḥ || hutastu sarpiṣā dadhnā payasā pāyasena vā || 72 || śataṃ va iti caitena hutvā parṇaphalāni vai || ārogyaṃ ciramāpnoti dīrghamāpnoti jīvitam || 73 || oṣadhīḥ pratimodadhvaṃ japetkarmakavatsadā || lavane bījavāpe vā viśeṣātsiddhimāpnuyāt || 74 || sarvauṣadhīḥ samānīya sarvavrīhiyutāstataḥ || kṣetramadhye dvijo hutvā kṛṣimāpnoti puṣṭidām || 75 || apāmārgaṃ yavaṃ dhānyamoṣadhīriti mātaraḥ || gokāmaścāśvakāmo vā taṃ kāmaṃ śīghramāpnuyāt || 76 || oṣadhīḥ samajanteti hutvā cājyena mānavaḥ || bhayamāpnoti naiveha yātudhānabhavaṃ kvacit || 77 || granthāvatīti caitena pāyasaṃ juhuyāddvija || sarvatra śāntimāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 78 || sīrāṃ yuñjati ityetaddhutvā kṛṣimavāpnuyāt || ucchugmā iti caitena bandhanastho vimucyate || 79 || yuvā suvāsā etena vāsāṃsyāpnotyasaṃśayam || yasmim̐ścāpaḥ sthitaḥ kāṣṭhe tadgṛhītvā vicakṣaṇaḥ || 2.125.80 || sāyaṃ yakṣmeti mantreṇa śatrostu nikhanetpade || kuṣṭhī bhavati cāṣasya pakṣaṃ gṛdhrasya vā punaḥ || 81 || sahasramantritaṃ kṛtvā śatroḥ pratikṛtiṃ tataḥ || tena baddhvā tato mṛtyuṃ śatruḥ prāpnotyasaṃśayam || 82 || śatruṃ tu nāśayatyāśu sarvātaṅkavināśanam || prapatantīti ca ṛcā juhuyādoṣadhīrdvija || 83 || miṣṭānnabhāgī bhavati bhāṇḍānāṃ caiva rakṣitā || mā mā hiṃsīti cājyena hutaṃ ripuvināśanam || 84 || kāntāramadhvarasyeti madhusaindhavasaṃyutām || saubhāgyakāmo juhuyātstriyo vā puruṣasya vā || 85 || homo drapsaśca skandeti vaśyakāmasya śasyate || namostu sarpebhya iti pāyasaṃ saghṛtaṃ naraḥ || 86 || nāgasthāneti juhuyātsuvarṇaṃ prāpnuyādbahu || kṛṇuṣva pāja ityetadabhicāravināśanam || 87 || agne tiṣṭheti juhuyāddravyāḥ khalvabhicārakāḥ || śatrornāma gṛhītvā tu śatruṃ kuryāttadā vaśe || 88 || dūrvākāṇḍāyutaṃ hutvā kāṇḍātkāṇḍeti mantrataḥ || grāme janapade vāpi marakaṃ tu śamaṃ nayet || 89 || rogārto mucyate rogāttathā duḥkhāttu duḥkhitaḥ || audumbaryastu samidho madhumānno vanaspatiḥ || 2.125.90 || hutvā sahasraśo rāma dhanamāpnoti mānavaḥ || saubhāgyaṃ mahadāpnoti vyavahāre tathā jayam || 91 || yogāditi tathā hutvā devaṃ varṣāpayeddhruvam || apaḥ pibanniti tathā hutvā dadhighṛtaṃ madhu || 92 || pravartayati dharmajña mahāvṛṣṭimanantaram || agnirdevateti tathā yavamuṣṭyayutaṃ dvija || 93 || hutvā śraddheyavākyastu sarvatraivābhijāyate || ayaṃ pureti juhuyādanuvākena mānavaḥ || 94 || ghṛtapūrṇāni padmāni sahasraṃ bhṛgunandana || kanyāṃ tāṃ samavāpnoti yāmasau manasepsati || 95|| śriyamāpnoti ca tathā dhanamāpnotyanuttamam || namaste rudra ityetatsarvopadravanāśanam || 96 || sarvaśāntikaraṃ proktaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam || rakṣoghnaṃ ca yaśasyaṃ ca śrīrāyuḥpuṣṭivardhanam || 97 || abhyavocadityanena rakṣā syādvyādhitasya tu || siddhārthakānāṃ kṣepeṇa pathi caitatsadā paṭhet || 98 || kṣemeṇa svagṛhāneti sarvabādhāvivarjitaḥ || asau yastāmra ityetatpaṭhennityaṃ divākaram || 99 || upatiṣṭheta dharmajña sāyaṃprātaratandritaḥ || annamakṣayyamāpnoti dīrghamāyuśca vindati || 2.125.100 || pramuñcanto na ityetatṣaḍbhirāyudhamantraṇam || ripūṇāṃ bhaṅgadaṃ yuddhe nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 101 || māno mahānta ityetadbālānāṃ śāntikārakam || namo hiraṇyabāhave ityanuvāk harṣakārakam || rājikāṃ tilatailāktāṃ juhuyācchatrunāśanam || 102 ||||| namo vaḥ kirikebhyaśca padmalakṣe hute naraḥ || rājalakṣmīmavāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || bilvānāṃ ca tathā hutvā kanakaṃ bahu vindati ||1 03 | imā rudrāyeti tilaiḥ kṛtvā homaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ || śīghrameva mahābhāga dhanamāpnoti cintitam || 104 || anenaiva tu mantreṇa dūrvāhomena mānavaḥ || sarvavyādhivinirmukto bhayānsarvānvyapohati || 105 || varāroheṇa idhmānāṃ yāte rudraśivātanūḥ || hutvā'yutaṃ tu dharmajñaṃ putramāpnotyabhīpsitam || 106 || asaṃkhyātāḥ sahasrāṇi mantraistadabhicārakam || namo'stu rudrebhya iti proktā pratyaṅgirā parā || 1 07|| raktoṣṇīṣo raktavāsā raktamālyānulepanaḥ || anenaiva śmaśāne tu lohaśaṅkuṃ narottama ||1 08|| prādeśamātraṃ juhuyātsahasraṃ bhṛgunandana || kṛtyāmutthāpayejjātāṃ raktakumbhena pūjayet ||1 09|| pūrṇapātreṇa ca tathā sarvakarmakaro bhaveta || āśuḥ śiśāna ityetadāyudhānāṃ ca rakṣaṇam ||2.125.110|| saṃgrāme kathitaṃ rāma sarvaśatruvināśanam || imaṃ somamityetannadīṃ gatvā samudragām || 111 || snātastoye'yutaṃ japtvā hutvā daśaśataṃ tataḥ || sāṣṭaṃ manujaśārdūla grāmamāpnotyabhīpsitam ||112|| vājaśca meti juhuyātsahasraṃ pañcabhirdvija || ājyāhutīnāṃ dharmajña cakṣurogādvimucyate || 113 || manobhavasveti gṛhe tathā hutvā vicakṣaṇaḥ || vāstudoṣāṃstataḥ sarvānkṣiprameva vyapohati || 114 || agna āyūṃṣi caitena hutvevājyamatandritaḥ || sahasraśastu dharmajña vaśaṃ nāpnoti kenacit||115|| apāmpheneti lājābhirhutābhirjayamāpnuyāt || bhadrā itīndriyairhīno japansyātsakalendriyaḥ || 116 || agniśca pṛthivī ceti vaśīkaraṇamuttamam || adhvanīti japanmantraṃ vyavahāre jayī bhavet || 117 || brahmarājabhyāmiti ca karmārambheṣu vai japet || sarveṣu sarvadharmajña teṣāṃ siddhimupāśnute || 118 || nūnapādosura iti nyagrodhe dvijasattama || aśokapuṣpānsaghṛtāñjuhuyāllakṣasaṃmitān ||119 || tato dānavakanyāṃ tu svayameveha paśyati || anuvākasya śeṣeṇa tasyānnaṃ vinivedayet || 2.125.120 || dadāti sā tato rukmaṃ tūṣṇīṃ tatrecchayā bhavet || anugacchettatastūṣṇīṃ pāṇau saṅgṛhya sā naram || 121 || bilaṃ praveśayedrāma nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || śūnyāyatanamāsādya māṣamiśramathaudanam || 122 || kayā naścitra ityetajjapaṃstu juhuyānnaraḥ || hute śatasahasre tu tasya vidyādharaḥ svakām || 123 || suvarṇarāśiṃ dharmajña śīghrameva prayacchati || saṃvatsarośītyanayā ghṛtaṃ hutvā vicakṣaṇaḥ || 124 || yāvajjīvamarogī syāllakṣahomena paṇḍitaḥ || ketuṃ kṛṇvannityetatsaṃgrāme jayavardhanam ||125|| aindrāgnaṃ varma ityetadraṇe sannāhabandhanam || dhananāgeti mantraśca dhanurgrahaṇikaḥ paraḥ || 126 || vakṣyantīti tathā mantro vijñeyo jyābhimantraṇe || mantraścāhirivetyetattṛṇamantraḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 127 || yuñjatīti tathāśvānāṃ yojane mantra ucyate || āśuḥ śiśāna ityetadgātrālambhanamucyate || 128 || viṣṇoḥ krameṇa mantraśca rathārohaṇikaḥ paraḥ || ājaṃghantīti cāśvānāṃ tāḍanīya udāhṛtaḥ || 129 || yaḥ senā abhītvarīti parasainyamukho japet || ḍuṇḍubha iti vāpyetaḍ ḍuṇḍubhītāḍane bhavet ||2.125.130 || etaiḥ pūrvahutairmantraiḥ kṛtvaivaṃ vijayo bhavet || yamena dattamityasya koṭihomādvicakṣaṇaḥ || 131 || rathamutpādayecchrīghraṃ saṃgrāme vijayapradam || ākṛṣṇeti tathaitasya karma vyāhativadbhavet || 132 || yuvaṃ cyavānametacca bhayeṣu bhayanāśanam || ghṛtāhutisahasreṇa nātra kāryā vicāraṇā||133|| mitraṃ huveta ityetanmedhākāmasya śasyate || sa rāja iti caitena devatārādhanaṃ naraḥ || 134 || kuyādbhārgava sarvatra homajapyairyathepsitam || śivasaṅkalpajapyena samādhiṃ manaso labhet||135|| pañca nadya ityanena padmalakṣaṃ ghṛtāplutam|| hutvā śīghramavāpnoti śriyaṃ te padmamālinīm ||136|| ubhāvapi ta ityetadrūpakāmasya śasyate || yadābadhnandākṣāyaṇā mantreṇānena mantritam ||137 || sahasrakṛtvaḥ kanakaṃ dhārayedripunāśanam|| guhyakānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ tathā nirvahaṇaṃ param || 138 || imaṃ jīvebhya iti ca sītāloṣṭaṃ caturdiśam || kṣipedgṛhe tadā tasya na syāccorabhayaṃ niśi || 139 || parī me gāmaneṣateti vaśīkaraṇamuttamam || hartumapyāgatastasya vaśībhavati mānavaḥ||2.125.140|| bhakṣyatāmbūlapuṣpādyaṃ mantritaṃ tu prayacchati || yasya dharmasya vaśagaḥ so'sya śīghraṃ bhaviṣyati || 141 || śannomiti ta ityetatsadā sarvatra śāntidam || manasaḥ kāmamākūtiḥ puṣṭikāmasya śasyate || 142 || camaṣaṭkaṃ ca dharmajña sarvakāmakaraṃ smṛtam || ṣaṭkena ca tathā homaḥ sarvadevaprasādanaḥ || 143 || audāryeṇodakaṃ spṛṣṭvā taddoṣādvipramucyate || vivṛtaṃ caitadājyena hutaṃ śūlāpahaṃ bhavet || 144 || gaṇānāṃ tvā gaṇapatiṃ homa kṛtvā catuṣpathe || vaśe kuryājjagatsarvaṃ sarvadhānyairasaṃśayam || 145 || vaikaṅkatedhmahome ca samāstvāgna itītyapi || yaśasā yogamāpnoti vipulaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || 146 || agnirmūrdhetimantreṇa hutvaivājyaṃ hutāśane || tatprasādamavāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā||147|| evaṃ hi devatāliṅgaistathā rāma yathā svakaiḥ || hutaiḥ prasādayediṣṭāṃ devatāṃ nātra saśayaḥ || 148 || hiraṇyavarṇāḥ śucayo mantro'yamabhiṣecane || śanna āpaśca dhanvanyāḥ sarvapāpaharāḥ smṛtāḥ || 149 || śanno devīrabhiṣṭaye ceti śāntikaraḥ paraḥ || ekacakreti mantreṇa hutenājyena bhārgava || 2.125.150 || grahebhyaḥ śīghramāpnoti prasādaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || yājyānuvākau vṛkṣāṇāṃ samāgne varca ityapi||151|| tatprasādamavāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || gāvo bhaga iti dvābhyāṃ hutvaivājyaṃ sahasraśaḥ || 152 || gāḥ samāpnoti dharmajña nāttra kāryā vicāraṇā || uduttamaṃ varuṇa iti juhuyādbhṛgunandana || 153 || nadīvāhataḍāgeṣu sukṛteṣu dvijottama || saṃvadattāṃ hiraṇyakośaṃ rūpaṃ kṛtvā tathaiva ca || 154|| pravādasāṃ seti caiva gṛhe yajño vidhīyate || devebhyo vanaspata iti brahmayajño vidhīyate||155|| rātrīyakhya iti dvābhyāṃ rātriyajñāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || śame śamīkaṃ śamyākāmaśvatthaṃ plakṣameva ca||156|| udumbaraṃ ca nyagrodhamapāmārgaṃ ca gomayam|| yāṃ kuryāddarbhapiṃjūlāṃ dūrvāṃ prācīnagāminīm ||157|| sītāṃ loṣṭaṃ suvarṇaṃ ca tathā valmīkamṛttikām || saṃ vaḥ sṛjāmīti dvābhyāṃ bījānyapsu vinikṣipet || 158 || yā oṣadhaya ityetadanuvākaṃ tato japet || apāmivedviti tataḥ prokṣaṇaṃ tu vidhīyate||159|| innobhayamitītyetaccāṣṭarcaṃ juhuyāddvijaḥ || yaddevā devaheḍanamṛcastisrastathaiva ca || 2.125.160 || | hutvā samprokṣaṇaṃ kuryādbhūyaḥ sarvatra mānavaḥ || sarvotpātapraśamanaṃ karmaitatparikīrtitam || 161 || gāyatrī vaiṣṇavī jñeyā tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam || sarvapāpapraśamanī sarvakarmakarī tathā || 162 || etāvaduktaṃ yajuṣāṃ vidhānaṃ mayā hi kiñcittava dharmaniṣṭha || ataḥ paraṃ vacmi nṛvīra sāmnāṃ tanme śṛṇuṣvāyatalohitākṣa ||163 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeya vajrasaṃvāde rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne tantravidhānannāma pañcaviṃśatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||125|| <2.126> puṣkara uvāca || saṃhitāṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ japtvā viṣṇuṃ prīṇāti mānavaḥ || sarvakāmamavāpnoti tathā hutvā ca bhārgava ||1|| skandasya saṃhitāṃ japtvā skandātkāmānupāśnute || āsyadaghne jale tiṣṭhannaghenākīrṇamānasaḥ ||2 || triḥsaptakṛtvo japtvā ca sarvānkāmānupāśnute || || tathā ca saṃhitāṃ pitryāṃ tatprasādamupāśnute || 3 || gurugobrāhmaṇādīnāmuktvā nāma priyaṃ naraḥ || sopavāso japettoye tvidaṃ viṣṇurvicakrame || 4 || sadā gāvaśca śucayaḥ prayājyayajane japet || amedhyadarśane jāpoḥ panthā ame divaḥ || 5 || etadindrastavāmīti sarvapāpaharaṃ japet || śukraṃ te'nyadyajataṃ japtvā steyādvimucyate || 6 || cakrāniti tathā japtvā pārayāyī vimucyate || sahantaḥ somamityetajjaptvā mucyetpratigrahāt || 7 || yattatsoma indra iti hiṃsādoṣavināśanam || agnerbhayātpramucyeta agnistigmeti vai japan || 8 || sarvapāpaharaṃ jñeyaṃ parito ṣiñcatāmiti || parvāsusometi japejjīvituṃ tu sukarmaṇā || 9 || avikreyaṃ ca vikreyaṃ japedghṛtavatītviti || apyānī devasavito jñeyaṃ duḥsvapnanāśanam || 2.126.10 || trātāramindramityeva mahi trīṇāmavostviti || uduttamaṃ varuṇapāśetyāyuṣyāṇi japetsadā || 11 || śukracandreti jāpyena pūto bhavati mānavaḥ || śuddhāśuddhīyametacca taṃ vacosūktameva ca || 12 || nyagrodhaśṛṅgamādāya śaramūlaṃ tathaiva ca || trivṛtaṃ tu maṇiṃ kṛtvā juhuyācca sahasraśaḥ || 13 || bodhyāsiriti mantreṇa ghṛtaṃ rāma yathāvidhi || abhyajya ghṛtaśeṣeṇa mekhalābandha iṣyate || 14 || strīṇāṃ yāsāṃ tu garbhāṇi patanti bhṛgusattama || vaṇigjātasya bālasya badhnīyāttadanantaram || 15 || gorvai svarūpavatsāyāḥ śuklāyā juhuyādghṛtam || ugrapriyā tu śaraṇaṃ maṃtreṇānena mantravit || 16 || rakṣasā mucyate janturmaṇiṃ śirasi dhārayet || kautsyaṃ ghṛtaṃ tu prāśnīyānnityameva vicakṣaṇaḥ || 17 || viśvāpṛtanniti mantreṇa vyādhibhirvipramucyate || carṣaṇīvṛtametena ghṛtaṃ hutvā yathāvidhi || 18 || śatāyārimaṇiṃ baddhvā na sarpaiḥ paribhūyate || samatyāyantīti japenna mriyeta pipāsayā || 19 || iṣṭyāhotritayaṃ japtvā salile nāpnuyādbhayam || tvamemā oṣadhītvetajjaptvā vyādhiṃ na cāpnuyāt || 2.126.20 || yatte payāṃsi pūrveṇa grāsaṃ vai prakṣipenmukhe || nigireduttareṇaitannityamārogyamāpnuyāt || 21 || devavratena hutvājyamuccheṣeṇa vicakṣaṇaḥ || karavīrakamabhyajya daṇḍahastagatena tu || 22 || svastimāṃstena bhavati yatra kvacana gacchati || pathi devavrataṃ japtvā bhayebhyo vipramucyate || 23 || yadindro anayatveti hutaṃ saubhāgyavardhanam || bhadrānno agniriti ca dantakāṣṭhaṃ ca bhakṣayet || 24 || saṃvatsaramaniṣṭhīvanmadhvājyasahitaṃ sadā || saubhāgyaṃ mahadāpnoti yatra kvacana gacchati || 25 || bhago na citra etena netrayorañjanaṃ smṛtam || saubhāgyavardhanaṃ rāma nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 26 || japannindreti vargaṃ ca tathā saubhāgyamāpnuyāt || karipriyo divaḥ kaviḥ kāmyāṃ saṃśrāvayetstriyam || 27 || sā taṃ kāmayate rāma nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || rathantaraṃ vāmadevyaṃ brahmavarcasavardhanam || 28 || yaśasāmeti juhuyātpuṣpeṇa tu priyaṅgukam || yaśasā yogamāpnoti karmaṇānena mānavaḥ || 29 || prāśayedbālakaṃ nityaṃ vacācūrṇaṃ ghṛtāplutam || indramidgāthinaṃ japtvā bhavecchrutidharastvasau || 2.126.30 || hutvā rathantaraṃ japtvā putramāpnotyasaṃśayam || gīrvāṇaḥ pāhi satataṃ japtaṃ syādaghatārakam || 31 || mayi śrīriti mantreṇa japtavyaṃ śrīvivardhanam || dānāviśati devo'pi mantreṇānena dharmavit || 32 || krītvā ghṛtaṃ tu puṣpeṇa suṣumāṇītyataḥ pibet || alakṣmīnāśanaṃ karma mayaitatte prakīrtitam || 33 || puṣpeṇa sarṣapāngaurāṃścūrṇayitvā vicakṣaṇaḥ || indrehimatsyaṃ dharmeti kuryādutsādanaṃ budhaḥ || 34 || ghṛtasnānaṃ budhaḥ kṛtvā sarṣapāñjuhuyāttataḥ || adyetvīḍāvindriyeti mantreṇānena mantritam || 35 || puṣṭidaṃ karma kathitaṃ mayaitattava bhārgava || miśrānvrīhi yavānagnau hutvā bhṛgukulodbhava || 36 || munīśo dhāma etena dhānyabhāgī bhavetsadā || madhvājyadadhimiśrāṇi viprāṇīti juhoti yaḥ || 37 || sāṣṭaṃ sahasraṃ dharmajña śrāvayantīha mānavāḥ || māsopavāsī labhate kanakaṃ bahu bhārgava || 38 || gavyeṣuṇeti ca dvābhyāṃ yastu saṃvatsaraṃ naraḥ || nyagrodhajapaniṣṭhīvaṃ bhakṣayeddantadhāvanam || 39 || sahasrasaṅkhyaṃ sa dhanaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ || bhadro na agna ityetattathā hutvā sahasraśaḥ || 2.126.40 || audumbaredhmahomena mantreṇānena gāṃ labhet || hutvā vrīhiyavānagnau dhānyamāpnoti mānavaḥ || 41 || evāsi vīreyuriti dvādaśāhamupoṣitaḥ || sarpiṣā tvayutaṃ hutvā grāmamāpnoti mānavaḥ || 42 || vairūpāṣṭakavannityaṃ prayuñjānaḥ śriyaṃ labhet || śrāntāṣṭakaṃ prayuñjānaḥ sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt || 43 || gavyeṣuṇeti yo nityaṃ sāyaṃ prātaratandritaḥ || upasthānaṃ gavāṃ kuryāttasya syustāḥ sadā gṛhe || 44 || agne vivasvaduṣasā mantreṇānena mantravit || bhājanasyopanītasya yastvagraṃ juhuyātsadā || 45 || uttareṇa baliṃ dattvā sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt || kṣīraikavṛkṣamāsādya maṇibhadrāya mānavaḥ || 46 || aṣṭarātroṣitaḥ pūjāṃ kṛtvā dadyāttato balim || susaṃskṛtena māṃsena kṛṣṇapakṣaṃ kṣapedbudhaḥ || 47 || eṣasyateti madhumannindra etena bhārgava || suvarṇamāpnoti naro yāvadicchati śatruhan || 48 || śuklapakṣacaturdaśyāṃ trirātropoṣito naraḥ || maunaṃ māsaṃ pāyasaṃ ca rasatraya samanvitam || 49 || saptadhenavo duduhurmantreṇānena mantravit || kṛṣṇapakṣacaturdaśyāṃ trirātropoṣitastathā || 2.126.50 || matsyānupaharedrātrāvāsurīmāpnuyācchriyam || balayuktaśca bhavati dīptatejāstathaiva ca || 21 || dhānāvantaṃ karambhiṇaṃ mantreṇānena pāyasam || hutvā digaṣṭake dadyāddikpālānāṃ tato balim || 52 || vāstudoṣaharaṃ karma mayaitatparikīrtitam || rājā samācaretsnānaṃ puṣyeṇa śravaṇena ca || 53 || āprātṛvya iti sadā rahasyaṃ snānamācaret || svecchāpatitajīvantīgavāṃ śṛṅgasamudbhavaiḥ || 54 || kāśairmadhvājyasampūrṇairdadhikṣīrayutaistathā || niḥsapatnamavāpnoti rājyaṃ nirgatakaṇṭakam || 55 || ghṛtāktaṃ tu yavadroṇaṃ vāta āvatabheṣajam || anena hutvā vidhivatsarvāndoṣānvyapohati ||56|| prādevo dāsa etena kṛṣṇānhutvā tathā tilān || kṛtvā karmāṇi tīrthodaiḥ stainyātkṣipraṃ vimucyate ||57 || abhi tvā pūrvapītaṃ ye vaṣaṭkārasamanvitam || bādhakedhmasahasraṃ tu hutaṃ yuddhe jayapradam || 58 || hastyaśvapuruṣānkuryādbudhaḥ piṣṭamayāñchubhān || parakīyānathoddiśya pradhānapuruṣām̐stathā || 59|| svastyannāpiṣṭapacane kṣureṇotkṛtya bhāgaśaḥ || abhitvā śūra no numo mantreṇānena mantravit || 2.126.60 || kṛtvā sarṣapatailāktānkrodhena juhuyāttataḥ || etatkṛtvā budhaḥ karma saṃgrāme jayamāpnuyāt || 61 || āṣāḍhyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ tu sopavāso vicakṣaṇaḥ || sāyaṃ dhānyāni vastrāṇi sasyāni tolayeda budhaḥ ||62 || idhmamiddevatāmanne mantreṇāmantrayettu tām || pūjitāṃ vāsayedrātrau deśe paramapūjite || 63 || deśānāṃ bhūmipālānāṃ tathā devacatuṣpadām || mṛnmayānāṃ tu kartavyaṃ tathā rātryādhivāsanam || 64 || tulitānāṃ dvitīyehni tattadvṛddhi pravardhane || hīnasya kṣayamādeśyaṃ samasya samatā tathā||65|| govrataṃ tu budhaḥ kuryādādau māsacatuṣṭayam || tatastvaraṇyaṃ praviśettatra kuryājjapaṃ śubham ||66|| tapaḥ sadṛśamāsādya jāptvaitaditi vai sadā || sahasrakṛtvastu japetsaptarātratraye gate||67|| manasā kāṃkṣitānkāmāndhruvamāpnoti mānavaḥ|| antarikṣeṇa vā yāti rūpānyatvaṃ karoti vā ||68|| adṛśyatvamavāpnoti daityatvamatha vā punaḥ || taṃtaṃ kāmamavāpnoti yaṃyaṃ vā manasecchati ||69|| sāmnastu devatāṃ jñātvā tena sāmnā tu devatām || ārādhayetsuprasannā sāmnā syātsaṃśayaṃ vinā||2.126.70|| amūṣu pūrvaṃ tu sadā mantramāvartayecchuciḥ || candanenānuliptāṃgo jātipuṣpadharastathā || 71 || śvetoṣṇīṣaḥ śvetavāsāḥ sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt || evaṃ duduhaketyetatsopavāsastu yo japet || 72 || akṣataiḥ sumanobhiśca tathā vā gaurasarṣapaiḥ || avakīrya śubhaṃ deśaṃ tvekākī prasvapenniśi || 73 || vāgyatastu tathā svapne paśyatīti śubhaṃśubham || yathāvadbhṛguśārdūla bhaviṣyadbhūtameva vā || 74 || bhāruṇḍaṃ vāmadevyaṃ ca rathantarabṛhadrathau || sarvapāpapraśamanāḥ kathitāḥ saṃśayaṃ vinā || 75 || sāmnāṃ vidhiste kathito nṛvīra saṃkṣepataḥ karmakaro mayaiṣaḥ || ātharvaṇaṃ vacmi nibodha tanme cetaḥ samādhāya mahānubhāva || 76 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne sāmavidhikathanannāma ṣaḍviṃśatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 126 || <2.127> || puṣkara uvāca || śāntātītaṃ gaṇaṃ hutvā śāntimāpnoti mānavaḥ || bhaiṣajyaṃ ca gaṇaṃ hutvā sarvānrogānapohati || 1 || triṣastīyaṃ gaṇaṃ hutvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || kvacinnāpnoti ca bhayaṃ hutvā caivābhayaṃ gaṇam || 2 || na kvacijjāyate rāma gaṇaṃ hutvā parājayaḥ || āyuṣyaṃ ca gaṇaṃ hutvā cāpamṛtyūnvyapohati||3|| ete daśaguṇāścaiva hotavyāḥ syuryathākramam || aṣṭādaśasu dharmajña daśaśāntiṣu bhārgava || 4 || vaiṣṇavī ca tathā caindrī brāhmī raudrī tathaiva ca || vāyavyā vāruṇī caiva kauberī bhārgavī tathā || 5 || prājāpatyā tathā tvāṣṭrī kaumārī vahnidevatā || mārudgaṇī ca gāndhārī śāntirvai rudatī tathā||6|| śāntirāṃgirasī yāmyā pārthivī ca bhṛgūttama || etāstu śāntayaḥ proktāḥ sarvakarmahitāḥ sadā || 7 || yastvāmṛtyuritītyetajjaptaṃ mṛtyuvināśanam || hutvā ca mātṛnāmāni kāmānevamavāpnuyāt || 8 || suparṇastviti hutvā ca bhujagairnaiva bādhyate || yasyedaṃ bhūmimiti ca bhūmikāmo japetsadā || 9 || pṛthivyāmuttamosīti hutaṃ śraiṣṭhyapradaṃ sadā || audumbaraṃ yo na iti tathā vīryavivardhanam || 2.127.10 || indreṇa dattamityetatsarvabādhāvināśanam || hiraṇyavarṇa iti ca snānaṃ pāpaharaṃ bhavet || 11 || asitasyeti sarvāṇi viṣaghnāni bhṛgūttama || sārasvatīti mantrāṃśca viṣaghnānnirviśedbudhaḥ ||12 || śarabhādīni sarvāṇi piśācakṣapaṇāni ca || yamasya lokādityetadduḥsvapnaśamanaṃ param || 13 || agnerva iti cāpyetatkathitaṃ manyunāśanam || ūrdhvo bhavati vijñeyaḥ kṛtvā sthānakaraḥ paraḥ||14|| indraṃ vayaṃ vaṇijamiti paṇyalābhakaraṃ param || kāmo me rājñīti hutaṃ strīṇāṃ saubhāgyavardhanam||15|| bhadrāya karṇamityetatkarṇaprasyandane japet || bhadrāsākṣivadhe jātā karṇaprasyandane tathā || 16 || tubhyamevājiriti āyuṣyaṃ tu hutaṃ bhavet || āyātu pitamityetanmitralabdhikaraṃ hutam || 17 || āśāsānamidaṃ janā miśradhānyena homayet || ādhipatyamavāpnoti sarvatra manujottama ||18|| agnirīśebhirityetadgavāṃ vṛddhikaraṃ param || dvādaśāhaṃ tu juhuyātparākeṇa viśeṣataḥ || 19 || śāto haviritītyetadgrāmasvāsthyakaraṃ bhavet || tasmādgrāmānmṛdā kṛtvā vedisāmyaṃ samaśnute || 2.127.20 || vidhāya sveti sarvāṇi rāṣṭrasvīkaraṇāni tu || tribhyo bhadrebhya ityetadvāstoṣpatamudāhṛtam || 21 || dhruvaṃ dhruveṇeti hutaṃ sthānalābhakaraṃ bhavet || acyutāpostathā rāma kathitaṃ sthānalābhadam ||22 || payo deveṣviti hutaṃ rāyaspoṣakaraṃ param || yunakta sīreti śunā kṛṣilābhakaraṃ bhavet || 23 || ayaṃ te yonirityetatputralābhakaraṃ bhavet || śune vatsā tathā hyetadgavāṃ vṛddhikaraṃ hutam || 24 || ... ... meti kathitaṃ sarvatra śraiṣṭhyakārakam || yadagna iti cāpyetadbandhanānmokṣakārakam || 25 || yo na sva iti cāpyetacchatrunāśakaraṃ param || savannahanniti tathā nātra kāryā vicāraṇā||26|| tvamatvamamitītyetadyaśaso vardhanaṃ param || yathā vṛṣimitītyetatstrīṇāṃ saubhāgyavardhanam || || 27 || āno agna ityetacca kathitaṃ patilābhadam || yena veheti māṃ caiva garbhalābhakaraṃ bhavet || 28 || imaṃ tapasvinniti tathā bhavetsaubhāgyavardhanam || yatpṛthivyāmanāvṛttaṃ hutametadyathāvidhi ||29 || kṛtvā tu saṃśanaṃ jñeyaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || ...........||2.127.30||| śivaṃ śivābhirityetadbhavecchreyaskaraṃ param || dūtyā dūṣaṇamityetatkṛtyādūṣaṇamucyate || 31 || bṛhaspatiḥ paripātu pathi svastyayanaṃ bhavet || mano vivanna bhayadaṃ pathi svastyayanaṃ bhavet || 32 || ayanno agniradhyakṣo bhavedagniprasādataḥ || saṃvatsaraṃ tu śirasā dhārayedyo hutāśanam || 33 ||' mantrametajjapennityamāgneyāśāmukhaḥ sthitaḥ || anagnijvalanaṃ kuryādrāmasaṃvatsare gate||34|| dūtyā dūtirasītyetajjapenmantramanuttamam || kuryātpradisarābandhaṃ sarvadoṣanibarhaṇam||35|| prāṇasūktañca kathitaṃ tathā prāṇavivardhanam || muñcāmi tveti kathitamapamṛtyuvimokṣaṇam ||36|| atharvaśiraso'dhyetā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || paramaṃ pāvanaṃ taddhi sarvakalmaṣanāśanam||37|| evamete śubhā mantrāḥ prativedaṃ mayā tava || samāsātkathitā rāma samuddhṛtya pradhānataḥ || 38 || ekaikasya ca mantrasya viniyogāḥ sahasraśaḥ || kathitā bhṛguśārdūla purāṇaiḥ sumahātmabhiḥ || 39 || na te śakyā mahābhāga vaktuṃ varṣaśatairapi || prādhānyena tu mantrāṇāṃ kiñcitkarma taveritam || 2.127.40 || home yatra na nirdiṣṭaṃ mayā dravyaṃ purā tava || havīṃṣi tatra vakṣyāmi tāni me gadataḥ śṛṇu || 41 || vṛkṣāṇāṃ yajñiyānāntu samidhaḥ prathamaṃ haviḥ || ājyañca vrīhayaścaiva tathā vai gaurasarṣapāḥ || 42 || akṣatāni tilāścaiva dadhi kṣīrañca bhārgava || darbhāstathaiva dūrvāśca bilvāni kamalāni ca || 43 || śāntipuṣṭikarāṇyāhurdravyāṇyetāni bhārgava || tailendhanāni dharmajña rājikāṃ rudhiraṃ viṣam || 44 || samidhaḥ kaṇṭakopetā abhicāreṣu yojayet || ārṣaṃ vai daivataṃ chandastvavijñāya bhṛgūttama || || 45 || mantrasya tena mantreṇa japyahomau na kārayet || chandasi brāhmaṇe sūkte yadavyaktaṃ pradṛśyate || 46 || vidvadbhi saha niścitya tadyajñamavatārayet || sambhārā ye yathā yatra yāni dravyāṇi yo vidhiḥ || 47 || śākhāṃ prati tathā tatra tatpramāṇamiti sthitiḥ || yaḥ svasūtramatikramya parasūtreṇa vartate || 48 || apramāṇamṛṣiṃ kṛtvā so'pyadhameṇa yujyate || tasmātsarvaprayatnena svasūttraṃ na vilaṃghayet || 49 || prāktantrottaratantre dve svaśākhāpratyayā dvija || sarvakarmasu kartavye madhye karma vidhīyate || 2.127.50 || atharvaṇo'yaṃ kathito vidhiste saṃkṣepato bhārgavavaṃśamukhya || ataḥ paraṃ kiṃ kathayāmi tubhyaṃ tanme vadasvāyatalohitākṣa || 51 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīya khaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne'tharvavidhikathanannāma saptaviṃśatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 127 || <2.128> rāma uvāca || ekaṃ mantraṃ samācakṣva deva lakṣmīvivardhanam || prativedaṃ jagannātha yādogaṇanṛpātmaja || 1 || puṣkara uvāca || śrīsūktaṃ prativedañca jñeyaṃ lakṣmīvivardhanam || asmim̐lloke pare vāpi yathākāmaṃ dvijasya tu||2|| rāma uvāca || prativedaṃ samācakṣva śrīsūktaṃ puṣṭivardhanam || śrīsūktasya tathā karma sarvadharmabhṛtāṃ vara|| ||3|| puṣkara uvāca || hiraṇyavarṇā hariṇīmṛcaḥ pañcadaśa dvija || śrīsūktaṃ kathitaṃ puṇyamṛgvede puṣṭivardhanam ||4|| rathe akṣeṣu vājeti catasrastu tathā ṛcaḥ || śrīsūktaṃ tu yajurvede kathitaṃ puṣṭivardhanam 45|| śrāyantīyaṃ tathā māsaṃ sāmavede prakīrtitam || śriyaṃ dāturmayi dehi proktamātharvaṇe tathā ||6|| śrīsūktaṃ yo japedbhaktyā tasyālakṣmīrvinaśyati || juhuyādyaśca dharmajña haviṣyeṇa viśeṣataḥ||7|| śrīsūktena tu padmānāṃ ghṛtāktānāṃ bhṛgūttama || ayutaṃ homayedyastu vahnau bhaktiyuto naraḥ ||8|| padmahastadvayā lakṣmīstaṃ naraṃ tūpatiṣṭhati || daśāyutaṃ tu padmānāṃ juhuyādyastathā jale ||9|| nāpaiti tatkulāllakṣmī viṣṇorvakṣogatā yathā || ghṛtāktānāntu bilvānāṃ hutvā rāmāyutaṃ tathā || 2.128.10 || bahuvittamavāpnoti sa yāvanmanasecchati || bilvānāṃ lakṣahomena kule lakṣmīmupāśnute ||11|| padmānāmatha bilvānāṃ koṭihomaṃ samācaret || śraddadhānaḥ samāpnoti devendratvamapi dhruvam || 12 || saṃpūjya devīṃ varadāṃ yathāvatpadmaiḥ sitairvā kusumaistathānyaiḥ || kṣīreṇa dhūpaiḥ paramānnabhakṣyairlakṣmīmavāpnoti vidhānataśca || 13 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne śrīsūktamāhātmyakathanannāmāṣṭāviṃśatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 128 || <2.129> rāma uvāca || ekaṃ mantraṃ samācakṣva sarvakarmakaraṃ śivam || aihikaṃ sarvadharmajña pāralaukikameva ca || 1 || puṣkara uvāca || prativedaṃ mahābhāga yatsūktaṃ pauruṣaṃ smṛtam || sarvakarmakaraṃ jñeyaṃ pavitraṃ mādhusūdanam || 2 || ekaikayā ṛcā rāma snāto dattvā jalāñjalīḥ || pauruṣeṇa ca sūktena mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ ||| antarjalagato japtvā tathā sūktaṃ tu pauruṣam || sarvakalmaṣanirmukto yatheṣṭāṃ labhate gatim || 4 || ekaikayā ṛcā snātaḥ puṣpaṃ puṣpaṃ nivedayeta || puruṣāya jale rāma sarvapāpairvimucyate || 5 || ekaikayā ṛcā snāto dattvā rāma phalaṃphalam || sarvānkāmānavāpnoti yānkāṃścinmanasecchati || 6 || pauruṣeṇa ca sūktena prāṇāyāmo mahāphalaḥ || japahomau tathā rāma sarvakalmaṣanāśanau ||7|| surāpo brahmahā stenastathaiva gurutalpagaḥ || pāpebhyo vipramucyeta japtvā sūktaṃ tu pauruṣam || 8 || kṛcchairviśodhitaḥ pūrvaṃ madhyāhne salilāpagaḥ || snātastu pauruṣaṃ sūktaṃ japennityamatandritaḥ || 9 || saṃvatsareṇa deveśaṃ vāsudevaṃ prapaśyati || svayameva mahābhāga śākamūlaphalāśanaḥ ||2.129.10|| tasmātkāmamavāpnoti yadrāma manasecchati || śriyamagryāṃ tathā rūpaṃ jīvitaṃ dīrghameva ca||11|| aṇimāṃ laghimāṃ prāptiṃ mahimāṃ ca bhṛgūttama || īśitvañca vaśitvañca prakāmyañca bhṛgūttama || 12|| yatra kāmāvasāyitvaṃ tasmātprāpnoti mānada || duravāpamathānyadvā yatkiñcinmanasecchati || 13|| akāmaḥ pauruṣaṃ sūktaṃ japtvā nityamatandritaḥ || tatra yāti mahābhāga yadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam || 14 || māṃgalyametatparamaṃ pavitraṃ saṃsāraduḥkhaughavināśakāri || sukhapradaṃ dharmavidhaṃ narāṇāṃ manoramāvāptikaraṃ pradiṣṭam || 15 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0saṃ0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne puruṣasūktamāhātmyavarṇanannāmaikonatriṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 129 || <2.130> rāma uvāca || | purā dharmāṇi proktāni brahmacārigṛhasthayoḥ || karmāṇyuktāni ca brūhi śiṣṭamapyāśramadvayam || 1 || gṛhasthadharmānāśritya kāmyāni surasattama ||| karmāṇi tāni me brūhi śiṣṭānyapyāśramadvaye || 2 || puṣkara uvāca | sukhaṃ gṛhāśrame sthitvā vidhivatsnātako dvijaḥ || vane vasettu niyato yathāvadvijitendriyaḥ || 3 || gṛhasthastu yadā paśyedvalīpalitamātmanaḥ || apatyasyaiva cāpatyaṃ tadāraṇyaṃ samāśrayet || 4 || saṃtyajya grāmyamāhāraṃ sarvañcaiva paricchadam || putreṣu bhāryāṃ nikṣipya vanaṃ gacchetsahaiva vā || 5 || agnihotraṃ samādāya gṛhyaṃ cāgniṃ paricchadam || grāmādaraṇyaṃ niḥsṛtya nivasedvijitendriyaḥ || 6 || munyannairvividhaimedhyaiḥ śākamūlaphalena vā || sarvāneva mahāyajñānnirvapedvidhipūrvakam || 7 || vasīta carma cīraṃ vā sāyaṃ snāyātprage tathā || jaṭāśca bibhṛyānnityaṃ śmaśrulomanakhāṃstathā ||8|| yadyacca syāttato dadyādbaliṃ bhikṣāñca śaktitaḥ || samūlaphalabhikṣābhirarcayedāśramāgatān || 9 || svādhyāyanityayuktaḥ syāddānto maitraḥ samāhitaḥ || dātā nityamanādātā sarvabhūtānukampakaḥ || 2.130.10 || vaitānikaśca juhuyādagnihotraṃ yathāvidhi || darśayanskandayanparvaṃ paurṇamāsīñca yogataḥ || 11 || ṛkṣeṣṭyāgrayaṇaścaiva cāturmāsyāni cāharet || uttarāyaṇañca kramaśo dakṣiṇāyanameva ca || 12 || vāsantaiḥ śāradaimedhyairmunyannaiḥ susamāhṛtaiḥ || puroḍāśāṃścarūm̐ścaiva vidhivannirvapetpṛthak || 13 || devatābhyastu taddhutvā vanyaṃ medhyataraṃ haviḥ || śeṣamātmani yuñjīta lavaṇañca svayaṃ kṛtam||14|| sthalajodakaśākāni puṣpamūlaphalāni ca || madhyavṛkṣodbhavānyadyātsnehāṃśca phalasaṃyutān || 15 || varjayenmadhumāṃsāni bhaumāni kavakāni ca || bhūstṛṇaṃ śigrukañcaiva bhallātakaphalāni ca ||16|| tyajedāśvayuje māsi munyannaṃ pūrvasañcitam || jīrṇāni caiva vāsāṃsi puṣpamūlaphalāni ca || 17 || na phālakṛṣṭamaśnīyādutsṛṣṭamapi kenacit || na grāmajātamannañca puṣpāṇi ca phalāni ca || 18 || agnipakvāśano vā syātkālapakvabhugeva vā || aśmaviddho bhavedvāpi dantolūkhalikastathā || 19 || sadyaḥ prakṣāliko vā syānmāsasañcayiko'pi vā || ṣaṇmāsanicayo vā syātsamānicaya eva vā||2.130.20|| naktaṃ vānnaṃ samaśnīyāddivā cāhṛtya śaktitaḥ|| caturthakāliko vā syātsyādvā cāṣṭamakālikaḥ || 21 || cāndrāyaṇavidhānairvā śukle kṛṣṇe ca vartayet || pakṣāntayorvāpyaśnīyādyavāgūṃ kvathitāṃ sakṛt || 22 || puṣpamūlaphalairvāpi kevalairvartayetsadā || kālapakvaiḥ svayaṃ śīrṇairvaikhānasapathi sthitaḥ || 23 || bhūmau viparivarteta tiṣṭhedvā prapadairdinam || sthānāsanābhyāṃ viharetsavaneṣūpayannapaḥ || 24 || grīṣme pañcatapāstu syādvarṣāsu bhāvakāśakaḥ || ārdravāsāstu hemante kramaśo vardhayaṃstapaḥ || 25 || upaspṛśaṃstriṣavaṇaṃ pitṝndevāṃśca tarpayet || tapaścaraṃścogrataraṃ śoṣayeddehamātmanaḥ || 26 || agnīnātmani vaitānānsamāropya yathāvidhi || anagniraniketaśca munirmūlaphalāśanaḥ || 27 || aprapannaḥ sukhārtheṣu brahmacārī dharāśrayaḥ|| śaraṇeṣu samaścaiva vṛkṣamūlaniketanaḥ || 28 ||| tāpaseṣveva vipreṣu yātrikaṃ bhaikṣamāharet || gṛhamedhyeṣu cānyeṣu dvijeṣu vanavāsiṣu || 29 || grāmādāhṛtya nāśnīyādaṣṭau grāsānvane vasan ||| vividhāścopaniṣado hyātmasaṃśuddhaye śrutīḥ || 2.130.30 || ṛṣibhirbrāhmaṇaiścaiva gṛhasthaireva sevitāḥ || vidyātapobhivṛddhyarthaṃ śarīrasya ca śuddhaye || 31 || aparājitāṃ vāsthāya vrajeddiśamajihmagaḥ || ānipātāccharīrasya yukto vāryanilāśanam || 32 || tyaktvā tanuṃ samyagathoditasya vidherathaikasya vane nivāsī || prāpnoti lokaṃ sa pitāmahasya tyaktvā bhayaṃ nātra vicāramasti || 33 || iti śrīvipṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne vānaprasthāśramakathanannāma triṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 130 || <2.131> || puṣkara uvāca || vaneṣu ca vihṛtyaivaṃ tṛtīyaṃ bhāgamāyuṣaḥ || caturthamāyuṣo bhāgaṃ tyaktasaṅgaḥ parivrajet || 1 || āśramādāśramaṃ gatvā hutahomo jitendriyaḥ || bhikṣābalapariśrāntaḥ pravrajedvratavarjitaḥ || 2 || ṛṇāni trīṇyapākṛtya mano mokṣe niveśayet || || anapākṛtya ca ṛṇaṃ mokṣamicchanvrajatyadhaḥ || 3 || adhītya vidhivadvedānputrāṃścotpādya dharmataḥ || iṣṭvā ca śaktito yajñairmano mokṣe niveśayet || 4 || anadhītya dvijo vedānanutpādya tathā sutān || aniṣṭvā caiva yajñaiśca mokṣamicchanvrajatyadhaḥ || 5 || prājāpatyāṃ nirūpyeṣṭiṃ sarvavedasadakṣiṇām || ātmanyagnīnsamāropya pravrajatyabhayaṃ gṛhī || 6 || tasya tejomayā lokā bhavanti brahmavādinaḥ || yasmādaṇvapi bhūtānāṃ dvija notpadyate bhayam || tasya dehādvimuktasya bhayaṃ nāsti kathañcana || 7 || agārādabhiniṣkrāntaḥ pavitropacito muniḥ || samupoḍheṣu kāmyeṣu nirapekṣaḥ parivrajet || 8 || eka eva carennityaṃ siddhyarthamasahāyavān || siddhimekasya tāṃ paśyanna jahāti na hīyate || 9 || anagniraniketaḥ syādgrāmamannārthamāśrayeta || 2.131.10 ||| upekṣako'sañcayako munirbhāvasamāhitaḥ || kapālaṃ vṛkṣamūlāni kucailamasahāyatā || mamatā naiva sarvasminnetanmuktasya lakṣaṇam || 11 || nābhinandeta maraṇaṃ nābhinandeta jīvitam || kālameva parīkṣeta nirdoṣabhṛtako yathā || 12 || dṛṣṭipūtaṃ nyasetpādaṃ vastrapūtaṃ jalaṃ pibet || satyapūtāṃ vadedvācaṃ manaḥpūtaṃ samācaret ||13|| atijaḍāṃstitikṣeta nāvamanyeta kañcana || 14 || na cainaṃ gṛhamāśritya vairaṃ kurvīta kenacit || krudhyantaṃ na pratikrudhyedāpṛṣṭaḥ kuśalaṃ vadet || 15 || saptadvārāvakīrṇāñca na vācamanṛtāṃ vadet || adhyātmaratirāsīno nirapekṣo nirāmiṣaḥ || 16 || ātmanaiva sahāyena tareddurgatimātmanaḥ || 17 || na cotpātanimittābhyāṃ na nakṣatrāṅgavidyayā || nānṛtasvanavādābhyāṃ bhikṣāṃ lipseta karhicit || 18|| na tāpasairbrāhmaṇairvā na yogibhirathāśramaiḥ || ākīrṇairbhikṣukairvarṇairāgāramupasaṃvrajet ||19|| klṛptakeśanakhaśmaśruḥ pātrī daṇḍī kusumbhavān || viracenniyato nityaṃ sarvabhūtānyapīḍayan || 2.131.20|| ataijasāni pātrāṇi tasya syurnirvraṇāni ca || teṣāmadbhiḥ smṛtaṃ śaucaṃ camasānāmivādhvare || 21 || alābuṃ dārupātrañca mṛnmayaṃ vaidalaṃ tathā || etāni yatipātrāṇi vijñeyāni manīṣibhiḥ || 22 || sauvarṇamaṇipātreṣu kāṃsyaraupyāyaseṣu ca || bhikṣāṃ dadyānna dharmajña grahītā narakaṃ vrajet || 23 || ekakālaṃ caredbhaikṣyaṃ na prasajyeta vistare || bhaikṣye prasaktasya matirviṣayeṣvapi sajjate || 24|| vidhūme nyastamusale vyaṅgāre bhuktavajjane || vṛtte śarāvasampāte bhikṣāṃ nityaṃ yatiścaret || 25 || alābhī na viṣādī syāllābhe cāpi na harṣayet || prāṇayātrikamātraḥ syānmātrāsaṃgādvinirgataḥ || abhipūjitalābhām̐stu yadi mukto'pi badhyate || 26 || alpānnābhyavahāreṇa rahaḥ sthānāsanena ca || hriyamāṇāni viṣayairindriyāṇi nivartayet || 27 || indriyāṇāṃ nirodhena rāgadveṣabhayena ca || ahiṃsayā ca bhūtānāmamṛtatvāya kalpate || 28 || avekṣeta gatiṃ nṝṇāṃ karmadoṣasamudbhavām || niraye caiva patanaṃ vyādhibhiścopapīḍanam || 29 || dehānukramaṇaṃ cāsmātpunargarbhe ca sambhavam || yonikoṭisahasreṣu mṛtau cāsyāntarātmanaḥ || 2.131.30 || adharmaprabhavaṃ caiva karmayogaṃ śarīriṇām || dharmārthaprabhavaṃ caiva sukhasaṃyogamakṣayam || 31 || sūkṣmatāṃ cānuvīkṣeta yogena paramātmanaḥ || deheṣu caiva patitamuttameṣvadhameṣu ca || 32|| dūṣito'pi careddharmaṃ yatrayatrāśrame rataḥ || samaḥ sarveṣu bhūteṣu na liṅgaṃ dharmakāraṇam || 33 || phalaṃ katakavṛkṣasya yadyapyambuprasādakam || na nāmagrahaṇādeva tasya vāri prasīdati || 34 || saṃrakṣaṇārthaṃ jantūnāṃ rātrāvahani vā sadā || śarīrasyātyaye vāpi samīkṣya vasudhāṃ careta || 35|| ahorātracayājjantūnhinastyajñānato yadi || teṣāṃ snātvā viśuddhyarthaṃ prāṇāyāmānṣaḍācaret || 36 || prāṇāyāmā brāhmaṇasya trayo'pi vidhivatkṛtāḥ || vyāhṛtipraṇavairyuktā vijñeyaṃ paramaṃ tapaḥ || 37 || dahyante dhmāyamānānāṃ dhātūnāṃ hi yathā malāḥ || tathendriyakṛtā doṣā dahyante prāṇanigrahāt || || 38 || prāṇāyāmairdaheddoṣāndhāraṇābhistu kilbiṣam || pratyāhāreṇa saṃsargāndhyānenānīśvarānguṇān || 39 || uccāvaceṣu bhūteṣu durjñeyamakṛtātmabhiḥ || jñānayogena sampaśyedgatimasyāntarātmanaḥ ||2.131.40|| samyagdarśanasaṃpannaḥ karmabhirna nibadhyate || darśanena vihīnastu saṃsāraṃ pratipadyate || 41 || ahiṃsayendriyāsaṅgairvaidyakaiścaiva karmabhiḥ || tapasaścaraṇaiścograiḥ sādhayantīha tatpadam || 42 || asthisthūṇaṃ snāyuyutaṃ māṃsaśoṇitalepitam || carmāvanaddhaṃ durgandhi pātraṃ mūtrapurīṣayoḥ || 43 || jarāśokasamāviṣṭaṃ rogāyatanamāturam || rajasvalamanityañca bhūtāvāsamidaṃ tyajet || 44 || nadīkūle yathā vṛkṣo vṛkṣe vā śakuniryathā || tathā tyajannimaṃ dehaṃ kṛcchragrāhādvimucyate || 45 || priyeṣu sveṣu sukṛtaṃ cāpriyeṣu ca duṣkṛtam || visṛjya dhyānayogena brahmābhyeti sanātanam||46|| yadā bhāvena bhavati sarvabhāveṣu niḥsṛtiḥ || tadā sukhamavāpnoti pretya ceha ca śāśvatam||47|| anena vidhinā sarvānkāmāṃstyaktvā śanaiḥśanaiḥ || sarvadvandvairvinirmukto brahmaṇyevāvatiṣṭhati || 48 || dhyānikaṃ sarvamevaitadyadetadatiśābdikam || na hyādhyātma kaviḥ kaścitkriyāphalamupāśnute || 49 || adhiyajñaṃ brahma japetsādhidaivikameva ca || ādhyātmikaṃ ca satataṃ vedāntābhihitaṃ phalam || 2.131.50 || idaṃ śaraṇamajñānāmidaṃ daivaṃ vijānatām || idamanvicchatāṃ svargamidamānantyamicchatām || 51 || anena kramayogeṇa parivrajati yo dvijaḥ || sa vidhūyeha pāpmānaṃ paraṃ brahmādhigacchati || 52 || eṣa dharmo'nuśiṣṭaste yatīnāṃ niyatātmanām || eva saṃnyāsakānāntu karmayogaṃ nibodha me || 53|| brahmacārī gṛhasthaśca vānaprastho yatistathā || ete gṛhasthaprabhavāścatvāraḥ pṛthagāśramāḥ || 54 || sarve'pi kramaśastvete yathāśāstraṃ niṣevitāḥ || yathoktakāriṇaṃ vipraṃ nayanti paramāṃ gatim || 55 || sarveṣāmeva caiteṣāṃ vedaśrutividhānataḥ || gṛhastha ucyate śreṣṭhaḥ sa trīnetānbibharti hi || 56 || yathā nadīnadāḥ sarve sāgare yānti saṃsthitim || tathaivāśramiṇaḥ sarve gṛhasthe yānti saṃsthitim||57|| caturbhirapi tattvajñairnityamāśramibhirdvijaiḥ || daśalākṣaṇiko dharmaḥ sevitavyaḥ prayatnataḥ ||58|| dhṛtiḥ kṣamā damo'steyaṃ śaucamindriyanigrahaḥ || dhīrvidyā satyamakrodho daśakaṃ dharmalakṣaṇam||59|| daśa cihnāni dharmasya ye viprāḥ samadhīyate || adhītya cānuvartante te yānti paramāṃ gatim || 2.131.60 || daśalākṣaṇikaṃ dharmamanutiṣṭhansamāhitaḥ || vedāntaṃ vidhivacchrutvā manyehamanṛṇo dvijaḥ ||61|| sannyasya sarvakarmāṇi sarvāndoṣānupānudet || niyato dharmamabhyasya putraiḥ saha sukhaṃ vaseta||62|| evaṃ sanyasya karmāṇi svakārye paramo'spṛhaḥ || saṃnyāsenāpahṛtyenaṃ prāpnoti paramāṃ gatim || eṣa te'bhihito dharmo dvijātīnāṃ caturvidhaḥ || 63 || svalpo'pi dharmaścarito yathāyaṃ mahāphalaḥ syātsatataṃ dvijānām || tasmātprayatnādayameva kāryaḥ sarvaṃ samutsṛjya mahānubhāvaḥ || 64 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne caturthāśramavarṇanannāmaikatriṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 131 || <2.132> rāma uvāca || aṣṭādaśabhyaḥ śāntibhyaḥ śāntayo yāḥ surottama || bhidyante vā na bhidyante tanmamācakṣva pṛcchataḥ || 1 || puṣkara uvāca || amṛtā cābhayā saumyāstisronyāḥ santi bhārgava || ekāpi tāsāṃ vijñeyā sarvakarmaphalapradā || 2 || sarvotpātapraśamanī maṅgalyā siddhikārikā ||| pūrvoktāḥ kathiteṣveva kartavyā adbhuteṣu ca || 3 || rāma uvāca || śāntīnāṃ me tvamācakṣva svarūpāṇi mahābhuja || pitāmahasamo loke sarvajño'pi mato mama||4|| puṣkara uvāca || amṛtā śarvadaivatyā abhayā brahmadaivatā || saumyā ca somadaivatyā kathitā bhṛgunandana || 5 || anyāsāṃ devatā jñānaṃ nāmnaiva kathitaṃ tava || ātharvaṇānāṃ śāntīnāṃ nibodha gadato mama || 6 || amṛtā citravarṇā syādabhayā tu śaśiprabhā|| saumyā śuklaiva vijñeyā nīlā bhavati vaiṣṇavī || 7 || bālārkasadṛśā raudrī brāhmī śaṃkhasamaprabhā || rukmavarṇā tathaivaindrī vāyavyā haritā bhavet|| 8 || śuklā ca vāruṇī jñeyā kauberī padmasuprabhā || bhārgavī śuklavarṇā syātprājāpatyā ca pītikā || 9 || tvāṣṭrī śuklā ca vijñeyā kaumārī tāmrasuprabhā || āgneyyagnisuvarṇā syācchuklā mātaṅginī bhavet || 2.132.10 || pravālābhā ca gāndharvī kṛṣṇā vai nainṛtā tathā|| rocanābhā cāṅgirasī yāmyā kṛṣṇā tathā bhavet||11|| pārthivī ca mayūrābhā varṇataḥ kathitāstava || ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi sthānānyāsāṃ yathāvidhi || 12 || amṛtā cābhayā saumyā tisrastu bhṛgunandana || tāsāṃ sarvatra saṃsthānaṃ kathitantu purātanaiḥ || 13 || prājāpatyā tathāgneyī yāmyā vai nairṛtī tathā || kauberī pārthivī ceti pṛthivyāṃ parikīrtitāḥ || 14 || vāyavyā caiva kaumārī vaiṣṇavī rudradaivatā || antarikṣe vinirdiṣṭāḥ śāntayo dvijasattama || 15 || aindrī mātaṅginī tvāṣṭrī divyā brāhmī tatheritā || vāruṇī caiva gāndhārī bhārgavyāṅgirasī tathā || 16 || ādyāstu kathitāstubhyaṃ kartavyāśca vijānatā || yathā svadeśajāteṣu cādbhuteṣu yathāvidhi || 17 || taddaivatyāstathā mantrāḥ sarvāsāṃ garbha ucyate || maṇīnāñca tathā garbhāḥ sarvāsāṃ mantra ucyate || 18 || maṇīnāñca tathā mantrā jñātavyā mantraliṅgataḥ || sarvāsāñcaiva śāntīnāṃ hotavyāśca gaṇā daśa || 19 || śāntyātītantu bhaiṣajyaṃ trisaptīyaṃ tathaiva ca || abhayā ca tathā rāma tathā caivāparājitā || 2.132.20 || āyuṣyaṃ ca svastyayanaṃ sarvavarmagaṇaṃ tathā || vāstoṣpatyaṃ tathā raudraṃ gaṇāḥ proktāstathā daśa || 21 || homastathaiṣāṃ mantavyaḥ sarvaśāntiṣu bhārgava || pṛthakpradhānataḥ kalpāstisraḥ pūrvāḥ prakīrtitāḥ||22|| gaṇegaṇe tu gāṃ dadyādgāṃ garbhe gāṃ tathā maṇau || arājā bhūmipālastu dadyāddaśa daśaiva tu ||23|| niṣkāmaḥ sabhuvaṃ caiva tathā dadyātpurodhase || abhayāyā maṇiḥ kāryo varuṇasya bhṛgūttama ||24|| śatakāṇḍo'mṛtāyāśca saumyāyāḥ śaṅkhajo maṇiḥ|| vaiṣṇavyāstrivṛtaḥ proktaḥ snāto raudryāstathā maṇiḥ || 25 || brahmarakṣastathā brahmyā maitryāḥ syātkanako maṇiḥ || vāyavyāścāṅgiraḥ prokto vāyavyaḥ śaṅkhajo bhavet || 26 || audumbaraśca kauberyā bhārgavyāyāḥ śatāvarīm || prājāpatyā bilvamaṇistvāṣṭryāḥ saṃskṛtako maṇiḥ || 27 || dākṣāyaṇaśca kaumāryyā āgneyyāśca tadeva tu || mātaṅginyā jigitajaṃ gāndharvyā ajaśṛṅgajam || 28 || nairṛtyāmāyasaṃ caiva āṅgirasyāstathāñjanam || śatakāṇḍaśca yāmyāyāḥ pārthivyā api pārthivam || 29 || adbhutasya balaṃ jñātvā kṛcchraṃ kuryātpurohitaḥ || prāgeva kuryācchamanamādāvevādbhutasya tu || 2.132.30 || kṛtakṛcchrastu kurvīta tataḥ śāntimupoṣitaḥ || araṇyāṃ pātayedvahniṃ sarvāsvetāsu śāntiṣu || 31 || upavāsadinasyānte vahnimutpādya yatnataḥ || utpannamannaṃ vibhajetkravyādaṃ saumyameva ca || 32 || kṛtvā kapāle kravyādaṃ dhruveṇa nairṛtīṃ diśam || śāntyāgāre sthāpayecca śāntyarthe saumyameva vā || 33 || kṛṣṇoṣṇīṣaḥ kṛṣṇavāsāḥ kṛṣṇamālyānulepanaḥ || purohitaḥ pradeśaṃ tu gatvā vai nairṛtīṃ yajet || 34 || mṛnmayaṃ jīrṇaśīrṣe tu gandhamālyānusampadā || kṛṣṇavastraistu saṃcchādya tatastūpaharedbalim || 35 || vādyaghoṣeṇa mahatā tathā kolāhalaiḥ śubhaiḥ || tato'gnau juhuyātsamyaṅmedaḥprabhṛti vai dvija || 36 || ye piśācāścaturbhistu iṣīkā śarkarī tataḥ ||| kevale juhuyādvahnau karaśuktyā śravāmayā || 37|| phalīkaraṇamagnau ca hutvā bhuktvā ca pāvakam || apaśyansvagṛhaṃ yāyātsnātvā śvetāmbarastataḥ ||| ||| 38 || ahomucaṃ śāntikaṃ ca japtvā tiṣṭhetsuyantritaḥ || rātrau tribhāgaśeṣāyāṃ śāntikarma samārabhet || 39 || śāntikalpavidhānajñaḥ sadasyaiḥ sahitastataḥ || ekaḥ karmaṇi yuktaḥ syādeko mantrasya niścaye ||2.132.40|| eṣa śāntividhiḥ proktaḥ samāsātsarvaśāntiṣu || vistare vistaraḥ proktaḥ śāntikarma hyatharvaṇaḥ ||41|| dhanena pūjyo'tha purohitaḥ syāttathopadeṣṭā gururapramattaḥ || sāṃvatsaro yastu tataḥ sadasyāḥ pūjyāstato vipravarāśca sarve||42|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0 saṃ0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne śāntikarmavarṇanannāma dvātriṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 132 ||| <2.133> || rāma uvāca || kākā śāntirbhavetkā vā kasminkasmiṃstathādbhute || etanme saṃśayaṃ chindhi devāribalasūdana ||1|| puṣkara uvāca || sarvotpātapraśaminī hyamṛtā cābhayā smṛtā || saumyā caiva mahāśāṃtiḥ sarvakarmaphalapradā || 2 || viśeṣeṇa tu bhaumeṣu śāntiḥ kāryāmṛtā bhavet || abhayā cāntarikṣeṣu saumyā divyeṣu bhārgava || 3 || vijigīṣuḥ parānrājā bhūmikāmaśca yojayet || ārogyadhanakāmaśca saumyāṃ tāṃ kārayetsadā || 4 || vijigīṣuḥ parānevamabhiyuktastathā paraiḥ || tathābhicāraśaṅkāyāṃ śatrūṇāmapi śāsane || 5 || bhaye mahati ca prāpte tvabhayā śāntiriṣyate || rājayakṣmābhibhūtasya kṣatakṣīṇasya cāpyatha || 6 || saumyā praśasyate śāntiryajñakāmasya caiva hi || bhūmikampe samutpanne prāpte cānnakṣaye tathā || 7 || ativṛṣṭyāmanāvṛṣṭyāṃ śalabhākhubhayeṣu ca || prapanneṣu ca caureṣu vaiṣṇavīśāntiriṣyate || 8 || paśūnāṃ maraṇe prāpte narāṇāmapi dāruṇe || bhūteṣu dṛśyamāneṣu raudrī śāntistatheṣyate || 9 || bhaviṣyatyabhiṣeke ca paracakrabhayeṣu ca || svarāṣṭrabhede'rivadhe śāntiraindrī praśasyate || 2.133.10 || tryahātirikte pavane rūkṣe sarvadigutthite || vaikṛte vātaje vyādhau vāyavī śāntiriṣyate || 11 || anāvṛṣṭibhaye jāte jāte vikṛtavarṣaṇe || jalāśayavikāre ca vāruṇī śāṃtiriṣyate || 12 || abhiśāpabhaye prāpte bhārgavī ca tathā dvija || jāte prasavavaikṛtyaṃ prājāpatyā mahābhuja || 13 || upaskarāṇāṃ vaikṛtyaṃ tvāṣṭrī bhārgavanandana || bālānāṃ śāntikāmasya kaumārī ca tathā śubhā || 14 || āgneyīṃ kārayecchāntiṃ samprāpte vahnivaikṛte || kāryā mārudgaṇī śāntirdurbalena mahīkṣitā || 15 || ājñābhaṃge tathā jāte jāte bhṛtyādisaṃkṣaye || aśvānāṃ śāṃtikāmasya tadvikāre tathotthite || 16 || gajānkāmayamānasya gāndharvī śāṃtiriṣyate || gajānāṃ śāṃtikāmasya tadvikāre tathotthite || 17 || gajānkāmayamānasya śāntirāṅgirasī bhavet || piśācādhibhaye jāte śāntirvai nairṛtī matā || 18 || apamṛtyubhaye jāte duḥsvapne ca tathā dvija || kāmyāṃ tu kārayecchāṃtiṃ prāpte tu marake tathā || 19 || dhananāśe samutpanne kauberī śāṃtiriṣyate || vṛkṣāṇāṃ ca tathārccānāṃ vaikṛte samupasthite || 2.133.20 || bhūmikāmastathā śāṃtiṃ pārthivīṃ saṃprayojayet || prathame dinayāme ca rātrau ca manujottama || 21 || haste svātau ca citrāyāmāditye cāśvine tathā || aryamṇe saumyajāteṣu vāyavyāṃ tvadbhuteṣu ca || 22 || dvitīye dinayāme ca rātrau ca bhṛgunandana || puṣyāgneyaviśākhāsu pitryāsu bharaṇīṣu ca || 23 || utpāteṣu tathā bhāgye tvāgneyī śāntiriṣyate || tṛtīyadinayāme ca rātrau ca bhṛgunandana || 24 || rohiṇyāṃ vaiṣṇave brāhme vāsave viśvadaivate || jyeṣṭhāyāṃ ca tathā maitre ye bhavaṃtyadbhutāḥ kvacit ||25 || aindrī teṣu prayoktavyā śāntirbhṛgukulodbhava || caturthe dinayāme vā rātrau ca bhṛgunandana || 26 || sārpe pauṣṇe tathārdrāyāṃ tvāhirbudhnye ca dāruṇe || mūle varuṇadaivatye ye bhavantyadbhutāstathā || 27 || vāruṇī teṣu kartavyā mahāśāṃtirmahīkṣitā || bhinnamaṇḍalavelāsu ye bhavantyadbhutāḥ kvacit || 28 || teṣu śāṃtidvayaṃ kāryaṃ nimitte sati nānyathā || nirnimittā kṛtā śāṃtirnimittāyopajāyate ||29|| bāṇaprahārā na bhavaṃti yadvannṛṇāṃ raṇe sannahanairyutānām || daivopaghātā na bhavaṃti tadvaddharmātmanāṃ śāṃtiparāyaṇānām ||2.133.30|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0saṃ0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne adbhuteṣu śāntikarmavarṇano nāma trayastriṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 133|| <2.134> rāma uvāca || adbhutānāṃ phalaṃ deva śamanaṃ ca tathā vada || tvaṃ hi vetsi viśālākṣa jñeyaṃ sarvamaśeṣataḥ||1|| puṣkara uvāca || atra te varṇayiṣyāmi yaduvāca mahātapāḥ|| atra yo vṛddhagargastu sarvadharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ||2|| sarasvatyāṃ sukhāsīnaṃ gargaṃ srotasi bhārgava || papracchātrirmahātejā gargaṃ munijanapriyam||3| atriruvāca || naśyatāṃ pūrvarūpāṇi janānāṃ kathayasva me || nagarāṇāṃ tathā rājñāṃ tvaṃ hi sarvaviducyase ||4|| garga uvāca|| puruṣāpacārānniyatamaparajyanti devatāḥ || tatoparāgāddevānāmupasargaḥ pravartate || 5 || divyāntarikṣabhaumaṃ tattrividhaṃ parikīrtitam || gṛharkṣaṃ vaikṛtaṃ divyamāṃtarikṣaṃ nibodha me || 6 || ulkāpāto diśāṃ dāhaḥ pariveṣastathaiva ca || gandharvanagaraṃ caiva vṛṣṭistu vikṛtā ca yā || 7 || evamādīni lokesminnāṃbhasāni vinirdiśet || carasthirabhayaṃ bhūmau bhūkalāmapi bhūmijam || 8 || jalāśayānāṃ vaikṛtyaṃ bhūmau tadapi kīrtitam || bhaumaṃ yāmyaphalaṃ jñeyaṃ cireṇa bhuvi paśyate || 9 || nābhasaṃ madhyaphaladaṃ madhyakālaphalapradam || divyaṃ tīvraphalaṃ jñeyaṃ śīghrakāri tathaiva ca || 2.134.10 || adbhute tu samutpanne yadi vṛṣṭiḥ śivā bhavet || saptāhābhyantare jñeyamadbhutaṃ niṣphalaṃ hi tat || 11 || adbhutasya vipākaścedvinā śānterna dṛśyate || tribhirvarṣaistathā jñeyaṃ sumahadbhayakārakam || 12 || rājñaḥ śarīre loke ca puradāre purohite || pākamāyāti putreṣu tathā vai kośavāhane || 33 || dattasvabhāvajā ye ca bhavantyadbhutasaṃjñakā || śubhāvahāste vijñeyāstām̐śca me gadataḥ śṛṇu || 14 || vajrāśanimahīkampasandhyānirvātanisvanāḥ || pariveṣaṃ rajo dhūmaṃ raktārkostamanodaye || 15 || drumebhyo varayaśceha bahupuṣpaphalāpagāḥ || gopakṣamadhuvṛddhiśca śubhāni madhumādhave || 16 || tārolkāpātakaluṣaṃ kapilārkaṃ tu maṇḍalam || anagnijvalanāsphoṭadhūmareṣvanilāvaham || 17 || raktapadmāruṇaṃ sāndhyaṃ nabhaḥ kṣubdhārṇavopamam || saritāṃ cāmbusaṃśoṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā grīṣme śubhaṃ vadet || 18 || śakrāyudhaṃ parīveśaṃ vidhuśuṣkavirohaṇam || kampodvelanavaikṛtyaṃ trasanaṃ dāruṇaṃ kṣiteḥ || 19 || nadyodapānasarasāṃ vṛddhyaśvataraṇa plavāḥ || śīrṇatā cāhni gehānāṃ varṣāsu ca bhaviṣyati||2.134.20|| divyastrībhūtagandharvavimānādbhutadarśanam || grahanakṣatratārāṇāṃ darśanaṃ ca divākare||21|| gītavāditranirghoṣo vanaparvatasānuṣu || rasavṛddhīrasotpattiḥ śaratkāle śubhāḥ smṛtāḥ || 22 || śītālulattupāratvaṃ nandanaṃ gṛhapakṣiṇām || rakṣoyakṣādisattvānāṃ darśanaṃ vāgamānuṣī ||23|| diśo dhūmrāndhakāraśca śarabhodhanaparvatāḥ || uccaiḥ sūryodayāstau ca hemante śobhanāḥ smṛtāḥ ||24|| himapātānilotpātau virūpādbhutadarśanam || kṛṣṇāñjanābhamākāśaṃ tārolkāpātapiñjaram||25|| citragarbhodbhavaṃ strīṣu gojāśvamṛgapakṣiṣu || patrāṅkuralatānāṃ ca vikārāḥ śiśire śubhāḥ||26|| ṛtusvabhāvena vinādbhutasya jātasya dṛṣṭasya tu śīghrameva|| kṛtvā śamaṃ śāntiranantaraṃ tu kāryā yathoktā vasudhādhipena||27|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0saṃ0rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne nānāvidhotpātakathano nāma catustriṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ||134|| <2.135> garga uvāca || devatārcāḥ pranṛtyanti vepante prajvalanti ca || āraṭanti ca rodanti prasvidyanti hasanti ca ||1|| uttiṣṭhanti niṣīdanti pradhāvanti vasanti ca || bhuñjate vikṣipante vā gātrapraharaṇādhvajān ||2|| avāṅmukhāvatiṣṭhanti sthānātsthānaṃ bhramanti ca || vamantyagniṃ tathā dhūmaṃ sneharakte tathā vasām||3|| evamādīni dṛśyante vikārā sahasotthitāḥ|| liṅgāyatanacitreṣu tatra vāsaṃ na rocayet||4|| rājño vā vyasanaṃ tatra sarvādeśo vinaśyati|| devayātrāṃ sacotpātāṃ dṛṣṭvā deśabhayaṃ vadet || 5 || pitāmaharṣidharmeṣu yannimittaṃ dvijeṣu tat || guruśukrāgnijātāni yāni tāni purohite ||6|| paśūnāṃ rudrajaṃ jñeyaṃ nṛpāṇāṃ lokapālajam|| jñeyaṃ senāpatīnāṃ tu yatsyātskandavināyakam ||7|| lokānāṃ viṣṇuvāyvindraviśvakarmasamudbhavam || vināyakodbhavaṃ jñeyaṃ gaṇānāṃ ye tu nāyakāḥ || 8 || devapreṣyanṛpapreṣyadeva strīṣu nṛpastriyaḥ || vāstudeveṣu vijñeyaṃ gṛhiṇāmeva nānyathā || 9 || devatārcāvikāreṣu śrutivettā purohitaḥ || devatārcāṃ tato gatvā snātāmācchādya bhūṣayet || 2.135.10 || pūjayecca mahābhāga gandhamālyānnasampadā || madhuparkeṇa vidhivadupatiṣṭhedanantaram || 11 || talliṅgena ca mantreṇa sthālīpākaṃ yathāvidhi || purodhā juhuyādvahnau saptarātramatandritaḥ || 12 || viprāśca pūjyā madhurānnapānaiḥ sadakṣiṇaiḥ saptadinaṃ dvijendra|| prāpte'ṣṭame'hni kṣitigopradānaiḥ sakāñcanaiḥ śāṃtimupaiti pāpam ||13|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne arcāvikāropaśamanavarṇano nāma pañcatriṃśaduttaruśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ||135|| <2.136> garga uvāca|| anagnirdīpyate yatra rāṣṭre bhṛśasamanvitaḥ || na dīpyate cendhanaṃ vā sarāṣṭraḥ pīḍyate nṛpaḥ ||1|| prajalādambunāśaṃ ca tathārdraṃ vāti kiñcana || prasādastoraṇaṃ dvāraṃ nṛpaveśma surālayam ||2 || etāni yatra dahyante tatra rājabhayaṃ bhavet || vidyutā vā pradahyante tathāpi nṛpaterbhayam ||3|| anaiśyāni tamāṃsi syurdiśa pāṃsurajāṃsi ca || dhūmaścānagnijo yatra tatra vidyānmahadbhayam || 4 rātrāvanabhre gagane bhayaṃ syādṛkṣavarjite || divā satāre gagane tathaiva bhayamādiśet || 5 || grahanakṣatravaikṛtye tārāvikṛtadarśane || puravāhanayāneṣu catuṣpānmṛgapakṣiṣu || 6 || āyudheṣu ca dīpteṣu dhūmāyatsu tathaiva ca || niryatsu kośāśca tathā saṃgrāmastumulo bhavet || 7 || vināgniṃ visphuliṅgāśca dṛśyante yatra karhicit || svabhāvāccāpi pūryante dhanūṃṣi vikṛtāni ca || 8 || vikārāścāyudhānāṃ syustatra saṃgrāmamādiśet || trirātro'poṣitastatra purodhāḥ susamāhitaḥ || 9 || samidbhiḥ kṣīravṛkṣāṇāṃ sarṣapaiśca ghṛtena ca || agniliṅgaiśca juhuyādvahniṃ śvetāmbaraḥ śuciḥ || 2.136.10 || dadyātsuvarṇaṃ ca tathā dvijebhyo gāścaiva vastrāṇi tathā bhuvaṃ ca || evaṃ kṛte pāpamupaiti nāśaṃ yadvahnivaikṛtyabhavaṃ dvijendra || 11 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne autpātikāgnivarṇano nāma ṣaṭatriṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 136 || <2.137> garga uvāca || pureṣu yeṣu dṛśyante pādapā daivacoditāḥ || rudanto vā hasanto vā sravanto vā bahūnrasān || 1 || purogavā vinā vāsaṃ śākhāṃ muñcantyasaṃśramāt || phalapuṣpaṃ tathā bālā darśayanti trihāyanā || 2 || sarvāvasthāṃ darśayanti phalapuṣpamathābhavam || kṣīraṃ snehaṃ surāṃ raktaṃ madhu toyaṃ sravanti ca || 3 || śuṣyantyarogāḥ sahasā śuṣkā rohanti vā punaḥ || uttiṣṭhantīha patitāḥ patanti ca tathotthitāḥ ||4|| tatra vakṣyāmi te brahmanvipāke phalameva ca || rodane vyādhimākhyāti hasane deśaviplavam || 5|| śākhāprapatane kuryātsaṃgrāme yo'dhapātanam || bālānāṃ maraṇe kuryādbālānāṃ phalapuṣpatā || 6 || svarāṣṭrabhedaṃ kurute phalapuṣpasanātanama || kṣayaṃ sarvatrage kṣīre snehe durbhikṣalakṣaṇam || 7 || vāhanāpacayaṃ madhye rakte saṃgrāmamādiśet || madhusrāve bhavedvyādhirjalasrāveṇa varṣati || 8 || arogaśoṣaṇājjñeyaṃ brahmandurbhikṣalakṣaṇam || śuṣkeṣu saṃprarohatsu vīryamannaṃ ca hīyate || 9 || utthāne patitānāṃ ca bhayaṃ bhedakaraṃ bhavet || sthānātsthānātturaṃgāṇāṃ deśabhaṅgaṃ tathādiśet||2.137.10|| jalpatsvapi ca vṛkṣeṣu rudatsvapi dhanakṣayam || etatpūjitavṛkṣeṣu sarvaṃ rājño vipacyate||11|| puṣpe phale vā vikṛte rājño mṛtyuṃ tadādiśet || anyeṣu caivaṃ yukteṣu vṛkṣātpāteṣvatandritaḥ ||12|| ācchādayitvā taṃ vṛkṣaṃ gandhamālyairvibhūṣayet || vṛkṣopari tathā chatraṃ kuryāttāpapraśāntaye || 13 || śivamabhyarcayeddevaṃ paśuṃ cāsmai nivedayet || mūlebhya iti ṣaṇmāṣānhutvā rudrīṃ japettathā || 14 || madhvājyayuktena tu pāyasena saṃpūjya viprāṃśca bhuvaṃ ca dadyāt || gītena nṛtyena tathārcayeta devaṃ bhavaṃ pāpavināśahetoḥ || 15 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0saṃ0rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne autpātike vṛkṣavaikṛtyavarṇano nāma saptatriṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ||137|| <2.138> || garga uvāca || ativṛṣṭiranāvṛṣṭirdurbhikṣāyobhayaṃ matam || anṛte bhadine riktā vṛṣṭirjñeyā bhayāvahā || 1 || anabhre vikṛtā caiva vijñeyā rājamṛtyave || śītoṣṇatāviparyāse jantūnāṃ ripujaṃ bhayam || 2 || śoṇitaṃ varṣate yatra tatra śastrabhayaṃ bhavet || aṅgārapāṃsuvarṣeṇa nagaraṃ tadvinaśyati || 3 || majjāsthisnehamāṃsānāṃ janamārabhayaṃ bhavet || phalapuṣpe tathā dhānyaṃ hiraṇyādi bhayāya tu || 4 || pāṃsujantūpalānāṃ tu varṣaṇe rogajaṃ bhayam || chidrāṇāṃ tu pravarṣe ca sasyānāmītivardhanam || 5 || virajaske ravau vyabhre yadā chāyā na dṛśyate || dṛśyate tu pratīpā vā tatra deśabhayaṃ bhavet || 6|| nirabhre cātha rātrau vā śvetaṃ yāmyottareṇa tu || indrāyudhaṃ tadā dṛṣṭvā ulkāpātāṃstathaiva ca || 7 || digdāhapariveṣau vā gandharvanagaraṃ tathā || paracakrabhayaṃ brūyāddeśopadravameva vā || 8 || sūryenduparjanyasamīraṇānāṃ yāgastu kāryo vidhivaddvijendra || dhānyānnagokāñcanadakṣiṇāśca deyā dvijānāṃ bhayanāśahetoḥ || 9 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0 saṃ0 rāmaṃ prati pupkaropākhyāne autpātikeṣu vṛṣṭivaikṛtyavarṇano nāmāṣṭatriṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 138 || <2.139> garga uvāca || nagarādapasarpanti samīpamupayānti vā || aśoṣyā api śuṣyanti samīpaṃ pravahanti vā || 1 || nadyo hradaprasravaṇā visarāśca bhavanti cet || vivarṇaṃ kaluṣaṃ taptaṃ phenavajraṃ tu saṃkulam || 2 || kṣīraṃ snehaṃ surāṃ raktaṃ vahante vā kulodakāḥ || ṣaṇmāsābhyantaraṃ tatra paracakrabhayaṃ bhavet || 3 || jalāśayā nadante vā prajalpanti kvathanti vā || vimuñcate'tha vā brahmañjalāndhūmarajāṃsi ca || 4 || akhāte vā jalotpattiḥ sasattvā vā jalāśayāḥ || saṃgītaśabdā dṛśyante janamārabhayaṃ vadet || 5 || jalāśayānāṃ vaikṛtye saṃyatastu jalāśaye || sthālīpākena paśunā varuṇaṃ pūjayeddvija || 6 || divyamambhaḥ payaḥ sarpirmadhu cātrāvasecanam || japtavyā vāruṇā mantrāstaiśca homo jale bhavet || 7 || madhvājyayuktaṃ paramānnamatra deyaṃ dvijānāṃ dvija bhojanārthe || gāvaśca deyā dvija vastrayuktāstathodakumbhāḥ sakalāṅgaśāntyai || 8 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne jalavaikṛtyavarṇano nāmaikonacatvāriṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 139 || <2.140> || garga uvāca || || kālaprasavanā nāryaḥ kālātītāḥ prajāstathā || vikṛtaprasavāścaiva yugmaprasavikāstathā || 1 || amānuṣā aruṇḍāśca sañjātavyasanāstathā || hīnāṅgā adhikāṅgāśca jāyante yadi vā striyaḥ || || 2 || paśavaḥ pakṣiṇaścaiva tathā caiva sarīsṛpāḥ || vināśaṃ tasya deśasya kulasyāpi vinirdiśet || 3 || vivāsayettānnṛpatiḥ svarāṣṭrātpriyaṃ ca pūjyāśca tato dvijendrāḥ || kimicchakairbrāhmaṇatarpaṇaṃ ca kāryaṃ tataḥ śāntimupaiti pāpam || 4 || iti śrīviṣṇudhamottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajra saṃvāde rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne strīprasavavaikṛtyavarṇano nāma catvāriṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||140|| <2.141> garga uvāca || vaḍavā hastinī gaurvā yadi yugmaṃ prasūyate || vijātaṃ vikṛtaṃ vāpi ṣaḍbhirmāsairmriyeta vai || 1 || viyoniṣu ca gacchanto maithunaṃ deśanāśanāḥ || anyatra vasarotpatternṛṇāṃ cājātimaithunam || 2 || sarpamūṣakamārjāramatsyaśvāno vivarjitāḥ || jñeyā durbhikṣyakartāraḥ svajātipiśitāśinaḥ || 3 || akālajaṃ madaṃ ghoraṃ catuṣpānmṛgapakṣiṇām || anyajātivadetacca dhainvaṃ śvānaṃ viśeṣataḥ || 4 || amānuṣā mānuṣavajjalpanti prāṇino yadi || vikṛtā vā prasūyanti paracakrāgamaṃ vadet || 5 || tyāgo vivāsanaṃ dānaṃ teṣāṃ kāryaṃ vijānatā || tarpayedbrāhmaṇāṃścātra japahomāṃśca kārayet || 6 || mṛdaṃgavādyaiḥ paṭahaiḥ sagītaiḥ pūjā ca kāryā tridivaukasāṃ vai || dhātustathejyā vidhinā ca kāryā deyaṃ tathānnaṃ bahugo dvijebhyaḥ || 7 || iti śrīviṣṇudhamottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne vaikṛtopaśamanavarṇano nāmaikacatvāriṃśaduttaraśatatamo' dhyāyaḥ || 141 || <2.142> garga uvāca || || yānti yānānyayuktāni yuktāni na hi yānti cet || codyamānāni tasya syānmahadduḥkhamupasthitam || 1|| vādyamānā na vādyante vādyante cāpyanāhatāḥ || acalāśca calantyeva na calanti calāstathā || 2 || ākāśe tūryanādāśca gatigandharvanisvanāḥ || kāṣṭhaṃ dārvīvikārādi kuṭhāraṃ kurute yadi || 3 || gavāṃ lāṃgūlasaṃgaścetstriyaṃ tu yadi pātayet || uparāgā divyakṛtā ghoraṃ śastrabhayaṃ vadet || 4|| vāyostu pūjā dvija saktubhiśca kṛtvā taduktāṃstu japecca mantrān || dadyātprabhūtaṃ paramānnamatra pradakṣiṇāntena śamosya bhūyāt ||5|| iti śrīviṣṇudhamottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0 vajrasaṃvāde rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne upaskaravaikṛtavarṇano nāma dvicatvāriṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 142 || <2.143> garga uvāca || praviśanti yadā grāmamaraṇyā mṛgapakṣiṇaḥ || araṇyaṃ yānti vā grāmyāḥ sthalaṃ yānti jalodbhavā || 1 || jalaṃ vā sthalajā yānti ghoraṃ vāśanti nirbhayāḥ || rājadvāre puradvāre śivāścāpyaśivapradāḥ || 2 || divā rātriñcarā vāpi rātrau vāpi divācarāḥ || grāmyāstyajanti grāmaṃ vā śūnyatāṃ tasya nirdiśet || 3 || dīptā vāśanti sandhyāsu maṇḍalāni ca kurvate || vāśante visvaraṃ yatra tadāpyetatphalaṃ vadet || 4 || pradoṣe kukkuṭo vāśeddhemante vāpi kokilaḥ || arkodaye'rkābhimukhaḥ śvā vā nṛpabhayaṃ bhavet|| 5 || gṛhaṃ kapotaḥ praviśetkravyādo mūrdhni līyate || madhu vā mākṣakā kuryānmṛtyuṃ gṛhapatervadet || 6 || prākāradvārageheṣu toraṇāpaṇavīthiṣu || ketucchatrāyudhādyeṣu kravyātsannipatedyadi || 7 || jāyate vātha valmīko madhu vā dṛśyate yadi || sa deśo nāśamāyāti rājā ca mriyate'tha vā ||8|| mūṣakāñchalabhāndraṣṭvā prabhūtānkṣudbhayaṃ bhavet || kāṣṭholmukāsthi śṛṅgādyāḥ śvāno markaṭakairjitāḥ || 9 || śmaśānaṃ nirgatā grāmādgrāmaśreṣṭhavināśanāḥ || ekāṇḍatā tu kākānāṃ yadi caivāpyanaṇḍatā || 2.143.10 || nimneṣu ca niveśaśca deśanāśakaraḥ smṛtaḥ || apasavyaṃ bhramantaśca maṇḍale raṇavedinaḥ || 11 || durbhikṣavedino jñeyāḥ kākā dhānyamuṣo yadi || janānabhibhavantaśca nirbhayā raṇavedinaḥ || 12 || kāko maithunasaktaśca śvetaśca yadi dṛśyate || rājā vā mriyate tatra sa vā deśo vinaśyati || 13 || ulūko vāśate yatra vipatedvā tathā gṛhe || jñeyo gṛhapatermṛtyurdhananāśastathaiva ca || 14 || mṛgapakṣivikāreṣu kuryāddhomānsadakṣiṇān || devāḥ kapota iti ca japtavyāḥ pañcabhirdvijaiḥ || 15 || gāvaśca deyā vidhivaddvijānāṃ sakāñcanā vastrayugottarīyāḥ || evaṃ kṛte śāntimupaiti pāpaṃ mṛgairdvijairvā viniveditaṃ yat || 16 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0saṃ0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne autpātike mṛgapakṣivaikṛtavarṇano nāma tricatvāriṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 143 || <2.144> garga uvāca || prāsādatoraṇāṭṭāladvāraprākāraveśmanām || animittaṃ tu patanaṃ dṛḍhānāṃ rājamṛtyave || 1 || rajasā vātha dhūmena diśo yatra samākulāḥ || ādityacandratārāśca vivarṇā bhayavṛddhaye ||2|| rākṣasā yatra dṛśyante brāhmaṇāśca vidharmiṇaḥ || ṛtavaśca viparyastā apūjyaḥ pūjyate janaiḥ || 3 || nakṣatrāṇi viyogīni tanmahadbhayalakṣaṇam || ketūdayoparāgau ca cchidratā śaśisūryayoḥ || 4 || graharkṣavikṛtiryatra tatrāpi bhayamādiśet || striyaśca kalahāyante bālā nighnanti bālakān|| 5 || śīlācāravihīnāśca madyamāṃsānṛtapriyāḥ || tathā pāṣāṇabhūyiṣṭhāstrayīmārgacyutā dvijāḥ ||6|| yatra deśe vijāyante tatra vidyādupadravam || ucitairnābhipūjyante yūpānnabalibhiḥ sadā || 7|| kriyāṇāmucitānāṃ ca vicchittiryatra jāyate || agniryatra na dīpyeta hūyamānāsu śāntiṣu || 8 || pipīlikāstu kravyādo yāti cāturatastathā || pūrṇakumbhāḥ sravante ca havirvā vipralupyate || 9|| maṅgalyāśca giro yatra na śrūyante samantataḥ || kṣavathurdhāvatī cātha prahasanti rudanti ca||2.144.10|| na ca deveṣu vartante yathāvadbrāhmaṇeṣu ca || marmadoṣāṇi cocyante vādyante visurāṇi ca || 11 || gurumitradruho yatra śatrupūjāratā janāḥ || brāhmaṇānsuhado'mātyāñjano yatrāvamanyate||12|| śāntimaṅgalahomeṣu nāstikyaṃ yatra jāyate || rājā vā mriyate tatra sa vā deśo vinaśyati||13|| rājño
