vināśe samprāpte nimittāni nibodha me || brāhmaṇānprathamaṃ dveṣṭi brāhmaṇaiśca virudhyate ||14|| brāhmaṇairnindyate cāpi brāhmaṇāṃśca jighāṃsati || na tānsmarati kṛtyeṣu yācitaścābhi bhūyate || 15|| ramate nirdayaścaiṣāṃ praśaṃsāṃ nābhinandati || apūrvaṃ tu karaṃ lobhāttathā pātayate jane || 16 || eteṣvabhyarcyayecchakraṃ sapatnīkaṃ dvijottama || bhojyāni caiva kāryāṇi surāṇāṃ valayastathā||17|| gāvaśca deyā dvijapuṅgavebhyo bhuvaṃ tathā kāñcanamambaraśca|| homaśca kāryaḥ surapūjanaṃ ca evaṃ kṛte śāntimupaiti pāpam ||18|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne utpātapraśamanaṃ nāma catuśca tvāriṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ||144|| <2.145> rāma uvāca || kiṃ nu kṛtyatamaṃ rājñastanmamācakṣva pṛcchataḥ|| rājyatantraṃ kathaṃ rājñā pālanīyaṃ vipaścitā||1|| || puṣkara uvāca || saptāṃgasya ca rājyasya bhāvayuktena bhūbhṛtā || etāvadeva kartavyaṃ rājñā tantraṃ bhṛgūttama || 2 || sāma dānaṃ tathā durgaṃ kośo daṇḍastathaiva ca || mitraṃ janapadaścaiva rājyaṃ saptāṅgamucyate || 3 || saptāṅgasya ca rājyasya vighnakartṝnvivāsayet || ahitānghātayedrājā kṣipramevāvicārayan || 4 || saptāṅgasya ca rājyasya vṛddhiḥ kāryā sumaṇḍale || maṇḍaleṣu ca sarveṣu karṣaṇīyā mahīkṣitā || 5 || rāma uvāca || maṇḍalāni samācakṣva vijigīṣoryathāvidhi || yānyāśritya nṛpaiḥ kāryaṃ sandhivigrahacintanam || 6 || puṣkara uvāca || ātmamaṇḍalamevātra prathamaṃ maṇḍalaṃ bhavet || samantāttasya vijñeyā ripavo maṇḍalasya tu || 7 || adhikṛtyā'bhiyojyaṃ tu tatrāpi śṛṇu kalpanam || abhiyojyaḥ smṛtaḥ śatrustatrāpi ca pratīkṣitā || 8 || tatparastu suhṛjjñeyo mitraṃ mitraripustathā || etatpurastātkathitaṃ paścādapi nibodha me || 9 || pārṣṇigrāhastataḥ paścāttatastvākranda ucyate || āsārastu tatopyanyastvākrandāsāra ucyate || 2.145.10 || jigīṣoḥ śastrayuktasya viyuktasya tathā dvija ||| nigrahānugrahe śakto madhyasthaḥ parikīrtitaḥ || 11 || nigrahānugrahe śaktaḥ sarveṣāmapi yo bhavet || udāsīnaḥ sa kathito balavānpṛthivīpatiḥ || 12 || etāvadeva te rāma proktaṃ dvādaśarājakam || nātrāpi niścayaḥ śakyo vaktuṃ manujapuṅgava || 13 || nāsti jātyā ripurnāma mitraṃ nāma na vidyate || sāmarthyayogājjāyante mitrāṇi ripavastathā || 14 || trividhā ripavaḥ proktāḥ kulyānantara kṛtrimāḥ || pūrvaḥ pūrvo gurusteṣāṃ duścikitsyatamo mataḥ ||15|| anantaro'pi yaḥ śatruḥ so'pi me kṛtrimo mataḥ|| pārṣṇigrāho bhavedrājā śatrormitrābhiyoginaḥ || 16 || pārṣṇigrāhamupāyaistu śamayecca tathā svakam || mitreṇa śatrorucchedaṃ na śaṃsanti purātanāḥ || 17 || mitraṃ hi śatrutāmeti sāmantatvādanantaram || śatruṃ jigīṣurucchindyātsvayaṃ śaknoti cedyadi || 18 || pratāpavṛddhau tenāsya na mitrājjāyate bhayam || nānyathā pṛthivīṃ jetuṃ śaktyā rāma jigīṣuṇā || 19 || pratāpavṛddhiḥ kartavyā tasmādrājñā yathā tathā || tathāsya nodvijelloko viśvāsyaśca yathā bhaveta || 2.145.20 ||| jigīṣurdharmavijayī tathā lokaṃ vaśaṃ nayet || yaḥ syādadharmavijayī tasmādudvijate janaḥ || prāpyāpi vasudhāṃ kṛtsnāṃ na ciraṃ śrithamaśnute || || 21|| dharmeṇa yajño bhavatīha vṛddhirdharmeṇa vṛddhiśca tathāparatra || dharmeṇa labdhā vasudhā jitārirbhuktvā ciraṃ nākamanuprayāti ||22|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne rājyamaṇḍalavarṇanaṃ nāma pañcacatvariṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 145 ||| | <2.146> || rāma uvāca || || sāmabhedau tathā proktau dānadaṇḍau tathaiva ca || daṇḍaḥ sudeśe kathitaḥ paradeśe bravīhi me || 1 || puṣkara uvāca ||| dvividhaḥ kathito daṇḍaḥ paradeśe purātanaiḥ || prakāśaścāprakāśaśca taṃ nibodha dvijottama ||2|| luṇṭhanaṃ grāmaghātaśca sasyaghātastathaiva ca || caturaṅgeṇa daṇḍena pareṣāṃ ca tathā vadhaḥ || 3|| prakāśaḥ kathito daṇḍaḥ pratyakṣaṃ vahnidīpanam || aprakāśo viṣaṃ vahnirgūḍhaiśca puruṣairvadhaḥ || 4 || dūṣaṇaṃ yavasādīnāmudakānāṃ ca dūṣaṇam || rasakriyāśca vividhāḥ subhagā bhedanādikam || 5 || evamādīni kāryāṇi paracakre mahīkṣitā || svarāṣṭre ca dvijaśreṣṭha dūṣaṇaṃ balināmapi || 6 || catvāra ete kathitābhyupāyāḥ prādhānabhūtā bhuvi pārthivānām || ataḥ paraṃ te kathayāmi rāma śeṣāstrayaste na mayeritā ye || 7 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmārttare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0 saṃ0 daṇḍapraṇayanavarṇano nāma ṣaṭcatvāriṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 146 ||| <2.147> puṣkara uvāca || abhimanyeta nṛpatiranena mama vigrahe || anarthāyānubandhaḥ syātsandhinā ca tathā bhavet || 1 || sāma lajjāspadaṃ cātra dānaṃ cātra kṣayārthakam || bhede daṇḍe'nubandhaḥ syāttadā pakṣaṃ samāśrayet || 2 || avajñopahatastatra rājñā kāryo ripurbhavet || upekṣayaiva dharmajña śreyase tatra sā smṛtā || 3 || upekṣayā yatra tu śakyamarthaṃ kṣayavyavāyā samatā na tatra || kāryaṃ bhavedbrāhmaṇavigraheṇa lajjāspadenāpyatha sandhinā vā || 4 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne upekṣāvarṇano nāma saptacatvāriṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||147|| <2.148> puṣkara uvāca || utpātairanṛtaiḥ kāryaṃ parasyodvījanaṃ nṛpaiḥ || arātiśibirasyātra vasatiryasya pakṣiṇaḥ || 1 || sthūlasya tasya pucchasthāṃ kṛtvolkāṃ vipulāṃ dvija || visṛjyainaṃ tatastīramulkāpātaṃ pradarśayet || 2 || anenaivātra sāreṇa buddhyā niścitya yatnataḥ || utpātāni tathānyāni darśanīyāni pārthivaiḥ || 3 || udvejanaṃ tathā kuryātkuhakairdvividhairdviṣām || saṃvatsarānahārṣaśca nāśaṃ brūyuḥ parasya ca || 4 || jigīṣuḥ pṛthivī rājye tena codvejayetparān || devatānāṃ prasādāni kīrtanīyāni tasya tu || 5 || sa svapnalābhāṃśca tathā jigīṣuḥ pratikīrtayet ||| duḥsvapnalābhaṃ ca tathā pareṣāmiti niścayaḥ || 6 || āgataṃ no mitra balaṃ praharadhvamabhītavat || evaṃ brūyādraṇe prāpte mayā bhagnāḥ pare iti || 7 || kṣveḍāḥ kilakilāśabdaṃ mama śatrurhatastathā || devājñābṛṃhito rājā sannaddhaḥ samaraṃ prati ||8|| evaṃ prakārā dvijavarya māyāḥ kāryā narendrairariṣu prahṛṣṭaiḥ || māyāhataḥ śatruratha prasahya śakyaḥ sukhaṃ hantumadīnasattvaḥ || 9 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne upādhivarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭacatvāriṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 148 || <2.149> puṣkara uvāca || caturaṅgaṃ balaṃ rājā māyājālena darśayet || sahāyārthamanuprāptāndarśayettridivaukasaḥ || 1 || raktavṛṣṭiśca saṃdarśyā pareṣāṃ śivaraṃ prati || chinnāni ripuśīrṣāṇi prasādāgreṣu darśayet || 2 || ādhitsatā sandhimahīnasatva kāryaṃ bhavedrāma mahendrajālam || vakṣyāmi taccopaniṣatsu tubhyaṃ yogāni cānyāni jayāvahāni || 3 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde indrajālavarṇano nāmaikonapañcāśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 149 || <2.150> puṣkara uvāca || sandhiśca vigrahaścaiva vaiguṇyaṃ kathitaṃ budhaiḥ || yadāśritya tathaivānyaiḥ ṣāḍguṇyaṃ parikīrtitam ||1|| sandhiśca nigrahaścaiva yānamāsanameva ca || dvaidhībhāvaṃ saṃśrayaṃ ca ṣāḍguṇyaṃ parikīrtitam || 2 || paṇabandhaḥ smṛtaḥ sandhirapakārastu vigrahaḥ || jigīṣoḥ śatruviṣaye yānaṃ yātrā vidhīyate || 3 || vigrahe'pi svake deśe sthitirāsanamucyate || balārdhena pramāṇaṃ tu dvaidhībhāvaṃ taducyate || 4|| udāsīne madhyame vā saṃśrayātsaṃśrayaḥ smṛtaḥ || samena sandhiranveṣyo hīnena ca balīyasaḥ || || 5 || hīnena vigrahaḥ kāryaḥ svayaṃ rājñā balīyasā || tatrāpi tasya pārṣṇistu balīyānna samāśrayet || 6 || āsīnaḥ karmavicchedaṃ śaktaḥ kartuṃ ripuryadā || aśuddhapārṣṇirbalavāndvaidhībhāvaṃ samāśrayet || 7 || balinā nigṛhītantu yo manyedyena pārthivaḥ || saṃśrayastena kartavyo guṇānāmadhamo guṇaḥ ||8|| bahukṣayavyayāyāsaṃ teṣāṃ yānaṃ prakīrtitam || bahulābhakarambhaḥ syāttadā rāma samāśrayet || 9 || sarvaśaktivihīnastu tadā kuryāttu saṃśrayam ||2.150.10 || evaṃ ca buddhvā nṛpatirguṇānāṃ kāle ca deśe ca tathā vibhāge || samāśrayedbhārgavavaṃśamukhyaṃ caitāvaduktaṃ nṛpatestu kāryam || 11 ||| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne ṣāḍguṇyavarṇano nāma pañcāśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 150||| <2.151> || rāma uvāca || || ajasraṃ karma me brūhi rājñāṃ rājīvalocana || yacca kāryaṃ narendrāṇāṃ tadhā ca prativatsaram || 1 || || puṣkara uvāca || ||| dvimuhūrtāvaśeṣāyāṃ rātrau nidrāṃ tyajennṛpaḥ || veṇuvīṇāmṛdaṅgānāṃ paṭahānāṃ ca niḥsvanaiḥ || 2 || bandināṃ niḥsvanaiścaiva tathā maṅgalavādinām || tataḥ paśyenmahīpālo gūḍhāṃśca puruṣānniśi || 3 || vijñāyante na ye loke tadīyā iti kenacit || āyavyayasya śravaṇaṃ tataḥ kāryaṃ yathāvidhi || 4 || vegotsargaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā rājā snānagṛhaṃ vrajet|| dattābhyaṅgaḥ pradoṣe tu kalpamutsāditastataḥ ||5|| snānaṃ kuryāttataḥ paścāddantadhāvanapūrvakam|| sauṣadhairmantrapūtaistu pānīyairvividhaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 6 || sandhyāmupāsya prayataḥ kṛtajapyaḥ samāhitaḥ || agnyāgāraṃ praviśyātha vahnīn paśyetpurodhasā || 7 || hutān samyaktataḥ kuryādvāsudevasya cārcanam || duḥsvapnaśamanaṃ karma tatra kuryātpurohitaḥ ||8|| svayaṃ caupasade vahnau pavitrāṃ juhuyānnṛpaḥ || tarpayedudakairdevānpitṝnatha yathāvidhi||9|| dadyāddvijātaye dhenuṃ savatsāṃ ca sakāñcanām| śaktyā dhanaiḥ pūjayitvā dattāśīḥ satataṃ dvijaiḥ||2.151.10|| | anuliptastataḥ sragvī suvāsāścāpyalaṃkṛtaḥ || darpaṇe ca mukhaṃ paśyetsasuvarṇe ca sarpiṣi || 11 || ājyaṃ prasannaṃ surabhi yadi syādvijayo bhavet || | dīyamāne ca durgandhe patite ca bhayaṃ bhavet||12|| vikṛtaṃ cenmukhaṃ paśyedrājā mṛtyumavāpnuyāt || suprabhaṃ ca yadā paśyettadā tasya śubhaṃ bhavet ||13 || tatastu śṛṇuyādrājā sāṃvatsaramukhodgatam || divase tithinakṣatre sarvāśubhavināśanam ||14|| bhiṣajāṃ ca vacaḥ kuryāttatastvārogyavardhanam || maṅgalālambhanaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ paśyedgurūnnṛpaḥ ||15|| kṛtvāśīrgurubhiḥ paścādrājā gacchetsamantataḥ || tatrasthānbrāhmaṇānpaśyedamātyānmantriṇastathā ||16|| prakṛtīśca mahābhāga pratīhāranibodhataḥ || tatretihāsaśravaṇaṃ kuryātkiñcidatandritaḥ || 17 || tataḥ kāryārthināṃ kuryādyathādhīḥ kāryanirṇayam ||18|| vyavahārāṃstataḥ paśyetsamo bhūtvārimitrayoḥ || tyaktvā sabhāṃ tataḥ kuryānmantraṃ tu saha mantribhiḥ || 19 || yatrāsya kaścittaṃ mantraṃ śṛṇuyānna kathañcana|| ekena saha taṃ kuryānna kuryādbahubhiḥ saha || 2.151.20 || na ca mūrkhairna cānāmaistathā nādhārmikairnṛpaḥ || mantraṃ svadhiṣṭhitaṃ kuryādyena rāṣṭraṃ na dhāvati ||21|| rājñāṃ vināśamūlastu kathito mantravibhramaḥ || nāśaheturbhavenmantraḥ kuprayuktastvamantravat || 22 || maṃtre suniścite siddhiḥ kathitā pṛthivīkṣitām || kriyamāṇāni karmāṇi yasya vetti na kaścana || 23 || kṛtānyeva vijānāti sa rājā pṛthivīpatiḥ || pṛthak ca mantribhirmantraṃ kṛtaṃ vai saṃhitaiḥ punaḥ || 24 || vicāryamātmanaḥ sādhu paścāttatra samāśrayet || prajñābhimānī nṛpatirna mantrivacane rataḥ || 25 || kṣipraṃ vināśamāyāti taḍāgamiva kājalam || ākāragūhanai rājño mantrarakṣā parā matā || 26 || ākārairiṅgitaiḥ prājñā mantraṃ jānanti paṇḍitāḥ || sāṃvatsarāṇāṃ vaidyānāṃ mantriṇāṃ vacane rataḥ||27|| rājā vibhūtimāpnoti ciraṃ yaśasi tiṣṭhati || ta enaṃ mṛgayāsaktaṃ dhārayanti vipaścitaḥ||28|| strīṣu māne tathākṣeṣu vṛthā jyāyāṃśca bhārgava || karapraṇayane saktaṃ hiṃsāyāṃ ca narādhipam || 29 || tathā parokṣanindāyāṃ balavadvigrahe'pi ca || anyeṣu cāpyanartheṣu prasaktaṃ vārayanti tam || 2.151.30 || mantraṃ kṛtvā tataḥ kuryādvyāyāmaṃ pṛthivīpatiḥ || rathe nāge tathaivāśve khaḍge dhanuṣi cāpyatha || 31 || anyeṣu caiva śastreṣu niyuddheṣu tataḥ param || padbhyāmudvartitaḥ snātaḥ paśyedviṣṇuṃ supūjitam||32|| hutaṃ ca pāvakaṃ paśyedviprānpaśyetsupūjitān|| svāmino dakṣiṇābhiśca pūjitānbhṛgunandana ||33|| tato'nuliptaḥ surabhiḥ sragvī rucirabhūṣaṇaḥ || suvāsā bhojanaṃ kuryādgītaṃ ca śṛṇuyāttadā ||34|| āptaṃ parīkṣitaṃ vahnau mṛgapakṣīṅgitaistathā|| pūrvaṃ parīkṣitaṃ cānyairjāṃgulyā cābhimantritam||35|| viṣaghnāṃśca maṇīnrājā dhārayannauṣadhīṃstathā || bhuktvā gṛhītatāmbūlaḥ parikramya viśeṣataḥ || 36|| śayane vāmapārśvena tataḥ śāstrāṇi cintayet || koṣṭhāgārāyudhāgārānprati cāgryaṃ ca vāhanam || 37 || yodhāṃśca dṛṣṭvā cānvāsyā tataḥ sandhyā ca paścimā || kāryāṇi cintayitvā ca preṣayitvā tataścarān || antaḥpuracaro bhūtvā laghu bhuktvā tathā hitam || 38 || saveṇuvīṇāpaṭahasvanena seveta nidrāṃ kṛtapūrvarakṣām || etadyaśasyaṃ hi narādhipānāmājasrikaṃ te kathitaṃ vidhānam || 39 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne ājasriko nāmaikapañcāśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 151 || <2.152> || puṣkara uvāca || rājā tu janmanakṣatre prati māsaṃ samācaret || janmanaḥ kṣālanaṃ karma yattatpūrvaṃ mayeritam || 1 || puṣpasnānaṃ tataḥ kuryātpratimāsaṃ narādhipaḥ || saṃkrāntau pūjayetsūryaṃ bālaminduṃ tathaiva ca ||2 || grahaṃ sampūjayedrājā nirgataṃ ravimaṇḍalāt|| agastyasyodaye kāryā tathā pūjā narādhipaiḥ || 3 || pūjayeccaturo māsānprasuptaṃ madhusūdanam || proṣṭhapādāmale rakṣetpūjayecca śatakratum ||4|| navamyāmāśvayucchukle bhadrakālīṃ ca pūjayet || ravau svātimanuprāpte kuryānnīrājanaṃ tathā||5|| saṃvatsarātkoṭihomaṃ kuryācca ghṛtakevalam|| rājyasaṃvatsaragranthau kuryāttadrudrapūjanam|| karmāṇyathaitāni narādhipasya nityāni te rāma mayoditāni || etāni kṛtvā vidhivannarendraściraṃ samāgrāṃ vasudhāṃ praśāsti||7|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0saṃ0rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne sāṃvatsarika varṇano nāma dvipañcāśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||152|| <2.153> rāma uvāca || kathaṃ hi caturo māsānkāryaṃ keśavapūjanam || pārthivena suraśreṣṭha tanmamācakṣva pṛcchataḥ || 1 || puṣkara uvāca || udyuktena sadā bhāvyaṃ rājñā bhṛgukulodvaha || āṣāḍhaśuklapakṣānte rājā sthānamupāśrayet || 2 || adhṛṣyaṃ pararāṣṭrāṇāṃ prabhūtayavasendhanam || toyopetaṃ vipaṅkaṃ ca prāvṛṭkālahataṃ tathā ||3|| yatrasthaśca svaviṣayaṃ sarvaṃ śaknoti rakṣitum || tatrasthaścaturo māsānajāṃśca poṣayennṛpaḥ || 4 || snehapānairbahuvidhaiḥ pratipānaiśca bhārgava || āṣāḍhaśuklapakṣānte daśamyūrddhvaṃ narādhipaḥ || 5 || utsavantu mahatkuryāddevasya cārcane rataḥ || arcāyāṃ vā paṭe vāpi kṛtaṃ devamathārcayeta || 6 || devabhogamayaṃ viṣṇuṃ śrīsahāyamarindamam || balibhirvividhābhistu puṣpairdhūpaiḥ sugandhibhiḥ || 7 || utsavaṃ tu mahatkuryāttataḥ pañcadinaṃ nṛpaḥ || tataḥ prabhṛti nityaṃ syādvāsudevasya pūjanam ||8|| sāttvatairbhārgavaśreṣṭha sāṃvatsarapurohitaiḥ || gītanṛtyaistathā devaṃ viśeṣeṇātra pūjayet ||9|| asminneva tathā kāle koṭihomaṃ samācaret || kārtikyāṃ tatsamāptistu yathā bhavati bhārgava||2.153.10|| śuklapakṣatribhāgentye kārtikasya tato nṛpaḥ || utsavaṃ sumahatkuryāddevadevārcanaṃ tathā || 11 || vaikuṇṭhaṃ pūjayeddevamarcāyāmathavā paṭe || mahādānaṃ tato dadyātprekṣyāṃ dadyāttathaiva ca || 12 || mallānāmatha jhallānāṃ naṭānāṃ nartakaiḥ saha || yātrāvidhānaṃ sakalaṃ tathā kuryānmahīpatiḥ || 13 || etatkṛtvā tato yātrā deyā bhavati pārthivaiḥ || śaratkāle gatātaṃkaiḥ puṣṭāśvarathakuñjaraiḥ || 14 || evaṃ ca rājñā caturo hi māsānpūjyo bhaveddevavaro hi hartā || santyaktacihnaṃ madhusūdanaṃ ca saṃpūjya yātrābhimatapradā syāt || 15 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne cāturmāsyavidhikathano nāma tripañcāśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 153 || <2.154> || rāma uvāca|| śakrasampūjanaṃ kāryaṃ kathaṃ rājñā surottama || samyagbhādrapade māsi tanmamācakṣva pṛcchataḥ || 1 || puṣkara uvāca || asuraistu surā bhagnāḥ purā yuddhe bhṛgūttama || brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ jagmuḥ sarvabhūtahite ratam || 2 || te tu mūḍhāḥ surāḥ sarve nirjitā dānavairvadham || tānuvāca tato brahmā kṣīrode madhusūdanam || 3 || gacchadhvaṃ sahitāḥ sarve sa vaḥ śreyaḥ kariṣyati || evamuktvā surāḥ sarve kṣīrode keśavaṃ yayuḥ || 4 || dadṛśuśca tadā devaṃ vāsudevaṃ jagadgurum || amṛtādhmātameghābhaṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam || 5 || tuṣṭuvuśca mahābhāgaṃ tridaśāstaṃ punaḥpunaḥ || sarveṣāmīśvaraṃ devaṃ bhuvanasyaikakāraṇam || 6 || devā ūcuḥ || namaste puṇḍarīkākṣa śaraṇāgatavatsala || devāribaladarpaghna tridaśendrasukhaprada ||7|| cāmīkarābhavasana tārkṣyapravaraketana || śeṣaparyaṅkaśayana lakṣmīhṛdayavallabha || 8 || surāsuraśiroratnanighṛṣṭacaraṇāmbuja || unnidracārukamalavirājitakarāmbuja || 9 || sa caikadaiva bhagnānāmasmākamasurairbhavān || gatistena sma samprāptā daityabhagnāstvadantikam || 2.154.10 || prasīda devadeveśa jahi tānasurādhamān || ye'smākaṃ devadeveśa pīḍayanti sadaiva tu || 11 || bhagavānuvāca || dhvajametaṃ pradāsyāmi bhavatāmarināśanam || dṛṣṭamātreṇa yeneha vidraviṣyanti dānavāḥ || 12 || śrīpuṣkara uvāca || evamuktvā dhvajaṃ teṣāṃ dadau viṣṇuranuttamam || sauvarṇamucchritaṃ divyaṃ śakradhvajamiti śrutam ||13|| tamādāya surāḥ sarve prayayurdānavālayam|| devānupagatāñchrutvā dānavā niryayustataḥ || 14 || susannaddhabalāḥ sarve pragṛhītāyudhāstathā || dṛṣṭvā devabalaṃ te ca śakraketuvirājitam || 15 || tattejasā mahābhāga mūrcchībhūtāḥ kṣaṇena tu || mūrcchitāstu tato daityāstridaśairvinipātitāḥ ||16 || kecidbhagnā diśo jagmussamudraṃ viviśustataḥ || tato labdhajayaḥ śakraḥ pūjayāmāsa taṃ dhvajam || 17|| pūjayitvā nṛpataye vasave pradadau tadā || gargoktena vidhānena taṃ ca pūjitavānvasuḥ || 18|| tenāsya tuṣṭo maghavānidaṃ vacanamabravīt || indra uvāca || yepyanye bhūmipāḥ śreṣṭhāḥ śakradhvajamahotsavam ||19|| adya prabhṛti dharmajña kariṣyanti samāhitāḥ || teṣāṃ tu vividhā vṛddhirbhaviṣyati sadā dvija || 2.154.20 || durbhikṣaṃ marako vyādhiḥ paracakrabhayaṃ tathā || sarvāṇyetāni naśyanti kṛte śakradhvajotsave || ||21|| puṣkara uvāca || tataḥ prabhṛti rājāno rāma śakramahotsavam || kurvanti gargakathitaṃ sarvābhayavināśanam ||22|| dhanyaṃ yaśasyaṃ ripunāśakāri kīrtipradaṃ dharmaphalapradaṃ ca || kāryaṃ narendrairvijayāya yatnācchakrotsavaṃ tatkathayāmi tubhyam || 23 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne śakradhvajotpattivarṇano nāma catuḥpañcāśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 154 || <2.155> puṣkara uvāca || śibirātpūrvadigbhāge bhūmibhāge tathā śubhe || prāgudakpravaṇe deśe śakrārthaṃ bhavanaṃ śubham || 1 || vāsobhiḥ śayanaiḥ śuddhairnānārāgaistathaiva ca || tataḥ śakradhvajasthānaṃ madhye saṃsthāpya yatnataḥ || 1 || maghavantaṃ paṭaṃ kuryāttasya bhāge tu dakṣiṇe || 3 || vāmabhāge paṭe kuryācchacīṃ devīṃ tathaiva ca || proṣṭhapādasite pakṣe pratipatprabhṛti kramāt || 4 || tayostu pūjā kartavyā satataṃ vasudhādhipaiḥ || vanapraveśavidhinā śakrayaṣṭiṃ tato nṛpa || 5 || ānayedgorathenātha vāyavaiḥ puruṣairatha || arjunasyājakarṇasya priyakasya vacasya ca || 6 || suradāruṇaśca tathā tathaivodumbarasya ca || candanasyātha vā rāma padmakasyātha vā yadi || 7 || alābhe sarvakāṣṭhānāṃ yaṣṭiṃ kurvīta vaiṇavīm || suvarṇanaddhāṃ dharmajña tāṃ ca samyakpraveśayet ||8|| proṣṭhapādasite pakṣe aṣṭamyāṃ ripusūdana || kramapramāṇā vijñeyā śakrayaṣṭistato nṛpa ||9|| caturbhiraṅgulairhīnā sāgre bhavati śarmadā || aṣṭābhiśca tathā mūle chittvā toye yathā kṣipet || 2.155.10 || yāyāduddhṛtya nagaraṃ samyageva pravartate || tasyāḥ praveśe nagaraṃ patākādhvajamāli ca || 11 || siktarājapathaṃ kuryāttathālaṃkṛtabālakam || naṭanartakasaṅkīrṇaṃ tathā pūjitadaivatam || 12 || sampūjitagṛhaṃ rāma tathā pūjitavānayam || paurairanugato rājā suvaṃśaiḥ phalapāṇibhiḥ ||13|| aṣṭamyāṃ vādyaghoṣeṇa tāṃ tu yaṣṭiṃ praveśayet || prākchirāstāṃ tataḥ kuryādvastraiḥ saṃcchāditāṃ śubhaiḥ || 14 || pūjitāṃ pūjayettāntu yāvatsā dvādaśīphalam || ekādaśyāṃ sopavāso nṛpaḥ kuryātprajāgaram || 15 || sāṃvatsareṇa sahito mantriṇā sapurodhasā || rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kāryaṃ nāgareṇa janena tu || 16 || sthānesthāne mahābhāga deyā prekṣyā tathā madhu || pūjayennṛtyagītena rātrau śakraṃ narādhipaḥ || 17 || dvādaśyāṃ tu śiraḥsnāto nṛpatiḥ prayatastataḥ || yantreṇotthāpanaṃ kuryācchakraketoḥ samāhitaḥ || 18 || suyaṃtritaṃ tu taṃ kuryādgṛhaṃ stambhacatuṣṭayam || pūjayettanmahābhāga gandhamālyānnasampadā || 19 || nityaṃ ca paṭayoḥ pūjā yaṣṭipūjāṃ ca kārayet || balibhistu vicitrābhistathā brāhmaṇapūjanaiḥ ||2.155.20|| nityaṃ ca juhuyānmantrānpurodhāḥ śākravaiṣṇavān || nityaṃ nṛtyena gītena tathā śakraṃ ca pūjayet || 21 || dvādaśyāṃ pūjayedrājā brāhmaṇāndhanasañcayaiḥ || viśeṣeṇa ca dharmajña sāṃvatsara purohitau || 22 || utthāne ca praveśe ca śakrabhūyānnarādhipaḥ || vakṣyamāṇena mantreṇa kālavitsapurohitaḥ || 23 || pūjayedutthitaṃ ketuṃ bhūṣaṇairvividhairapi || chatreṇa ca tathā vastrairmālyadāmaistathaiva ca || 24 || evaṃ sampūjayedrāma tadā dinacatuṣṭayam || pañcame divase prāpte śukraketuṃ visarjayet || 25|| pūjayitvā mahābhāga balena caturaṅgiṇā || nītvā karīndraistritayaṃ tato nadyāṃ pravāhayet || 26 || vādyaghoṣeṇa mahatā saṃgītaṃ tatra kīrtitam || paurā jānapadāstatra krīḍāṃ kuryustadāmbhasi || utsavaṃ ca tathā kāryaṃ jalatīragatairmahat || 27 || etadvidhānaṃ nṛpatistu kṛtvā prāpnoti vṛddhiṃ dhanavāhanānām || nāśaṃ tathā śatrugaṇasya rāma mahatprasādaṃ tridaśādhinātham || 28 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne śakradhvajotsavavarṇano nāma pañcapañcāśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 155 || <2.156> || puṣkara uvāca || indradhvajaśiro bhajyetpatedindradhvajo yadi || bhajyate śakrayaṣṭirvā nṛpaterniyataṃ vadhaḥ || 1 || yantrabhaṅge tathā jñeyaṃ rajjucchede tathaiva ca || mātṛkāyāstathā bhaṅge paracakre bhayaṃ dvija || 2 || divyāntarikṣabhaumāḥ syurutpātāstatra vai yathā || teṣāṃ tīvratamaṃ jñeyaṃ phalamatyantadāruṇam || 3 || nilīyate cetkravyādaḥ śakrayaṣṭau yadā dvija || rājā vā mriyate tatra sa vā deśo vinaśyati || 4 || iṃdradhvajopakaraṇaṃ yatkiṃciddvijasattama || vinaśyati tadā jñeyā pīḍā nagaravāsinām || 5 || iṃdravājinimitte tu prāyaścittamidaṃ smṛtam || indrayāgaṃ punaḥ kuryātsauvarṇenendraketunā || 6 || rājyaṃ dattvā ca guruve bandhanāni pramocayet || saptāhaṃ pūjayitvā ca dhvajaṃ dadyāddvijātiṣu || 7 || śāntiraindrī bhavetkāryā yaṣṭavyaśca purandaraḥ || mahābhojyāni kāryāṇi brāhmaṇānāṃ dinedine || 8 || gāvaśca deyā drijapuṅgavebhyo hiraṇyavāsorajataiḥ sametāḥ || evaṃ kṛte śāntimupaiti pāpa vṛddhistathā syānmanujādhipasya || 9 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde indradhvaja nimittaśamanavarṇano nāma ṣaṭpañcāśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||156|| <2.157> rāma uvāca || śakrocchrāye tu yānmantrānsopavāso nṛpaḥ paṭhet || tānahaṃ śrotumicchāmi sarvadharmabhṛtāṃ vara ||1|| puṣkara uvāca || śṛṇu mantrānimānsamyaksarvakilbiṣanāśanān || prāpte śakradhvajocchrāye yaḥ paṭhetprayato nṛpaḥ ||2|| varastvindrajitā mitravṛtrahanpākaśāsana || devadeva mahābhāga tvaṃ hi vardhiṣṇutāṃ gataḥ||3|| tvaṃ prabhuḥ śāśvataścaiva sarvabhūtahite rataḥ|| anantatejo virajo yaśovijayavardhanaḥ || aprabhustvaṃ prabhurnityamuttiṣṭha surapūjita || 4 || brahmā svayaṃbhūrbhagavānsarvalokapitāmahaḥ || rudraḥ pinākabhṛddṛptaścatasṛdvayasaṃstutaḥ || 5 || yogasya netā kartā ca tathā viṣṇururukramaḥ || tejaste vardhayantvete nityameva mahābalāḥ || 6 || anādinidhano devo brahmā sraṣṭā sanātanaḥ || agnistejomayo bhāgo rudrātmā pārvatīsutaḥ || 7 || kārtikeyaḥ śaktidharaḥ ṣaḍvaktraśca gadādharaḥ || śataṃ vareṇyo varadastejo vardhayatāṃ vibhuḥ || 8 || devaḥ senāpatiḥ skandaḥ surapravarapūjitaḥ || ādityā vasavo rudrāḥ sādhyā devāstathāśvinau || 9 || bhṛguraṅgirasaścaiva viśvedevā marudgaṇāḥ || lokapālāstrayaścaiva candraḥ sūryo'nalo'nilaḥ || 2.157.10 || devāśca ṛṣayaścaiva yakṣagandharvarākṣasāḥ || samudrā girayaścaiva nadyo bhūtāni yāni ca || 11 || tejastapāṃsi satyaṃ ca lakṣmīḥ śrīḥ kīrtireva ca || pravardhayatu tattejo jaya śakra śacīpate||12|| tava cāpi jayānnityaṃ tviha saṃpadyate śubham || prasīda rājñāṃ viprāṇāṃ prajānāmapi sarvaśaḥ || 13 || tava prasādātpṛthivī nityaṃ sasyavatī bhavet || śivaṃ bhavatu nirvighnaṃ śamyaṃtāmītayo bhṛśam ||14 || namaste devadeveśa namaste balasūdana || namucighna namaste'stu sahasrākṣa śacīpate || 15 || sarveṣāmeva lokānāṃ tvamekā paramā gatiḥ || tvameva paramaḥ prāṇaḥ sarvasyāsya jagatpate || 16 || pāśo hyasi pathaḥ sraṣṭuṃ tvamanalpaṃ purandara || tvameva meghastvaṃ vāyustvamagnirvaidyutombare || 17|| tvamatra medhā vikṣiptā tvamme bāhuḥ pratardanam|| tvaṃ vajramatulaṃ ghoraṃ ghoṣavāṃstvaṃ balāhakaḥ || 18 || sraṣṭā tvameva lokānāṃ saṃhartā cāparājitaḥ || tvaṃ jyotiḥ sarvalokānāṃ tvamādityo vibhāvasuḥ||19|| tvaṃ mahadbhūtamāścaryaṃ tvaṃ rājā tvaṃ surottamaḥ || tvaṃ viṣṇustvaṃ sahasrākṣastvaṃ devastvaṃ parāyaṇam||| || 2.157.20|| tvameva cāmṛtaṃ devastvaṃ mokṣaḥ paramārcitaḥ || tvaṃ muhūrtaḥ sthitistvaṃ ca lavastvaṃ ca punaḥ kṣaṇaḥ ||21|| śuklastvaṃ bahulaścaiva kalā kāṣṭhā truṭistathā || saṃvatsarartavo māsā rajanyaśca dināni ca ||22|| tvamuttamā sagiricarā vasuṃdharā sabhāskaraṃ timiramambaraṃ tathā || sahodadhiḥ satimiṅgilastathā sahormivānbahumakaro jhaṣākulaḥ ||23|| mahadyaśāstvamiha sadā ca pūjyase maharṣibhirmuditamanā maharṣibhiḥ || abhiṣṭutaḥ pibasi ca somamadhvare hutānyapi ca havīṃṣi bhūtaye || 24 || tvaṃ vipraiḥ satatamihejyase phalārthaṃ bhedārtheṣvaṣṭasu balaugha gīyase tvam || tvaddhetoryajanapārāyaṇā dvijendrā vedāṅgānyadhigamayanti sarvavedaiḥ || 25 || vajrasya bhartā bhuvanasya goptā vṛtrasya hartā namucernihantā || kṛṣṇe vasāno vasane mahātmā satyānṛte yo vivinakti loke ||26|| yaṃ vājinaṃ garbhamapāṃ surāṇāṃ vaiśvānaraṃ vāhanamabhyupaiti || namaḥ sadā'smai tridiveśvarāya lokatrayeśāya purandarāya || 27 ||| ajo'vyayaḥ śāśvata ekarūpo viṣṇurvarāhaḥ puruṣaḥ purāṇaḥ || tvamantakaḥ sarvaharaḥ kṛśānuḥ saharṣaśīrṣā śatamanyurīḍyaḥ || 28 || kaviṃ saptajihvaṃ trātāramindraṃ savitāraṃ sureśam || hṛdayābhiśakraṃ vṛtrahaṇaṃ suṣeṇamasmākaṃ vīrā uttare bhavantu || 29 || trātāramindrendriyakāraṇātmañjagatpradhānaṃ ca hiraṇyagarbham || lokeśvaraṃ devavaraṃ vareṇyaṃ cānandarūpaṃ praṇatosmi nityama || 2.157.30 || imaṃ stavaṃ devavarasya kīrtayenmahātmanastridaśapateḥ susaṃyataḥ || avāpya kāmānmanasobhirāmānsvarlokamāyāti ca dehabhede || 31 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0saṃ0 śakrastavavarṇano nāma saptapañcāśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 157 || <2.158> rāma uvāca || vidhinā pūjayetkena bhadrakālīṃ narādhipaḥ || navamyāmāśvine māsi śuklapakṣe narottama|| 1 || puṣkara uvāca || pūrvottare tu digbhāge śibirātsumanohare || bhadrakālīgṛhaṃ kuryāccitravastrairalaṃkṛtam || 2|| bhadrakālīṃ paṭe kṛtvā tatra sampūjayeddvija|| āśvine śuklapakṣe tu aṣṭamyāṃ prayatastataḥ||3|| tatraivāyudhavarmādyaṃ chatraṃ ketuṃ ca pūjayet || rājaliṅgāni sarvāṇi tathāstrāṇi ca pūjayeta ||4|| puṣpairgandhaiḥ phalairbhakṣyerbhojyaiśca sumanoharaiḥ || bahubhiśca vicitrābhiḥ prekṣādānaistathaiva ca||5|| rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryāttatraiva vasudhādhipaḥ || evaṃ saṃpūjayeddevīṃ varadāṃ bhaktavatsalām||6|| kātyāyanīṃ kāmagamāṃ vararūpāṃ varapradām|| pūjitāṃ sarvakāmaiśca sā yuṅkte vasudhādhipam ||7|| evaṃ hi sampūjya jagatpradhānaṃ yātrā tu deyā vasudhādhipena || prāpnoti siddhiṃ paramāṃ maheśo janastathānyo'pi hi vittaśaktyā || 8 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0 saṃ0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne bhadrakālīpūjā nāmāṣṭapañcāśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ||158|| <2.159> rāma uvāca || nīrājanavidhiṃ tvattaḥ śrotumicchāmi sattama || kathaṃ kāryā narendrasya śāntiṃ nīrājane prabho || 1 || puṣkara uvāca || pūrvottare tu digbhāge nagarātsumanohare || vistīrṇaṃ kārayedrājā manoharamāśrayam || 2 || kaṭairguptaṃ kuśāstīrṇaṃ patākādhvajaśobhitam || toraṇatritayaṃ tatra prāṅmukhaṃ kārayecchubham || 3 || kāryaṃ ṣoḍaśahastaṃ tu toraṇaṃ tu samucchritam || vaipulyaṃ daśahastaṃ tu tatra kāryaṃ bhṛgūttama || 4 || toraṇāddakṣiṇe bhāge tatra kāryaṃ samāśrayam || devatārcā bhavedyatra tathāgnihavana kriyā || 5 || aṣṭahastāyatotsedhamulmukānāṃ tu vāmataḥ || kāryaṃ bhavati śuṣkāṇāṃ kūṭaṃ bhṛgukulodvaha || 6 || pañcaraṅkasūtreṇa śatagranthiṃ manoramām || madhyame toraṇe kuryācchatapāśīṃ tu madhyagām || 7 || chādayitvā kuśaistāṃ tu mudā saṃchādayetpunaḥ || tasyāśca laṃghanaṃ varjyaṃ prayatnātsarvajantubhiḥ || 8 || na laṃghitā sā yāvatsyātprathamaṃ rājahastinā || citrāṃ tyaktvā yadā svātiṃ savitā pratipadyate || 9 ||| tataḥ prabhṛti kartavyā yāvatsvātau raviḥ sthitaḥ || āśrame pratyahaṃ devāḥ pūjanīyā dvijottama || 2.159.10 || brahmā viṣṇuśca śambhuśca śakraścaivānalānilau|| vināyakaḥ kumāraśca varuṇo dhanado yamaḥ || 11 || viśvāndevānmahābhāga uccaiḥśravasameva ca || aṣṭau mahāgajāḥ pūjyāsteṣāṃ nāmāni me śṛṇu || 12 || kumudairāvaṇau padmaḥ puṣpadanto'tha vāmanaḥ || supratīkāñjanau nīla ete'ṣṭau devayonayaḥ || || 13 || pūjā kāryā graharkṣāṇāṃ tathaiva ca purodhasā || tatastu juhuyādvahnau purodhā susamāhitaḥ || 14 || yathābhimatadevānāṃ mantraistalliṅgasaṃjñakam|| tathā ca mantrahīnānāṃ praṇavena mahābhuja || 15 || samidhaḥ kṣīravṛkṣāṇāṃ tathā siddhārthakāni ca || ghṛtaṃ tilāṃśca dharmajña tathā caivākṣatāni ca || 16| hutvā ca kalaśānkuryātsodakāngandhasaṃyutān || pūjitānmālyagandhaiśca vanaspativibhūṣitān || 17 || pañcaraṅgakasūtreṇa kuryādvastragatāṃstathā || bhallātaśālisiddhārthā vacākuṣṭhapriyaṅgavaḥ || 18 || toraṇātpaścime bhāge kalaśaiḥ pūrvakalpitaiḥ || tataḥ saṃsnāpanīyāḥ syurmaṃtrapūtairgajottamaiḥ || 19 || turagāṃśca mahābhāga cālaṅkṛtya tatastu tān || tatobhiṣekanāgasya tathā tatturagasya ca ||2.159.20|| annapiṇḍaṃ tato deyamabhimantrya purodhasā || tasyābhinandane rājño vinayaḥ parikīrtitaḥ || 21 || tyāge ca tasya vijñeyaṃ mahadbhayamupasthitam || niṣkrāmayettoraṇaistu tato hi prathamaṃ gajān || 22 || tatrāpi prathamaṃ rāma abhiṣicya gajottamam || tasyādau śatapāśīṃ tu naraḥ pañcanakho'pi vā || 23 || atha hyanyo laṃghayettāṃ rājño maraṇamādiśet || durbhikṣaṃ tatra vijñeyaṃ gokharoṣṭraiśca laṃghane || 24 || laṃghayedvāmapādena yadi tāṃ nṛpakuñjaraḥ || rājā purohitāmātyarājaputrahitaṃ bhavet ||25 || rājñastu maraṇaṃ būyādākramettaṃ yadāparaḥ || rājñopi jayamācaṣṭe laṃghayendakṣiṇena tām || 26 || rājahastini niṣkrānte sā tvayā syāttadā bhavet || niṣkrāmeyustataḥ sarveḥ prāṅmukhāstoraṇairgajāḥ || 27 || tatostrāḥ sumahābhāga tatastu narasattama || tataśchatraṃ dhvajaṃ caiva rājaliṅgāni yāni ca || || 28 || āśrame tāni saṃsthāpya pūjayedāyudhāni ca || pañcaraṅgakasūtreṇa yāstāḥ pratisarā kṛtāḥ || 29 || dūṣyādūṣyetimantreṇa nibadhnīyātpurohitaḥ || sarveṣāṃ nṛpanāgānāṃ turagāṇāṃ ca bhārgava || 2.159.30 || svagṛheṣu tato neyā kuñjarāsturagaiḥ saha || svātisthaḥ savitā yāvattāvacchāyāsu saṃsthitān || 31 || pūjayetsatataṃ rāma nākrośenna ca tāḍayet || rājacihnāni sarvāṇi pūjayedāśrame sadā || 32 || pūjayedvaruṇaṃ nityaṃ tathāpsu vidhivaddvija || bhūtejyā ca tathā kāryā rātrau balibhiruttamaiḥ || 33 || āśramaṃ rakṣaṇīyaṃ syātpuruṣaiḥ śastrapāṇibhiḥ || vasetāmāśrame nityaṃ sāṃvatsara purohitau||34|| aśvavaidyapradhānaśca tathā nāgabhiṣagvaraḥ || dīkṣitaistaistathā bhāvyaṃ brahmacāribhireva ca||35|| svātiṃ tyaktvā yadā sūryo viśākhāṃ pratipadyate|| alaṃkuryāddine tasminvāhanāṃśca viśeṣataḥ||36|| pūjitā rājaliṅgāśca kartavyā narahastagāḥ|| hastinaṃ turagaṃ chatraṃ khaḍgaṃ vā pañcadundubhim ||37|| dhvajaṃ patākāṃ dharmajña kālajñastvabhimaṃtrayet || abhimantrya tataḥ sarvānkuryātkuñjaradhūrgatāma||38|| kuñjaroparigau syātāṃ sāṃvatsarapurohitau || aśvavaidya pradhānaśca tathā nāgabhiṣagvaraḥ || 39 || tato'bhimantritaṃ rājā samāruhya turaṅgamam || niṣkramya toraṇe nāgamabhimantrya samāruhet || 2.159.40 || toraṇena viniṣkramya kuryātsuravisarjanam || baliṃ visṛjya vidhivadrājā kuñjaradhūrgataḥ ||41|| ratnairalaṅkṛtaḥ sarvairvījyamānaśca cāmaraiḥ || ulmukānāṃ ca nicayamādīpitamanantaram || 42 || rājā pradakṣiṇaṃ kuryāttrīnvārānsusamāhitaḥ || 43 || caturaṅgabalopetaḥ sarvasainyasamanvitaḥ || kṣveḍākilakilā śabdaiḥ sarvavāditraniḥsvanaiḥ || 44 || valgitaiśca padātīnāṃ hṛṣṭānāṃ manujottama || evaṃ kṛtvā gṛhaṃ gacchedrājā sainyapuraḥsaraḥ || 45 || janaṃ sampūjya ca gṛhātsarvameva visarjayet || śāntirnīrājanākhyeyaṃ kartavyā vasudhādhipaiḥ|| kṣemyā vṛddhikarī rāma narakuñjaravājinām || 46 || dhanyā yaśasyā ripunāśanī ca sukhāvahā śāntiranuttamā ca || kāryā nṛpai rāṣṭravivṛddhihetoḥ sarvaprayatnena bhṛgupravīra || 47 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne nīrājanaśāntivarṇano nāmaikonaṣaṣṭyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 159 || <2.160> || rāma uvāca || chatrāśca ketukariṇāṃ patākā khaḍgacarmaṇām || tathā dundubhicāpānāṃ brūhi mantrānmamānagha || 1 || puṣkara uvāca || śṛṇu mantrānmahābhāga bhagavānyatparāśaraḥ || gālavāya purovāca sarvadharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ || 2 || parāśara uvāca || yathāmbudaśchādayati śivāyemāṃ vasundharāma || tathācchādaya rājānaṃ vijayārogyavṛddhaye || 3 || iti cchatramantraḥ || parāśara uvāca || gandharvakularājastvaṃ mā bhūyāḥ kuladūṣakaḥ || brahmaṇaḥ satyavākyena somasya varuṇasya ca || 4 || prabhāvaśca hutāśasya bhavasya tvaṃ turaṅgama || tejasā caiva sūryasya munīnāṃ tapasāṃ tathā || 5 || rudrasya brahmacaryeṇa pavanasya balena ca || smara tvaṃ rājaputro'si kaustubhaṃ ca maṇiṃ smara ||6|| yāṃ gatiṃ brahmahā gacchetpitṛhā mātṛhā tathā || bhūmyarthe'nṛtavādī ca kṣattriyaśca parāṅmukhaḥ || 7 || sūryācandramasau vāyuryāvatpaśyanti duṣkṛtam || vrajettvetāṃ gatiṃ kṣipraṃ tacca pāpaṃ bhavettava || 8 || vikṛtiṃ yadi gacchenno yuddhe'dhvani turaṅgama || ripūnvijitya samare sahabhartrā sukhī bhava || 9 || ityaśvamantraḥ || parāśara uvāca || śakraketo mahāvīra suparṇastatsutāśritaḥ || patatrirāṭ vainateyastathā nārāyaṇadhvajaḥ || 2.160.10 || kāśyapeyo'mṛtāhartā nāgārirviṣṇuvāhanaḥ || aprameyo durādharṣo raṇe caivārisūdanaḥ || 11 || | garutmānmārutagatiḥ tvayi sannihitaḥ sthitaḥ || sāśvavarmāyudhānyodhānrakṣāsmākaṃ mahadripūn || 12|| iti dhvajamantraḥ || parāśara uvāca || kumudairāvaṇau padmaḥ puṣpadantotha vāmanaḥ || supratīkoñjano nīla eteṣṭau devayonayaḥ || 13 || teṣāṃ putrāśca pautrāśca dhanānyaṣṭau samāśritāḥ || bhadro mando mṛgaścaiva gajaḥ saṃkīrṇa eva ca || 14 || vanevane prasṛtāste smara yoniṃ mahāgaja || pāntu tvāṃ vasavo rudrā ādityāḥ samarudgaṇāḥ || 15 || bhartāraṃ rakṣa nāgendra samayaḥ pratipālyatām || avāpnuhi jayaṃ yuddhe gamane svasti no vraja || 16 || śrīste somādbalaṃ viṣṇostejaḥ sūryājjavo'nilāt || sthairyaṃ merorjayaṃ rudrādyaśo devātpurandarāt || 17 || yuddhe rakṣantu nāgāstvāṃ diśaśca saha daivataiḥ || aśvibhyāṃ saha gandharvā pāntu tvāṃ sarvataḥ sadā || 18 || iti hastimaṃtraḥ || parāśara uvāca || hutabhugvasavo rudrā vāyuḥ somo maharṣayaḥ || nāgakinnaragandharvayajñabhūtagaṇagrahāḥ || 19 || pramathāstu sahādityairbhūteśo mātṛbhiḥ sahaḥ || śakrasenāpatiḥ skando varuṇaścāśritastvayi || 2.160.20 || pradahantu ripūnsarvānrājā vijayamicchatu || yāni prayuktānyaribhirdūṣaṇāni samantataḥ || 21 || patantūpari śatrūṇāṃ hatāni tava tejasā || kālanemivadhe yadvadyaśca tripurapātane || 22 || hiraṇyakaśiporyadvadvadhe sarvāsureṣu ca || śobhitāsi tathaivādya śobhasva samayaṃ smara || 23 || nīlāñśvetānimāndṛṣṭvā naśyaṃtvāśu nṛpārayaḥ || vyādhibhirvividhairghoraiḥ śastraiśca yudhi nirjitāḥ || 24 || pūtanā revatī nāmnā kālarātrīti paṭhyate || dahatvāśu ripūnsarvānpatāke tvāmupāśritā || 25 || iti patākāmantraḥ || parāśara uvāca || asirviśasanaḥ khaḍgastīkṣṇadhāro durāsadaḥ || śrīgarbho vijayaścaiva dharmācārastathaiva ca || 26 || ityaṣṭau tava nāmāni svayamuktāni vedhasā || nakṣatraṃ kṛttikā tubhyaṃ gururdevo maheśvaraḥ || 27 || rohiṇyāśca śarīraṃ te daivataṃ tu janārdanaḥ || pitā pitāmaho devaḥ sa tvaṃ pālaya sarvadā || 28 || iti khaḍgamantraḥ || parāśara uvāca || varmapradastvaṃ samare dharmasainyāya mānada || rakṣa māṃ rakṣaṇīyo'haṃ tavānagha namostu te || 29 || iti varmamantraḥ || parāśara uvāca || dundubhe tvaṃ sapatnānāṃ ghoṣāddhṛdayakaṃpanaḥ || 2.160.30 || tava bhūmipasainyānāṃ tathā vijayavardhanaḥ || yathā jīmūtaghoṣeṇa hṛṣyanti śaravāraṇāḥ || tathā ca tava śabdena trasyantvasmaddviṣo raṇe || 31 || iti dundubhimaṃtraḥ || parāśara uvāca || sarvāyudhamahāmātra sarvadevārisūdana || cāpastvaṃ sarvadā rakṣa sākaṃ śaravaraiḥ sadā || 32 || iti cāpamantraḥ || puṣkara uvāca || maṃtrāstavaite'bhihitā nṛvīra sammaṃtraṇe vaijayikā yathāvat || etaistu maṃtrairabhimantritānāṃ calatyamoghaṃ balamapramṛṣyam || 33 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne mantrādhyāyavarṇano nāma ṣaṣṭyuttaraśatatamodhyāyaḥ || 160 || <2.161> paraśurāma uvāca || śāntimācakṣva māṃ deva ghṛtakambalasaṃjñitām || kāryā yā pārthivendrāṇāṃ vijayāya purodhasā || 1 || puṣkara uvāca || pūrvottare tu digbhāge nagarātsumanohare || prāgudakpravaṇe deśe śāntyāgāraṃ tu kārayet || 2 || taṃ tamatyantavistīrṇaṃ nānāvastravibhūṣitam || punarvasau gate candre tatra yāyānnarādhipaḥ || 3 || puraskṛtya mahābhāga sāṃvatsarapurohitau || abhiṣecanikā mantrā ye mayābhihitāḥ purā || 4 || devādayastu teṣāṃ vai sthānaṃ tatra prakalpayet || gandhamaṇḍalakairmukhyairyathāsthānaṃ purohitaḥ || 5 || āvāhanaṃ tataḥ kuryātsnātāstatra ca ye'pi te || devādīnāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ brāhmaṇaiḥ sahitā dvija ||6|| āvāhitānāṃ sarveṣāṃ gandhamālyānnasampadā || devavatpūjanaṃ kuryāttathā nṛpapurohitau || 7 || evaṃ saṃpūjanaṃ kṛtvā sopavāsāstu te trayaḥ || svapyuśca tāṃ niśāṃ tatra sarva eva samāhitāḥ || 8 || tato nairṛtakaṃ karma pradeśe tu purohitaḥ || kṛtvā tribhāgaśeṣāyāṃ rātrau kuryāttu śāntikam || 9 || śrutvā daśaguṇānatra snāpayettaṃ narādhipam || pūrvameva tathā snānaṃ siddhārthotsādhitaṃ tathā || 2.161.10 || pūrṇena ghṛtakumbhena mantreṇānena kālavit || ājyaṃ tejaḥ samuddiṣṭamājyaṃ tejoharaṃ param || 11 || ājyaṃ surāṇāmāhāramājye lokaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ || tenāntarikṣaṃ divyaṃ vā dhatte kalmaṣanāśanam || 12 || sarve tadājyasaṃsparśātpraṇāśamupagacchatu || tato virūkṣitaṃ snātaṃ snānavedyāṃ narādhipam || 13 || gacchettaṃ tu puraskṛtya sāṃvatsarapurohitau || snānavedī tu kartavyā lājākusumamaṇḍitā ||14 || caturbhiḥ pūrṇakumbhaistu vidikṣu hyupaśobhitā || catvāri tasyāścarmāṇi prāggrīvāṇi samāstaret || 15 || vṛṣasya dvīpinaścaiva siṃhaśārdūlayostathā || bhadrāsanaṃ nyasedrāma teṣāmupari carmaṇām || 16 || svāsīnaṃ nṛpatiṃ tatra vastrairācchādayennṛpaiḥ || kārpāsikaistataḥ paścādāvikaiḥ kṛmijaistataḥ || 17 || tatastu sarpiṣaḥ kumbhaiḥ pūrṇaistamabhiṣecayet || kumbhāṣṭakaṃ tu kartavyamaṣṭāviṃśatireva vā ||18 || athavāṣṭaśataṃ rāma vṛddhireṣā guṇottarā || tatopanīya vastrāṇi tasyāṃ vedyāṃ purohitaḥ || 19 || śūlena mṛnmayaṃ bhiṃdyācchatruṃ krodhasamanvitaḥ || rājñastu kalaśaṃ dattvā svayaṃ sāṃvatsarastataḥ || 2.161.20 || abhiṣecanamantreṇa svarcitaṃ kalpitaṃ dṛḍham ||| jyotiṣmatīṃ trāyamāṇāmabhayāmaparājitām ||21|| jīvāṃ viśveśvarīṃ pāṭhāṃ samaṃgāmabhayāṃ tathā || sahāṃ ca sahadevāṃ ca pūrṇakośāṃ śatāvarīm ||22|| ariṣṭikāṃ śivāṃ bhadrāṃ kalaśaṃ tatra vinyaset || brāhmī kṣemāmajāṃ caiva sarvabījāni kāñcanam || 23 || maṅgalyāśca yathālābhaṃ sarvauṣadhyo rasastathā || ratnāni sarvagandhāśca bilvaṃ ca savikaṅkatam || 24 || evaṃ snāto ghṛte dṛṣṭvā vadanaṃ tarpaṇaṃ tathā || maṅgalālabhanaṃ kṛtvā dhautavāsāḥ samāhitaḥ || 25 || abhyarcanaṃ tataḥ kuryāddevādīnāṃ pṛthakpṛthak || teṣāmeva tato vahnau caturthyantaistu nāmabhiḥ || 26 || oṅkārapūtaṃ juhuyād ghṛtaṃ bahu purohitaḥ || āyudhābhyarcanaṃ kāryaṃ vāhanābhyarcanaṃ tataḥ ||27 || rājacihnārcanaṃ kṛtvā hyalaṅkṛtya svakāṃ tanum || anulepanamādadyādgandhadvāreti mantrataḥ || 28 || śubhaṃ vasanamādadyācchrīsūktenābhimaṃtritam || śriyaṃ dhātarmayi dehi maṃtraḥ sumanasāṃ bhaveta || 29 || rāyaspoṣeti ca tathā mantrelaṅkaraṇe smṛtaḥ || tatonuliptaḥ surabhiḥ sragvī rucirabhūṣaṇaḥ || 2.161.30 || keśavābhyarcanaṃ kṛtvā vahnisthānaṃ tato vrajet || vahneruttaradigbhāge tataḥ prāguktakarmaṇām || 31 || siṃhāsanaṃ nyasetpṛṣṭhe bhavyāstaraṇasaṃyutam || tatastu rāma carmāṇi prāggrīvāṇi tu vinyaset || 32 || vṛṣasya vṛṣadaṃśasya kareśca pṛṣatasya ca || teṣāmupari siṃhasya vyāghrasya ca tataḥ param || 33 || dhruvā dyauriti mantreṇa nṛpaṃ tatropaveśayeta || darbhapāṇistato rājā tathaiva ca purohitaḥ || 34 || tayorhastagatāvagre darbhau saṃgrathayeddvijaḥ || tataḥ purodhā juhuyādbrāhmairmantrairghṛtaṃ śuciḥ || 38 || raudravaiṣṇava vāyavyaśākrasaumyaiḥ savāruṇaiḥ || bārhaspatyaistataḥ kuryāttaṃtramuttarasaṃjakam || 36 || daivajñaḥ prayataḥ kuryāddevatānāṃ visarjanam || yāntu devagaṇāḥ sarve sānugāḥ saparicchadāḥ || 37 || ādāya pārthivātpūjāṃ nagarāgamanāya ca || tatastu pūjayedrājā sāṃvatsarapurohitau || 38 || dhanena brāhmaṇānāṃ ca tato dadyācca dakṣiṇām || maṅgalālabhanaṃ kṛtvā khaḍgapāṇirgṛhādvrajet || śāntighoṣeṇa mahatā rājā kuñjaragastataḥ || 39 || śāṃtirmayā te'bhihitā nṛvīra dhanyā yaśasyā ripunāśanī ca || sukhāvahā rāṣṭravivṛddhikartrī kāryā nṛpairdharmavivṛddhidā ca || 2.161.40 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne ghṛtakambalaśāntikathano nāmaikaṣaṣṭyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 161 || <2.162> ||rāma uvāca || || saṃvatsarābhiṣekaṃ ca kathayasva mahībhṛtaḥ || tatra me saṃśayaṃ deva tvaṃ hi sarvaṃ vipaśyasi || 1 || puṣkara uvāca || rājābhiṣekanakṣatre pratisaṃvatsaraṃ dvijaḥ || pūrvābhiṣekavidhinā kartavyamabhiṣecanam || 2 || dhanyaṃ yaśasyaṃ ripunāśanaṃ ca saubhāgyadaṃ puṣṭivivardhanaṃ ca || varṣābhiṣekaṃ nṛpateḥ pradiṣṭaṃ saukhyāvahaṃ rājyavivṛddhidaṃ ca ||3|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0 saṃ0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne saṃvatsarābhiṣekādhyāyo nāma dviṣaṣṭyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 162|| <2.163> rāma uvāca || bhagavansarvadharmajña sarvaśāstravidāṃ vara || yātrākālavidhānaṃ me kathayasva mahīkṣitām || 1 || puṣkara uvāca || yadā manyeta nṛpatirākrandena balīyasā || pārṣṇigrāhebhibhūṇā taṃ tadā yātrāṃ prayojayeta|| ||2|| puṣṭā medya bhṛtā bhṛtyā prabhūtañca balaṃ mama || mūlarakṣāsamartho'smi tadā yātrāṃ prayojayet ||3|| pārṣṇigrāhādhikaṃ sainyaṃ mūle nikṣipya vā vrajet|| caitraṃ vā mārgaśīrṣaṃ vā yātrāṃ yāyānnarādhipaḥ || 4 || caitryāṃ sasyaṃ hi naṃdādyaṃ hanti puṣṭiṃ ca śāradam || etadeva viparyastaṃ mārgaśīrṣyāṃ narādhipaḥ || || 5 || śatrorvā vyasane yāyātkāla eva sudurlabhaḥ || divyāntarikṣakṣitijairutpātaiḥ pīḍitaṃ bhṛśam || 6 || ṣaḍṛkṣapīḍanāttṛptaṃ pīḍitaṃ ca tathā grahaiḥ || prajvalanti tathaivolkā diśaṃ yasya prapadyate || 7 || bhūkampo yāṃ diśaṃ yāti yāṃ ca ketuḥ pradhūmayet || nirghātaḥ śrūyate yatra tāṃ yāyādvasudhādhipaḥ || 8 || svabalavyasanopetaṃ tathā durbhikṣapīḍitam || sambhūtāntarakopaṃ ca kṣipraṃ yāyādariṃ nṛpaḥ || 9 || yūkāmakṣikabahulaṃ bahuvighnaṃ tathā bilam || nāstikaṃ bhinnamaryādaṃ tathā maṅgalavādi ca || 2.163.10 || apetaprakṛtiṃ caiva nirāśaṃ ca tathā jayet || viṣṭināyakakaṃ sainyaṃ tathā bhinnaparasparam || 11 || vyasanāsaktanṛpatiṃ balaṃ rājā niyojayet || gacchettu paścāddharmajña purastāttu vigarhitaiḥ || 12 || kva yāsi tiṣṭha māgaccha kiṃ tatra gamanasya ca || anye śabdāśca ye dṛṣṭāste vipattikarā api || 13 || dhvājādiṣu tathā snānaṃ kravyādānāṃ vigarhitam || skhalanaṃ vāhanānāṃ ca vastrasaṅgastathaiva ca || 14 || vinirgataśca dvārādyaiḥ śirasaścābhighātanam || chatradhvajādivastrāṇāṃ patanaṃ ca tathāśubham || 15 || dṛṣṭvā nimittaṃ prathamamamaṅgalyaṃ vināśanam || keśavaṃ pūjayedvidvāṃstathaiva madhusūdanam || 26 || dvitīye tu tato dṛṣṭe pratīpe praviśedgṛham || atheṣṭāni pravakṣyāmi maṅgalyāni tathānagha || 17 || śvetāḥ sumanasaḥ śreṣṭhāḥ pūrṇakumbhaṃ tathaiva ca || jalajāni ca matsyāni māṃsaṃ matsyāśca bhārgava || 18 || gāvasturaṅgamā nāgā baddha ekaḥ paśustataḥ || tridaśāḥ suhṛdo viprā jvalitaśca hutāśanaḥ || 19 || gaṇikāśca mahābhāgāḥ pūrvācāryādigomayam || rukmaṃ raupyaṃ tathā tāmraṃ sarvaratnāni cāpyatha || 2.163.20 || auṣadhāni ca sarvajña vacāsiddhārthake tathā || nṛvardhamānaṃ yānaṃ ca bhadrapīṭhaṃ tathaiva ca || 21 || khaḍgaṃ chatraṃ patākāṃ ca mṛdamāyudhameva ca || rājaliṅgāni sarvāṇi śavaṃ ruditavarjitam || 22 || ghṛtaṃ dadhi payaścaiva phalāni vividhāni ca || svastikaṃ vardhamānaṃ ca nandyāvartaṃ sakaustubham||23|| nadyaśca citravinyastā maṅgalyānyaparāṇi ca|| akṣatāśca tathā mukhyāstathā darpaṇameva ca ||24|| añjanaṃ rocanaṃ caiva śṛṅgāro mākṣikaṃ tathā || śaṅkha ikṣustathā bhakṣyā vācaścaiva tathā śubhāḥ || 25 || vāditrāṇāṃ mukhaḥ śabdo gambhīraśca manoharaḥ || gāndhāraṣaḍjaṛṣabhā yāne śastāstathā svarāḥ || 26|| vāyuḥ saśarkaro rūkṣaḥ sa ca digbhyaḥ samarthitaḥ|| pratilomastathā nīco vijñeyo bhayakṛddvija || 27 || anukūlo mṛdusnigdhaḥ sukhasparśaḥ sukhāvahaḥ || ṛkṣā ṛkṣasvarāḥ khaṅgāḥ kravyādāśca vigarhitāḥ || 28 || meghāḥ śastā ghanāḥ snigdhā gajabṛṃhitasannibhāḥ || anulomā taḍicchastā śakraścāpaṃ tathaiva ca || 29 || apraśaste tathājñeye pīraveśapravarṣaṇe || anulomā grahaḥ śastā dikpatistu viśeṣataḥ || 2.163.30 || āstikyaṃ śraddadhānatvaṃ tathā pūjyābhipūjanam || śastānyetāni dharmajña yacca syānmanasaḥ priyam || 31 || manasastuṣṭirevātra paramaṃ jayalakṣaṇam || ekataḥ sarvaliṅgāni manastuṣṭirathaikataḥ || 32 || yānotsukatvaṃ manasaḥ praharṣaḥ susvapnalābho manasaḥ prasādaḥ || māṅgalyalabdhiśravaṇaṃ ca rāma jñeyāni nityaṃ vijayāvahāni || 33|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0 saṃ0 yātrāśakunavarṇanaṃ nāma triṣaṣṭyuttaraśatatamodhyāyaḥ || 163 || <2.164> puṣkara uvāca || tiṣṭhato gamane praśne puruṣasya śubhāśubham || nivedayanti śakunā deśasya nagarasya ca ||1|| pathi pāntho nṛpaḥ sainye marīcoddiśya devatām || sārthe pradhānaḥ sāmye ca jñātividyāvayodhikaḥ || 2 || sarvapāpaphalo dīptaḥ śāntaḥ śubhaphalo mataḥ || ṣaṭprakārā vinirdiṣṭāḥ śakunānāṃ ca dīptatā || 3 || velā digdeśakaraṇaṃ sa tu jātivibhedakaḥ || pūrvāpūrvā ca vijñeyā sā teṣāṃ balavattarā || 4 || divācaro rātricarastathā rātrau divācaraḥ || krūrasya velādīptasya khalarkṣanigrahādiṣu || 5 || dhūmitāsā tu vijñeyā yāṃ gamiṣyati bhāskaraḥ || yasyāṃ sthitaḥ sā jvalitā muktā cāṅgāriṇī matā || 6 || etāstisraḥ smṛtā dīptāḥ pañca śantāstathā parāḥ || dīptāyāṃ diśi digdīptaḥ śakunaḥ parikīrtitaḥ || 7 || grāmye vanyo vane grāmyastathā ninditapādape || deśe caivāśubhe jñeyo deśadīpto dvijottama || 8 || kriyādīpto vinirdiṣṭaḥ svajātyanucitakriyaḥ|| tato dīptaśca kathito bhinnabhairavaniḥsvanaḥ||9|| pratidīptastathā jñeyaḥ kevalaṃ māṃsabhojanaḥ || dīptaśānto vinirdiṣṭaḥ sarvaibhedaiḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 2.164.10 || miśrāṃmiśro vinirdiṣṭastato vācyaṃ balātphalam || gośvoṣṭragardabhaśvānaḥ śārikāgṛhagodhike || naṭikeṣāṃ sacarmādye kathitā grāmavāsinaḥ || 11 || ajāviśukranāgendrakharā mahiṣavāyasau || grāmyāraṇyā vinirdiṣṭāḥ sarve'nye vanagocarāḥ || 12 || mārjaraktakṛṣo grāmyastathānyo vanagocare || sarve'pyeveti vijñeyā nityaṃ rūpavibhedataḥ || 13 || śrīkaṇṭhaśikhicakrāhvā ye ca hārītavāyasāḥ || kulālakukkuṭaśyenaphāṃṭavaṃ jalavānarāḥ || 14 || śaśaghnacaṭakaśyāmāścāṣabhāsa kapiñjalāḥ || tittiriḥ śatapatraśca kapotāśca tathā trayaḥ || 15 || khañjarīṭakadātyūha śukāṇḍīvahatiktakāḥ || bhāradvājaśca sāraṅgaḥ iti jñeyā divācarāḥ || 16 || valgulyulūkaḥ śaśakā śarabhotkrośapicchalau || māṣikā piṅgalī kākaḥ kathitā rātricāriṇaḥ || 17 || haṃsājamṛgamārjāranakularkṣa bhujaṅgamāḥ || vṛkaśca siṃhavyāghroṣṭraśvasūkaraturaṅgamāḥ || 18 || śvāvitpṛthutagomāyughṛtakokilasārasāḥ || turaṅgamo dvīpinarāścorā ubhayacāriṇaḥ ||19|| raṇaprasthānayoḥ sarve purastātsaṅgacāriṇaḥ || jayāvahā vinirdiṣṭāḥ paścādvijayakāriṇaḥ ||2.164.20|| gṛhe gamyo yadā cāyaṃ vyāharetpurataḥ sthitaḥ || nṛpāvamānaṃ vadati vāmaḥ kalahabhojane ||21|| yāne taddarśanaṃ dhanyaṃ sapataṅgasya cāpyatha || caurairdoṣamathākhyāti mayūro bhinnaniḥsvanaḥ || ||22|| vamate kapilaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ tathā dakṣiṇasaṃsthitaḥ || pṛṣṭhato ninditaphalaḥ tittiristatra śasyate || 23 || eṇā varāhāḥ pṛṣato vāmā bhūtvā tu dakṣiṇāḥ|| bhavantyarthakarā nityaṃ viparītā vigarhitāḥ ||24|| vṛkāśca jambukavyāghra siṃhamārjāragardabhāḥ || vācchitārthakarā jñeyā dakṣiṇādvāmabhāgagāḥ ||25|| śivā śyāmā ralā cchucchaḥ piṅgalā gṛhagodhikāḥ || sūkarī parapuṣṭā ca puṃnāmānaśca vāmataḥ || 26 || śrīsaṃjñā cāṣabhaṣakakapiśrīkarṇachikkarāḥ || kapiśrīkarṇapippīkā ruruśyenāśca dakṣiṇāḥ ||27|| jāhakāhiśaśakroḍagodhānāṃ kīrtanaṃ śubham || tataḥ sandarśanaṃ neṣṭaṃ pratīpaṃ vānararkṣayoḥ || 28 || phalakṛtpūrvaśakunaḥ prasthitasya ca yonvaham || bhavettasya phalaṃ vānyattadeva divasaṃ budhaiḥ || 29 || mattā bhikṣārthino bālā viraktābhāstathaiva ca || sīmāntanadyantaritā vijñeyā niṣphalā dvija || 2.164.30 || ekadvitricaturbhistu śivā dhanyā tato bhavet || pañcabhiśca tathā ṣaḍbhiradhanyāḥ parikīrtitāḥ || 31 || saptabhiśca tathā dhanyā niṣphalā parato bhavet || nṛṇāṃ romāñcajananī vāhanānāṃ bhayapradā|| 32 || jvālānanā sūryamukhī vijñeyā bhayavardhinī || prathamaṃ śārṅgake dṛṣṭe śubhe deśe śubhaṃ vadet || 33 || saṃvatsaraṃ manuṣyasya hyaśubhe cāśubhaṃ tathā || yathāvidhi naraḥ paśyañchakunaṃ prathamehani || 34 || ātmanaśca tathā tena jñātavyaṃ vatsaraṃ phalam || śārṅgaka ca naro dṛṣṭvā bhujaṅgamaśirogataḥ || 35 || avaśyaṃ tadavāpnoti yatkiñcinmanasecchati || viśanti yena mārgeṇa vāyasā bahavaḥ param || 36 || tena mārgeṇa vai tasya purasya grahaṇaṃ bhavet || senāyāṃ yadi vāsārthe viniṣṭo vāyaso bhavet || 37 || vāso bhayāya rātrastho bhayaṃ vadati dustaram || chāyāṅgavāhanopānacchatravastrādikuṇṭhanaiḥ || 38 || mṛtyustatpūjane pūjā tadviṣṭhākaraṇe śubham || proṣitāgamakṛtkākaḥ kurvandvāri gatāgatam || 39 || raktaṃ dagdhaṃ gṛhe dravyaṃ vikṣapanvahnivedakaḥ || nyasedrajaṃ purastāccennivedayati bandhanam || 2.164.40 || pītadravyaṃ tathā rukmaṃ rūpyaṃ śvetaṃ tu bhārgava || yaścaivopalabheddravyaṃ tasya labdhiṃ vinirdiśet || 41 || dravyaṃ copanayedyattu tasya hāniṃ dvijottama || parato dhanalabdhiḥ syādrāma māṃsasya bhakṣaṇe || 42 || śrīlabdhiḥ syānmṛgakṣepe rājyaṃ ratnārpaṇe mahat || yātuḥ kākonukūlasthaḥ kṣepyaḥ karṇasamo bhavet || 43 || nanvarthasādhako jñeyaḥ pratikūlo bhayāvahaḥ || 44 || samukho'bhyeti vitataḥ yātrāghātakaro bhavet || vāmaḥ kākaḥ smṛto dhanyo dakṣiṇastu vināśakṛt || 45 || vāmo'nulomagaḥ preṣṭho madhyamo dakṣiṇaḥ smṛtaḥ || pratilomakṛtirvāmo gamanapratiṣedhakṛt || || 46 || nivedayati yātrārthamabhipretaṃ gṛhe rataḥ || ekākṣicaraṇastvarka vakṣyamāṇo bhayāvahaḥ || 47 || koṭare vāsamānastu mahānarthakaro bhavet || na śubhaḥ sūkare kākaḥ paṅkāntaḥ sa tu dṛśyate || 48 || amedhyapūrṇavadanaḥ kākaḥ sarvārthasādhakaḥ || jñeyāḥ patatriṇo'nyemī kākavadbhṛgunandana || || 49|| skandādau rāma savyasthāḥ śvāno ripuvināśakāḥ || indrasthāne narendrasya pureśasya tu gopure || 2.164.50 || antargṛhe gṛheśasya maraṇāya bhavedbhṛśam || yasya vrajati vāmāṅgaṃ tasya syāddīrghasiddhaye || 51 || bhayāya dakṣiṇaṃ cāṃgaṃ tathā bhujamadakṣiṇam || yātrāghātakaro yastu harṣaṃ prati mukhāgataḥ || 52 || mārgāvarodhako mārge caurastudati bhārgava || alātāsthimukhaḥ pāpo rajjumīramukhastathā || 53 || sopānatkamukho dhanyo māṃsapūrṇamukho'pi ca || amaṅgalyamatha dravyaṃ deśaṃ caivāśubhaṃ tathā || 54 || avamūlyāgrato yāti yātasya na bhayaṃ bhavet || tathāvamūttyāṃ vrajati śubhaṃ deśaṃ tathā kramam || 55 || maṅgalyaṃ ca tathā dravyaṃ tasya syādarthasiddhaye || evañca rāma vijñeyāstathā vai jambukādayaḥ || 56 || bhayāya svāmino jñeyā animittabhayaṃ gavām || niśi caurabhayāya syādvikṛtaṃ mṛtyave tathā || 97 || śivāya svāmino rātrau balīvardo nadanbhavet || utsṛṣṭavṛṣabho rājño vijayaṃ saṃprayacchati ||58|| abhakṣyaṃ bhakṣyayantaśca gāvo nyāsastathāmbakān || tyaktasnehāśca vatseṣu gavāṃ kṣayakaro mataḥ || 59 || bhūmiṃ pādairvinirhatya dīnā bhūtā vikāraṇāt || anyonyalagnapucchāśca gāvo bhayakarā matāḥ||2.164.60|| ārdrāṅgā hṛṣṭaromāśca praviśantyastathā gṛham || śṛṅgalagnamṛdo vāpi vijñeyāḥ svāmivṛddhaye || 61 || mahiṣyādiṣu cāpyetatsarvaṃ vācyaṃ vijānatā || netranāsāpuṭaprothaskaṃdhasyāsanamūrdhasu || 62 || hayānāṃ jvalanaṃ śastamatonyatra praśasyate || sarvāṅgajvalanaṃ neṣṭaṃ tathā dhūmasamuddhavaḥ || 63 || visphuliṅgodbhavaścaiva śakṛtyāṃ svaśanaṃ tathā || ārohaṇaṃ tathānyena saparyāṇasya vājinaḥ || 64 || jalopaveśanaṃ neṣṭaṃ bhūmau ca parivartanam || vipatkalpataraṅgasya svato vāpyanimittataḥ || 65 || yavasodakayordveṣastvakasmāccaiva śasyate || krītaḥ kākaiḥ kapotairvā śārikābhisturaṅgamaḥ || 66 || ātmanaḥ svāmino vāpi tadā maraṇavedakaḥ || duḥkhārtadhyānaśīlaśca sāśrunetro bhayāvahaḥ || 67 || jihvayā leḍhi caraṇamasāvapi bhayaṅkaraḥ || nirnimittaṃ patati vā tadā syānnṛṣu vṛddhaye || 68 || vāmapādena ca tathā vilikhaṃśca vasundharām || svenaiva vāmapārśvena divā vā na śubhapradaḥ || 69 || pravepamānā hreṣante rodante ca muhurmuhuḥ || śakṛnmūtre vimuñcanto vedayanti mahadbhayam || 2.164.70 || uttiṣṭhanto niṣīdantaḥ sandhyāyāṃ dīnamānasāḥ || srastāḥ sāsrāśca dīnāśca hreṣamāṇā bhayāvahāḥ || 71 || hreṣatastu yadā jvālā jyotsnā vā mukhato bhavet || tadā vijayamākhyāti svāmino dhruvameva hi || 72 || dakṣiṇena padā bhūmiṃ vikirañjayavardhanaḥ || rātrau dakṣiṇapārśvena prasvapaṃśca narottama || 73 || ārohaṇaṃ nave dadyātpratīpaṃ vā gṛhaṃ vrajet || yātrāvighātamācaṣṭe vāmaṃ pādaṃ tathā spṛśan || 74 || anulomaṃ yadā yāti purastātpratihreṣite || dakṣiṇaṃ vā tathā pārśvaṃ mukhenopari mārjati ||75|| ,preritastvanukūlena pavanena raṇe hayaḥ || hreṣamāṇaḥ parānyāti tadā syādvijayāvahaḥ || 76 || grāme vrajati nāgaścenmaithunaṃ deśahā bhavet || prasūtā nāgavanitā mattā cāntāya bhūpateḥ || 77 || dantabhaṅge śubhe deśe drume vā bhayavardhanaḥ || krūreṣu velālagneṣu tathā rāma viśeṣataḥ || 78 || | gaṇḍūṣadhāraṇaṃ kṛtvā vaktrabhāge tu dakṣiṇe || hastaṃ gṛhītvā hastena nāgasyānyasya vā punaḥ || 79 || uccairvā karamunnamya viṣāṇe vātha dakṣiṇe || gambhīraṃ śrotramadhuraṃ rājñastadvijayāvaham || 2.164.80 || atonyathā viparyastaṃ tvaśubhaṃ parikīrtitam || arohaṇaṃ na ceddadyātpratīpaṃ vā gṛhaṃ vrajet ||81|| madaṃ vā vāraṇo jahyādyātrāghātakaro bhavet || grāhagṛhīto dviradaḥ sagrāhaḥ salilāśayāt || 82 || uttaranvijayāya syātsagrāho bhayavardhanaḥ || śastrāṅkuśapatākānāṃ bhūmau nipatanaṃ gajāt || 83|| loṣṭakāṣṭhakarīṣāṇāṃ kṣepaṇe cāpi yadbhavet || anuyātraṃ jayāyaitatpratiyātraṃ na śasyate || || 84 || vāryamāṇo yadā nāgaḥ śatruṇābhimukho vrajet || tanprasuptatāraṃ ca tadā tejaḥ praśaṅkitaḥ || 85 || iṣṭāṃstu yastu bhakṣyāṃśca tathā spṛśati hastinīm || rāma bṛṃhitaghaṇṭānāṃ pratiśabdena kupyate || 86 || kakṣāyāṃ baddhyamānāyāṃ yadā voccairnadatyapi || yātrānugaśca bhavati prahṛṣṭaścaiva vāraṇaḥ || 87 || vāmaṃ dakṣiṇapādena pādamākramate tathā || dakṣiṇaṃ ca tathā dante parimārṣṭi kareṇa cet || 88 || veṣṭayatyatha vā karṇau tathā stabdhau karoti ca || jayāya rājño bhavati janayannapi śīkaram || 89 || vāmaṃ tu veṣṭayeddanta pādaṃ vāmena dakṣiṇam || pādamākramamāṇaśca praskhalannipatannapi || 2.164.90 || agrahastaṃ noddharati yadā ca vasudhātalāt || sāsuśca kavaladveṣī dīno bhayavivardhanaḥ || 91 || niḥśvāsaṃ paramaṃ kurvañchāntaṃ vikṛtameva ca || bhayāvaho vinirdiṣṭaḥ pratilomagatistathā || 92 || kṣīrapādapagulmānāṃ nihantā vijayāvahaḥ || tathā vikāsitākṣaśca rāma labdhapado'pi ca ||93|| vṛṣośvaḥ kuñjaro vāpi ripusainyaṃ yadā vrajet || parājayastato jñeyaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ bhṛgunandana || 94 || khaṇḍameghābhidṛṣṭyā ca senānāśamavāpnuvān || pratikūlagraharkṣā ca tathā saṃmukhamāsatā || 95 || yātrākāle raṇe vāpi cchatrādipatanādbhayam || vijñeyaṃ bhūmipālasya ghorāṇāṃ dīnatā tathā||96|| narāśvanāgā hṛṣṭāśca vidhūmognistathā jvalan || anulomā grahāścaiva vijñeyañjayalakṣaṇam 97 || āyudhānāṃ prajvalanaṃ kośādapi vinirgamaḥ || saṃgrāmakāle vijñeyaṃ vijayasya tu lakṣaṇam ||98|| kākairyodhābhibhavanaṃ kravyādairmaṇḍalakriyā || sainyoparyupasainyena vijñeyaṃ bhayalakṣaṇam || 99 || kaṇḍūtirdakṣiṇe haste chāyā ca śubhalakṣaṇā || śobhā manujaśārdūla tatkālaṃ vijayāvahā || 2.164.100 || senāṅgasaṃstho bhayakṛddvijendra kravyādbhavedvāpyatha makṣikā ca || śubhāvahāḥ syuḥ śatapatracāṣamayūrahaṃsāśca sajīvajīvāḥ || 101 || || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne śakunavarṇano nāma catuḥṣaṣṭyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 164 || <2.165> || puṣkara uvāca || praṣṭurdeśe śubhe vedyaṃ śubhaṃ bhavati bhārgava || aśubhe vāśubhaṃ rāma tanme nigadataḥ śṛṇu || 1 || śmaśānasūnābhavanabandhanāgāraveśmasu || rathyākardamadurgeṣu śūnyeṣu bhavaneṣu ca || 2 || kaṇṭakidrumayukteṣu śīrṇaprākāraveśmasu || valmīkamūṣikāsarpasakīṭeṣvaśubhaṃ vadet || 3 || māṃsaspṛṣṭopalipteṣu supuṣpeṣu viśeṣataḥ || praśastadrumayukteṣu vidyādvijayalakṣaṇam || 4 || saśādvaleṣu tīreṣu saritāṃ sarasāmapi || bhavaneṣu vicitreṣu śubhaṃ vācyaṃ vijānatā || 5 || abhyaktaṃ śocyamānaṃ ca muktakeśaṃ tathaiva ca || bhūmiṣṭhamupasarpanti teṣāṃ vidyādaśobhanam || 6 || hṛṣṭaśuklāmbaropetā sumanaskāstathaiva ca || daivajñamupasarpanti teṣāṃ vidyācchubhaṃ dvijāḥ ||7|| bahavo daṇḍahastāśca kāṣāyavasanāstathā || abhyaktamuṇḍapatitāstathā klībāśca yoṣitaḥ ||8|| śṛṅkhalārajjuhastāśca saṃklinnaphalapāṇayaḥ || pṛcchantaste tu vijñeyā nṛṣvaśeṣabhayāvahāḥ ||9|| śuklāmbarā sapuṣpāśca tathaiva phalapāṇayaḥ|| ratnahastāḥ śubhā jñeyāstathā maṅgalavādinaḥ ||2.165.10|| velāḥ sarvāḥ prapaśyeta pūrvāhṇe paripṛcchataḥ || sandhyayoraparāhṇe ca niśāyāṃ ca vigarhitāḥ||11|| śāntāṃ diśamathāsthāya pṛcchataḥ siddhimādiśeta || udīcīṃ prāgudīcīṃ ca pūrvāṃ caiva viśeṣataḥ || 12 || aṅguṣṭhanakhapādorugulphamuṣkamurastanāḥ || gaṇḍaśṛṅgākṣikau karṇau dantoṣṭhabhujamastakam || 13 || gurulurguruvastiśca vakṣaḥ kakṣorusandhayaḥ || punnāmānyevamādīni spṛśataḥ pṛcchataḥ śubham || 14 || karṇapālirbhruvau nāsājihvāgrīvākṛkāṭikāḥ || nābhiśroṇī sphice jaṃghe piṇḍikāṅgulayo'pi ca || 15 || pāṇipādāśrayā rekhā valayaḥ sarvasandhiṣu || pārṣṇirityevamādīni strīnāmānyabhinirdiśet || 16 || śiro lalāṭaṃ cibukaṃ mukhaṃ pṛṣṭhodaraṃ trikam || jaṭharaṃ vastiśīrṣaṃ ca mehanaṃ jānunī tathā || 17 || karṇapīṭhe'kṣikūṭe ca pārśve ca hṛdayaṃ tathā || napuṃsakāni jānīyuraṃgavidyāviśāradāḥ || 18 || puṃnāmānaṃ dṛḍhaṃ snigdhamavibhagnamapīḍitam || samaṃ samāhitaṃ cāṃgaṃ vīrujaṃ ca yadā spṛśet || 19 || yamarthamabhipṛccheta tasya siddhiṃ vinirdiśet || śatruṇāpyudaye praṣṭustallagnasya tathodaye ||2.165.20|| śatrurāśyudaye praṣṭusteṣāṃ vāpyadhipodaye || parājayaṃ tu vaktavyaṃ svalagnasyāṣṭamodaye || 21 || svarāśeśca mahābhāga tathā vidyādaśobhanam || svalagnasyodaye rāma śatrurāśyudaye tathā || 22 || lagnādvā rāśito vāpi triṣaṣṭadaśamodaye || ekādaśodaye vāpi teṣāṃ vāpyadhipodaye || 23 || praṣṭuḥ sarvārthasaṃpattirvijñeyā bhṛgunandana || lagne vā taccaturthe vā saptame daśame'pi vā || 24 || pañcame navame vāpi śastāḥ saumyagrahāḥ smṛtāḥ || triṣaḍdaśasamaṃ sthāne pāpāścaikādaśe śubhāḥ||25|| sarvārthasādhakā jñeyāḥ praṣṭurbhṛgukulodvaha || saumyā balādhikā jñeyāḥ pāpā hīnabalāstathā || 26 || balavacca tathā lagnaṃ praśnakāle śubhapradam || evaṃ tu praśrakālena śubhaṃ vijñāya bhūpatiḥ||27|| yātrā rāma śubhā jñeyā nānyathā tu kadācana || jātakaṃ cātha vijñāya daśākāle suśobhane || aṣṭavargabale śuddhe yātrākālaḥ praśasyate || 28 || parasya deve tvaśubhe dvijendra yātrā ca deyā svaśubhāya nityam || grahādipākeṣu śubheṣu caiva dattā bhavetkāryakarī yathāvat || 29 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0 vajrasaṃvāde śrīparaśurāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne aṃgavidyāyogo nāma pañcaṣaṣṭyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 165 || <2.166> śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca || atha bhārgavo rāmo varuṇanandanaṃ puṣkaraṃ nāma papraccha || bhagavañjyotiśśāstraṃ śrotumicchāmi || tamuvāca vāruṇiḥ || purā surarṣigaṇamadhyagataṃ bhagavantamatiśayaṃ sarvajagatpālanasaṃhārakaraṃ śrībrahmāṇaṃ bhṛgurvijñāpayāmāsa || bhagavañ jyotiṣāmayanaṃ śrotumicchāmi|| tamuvāca bhagavānpitāmahaḥ || yadā me tvaṃ kalpādau hṛdayājjātastadā mayā te ślokānāṃ caturviṃśatilakṣaṃ jyotirayanamuktaṃ tadevāsminvāruṇe yajñe mahādeva śāpena jvālāṃ bhittvā vinirgatasya janmāntarotpannasyātisaṃkṣiptaṃ vakṣyāmi || tacchrutvā sarvameva te pūrvajanmābhihitaṃ jyotirjñānamāvirbhaviṣyati || atha bhagavānsahasraraśmirvimalo vimalamayūkhaḥ kṣemāya śikhipatrākāraḥ stavagrahāya candra iva dṛṣṭigamyo rājyasyāptaye candramāḥ samāgame grahāṇāmudaṅmadhyagataśca dṛśyate | yathāsaṃbhavaṃ ca nakṣatrāṇāṃ samāgame nakṣatrādīnyapi śasyante || atha yasminnakṣatre bhauma udayaṃ pratipadyate tasmātsaptāṣṭanavamarkṣe pūṣṇomukhaṃ nāma vaktraṃ karoti yenāgnimanto brāhmaṇā agnijīvinaśca pīḍyante | daśamaikādaśadvādaśe'śvamukhaṃ nāma marakakārakaṃ karoti | trayodaśacaturdaśayorvyālākhyaṃ vyālavṛddhikaram | pañcadaśaṣoḍaśayo rudhiramukhaṃ saṃgrāmasūcakam | saptadaśāṣṭādaśayorasimukhaṃ cauraprābalyakaram || atha budho bharaṇīkṛttikārohiṇīṣu vicaranprākṛtāṃ gatiṃ subhikṣajananīṃ vicarati | āśleṣāraudrapitryaṣu miśrāṃ miśraphaladāṃ punarvasupuṣyabhāgyāryamṇeṣu saṃkṣiptaṃ miśraphaladāmeva || ahirbudhnyājapauṣṇaśakrāgnināmni tīkṣṇāṃ nāma vigrahakāriṇīṃ mūlāditritayasaṃyogātkāntikīrtyādipradāma | śravaṇadhaniṣṭhāvāruṇītvāṣṭrāṇi, ghorāṃ ghoraphalām|| jīvastrayodaśabhirmāsairāśiṃ vicarañśubho bhavati, anyathā kaṣṭaphalaḥ | athodayāstamayacāraiḥ śukrasya yamādyaṃ nakṣatracatuṣṭayamādyaṃ maṇḍalaṃ subhikṣajananaṃ, raudrādyamapi catuṣṭaya dvijabhayapradaṃ, śakrādyaṃ pañcarkṣaṃ rogajananaṃ, dhaniṣṭhādyaṃ ṣaṇṇakṣatramativṛṣṭikaramiti|| yaddeśadravyapuruṣanakṣatreṣu sauro vicarati, tatpīḍā bahvyo bhavanti || yasyāṃ diśi ketoḥ śikhā dīptā bhavati taṃ deśaṃ nṛpatirabhiyuñjyāt | uparāgaḥ śvetaraktapītakṛṣṇo rāhorbrāhmaṇakṣattriyaviṭśūdrapīḍāṃ karoti | agastyaḥ sphuruṇo rūkṣatayopahūtaḥ śikhiśikhāstobhayāya | evaṃvidhā saptarṣayaśca evaṃvidhe trailokyamapi pīḍyate aiśānyāṃ diśi kṛttikābhiḥ sahodeti kumārastasminnevaṃvidhe bālapīḍā || jīvajñasaurāḥ paurāḥ | kujaśukrau yāyigrahau | candrārkau madhyamau | tatrārkeṇa saha grahāṇāmastamayo bhavati | candreṇa saha samāgamaḥ parasparaṃ yuddham | udaṅmārgagataḥ suprabho vijayī bhavati | yāyigrahe vijayini sarale ca rājā parānabhiyuñjīta, anyathā paureṣu balavat, yāyināṃ nāśaḥ syāt | agastyavadupahate nakṣatre taddeśadravyatajjātapuruṣapīḍā | vā yasyāṃ diśi bhūcalo yāti tāṃ diśaṃ rājā yāyāt | sanirghāte dīrghe rājamaraṇaṃ syāt | yāṃ diśamulkā yāti tāṃ diśaṃ nṛpo yāyāt | divolkā candrārkavinirgatā uddhātinyatisthūlā sasphuliṅgā tatordhvagā rājamṛtyave syāt | bahuvarṇe pariveṣe prajāpīḍā syāt, yataḥ khaṇḍaḥ pariveṣaḥ syāt, tāṃ diśaṃ nṛpatiryāyāt | atibhīmanirghāto rājamṛtyave | yāṃ ca diśaṃ yāti tāṃ diśaṃ rājā yāyāt | gandharvanagaraṃ śakyodbhūtaṃ mahābhayāya | rātrāvindradhanuḥ śvetaṃ vyabhre ca mahābhayāya | pratisūryaṃ udagdakṣiṇenārkādvātakṛt | ubhayasthito mahāvarṣāya upari rājamṛtyave || tathādhastājjanavināśāya | ubhayathā mahābhayāya sarvataḥ tribhuvanapīḍāvaho bhavati | yā digdāhena dīptā syāttāṃ diśaṃ rājā yāyāt | atidīpte chāyāvyañjake rājamaraṇaṃ vindyāt || atha vā dhruvadāruṇograkṣipracarasādhāraṇeṣu yathā svakarma dhruvādikarma kriyamāṇaṃ siddhimupaiti || vyatīpātaviṣṭivaidhṛtāstamitanakṣatreṣu na kiñcidapi | tathā cārkānalarāhudhūmitajvalitadagdhaviddheṣu nakṣatreṣu tathā ca vividhotpātābhihateṣu yatra yasminnakṣatre puruṣasya janma tannakṣatraṃ tasmānnakṣatrācca daśamaṃ tata ekonaviṃśajjanmanakṣatramiti vindyāt | sarvasmājjanmanakṣatrāddvitīyaṃ saṃpatkaram | tṛtīyaṃ vipatkaraṃ | caturtha kṣemyam | pañcamaṃ pratyari | ṣaṣṭhaṃ sādhakam | saptamaṃ naidhanam | aṣṭamaṃ maitram | navamaṃ paramaṃ maitraṃ ceti || tatra sampatkarakṣemasādhaka maitrātimaitreṣu sarvāṇi karmāṇi kuryāt | daśamarkṣe ca || yathā karmasu nakṣatre tithiṃ riktāṃ vinā kṛtam|| saumye dinakṛte vatsa siddhimāyātyasaṃśayam|| iti bhacakraṃ nāḍikāṣaṣṭyeti tatrādāveva rāśirajo raktavarṇaḥ kālasyamūrdhā pūrvāvanyo divārātrau grāmyaḥ prāgdvāraḥ catuṣpāt rātrau dakṣiṇasyāṃ diśi balī caraḥ pṛṣṭhodayaḥ krūro viṣamaḥ pumāñ śanaiścarasya nīcaḥ | viṃśatistathāgatasyaivātinīcaḥ | ādityasyoccaḥ, tasyaiva daśame bhāge'tyuccaḥ aṅgārakṣetram | tasyaiva trikoṇamiti || vṛṣaḥ śvetavarṇo mukhaṃ kālasyāraṇyo divārātrau grāmyo vīṇākarā nārī ca haritavarṇaḥ kālasya bāhū grāmyaḥ paścimadvāro dvipāt pūrvasyāṃ diśi divā balī dvisvabhāvaḥ śīrṣodayaḥ krūro viṣamaḥ puruṣarāśiḥ budhakṣetramiti || balī caraḥ pṛṣṭhodayaḥ kīṭaḥ tulādharāpaṇavīthīgataḥ kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ kālasya vastisthito grāmyaḥ paścimadvāro dvidhā pūrvasyāṃ diśi balī caraḥ śīrṣodayaḥ krūro viṣamaḥ puruṣarāśiḥ śukrakṣetram ādityanīcastasyaiva daśame bhāge'tinīcaḥ || makaro nāma mṛgaḥ pūvārdho makaraḥ, paścārdho mṛgaḥ, prāgardhenāraṇyo dvitīyārdhenāmbucaraḥ kaberaiḥ kālasya jānunī pūrvārdhordhacatuṣpāt, paścārdhena kīṭo, dakṣiṇadvāraḥ, prāgardhena rātrau dvitīyā saurī sarvarāśiṣu dreṣkāṇatrayam | te prathamapañcamanavamarāśināthāḥ | prāgdvārāṇāṃ rāśīnāṃ meṣādyā na vāṃśakāḥ dakṣiṇadvārāṇāṃ makarādyāḥ paścimadvārāṇāṃ tulādyāḥ uttaradvārāṇāṃ kulīrādyāḥ dattvā saptadaśī jyā | tataḥ prathamajyāvāptaṃ saptadaśajyāntarātsaṃśodhyāṣṭādaśamaṃ jyāntaram || tatsaptadaśa jīvāyāṃ dattvāṣṭādaśī jyā | tataḥ prathamajyāvāptam | aṣṭādaśājjyāntarātsaṃśodhya ekonaviṃśaṃ jyāntaram | tadaṣṭādaśajīvāyāṃ dattvaikonaviṃśī jyā | tataḥ prathamajyāvāptamekonaviṃśājjyāntarātsaṃśodhya viṃśatitamaṃ jyāntaram | tadekonaviṃśajīvāyāṃ dattvā viṃśatitamī jyā | tataḥ prathama jyāvāptaṃ viṃśājjyāntarātsaṃśodhyaikaviṃśaṃ jyāntaram | tadviṃśatijīvāyāṃ dattvā ekaviṃśī jyā| tataḥ prathamajyāvāptaṃ ekaviṃśājjyāntarātsaṃśodhya dvāviṃśaṃ jyāntaram | tadekaviṃśajīvāyāṃ dattvā dvāviṃśī jyā | tataḥ prathamajyāvāptaṃ dvāviṃśājjyāntarātsaṃśodhya trayoviṃśaṃ jyāntaram || taddvāviṃśa jīvāyāṃ dattvā trayoviṃśī jyā | tataḥ prathamaṃ jyāvāptaṃ trayoviṃśājjyāntarātsaṃśodhya caturviṃśaṃ jyāntaram | tattrayoviṃśajīvāyāṃ dattvā caturviṃśī jyā | tataḥ prathamajyāvāptaṃ caturviṃśājjyāntarātsaṃśodhya pañcaṃviṃśaṃ jyāntaram | taccaturviṃśajīvāyāṃ dattvā pañcaviṃśī jyā | khakharasendukakṣāyāṃ ca vyāsāraṃ tadevānupadanyāsāyām | jyāntavyastānāmantarālayoge caturviṃśatiḥ śarā bhavanti | kramajyākṛtijīvābhistastatkramajyākṛtiḥ śare yāsāṃ liptānāṃ jīvā kriyate tatkendrastasya ca rāśitraye padākhyā prathamapadasthe tadgamaṃ caturthapadasthe cakrādūnam | jyākendraliptā rāśiliptāṣṭavibhāgena vibhājyā | labdhāṅgasamāśca sthāpyāḥ | avaśeṣaṃ tadanantaraṃ jyāntareṇa guṇayet| rāśiliptāṣṭabhāgena vibhajet| labdhaṃ sthāpitajīvāyāṃ dattveṣṭa jyāsiddhiḥ | kālakṣaṇebhyo liptatvena parikalpitebhyo jīvā kāryā | liptābhyo yāvanti jyāntarāṇi saṃśuddhanti tāvanti saṃśodhyāvaśiṣṭabhāgaliptāṣṭabhāgāhatamaśuddhajyāntareṇa vibhajet| labdhahatāsu ādyaṣṭakabhāgaliptāsu kṣipet| śarāntarairevaṃ śaracāpaḥ bhāgacaturviṃśatijyāparamāpakramajyā meṣādi stho viṣuvallekhāstho graho bhavati| kulīrādisthaścāntareṇa | paramāpakramāntastho bhavati| tulādistho viṣuvallekhāsthaḥ makarādistho dakṣiṇena paramāpakramahatāṃ vyāsārdhena vibhajet| labdhaṃ candrasphuṭavikṣepaḥ | tātkālikaśīghraṃ sphuṭaṃ supāte yojyaṃ budhaśukrayoḥ svamadāvikṣepahatāṃ sphuṭāntyakarṇena vibhajetaḥ labdhaṃ tayoḥ sphuṭavikṣepaḥ | tātkālikasphuṭagrahasphuṭapātayogajyāṃ bhaumajīvasaurāṇāṃ madhyavikṣepahatāṃ sphuṭāntyakarṇena vibhajet, labdhaṃ teṣāṃ sphuṭa vikṣepaḥ | utkrānticāpasphuṭavikṣepayordiśaiko yogaḥ tajjīvasyakrāntiḥ, tasyā niyogaḥ śiṣyate sā dik tadgolasthaśca graho bhavati | evaṃ grahāṇāmuttareṇa dakṣiṇena gatirjñeyā | bhacakravaśenodayāstamayau kurvaṃtaḥ paścimena yānti | pūrvāṃ vrajanto bhagaṇaparivartānkurvanti tatra ca sūryāśvapātaiḥ samameva laṅkādakṣiṇottararekhāyāḥ phālgunānte sarva eva kalpādāvarkodaye mīnameṣasandhigā bhavanti | kalpāvasāne ca meṣapraveśe vā bhānorgaganamadhyavartinyāditye dvādaśāṅgulena śaṃkunā samāvanau chāyā grāhyā, tadvargaṃ vyāsārdhavargahate cchāyāśaṃkuvargayogena vibhajet, labdhamakṣajyāvargaḥ | tatpadamakṣajyā taccāpaṃ svadeśākṣaḥ taṃ rāśitrayādapāsya svadeśāvalambako bhavati | tajjyāvalambakajyā trijyā vargasya svakrāntivargonasya padaṃ svāharvyāsārdhastasya ca svakāntivaśena dik | svakrāntiviṣuvacchāyāhatā śakuhṛtā kṣitijā, sā trijyāhatā svāharnyāsārdhabhājitā kṣaye vṛddhijyā | taddhanuścarārdhaṃ vā prāṇāstadghaṭikābhiḥ pañcadaśaghaṭikāyutā dinārdham | ūnā rātryardhagā evamuttaragolasthā dakṣiṇakāraḥ svasvabhāgāpahāraḥ avāmadhanuṣāmabodhaḥ | śodhanaṃ vyakṣarāśyudayaprāṇāḥ meṣavṛṣamithunānāṃ krameṇa karkaṭasiṃhakanyānāmutkrameṇa | meṣavṛṣamidhunajīvādiḥ prāgvaccaraprāṇāḥ kartavyāḥ | teṣāmavabodhaḥ śodhanaṃ ca tenaikadvitryākṣaraprāṇāḥ taiḥ krameṇa meṣavṛṣamithunāḥ prāṇahīnāḥ utkrameṇa kulīrasiṃhakanyānām | yuktasvadeśe carā vyudayaprāṇā bhavanti ta evotkrameṇa tulādīnāṃ mīnādīnāmapi ardhadinamadhyāhnacchāyāgramūlayāmyottarāgramūlāgraparilekhamatsyamukhapuccharakhā prācyāparā ādityacandrayoranyatamasya deśāntarakarma vinā grahaṇaṃ na kāryam | tadyathāgate kāle yadi bhavati tadā rekhāmadhye svadeśo jñeyaḥ | athādau rekhā paścāccetprāk tatkālāntaraṃ ṣaṣṭihataṃ pañcabhiḥ sahasrairvibhajet | labdhadeśāntarayojanāni grahasyārdhaṃ rātrānmadhyāhnaṃ yāvatpūrvaḥ kālo madhyāhnādapararātraṃ yāvadaparastatrārkasya kālamavilaṅghayan chāyādvayaṃ gṛhṇīyāt | tatkarṇo vyatyāsena śaṃkuprācyaparānte rahitau tadanantaraṃ viṣuvacchāyāgrahaṇamiṣṭe'hni iṣṭadinākṣavaiṣuvatākṣāntamekadigabhimukhībhyaśchāyābhyo yuktaṃ svarāpakramaḥ tena trijyāhatā paramāpakramajyāyā vibhajet | labdhacāpamarkaḥ prathame pade dvitīyādbhāvācchuddhaḥ | tṛtīyena yuktaḥ caturthe cakrācchuddhaḥ | viṣuvacchāyā taruṇā ca hīyamānā ca cchāyā prathama padasthe'rke bhavati, ūnā vṛddhimatī dvitīyasthe, vṛddhimatyadhikā tṛtīyasthe, hīyamānādhikā caturthasthe, evamatītadivasārkasya tadarkasya ca vivaraṃ sphuṭabhuktiḥ | ādityodayāstamayādvā candrodayaṃ dṛṣṭvā nagradaddharito'rkastena kālena candramā bhavati candrānnakṣatrajñānam, candrārkavivarāttithijñānaṃ tasmādahargaṇaḥ | sphuṭārkādviparītakarmaṇā madhyamārkaḥ | saurajīvayoścārātsaṃvatsaraḥ | candravatsarvagrahakriyā,grahebhyo vā kalpagatakālajñānam, evaṃ kāla paricchedaḥ | aśvinyādīnāṃ dhruvakā rāśyādyāḥ, khamaṣṭau khaṃkhaṃkhayamāḥ khaṃśaśīmunayoṣṭayamāḥ śaśīnavendavo'śvayamāḥ pakṣau guṇāḥ khapakṣau śailāḥ khaṃguṇā guṇāḥ khaṃ guṇā ṣoḍaśakhaṃ trīdvyaṣṭādaśakhaṃ vedā randhrāṇi khaṃ vedāḥ saptayamāḥ khaṃ śarā nakhāḥ khaṃ rasā puṣkarā khaṃ rasā navendavaḥ khaṃ sapta pakṣau śarā munayo manavo bhūtāni ca sapta navendavaḥ pañca aṣṭau ca khaṃ aṣṭau janakhaṃ aṣṭau nakhaḥ khaṃ aṣṭau catvāri khaṃ nava vasavaḥ khaṃ sūyamunayaḥ kham | athaiteṣāṃ vikṣepāṃśāḥ daśa dvādaśa pañcadaśa ekādaśa ṣaḍ khaṃ sapta khaṃ dvādaśa trayodaśa ekādaśa dvāvaṣṭātriṃśatsārdhaṃ trīṇi catvāri sārdhānyaṣṭau pañcavibhāgāḥ pañca dviṣaṣṭiḥ triṃśat aṃśavibhāgaḥ caturviśatiḥ ṣaḍviśatiḥ śūnyaṃ cāśvinī bharaṇī kṛttikā punarvasu puṣya maghā bhāgyāryamāṇaḥ || svāti vaiśvadevābhijicchravaṇa dhaniṣṭhājāhirbudhnya revatīnām| uttarā rohiṇī saumyārdrā sārpa hasta citrā viśākhā maitrendra mūlāpyavāruṇānā yāmyāḥ | revatyudayaḥ prācī sarvasya mahatī yogatārā rāśidvayaṃ saptaviṃśatirbhāgāḥ agastyadhruvakaḥ saptabhirmāgaistasya yāmyo vikṣepaḥ | atha bhaumādīnāṃ vakrakendrāṇi rāśyādyāni pañcamanavaḥ khaṃ vedāḥ ṣaḍyamāḥ khaṃ pañca vedāḥ khaṃ pañca pañcadaśa khaṃ vedāstrayodaśa kham | athānuvakrakendrāṇi ṣaḍṣoḍaśa khaṃ sapta vedāḥ khaṃ ṣaḍyamāḥ khaṃ ṣaṭpañcaviṃśatiḥ khaṃkhaṃ manavaḥ khaṃ ṣaḍguṇāḥ khaṃ saptadaśa kham | atha pūrvādvārodayakendrāṇi khamaṣṭayamāḥ khaṃ ṣaṭpañcaviṃśatiḥ khaṃ khaṃ manaḥ khaṃ ṣaḍguṇāḥ khaṃ khaṃ saptadaśa kham | atha paścārdhāstamayakendrāṇi ekādaśa dvau khaṃ pañcapañca khaṃ ekādaśaṣoḍaśa khaṃ pañcasaptaviṃśati khaṃ ekādaśa trayodaśa kham | atha budhaśukrayoḥ pūrvārdhāstamayakendre daśadaśa khaṃ ekādaśa ṣoḍaśa khaṃ catvāri śūnyāni catvāri śūnyāni paṃcavedarasāgniyamapakṣāṣṭaśarendavaḥ kalpanapratinakṣatrodayaḥ ta evārkabhagaṇonā divasāḥ | arkabhagaṇā dvādaśahatāstaṃ māsāstaistriṃśaddhatāstaddivasāścandrabhagaṇāḥ saptaviṃśati hatā nakṣatradivasāḥ bhagaṇāṃtaramarkendvoścandramasaste triṃśadguṇāstaddivasāścandramāsaḥ | sūryamāsonādhimāsāścandradivasastu divasāntaramavamānīti | iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare mā0 va0 saṃ0 dvi0 khaṃ0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne upakaraṇavivaraṇaṃ nāmaṣṭaṣaṣṭyuttaraśatatamodhyāyaḥ || 168|| <2.169> atha yathākālaṃ| gatamanavastvekasaptatihatāścaturyugābdahatāḥ kāryāḥ | teṣu kṛtapramāṇaṃ kṣepyam | tameva tatra bhūyo gatasaṃkhyāhataṃ ca tato vartamānamanvantarādgatacaturyugasaṃkhyāhatāni caturyugābdāni yugāni ca vartamānayugāccaitraprabhavagatābdāni ca evamiṣṭakālābdagaṇo bhavati | sa dvādaśahataścaitrasitādimāsayuktastriṃśa ddhatovamānamitāditithisahitaḥ kāryaḥ | evaṃ sauro dinagaṇo bhavati | taṃ pṛthakkalpādhimāsakahataṃ kalpanavidinairvibhajet | labdhaṃ gatādhimāsāḥ | taistriṃśadabdairarkāhargaṇoyukte candrāhargaṇo bhavati | taṃ pṛthakkalpāvamahataṃ kalpacandradinairvibhajet | labdhaṃ gatonarātriḥ taiścandrāhargaṇāddhanaṃ sādhanāhargaṇo bhavati | adhimāsaśeṣasya kalpādhimāsakairbhāge hate eṣyādhimāsakairbhāge hate gatādhimāsakasya dinādiḥ kālo labhyate | adhimāsaśeṣaṃ kalparavidivasebhyaḥ saṃśodhyāvaśeṣasya kalpādhimāsakairbhāge hate eṣyedhimāsekatāsya kālo labhyate | avamaśeṣasya kalpena rātrerbhāge hate eṣyonarātrakālaḥ avamaśeṣakalpacandradivasebhyaḥ saṃśodhyāvaśeṣasya kalponarātrenarātrerbhāge hate eṣyonarātrapātakālaḥ saṃvatsaragaṇātpaṃcahatāvaśeṣe saṃvatsarādyobdaḥ ādityaḥ, candraḥ , bhaumaḥ, budhaḥ, jīvaḥ, sitaḥ, sauraśceti krameṇa grahaṇaṃ saṃvatsarāḥ saptahatāvaśeṣe caturthakrameṇa saṃvatsarādhipaḥ sāvanāddinagaṇātsaptahṛtātkrameṇaiva divasādhipaḥ cāndrāḥ dinagaṇā daśātyadhikaśatahatāllabdhaṃ saptahataṃ tadavaśeṣaṃ parva brahmacandreṃdravaiśravaṇavaruṇāgniyamāśca parvapatayaḥ dinagaṇami ṣṭagrahabhagaṇaguṇabhūdinairvibhajet | labdhaṃ bhagaṇādiḥ lekhārkodayo graho bhavati | evaṃrūpeṇāhargaṇena grahabhuktiḥ | iṣṭāṃ kālādyāvatākālenārkodayo bhaviṣyati tāvatā kālena grahasyekadivasabhuktiṃ saṃguṇya ṣaṣṭyā vibhajet | avāptaṃ ravyudaye grahasya dhanamastamaye ṛṇam | evamuttaragole dakṣiṇena viparīta diśāntarayojanāni ṣaṣṭhyāsaṅguṇya pañcabhiḥ sahasrairvibhajet | labdhaṃ lekhāprāgbhāve saṃśodhyamaparasmindeyamevamiṣṭe deśe | iṣṭe ca kāle graho madhyamo bhavati | tatkālārkacandramandakarmaṇaiva sphuṭe kāryo bhaumaḥ karmacatuṣṭayena tasya manda śīghraṃ maṃdaṃ śīghramiti ca karmāṇi | anyeṣāṃ mandaśīghre karmaṇī tatra bhaumamardaḥ saṃskāryaḥ tacchīghraparidhiśca śukrasya paridhidvayamapi tatra bhaumajīvasaurāṇāmarkaḥ śīghraḥ | svayaṃ madhyamo budhaśukrayorarko madhyamaḥ | svayaṃ śīghrośīghro grahonaṃ kendraḥ grahaśca mandonaḥ bhaumaśīghrakendrapadabhuktābhuktayoralpasya jīvaṃ caturbhiḥ śataiḥ grahaiśca mandonaḥ bhāṇitaṃ dvādaśyā jīvayā vibhajet | labdhena kendre makarādige bhaumamandayutaṃ kāryaṃ karkaṭādige conamiti śukramadaṃ kendrajyāṃ nyāsārdhāvahūtāṃ labdhena taṃ madaṃ paridhirūnaḥ spaṣṭo bhavati | tasyaiva śīghrakendrajyāṃ vyāsārdhaṃ pañcamena vibhajet | labdhe yutaḥ śukraśīghraparidhiḥ spaṣṭo bhavatīti mandakendrāt jīvā bhujajyā trirāśisahitārkoṭijyākoṭibhujajye svamardavāridhihate kharasāmibhirvibhajeta | labdhaṃ bhujakoṭipāte makarādikendre koṭiphalaṃ vyāsārthe dadyāta | kulīrādike śodhayetkoṭirbhavati | bhujāphalaṃ bhujā koṭibhujāvargayogamūlaṃ karṇaḥ vyāsārdhahatāṃ bhujajyāṃ sphuṭakarṇena vibhajet | labdhacāpaṃ phalakalāḥ meṣādikendre grahe śodhyāstulādau deyāḥ | bhaumasya śyamamandakarmaṇyadhikṛtāḥ evaṃ spandasphuṭagrahaṃ śīghrādapāsya kendraṃ kṛtaitadeva śīghraparidhinā karma kuryāt | tatphalaṃ mandasphuṭe grahe meṣādikendre dhanaṃ tulādṛṇamiti | bhaumasya prathame śīghrakarmaṇi tadūnīkṛtaṃ evaṃ grahaḥ sphuṭo bhavati| budhasitapātau viparītena abdaphalena sphuṭo kāryo bhaumajīvasaurāṇāṃ śīghrāntyaphalenānulomenānītavartamānasphuṭaṃ grahāntaraṃ sphuṭabhuktiḥ arkaphalam | sphuṭabhaktihataṃ bhavanakalābhirvibhajet labdhamarkakendravaśe tadvadeva grahasya dhanarṇe yojye | antyaśīghrakarmāviśeṣaṃ kendrasya vakrādikendrasya vāntaraṃ sphuṭabhuktiśīghramutsaṃtareṇa vibhajet | labdho vakrāderdinādiḥ kālaḥ dhuvakakendredhika eṣyaḥ śīghrakendredhiketītaḥ || iti śrīvi0 mā0 vajra saṃ0 dvitīyakhaṇḍe rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne jyotiḥśāstre grahagatirnāmaikonasaptatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 169 || <2.170> sphuṭagrahaṃ liptīkṛtam aṣṭabhiḥ śatairvibhajet | labdhaṃ graheṇa bhuktānyaśvinyādyāni nakṣatrāṇi śeṣaṃ sphuṭabhuktyā vibhajet | labdhaṃ dinādiḥ kālā nakṣatrapraviṣṭasya avaśeṣamaṣṭabhyaḥ śatebhyaḥ saṃśodhyāvameṣāta prāgghatakālo nakṣatrasthiteḥ rāśau bhuktā abhuktā vā sphuṭabhuktā vibhajeta | labdhaṃ dinādiḥ saṃkrāntergataiṣyaḥ kālaḥ atha yojanakarṇāntaṃ sarvāṃtyāviśeṣakarṇādyantaṃ vyastaṃ vyāsārdhena vibhajet | labdhaṃ sphuṭayojanakarṇārthā grahā pramāṇaviṣkabhayojanāni vyāsādhehatāni sphuṭayojanakarṇārdhena vibhajet | labdhaṃ sphuṭagrahāpramāṇavyāsakalāḥ sphuṭānyarkakarṇārdhayojanati pāṃcasāhasrikasyaparidheḥ karṇonāni tenaiva guṇitāni ravinyāse na tadgaṇena vibhajet | labdhaṃ bhūcchāyā sphuṭarāśikarṇārdhonapāñcasāhasrikasya | paridheḥ karṇahatāṃ bhūcchāyayā vibhajet | labdhaṃ vyāsārdhaguṇaṃ candrasphuṭayojanakarṇārdhena vibhajet labdhaṃ rāhumānakalāḥ | grahamānārdhakalāḥ ṣaṣṭiguṇā bhuktyā vibhajet | labdhaṃ saṃkrāṃtikālātprāgapareṇa ca puṇyakālaḥ | arkonāccandrālliptīkṛtāt vayamāgatabhaktācchuklapratipadādyā tithiḥ | śeṣātṣaṣṭiguṇyādbhuktāntarahṛtādghaṭikādiḥ kālaḥ kṛṣṇacaturdaśāṃtaḥ sadaiva śakuniḥ amāyā ādyardhe catuṣpāt dvitīye nāgaḥ pratipadādyardhe kiṃstughnama arkonacandraliptāḥ kharadāgnibhirvibhajet| avaśeṣāttithivatkālaḥ labdhādekonātsaptamahṛtādavaśeṣaṃ bavādyaṃ karaṇaṃ candrārkayoge candrārdhayorāsaneghātavai dhṛte tena candrārkayoḥ krāntisāmye | tatra vyatīpātaurbhinnanayane golaikatve ca vaidhṛtaḥ samāyane golabhede ca dhruvakārkacandrayogāntaraṃ candrārkabhuktiyogena vibhajet | labdhena dhruvakāditye candrārkayogādhikāviti | tatorkātkrāntistātkālikapātena candrātsvakāntiḥ prathamatṛtīyapādāntasthe candrasya krānteḥ candrakrāntiryadonā bhavati tadā krāṃtisāmyārāvāḥ prathamatṛtīyapadasthe candramasi tadapakramamarkāpakramādūne eṣyaḥ krāntisāmyakālonyathātītaḥ| dvitīyacaturthapadasthānyathāvikṣepeṇa svakrāntidigutpattau candrāpakramamadhikṛtaṃ kalpayet| krāṃteryutiranyadiśorekadiśorantaraṃ vyatīpātenyathā vaidhṛtiprathamākhyaḥ| evamiṣṭakālikairarkacandrapātairdvitīyādayastataḥ prathamadvitīyakālayoḥ dvayoreṣyotīto vā pātastadā tayorantaram| anyathā yogo bhāgāpahāraḥ sthitiriti || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṃḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde tithinakṣatraprakaraṇaṃ nāma saptatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 170 || <2.171>
