śaṃkuvargahīnasya kriyāvargasya padaṃ dṛśyadvādaśahatā śaṃkuhṛtā chāyā madhyāhnikārkakrāntyā sākṣasaṃyogavivaro dakṣiṇottaragolayoraniṣṭa tadrāśitrayādapāsya tajjyābhāgāpahāraḥ dvādaśahatāyā anaṣṭajīvāyā labdhaṃ mādhyāhnikī cchāyā tridyārkaghātamadhyāhnachāyābhāgāpahāravibhaktastatkarṇaḥ viṣuvakarṇahatāṃ tridyāṃ sveṣṭakāyākarṇena vibhajet | labdhamuttaradakṣiṇa golayoḥ kṣitijyayā yutonavyāsārdhatāḍitaṃ svāhorātrārdhena vibhajet | labdhā cāyaṃ golaviparyayāścaradalonayutaṃ divasasya gataṃ śeṣaṃ vā bhavati || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde jyotiḥśāstre chāyāprakaraṇaṃ nāmaikasaptatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 171 || <2.172> iṣṭakālasphuṭārkarāśibhuktaliptāstadā krāntirāśyudayaprāṇāhatāgrahatāgrahaliptābhirvibhajet| labdhamarkakrāntirāśerdinabhāgakālaḥ tadiṣṭakālaprāṇebhyoṇasyāditye cābhuktaliptā deyāḥ kāle cānantararavyudayāśrayāsyāḥ arka ..........carācyudayo deyaḥ śeṣādaśuddharāśyudayairbhāvādyāḥ| evaṃ rāśigata kālalagnodayaḥ ṣaḍrāśiyutārkā arkabhuktakālādyāḥ kālāḥ lagnāśca bhuktakalābhyastadyoge tadantarā vyudaye yute lagrodayaḥ kālaḥ || itiśrīvi0 mā0 va0 saṃ0 dvi0 lagnaprakaraṇaṃ nāma dvisaptatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 172 || <2.173> bhaumajīvamaṃdāḥ kendraḥ śīghraḥ budhasitau vakre maṃdāvatyathāśīghrau manda graharkāṃtaragāḥ kāladṛśyādṛśyāṃśena yadā tadā pūrvārdhodayāstamayayorārkodayiko grahaḥ paścārdhena tadāstamayikaḥ tātkālikagrahasphuṭavikṣepamadājyāhatavyāmārdhena vibhajeta | labdhagraha audayike ṛṇamāstamayikavanauttaravikṣepaparamāpakrameṇa vibhajet| labdhamayanavikṣepenye śodhyamanyathādeyam | evaṃ grahodayāstalagnau bhavataḥ | tato grahāntarāllagnavatkālaḥ kalāṃśagrahāntarāṃśānāṃ bhujāntareṇa bhāgamapaharet | grahe vakriṇi bhuktiyogena labdho dinādiḥ kālamupāstamayasya eva nakṣatrāṇāṃ teṣāṃ dvādaśa dṛśyādṛśyāṃśaḥ agastyadhruvakṛdikkarmadvayakaṃ kṛtvā tadvaṭikādvayena svadeśarāśyudaye vardhayet | tadaṃśekegastyodayaḥ vakronestamayaḥ pratidaivasika udayo grahāntaṃ lagnavaśeneti || iti śrīvi0 dha0 dvi0 khaṃ0 mā0 saṃ0 udayāstamayaprakaraṇaṃ nāma saptatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 173 || <2.174> svodayāstavilagnau candrārkayoḥ tataścandrodayāstakālau sādhyau iṣṭakālikacandrārkasvakrānti trijyāguṇe vilasvajyayā vibhajet | labdhegre krāntidiṣṭeśena tatorkacandraśaṃkukāryau pṛthakcchaṃkuhatākṣajyāvalambakena vibhajet | labdhe śaṅkutale tau cottare svarātrau divasayāmye dvādaśaśaṃkutalayordiśaiko yogo digbhedaviyogaḥ pṛthagbāhuḥ tayordigaiko viyogonyathā yogaḥsphuṭabāhuḥ svadṛgarṇyavarjabhujāvargaviśleṣapadayogaḥ kapālabhede sāmye viyogaḥ prathamāṃśajāṃ digaivātiśleṣo digbhedo yutirdvitīyaḥ prathamadvitīyavargayogapadaṃ koṭiḥ koṭi vāhuvargayogamūlakarṇaḥ arkonāścandrārkerddhaṃ tasmājjyākendraliptāścandramāsaliptāḥ tasmājjyākendraliptāścandramānaghnāḥ navatyāhṛtāsmin kendra prayamacaturthapadasthe dvitīyasthe kṛṣṇam indumānacaturbhāgakṛtāsmiterkamānabhujakakarṇakoṭisūtrāṇyaṅgulatāṃ yānti pūrvāparāśābhimukhārkendrāṇyādya padage mitaśṛṅgaṃ parilikhet | evaṃ dvitīyatṛtīyage kṛṣṇaṃ bindumarkaṃ parikalpya tatorkādyathā śaśī tathā bhujā deyā tadagrātsvābhimukhyena koṭiḥ tataḥ tadaṃtalagnena pūrvāntaṃ punaḥpunaḥ satkulam | yāvadaviśeṣaṃ labdhonaṃ syāt iti lambanaṃ saṃskṛte tithyante grahaṇamadhyaścandraścandravatkalpitāddvitri bhātsvakrāntiḥ akṣe saumyā śodhyā yāmyā deyā tajjyāmadhyamacandrārkabhuktyaṃtarahatā śarerkahatayā trijyayā vibhajet | labdhabhavanatiḥ svakrāntitokṣedhike saumyānyathā yāmyā tātkālikacandravikṣepāvananyādigaikye yogo digbhedo viyogaḥ sphuṭavikṣepaḥ tena sthite mandabhadalonayutairgrahaiḥ sparthanimīlonmīlanamokṣakālikailambanamāni kāryāṇi madhyalambanasyeṣṭalaṃbanasya dhanarṇekontare bhedayogaḥ phalam | tena madhyasthityaravimandāveva yute svakālike sphuṭe bhavataḥ pañcadaśaṃ ghaṭikākālikaṃ laṃbane phalena hīne vimaṃdārdhe kārye śeṣaṃ pīralekhāḍhye cadragrahaṇavadbhavati || dhanyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ svargalokapradaṃ tathā || idaṃ grahāṇāṃ gaṇitaṃ sarvakāmapradaṃ śivam || gatimekasya vijñāya grahasya susamāhitaḥ || tasya lokamavāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || sarvagrahagatiṃ jñātvā brahmalokaṃ prapadyate || dharmārthī prāpnuyāddharmamarthārthī cārthamāpnuyāt || kāmānavāpnuyātkāmī mokṣārthī paramaṃ padam || samyaggrahagatiṃ jñātvā pātratāṃ yāti vai dvijaḥ|| na ced vṛttiṃ tathā kuryāttathā vṛttiṃ vivarjayet|| pātrāṇāmapi tatpātraṃ grahāṇāṃ vetti yo gatim|| vedāstu yajñārthamabhipravṛttāḥ kalānupūrvyā vihitāśca yajñāḥ || tasmādidaṃ kālavidhānaśāstraṃ yo jyotiṣaṃ veda sa veda sarvam || ini śrīvi0 dha0 dvi0 kha0 mā0 saṃ0 paitāmahasiddhānto nāma catuḥsaptatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 174 || || samāptaṃ paitāmahasiddhāntam | <2.175> śrīparaśurāma uvāca || bhagavansarvadharmajña sarvaśāstraviśārada || jigīṣūṇāṃ samācakṣva yātrākālaṃ mahīkṣitām || 1 || puṣkara uvāca || sarveṣāmeva varṇānāṃ yātrākālaṃ nibodha me || adhikṛtya mahīnāthaṃ vijigīṣorguṇānvitam || 2 || pūrve kapāle pauro'rke yāyī bhavati cāpare || yāyigrahau śukrakujau śeṣāḥ paurāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || 3 || pauragrahairbalopetairna yātrāṃ samprayojayet || yāyigrahabale rājā nityaṃ yātrāṃ prayojayet || 4 || astaṃ gate nīcagate vivaśe ripurāśige || pratilomaṃ ca viddhvaste śukre yātrāṃ vivarjayet || 5 || pratilome budhe yātrā dikpatau ca tathā grahe || viṣṭo vṛṣṭyāṃ vāti vāte vātyāyāñca vivarjayeta || 6 || vaidhṛte ca vyatīpāte nāge ca śakunau tathā || catuṣpade ca kiṃstughne tathā yātrāṃ vivarjayet || || 7 || vipatkare naidhane ca pratyarau bhe ca janmani || gaṇe vivarjayedyātrāṃ riktāyāṃ ca tithāvapi || 8 || udīcī ca tathā prācī tayoraikyaṃ prakīrtitam || paścimā dakṣiṇā yā diktayoraikyaṃ tathaiva ca || 9 || vāyvagnidiksamudbhūtaṃ paridhintu na laṃghayet || rāma saṃvatsarādyeṣu sarveṣveva mahīpatiḥ || 2.175.10 || saṃvatsaramadikprācī paripūrvasya dakṣiṇā || tatpūrvasyāparā jñeyā cānupūrvasya dakṣiṇā || 11 || advārastu vinirdiṣṭastathā vatsarasaṃjñitaḥ || uttarāyaṇage sūrye prācīṃ yāyāddiśaṃ nṛpaḥ || 12 || candre ca brāhmaṇaśreṣṭha paścimāṃ dakṣiṇasthite || tayorayanabhedena yāyātsūryāyanaṃ divā || 13 || rātrau cāndrāyaṇaṃ yāyādyā diguktā mayā tava || vasanta uttaradvāre grīṣmaḥ prāgdvārikastathā || 14 || śaracca paścimadvāraḥ śiśiraścottarāmukhaḥ || hemantaḥ sarvatodvāraḥ prāvṛḍadvārikā smṛtā || 15 || nakṣatravaddevatābhiryā yasya tu digucyate || māsārdhe'sya mahābhāga tathaiva parikīrtitā || 16 || ādityacandrasaurārkadivasāstu na śobhanāḥ || ta eva cānukūlasya divaso na praśasyate || 17 || prāgdvāro bhāskaro jñeyo dakṣiṇena tathā kujaḥ || paścimena śanaiścārī udagdvārastu candramāḥ || 18 || sarvadvārāḥ smṛtā rāma jīvaśukrendunandanāḥ || teṣāṃ hi divasāḥ śastā viśeṣeṇa gamiṣyatām ||19|| samāgame jito yastu jīvo mitragṛhe sthitaḥ|| sphuraṇo raśmihīnaśca na praśaṃsanti taddinam ||2.175.20|| uccastho mitragṛhagaḥ svakṣetrasthaśca yo grahaḥ || vijayī raśmivāṃsthūlo dinaṃ tasya praśasyate||21|| kṛttikādyāni pūrveṇa maghādyāni ca yāmyataḥ|| maitrādyāḥ paścimenātha vāsavādyāni cāpyudak || 22 || sarvadvārāṇi tatrāpi divādyāni vinirdiśet || bhavanti stambhasaṃjñāni tāni diṅmadhyagāni ca || 23 || stambharkṣādyāni pūrvāṇi tāni prāveśikāni tu || nirgamarkṣāṇi jānīyātstambharkṣāduttarāṇi tu||24|| praveśabheṣu duṣṭeṣu yāyināṃ vijayaṃ vadet || stambhabheṣu tu duṣṭeṣu durgāṇāṃ grahaṇe tadā ||25|| nirgamarkṣeṣu duṣṭeṣu nāgarāṇāṃ jayaṃ vadet || ṛkṣe pāpagrahākrānte tathā cāstamite dvija || 26 || dagdhe ca dhūmite vāpi rajasopahate'tha vā || ketunā dhūmite vāpi pariviṣṭe'thavā punaḥ '| || 27 || utpātadarśanaṃ ca syādyena carkṣeṇa bhārgava || saṃkrāntirvā grahasya syādyena cāstodayau tathā || 28 || bhinnaścandramasā yaśca graheṇānyena vā punaḥ || yannakṣatragatau grastau syātāṃ vā śaśibhāskarau || 29 || na tena nṛpatiryāyānnakṣatreṇa kadācana || aṣṭavargānukūlastha candre yātrāṃ prayojayet || 2.175.30 || pūrvadvārasthitānandā bhadrā dakṣiṇataḥ sthitā || jayā ca paścimadvārā riktā codakprakīrtitā || 31 || pūrṇā tu sarvato dvārā tithiruktā mahābhuja || nakṣatradevatātulyā muhūrtānāṃ tu digbhavet || 32 || tridigdvārābhijijjñeyā dakṣiṇena vigarhitā || prāgdvārāḥ kathitā rāma meṣasiṃhadhanurdharāḥ || 33 || tathā ca paścimadvārāḥ kanyāmakaragovṛṣāḥ || tulāmakarakumbhāśca jñeyāḥ paścimadiṅmukhāḥ || 34 || kīṭavṛścikamīnāśca tathā codakprakīrtitāḥ || lagnena diṅmukhaṃ yatnājjñeyaṃ prāṅmukhamaṃśakam || 35 || saurāḥ sarve praśasyante kālarodhaṃ vivarjayet '| viśākhādyaṃ bhatritayaṃ dīne sūrye vivarjayet || 36 || āṣāḍhātritayaṃ candre tathā brāhmaṇasaṃjñakam || dhaniṣṭhādyatrayaṃ bhaume pauṣṇādyatritayaṃ budhe| || 37 || rohiṇyādyaṃ tathā jīve puṣyādyaṃ ca tathā site || aryamṇādya tathā saure prayatnena mahābhuja || 38 || mūlaṃ ca śravaṇaṃ caiva āhirbudhnyaṃ tathaiva ca || āgneyamatha cādityaṃ bhāgyaṃ vāyavyameva vā || 39 || ādityādidineṣvete siddhiyogāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || siddhiyogānviśeṣeṇa tithiṣvapi nibodha me || 2.175.40 || grahakrameṇa dharmajña sarvakarmasu siddhidān || dvitīyā ca tṛtīyā ca pratipaccāṣṭamī tathā || 41 || saptamī ca caturthī ca pañcamī ca tathā tithiḥ || anyāśca siddhayogeṣu tithayastvaṃ śṛṇu kramāt || 42 || ekādaśī ca daśamī navamī pañcadaśyapi || caturdaśī dvādaśī ca tathā rāma trayodaśī || 43 || chāyāpramāṇaṃ vakṣyāmi siddhiyogeṣvataḥ kramāt || tatra kāle kṛtaṃ karma sakṛtsaṃpaśyate dhruvam || 44 || āditye viṃśatirjñeyāścandre ṣoḍaśa kīrtitāḥ || bhaume pañcadaśaivoktāścaturdaśa tathā budhe || 45 || trayodaśa tathā jīve śukre dvādaśa kīrtitāḥ || uditenottarāṃ gacchetprācīṃ madhyasthite ravau || 46 || dakṣiṇāmaparāhṇe tu ardharātre tu paścimām || janmarāśyudaye yātrā na praśastā mahābhuja || 47 || tābhyāmupacayarkṣe tu yātrā śastā tathā bhavet || śeṣeṣu varjayedyātrāṃ bhūtikāmo narādhipaḥ || 438 || yātrā śubhaphalā jñeyā saumyagrahanavāṃśake || pāpagrahāṃśake yātrāṃ prayatnena vivarjayet || 49 || janmabhe naidhane caiva tathādhāne vipatkare || pratyarau bhagaṇe yātrāṃ prayatnena vivarjayet || 2.175.50 || kṣeme saṃpatkare maitre sādhake cātimaitrake || karmabhe ca tathā yātrā praśastā manujottama || 51 || divyāntarikṣakṣitije dṛṣṭe rāma mahādbhute || saptāhaṃ varjeyedyātrāṃ prayatnena mahābhuja || 52 || lagne tu vibale yātrāṃ śūnye kendre ca varjayet || janmape lagnape rāma balahīne viśeṣataḥ || 53 || dikpatāvanukūle tu śubhā yātrā prakīrtitā || sammukhe śakracāpe tu yātrāṃ yatnena varjayet || 54 || na ca gacchettathā rāma dvārābhihatamastakaḥ || dṛṣṭvā dravyamamaṅgalyaṃ khinnacetāstathaiva ca || tuṣṭe manasi gantavyaṃ prayatnena mahībhujā || 55 || trikoṇa kendropagatāstu saumyāḥ pāpāstathā copacayarkṣasaṃsthāḥ || bhavanti lagnasya tu yasya tena yātrā prayuktā tu śubhāvahā syāt || 56 || iti śrīviṣṇu0 dvi0 mā0 saṃ0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne jyotiḥśāstramate yātrādhikāro nāma pañcasaptatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 175 || <2.176> || rāma uvāca || || yātrāvidhānamācakṣva sarvadharmabhṛtāṃvara || jigīṣūṇāṃ narendrāṇāṃ siddhikāraṇamuttamam || 1 || puṣkara uvāca || saptāhena yadā yātrā bhaviṣyati mahīpateḥ || tadā dine tu prathame pūjanīyo vināyakaḥ || 2 || modakairakṣatairdadhnā kusumaiśca tathā phalaiḥ || gandharvāstrairalaṅkārairdhūpairdīpairmanoharaiḥ || 3 || dvitīye'nhi tataḥ kāryaṃ sarvadikpālapūjanam || dikpālapūjanaṃ kṛtvā teṣāṃ ca purataḥ sthitaḥ || 4 || śayyāṃ kuśābhiḥ kurvīta sitavastrottaracchadām || vikirennāgapuṣpaistāṃ tathā siddhārthakaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 5 || tacchīrṣake tu pūjyā śrīrbhadrakālī ca pādayoḥ || haraṃ dakṣiṇapārśve tu vāme brahmāṇameva ca || 6 || pūjitaṃ kalaśaṃ hṛdyaṃ kuryāduṣṇīṣake dṛḍham || nīlapallavasaṃchannaṃ cārupuṣpojjvalaṃ śubham || 7 || ekakālaṃ haviṣyānnaṃ laghu bhuktvā mahīpatiḥ || svayaṃ dakṣiṇapārśve ca mantrametadudīrayet || 8 || namaḥ śambho trinetrāya rudrāya varadāya ca || vāmanāya virūpāya svapnādhipataye namaḥ ||9|| bhagavandevadeveśa śūlabhṛdvṛṣavāhana || iṣṭāniṣṭaṃ samācakṣva svapne suptasya śāśvatam||2.176.10|| yajjāgrato dūramiti mantramāvartayettataḥ || hṛdi nyasya kuśānrājñaḥ prayatastu purohitaḥ ||11|| tataḥ svapne śubhe dṛṣṭe yātrā deyā tu nānyathā || tṛtīye'hani saṃprāpte devaṃ diṅnāthamarcayet||12|| ekameva mahābhāga dinanāthaṃ tathā graham || yāṃ diśaṃ nṛpatirgacchennāthaṃ tasyāstathaiva tām||13|| caturthe'hani saṃprāpte grahayāgo vidhīyate|| pañcame'hani saṃprāpte sarvayāgastathaiva ca || devatānāṃ svanagare kṛtā yāsāṃ tathālayāḥ ||14|| tāsāṃ saṃpūjanaṃ kāryaṃ svapure ye tathā sthitāḥ || tatraiva rātrau bhūtānāṃ kartavyaṃ ca tathārcanam || 15 || ekavṛkṣeṣu caityeṣu catvarāṭṭālakeṣu ca || catuṣpatheṣu rathyāsu parvatānāṃ guhāsu ca || 16 || nadītīreṣu śaileṣu devatāyataneṣu ca || teṣāṃ saṃpūjanaṃ kṛtvā svagṛhe tānsamarcayet || 17 || tatra kṛtvā tato vācyāḥ pramathā bhūbhujā svayam || vāsudevasya devasya tathā saṃkarṣaṇasya ca || 18 || pradyumnasyāniruddhasya brahmaṇaḥ śaṅkarasya ca || kīnāśaśakravaruṇadhaneśānāṃ tu ye gaṇāḥ || 19 || vāyośca nirṛtervahnestathā candrārkayośca ye || grahāṇāmatha ṛkṣāṇāṃ skandasya ca mahābalāḥ || 2.176.20 || vināyakasya devasya devatānāṃ gaṇāśca ye || daityānāṃ rākṣasānāṃ ca sarveṣāmanugāśca ye || 21 || mahābalā mahākāyā mahāsattvā mahābratāḥ|| aṇimā mahimā prāptiḥ prākāmyena ca saṃyutāḥ||22|| īśitvena vaśitvena prāptināmnā tathodaye || yatra kāmāvasāyitvāttathā yeṣāṃ ca vidyate || 23 || evamaṣṭaguṇaiśvaryasaṃyutā bhīmavikramāḥ || nānāsattvaśirogrīvā nānāpraharaṇāyudhāḥ || 24 || nānāvirāgavasanā nānāsattvavapurdharāḥ || tathā nānāvidhāhārā mahāceṣṭā mahābalāḥ || 25 || bhaktānukampino vīrā varadāḥ kāmarūpiṇaḥ || pramathāḥ parigṛhṇantu upakāraṃ namo'stu vaḥ || saputrāmātyabhṛtyo'haṃ sadāraḥ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ || 26 || rakṣantu māṃ mahābhāgā gṛhe yuddhe tathādhvani || camūnāṃ pṛṣṭhato gatvā nāśayadhvaṃ tathā ripūn || 27 || svapne śubhāśubhaṃ vāpi kathayadhvaṃ samāhitāḥ || vinivṛttaśca dāsyāmi dattādabhyadhikaṃ balim || 28 || vinivṛttena dātavyaḥ sa ca yatnena bhūbhujā || pūrvavacca tathā rātrau svapnaprārthanamiṣyate || || 29 || ṣaṣṭhe'hani jayasnānaṃ kartavyaṃ ca tathā bhavet || vidhirasyābhiṣekārthaḥ sarva eva vidhīyate || 2.176.30 || tato yātrādine prāpte kṣaurakarma vivarjayet || mudraṇaṃ bhedanaṃ caiva tathā ca nakhakṛntanam || 31 || abhyaṅgaṃ gṛhakāryaṃ ca krodhaśokau ca kaṅkatam || yātavyaṃ yena tenātha taduktaṃ snānamācaret || 32 || snātaḥ śuklāmbaraḥ sragvī tathā śvetānulepanaḥ || citrābharaṇavānrājā dūrvāpallavalācchanaḥ || 33 || pūjayitvā mahābhāgaṃ devadevaṃ trivikramam || juhuyācca tathā vahnau susamiddhe purohitaḥ || 34 || āyuṣyamabhayaṃ caiva tathā svastyayanaṃ gaṇam || śarmavarmagaṇaṃ caiva tathā pratirathaṃ śubhama || 35 || śakunaṃ ca tathā sūktaṃ sūktaṃ vaiṣṇavameva ca || tathāgnilakṣaṇotpattau śubhe yāyānmahīpatiḥ || 36 || nakṣatrasya diśaścaiva naivedyaṃ yatprakīrtitam || tadeva nṛpatiḥ prāśya yātrāṃ vidyādyathāvidhi || 37 || ahṛdyaṃ makṣikākeśakīṭayuktaṃ vivarjayet || dagdhe ca varjayedyātrāṃ deyā bhavati cānyathā || 38 || tatastu rājaliṅgānāṃ cāyudhānāṃ tathaiva ca || nīrājanoktamantraistu sarvāṃstānabhimantrayet || 39 || daivavitprayato bhūtvā rājā vātha purohitaḥ || teṣāṃ saṃpūjanaṃ kṛtvā daivajñaṃ sapurohitam || 2.176.40 || dhanena pūjayedrājā dakṣiṇābhirdvijottamān || tataḥ puṇyāhaghoṣeṇa dvijānāṃ hatakalmaṣaḥ || 41 || maṅgalālambhanaṃ kṛtvā mantrametaṃ niśāmayan || ādityā vasavo rudrā viśvedevā marudgaṇāḥ || 42 || lokapālāḥ sagandharvā nadyaḥ śailā mahī dvijāḥ || agniḥ svāhā svadhā homaḥ skando brahmā prajāpatiḥ || 43 || muhūrtāstithayo bhāni vedāḥ sāyanavatsarāḥ || gāvaḥ sarasvatī devī dīrghamāyurdiśantu te ||44 || jagatsṛjo'tha yā siddhirbabhūva brahmaṇaḥ purā || jagajjiṣṇośca yā viṣṇoḥ siddhiryāsīttrivikrame || 45 || asuraiśvaryanāśe ca babhūva tryambakasya yā || siddhistridarśavṛddhyarthaṃ tripurāntakṛtaḥ purā || 46 || śakre vṛtravadhe yāvatskande devārisaṃkṣaye || tāṃ prāpnuhi sadā siddhiṃ sā ca yātrāstu te sadā || 47 || rakṣantu sarvataḥ sarve devāḥ śakrapurogamāḥ || iti coktvā śubhāṃ vācaṃ gṛhītvā saśaraṃ dhanuḥ || || 48 || dhanvanāgetimantreṇa daivajñasya karātsvayam || tadviṣṇoḥ paramityeva śṛṇvanmantramanuttamam || 49 || paiṣṭe ripumukhe dadyātprathamaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ padam || padadvātriṃśakaṃ gatvā viṣṇuprācyādiṣu tvatha || 2.176.50 || nāgaṃ rathaṃ hayaṃ caiva yuñjāne cāruhetkramāta || āruhya sumanā gacchedvādyaghoṣeṇa bhūriṇā || 51 || sa niṣkramya mahānīśo na pṛṣṭhamavalokayet || maṅgalāni tataḥ paśyanspṛñchṛṇvañśanairvrajet || 52 || krośamātraṃ tato gacchennādhikaṃ tu kadācana || gatvā deśe śubhe tiṣṭhetpūjayitvā suradvijān || 53 || tataḥ krameṇa gacchecca paradeśaṃ mahīpatiḥ || ātmasainyānurūpeṇa kṛtarakṣaḥ pathā dvija || 54 || trirātramuṣito gacchedbhūyo nakṣatrasampadā || yavasaindhavatoyānāṃ rakṣako viṣadūṣaṇāt || 55 || parānabhimukho gacchetprabhūtayavasaindhavaḥ || svairacaṃkramaṇaṃ śayyāṃ bhāṇḍaprakṣepaṇaṃ tathā || 56 || bhojana taṃ sukhaṃ kuryātpratilomaṃ na cācareta || rājāpyamitradeśe tu deśācāraṃ na laṃghayet || 57 || devatāpūjanaṃ kuyārnnocchiṃdyāddāvamatra tu || kulastriyaṃ ca tanvīṃ ca vṛddhāṃ naivāpamānayeta || 58 || kulīnamabhinindettu na vai nṛpativaṃśajam || na karṇanāsācchedāṃśca na tathā netrabhedanam || kālavinmantribhiṣajorvākyaṃ kuryānmahīpatiḥ || 59 || tataḥ kramātprāpya purīṃ svakīyāṃ baliṃ tu dadyādadhikāṃ puroktām || kuryānmahīṃ yūpasurālayāṃkāṃ svarlokamicchanpṛthivīṃ samagrām || 2.176.60 || iti śrīvipṇu0 dvi0 mā0 va0 sa0 yātrāvidhināma ṣaṭsaptatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 176 || <2.177> rāma uvāca || sāṃgrāmikamahaṃ tvattaḥ śrotumicchāmi bhūbhujaḥ || sarvaṃ vetsi mahābhāga tvaṃ deva parameṣṭhivat || 1 || puṣkara uvāca || dvitīye'hani saṃgrāmo bhaviṣyati yadā tadā || gajāśvānsnāpayedrājā sarvauṣadhijalaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 2 || gandhamālyairalaṃkuryātpūjayecca yathāvidhi || nṛsiṃhaṃ pūjayedviṣṇuṃ rājaliṅgānyaśeṣataḥ || 3 || chatraṃ dhvajaṃ patākāśca dharmāścaiva mahābhuja || āyudhāni ca sarvāṇi tathā pūjyāni bhūbhujā || 4 || teṣāṃ sampūjanaṃ kṛtvā rātrau pramathapūjanam || kṛtvā tu prārthayedrājā vijayāyetaro yathā || 5 || pramathāṃśca sahāyārthe dharaṇīṃ ca mahābhuja || bhiṣakpurohitāmātyamantrimadhye tathā svapet || 6 || saṃyato brahmacārī ca nṛsiṃhaṃ saṃsmaranharim|| rātrau dṛṣṭe śubhe svapne samarārambhamācaret || 7 || rātriśeṣe samutthāya snātaḥ sarvauṣadhī jalaiḥ || pūjayitvā nṛsiṃhaṃ tu vāhanāḍhyamaśeṣataḥ || 8 || purodhasā hutaṃ paśyejjvalitaṃ jātavedasam || purodhāḥ pūrvavattatra mantrāṃstu juhuyāttataḥ ||9 || dakṣiṇābhiḥ śucirviprānpūjayetpṛthivīpatiḥ || tatonulimpedgātrāṇi gandhadvāreti pārthivaḥ || 2.177.10|| candanāgurukarpūrakāntākālīyakaiḥ śubhaiḥ || mūrtiṃ kaṇṭhe samālabhya rocanāṃ ca tathā śubhām||11|| āyuṣyaṃ varcasaṃ caiva mantreṇānena mantritamam|| alaṅkaraṇamābaddhyācchriyaṃ dhāturiti srajam || 12|| yā oṣadhaya ityevaṃ dhārayedoṣadhīḥ śubhāḥ || navo naveti vastraṃ ca kārpāsaṃ bibhṛyācchubham ||13|| aindrāgneti tato carma dhanvanāgeti vai dhanuḥ|| tato rājñaḥ samādadyātsaśarantvabhimantritam||14|| kuñjaraṃ vā rathaṃ cāśvamāruhedabhimantritam|| āruhya śibirādrājā niṣkramya samaye śubhe||15|| deśe tvadṛśyaḥ śatrūṇāṃ kuryātprakṛtikalpanām || saṃhatānyodhayedalpā kāmaṃ vistārayedbahūn ||16|| sūcīmukhamanīkaṃ syādalpānāṃ bahubhiḥ saha || vyūhāḥ prāṇyaṅgarūpāśca dravyarūpāśca kalpitāḥ||17|| gāruḍo makaravyūhaścakraṃ śyenastathaiva ca|| ardhacandraśca candraśca śakaṭavyūha eva ca||18|| vyūhaśca sarvatobhadraḥ sūcīvyūhastathaiva ca || padmaśca maṇḍalavyūhaḥ prādhānyena prakīrtitāḥ||19|| vyūhānāmatha sarveṣāṃ pañcadhā sainyakalpanā || dvau pakṣau bandhapakṣau dvāvaurasyaḥ pañcamo bhavet||2.177.20|| anena yadi vā dvābhyāṃ bhāgābhyāṃ yuddhamācaret|| bhāgatrayaṃ sthāpayettu teṣāṃ rakṣārthameva ca||21|| na vyūhe kalpanā kāryā rājño bhavati karhicit || patracchede phalacchede vṛkṣacchedāvakalpane||22|| punaḥ prarohamāyāti mūlacchede vinaśyati || svayaṃ rājñā na yoddhavyamapi sarvāstraśālinā||23|| nityaṃ loke hi dṛśyante śaktebhyaḥ śaktimāttarāḥ || sainyasya paścāttiṣṭhettu krośamātre mahīpatiḥ||24|| bhagnasandhāraṇaṃ tatra yodhānāṃ parikīrtitam || pradhānabhaṅge sainyasya nāvasthānaṃ vidhīyate || 25 || na bhagnānpīḍayecchatrūnekāyanagatā hi te || maraṇe niścitāḥ sarve hanyuḥ śatrūṃścamūrapi || 26 || śaṭābhaṅgacchalenāpi nayati svabhuvaṃ parām || teṣāṃ svabhūmisaṃsthānāṃ vadhaḥ syātsukarastadā || 27 || na saṃhatārtaviralānyodhānvyūhe prakalpayet || āyudhānāṃ tu saṃmardo yathā na syātparasparam || 28 || tathā tu kalpanā kāryā yodhānāṃ bhṛgunandana || bhettukāmaḥ parānīkaṃ saṃhataireva bhedayet||29|| bhedarakṣāpareṇāpi kartavyā saṃhatā tathā || svecchayā kalpayedvyūhaṃ jñātvā vā ripukalpitam||2.177.30|| vyūhe bhedāvahaṃ kuryādripuvyūhasya pārthivaḥ || gajasya deyā rakṣārthaṃ catvārastu rathā dvija||31|| rathasya cāśvāścatvāro'śvasya tasya ca varmiṇaḥ || varmibhiśca samāstatra dhanvinaḥ parikīrtitāḥ||32|| purastāccarmiṇo deyā deyāstadanu dhanvinaḥ || dhanvināmanu cāśvīyaṃ rathāṃstadanu yojayet ||33|| rathānāṃ kuñjarāścānu dātavyāḥ pṛthivīkṣitā || padātikuñjarāśvānāṃ varma kāryaṃ prayatnataḥ ||34|| avarmayitvā yo vāhaṃ cātmānaṃ varmayennaraḥ || sa rāma narakaṃ yāti svakṛtenāpi karmaṇā || 35 || śūrāḥ pramukhato deyā na deyā bhīravaḥ kvacit || śūrānvā mukhato dattvā skandamātrapradarśanam || 36|| kartavyaṃ bhīrusaṃghena śatruvidrāvakārakam || dārayanti purastāttu vidrutā bhīravaḥ puraḥ || 37 || protsārayante varuṇī bhīrūñśūrānpunaḥ sthitāḥ || prāṃśavaḥ śukanāsāśca ye ca jihvekṣaṇā narāḥ || 38 || saṃhatabhrūyugāścaiva krodhanāḥ kalahapriyāḥ || nityaṃ hṛṣṭāśca hrasvāśca śūrā jñeyāśca kāminaḥ || 39 || dākṣiṇātyāśca vijñeyāḥ kuśalāḥ khaḍgavarmiṇaḥ || vaṅkalā dhānvino jñeyāḥ pārvatīyāstathaiva ca || 2.177.40 || pāṣāṇayuddhakuśalāstathā parvatavāsinaḥ || pāṃcālāḥ śūrasenāśca ratheṣu kuśalā narāḥ || 41|| kāmbojā ye ca gāṃdhārāḥ kuśalāste hayeṣu ca || prāyaśaśca tathā mlecchā vijñeyāḥ pāśayodhinaḥ || 42 || aṅgā vaṅgā kaliṅgāśca jñeyā mātaṅgayodhinaḥ || āhatānāṃ hatānāṃ ca raṇāpanayanakriyā || 43 || pattiyodhagajānāñca toyadānādikaṃ ca yat || āyudhānayanaṃ caiva pattikarma vidhīyate || || 44 || ripūṇāṃ bhedakāmānāṃ svasainyasya tu rakṣaṇam || bhedanaṃ saṃhatānāṃ ca karmaṇāṃ carma kīrtitam || 45 || vimukhīkaraṇaṃ yuddhe dhanvināṃ ca tathocyate || carmibhiḥ kriyate śūrairbhinnānāmapi saṃhatiḥ || 46 || śūrāpasaraṇaṃ yāvatsāśvīyasya tathocyate || trāsane ripusainyānāṃ rathakarma tathocyate || 47 || prākāragomukhāṭṭāladrumabhaṃgāśca bhārgava || gajānāṃ karma nirdiṣṭaṃ yadasahyaṃ tathā paraiḥ || 48|| pattibhūviṣamājeyā rathāśvasya tathā samā|| śarmādrumā ca nāgānāṃ yuddhabhūmirudāhṛtā || 49 || evaṃ viracitavyūhaḥ kṛtapṛṣṭhadivākaraḥ || tathānulomaśukro vā dikpālabudhamārutāḥ || 2.177.50 || yodhānuttejayetsarvānrāmagotrāpadānanaḥ || bhogaprāptiśca vijaye svargaprāptirmṛtasya ca || 51 || dhanyāni tu nimittāni vadanti vijayaṃ dvija || spandanaṃ śubhagātrāṇāṃ śubhasvapnanidarśanam || 52 || nimittaṃ ca gajāśvasya sarvato dṛśyate śubham || śakunā maṅgalāścaiva dṛśyante hi mano'nugā|| || 53 || viparītasarīsarpānmṛtyuḥ spṛśati nānyathā || bhavanto'pi kule jātāḥ sarvaśastrāstrapāragāḥ || 54 || gāndharve ca parā nityaṃ nityaṃ sanmārgamāśritāḥ || anāhāryāḥ parairnityaṃ kathaṃ na syājjayo mama || 55 || rājaśrīrbhavatāmeva bhavadbhiḥ kevalaṃ mama || dve cāmare'dhike śūrācchatraṃ carmābhameva ca || 56 || jitvarīnbhogasaṃprāptirmṛtasya ca parā gatiḥ || niṣkṛtiḥ svāmipiṇḍasya nāsti yuddhasamā gatiḥ || 57 || śūrāṇāṃ yadviniryāti raktamābādhataḥ kvacit || tenaiva saha pāpmānaṃ sarva tyajati dhārmika || 58 || tathā bādhacikitsāyāṃ vedanāsahite tathā || tato nāstyadhikaṃ loke kiñcitparamadāruṇam || 59 || mṛtasya nāgnisaṃskāro nāśaucannodakakriyā || kartumicchati yasyeha saṃgrāmādadhikaṃ nu kim || 2.177.60 || tapasvino dānaparā yajvāno bahudakṣiṇāḥ || śūrāṇāṃ gatimicchanti dṛṣṭvā bhogānanuttamān ||61 || varāpsaraḥsahasrāṇi śūramāyodhane hatam || abhidravanti kāmārtā mama bhartā bhaviṣyati || 62 || svāmī sukṛtamādatte bhagnānāṃ vinivartatām || brahmahatyāphalaṃ teṣāṃ tathā proktaṃ padepade || 63 || yaḥ sahāyānparityajya svastimāngantumicchati || asvasti tasya kurvanti devāḥ śakrapurogamāḥ || 64 || aśvamedhaphalaṃ proktaṃ bhagnānāmanivartatām || padepade mahābhāgā saṃmukhānāṃ mahātmanām || 65 || devastriyastathā lakṣmīḥ pāpmānamayaśastathā || pratīkṣante mahābhāga saṃgrāme samupasthite || 66 || parāṅmukhā mayā grāhyā jīvantopyabhavā mṛtāḥ || ityevamayaśastasya pāpmanā saha tiṣṭhati || 67 || lakṣmīḥ santiṣṭhate tasya jīvataḥ kṛtakarmaṇaḥ || 68 || mṛtasya cāpi tiṣṭhanti vimānasthā surastriyaḥ || evamudghoṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā dharmeṇecchejjayaṃ raṇe || 69 || adharmavijayo rājño nṛpaloke bhayāvahaḥ || adharmavijayādarthairyacchidramupadhīyate || 2.177.70 || chidrādeva paraṃ chidraṃ tasya syānnātra saṃśayaḥ || na karṇī na tathā digdhaḥ śaraḥ syāddharmayodhinām || 71 || nāsthiśalyaḥ śaraḥ kāryo dāruśalyaśca bhārgava || samaḥ samena yoddhavyo nāpacāro raṇe dvija || 72 || sannaddhena ca sannaddhaḥ sāśvaścāśvagatena tu || rathī ca rathinā rāma padātiśca padātinā || 73 || kuñjarastho gajasthena yoddhavyo bhṛgunandana || vimukho bhagnaśastraśca strībālaparirakṣitā || 74 || vyāyudho bhagnagātraśca tathaiva śaraṇāgataḥ || pareṇa yuddhyamānaśca yuddhaprekṣaka eva ca || 75 || ārtastoyapradātā ca daṇḍapāṇistathaiva ca || ete raṇe na hantavyā kṣatradharmamabhīpsatā || 76 || pāpiṣṭho kūṭayuddhe ca kartavyamapi cāhave || śrāntena vābhibhūtena ardhottīrṇabalena ca || 77 || durdine na ca yuddhāni kartavyāni mahābala || 78 || pravṛtte samare rāma pareṣāṃ nāmakāraṇāt || bāhū pragṛhya vikrośedbhagnā bhagnāḥ pare tviti || prāptaṃ mitrabalaṃ bhūri nāyako'tra nipātitaḥ || 79 || senānīrnihataścāyaṃ sarvā senāpi vidrutā || evaṃ citrāsanaṃ kuryātpareṣāṃ bhṛgunandana || 2.177.80 || vidrutānāṃ tu yodhānāṃ suvighāto vidhīyate || dhanurvedavidhānena kalpanā ca tathā bhavet || 81 || pāpāśca deyā dharmajña tathaiva paramohanāḥ || patākābhyucchrayaḥ kāryaḥ svabale ca tathā śubhaḥ || 82 || saṃskāraścaiva kartavyo vāditrāṇāṃ bhayāvahaḥ || etasya varṣaṃ vakṣyāmi tavopaniṣadi dvija || 83 || saṃprāpya vijayaṃ yuddhe kāryaṃ daivatapūjanam || pūjayedbrāhmaṇāṃścātra gurūnapi ca pūjayet || 84 || ratnāni rājagāmīni carma vāhanamāyudham || sarvamanyadbhavettasya yadyenaiva raṇe hṛtam || 85 || kulastriyastu vijñeyāstathā rāma na kasyacit || svadeśe paradeśe vā sādhvīṃ yatnānna dūṣayet || 86 || anyathā saṃkaro ghoro bhavatīha kṣayāvahaḥ || śakraḥ prāpya raṇe muktaḥ putrastasya prakīrtitaḥ || 87 || purastenāsya yoddhavyaṃ tasya dharmaṃ vijānatā || deśedeśe ya ācāraḥ pāramparyakramāgataḥ || 88 || sa eva paripālyaḥ syātprāpya deśaṃ mahīkṣitā || nṛṇāṃ pradarśayedrājā samare'pi hate ripau || 89 || na me priyaṃ kṛtaṃ tena yenāyaṃ samare hataḥ || kintu pūjā karomyasya svacchandamavijānataḥ || 2.177.90 || hato'yaṃ maddhitārthāya priyaṃ yadyapi no mama || aputrāśca striyaścaiva nṛpatiḥ paripālayet || 91 || tatastu svapuraṃ prāpya nṛpatiḥ praviśedgṛham || yātrāvidhānavihitaṃ bhūyo daivatapūjanam || 92 || pitṝṇāṃ pūjanaṃ caiva tathā kuryādviśeṣavat || saṃvibhāgaṃ parāvāpteḥ kuryādbhṛtyajanasya tu || 93 || avāpya dharmeṇa nṛpastu pṛthvīmārāmayūpādisurālayāṅkām || kṛtvā tathānyāṃ dvijasācca śaktyā lokaṃ jayaṃtyasya narādhipasya || 94 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0 va0 saṃ0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne śatrupratyabhigamano nāma saptasaptatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 177 || <2.178> rāma uvāca || dhanurvedaṃ samācakṣva saṃkṣepātsuranandana || sarvaṃ tvameva jānāsi yathā devaḥ pitāmahaḥ || || 1 || puṣkara uvāca || catuṣpādo dhanurvedastathā pañcavidho dvija || rathanāgāśvapattīnāṃ pādānāśritya kīrtitaḥ || 2 || yantramuktaṃ prāṇimuktaṃ muktasandhāritaṃ tathā || amuktaṃ bāhuyuddhaṃ ca pañcadhā tatprakīrtitam || 3 || tacca śastrāstrasaṃpattyā dvividhaṃ parikīrtitam || daṇḍamāyāvibhedena bhūyo dvividhamucyate || ṛjumāyāvibhedena bhūyo dvividhamucyate || 4 || kṣepaṇīcāpayantrādyaṃ yantramuktaṃ prakīrtitam || 5 || śilātomaracakrādyaṃ pāṇimuktaṃ tathaiva ca || muktasandhāritaṃ jñeyaṃ pāśādyamapi yadbhavet || 6 || khaḍgādikamanuktaṃ ca tathā jñeyaṃ mahābhuja || niyuddhaṃ vyāyudhaṃ jñeyaṃ pāṇipraharaṇādikam || 7 || tatrādāveva yogyatvaṃ gātrāṇāṃ tu vidhīyate || tathā vyāyāmacāritvaṃ bhārakarṣaṇameva ca || 8 || jitaśramo hi yuddheṣu karmayogyatvamāpnuyāt || rathāśvagajapṛṣṭheṣu tāni śastrāṇi cābhyaset|||| tāni vai khaḍgamukhyāni bāhupratyavarāṇi ca|| dhanurvede gururvipraḥ prokto varṇadvayasya ca||2.178.10|| vaiśyasya gurutāṃ kuryānna vā kuryāttathā dvijam || dhanurvede na gurutāṃ śūdraḥ kuryātkadācana || 11 || svayameva tu śūdraṃ ca kartavyā karmayogyatā || tasmāyuddhādhikārosti śūdrasyāpi viśāṃpate || 12 || saṅgarāṇāmapi tathā hitaḥ syātsa svayaṃ prabhoḥ || sarvaratnairmahārāja rājā rakṣyaḥ prayatnataḥ || 13 || śraddhāvato bhaktimataḥ suśīlānnamrānvinītānkṣamayopapannān || snigdhānnareśānsudṛḍhānmanojñānadhyāpanīyāṃstu vadanti santaḥ || 14 || iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde dhanurvedavarṇano nāmāṣṭasaptatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 178 || <2.179> || puṣkara uvāca || pāṇipādatale pṛṣṭhaṃ sarve syuḥ saṃhitā yadi || dṛṣṭaṃ sāmapadaṃ sthānametallakṣaṇatastadhā || 1 || bāhyāṃguliḥ sphicau pādau stabdhajānubalāvubhau || trivitastyantarāyāmamevaṃ vaiśākhamucyate || 2 || maṇḍalākārapādābhyāmudyate yatra jānunī || caturvidhaṃ trivicchinnaṃ tadevaṃ maṇḍalaṃ smṛtam ||3|| phalākṛtisamaṃ yacca stabdhajānūrudakṣiṇam|| vitastipañcavistārantadālīḍhaṃ prakīrtitam||4|| namitā pūrvajaṅghā ca sadālīḍhavidhīyate|| tiryaggato bhavedvāmo dakṣiṇo'pi bhavedṛjuḥ || 5|| gulphau pārṇisthitāveva sthirau pañcāṅgulāntarau || sthānajātaṃ bhavedetaddvādaśāṅgulamāyatam || 6 || etadeva viparyastaṃ pratyākhyātaṃ prakīrtitam || kubjajānurbhavedvāmo dakṣiṇastu prasāritaḥ ||7|| atha vā dakṣiṇaṃ jānuṃ kubjaṃ bhavati niścalam || bhaveddaṇḍāyato vāmaścaraṇaḥ saha jānunā || 8 || evaṃ vikacchamuddiṣṭaṃ dvihastāntaramāyatam || jānunī dviguṇau syātāṃ hyuttānau caraṇāvapi || 9 || anena viniyogena sampuṭaṃ parikīrtitam || kiñcidvivartitau pādau samadaṇḍāyatau sthirau || 2.179.10 || dṛṣṭimeva yathānyāyaṃ ṣoḍaśāṅgulamāyatam || svastikenātra kurvīta praṇāmaṃ prathamaṃ dvijaḥ || 11 || kārmukaṃ bhṛguvāmena vāmaṃ dakṣiṇakena vā || vaiśākhepyatha vā jāte sthito vā pyatha vāyate || 12 || guṇāgraṃ tu tataḥ kṛtvā kārmuke priyakārmukaḥ|| adhaḥkoṭiṃ tu dhanuṣaḥ phaladeśe ca patriṇaḥ ||13|| dharaṇyāṃ sthāpayitvā tu lālayitvā tathaiva ca|| bhujābhyāmatra kubjābhyāṃ prakoṣṭhābhyāmariṃdama||14|| nyasya bāṇaṃ dhanuḥśreṣṭhaṃ puṅkhadeśe ca patriṇaḥ || vinyāso dhanuṣaścaiva dvādaśāṅgulamantaraḥ||15|| tayorbhārgava kartavyo nāto hīno na cādhikaḥ || niveśya kārmukaṃ kaṇṭhe nitambe śarasaṅkaram||16| utkṣipedasthiraṃhastamantareṇākṣikarṇayoḥ || pūrveṇa muṣṭinā grāhyaḥ stanāgraṃ dakṣiṇaḥ śaraḥ || 17 || haraṇaṃ tu tataḥ kṛtvā śīghraṃ pūrvāṃ prasārayet|| nātyantarā naiva bāhyā nordhvagā nādharāstathā || 18 || na ca kubjā na cottānā na calā nātiveṣṭitāḥ || samāḥ sthairyaguṇopetāḥ pūrve daṇḍamiva sthitāḥ || 19 || chādayitvā tato lakṣyaṃ pūrveṇānena muṣṭinā || tarasā tūtthito yatnāttrikoṇavinatisthitaḥ ||2.179.20|| srastāṃso niścalagrīvo mayūrāṃcitamastakaḥ || lalāṭanāsāvaktrāṃsaḥ kūrparaśca samaṃ bhavet || 21 || antaraṃ tvaṅgulaṃ jñeyaṃ cibukasyāṃsakasya ca || prathame tryaṅgule vindyāddvitīye dvyaṅgulaṃ smṛtam || 22|| tṛtīye'ṅgulamuddiṣṭaṃ cāyataṃ cibukāṃsayoḥ || gṛhītvā sāyakaṃ tatra tarjanyaṅguṣṭhameva ca || 23 || anāmayā tato gṛhya punarmadhyamayāpi ca || tāvadākarṣayedyogādyāvadbāṇaḥ supūritaḥ || 24 ||| evaṃvidhamupakramya moktavyo vidhivatkhagaḥ || dṛṣṭimuṣṭihataṃ lakṣyaṃ bhindyādbāṇena bhārgava||25|| muktvā cāpaṃ vāmahastaṃ kṣipedvegena pṛcchataḥ || etaducchedamicchanti jñātavyaṃ hi tvayā dvija || 26 || kūrparaṃ trividhaṃ kāryamākṛṣṭantu dhanuṣmatā || tatrāpi muktake kāryamakṣaśliṣṭastu madhyamam || 27 || jyeṣṭhaṃ prakṛṣṭaṃ vijñeyaṃ dhanuḥśāstraviśāradāḥ || jyeṣṭhastu pāvako jñeyo bhaveddvādaśamuṣṭayaḥ || 28 || ekādaśa tathā sādhyaḥ kanīyāndaśamuṣṭayaḥ || caturhastaṃ dhanuḥśreṣṭhaṃ prayogaṃ cāsya madhyamam || 29 || kanīyasaṃ trayaḥ proktaṃ nityameva padātinā || aśve rathe gaje jyeṣṭhaṃ tadeva parikīrtitam || 2.179.30 || tadeva hīnaṃ khalu madhyamaṃ syāttadeva hīnaṃ ca tathā kanīyaḥ || pūrṇāyudhasyaiṣa vidhirmayā te proktaḥ samāsād bhṛguvaṃśamukhya ||31|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mā0 vajra saṃ0 rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne dhanurvedo nāmaikonāśītyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||179|| <2.180> puṣkara uvāca || pūrṇāyudho bhṛtiṃ kṛtvā tato māṃsairgatāyuṣām || varāhamṛgameṣāṇāṃ māhiṣādyaistathā dvija || 1 || munidhautaṃ tataḥ kuryādyugyaṃ bhūpairvidhānavit || mṛdusaṃstaraṇopetaṃ mṛdu valgu ca yojayet || 2 || tato vāhaṃ samāruhya daṃśitaḥ susamāhitaḥ || tūrṇamāruhya badhnīyāddṛḍhāṃ kakṣāṃ ca dakṣiṇām ||3|| vaikakṣyamapi taccāpaṃ dhārayedyantrasaṃsthitam || tato samuddharedbāṇaṃ ṛṇāddakṣiṇapāṇinā || 4 || tajjavaḥ sahitaṃ sarvaṃ madhye saṃgṛhya dhārayet || vāmahastena vai kakṣyāddhanustasmātsamuddharet || 5 || suniṣaṇṇamaṇirbhūtvā guṇe puṅkhaṃ niveśayet || saṃpīḍya siṃhakarṇena puṃkhenāpi same dṛḍham || 6 || vāmakarṇoparisthaṃ ca phalaṃ vyāmasya dhāraṇāt || balāmadhyamayā tatra vāmāṃgulyā ca dhārayet | 7 || manolakṣyagataṃ kṛtvā dṛṣṭiṃ ca suvidhānavit || dakṣiṇe gātrabhāge tu balāmāśu vimokṣayet || 8 || lalāṭapuṭasaṃsthānaṃ dāṇīṃ lakṣye niveśayet || 9 || ākṛṣya tāḍayettatra daṇḍakaṃ ṣoḍaśāṃgulam || muktvā bāṇaṃ tataḥ paścādbalāṃ śikṣettadātadā || 2.180.10 || vigṛhṇīyānmadhyamayā tatoṃgulyā punaḥpunaḥ || abhilakṣyākṣipettūṇāṃścaturasraṃ ca dakṣiṇam || 11 || caturasragataṃ vaidhyamabhyasedāditaḥ sthitaḥ || tasmādanantaraṃ tīkṣṇaṃ parāvṛttagataṃ ca yat || 12 || niśramunnatavedyantamabhyasettuṣyakaṃ tataḥ || vedhyasthāneṣvathaiteṣu sanyastapuṭakaṃ dhanuḥ || 13 || hastāvāpagataiḥ srastairjapeddhastakarairapi || tasminvedhyagate rāma dve vedhye dṛḍhasaṃjñite || 14 || dve vedhye puṣkare viddhi dve tathā citrapuṣkare || caturasraṃ ca tīkṣṇaṃ ca dṛḍhavedhye prakīrtite || 15 || caturasraṃ sthūlatīkṣṇaṃ...... || nimnaṃ puṣkaramuddiṣṭaṃ vedhyamūdūrdhvagataṃ ca yat || 16 || puṣkare'dhamavedhye tu citrapuṣkarasaṃjñake || evaṃ vedhyagaṇaṃ kṛtvā dakṣiṇenetareṇa ca || 17 || ārohetprathamaṃ dhīro jitalakṣyastato naraḥ || eṣa eva vidhiḥ proktastatra dṛṣṭaḥ prayoktṛbhiḥ || 18 || ādikaṃ bhramaṇaṃ tasya tasmādvidvanprakīrtitam || lakṣyaṃ saṃyojayettatra pratiyantragataṃ dṛḍham || 19 || bhrāntaṃ pracalitaṃ caiva sthitaṃ yacca bhavediti || samantācchādayetpaścācchedayecchlathayedapi || 2.180.20 || karmayogavidhānajño jñātvaivaṃ vidhimācaret || manasā cakṣuṣā dṛṣṭyā yogaṃ śikṣannyasaṃjayet || 21 || dattvā prayuktaṃ sukṛtaṃ pramāṇānnyasetsamantātpuṭakānvicitrān || apyaṅgulīyapratimāṃ japecca vālaṅgatāḥ kāṣṭhagataṃ pralambam || 22 || siddhārthakānguñjayavāṃśca tasminnyasedvidhijño bhramarīrikāñca || mṛtpiṇḍasaṃsthānphalakāṃkṣitāṃśca kabandhaniṣpāvakapelavāśca || 23 || haṃsānmayūrānkurarāṃstathā ca kāraṇḍavāṃścaiva śilīmukhāṃśca || gṛdhrānulūkānatha vāpi cāṣānkapotagodhāśukasārikāśca || 24 || palāśamūlorṇavapūrṇa dehāṃścarmāvabaddhāṃ mṛducitragātrām || vastrayantrairvividhaiḥ suyuktāṃ kāṣṭhāvasaktairbahubhiḥ prakāraiḥ || 25 || calānsthirāṃścāpragatāṃśca viddhānnyasedyathānyāyamathordhvasaṃsthān || vyāghrānmṛgendrānpṛṣatānrurūṃśca mṛgānsagokarṇavarāhavaktrān || 26 || gomāyumārjāraśaśāṃstathānyānṛkṣānmṛgāścandramayendupūrṇān || anyānsamīpopagatānmṛgāṃśca vidhānavittānpratiyantrasaṃsthān || 27 || jātāṃstathānyāṃśca bahuprakārānanekasaṃsthānavibaddhadehān || nānāvidhaistairviśikhabhramasthaḥ sandhānayogaistrividhaśca hanyāt||28|| iti śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeya vajrasaṃvāde rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne dhanurvedo nāmāśītyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||180|| <2.181> puṣkara uvāca || jitahasto jitamatirjitadṛglakṣyasādhaka || niyatāṃ siddhimāsādya tato vāhanamāruhet || 1 || eṣa tatraiva ca vidhiḥ kārtsyena parikīrtitaḥ || adhikaṃ bhramatastasya bhāge grahaṇameva ca || 2 || eteṣāṃ caiva yogānāṃ vidhiryastryaiṣukasya ca || vāhāśritasya vakṣyāmi saviśeṣeṇa lakṣaṇam || 3 || pāśāsiyaṣṭidaṇḍānāṃ vidhiryaḥ pariniṣṭhitaḥ || kṣepa eva yathānyāyaṃ tasya vakṣyāmi yā kriyā || 4 || daśahasto bhavetpāśo vṛtaḥ karamukhastathā || śaṇakārpāsapuñjānāṃ bhagna snāyvasthicarmaṇām || 5 || anyeṣāṃ sudṛḍhānāṃ ca sukṛtaṃ pariveṣṭitam || trayastriṃśatsamaṃ cāpaṃ budhaḥ kuryātsuvartitam || 6 || kartavyā śibikaistasya sthānaṃ kakṣyāsu vai tadā || vāmahastena saṃgṛhya dakṣiṇenoddharettu saḥ || 7 || kuṇḍalasyākṛtiṃ kṛtvā grāmaikaṃ mastakopari || kṣipettṛṇamaye tūrṇaṃ puruṣe carmaveṣṭite || 8 || calite ca plutaṃ caiva tathā prajaviteṣu ca || samāyogavidhiṃ jñātvā prayuñjīta suśikṣitaḥ || 9|| vijitya tu yathānyāyaṃ tato bandhaṃ samācaret || kaṭyāṃ baddhvā tataḥ khaḍgaṃ vāmapārśvāvalambinam || 2.181.10 || dṛḍhaṃ vigṛhya vāmena vikarme dakṣiṇena tu || ṣaḍaṅgulaparīṇāhaṃ samahastaṃ samucchritam || 11 || ayomayaśalākāśca carmāṇi vividhāni ca || apahastaṃ samaṃ caiva tiryagūrddhvahataṃ tathā || 12 || śodhayedvidhinā yena tathā me gadataḥ śṛṇu || tārṇaṃ carmāvanaddhāṅgaṃ sthāpayitvā naraṃ dṛḍham || 13 || kareṇādāya laguḍaṃ dakṣiṇāṅguṣṭhakānnaraḥ || udyamya ghātayedyasya nāmnastaṃ śiraso dṛḍham || ubhābhyāmapi hastābhyāṃ kuryāttasya nipātanam || 14|| bimboyaṃ vidhi sahito hitaḥ sumuktiḥ śiṣyāṇāṃ hitamatikurvatā mayā te || vāhānāṃ śramaraṇapradhāraṇārthaṃ yogyārhaṃ prathamataraṃ budhena vadhyam || 15 || iti śrīviṣṇudhamottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne dhanurvedavidyākathano nāmaikāśītyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 181 || <2.182> puṣkara uvāca || bhrāntamudbhrāntamāviddhamāplutaṃ niḥsṛtaṃ sṛtam || saṃpātaṃ samudīrṇaṃ ca senāpātamanākulam || 1 || udghātamavadhṛtaṃ ca savyadakṣiṇameva ca || anālakṣiravisphoṭo karālendramahāmukhau || 2 || vikarālavipātau ca vibhīṣaṇabhayaṅkarau || samagrāṃ vā tṛtīyāṃ vā pādapādāvajārijāḥ || 3 || pratyālīḍhamanālīḍhaṃ varāhalulitaṃ tathā || iti dvātriṃśadhā jñeyā khaḍgāścarmavidhāraṇāḥ || 4 || ṛjvāyataviśālaṃ ca tiryaṅnamitameva ca || pañcakarma vinirdiṣṭaṃ vyastre prāsaṃ mahātmabhiḥ || 5 || chedanaṃ tarjanaṃ pāto bhramaṇaṃ bhrāmaṇaṃ tathā || vikartanaṃ kartanaṃ ca cakrabhramaṇameva ca || 6|| āsphoṭakṣveḍanaṃ bhedastrāsollāsitakau tathā || śūlakarmāṇi jānīhi ṣaṣṭhamāghrātasaṃjñakam || 7 || dṛṣṭighātaṃ bhujāghātaṃ pārśvaghātaṃ ca bhārgava || ṛjvāvakṣopamāghātaṃ tomarasya prakīrtitam || 8 || saṃhatāvitataṃ vāmaṃ gomūtraṃ kamalāvilam || tato'rdhabhāganamitaṃ vāmadakṣiṇameva ca || 9 || vyāvṛttaṃ ca parāvṛttaṃ pādoddhūtamaviplutam || haṃsamārgavimārge ca gadākarma prakīrtitam || 2.182.10 || karālamaṭhapātaṃ ca daśopaplavameva ca || kṣiptaṃ hastasthitaṃ śūnyaṃ paraśostu vinirdiśet || 11 || tāḍanaṃ chedanaṃ rāma tathā cūrṇanameva ca || mudgarasya tu karmāṇi laguḍasya ca tānyapi || 12 || antyamadhyaṃ parāvṛttaṃ nideśārddhaṃ tathaiva ca || vajrasyaitāni karmāṇi paṭṭiśasya tathaiva hi || 13 || haraṇaṃ chedanaṃ ghāto bhedanaṃ rakṣaṇaṃ tathā || kṛpāṇīkarma nirdiṣṭaṃ pātanaṃ sphoṭanaṃ tathā || 14 || trāsanaṃ rakṣaṇaṃ ghātaṃ taloddharaṇamāyatam || kṣepaṇīkarma nirdiṣṭaṃ yantrakarmaitadeva tu || 15 || santyāgamaṅgamardañca varāhoddhūtakaṃ tathā || hastārdhahastapālīnamekahastārdhahastakam||16|| dvihastabāhupāśe ca koṭirecitakoddhate || uro lalāṭaghāte ca bhujādivasanaṃ tathā || 17 || karoddhatavimārgaṃ ca pādāhati vipādakam || gātrasaṃśleṣaṇaṃ kāntaṃ tathā govidhiparyayam || 18 || ūrdhvaprahāraṃ ghātaṃ ca gomūtraṃ savyadakṣiṇam || pādasañcārakaṃ gaṇḍaṃ kabarībandhabhākulam || 19 || tiryaggatamapāmārgaṃ bhīmavegaṃ sudarśanam || siṃhakrāntaṃ gajakrātaṃ vṛṣabhākrāntameva va || 2.182.20 || gadākarma vijānīyāddhanurvedaviśāradaḥ || ākarṣaṇaṃ vikarṣaṃ ca bāhunāmanameva ca || 21 || grīvāviparivartaṃ ca pṛṣṭhabhaṅgaṃ sudāruṇam || parṇāsanaṃ viparyāsaḥ paśupāramajāvikam || 22 || pādaprahāramāsphoṭaṃ kavirecitakaṃ tathā || gātraśleṣaṃ kaṇṭhagataṃ mahītyājanameva ca || 23 || urolalāṭaghātaṃ ca vispaṣṭakaraṇaṃ tathā || uddhūtamavadhūtaṃ ca tiryagmārgagataṃ tathā ||24|| gajaskandhamavakṣepamavāṅmukhakameva ca || devamārgamadhomārgamamārgagamanākulama||25|| muṣṭivātamavakṣepo vasudhādāraṇaṃ tathā || jānubandhaṃ bhujābandhaṃ ūrubandhaṃ sudāruṇam || 26 || saṃsṛṣṭaṃ sodaraṃ śubhraṃ bhujāvellitameva ca || niyuddhakarma jānīyānniyuddhakuśalo janaḥ || 27 || pradhānakarmāṇi taveritāni nyastapradhāne puruṣapravīra || nāmāni rūpāṇi bhavanti tāni jñeyāni sarvāṇi yathānurūpam |||28 || iti śrīvirpṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne dhanurvedavidyāvarṇano nāma dvyaśītyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 182 || <2.183> || puṣkara uvāca || sannaddhaiścarmibhirbhāvyaṃ tathā baddhakṛpāṇibhiḥ || carmāṇi tatra vaiyāghramāhiṣāṇyṛṣabhāṇi ca || 1 || kheṭakādyatha vā rāma carmāṇi prabhavanti tu || tathā varaṇamukhyāni khaḍgāni vividhāni ca || 2 || baddhādibhiḥ satūṇīraistathā rāma satomaraiḥ || baddhagodhāṅgulitrāṇairbaddhādarśairvibhīṣaṇaiḥ || 3 || tathā paraśvadhopetai rāma svāsanayodhibhiḥ || 4 || gadādharāstathaivātra sakṛtpāṇiparicchadāḥ || susaṃnaddhā sumanaso bhaveyurvipulaujasaḥ || 5 || yatra yasya viśeṣeṇa śastrāstrairvātakauśalam || tadeva tasya nirdiṣṭaṃ yathāvanmanujottama || 6 || sakhalīnāḥ saparyāṇāstathā sāstaraṇā hayāḥ || kāryāḥ sakavacā yuddhe cāmarāpīḍadhāriṇaḥ || 7 || aśvī bhavetsusannaddho raśmipragrahakovidaḥ || tathā sāvaraṇo rāma sakṛpāṇī paricchadaḥ || 8 || baddhāsirbaddhajīvaśca turagārūḍhapiṇḍakaḥ || sasuprāso bhavedrāma nānāyudhadharastathā || 9 || rathaḥ kāryastathā yuktaḥ īṣādaṇḍakabandhuraiḥ || sucakropaskarayutaḥ sarvarūpaḥ patākarāṭ || 2.183.10 || triveṇusaṃtataścaiva vaiyāghraparivāraṇaḥ || kiṃkiṇījālanirghoṣastathā vai supratiṣṭhitaḥ || 11 || upāsaṅgairniṣaṅgaiśca tūṇīrairvarakārmukaiḥ || sarvāyudhairupetaśca tathā vṛkṣādanīyutaḥ ||12|| toyajīrakapiṇḍībhiryuktaḥ śṛṅgaistathaiva ca || sannaddhaḥ sārathistatra bhavedrāma pratodavān || 13 || raśmigrahaṇaviccāpi tathā maṇḍalakovidaḥ || tathāśvahṛdayajñaśca dūradṛṣṭiḥ suyantritaḥ || 14 || svāsanaḥ kālaviccaiva baddhāsiḥ pāśasaṃyutaḥ || pārṣṇiḥ syādāyudhajñasya tathaivāyudhakovidaḥ || 15 || cireṇa mūle yasya syādavasthānaṃ mahābhujaḥ || patākāvaraṇaṃ yasya āyudhānāṃ samarpaṇam || 16 || samāyāntaṃ mahābhāgaṃ tathā sārathirakṣaṇama || syātāṃ dhanurdharau tatra tathā ca rathināvubhau || 17 || yodhau dhanurbhṛtāṃ śreṣṭha sarvāyudhaviśāradau || turagāśca susaṃnaddhā dāntāḥ kāryāstathā rathe || || 18 || tulyavegabalāścaiva tathā laghuparicchadāḥ || ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi tava nāgendrakalpanam || 19 || kuñjaraḥ syātsusannaddhaḥ saparyāṇaḥ kuthā vṛtaḥ || sarvāyudhadharaścaiva tathā yodhā varāyudhāḥ ||2.183.20 || paraśvadhakarāścaiva toyajīrakasaṃyutāḥ || samyagvibhājyāśca tathā śṛṅkhalāvatatāstathā || 21 || patākā ca tathā kāryā kuñjarasya suśobhanā || varāṅkuśadharau tatra syātāṃ manujapuṅgavau || 22 || ekaḥ pṛṣṭhasthitastatra dvitīyaḥ skandhago bhavet || yodhau dvau varadhānuṣkau dvau ca khaḍgadharau darau || 23 || tayoranubhavetāṃ vai tathā rakṣāparāyaṇau || ekaḥ pārṣṇisthitastatra varaśaktipatākadhṛk || 24 || pālayejjaghanaṃ yadvatkuñjarasya mahāmate || evaṃ parasparāyattā rakṣā teṣāṃ yathā bhavet || 25 || mahāmātrasya dharmajña tathā ca gajayodhinaḥ || evameva tathā rakṣyo rathinaḥ sa rathī bhavet || 26 || kuñjarasya tu rakṣārthaṃ bhavedrathacatuṣṭayam || ratherathe gaje vāpi turagāṇāṃ trayaṃ bhavet || 27 || dhānuṣkāṇāṃ trayaṃ proktaṃ rakṣārthaṃ turagasya ca || dhanvino rakṣaṇārthāya varmiṇo'pi niyojayet || 28 || kāryaṃ sarvaṃ susaṃbādhaṃ tathā toraṇarakṣaṇam || yojanā ca tathā kāryā yathā tu syāddhṛtikramaḥ || 29 || saṃbādhaśca tathā rāma na bhavecca parasparam || 2.183.30 || nāgendrakalpaṃ tava sarvayuktaṃ saṃkṣepato bhārgavavaṃśa mukhya|| etattu kṛtvāpi naraḥ sayuddhe jayatyavaśyaṃ samupārjane ca || 31 || iti śrīviṣṇumahāpurāṇe dvitīyabhāge śrīviṣṇudharmottare dvitīyakhaṇḍe mārkaṇḍeyavajrasaṃvāde rāmaṃ prati puṣkaropākhyāne dhanurvede vāhanasajjīkaraṇo nāma tryaśītyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 183 || || samāpto'yaṃ viṣṇudharmottaradvitīyakhaṇḍaḥ |
